`apps/web/src/store/ui.test.ts`:

```typescript
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { safeStorage, UI_STORAGE_KEY, useUi } from "./ui";

const DEFAULT_PERSISTED = {
  theme: "system",
  density: "compact",
  privacy: false,
  sidebarCollapsed: false,
} as const;

function stored(): { state: Record<string, unknown>; version: number } | null {
  const raw = globalThis.localStorage.getItem(UI_STORAGE_KEY);
  return raw === null ? null : JSON.parse(raw);
}

describe("useUi", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    globalThis.localStorage.clear();
    useUi.setState(DEFAULT_PERSISTED);
  });
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllGlobals();
    globalThis.localStorage.clear();
  });

  it("starts with the system theme, compact rows, visible amounts and an open sidebar", () => {
    const state = useUi.getState();
    expect(state).toMatchObject(DEFAULT_PERSISTED);
  });

  it("changes each preference through its action", () => {
    const ui = useUi.getState();
    ui.setTheme("dark");
    ui.setDensity("comfortable");
    ui.togglePrivacy();
    ui.toggleSidebar();
    expect(useUi.getState()).toMatchObject({
      theme: "dark",
      density: "comfortable",
      privacy: true,
      sidebarCollapsed: true,
    });
    ui.togglePrivacy();
    ui.toggleSidebar();
    ui.setPrivacy(true);
    expect(useUi.getState()).toMatchObject({ privacy: true, sidebarCollapsed: false });
    ui.setPrivacy(false);
    expect(useUi.getState().privacy).toBe(false);
  });

  it("persists only the four values under the bursar-ui key, version 1", () => {
    useUi.getState().setTheme("light");
    useUi.getState().setDensity("comfortable");
    expect(stored()).toEqual({
      state: { theme: "light", density: "comfortable", privacy: false, sidebarCollapsed: false },
      version: 1,
    });
  });

  it("restores a stored state", async () => {
    globalThis.localStorage.setItem(
      UI_STORAGE_KEY,
      JSON.stringify({
        state: { theme: "dark", density: "comfortable", privacy: true, sidebarCollapsed: true },
        version: 1,
      }),
    );
    await useUi.persist.rehydrate();
    expect(useUi.getState()).toMatchObject({
      theme: "dark",
      density: "comfortable",
      privacy: true,
      sidebarCollapsed: true,
    });
  });

  it("ignores stored values of the wrong type or outside the allowed set", async () => {
    globalThis.localStorage.setItem(
      UI_STORAGE_KEY,
      JSON.stringify({
        state: { theme: "purple", density: 42, privacy: "yes", sidebarCollapsed: true },
        version: 1,
      }),
    );
    await useUi.persist.rehydrate();
    expect(useUi.getState()).toMatchObject({
      theme: "system",
      density: "compact",
      privacy: false,
      sidebarCollapsed: true,
    });
  });

  it("keeps working when localStorage throws", () => {
    const blocked = {
      getItem: () => {
        throw new Error("blocked");
      },
      setItem: () => {
        throw new Error("blocked");
      },
      removeItem: () => {
        throw new Error("blocked");
      },
    };
    vi.stubGlobal("localStorage", blocked);
    expect(() => useUi.getState().setTheme("dark")).not.toThrow();
    expect(useUi.getState().theme).toBe("dark");
  });
});

describe("safeStorage", () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  });

  it("uses localStorage when it works", () => {
    safeStorage.setItem("safe-storage-test", "a");
    expect(globalThis.localStorage.getItem("safe-storage-test")).toBe("a");
    expect(safeStorage.getItem("safe-storage-test")).toBe("a");
    safeStorage.removeItem("safe-storage-test");
    expect(safeStorage.getItem("safe-storage-test")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("falls back to memory when localStorage throws", () => {
    const fail = () => {
      throw new Error("blocked");
    };
    vi.stubGlobal("localStorage", { getItem: fail, setItem: fail, removeItem: fail });
    safeStorage.setItem("safe-storage-memory", "b");
    expect(safeStorage.getItem("safe-storage-memory")).toBe("b");
    safeStorage.removeItem("safe-storage-memory");
    expect(safeStorage.getItem("safe-storage-memory")).toBeNull();
  });
});

`apps/web/src/lib/theme.test.ts`. It also runs `public/theme-init.js` against jsdom (with and without storage and `matchMedia`):

```typescript
import { act, renderHook } from "@testing-library/react";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import themeInitSource from "../../public/theme-init.js?raw";
import { useUi } from "../store/ui";
import { applyDensity, applyTheme, resolveTheme, useThemeSync } from "./theme";

/** jsdom has no matchMedia: install a controllable one. */
function installMatchMedia(initialDark: boolean) {
  let dark = initialDark;
  const listeners = new Set<(event: MediaQueryListEvent) => void>();
  const query = {
    get matches() {
      return dark;
    },
    addEventListener: vi.fn((_type: string, listener: (event: MediaQueryListEvent) => void) => {
      listeners.add(listener);
    }),
    removeEventListener: vi.fn((_type: string, listener: (event: MediaQueryListEvent) => void) => {
      listeners.delete(listener);
    }),
  };
  Object.defineProperty(window, "matchMedia", {
    configurable: true,
    writable: true,
    value: vi.fn(() => query),
  });
  return {
    query,
    setDark(next: boolean) {
      dark = next;
      for (const listener of listeners) listener({ matches: next } as MediaQueryListEvent);
    },
  };
}

function runThemeInit() {
  new Function(themeInitSource)();
}

function resetDocument() {
  const root = document.documentElement;
  delete root.dataset.theme;
  delete root.dataset.density;
  root.style.removeProperty("color-scheme");
}

afterEach(() => {
  Reflect.deleteProperty(window, "matchMedia");
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  globalThis.localStorage.clear();
  resetDocument();
  useUi.setState({ theme: "system", density: "compact" });
});

describe("resolveTheme", () => {
  it("returns an explicit choice as is and resolves system from the OS preference", () => {
    expect(resolveTheme("light", true)).toBe("light");
    expect(resolveTheme("dark", false)).toBe("dark");
    expect(resolveTheme("system", true)).toBe("dark");
    expect(resolveTheme("system", false)).toBe("light");
  });
});

describe("applyTheme and applyDensity", () => {
  it("set the attributes and the color scheme on <html>", () => {
    applyTheme("dark");
    expect(document.documentElement.dataset.theme).toBe("dark");
    expect(document.documentElement.style.colorScheme).toBe("dark");
    applyTheme("light");
    expect(document.documentElement.dataset.theme).toBe("light");
    expect(document.documentElement.style.colorScheme).toBe("light");
    applyDensity("comfortable");
    expect(document.documentElement.dataset.density).toBe("comfortable");
  });
});

describe("useThemeSync", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    resetDocument();
  });

  it("applies the stored theme and density", () => {
    installMatchMedia(false);
    useUi.setState({ theme: "dark", density: "comfortable" });
    renderHook(() => useThemeSync());
    expect(document.documentElement.dataset.theme).toBe("dark");
    expect(document.documentElement.dataset.density).toBe("comfortable");
  });

  it("follows store changes", () => {
    installMatchMedia(false);
    renderHook(() => useThemeSync());
    expect(document.documentElement.dataset.theme).toBe("light");
    act(() => useUi.getState().setTheme("dark"));
    expect(document.documentElement.dataset.theme).toBe("dark");
    act(() => useUi.getState().setDensity("comfortable"));
    expect(document.documentElement.dataset.density).toBe("comfortable");
  });

  it("follows the operating system while the preference is system", () => {
    const media = installMatchMedia(false);
    renderHook(() => useThemeSync());
    expect(document.documentElement.dataset.theme).toBe("light");
    act(() => media.setDark(true));
    expect(document.documentElement.dataset.theme).toBe("dark");
    act(() => useUi.getState().setTheme("light"));
    act(() => media.setDark(true));
    expect(document.documentElement.dataset.theme).toBe("light");
  });

  it("stops listening when unmounted", () => {
    const media = installMatchMedia(false);
    const { unmount } = renderHook(() => useThemeSync());
    expect(media.query.addEventListener).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    unmount();
    expect(media.query.removeEventListener).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it("works without matchMedia", () => {
    renderHook(() => useThemeSync());
    expect(document.documentElement.dataset.theme).toBe("light");
  });
});

describe("public/theme-init.js", () => {
  function store(value: unknown) {
    globalThis.localStorage.setItem("bursar-ui", JSON.stringify(value));
  }

  it("uses the system theme and compact density when nothing is stored", () => {
    installMatchMedia(true);
    runThemeInit();
    expect(document.documentElement.dataset.theme).toBe("dark");
    expect(document.documentElement.dataset.density).toBe("compact");
  });

  it("applies a stored explicit theme and density without asking the system", () => {
    const media = installMatchMedia(true);
    store({ state: { theme: "light", density: "comfortable" }, version: 1 });
    runThemeInit();
    expect(document.documentElement.dataset.theme).toBe("light");
    expect(document.documentElement.dataset.density).toBe("comfortable");
    expect(media.query.matches).toBe(true);
  });

  it("resolves a stored system theme from the OS preference", () => {
    installMatchMedia(false);
    store({ state: { theme: "system", density: "compact" }, version: 1 });
    runThemeInit();
    expect(document.documentElement.dataset.theme).toBe("light");
  });

  it("falls back to the defaults on corrupted or unexpected storage", () => {
    installMatchMedia(false);
    for (const raw of ["{not json", "null", "42", '{"state":{"theme":"purple","density":7}}']) {
      resetDocument();
      globalThis.localStorage.setItem("bursar-ui", raw);
      runThemeInit();
      expect(document.documentElement.dataset.theme).toBe("light");
      expect(document.documentElement.dataset.density).toBe("compact");
    }
  });

  it("falls back to light and compact when storage and matchMedia are unavailable", () => {
    const fail = () => {
      throw new Error("blocked");
    };
    vi.stubGlobal("localStorage", { getItem: fail, setItem: fail, removeItem: fail });
    runThemeInit();
    expect(document.documentElement.dataset.theme).toBe("light");
    expect(document.documentElement.dataset.density).toBe("compact");
  });

  it("leaks no globals", () => {
    const before = Object.keys(globalThis);
    runThemeInit();
    expect(Object.keys(globalThis)).toEqual(before);
  });
});

`apps/web/src/lib/tones.test.ts`:

```typescript
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { amountTone, toneTextClass } from "./tones";

describe("amountTone", () => {
  it("flow: inflow is positive, outflow is ink and never danger, zero is muted", () => {
    expect(amountTone(1234)).toBe("positive");
    expect(amountTone(-1234)).toBe("ink");
    expect(amountTone(-100000000, "flow")).toBe("ink");
    expect(amountTone(0)).toBe("muted");
    expect(amountTone(-0, "flow")).toBe("muted");
  });

  it("balance: negative is danger, positive and zero are ink", () => {
    expect(amountTone(-1, "balance")).toBe("danger");
    expect(amountTone(0, "balance")).toBe("ink");
    expect(amountTone(5000, "balance")).toBe("ink");
  });

  it("net: positive is positive, negative is danger, zero is muted", () => {
    expect(amountTone(47000, "net")).toBe("positive");
    expect(amountTone(-47000, "net")).toBe("danger");
    expect(amountTone(0, "net")).toBe("muted");
  });

  it("net: the highlight option turns a negative net into ink only when it is false", () => {
    expect(amountTone(-1, "net", { highlightNegativeNet: false })).toBe("ink");
    expect(amountTone(-1, "net", { highlightNegativeNet: true })).toBe("danger");
    expect(amountTone(-1, "net", {})).toBe("danger");
    expect(amountTone(1, "net", { highlightNegativeNet: false })).toBe("positive");
    expect(amountTone(0, "net", { highlightNegativeNet: false })).toBe("muted");
  });

  it("the highlight option does not affect flow or balance", () => {
    expect(amountTone(-1, "flow", { highlightNegativeNet: true })).toBe("ink");
    expect(amountTone(-1, "balance", { highlightNegativeNet: false })).toBe("danger");
  });
});

describe("toneTextClass", () => {
  it("returns the semantic text utility of each tone", () => {
    expect(toneTextClass("positive")).toBe("text-positive");
    expect(toneTextClass("ink")).toBe("text-ink");
    expect(toneTextClass("danger")).toBe("text-danger");
    expect(toneTextClass("muted")).toBe("text-muted");
  });
});

`apps/web/src/lib/thresholds.test.ts`:

```typescript
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  CONSENT_THRESHOLDS,
  consentUrgency,
  FRESHNESS_THRESHOLDS,
  freshnessUrgency,
  urgencyClasses,
} from "./thresholds";

const HOUR = 3_600_000;
const DAY = 24 * HOUR;
const ZONE = "Europe/Rome";
// 2026-11-09 11:00 in Rome (CET, UTC+1). The clocks changed on 2026-10-25, so the next
// weeks have no DST shift.
const NOW = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 9, 10, 0, 0);

describe("thresholds", () => {
  it("expose the central values", () => {
    expect(CONSENT_THRESHOLDS).toEqual({ dangerDays: 3, warningDays: 14 });
    expect(FRESHNESS_THRESHOLDS).toEqual({ dangerHours: 72, warningHours: 24 });
  });
});

describe("consentUrgency", () => {
  it("is danger and expired when the consent is over", () => {
    expect(consentUrgency(NOW - HOUR, NOW, ZONE)).toEqual({
      urgency: "danger",
      daysLeft: 0,
      expired: true,
    });
    expect(consentUrgency(NOW, NOW, ZONE).expired).toBe(true);
    expect(consentUrgency(NOW - 2 * DAY, NOW, ZONE)).toEqual({
      urgency: "danger",
      daysLeft: -2,
      expired: true,
    });
  });

  it("is danger when it ends later today or within 3 calendar days", () => {
    expect(consentUrgency(NOW + 2 * HOUR, NOW, ZONE)).toEqual({
      urgency: "danger",
      daysLeft: 0,
      expired: false,
    });
    expect(consentUrgency(NOW + 3 * DAY, NOW, ZONE)).toMatchObject({
      urgency: "danger",
      daysLeft: 3,
    });
  });

  it("is warning from 4 to 14 calendar days", () => {
    expect(consentUrgency(NOW + 4 * DAY, NOW, ZONE)).toMatchObject({
      urgency: "warning",
      daysLeft: 4,
    });
    expect(consentUrgency(NOW + 14 * DAY, NOW, ZONE)).toMatchObject({
      urgency: "warning",
      daysLeft: 14,
    });
  });

  it("is ok beyond 14 days", () => {
    expect(consentUrgency(NOW + 15 * DAY, NOW, ZONE)).toEqual({
      urgency: "ok",
      daysLeft: 15,
      expired: false,
    });
  });

  it("counts local calendar days, not blocks of 24 hours", () => {
    // 2026-11-12 23:30 Rome is 3 days away; 2026-11-13 00:30 Rome is 4 days away, although
    // the two instants are only an hour apart.
    const before = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 12, 22, 30, 0);
    const after = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 12, 23, 30, 0);
    expect(consentUrgency(before, NOW, ZONE)).toMatchObject({ urgency: "danger", daysLeft: 3 });
    expect(consentUrgency(after, NOW, ZONE)).toMatchObject({ urgency: "warning", daysLeft: 4 });
  });
});

describe("freshnessUrgency", () => {
  it("is danger with no successful sync", () => {
    expect(freshnessUrgency(null, NOW)).toEqual({ urgency: "danger", hours: null });
  });

  it("is ok up to and including 24 hours", () => {
    expect(freshnessUrgency(NOW - 3 * HOUR, NOW)).toEqual({ urgency: "ok", hours: 3 });
    expect(freshnessUrgency(NOW - 24 * HOUR, NOW).urgency).toBe("ok");
  });

  it("is warning above 24 hours up to and including 72 hours", () => {
    expect(freshnessUrgency(NOW - 24 * HOUR - 1, NOW).urgency).toBe("warning");
    expect(freshnessUrgency(NOW - 72 * HOUR, NOW).urgency).toBe("warning");
  });

  it("is danger above 72 hours", () => {
    expect(freshnessUrgency(NOW - 72 * HOUR - 1, NOW).urgency).toBe("danger");
    expect(freshnessUrgency(NOW - 10 * DAY, NOW)).toMatchObject({ urgency: "danger", hours: 240 });
  });

  it("treats a sync time in the future (clock skew) as just synced", () => {
    expect(freshnessUrgency(NOW + HOUR, NOW)).toEqual({ urgency: "ok", hours: 0 });
  });
});

describe("urgencyClasses", () => {
  it("returns the semantic utilities of each urgency", () => {
    expect(urgencyClasses("danger")).toBe("text-danger bg-danger-soft");
    expect(urgencyClasses("warning")).toBe("text-warning bg-warning-soft");
    expect(urgencyClasses("ok")).toBe("text-positive bg-surface-2");
  });
});

`apps/web/src/i18n/i18n.test.ts` (replaces the existing file: the parity test becomes plural-aware, the `many` behaviour of Italian is pinned, `initialLanguage` and `<html lang>` are covered):

```typescript
import i18next from "i18next";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import english from "./en.json";
import i18n, { initialLanguage } from "./index";
import italian from "./it.json";

type Resource = Record<string, unknown>;

function flatten(value: object, prefix = ""): Record<string, unknown> {
  return Object.entries(value).reduce<Record<string, unknown>>((acc, [key, child]) => {
    if (typeof child === "object" && child !== null)
      Object.assign(acc, flatten(child, `${prefix}${key}.`));
    else acc[`${prefix}${key}`] = child;
    return acc;
  }, {});
}

const PLURAL_SUFFIX = /_(zero|one|two|few|many|other)$/;

/** `accounts.count_one` and `accounts.count_other` are both forms of `accounts.count`. */
function pluralBase(key: string): string {
  return key.replace(PLURAL_SUFFIX, "");
}

function baseKeys(resource: Resource): string[] {
  return [...new Set(Object.keys(flatten(resource)).map(pluralBase))].sort();
}

/** Every plural base needs `_one`, `_other` and any other category the language uses. */
function pluralProblems(resource: Resource, locale: string): string[] {
  const forms = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  for (const key of Object.keys(flatten(resource))) {
    const match = PLURAL_SUFFIX.exec(key);
    if (!match) continue;
    const base = pluralBase(key);
    const suffixes = forms.get(base) ?? new Set<string>();
    suffixes.add(match[1] ?? "");
    forms.set(base, suffixes);
  }
  const required = new Set([
    "one",
    "other",
    ...new Intl.PluralRules(locale).resolvedOptions().pluralCategories,
  ]);
  const problems: string[] = [];
  for (const [base, suffixes] of forms) {
    for (const category of required) {
      if (!suffixes.has(category)) problems.push(`${base}_${category}`);
    }
  }
  return problems.sort();
}

describe("translations", () => {
  it("define the same keys in Italian and English, ignoring plural suffixes", () => {
    expect(baseKeys(italian)).toEqual(baseKeys(english));
  });

  it("contain no empty strings", () => {
    for (const value of [...Object.values(flatten(italian)), ...Object.values(flatten(english))]) {
      expect(typeof value === "string" && value.trim().length > 0).toBe(true);
    }
  });

  it("give every plural key all the forms its language needs", () => {
    expect(pluralProblems(italian, "it")).toEqual([]);
    expect(pluralProblems(english, "en")).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe("plural checks", () => {
  it("accept complete forms and flag missing ones", () => {
    const complete = { n_one: "a", n_many: "b", n_other: "c", plain: "d" };
    expect(pluralProblems(complete, "it")).toEqual([]);
    expect(pluralProblems({ n_one: "a", n_other: "c" }, "en")).toEqual([]);
    expect(pluralProblems({ group: { n_one: "a" } }, "en")).toEqual(["group.n_other"]);
    expect(pluralProblems({ n_one: "a", n_other: "c" }, "it")).toEqual(["n_many"]);
  });

  it("compare bases, not suffixes", () => {
    expect(baseKeys({ n_one: "a", n_many: "b", n_other: "c" })).toEqual(["n"]);
    expect(baseKeys({ n_one: "a", n_other: "c" })).toEqual(["n"]);
  });
});

describe("Italian plural category many", () => {
  async function translator(italianResource: Resource) {
    const instance = i18next.createInstance();
    await instance.init({
      lng: "it",
      fallbackLng: "en",
      resources: {
        it: { translation: italianResource },
        en: { translation: { n_one: "{{count}} thing", n_other: "{{count}} things" } },
      },
      interpolation: { escapeValue: false },
      initAsync: false,
    });
    return instance;
  }

  it("is selected by Intl.PluralRules for exact millions", () => {
    expect(new Intl.PluralRules("it").select(1_000_000)).toBe("many");
    expect(new Intl.PluralRules("it").select(2)).toBe("other");
    expect(new Intl.PluralRules("en").select(1_000_000)).toBe("other");
  });

  it("uses the _many key when it exists", async () => {
    const t = (
      await translator({
        n_one: "{{count}} cosa",
        n_many: "{{count}} di cose",
        n_other: "{{count}} cose",
      })
    ).t;
    expect(t("n", { count: 1 })).toBe("1 cosa");
    expect(t("n", { count: 2 })).toBe("2 cose");
    expect(t("n", { count: 1_000_000 })).toBe("1000000 di cose");
  });

  it("does not fall back to _other: without _many the English fallback language answers", async () => {
    const t = (await translator({ n_one: "{{count}} cosa", n_other: "{{count}} cose" })).t;
    expect(t("n", { count: 1_000_000 })).toBe("1000000 things");
  });
});

describe("initialLanguage", () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
    globalThis.localStorage.clear();
  });

  function browserLanguage(language: string) {
    vi.spyOn(globalThis.navigator, "language", "get").mockReturnValue(language);
  }

  it("prefers the stored language", () => {
    browserLanguage("en-GB");
    globalThis.localStorage.setItem("bursar.language", "it");
    expect(initialLanguage()).toBe("it");
  });

  it("follows an English or Italian browser", () => {
    browserLanguage("en-GB");
    expect(initialLanguage()).toBe("en");
    browserLanguage("it-IT");
    expect(initialLanguage()).toBe("it");
  });

  it("defaults to Italian for any other browser language or a bad stored value", () => {
    browserLanguage("de-DE");
    expect(initialLanguage()).toBe("it");
    globalThis.localStorage.setItem("bursar.language", "fr");
    expect(initialLanguage()).toBe("it");
  });

  it("survives a throwing localStorage", () => {
    browserLanguage("en-US");
    vi.spyOn(Storage.prototype, "getItem").mockImplementation(() => {
      throw new Error("blocked");
    });
    expect(initialLanguage()).toBe("en");
  });
});

describe("document language", () => {
  it("follows the active language", async () => {
    await i18n.changeLanguage("it");
    expect(document.documentElement.lang).toBe("it");
    await i18n.changeLanguage("en");
    expect(document.documentElement.lang).toBe("en");
  });
});

/*
 * Semantic colour tokens, stored as space-separated RGB triplets so that Tailwind
 * can build alpha variants (`bg-primary/50`). Values come from the panel UX design
 * (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-09-panel-ux-design.md, section 5) and are checked
 * by tokens.test.ts. Components never use these variables directly: they use the
 * semantic utilities mapped in styles.css (`bg-surface`, `text-muted`, ...).
 *
 * `--on-accent` is the one addition to the table: the foreground for text on an
 * `accent` fill. The `text` token cannot be used there in dark mode (1.8:1).
 */
:root {
  color-scheme: light;
  --bg: 246 247 249; /* #F6F7F9 */
  --surface: 255 255 255; /* #FFFFFF */
  --surface-2: 241 243 247; /* #F1F3F7 */

}

`apps/web/src/styles/base.css`. Everything is inside `@layer base` on purpose: an unlayered `.grid > * { min-width: 0 }` would beat a `min-w-[240px]` utility on a grid child.

```css
/*
 * Global rules. Everything lives in the `base` layer so that Tailwind utilities
 * (for example `min-w-[240px]` on a grid child) still override it.
 */
@layer base {
  *,
  ::before,
  ::after {
    border-color: rgb(var(--border));
  }

  body {
    @apply bg-bg font-sans text-fg antialiased;
  }

  h1,
  h2,
  h3,
  h4 {
    @apply font-display;
  }

  :focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--primary));
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }

  /* Grid children may shrink below their content width: no horizontal page scroll. */
  .grid > * {
    min-width: 0;
  }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    *,
    ::before,
    ::after {
      animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
      animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
      transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
      scroll-behavior: auto !important;
    }
  }
}
```

`apps/web/public/theme-init.js` (classic script, no globals, no inline script under the CSP):

```javascript
// Runs synchronously from <head>, before the first paint, so the panel never flashes
// the wrong theme. It must stay a classic script without globals: the CSP allows
// `script-src 'self'` only. The stored shape is written by src/store/ui.ts
// ({ state: { theme, density }, version }).
(() => {
  const root = document.documentElement;
  let theme = "system";
  let density = "compact";
  try {
    const stored = JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem("bursar-ui") ?? "null");
    const state = stored?.state;
    if (state?.theme === "light" || state?.theme === "dark" || state?.theme === "system") {
      theme = state.theme;
    }
    if (state?.density === "compact" || state?.density === "comfortable") {
      density = state.density;
    }
  } catch {
    // Storage unavailable or corrupted: keep the defaults.
  }
  let dark = theme === "dark";
  if (theme === "system") {
    try {
      dark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches;
    } catch {
      dark = false;
    }
  }
  root.dataset.theme = dark ? "dark" : "light";
  root.dataset.density = density;
})();
```

`apps/web/src/store/ui.ts`:

```typescript
import { create } from "zustand";
import { createJSONStorage, persist, type StateStorage } from "zustand/middleware";

export type ThemePreference = "system" | "light" | "dark";
export type Density = "compact" | "comfortable";

export interface UiState {
  theme: ThemePreference;
  density: Density;
  privacy: boolean;
  sidebarCollapsed: boolean;
  setTheme(theme: ThemePreference): void;
  setDensity(density: Density): void;
  togglePrivacy(): void;
  setPrivacy(on: boolean): void;
  toggleSidebar(): void;
}

/** Browser storage key. public/theme-init.js reads the same key before first paint. */
export const UI_STORAGE_KEY = "bursar-ui";

const memory = new Map<string, string>();

/**
 * `localStorage` can be missing or throw (private windows, blocked site data). Any
 * failure falls back to an in-memory map so preferences still work for the session.
 */
export const safeStorage: StateStorage = {
  getItem(name) {
    try {
      return globalThis.localStorage.getItem(name);
    } catch {
      return memory.get(name) ?? null;
    }
  },
  setItem(name, value) {
    try {
      globalThis.localStorage.setItem(name, value);
    } catch {
      memory.set(name, value);
    }
  },
  removeItem(name) {
    try {
      globalThis.localStorage.removeItem(name);
    } catch {
      memory.delete(name);
    }
  },
};

const DEFAULTS = {
  theme: "system",
  density: "compact",
  privacy: false,
  sidebarCollapsed: false,
} as const satisfies Pick<UiState, "theme" | "density" | "privacy" | "sidebarCollapsed">;

/** Keeps only well-typed persisted values, so a hand-edited or old entry cannot break the panel. */
function sanitize(persisted: unknown): Partial<UiState> {
  if (typeof persisted !== "object" || persisted === null) return {};
  const value = persisted as Record<string, unknown>;
  const clean: Partial<UiState> = {};
  if (value.theme === "system" || value.theme === "light" || value.theme === "dark") {
    clean.theme = value.theme;
  }
  if (value.density === "compact" || value.density === "comfortable") {
    clean.density = value.density;
  }
  if (typeof value.privacy === "boolean") clean.privacy = value.privacy;
  if (typeof value.sidebarCollapsed === "boolean") clean.sidebarCollapsed = value.sidebarCollapsed;
  return clean;
}

export const useUi = create<UiState>()(
  persist(
    (set) => ({
      ...DEFAULTS,
      setTheme: (theme) => set({ theme }),
      setDensity: (density) => set({ density }),
      togglePrivacy: () => set((state) => ({ privacy: !state.privacy })),
      setPrivacy: (on) => set({ privacy: on }),
      toggleSidebar: () => set((state) => ({ sidebarCollapsed: !state.sidebarCollapsed })),
    }),
    {
      name: UI_STORAGE_KEY,
      version: 1,
      storage: createJSONStorage(() => safeStorage),
      partialize: (state) => ({
        theme: state.theme,
        density: state.density,
        privacy: state.privacy,
        sidebarCollapsed: state.sidebarCollapsed,
      }),
      merge: (persisted, current) => ({ ...current, ...sanitize(persisted) }),
    },
  ),
);
```

`apps/web/src/lib/theme.ts`:

```typescript
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { type Density, type ThemePreference, useUi } from "../store/ui";

const DARK_QUERY = "(prefers-color-scheme: dark)";

export function resolveTheme(pref: ThemePreference, prefersDark: boolean): "light" | "dark" {
  if (pref === "system") return prefersDark ? "dark" : "light";
  return pref;
}

export function applyTheme(resolved: "light" | "dark"): void {
  const root = document.documentElement;
  root.dataset.theme = resolved;
  root.style.colorScheme = resolved;
}

export function applyDensity(density: Density): void {
  document.documentElement.dataset.density = density;
}

function darkQuery(): MediaQueryList | null {
  return typeof window.matchMedia === "function" ? window.matchMedia(DARK_QUERY) : null;
}

/**
 * Keeps `data-theme` and `data-density` on <html> in step with the UI store and with the
 * operating system preference. public/theme-init.js already set both before first paint.
 */
export function useThemeSync(): void {
  const theme = useUi((state) => state.theme);
  const density = useUi((state) => state.density);
  const [prefersDark, setPrefersDark] = useState(() => darkQuery()?.matches ?? false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const query = darkQuery();
    if (!query) return;
    setPrefersDark(query.matches);
    const onChange = (event: MediaQueryListEvent) => setPrefersDark(event.matches);
    query.addEventListener("change", onChange);
    return () => query.removeEventListener("change", onChange);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    applyTheme(resolveTheme(theme, prefersDark));
  }, [theme, prefersDark]);

  useEffect(() => {
    applyDensity(density);
  }, [density]);
}
```

`apps/web/src/lib/tones.ts`:

```typescript
export type AmountTone = "positive" | "ink" | "danger" | "muted";
export type AmountKind = "flow" | "balance" | "net";

/**
 * Maps a signed amount in minor units to a colour tone. Every amount in the panel goes
 * through this function.
 * - flow (a transaction, an inflow or outflow): > 0 positive, < 0 ink, 0 muted. Spending is
 *   never red.
 * - balance: negative is danger, positive or zero is ink.
 * - net (inflow minus outflow over a period): > 0 positive, < 0 danger unless
 *   `highlightNegativeNet` is false (then ink), 0 muted.
 */
export function amountTone(
  minor: number,
  kind: AmountKind = "flow",
  options: { highlightNegativeNet?: boolean } = {},
): AmountTone {
  if (kind === "balance") return minor < 0 ? "danger" : "ink";
  if (minor > 0) return "positive";
  if (minor < 0) {
    if (kind === "net") return options.highlightNegativeNet === false ? "ink" : "danger";
    return "ink";
  }
  return "muted";
}

/** Full class names are written out so that Tailwind finds them when it scans the sources. */
export function toneTextClass(tone: AmountTone): string {
  switch (tone) {
    case "positive":
      return "text-positive";
    case "danger":
      return "text-danger";
    case "muted":
      return "text-muted";
    default:
      return "text-ink";
  }
}
```

`apps/web/src/lib/thresholds.ts`:

```typescript
import { calendarDaysUntil } from "@bursar/shared";

export type Urgency = "danger" | "warning" | "ok";

/** Consent expiry, in local calendar days: red at 3 or fewer (or expired), amber at 14 or fewer. */
export const CONSENT_THRESHOLDS = { dangerDays: 3, warningDays: 14 } as const;

/** Data freshness, in hours since the last successful sync: red above 72, amber above 24. */
export const FRESHNESS_THRESHOLDS = { dangerHours: 72, warningHours: 24 } as const;

const HOUR_MS = 3_600_000;

export function consentUrgency(
  validUntil: number,
  now: number,
  timeZone: string,
): { urgency: Urgency; daysLeft: number; expired: boolean } {
  const daysLeft = calendarDaysUntil(validUntil, now, timeZone);
  const expired = validUntil <= now;
  let urgency: Urgency = "ok";
  if (expired || daysLeft <= CONSENT_THRESHOLDS.dangerDays) urgency = "danger";
  else if (daysLeft <= CONSENT_THRESHOLDS.warningDays) urgency = "warning";
  return { urgency, daysLeft, expired };
}

/** `hours` is the exact elapsed time (never negative); a connection that never synced is `danger`. */
export function freshnessUrgency(
  lastSyncedAt: number | null,
  now: number,
): { urgency: Urgency; hours: number | null } {
  if (lastSyncedAt === null) return { urgency: "danger", hours: null };
  const hours = Math.max(0, now - lastSyncedAt) / HOUR_MS;
  let urgency: Urgency = "ok";
  if (hours > FRESHNESS_THRESHOLDS.dangerHours) urgency = "danger";
  else if (hours > FRESHNESS_THRESHOLDS.warningHours) urgency = "warning";
  return { urgency, hours };
}

/** Full class names are written out so that Tailwind finds them when it scans the sources. */
export function urgencyClasses(urgency: Urgency): string {
  switch (urgency) {
    case "danger":
      return "text-danger bg-danger-soft";
    case "warning":
      return "text-warning bg-warning-soft";
    default:
      return "text-positive bg-surface-2";
  }

- [ ] **Step 6: Fix i18n initialisation and add the new keys**

Italian is the default language, `<html lang>` follows the active language from the first paint of React onwards, and a throwing `localStorage` no longer breaks start-up or `setLanguage`.

Finding recorded for the commit body (verified with i18next 27.0.1 and Node 24 in `i18n.test.ts`): `Intl.PluralRules("it").select(1000000)` is `"many"`. i18next looks up `key_many`, then the bare `key`, and never `key_other`; with only `_one` and `_other` present it falls through to the fallback language, so an Italian user would read the English text for exactly 1,000,000, 2,000,000 and so on. Italian plural keys therefore also carry `_many` (Italian needs the "di" there: "1000000 di conti").

`apps/web/src/i18n/index.ts`:

```typescript
import i18n from "i18next";
import { initReactI18next } from "react-i18next";
import en from "./en.json";
import it from "./it.json";

export const SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES = ["it", "en"] as const;
export type Language = (typeof SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES)[number];

const STORAGE_KEY = "bursar.language";

function readStoredLanguage(): string | null {
  try {
    return globalThis.localStorage?.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) ?? null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** Stored choice, then the browser language (`it*` or `en*`), then Italian. */
export function initialLanguage(): Language {
  const stored = readStoredLanguage();
  if (stored === "it" || stored === "en") return stored;
  const browser = globalThis.navigator?.language?.toLowerCase() ?? "";
  return browser.startsWith("en") ? "en" : "it";
}

function setDocumentLanguage(language: string): void {
  if (typeof document !== "undefined") document.documentElement.lang = language;
}

const language = initialLanguage();
setDocumentLanguage(language);
i18n.on("languageChanged", setDocumentLanguage);

void i18n.use(initReactI18next).init({
  resources: { en: { translation: en }, it: { translation: it } },
  lng: language,
  fallbackLng: "en",
  interpolation: { escapeValue: false },
});

export function setLanguage(language: Language): void {
  try {
    globalThis.localStorage?.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, language);
  } catch {
    // Storage unavailable: the choice applies to this session only.
  }
  void i18n.changeLanguage(language);
}

export default i18n;
```

}: { label: string } & InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>) {

        className="mt-1 block w-full rounded-md border border-muted bg-surface px-3 py-2 text-base text-fg"

They start a loopback `vite preview` for the duration of one command and stop it (a test fixture, like the Task 5 QA server, not a dev server), drive the system Chrome in headless mode (no browser download) and write the screenshots to a new temporary directory. Chrome decides light or dark from the operating system preference, which the panel follows while the stored theme is `system`; the script forces it with Chromium's `PreferredColorScheme` setting (1 light, 0 dark; verified on Chrome 157). ```javascript
// Throwaway generator (never committed): renders every token and the contrast pairs
// using the CSS variables of the built stylesheet, in the theme named by the URL hash.
import { readdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { join, resolve } from "node:path";

const dist = resolve(process.argv[2] ?? "");
const out = resolve(process.argv[3] ?? "");
const css = readdirSync(join(dist, "assets")).find((file) => /^index-.*\.css$/.test(file));
if (!css) throw new Error(`No built stylesheet in ${dist}`);

const tokens = [
  "bg", "surface", "surface-2", "border", "text", "muted", "primary", "primary-50", "accent",
  "on-accent", "positive", "ink", "warning", "warning-bg", "danger", "danger-bg", "info", "info-bg",
];
const pairs = [
  ["text", "bg"], ["muted", "surface"], ["primary", "primary-50"], ["positive", "surface"],
  ["ink", "surface"], ["warning", "warning-bg"], ["danger", "danger-bg"], ["info", "info-bg"],
  ["on-accent", "accent"], ["bg", "primary"],
];
const swatch = (name) =>
  `<div class="sw"><i style="background:rgb(var(--${name}))"></i><span>${name}</span></div>`;
const pair = ([fg, bg]) =>
  `<div class="pair" style="color:rgb(var(--${fg}));background:rgb(var(--${bg}))">${fg} on ${bg}<b>1.234,50 €</b></div>`;

writeFileSync(
  out,
  `<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="file://${join(dist, "assets", css)}">
<style>
  body { margin: 0; padding: 24px; font-family: "Inter Variable", sans-serif; background: rgb(var(--bg)); color: rgb(var(--text)); }
  h1 { font-family: "Manrope Variable", sans-serif; font-size: 24px; margin: 0 0 4px; }
  p { color: rgb(var(--muted)); margin: 0 0 16px; font-size: 14px; }
  .row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
  .sw { width: 104px; font-size: 12px; }
  .sw i { display: block; height: 40px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--border)); }
  .pair { padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--border)); font-size: 13px; min-width: 190px; }
  .pair b { display: block; font-family: "Manrope Variable", sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .card { background: rgb(var(--surface)); border: 1px solid rgb(var(--border)); border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; max-width: 420px; }
</style>
<script>document.documentElement.dataset.theme = location.hash === "#dark" ? "dark" : "light";</script>
</head><body>
<h1>Bursar tokens</h1><p>${css}</p>
<div class="row">${tokens.map(swatch).join("")}</div>
<div class="row">${pairs.map(pair).join("")}</div>
<div class="card"><h1>Card title</h1><p>Muted description set in Inter Variable.</p><b style="font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums">1.234,50 €</b></div>
</body></html>`,
);
```

Create `<scratch>/task2-visual-check.sh`:

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Run from apps/web after `pnpm build`. Starts a loopback `vite preview`, takes the screenshots
# with the system Chrome and stops the preview again. Nothing is written inside the repository.
set -euo pipefail
HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
CHROME="${CHROME_PATH:-/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome}"
OUT="$(mktemp -d)"
PORT=4173

node "$HERE/task2-swatch.mjs" "$PWD/dist" "$OUT/swatch.html"
node_modules/.bin/vite preview --host 127.0.0.1 --port "$PORT" --strictPort >"$OUT/preview.log" 2>&1 &
PREVIEW_PID=$!
trap 'kill "$PREVIEW_PID" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
for _ in $(seq 1 50); do
  curl -fs "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/" >/dev/null && break
  sleep 0.2
done

# Headless Chrome will not open a window narrower than about 500 px, so the 390 px views are
# an iframe of exactly 390 px: the page inside it lays out at 390 px.
phone() { printf '<body style="margin:0;background:#888"><iframe src="%s" style="width:390px;height:844px;border:0;display:block"></iframe>' "$1" >"$OUT/$2.html"; }
phone "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/" phone-app
phone "file://$OUT/swatch.html#dark" phone-swatch

# scheme: 1 = light, 0 = dark (Chromium's PreferredColorScheme enum; the panel follows it while
# the stored theme is "system").
shot() { # name url scheme width height
  "$CHROME" --headless=new --disable-gpu --hide-scrollbars \
    --blink-settings=preferredColorScheme="$3" --window-size="$4,$5" \
    --virtual-time-budget=6000 --screenshot="$OUT/$1.png" "$2" >/dev/null 2>&1
}
shot app-desktop-light "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/" 1 1440 900
shot app-desktop-dark "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/" 0 1440 900
shot app-phone-light "file://$OUT/phone-app.html" 1 500 844
shot swatch-desktop-light "file://$OUT/swatch.html#light" 1 1440 900
shot swatch-desktop-dark "file://$OUT/swatch.html#dark" 0 1440 900
shot swatch-phone-dark "file://$OUT/phone-swatch.html" 0 500 844

echo "Screenshots in: $OUT"
ls "$OUT"/*.png
```

  - `feedback.ts`: `type FeedbackTone = "success" | "info" | "warning" | "error"`; `feedback(title: string, detail?: string, tone?: FeedbackTone): void` (default `success`; toast top right, auto-dismiss 4 s, `error` stays until closed; also pulses the save indicator for 1 s); `useToasts()` (store hook used by `Toaster`); `dismissToast(id: number): void`; `useSaveState(): "saved" | "saving"` (saving while `useIsMutating() > 0` or during a pulse).
  - `<Toaster />` (`role="status"` `aria-live="polite"` region; `error` toasts in an `aria-live="assertive"` region), `<SaveIndicator />` (green dot "Saved" / pulsing amber "Saving…").
  - `<Button variant?: "primary" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "danger" size?: "sm" | "md" loading?: boolean icon?: LucideIcon …button props>`; `<IconButton label: string icon: LucideIcon …>` (label → `aria-label` and `title`; 44 px touch target below `sm`).
  - `<Card padding?: "none" | "md" | "lg">`, `<Badge tone: "neutral" | "accent" count?: number>`, `<StatusPill tone: "positive" | "warning" | "danger" | "info" | "neutral" label: string>`, `<DeadlineChip urgency: Urgency label: string title?: string>`.
  - `<Money minor: number currency: string sign?: "auto" | "always" | "never" tone?: AmountTone | "auto-flow" | "auto-balance" | "auto-net" className?>` (uses `useFormatters`, renders `MASKED_AMOUNT` with `aria-label` of the privacy notice when `useUi().privacy`; `tabular` class).
  - `<RelativeTime at: number withTime?: boolean>` (`<time dateTime title={absolute with time}>`), `<MaskedIban masked: string iban?: string | null copyable?: boolean>` (monospace; privacy mode applies `maskIbanDigitsForPrivacy`; copy copies the full IBAN and calls `feedback(t("copy.done"), t("copy.ibanDetail"), "info")`), `<CopyButton value: string label: string onCopied?: () => void>` (icon turns into a check for 1.5 s).
  - `Field.tsx`: `<TextInput label error? hint? …input>`, `<Select label options: { value: string; label: string }[] …>`, `<Switch label description? checked onChange>`, `<FieldError>`.
  - `<PageHeader title: string count?: number subtitle?: string actions?: ReactNode breadcrumb?: ReactNode back?: ReactNode>`.
  - `<Tabs items: { id: string; label: string; count?: number }[] value: string onChange(id: string) ariaLabel: string>` (underlined, arrow-key navigation, `role="tablist"`).
  - `<FilterChips chips: { id: string; label: string; onRemove(): void }[] onClearAll(): void summary?: string>` (renders nothing with no chips; each chip has `aria-label` "Remove filter …").
  - `<SearchInput value onChange(value: string) placeholder debounceMs?: number (250) label>`.
  - `<Pagination page: number pageSize: number total: number onPageChange(page: number)>` (text "21–40 of 840" from `table.range` with plural/count formatting).
  - `DataTable.tsx`: `interface Column<Row> { id: string; header: string; cell(row: Row): ReactNode; sortable?: boolean; align?: "start" | "end"; hideBelow?: "sm" | "md" | "lg"; className?: string }`; `type SortState = { columnId: string; direction: "asc" | "desc" } | null`; `nextSort(current: SortState, columnId: string): SortState` (asc → desc → null); `<DataTable<Row> columns rows: Row[] | undefined getRowKey(row): string | number loading?: boolean skeletonRows?: number sort?: SortState onSortChange?(s: SortState) onRowClick?(row) selectedKey? empty?: ReactNode caption: string>` (row click ignores clicks on buttons, links, inputs, labels; Enter on a focused row triggers it; skeleton rows of varied widths; never a spinner over the table; row height from `--row-height`).
  - `<SkeletonRows rows columns>`, `<Drawer open onClose title width?: 520 footer? children>` (right side, full width below 640 px, focus trap, Esc, restores focus, `aria-modal`), `<Dialog open onClose title children footer>`, `<ConfirmDialog open tone: "primary" | "danger" title body confirmLabel cancelLabel? busy? onConfirm onCancel>` (Cancel on the left; closes itself after a resolved `onConfirm`).
  - `<EmptyState kind: "filter" | "empty" | "positive" | "state" | "notFound" icon?: LucideIcon title description? action?: ReactNode>`; `<InlineEmpty icon? title description?>` (both enter with a 200 ms fade).
  - `<Cascade index: number children>` (motion entry, 35 ms × min(index, 10), 180 ms, no exit; respects reduced motion through `MotionConfig reducedMotion="user"` provided by the shell).
  - `lib/format.tsx`: `<FormatProvider timeZone?: string children>`; `useFormatters(): { locale: string; timeZone: string; money(minor: number, currency: string, options?: FormatMoneyOptions): string; relative(at: number): string; absolute(at: number, withTime?: boolean): string; localDate(date: LocalDate, style?: "short" | "medium" | "long"): string; relativeDay(date: LocalDate): string; now(): number }` (`relativeDay` is Task 1's `formatRelativeDay` against today in the owner's time zone: "Today", "Yesterday", "3 days ago", the medium date beyond 45 days; locale `it-IT` or `en-GB` from `i18n.language`; `timeZone` from the provider or `Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone`).
  - `lib/url-state.ts`: `useUrlState<T extends Record<string, string>>(defaults: T, options?: { validate?: Partial<Record<keyof T, (value: string) => boolean>>; resetOnChange?: (keyof T)[] }): [T, (patch: Partial<T>) => void]` (writes with `replace`; default values absent from the URL; invalid values fall back to the default; keys in `resetOnChange` reset to default when any other key changes, used for `page`). Implemented on `window.history`/`URLSearchParams` with a `popstate` listener so it works before the router exists; Task 4 rewires it to `useSearchParams` without changing the signature.
  - `lib/search.ts`: re-exports `normalizeForSearch` from `@bursar/shared`; `matchesQuery(haystack: string | readonly string[], query: string): boolean`; `naturalCollator(locale: string): Intl.Collator` (`numeric: true, sensitivity: "base"`).
  - `lib/focus-trap.ts`: `useFocusTrap(ref: RefObject<HTMLElement>, active: boolean): void`.
  - i18n prefixes: `common.*` (extend), `feedback.*`, `table.*`, `dialog.*`, `copy.*`, `privacy.maskedIban` (the only `privacy.*` key added here; `privacy.maskedAmount` is Task 2's).

**Read before starting:**

- **The legacy `components/ui.tsx` shadows the new `components/ui/` directory until Task 4.** A file and a directory with the same stem coexist, and `import … from "../components/ui"` resolves to `ui.tsx` first. Nothing in this task touches `ui.tsx`: the components import each other by file name, the tests import the file under test directly, and the barrel is tested as `./index` from inside the directory. Task 4 deletes `ui.tsx`, after which `components/ui` resolves to `components/ui/index.ts`. Do not import `from "../components/ui"` in any file this task adds.
- **Tasks 1 and 2 must be merged.** The code uses `formatMoney`, `formatRelative`, `formatRelativeDay`, `toLocalDate`, `formatAbsolute`, `formatLocalDate`, `maskIbanDigitsForPrivacy`, `MASKED_AMOUNT`, `normalizeForSearch` from `@bursar/shared` (Task 1) and `useUi`, `amountTone`, `toneTextClass`, `Urgency`, `urgencyClasses` from Task 2. The tests were written against exactly those signatures. If a test fails only because a Task 1 or Task 2 function prints different text than the assertion expects, fix the assertion to what the Task 1 spec says, not the component, and say so in the commit body.
- **`formatMoney` groups from four digits in it-IT** (`1.234,50 €`): Task 1 forces `useGrouping: "always"`, overriding the CLDR minimum grouping digits that plain `Intl.NumberFormat("it-IT")` applies. Tests may rely on it.
- **Accent badge text colour.** Use Task 2's token: `Badge` with `tone="accent"` is `bg-accent text-on-accent`. Do not redefine `--on-accent` anywhere in this task; Task 2's `tokens.test.ts` already checks the `on-accent`/`accent` contrast in both themes.
- **Modal backdrop:** `bg-bg/60` (Task 2 verified that opacity modifiers on semantic colours work through `color-mix`). A dark theme needs a dark veil and a light theme a light one, so the backdrop follows `bg` rather than `ink`; Drawer, Dialog and the shell overlay share it.
- **Behaviour decisions the tests pin down** (reviewer checklist): `ConfirmDialog` calls `onCancel` after a resolved `onConfirm` (that is how it "closes itself": the parent owns `open`), stays open and re-enabled when `onConfirm` rejects (the caller reports the failure), ignores a second click and Esc while pending; `Money` in privacy mode drops the tone class so the sign does not leak through colour; `feedback` keeps at most five toasts; `Esc` inside a dialog opened from a drawer closes only the dialog; `useUrlState` keeps parameters it does not own, preserves `history.state` (React Router keeps its `idx` there) and the hash, and lets an explicit `page` in the same patch win over the reset; `SearchInput` commits after `debounceMs`, on Enter, on Escape and on the clear button, and follows `value` when it changes from outside.
- **Widened type:** `useFocusTrap(ref: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, …)` accepts `RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>` (what `useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)` returns in React 19); the contract's `RefObject<HTMLElement>` would not accept it.
- **Not built here, by design:** an `empty.*` i18n prefix (every empty-state string is supplied by the page that uses it), the `AnimatePresence` exit of toasts and dialogs (UX doc §5: entry only), and a `MotionConfig` (the Task 4 shell provides `reducedMotion="user"`).

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { matchesQuery, naturalCollator, normalizeForSearch } from "./search";

describe("matchesQuery", () => {
  it("ignores case and accents in both the query and the haystack", () => {
    expect(matchesQuery("Caffè Roma", "CAFFE")).toBe(true);
    expect(matchesQuery("Caffe Roma", "caffè")).toBe(true);
    expect(matchesQuery("Società Elettrica", "societa elettrica")).toBe(true);
  });

  it("needs every word of the query, in any order", () => {
    expect(matchesQuery("Coffee shop Milano", "milano coffee")).toBe(true);
    expect(matchesQuery("Coffee shop Milano", "milano rent")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("searches across the parts of a row", () => {
    expect(matchesQuery(["Landlord", "Rent November", "-850,00"], "rent landlord")).toBe(true);
    expect(matchesQuery(["Landlord", "Rent November", "-850,00"], "850")).toBe(true);
    expect(matchesQuery(["Landlord", "Rent November"], "gas")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("matches everything for an empty or blank query", () => {
    expect(matchesQuery("anything", "")).toBe(true);
    expect(matchesQuery([], "   ")).toBe(true);
  });

  it("re-exports the shared normaliser", () => {
    expect(normalizeForSearch("  Caffè   ÀB ")).toBe("caffe ab");
  });
});

describe("naturalCollator", () => {
  it("sorts numbers inside text by value and ignores case and accents", () => {
    const names = ["Conto 10", "conto 2", "Conto 1", "Cònto 3"];
    expect([...names].sort(naturalCollator("it-IT").compare)).toEqual([
      "Conto 1",
      "conto 2",
      "Cònto 3",
      "Conto 10",
    ]);
    expect(naturalCollator("en-GB").compare("é", "e")).toBe(0);
  });
});

`apps/web/src/lib/url-state.test.tsx`:

```tsx
import { act, renderHook } from "@testing-library/react";
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { useUrlState } from "./url-state";

const DEFAULTS = { tab: "all", q: "", page: "1" };
const OPTIONS = {
  validate: {
    tab: (value: string) => ["all", "in", "out", "pending"].includes(value),
    page: (value: string) => /^[1-9]\d*$/.test(value),
  },
  resetOnChange: ["page" as const],
};

function useTransactionsState() {
  return useUrlState(DEFAULTS, OPTIONS);
}

beforeEach(() => {
  window.history.replaceState({ idx: 4 }, "", "/transactions");
});

describe("useUrlState", () => {
  it("returns the defaults for an empty query string", () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(useTransactionsState);
    expect(result.current[0]).toEqual(DEFAULTS);
  });

  it("reads valid values and falls back to the default for invalid ones", () => {
    window.history.replaceState(null, "", "/transactions?tab=bogus&page=0&q=coffee");
    const { result } = renderHook(useTransactionsState);
    expect(result.current[0]).toEqual({ tab: "all", q: "coffee", page: "1" });
    window.history.replaceState(null, "", "/transactions?tab=out&page=3");
    const second = renderHook(useTransactionsState);
    expect(second.result.current[0]).toEqual({ tab: "out", q: "", page: "3" });
  });

  it("treats an empty value as the default when the default is not empty", () => {
    window.history.replaceState(null, "", "/transactions?tab=&q=");
    const { result } = renderHook(useTransactionsState);
    expect(result.current[0]).toEqual(DEFAULTS);
  });

  it("writes with replace: no new history entry, state and hash kept, defaults omitted", () => {
    window.history.replaceState({ idx: 4 }, "", "/transactions#top");
    const entries = window.history.length;
    const { result } = renderHook(useTransactionsState);
    act(() => result.current[1]({ tab: "in", q: "rent" }));
    expect(window.location.pathname + window.location.search + window.location.hash).toBe(
      "/transactions?tab=in&q=rent#top",
    );
    expect(window.history.length).toBe(entries);
    expect(window.history.state).toEqual({ idx: 4 });
    expect(result.current[0]).toEqual({ tab: "in", q: "rent", page: "1" });

    act(() => result.current[1]({ tab: "all" }));
    expect(window.location.search).toBe("?q=rent");
    act(() => result.current[1]({ q: "" }));
    expect(window.location.search).toBe("");
  });

  it("never writes an invalid value", () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(useTransactionsState);
    act(() => result.current[1]({ tab: "bogus" }));
    expect(window.location.search).toBe("");
    expect(result.current[0].tab).toBe("all");
  });

  it("keeps parameters it does not own", () => {
    window.history.replaceState(null, "", "/transactions?account=12&tab=in");
    const { result } = renderHook(useTransactionsState);
    act(() => result.current[1]({ tab: "out" }));
    expect(window.location.search).toBe("?account=12&tab=out");
  });

  it("returns to the first page when another key changes, but not when only the page changes", () => {
    window.history.replaceState(null, "", "/transactions?page=4&tab=in");
    const { result } = renderHook(useTransactionsState);
    act(() => result.current[1]({ page: "5" }));
    expect(result.current[0].page).toBe("5");

    act(() => result.current[1]({ q: "gas" }));
    expect(result.current[0]).toEqual({ tab: "in", q: "gas", page: "1" });
    expect(window.location.search).toBe("?tab=in&q=gas");
  });

  it("lets an explicit page in the same patch win over the reset", () => {
    window.history.replaceState(null, "", "/transactions?page=4");
    const { result } = renderHook(useTransactionsState);
    act(() => result.current[1]({ tab: "out", page: "2" }));
    expect(result.current[0]).toEqual({ tab: "out", q: "", page: "2" });
  });

  it("does not reset the page when the other key is set to the value it already has", () => {
    window.history.replaceState(null, "", "/transactions?page=4&tab=in");
    const { result } = renderHook(useTransactionsState);
    act(() => result.current[1]({ tab: "in" }));
    expect(result.current[0].page).toBe("4");
  });

  it("follows the back and forward buttons", () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(useTransactionsState);
    act(() => {
      window.history.replaceState(null, "", "/transactions?tab=pending");
      window.dispatchEvent(new PopStateEvent("popstate"));
    });
    expect(result.current[0].tab).toBe("pending");
  });

  it("keeps two consumers in sync and gives a stable setter", () => {
    const first = renderHook(useTransactionsState);
    const second = renderHook(useTransactionsState);
    const setter = first.result.current[1];
    act(() => first.result.current[1]({ q: "milk" }));
    expect(second.result.current[0].q).toBe("milk");
    first.rerender();
    expect(first.result.current[1]).toBe(setter);
  });
});
```

`apps/web/src/lib/format.test.tsx`:

```tsx
import { act, render, renderHook, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { RelativeTime } from "../components/ui/RelativeTime";
import i18n from "../i18n";
import { FormatProvider, localeFor, useFormatters } from "./format";

const NOW = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 9, 12, 0, 0);

function wrapper(timeZone?: string) {
  return ({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) => (
    <FormatProvider {...(timeZone ? { timeZone } : {})}>{children}</FormatProvider>
  );
}

beforeEach(async () => {
  await i18n.changeLanguage("en");
  vi.useFakeTimers();
  vi.setSystemTime(NOW);
});
afterEach(() => {
  vi.useRealTimers();
});

describe("useFormatters", () => {
  it("maps the language to a locale", () => {
    expect(localeFor("it")).toBe("it-IT");
    expect(localeFor("en")).toBe("en-GB");
    expect(localeFor("en-US")).toBe("en-GB");
  });

  it("formats money, relative and absolute times and local dates in English", () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFormatters(), { wrapper: wrapper("Europe/Rome") });
    expect(result.current.locale).toBe("en-GB");
    expect(result.current.timeZone).toBe("Europe/Rome");
    expect(result.current.money(-123450, "EUR")).toBe("-€1,234.50");
    expect(result.current.money(123450, "EUR", { masked: true })).toBe("•••••");
    expect(result.current.relative(NOW - 2 * 3_600_000)).toBe("2 hours ago");
    expect(result.current.absolute(NOW, true)).toContain("13:00");
    expect(result.current.localDate("2026-11-09")).toMatch(/9 Nov 2026/);
    expect(result.current.relativeDay("2026-11-08")).toBe("Yesterday");
    expect(result.current.now()).toBe(NOW);
  });

  it("switches to Italian when the language changes", async () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFormatters(), { wrapper: wrapper("Europe/Rome") });
    await act(async () => {
      await i18n.changeLanguage("it");
    });
    expect(result.current.locale).toBe("it-IT");
    expect(result.current.relative(NOW - 2 * 3_600_000)).toBe("2 ore fa");
    expect(result.current.localDate("2026-11-09")).toMatch(/9 nov 2026/);
  });

  it("works without a provider and falls back to the browser zone for an unknown zone", () => {
    const browser = Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone;
    const bare = renderHook(() => useFormatters());
    expect(bare.result.current.timeZone).toBe(browser);
    const invalid = renderHook(() => useFormatters(), { wrapper: wrapper("Not/AZone") });
    expect(invalid.result.current.timeZone).toBe(browser);
  });

  it("returns the same object until the language or the zone changes", () => {
    const { result, rerender } = renderHook(() => useFormatters(), {
      wrapper: wrapper("Europe/Rome"),
    });
    const first = result.current;
    rerender();
    expect(result.current).toBe(first);
  });
});

describe("RelativeTime", () => {
  it("renders a time element with the ISO instant and the absolute date with time in the title", () => {
    render(
      <FormatProvider timeZone="Europe/Rome">
        <RelativeTime at={NOW - 3_600_000} />
      </FormatProvider>,
    );
    const element = screen.getByText("1 hour ago");
    expect(element.tagName).toBe("TIME");
    expect(element.getAttribute("datetime")).toBe(new Date(NOW - 3_600_000).toISOString());
    expect(element.getAttribute("title")).toContain("12:00");
  });

  it("shows a dash instead of 'Invalid Date' for a missing instant", () => {
    render(<RelativeTime at={Number.NaN} />);
    expect(screen.queryByText("—")).not.toBeNull();
  });
});
```

`apps/web/src/components/feedback.test.tsx`:

```tsx
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider, useMutation } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { act, fireEvent, render, screen, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import i18n from "../i18n";
import { clearToasts, feedback } from "./feedback";
import { SaveIndicator } from "./ui/SaveIndicator";
import { Toaster } from "./ui/Toaster";

function renderChrome(extra?: React.ReactNode) {
  const client = new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { mutations: { retry: false } } });
  return render(
    <QueryClientProvider client={client}>
      <Toaster />
      <SaveIndicator />
      {extra}
    </QueryClientProvider>,
  );
}

let finishMutation: () => void = () => undefined;

function Trigger() {
  const mutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () =>
      new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        finishMutation = resolve;
      }),
  });
  return (
    <button type="button" onClick={() => mutation.mutate()}>
      Go
    </button>
  );
}

function saveState(container: HTMLElement): string | null {
  return container.querySelector("[data-state]")?.getAttribute("data-state") ?? null;
}

describe("feedback and Toaster", () => {
  beforeEach(async () => {
    await i18n.changeLanguage("en");
    clearToasts();
    vi.useFakeTimers();
  });
  afterEach(() => {
    clearToasts();
    vi.useRealTimers();
  });

  it("shows a toast with title and detail and removes it after 4 seconds", () => {
    renderChrome();
    act(() => feedback("Account renamed", "The account is now called Household"));
    const region = screen.getByRole("status");
    expect(within(region).queryByText("Account renamed")).not.toBeNull();
    expect(within(region).queryByText("The account is now called Household")).not.toBeNull();

    act(() => {
      vi.advanceTimersByTime(3999);
    });
    expect(screen.queryByText("Account renamed")).not.toBeNull();
    act(() => {
      vi.advanceTimersByTime(1);
    });
    expect(screen.queryByText("Account renamed")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("keeps an error until it is closed and announces it in the assertive region", () => {
    renderChrome();
    act(() => feedback("Sync failed", "The bank did not answer", "error"));
    const region = screen.getByRole("alert");
    expect(region.getAttribute("aria-live")).toBe("assertive");
    expect(within(region).queryByText("Sync failed")).not.toBeNull();

    act(() => {
      vi.advanceTimersByTime(60_000);
    });
    expect(screen.queryByText("Sync failed")).not.toBeNull();

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Dismiss notification" }));
    expect(screen.queryByText("Sync failed")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("uses the success tone when none is given and carries the tone on the toast", () => {
    renderChrome();
    act(() => feedback("Saved"));
    act(() => feedback("Sync started", undefined, "info"));
    const tones = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("[data-tone]")).map((element) =>
      element.getAttribute("data-tone"),
    );
    expect(tones).toEqual(["success", "info"]);
  });

  it("keeps at most five toasts, dropping the oldest", () => {
    renderChrome();
    act(() => {
      for (let i = 1; i <= 7; i += 1) feedback(`Toast ${i}`);
    });
    expect(screen.queryByText("Toast 2")).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByText("Toast 3")).not.toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByText("Toast 7")).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it("flips the save indicator to saving for one second after a toast", () => {
    const { container } = renderChrome();
    expect(saveState(container)).toBe("saved");
    expect(screen.queryByText("Saved")).not.toBeNull();

    act(() => feedback("Settings saved"));
    expect(saveState(container)).toBe("saving");
    expect(screen.queryByText("Saving…")).not.toBeNull();

    act(() => {
      vi.advanceTimersByTime(1000);
    });
    expect(saveState(container)).toBe("saved");
  });

  it("shows saving while a mutation is in flight", async () => {
    const { container } = renderChrome(<Trigger />);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Go" }));
    await act(async () => {
      await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(10);
    });
    expect(saveState(container)).toBe("saving");

    await act(async () => {
      finishMutation();
      await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(10);
    });
    expect(saveState(container)).toBe("saved");
  });
});

});

function SwitchHarness() {

  return (

  );
}

describe("Button", () => {

    expect(button.className).toContain("bg-surface");
  });

    render(

        Sync now

    expect(button.disabled).toBe(true);
    expect(button.getAttribute("aria-busy")).toBe("true");

});

});

      </>,
    );

    expect(accent?.textContent).toBe("2");

    expect(lg?.className).toContain("p-6");
  });

  it("writes the page title as a level-one heading with a count badge and actions", () => {

describe("form fields", () => {
  it("links the label, hint and error to the input", () => {

import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import i18n from "../../i18n";
import { useUi } from "../../store/ui";
import { Money } from "./Money";

beforeEach(async () => {
  await i18n.changeLanguage("en");
  useUi.setState({ privacy: false });
});
afterEach(() => {
  useUi.setState({ privacy: false });
});

describe("Money", () => {
  it("formats integer minor units in the active language and uses tabular figures", async () => {
    const { container, rerender } = render(<Money minor={12345050} currency="EUR" />);
    const span = container.querySelector("span") as HTMLElement;
    expect(span.textContent).toBe("€123,450.50");
    expect(span.className).toContain("tabular");

    await i18n.changeLanguage("it");
    rerender(<Money minor={12345050} currency="EUR" />);
    expect((container.querySelector("span") as HTMLElement).textContent).toMatch(
      /^123\.450,50\s€$/,
    );
  });

  it("shows an explicit sign when asked", () => {
    const { container } = render(<Money minor={4700} currency="EUR" sign="always" />);
    expect(container.textContent).toBe("+€47.00");
  });

  it("derives the tone from the amount: inflow green, outflow ink, never red for a flow", () => {
    const { container, rerender } = render(<Money minor={500} currency="EUR" tone="auto-flow" />);
    expect((container.firstChild as HTMLElement).className).toContain("text-positive");
    rerender(<Money minor={-500} currency="EUR" tone="auto-flow" />);
    expect((container.firstChild as HTMLElement).className).toContain("text-ink");
    expect((container.firstChild as HTMLElement).className).not.toContain("text-danger");
    rerender(<Money minor={-500} currency="EUR" tone="auto-balance" />);
    expect((container.firstChild as HTMLElement).className).toContain("text-danger");
    rerender(<Money minor={-500} currency="EUR" tone="auto-net" />);
    expect((container.firstChild as HTMLElement).className).toContain("text-danger");
    rerender(<Money minor={500} currency="EUR" tone="muted" />);
    expect((container.firstChild as HTMLElement).className).toContain("text-muted");
  });

  it("masks the amount in privacy mode, labels the mask and drops the tone", () => {
    useUi.setState({ privacy: true });
    const { container } = render(<Money minor={-12345} currency="EUR" tone="auto-flow" />);
    const masked = screen.getByRole("img", { name: "Amount hidden" });
    expect(masked.textContent).toBe("•••••");
    expect(masked.className).toContain("tabular");
    expect(masked.className).not.toContain("text-");
    expect(container.textContent).not.toMatch(/\d/);
  });
});

import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { type Urgency, urgencyClasses } from "../../lib/thresholds";
import { DeadlineChip } from "./DeadlineChip";

const URGENCIES: Urgency[] = ["danger", "warning", "ok"];

describe("DeadlineChip", () => {
  it.each(URGENCIES)("states the deadline as text for the %s urgency", (urgency) => {
    const { container } = render(
      <DeadlineChip
        urgency={urgency}
        label="Consent expires in 9 days"
        title="Expires on 18 Nov"
      />,
    );
    const chip = screen.getByText("Consent expires in 9 days");
    expect(chip.getAttribute("data-urgency")).toBe(urgency);
    expect(chip.getAttribute("title")).toBe("Expires on 18 Nov");
    for (const token of urgencyClasses(urgency).split(" ")) expect(chip.className).toContain(token);
    expect(container.querySelector("svg")?.getAttribute("aria-hidden")).toBe("true");
  });

  it("uses a different icon for each urgency, so colour is not the only signal", () => {
    const icons = URGENCIES.map((urgency) => {
      const { container, unmount } = render(<DeadlineChip urgency={urgency} label="x" />);
      const name = container.querySelector("svg")?.getAttribute("class") ?? "";
      unmount();
      return name;
    });
    expect(new Set(icons).size).toBe(3);
  });
});

import { act, fireEvent, render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import i18n from "../../i18n";
import { useUi } from "../../store/ui";
import { clearToasts } from "../feedback";
import { CopyButton } from "./CopyButton";
import { MaskedIban } from "./MaskedIban";
import { Toaster } from "./Toaster";

const MASKED = "IT89 •••• •••• 1001";
const FULL_IBAN = "IT89X9900101600000000001001";

function stubClipboard(writeText: (value: string) => Promise<void>) {
  Object.defineProperty(navigator, "clipboard", { value: { writeText }, configurable: true });
}

beforeEach(async () => {
  await i18n.changeLanguage("en");
  useUi.setState({ privacy: false });
  clearToasts();
});
afterEach(() => {
  useUi.setState({ privacy: false });
  clearToasts();
  Reflect.deleteProperty(navigator, "clipboard");
  vi.useRealTimers();
});

describe("MaskedIban", () => {
  it("shows the masked IBAN in monospace and no copy button unless asked", () => {
    render(<MaskedIban masked={MASKED} iban={FULL_IBAN} />);
    const text = screen.getByText(MASKED);
    expect(text.className).toContain("font-mono");
    expect(screen.queryByRole("button")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("hides every digit in privacy mode and labels the mask", () => {
    useUi.setState({ privacy: true });
    render(<MaskedIban masked={MASKED} />);
    const masked = screen.getByRole("img", { name: "IBAN hidden by privacy mode" });
    expect(masked.textContent).not.toMatch(/\d/);
    expect(screen.queryByText(MASKED)).toBeNull();
  });

  it("copies the full IBAN and confirms with an info toast that never shows it", async () => {
    const writeText = vi.fn(async (_value: string) => undefined);
    stubClipboard(writeText);
    render(
      <>
        <Toaster />
        <MaskedIban masked={MASKED} iban={FULL_IBAN} copyable />
      </>,
    );
    await act(async () => {
      fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Copy IBAN" }));
    });
    expect(writeText).toHaveBeenCalledWith(FULL_IBAN);
    expect(screen.queryByText("Copied")).not.toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByText("The full IBAN is on your clipboard.")).not.toBeNull();
    expect(document.body.textContent).not.toContain(FULL_IBAN);
    expect(document.querySelector('[data-tone="info"]')).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it("hides the copy button when the full IBAN is not available", () => {
    render(<MaskedIban masked={MASKED} iban={null} copyable />);
    expect(screen.queryByRole("button")).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe("CopyButton", () => {
  it("turns into a check for 1.5 seconds after copying", async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    stubClipboard(async () => undefined);
    const onCopied = vi.fn();
    render(<CopyButton value="abc" label="Copy code" onCopied={onCopied} />);
    const button = screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Copy code" });
    expect(button.getAttribute("data-copied")).toBeNull();
    await act(async () => {
      fireEvent.click(button);
    });
    expect(onCopied).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(button.getAttribute("data-copied")).toBe("true");
    act(() => {
      vi.advanceTimersByTime(1500);
    });
    expect(button.getAttribute("data-copied")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("reports an error toast when the clipboard cannot be used", async () => {
    render(
      <>
        <Toaster />
        <CopyButton value="abc" label="Copy code" />
      </>,
    );
    await act(async () => {
      fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Copy code" }));
    });
    expect(screen.queryByText("Copy failed")).not.toBeNull();
    expect(document.querySelector('[data-tone="error"]')).not.toBeNull();
  });
});

import { act, fireEvent, render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import i18n from "../../i18n";
import { FilterChips } from "./FilterChips";
import { SearchInput } from "./SearchInput";
import { Tabs } from "./Tabs";

beforeEach(async () => {
  await i18n.changeLanguage("en");
});
afterEach(() => {
  vi.useRealTimers();
});

const ITEMS = [
  { id: "all", label: "All", count: 840 },
  { id: "in", label: "Inflows", count: 120 },
  { id: "out", label: "Outflows", count: 700 },
];

describe("Tabs", () => {
  it("renders a labelled tablist with the selected tab focusable and counts shown", () => {
    render(<Tabs items={ITEMS} value="in" onChange={() => undefined} ariaLabel="Direction" />);
    expect(screen.getByRole("tablist", { name: "Direction" })).not.toBeNull();
    const tabs = screen.getAllByRole("tab");
    expect(tabs.map((tab) => tab.getAttribute("aria-selected"))).toEqual([
      "false",
      "true",
      "false",
    ]);
    expect(tabs.map((tab) => tab.getAttribute("tabindex"))).toEqual(["-1", "0", "-1"]);
    expect(tabs[0]?.textContent).toBe("All840");
  });

  it("moves with the arrow keys, wraps around and supports Home and End", () => {
    const onChange = vi.fn();
    render(<Tabs items={ITEMS} value="out" onChange={onChange} ariaLabel="Direction" />);
    const list = screen.getByRole("tablist");
    fireEvent.keyDown(list, { key: "ArrowRight" });
    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith("all");
    fireEvent.keyDown(list, { key: "ArrowLeft" });
    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith("in");
    fireEvent.keyDown(list, { key: "Home" });
    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith("all");
    fireEvent.keyDown(list, { key: "End" });
    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith("out");
  });

  it("selects a tab on click", () => {
    const onChange = vi.fn();
    render(<Tabs items={ITEMS} value="all" onChange={onChange} ariaLabel="Direction" />);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("tab", { name: /Outflows/ }));
    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenCalledWith("out");
  });
});

describe("FilterChips", () => {
  it("renders nothing without chips", () => {
    const { container } = render(<FilterChips chips={[]} onClearAll={() => undefined} />);
    expect(container.firstChild).toBeNull();
  });

  it("removes one chip or clears all, with a descriptive label on each remove button", () => {
    const onRemove = vi.fn();
    const onClearAll = vi.fn();
    render(
      <FilterChips
        summary="2 filters"
        chips={[
          { id: "account", label: "Account: Household", onRemove },
          { id: "q", label: "“coffee”", onRemove: () => undefined },
        ]}
        onClearAll={onClearAll}
      />,
    );
    expect(screen.queryByText("2 filters")).not.toBeNull();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Remove filter Account: Household" }));
    expect(onRemove).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Clear filters" }));
    expect(onClearAll).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
});

describe("SearchInput", () => {
  function setup(value = "") {
    const onChange = vi.fn();
    const view = render(
      <SearchInput
        value={value}
        onChange={onChange}
        placeholder="Search"
        label="Search transactions"
      />,
    );
    const input = screen.getByRole("searchbox", {
      name: "Search transactions",
    }) as HTMLInputElement;
    return { onChange, input, ...view };
  }

  it("waits 250 ms after the last keystroke and reports only the final value", () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    const { onChange, input } = setup();
    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: "co" } });
    act(() => {
      vi.advanceTimersByTime(200);
    });
    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: "coffee" } });
    act(() => {
      vi.advanceTimersByTime(249);
    });
    expect(onChange).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    act(() => {
      vi.advanceTimersByTime(1);
    });
    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenCalledWith("coffee");
  });

  it("commits at once on Enter, and clears on Escape and on the clear button", () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    const { onChange, input } = setup();
    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: "rent" } });
    fireEvent.keyDown(input, { key: "Enter" });
    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith("rent");

    fireEvent.keyDown(input, { key: "Escape" });
    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith("");
    expect(input.value).toBe("");

    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: "gas" } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Clear search" }));
    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith("");
    expect(input.value).toBe("");
  });

  it("follows the committed value when it changes from outside (Clear filters)", () => {
    const { input, rerender } = setup("coffee");
    expect(input.value).toBe("coffee");
    rerender(
      <SearchInput
        value=""
        onChange={() => undefined}
        placeholder="Search"
        label="Search transactions"
      />,
    );
    expect(input.value).toBe("");
  });
});

import { fireEvent, render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
