```tsx
describe("Pagination", () => {
  it("writes the range as '21–40 of 840' in English", () => {
    render(<Pagination page={2} pageSize={20} total={840} onPageChange={() => undefined} />);
    expect(screen.queryByText("21–40 of 840")).not.toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByText("Page 2 of 42")).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it("writes the range as '21–40 di 840' in Italian", async () => {
    await i18n.changeLanguage("it");
    render(<Pagination page={2} pageSize={20} total={840} onPageChange={() => undefined} />);
    expect(screen.queryByText("21–40 di 840")).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it("groups thousands with the locale and shortens the last page", () => {
    render(<Pagination page={62} pageSize={20} total={1235} onPageChange={() => undefined} />);
    expect(screen.queryByText("1,221–1,235 of 1,235")).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it("goes to the previous and next page, and disables the ends", () => {
    const onPageChange = vi.fn();
    const { rerender } = render(
      <Pagination page={1} pageSize={20} total={50} onPageChange={onPageChange} />,
    );
    const previous = screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Previous page" }) as HTMLButtonElement;
    const next = screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Next page" }) as HTMLButtonElement;
    expect(previous.disabled).toBe(true);
    fireEvent.click(next);
    expect(onPageChange).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(2);

    rerender(<Pagination page={3} pageSize={20} total={50} onPageChange={onPageChange} />);
    expect(screen.queryByText("41–50 of 50")).not.toBeNull();
    expect((screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Next page" }) as HTMLButtonElement).disabled).toBe(
      true,
    );
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Previous page" }));
    expect(onPageChange).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(2);
  });

  it("shows only the range when everything fits on one page", () => {
    render(<Pagination page={1} pageSize={20} total={12} onPageChange={() => undefined} />);
    expect(screen.queryByText("1–12 of 12")).not.toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByRole("button")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("renders nothing for an empty list and clamps a page beyond the end", () => {
    const { container, rerender } = render(
      <Pagination page={1} pageSize={20} total={0} onPageChange={() => undefined} />,
    );
    expect(container.firstChild).toBeNull();
    rerender(<Pagination page={99} pageSize={20} total={50} onPageChange={() => undefined} />);
    expect(screen.queryByText("41–50 of 50")).not.toBeNull();
  });
});
```

```tsx
import { fireEvent, render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import i18n from "../../i18n";
import { type Column, DataTable, nextSort, type SortState } from "./DataTable";

interface Row {
  id: number;
  name: string;
}

const ROWS: Row[] = [
  { id: 1, name: "Coffee shop" },
  { id: 2, name: "Landlord" },
];

const COLUMNS: Column<Row>[] = [
  { id: "name", header: "Counterparty", cell: (row) => row.name, sortable: true },
  {
    id: "actions",
    header: "Actions",
    cell: () => <button type="button">Open menu</button>,
    hideBelow: "md",
  },
];

beforeEach(async () => {
  await i18n.changeLanguage("en");
});

function SortHarness({ onSeen }: { onSeen: (sort: SortState) => void }) {
  const [sort, setSort] = useState<SortState>(null);
  return (
    <DataTable
      caption="Transactions"
      columns={COLUMNS}
      rows={ROWS}
      getRowKey={(row) => row.id}
      sort={sort}
      onSortChange={(next) => {
        onSeen(next);
        setSort(next);
      }}
    />
  );
}

describe("nextSort", () => {
  it("cycles ascending, descending, none, and restarts on another column", () => {
    const asc = nextSort(null, "name");
    expect(asc).toEqual({ columnId: "name", direction: "asc" });
    const desc = nextSort(asc, "name");
    expect(desc).toEqual({ columnId: "name", direction: "desc" });
    expect(nextSort(desc, "name")).toBeNull();
    expect(nextSort(desc, "amount")).toEqual({ columnId: "amount", direction: "asc" });
  });
});

describe("DataTable", () => {
```

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";

function Harness({ onClose }: { onClose?: () => void }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  return (
    <>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
        Open details
      </button>
      <Drawer
        open={open}
        title="Transaction details"
        onClose={() => {
          onClose?.();
          setOpen(false);
        }}
        footer={<button type="button">Footer action</button>}
      >
        <button type="button">First action</button>
        <button type="button">Second action</button>
      </Drawer>
    </>
  );
}

describe("Drawer", () => {
  it("renders nothing while closed", () => {

      <Drawer open={false} title="Details" onClose={() => undefined}>
        content
      </Drawer>,
    );

  });

  it("is a labelled modal dialog 520 px wide by default", () => {

      <Drawer open title="Transaction details" onClose={() => undefined}>
        content
      </Drawer>,

    expect(dialog.style.getPropertyValue("--drawer-width")).toBe("520px");
```

```tsx
import { act, fireEvent, render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import i18n from "../../i18n";
import { ConfirmDialog } from "./ConfirmDialog";
import { Drawer } from "./Drawer";

beforeEach(async () => {
  await i18n.changeLanguage("en");
});

function Nested({ onDrawerClose }: { onDrawerClose: () => void }) {
  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(true);
  return (
    <Drawer open title="Account" onClose={onDrawerClose}>
      <button type="button">Remove</button>
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={confirming}
        tone="danger"
        title="Remove this account?"
        body="It disappears from the list."
        confirmLabel="Yes, remove"
        onConfirm={() => undefined}
        onCancel={() => setConfirming(false)}
      />
    </Drawer>
  );
}

function setup(overrides: Partial<React.ComponentProps<typeof ConfirmDialog>> = {}) {
  const onConfirm = vi.fn();
  const onCancel = vi.fn();
  render(
    <ConfirmDialog
      open
      tone="danger"
      title="Disconnect this bank?"
      body={<p>2 accounts and 840 transactions stay in Bursar.</p>}
      confirmLabel="Yes, disconnect"
      onConfirm={onConfirm}
      onCancel={onCancel}
      {...overrides}
    />,
  );
  return { onConfirm, onCancel };
}

describe("ConfirmDialog", () => {
  it("asks the question, shows the counts and repeats the verb on the button", () => {
    setup();
    const dialog = screen.getByRole("alertdialog", { name: "Disconnect this bank?" });
    expect(dialog.textContent).toContain("2 accounts and 840 transactions");
    const buttons = screen
      .getAllByRole("button")
      .map((button) => button.getAttribute("aria-label") ?? button.textContent);
    expect(buttons).toEqual(["Close", "Cancel", "Yes, disconnect"]);
  });

  it("styles a destructive confirmation as danger and a reversible one as primary", () => {
    setup();
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Yes, disconnect" }).className).toContain(
      "bg-danger",
    );
  });

  it("uses the primary style for the primary tone", () => {
    setup({ tone: "primary", confirmLabel: "Yes, disable" });
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Yes, disable" }).className).toContain("bg-primary");
  });

  it("calls onConfirm and then closes itself through onCancel", async () => {
    const { onConfirm, onCancel } = setup({ onConfirm: vi.fn(async () => undefined) });
    await act(async () => {
      fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Yes, disconnect" }));
    });
    expect(onCancel).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(onConfirm).toBeDefined();
  });

  it("stays open and busy while onConfirm is pending, and ignores a second click", async () => {
    let finish: () => void = () => undefined;
    const onConfirm = vi.fn(
      () =>
        new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
          finish = resolve;
        }),
    );
    const { onCancel } = setup({ onConfirm });
    const confirm = screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Yes, disconnect" });
    await act(async () => {
      fireEvent.click(confirm);
    });
    expect(confirm.getAttribute("aria-busy")).toBe("true");
    expect((confirm as HTMLButtonElement).disabled).toBe(true);
    expect((screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel" }) as HTMLButtonElement).disabled).toBe(
      true,
    );
    fireEvent.click(confirm);
    fireEvent.keyDown(screen.getByRole("alertdialog"), { key: "Escape" });
    expect(onConfirm).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(onCancel).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    await act(async () => {
      finish();
    });
    expect(onCancel).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it("stays open when onConfirm rejects so the action can be retried", async () => {
    const onConfirm = vi.fn(async () => {
      throw new Error("network");
    });
    const { onCancel } = setup({ onConfirm });
    await act(async () => {
      fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Yes, disconnect" }));
    });
    expect(onCancel).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    const confirm = screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Yes, disconnect" }) as HTMLButtonElement;
    expect(confirm.disabled).toBe(false);
    await act(async () => {
      fireEvent.click(confirm);
    });
    expect(onConfirm).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  });

  it("cancels with the Cancel button and with Escape", () => {
    const { onCancel } = setup();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel" }));
    fireEvent.keyDown(screen.getByRole("alertdialog"), { key: "Escape" });
    expect(onCancel).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  });

  it("honours a custom cancel label", () => {
    setup({ cancelLabel: "Keep connected" });
    expect(screen.queryByRole("button", { name: "Keep connected" })).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it("closes alone when opened from a drawer: Escape does not reach the drawer", () => {
    const onDrawerClose = vi.fn();
    render(<Nested onDrawerClose={onDrawerClose} />);
    fireEvent.keyDown(screen.getByRole("alertdialog"), { key: "Escape" });
    expect(screen.queryByRole("alertdialog")).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByRole("dialog", { name: "Account" })).not.toBeNull();
    expect(onDrawerClose).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
```

Expected: FAIL. All 15 test files fail to load (`Failed to resolve import "./search"`, `"./ui/SaveIndicator"`, `"./Money"` and so on) and `Tests  no tests`. A file that loads and runs a test means a name or path in this plan was mistyped: fix that before going on.

- [ ] **Step 8: Implement the libraries: search, focus trap, URL state, formatters**

`useUrlState` is built on `window.history` and `URLSearchParams` with a `popstate` listener and a custom `bursar:urlchange` event so several consumers stay in sync; Task 4 rewires it to `useSearchParams` without changing the signature. `useFormatters` subscribes to `i18n.language` through `useTranslation`, so a language change re-renders its consumers; an unknown time zone falls back to the browser's.

```ts
import { normalizeForSearch } from "@bursar/shared";

export { normalizeForSearch };

/**
 * Accent- and case-insensitive match. Every whitespace-separated word of `query` must appear
 * somewhere in the haystack (a string, or the parts of a row joined together). An empty query
 * matches everything.
 */
export function matchesQuery(haystack: string | readonly string[], query: string): boolean {
  const words = normalizeForSearch(query).split(" ").filter(Boolean);
  if (words.length === 0) return true;
  const text = normalizeForSearch(typeof haystack === "string" ? haystack : haystack.join(" "));
  return words.every((word) => text.includes(word));
}

/** Natural-order collator: "Account 2" sorts before "Account 10", case and accents ignored. */
export function naturalCollator(locale: string): Intl.Collator {
  return new Intl.Collator(locale, { numeric: true, sensitivity: "base" });
}
```

`apps/web/src/lib/focus-trap.ts`:

```ts
import { type RefObject, useEffect } from "react";

const FOCUSABLE = [
  "a[href]",
  "button:not([disabled])",
  'input:not([disabled]):not([type="hidden"])',
  "select:not([disabled])",
  "textarea:not([disabled])",
  '[tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])',
].join(",");

function focusableWithin(root: HTMLElement): HTMLElement[] {
  return Array.from(root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(FOCUSABLE)).filter(
    (element) => !element.hasAttribute("hidden") && element.getAttribute("aria-hidden") !== "true",
  );
}

/**
 * While `active`, moves focus into `ref`, keeps Tab and Shift+Tab inside it and, when it turns
 * inactive or unmounts, gives focus back to the element that had it before. The Tab listener is
 * a native one on the container, so a dialog portalled out of it does not fight with it.
 */
export function useFocusTrap(ref: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, active: boolean): void {
  useEffect(() => {
    const root = ref.current;
    if (!active || !root) return;
    const previous = document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement ? document.activeElement : null;
    (focusableWithin(root)[0] ?? root).focus();

    function onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent): void {
      if (event.key !== "Tab" || !root) return;
      const items = focusableWithin(root);
      const first = items[0];
      const last = items[items.length - 1];
      if (!first || !last) {
        event.preventDefault();
        root.focus();
        return;
      }
      const current = document.activeElement;
      if (!root.contains(current)) {
        event.preventDefault();
        first.focus();
      } else if (event.shiftKey && (current === first || current === root)) {
        event.preventDefault();
        last.focus();
      } else if (!event.shiftKey && current === last) {
        event.preventDefault();
        first.focus();
      }
    }

    root.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => {
      root.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
      if (previous?.isConnected) previous.focus();
    };
  }, [ref, active]);
}

let scrollLocks = 0;
let savedOverflow = "";

/** Stops the page behind a drawer or dialog from scrolling; nested overlays share one lock. */
export function useBodyScrollLock(active: boolean): void {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!active) return;
    if (scrollLocks === 0) {
      savedOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
      document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    }
    scrollLocks += 1;
    return () => {
      scrollLocks -= 1;
      if (scrollLocks === 0) document.body.style.overflow = savedOverflow;
    };
  }, [active]);
}
```

`apps/web/src/lib/url-state.ts`:

```ts
import { useCallback, useMemo, useRef, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";

const URL_CHANGE_EVENT = "bursar:urlchange";

export interface UrlStateOptions<T extends Record<string, string>> {
  /** Per-key validators; a value that fails its validator falls back to the default. */
  validate?: Partial<Record<keyof T, (value: string) => boolean>>;
  /** Keys (such as `page`) that return to their default when any other key changes. */
  resetOnChange?: (keyof T)[];
}

function subscribe(onChange: () => void): () => void {
  window.addEventListener("popstate", onChange);
  window.addEventListener(URL_CHANGE_EVENT, onChange);
  return () => {
    window.removeEventListener("popstate", onChange);
    window.removeEventListener(URL_CHANGE_EVENT, onChange);
  };
}

function currentSearch(): string {
  return window.location.search;
}

function serverSearch(): string {
  return "";
}

function parse<T extends Record<string, string>>(
  search: string,
  defaults: T,
  validate: UrlStateOptions<T>["validate"],
): T {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(search);
  const result: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const key of Object.keys(defaults)) {
    const fallback = defaults[key] as string;
    const raw = params.get(key);
    const usable = raw !== null && (raw !== "" || fallback === "");
    const valid = usable && (validate?.[key]?.(raw) ?? true);
    result[key] = valid ? raw : fallback;
  }
  return result as T;
}

/**
 * Filters, tabs and the selected period live in the URL. Writes use `history.replaceState`
 * (never a new history entry), a value equal to its default is removed from the URL, an invalid
 * value reads as the default, and parameters this hook does not know about are left alone.
 */
export function useUrlState<T extends Record<string, string>>(
  defaults: T,
  options: UrlStateOptions<T> = {},
): [T, (patch: Partial<T>) => void] {
  const search = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, currentSearch, serverSearch);
  const latest = useRef({ defaults, options });
  latest.current = { defaults, options };

  const defaultsKey = JSON.stringify(defaults);
  // biome-ignore lint/correctness/useExhaustiveDependencies: defaults are compared by value through defaultsKey, validators are read from the latest render
  const state = useMemo(
    () => parse(search, latest.current.defaults, latest.current.options.validate),
    [search, defaultsKey],
  );

  const update = useCallback((patch: Partial<T>) => {
    const { defaults: base, options: opts } = latest.current;
    const before = window.location.search;
    const current = parse(before, base, opts.validate);
    const next: Record<string, string> = { ...current };
    let changedOther = false;
    for (const key of Object.keys(patch)) {
      const value = patch[key];
      if (value === undefined || !(key in base)) continue;
      if (value !== current[key]) {
        next[key] = value;
        if (!opts.resetOnChange?.includes(key)) changedOther = true;
      }
    }
    if (changedOther) {
      for (const key of opts.resetOnChange ?? []) {
        if (!(key in patch)) next[key as string] = base[key as string] as string;
      }
    }
    const params = new URLSearchParams(before);
    for (const key of Object.keys(base)) {
      const value = next[key] as string;
      const valid = opts.validate?.[key]?.(value) ?? true;
      if (!valid || value === base[key]) params.delete(key);
      else params.set(key, value);
    }
    const after = params.toString();
    if (after === before.replace(/^\?/, "")) return;
    const url = `${window.location.pathname}${after ? `?${after}` : ""}${window.location.hash}`;
    window.history.replaceState(window.history.state, "", url);
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event(URL_CHANGE_EVENT));
  }, []);

  return [state, update];
}
```

```tsx
import {
  type FormatMoneyOptions,
  formatAbsolute,
  formatLocalDate,
  formatMoney,
  formatRelative,
  formatRelativeDay,
  type LocalDate,
  toLocalDate,
} from "@bursar/shared";
import { createContext, type ReactNode, useContext, useMemo } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

export interface Formatters {
  locale: string;
  timeZone: string;
  money(minor: number, currency: string, options?: FormatMoneyOptions): string;
  relative(at: number): string;
  absolute(at: number, withTime?: boolean): string;
  localDate(date: LocalDate, style?: "short" | "medium" | "long"): string;
  /** A booking date relative to today in the owner's zone ("Yesterday"; the date beyond 45 days). */
  relativeDay(date: LocalDate): string;
  now(): number;
}

const FormatContext = createContext<string | null>(null);

function isTimeZone(value: string): boolean {
  try {
    new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en", { timeZone: value });
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function browserTimeZone(): string {
  return Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone;
}

/** The BCP 47 locale used for numbers and dates: Italian for `it`, British English otherwise. */
export function localeFor(language: string): string {
  return language.toLowerCase().startsWith("it") ? "it-IT" : "en-GB";
}

/** Supplies the owner's time zone (the `TZ` setting). Without it the browser's zone is used. */
export function FormatProvider({ timeZone, children }: { timeZone?: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return <FormatContext.Provider value={timeZone ?? null}>{children}</FormatContext.Provider>;
}

export function useFormatters(): Formatters {
  const { i18n } = useTranslation();
  const configured = useContext(FormatContext);
  const locale = localeFor(i18n.language);
  const timeZone = configured && isTimeZone(configured) ? configured : browserTimeZone();
  return useMemo(
    () => ({
      locale,
      timeZone,
      money: (minor, currency, options) => formatMoney(minor, currency, locale, options),
      relative: (at) => formatRelative(at, Date.now(), locale, timeZone),
      absolute: (at, withTime = false) => formatAbsolute(at, locale, timeZone, { withTime }),
      localDate: (date, style = "medium") => formatLocalDate(date, locale, { style }),
      relativeDay: (date) =>
        formatRelativeDay(date, toLocalDate(Date.now(), timeZone), locale),
      now: () => Date.now(),
    }),
    [locale, timeZone],
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 10: Implement `feedback()`, the toaster and the save indicator**

`feedback.ts` holds a small Zustand store (toasts and a pulse counter) and the toast grammar in a JSDoc. `Toaster` always renders both live regions (a `role="status"` polite one and a `role="alert"` assertive one for errors) so screen readers announce what is added. Toasts enter with a 180 ms `motion` fade and never animate out.

`apps/web/src/components/feedback.ts`:

```ts
import { useIsMutating } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { create } from "zustand";

export type FeedbackTone = "success" | "info" | "warning" | "error";

export interface Toast {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  detail?: string;
  tone: FeedbackTone;
}

const AUTO_DISMISS_MS = 4000;
const PULSE_MS = 1000;
const MAX_TOASTS = 5;

interface FeedbackState {
  toasts: Toast[];
  pulses: number;
}

const useFeedbackStore = create<FeedbackState>()(() => ({ toasts: [], pulses: 0 }));
const timers = new Map<number, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>();
let nextId = 1;

function forgetTimer(id: number): void {
  const timer = timers.get(id);
  if (timer !== undefined) clearTimeout(timer);
  timers.delete(id);
}

export function dismissToast(id: number): void {
  forgetTimer(id);
  useFeedbackStore.setState((state) => ({
    toasts: state.toasts.filter((toast) => toast.id !== id),
  }));
}

/** Removes every toast. Used by tests and when the session ends. */
export function clearToasts(): void {
  for (const id of [...timers.keys()]) forgetTimer(id);
  useFeedbackStore.setState({ toasts: [], pulses: 0 });
}

/**
 * The only way the panel shows the result of an action: a toast at the top right, plus a one
 * second pulse of the save indicator.
 *
 * Grammar (UX doc §7): `title` names the outcome ("Account renamed", "Sync started"); `detail`
 * names the real object and the consequence ("Main account is now called Household", "New
 * transactions appear in a minute"). Never an id, an IBAN or a remittance text.
 *
 * Tones: `success` for something already done (default); `info` for background work;
 * `warning` for a refusal or a restrictive consequence; `error` only for real errors. Success,
 * info and warning disappear after 4 seconds, an error stays until it is closed.
 */
export function feedback(title: string, detail?: string, tone: FeedbackTone = "success"): void {
  const id = nextId++;
  const toast: Toast = detail === undefined ? { id, title, tone } : { id, title, detail, tone };
  const kept = useFeedbackStore.getState().toasts;
  const overflow = kept.slice(0, Math.max(0, kept.length + 1 - MAX_TOASTS));
  for (const old of overflow) forgetTimer(old.id);
  useFeedbackStore.setState((state) => ({
    toasts: [...state.toasts.slice(overflow.length), toast],
    pulses: state.pulses + 1,
  }));
  setTimeout(() => {
    useFeedbackStore.setState((state) => ({ pulses: Math.max(0, state.pulses - 1) }));
  }, PULSE_MS);
  if (tone !== "error")
    timers.set(
      id,
      setTimeout(() => dismissToast(id), AUTO_DISMISS_MS),
    );
}

export function useToasts(): Toast[] {
  return useFeedbackStore((state) => state.toasts);
}

/** "saving" while a mutation is in flight or for one second after a toast; otherwise "saved". */
export function useSaveState(): "saved" | "saving" {
  const mutating = useIsMutating();
  const pulsing = useFeedbackStore((state) => state.pulses > 0);
  return mutating > 0 || pulsing ? "saving" : "saved";
}
```

```tsx
import { Check, CircleAlert, Info, type LucideIcon, TriangleAlert, X } from "lucide-react";
import { motion } from "motion/react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { dismissToast, type FeedbackTone, type Toast, useToasts } from "../feedback";
import { cn } from "./cn";
import { IconButton } from "./IconButton";

const ICONS: Record<FeedbackTone, LucideIcon> = {
  success: Check,
  info: Info,
  warning: TriangleAlert,
  error: CircleAlert,
};

const ICON_TONES: Record<FeedbackTone, string> = {
  success: "text-positive",
  info: "text-info",
  warning: "text-warning",
  error: "text-danger",
};

function ToastCard({ toast }: { toast: Toast }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const Icon = ICONS[toast.tone];
  return (
    <motion.div
      data-tone={toast.tone}
      initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 16 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.18 }}
      className="pointer-events-auto flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-subtle bg-surface p-3 shadow-lg"
    >
      <Icon
        aria-hidden
        size={18}
        strokeWidth={2}
        className={cn("mt-0.5 shrink-0", ICON_TONES[toast.tone])}
      />
      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-fg">{toast.title}</p>
        {toast.detail ? <p className="mt-0.5 text-[13px] text-muted">{toast.detail}</p> : null}
      </div>
      <IconButton
        label={t("feedback.dismiss")}
        icon={X}
        className="-my-1 -mr-1 size-8"
        onClick={() => dismissToast(toast.id)}
      />
    </motion.div>
  );
}

/**
 * Mounted once by the app shell. The polite region carries success, info and warning toasts; the
 * assertive one carries errors, which stay until they are closed. Both regions always exist so
 * screen readers announce what is added to them.
 */
export function Toaster() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const toasts = useToasts();
  return (
    <div className="pointer-events-none fixed top-4 right-4 z-[60] flex w-[min(24rem,calc(100vw-2rem))] flex-col gap-2">
      <div
        role="status"
        aria-live="polite"
        aria-label={t("feedback.region")}
        className="flex flex-col gap-2"
      >
        {toasts
          .filter((toast) => toast.tone !== "error")
          .map((toast) => (
            <ToastCard key={toast.id} toast={toast} />
          ))}
      </div>
      <div
        role="alert"
        aria-live="assertive"
        aria-label={t("feedback.region")}
        className="flex flex-col gap-2"
      >
        {toasts
          .filter((toast) => toast.tone === "error")
          .map((toast) => (
            <ToastCard key={toast.id} toast={toast} />
          ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { LoaderCircle, type LucideIcon } from "lucide-react";
import type { ComponentProps } from "react";
import { cn } from "./cn";

export interface ButtonProps extends ComponentProps<"button"> {
  variant?: "primary" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "danger";
  size?: "sm" | "md";
  /** Disables the button, sets `aria-busy` and swaps the icon for a spinner. */
  loading?: boolean;
  icon?: LucideIcon;
}

const VARIANTS = {
  primary: "bg-primary text-bg hover:opacity-90",
  secondary: "border border-subtle bg-surface text-fg hover:bg-surface-2",
  ghost: "text-fg hover:bg-surface-2",
  danger: "bg-danger text-bg hover:opacity-90",
} as const;

const SIZES = {
  sm: "h-8 gap-1.5 px-3 text-[13px] max-sm:min-h-11",
  md: "h-10 gap-2 px-4 text-sm max-sm:min-h-11",
} as const;

export function Button({
  variant = "primary",
  size = "md",
  loading = false,
  icon: Icon,
  className,
  type = "button",
  disabled,
  children,
  ...props
}: ButtonProps) {
  return (
    <button
      type={type}
      disabled={disabled || loading}
      aria-busy={loading || undefined}
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg font-semibold transition-colors disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50",
        VARIANTS[variant],
        SIZES[size],
        className,
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {loading ? (
        <LoaderCircle aria-hidden size={16} strokeWidth={1.75} className="animate-spin" />
      ) : Icon ? (
        <Icon aria-hidden size={16} strokeWidth={1.75} />
      ) : null}
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useFormatters } from "../../lib/format";
import { type AmountTone, amountTone, toneTextClass } from "../../lib/tones";
import { useUi } from "../../store/ui";
import { cn } from "./cn";

export interface MoneyProps {
  minor: number;
  currency: string;
  sign?: "auto" | "always" | "never";
  /** A fixed tone, or `auto-*` to derive it from the amount with `amountTone`. */
  tone?: AmountTone | "auto-flow" | "auto-balance" | "auto-net";
  className?: string;
}

function resolveTone(tone: MoneyProps["tone"], minor: number): AmountTone | null {
  if (!tone) return null;
  if (tone === "auto-flow") return amountTone(minor, "flow");
  if (tone === "auto-balance") return amountTone(minor, "balance");
  if (tone === "auto-net") return amountTone(minor, "net");
  return tone;
}

/**
 * The only way the panel renders an amount. In privacy mode it prints the mask and drops the
 * tone, so neither the digits nor the sign leak through the colour.
 */
export function Money({ minor, currency, sign, tone, className }: MoneyProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { money } = useFormatters();
  const privacy = useUi((state) => state.privacy);
  const resolved = privacy ? null : resolveTone(tone, minor);
  const text = money(minor, currency, { sign, masked: privacy });
  return (
    <span
      className={cn("tabular", resolved && toneTextClass(resolved), className)}
      {...(privacy ? { role: "img", "aria-label": t("privacy.maskedAmount") } : {})}
    >
      {text}
    </span>
  );
}
```

```tsx
export interface RelativeTimeProps {
  /** Epoch milliseconds. */
  at: number;
  /** Adds the time of day to the absolute date in the tooltip (always true when relative). */
  withTime?: boolean;
}

/** "2 hours ago" under 45 days, a date beyond; the absolute date with time is in `title`. */
export function RelativeTime({ at, withTime = true }: RelativeTimeProps) {
  const { relative, absolute } = useFormatters();
  if (!Number.isFinite(at)) return <span>—</span>;
  return (
    <time
      dateTime={new Date(at).toISOString()}
      title={absolute(at, withTime)}
      className="whitespace-nowrap"
    >
      {relative(at)}
    </time>
  );
}
```

`apps/web/src/components/ui/CopyButton.tsx`:

```tsx
import { Check, Copy } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { feedback } from "../feedback";
import { IconButton } from "./IconButton";

export interface CopyButtonProps {
  value: string;
  /** Accessible name, for example "Copy IBAN". */
  label: string;
  onCopied?: () => void;
}

async function writeToClipboard(value: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    if (navigator.clipboard) {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(value);
      return true;
    }
  } catch {
    // Fall through to the textarea fallback (insecure context or denied permission).
  }
  const area = document.createElement("textarea");
  area.value = value;
  area.setAttribute("readonly", "");
  area.style.position = "fixed";
  area.style.opacity = "0";
  document.body.appendChild(area);
  area.select();
  try {
    return document.execCommand("copy");
  } catch {
    return false;
  } finally {
    area.remove();
  }
}

export function CopyButton({ value, label, onCopied }: CopyButtonProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);

  useEffect(() => () => clearTimeout(timer.current), []);

  async function copy(): Promise<void> {
    if (await writeToClipboard(value)) {
      setCopied(true);
      clearTimeout(timer.current);
      timer.current = setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1500);
      onCopied?.();
    } else {
      feedback(t("copy.failed"), t("copy.failedDetail"), "error");
    }
  }

  return (
    <IconButton
      label={label}
      icon={copied ? Check : Copy}
      data-copied={copied || undefined}
      onClick={() => void copy()}
    />
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { type ComponentProps, type ReactNode, useId } from "react";
import { cn } from "./cn";

const CONTROL =
  "block w-full rounded-lg border border-subtle bg-surface px-3 text-sm text-fg placeholder:text-muted disabled:opacity-50 aria-[invalid=true]:border-danger h-10 max-sm:h-11";

export function FieldError({ id, children }: { id?: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <p id={id} role="alert" className="mt-1 text-[13px] text-danger">
      {children}
    </p>
  );
}

interface FieldShellProps {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  error?: string;
  children: ReactNode;
}

function FieldShell({ id, label, hint, error, children }: FieldShellProps) {
  return (
    <div className="mb-4">
      <label htmlFor={id} className="mb-1 block text-[13px] font-medium text-fg">
        {label}
      </label>
      {children}
      {hint && !error ? (
        <p id={`${id}-hint`} className="mt-1 text-[13px] text-muted">
          {hint}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {error ? <FieldError id={`${id}-error`}>{error}</FieldError> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

function describedBy(id: string, hint?: string, error?: string): string | undefined {
  if (error) return `${id}-error`;
  return hint ? `${id}-hint` : undefined;
}

export interface TextInputProps extends ComponentProps<"input"> {
  label: string;
  error?: string;
  hint?: string;
}

export function TextInput({ label, error, hint, className, id, ...props }: TextInputProps) {
  const generated = useId();
  const inputId = id ?? generated;
  return (
    <FieldShell id={inputId} label={label} hint={hint} error={error}>
      <input
        id={inputId}
        aria-invalid={error ? true : undefined}
        aria-describedby={describedBy(inputId, hint, error)}
        className={cn(CONTROL, className)}
        {...props}
      />
    </FieldShell>
  );
}

export interface SelectProps extends ComponentProps<"select"> {
  label: string;
  options: { value: string; label: string }[];
  error?: string;
  hint?: string;
}

export function Select({ label, options, error, hint, className, id, ...props }: SelectProps) {
  const generated = useId();
  const selectId = id ?? generated;
  return (
    <FieldShell id={selectId} label={label} hint={hint} error={error}>
      <select
        id={selectId}
        aria-invalid={error ? true : undefined}
        aria-describedby={describedBy(selectId, hint, error)}
        className={cn(CONTROL, className)}
        {...props}
      >
        {options.map((option) => (
          <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>
            {option.label}
          </option>
        ))}
      </select>
    </FieldShell>
  );
}

export interface SwitchProps {
  label: string;
  description?: string;
  checked: boolean;
  onChange(checked: boolean): void;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export function Switch({ label, description, checked, onChange, disabled }: SwitchProps) {
  const id = useId();
  return (
    <div className="mb-4 flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
      <div>
        <span id={`${id}-label`} className="block text-sm font-medium text-fg">
          {label}
        </span>
        {description ? (
          <span id={`${id}-description`} className="block text-[13px] text-muted">
            {description}
          </span>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      <button
        type="button"
        role="switch"
        aria-checked={checked}
        aria-labelledby={`${id}-label`}
        aria-describedby={description ? `${id}-description` : undefined}
        disabled={disabled}
        onClick={() => onChange(!checked)}
        className={cn(
          "relative h-6 w-11 shrink-0 rounded-full transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 max-sm:my-1",
          checked ? "bg-primary" : "bg-surface-2 border border-subtle",
        )}
      >
        <span
          aria-hidden
          className={cn(
            "absolute top-0.5 size-5 rounded-full bg-surface shadow transition-all",
            checked ? "left-[calc(100%-1.375rem)]" : "left-0.5",
          )}
        />
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`apps/web/src/components/ui/Tabs.tsx`:

```tsx
import { type KeyboardEvent, useRef } from "react";
import { cn } from "./cn";

export interface TabItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  count?: number;
}

export interface TabsProps {
  items: TabItem[];
  value: string;
  onChange(id: string): void;
  ariaLabel: string;
}

export function Tabs({ items, value, onChange, ariaLabel }: TabsProps) {
  const list = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  function onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>): void {
    const keys = ["ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", "Home", "End"];
    if (!keys.includes(event.key) || items.length === 0) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    const current = Math.max(
      0,
      items.findIndex((item) => item.id === value),
    );
    let next = current;
    if (event.key === "ArrowRight") next = (current + 1) % items.length;
    if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") next = (current - 1 + items.length) % items.length;
    if (event.key === "Home") next = 0;
    if (event.key === "End") next = items.length - 1;
    const target = items[next];
    if (!target) return;
    onChange(target.id);
    list.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[role="tab"]')[next]?.focus();
  }

  return (
    <div
      ref={list}
      role="tablist"
      aria-label={ariaLabel}
      onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
      className="flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto border-b border-subtle"
    >
      {items.map((item) => {
        const selected = item.id === value;
        return (
          <button
            key={item.id}
            type="button"
            role="tab"
            id={`tab-${item.id}`}
            aria-selected={selected}
            tabIndex={selected ? 0 : -1}
            onClick={() => onChange(item.id)}
            className={cn(
              "-mb-px inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 border-b-2 px-3 py-2.5 text-sm transition-colors max-sm:min-h-11",
              selected
                ? "border-primary font-semibold text-fg"
                : "border-transparent text-muted hover:text-fg",
            )}
          >
            {item.label}
            {item.count !== undefined ? (
              <span className="tabular text-xs text-muted">{item.count}</span>
            ) : null}
          </button>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}
```

`apps/web/src/components/ui/SearchInput.tsx`:

```tsx
import { Search, X } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

export interface SearchInputProps {
  /** The committed value (usually from the URL). */
  value: string;
  onChange(value: string): void;
  placeholder: string;
  /** Accessible name of the field. */
  label: string;
  debounceMs?: number;
}

export function SearchInput({
  value,
  onChange,
  placeholder,
  label,
  debounceMs = 250,
}: SearchInputProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(value);
  const committed = useRef(value);
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (value !== committed.current) {
      committed.current = value;
      setDraft(value);
    }
  }, [value]);

  useEffect(() => () => clearTimeout(timer.current), []);

  function commit(next: string): void {
    clearTimeout(timer.current);
    if (next === committed.current) return;
    committed.current = next;
    onChange(next);
  }

  function edit(next: string): void {
    setDraft(next);
    clearTimeout(timer.current);
    timer.current = setTimeout(() => commit(next), debounceMs);
  }

  return (
    <div className="relative">
      <Search
        aria-hidden
        size={16}
        strokeWidth={1.75}
        className="pointer-events-none absolute top-1/2 left-3 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted"
      />
      <input
        type="search"
        aria-label={label}
        placeholder={placeholder}
        value={draft}
        onChange={(event) => edit(event.target.value)}
        onKeyDown={(event) => {
          if (event.key === "Enter") commit(draft);
          if (event.key === "Escape" && draft !== "") {
            setDraft("");
            commit("");
          }
        }}
        className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border border-subtle bg-surface pr-9 pl-9 text-sm text-fg placeholder:text-muted max-sm:h-11 [&::-webkit-search-cancel-button]:hidden"
      />
      {draft !== "" ? (
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-label={t("table.clearSearch")}
          onClick={() => {
            setDraft("");
            commit("");
          }}
          className="absolute top-1/2 right-1.5 inline-flex size-7 -translate-y-1/2 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-muted hover:bg-surface-2 hover:text-fg max-sm:size-9"
        >
          <X aria-hidden size={14} strokeWidth={2} />
        </button>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

`apps/web/src/components/ui/Pagination.tsx`:

```tsx
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useFormatters } from "../../lib/format";
import { IconButton } from "./IconButton";

export interface PaginationProps {
  /** 1-based. */
  page: number;
  pageSize: number;
  total: number;
  onPageChange(page: number): void;
}

export function Pagination({ page, pageSize, total, onPageChange }: PaginationProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { locale } = useFormatters();
  if (total <= 0 || pageSize <= 0) return null;
  const pages = Math.ceil(total / pageSize);
  const current = Math.min(Math.max(1, page), pages);
  const number = new Intl.NumberFormat(locale);
  const from = (current - 1) * pageSize + 1;
  const to = Math.min(current * pageSize, total);
  return (
    <nav
      aria-label={t("table.pagination")}
      className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 px-1 py-3"
    >
      <p className="tabular text-[13px] text-muted">
        {t("table.range", {
          from: number.format(from),
          to: number.format(to),
          total: number.format(total),
        })}
      </p>
      {pages > 1 ? (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <span className="tabular mr-2 text-[13px] text-muted">
            {t("table.pageOf", { page: number.format(current), pages: number.format(pages) })}
          </span>
          <IconButton
            label={t("table.previous")}
            icon={ChevronLeft}
            disabled={current <= 1}
            onClick={() => onPageChange(current - 1)}
          />
          <IconButton
            label={t("table.next")}
            icon={ChevronRight}
            disabled={current >= pages}
            onClick={() => onPageChange(current + 1)}
          />
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </nav>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { cn } from "./cn";

export interface SkeletonRowsProps {
  rows: number;
  columns: number;
  /** Optional classes per column, so columns hidden on small screens stay hidden here too. */
  cellClassNames?: readonly (string | undefined)[];
}

const WIDTHS = ["w-3/4", "w-1/2", "w-2/3", "w-5/6", "w-2/5", "w-3/5"] as const;

/** Table rows of varied widths: the loading state of a table. Never a spinner over a table. */
export function SkeletonRows({ rows, columns, cellClassNames }: SkeletonRowsProps) {
  return Array.from({ length: rows }, (_, row) => (
    <tr
      // biome-ignore lint/suspicious/noArrayIndexKey: placeholder rows have no identity
      key={row}
      aria-hidden
      data-skeleton-row
      className="border-t border-subtle"
      style={{ height: "var(--row-height)" }}
    >
      {Array.from({ length: columns }, (_, column) => (
        <td
          // biome-ignore lint/suspicious/noArrayIndexKey: placeholder cells have no identity
          key={column}
          className={cn("px-4", cellClassNames?.[column])}
        >
          <div
            className={cn(
              "h-3 animate-pulse rounded bg-surface-2",
              WIDTHS[(row * 5 + column * 3) % WIDTHS.length],
            )}
          />
        </td>
      ))}
    </tr>
  ));
}
```

`apps/web/src/components/ui/DataTable.tsx`:

```tsx
import { ArrowDown, ArrowUp, ChevronsUpDown } from "lucide-react";
import type { KeyboardEvent, MouseEvent, ReactNode } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { cn } from "./cn";
import { SkeletonRows } from "./SkeletonRows";

export interface Column<Row> {
  id: string;
  header: string;
  cell(row: Row): ReactNode;
  sortable?: boolean;
  align?: "start" | "end";
  /** Hides the column below this breakpoint. */
  hideBelow?: "sm" | "md" | "lg";
  className?: string;
}

export type SortState = { columnId: string; direction: "asc" | "desc" } | null;

/** Header click cycle: ascending, then descending, then unsorted. */
export function nextSort(current: SortState, columnId: string): SortState {
  if (!current || current.columnId !== columnId) return { columnId, direction: "asc" };
  if (current.direction === "asc") return { columnId, direction: "desc" };
  return null;
}

export interface DataTableProps<Row> {
  columns: Column<Row>[];
  /** `undefined` while the first response is on its way. */
  rows: Row[] | undefined;
  getRowKey(row: Row): string | number;
  loading?: boolean;
  skeletonRows?: number;
  sort?: SortState;
  onSortChange?(sort: SortState): void;
  onRowClick?(row: Row): void;
  selectedKey?: string | number | null;
  /** Shown instead of the body when `rows` is empty. */
  empty?: ReactNode;
  /** Accessible table name (visually hidden). */
  caption: string;
}

const HIDE_BELOW = {
  sm: "max-sm:hidden",
  md: "max-md:hidden",
  lg: "max-lg:hidden",
} as const;

const INTERACTIVE = "button, a, input, select, textarea, label, summary, [role='button']";

function columnClass<Row>(column: Column<Row>): string {
  return cn(
    column.align === "end" ? "text-end" : "text-start",
    column.hideBelow && HIDE_BELOW[column.hideBelow],
    column.className,
  );
}

export function DataTable<Row>({
  columns,
  rows,
  getRowKey,
  loading = false,
  skeletonRows = 8,
  sort = null,
  onSortChange,
  onRowClick,
  selectedKey = null,
  empty,
  caption,
}: DataTableProps<Row>) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const showSkeleton = loading || rows === undefined;

  function onClick(event: MouseEvent<HTMLTableRowElement>, row: Row): void {
    const target = event.target;
    if (target instanceof Element) {
      const inner = target.closest(INTERACTIVE);
      if (inner && event.currentTarget.contains(inner)) return;
    }
    onRowClick?.(row);
  }

  function onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLTableRowElement>, row: Row): void {
    if (event.key === "Enter" && event.target === event.currentTarget) {
      event.preventDefault();
      onRowClick?.(row);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl border border-subtle bg-surface shadow-sm">
      <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-2xl">
        <table className="w-full border-collapse text-[13px]" aria-busy={showSkeleton || undefined}>
          <caption className="sr-only">{caption}</caption>
          <thead>
            <tr className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted">
              {columns.map((column) => {
                const active = sort?.columnId === column.id ? sort.direction : null;
                const Icon =
                  active === "asc" ? ArrowUp : active === "desc" ? ArrowDown : ChevronsUpDown;
                return (
                  <th
                    key={column.id}
                    scope="col"
                    aria-sort={
                      active === "asc" ? "ascending" : active === "desc" ? "descending" : undefined
                    }
                    className={cn("px-4 py-2.5 font-semibold", columnClass(column))}
                  >
                    {column.sortable && onSortChange ? (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        title={t("table.sortBy", { column: column.header })}
                        onClick={() => onSortChange(nextSort(sort, column.id))}
                        className={cn(
                          "inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md hover:text-fg max-sm:min-h-11",
                          active && "text-fg",
                        )}
                      >
                        {column.header}
                        <Icon aria-hidden size={13} strokeWidth={2} />
                      </button>
                    ) : (
                      column.header
                    )}
                  </th>
                );
              })}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {showSkeleton ? (
              <SkeletonRows
                rows={skeletonRows}
                columns={columns.length}
                cellClassNames={columns.map((column) =>
                  column.hideBelow ? HIDE_BELOW[column.hideBelow] : undefined,
                )}
              />
            ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
              empty ? (
                <tr className="border-t border-subtle">
                  <td colSpan={columns.length}>{empty}</td>
                </tr>
              ) : null
            ) : (
              rows.map((row) => {
                const key = getRowKey(row);
                const clickable = onRowClick !== undefined;
                return (
                  <tr
                    key={key}
                    data-selected={selectedKey === key || undefined}
                    tabIndex={clickable ? 0 : undefined}
                    onClick={clickable ? (event) => onClick(event, row) : undefined}
                    onKeyDown={clickable ? (event) => onKeyDown(event, row) : undefined}
                    style={{ height: "var(--row-height)" }}
                    className={cn(
                      "border-t border-subtle",
                      clickable && "cursor-pointer hover:bg-surface-2",
                      selectedKey === key && "bg-primary-50",
                    )}
                  >
                    {columns.map((column) => (
                      <td key={column.id} className={cn("px-4 py-1", columnClass(column))}>
                        {column.cell(row)}
                      </td>
                    ))}
                  </tr>
                );
              })
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`Modal` is the shared shell: portal, backdrop, `aria-modal`, focus trap, scroll lock and Esc handled on the panel with `stopPropagation` so a dialog opened from a drawer closes alone.

`apps/web/src/components/ui/Modal.tsx`:

```tsx
import { X } from "lucide-react";
import { motion } from "motion/react";
import { type CSSProperties, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode, useId, useRef } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useBodyScrollLock, useFocusTrap } from "../../lib/focus-trap";
import { cn } from "./cn";
import { IconButton } from "./IconButton";

export interface ModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose(): void;
  title: string;
  children: ReactNode;
  footer?: ReactNode;
  placement: "center" | "right";
  /** Width in pixels of a right-hand panel; it is full width below 640 px. */
  width?: number;
  role?: "dialog" | "alertdialog";
  /** When false, Esc and a click on the backdrop do nothing (a request is in flight). */
  dismissible?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Shared shell of `Drawer` and `Dialog`: portal, backdrop, `aria-modal`, focus trap, Esc, body
 * scroll lock. It animates on entry only. Esc is handled on the panel and stopped there, so an
 * overlay opened from inside another one closes alone.
 */
export function Modal({
  open,
  onClose,
  title,
  children,
  footer,
  placement,
  width = 520,
  role = "dialog",
  dismissible = true,
}: ModalProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const titleId = useId();
  const panel = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  useFocusTrap(panel, open);
  useBodyScrollLock(open);
  if (!open) return null;

  function onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>): void {
    if (event.key !== "Escape") return;
    event.stopPropagation();
    if (dismissible) onClose();
  }

  const right = placement === "right";
  return createPortal(
    <div
      className={cn(
        "fixed inset-0 z-50 flex",
        right ? "justify-end" : "items-center justify-center p-4",
      )}
    >
      <div
        aria-hidden
        data-backdrop
        className="absolute inset-0 bg-bg/60 backdrop-blur-sm"
        onClick={dismissible ? onClose : undefined}
      />
      <motion.div
        ref={panel}
        role={role}
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby={titleId}
        tabIndex={-1}
        onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
        initial={right ? { opacity: 0, x: 32 } : { opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0, y: 0 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
        style={right ? ({ "--drawer-width": `${width}px` } as CSSProperties) : undefined}
        className={cn(
          "relative flex flex-col bg-surface text-fg shadow-xl outline-none",
          right
            ? "h-full w-full sm:w-[var(--drawer-width)]"
            : "max-h-full w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl",
        )}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-subtle px-5 py-4">
          <h2 id={titleId} className="min-w-0 truncate font-display text-lg font-bold">
            {title}
          </h2>
          <IconButton
            label={t("dialog.close")}
            icon={X}
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={!dismissible}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-5 py-4">{children}</div>
        {footer ? (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-2 border-t border-subtle px-5 py-3">
            {footer}
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </motion.div>
    </div>,
    document.body,
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { type ReactNode, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Button } from "./Button";
import { Modal } from "./Modal";

export interface ConfirmDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  /** `danger` for permanent actions (UX doc §7 level 3), `primary` for reversible ones. */
  tone: "primary" | "danger";
  /** A question for destructive actions: "Disconnect this bank?". */
  title: string;
  /** What changes, with real counts. */
  body: ReactNode;
  /** Repeats the verb: "Yes, disconnect". */
  confirmLabel: string;
  cancelLabel?: string;
  /** Forces the busy state from outside (a mutation owned by the caller). */
  busy?: boolean;
  /**
   * May return a promise. When it resolves the dialog closes itself by calling `onCancel`; when it
   * rejects the dialog stays open and the caller is expected to have reported the failure.
   */
  onConfirm(): void | Promise<void>;
  onCancel(): void;
}

export function ConfirmDialog({
  open,
  tone,
  title,
  body,
  confirmLabel,
  cancelLabel,
  busy,
  onConfirm,
  onCancel,
}: ConfirmDialogProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);
  const running = useRef(false);
  const isBusy = Boolean(busy) || pending;

  async function confirm(): Promise<void> {
    if (running.current) return;
    running.current = true;
    setPending(true);
    try {
      await onConfirm();
      onCancel();
    } catch {
      // The caller reports the failure; the dialog stays open so the action can be retried.
    } finally {
      running.current = false;
      setPending(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onCancel}
      title={title}
      placement="center"
      role="alertdialog"
      dismissible={!isBusy}
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onCancel} disabled={isBusy}>
            {cancelLabel ?? t("common.cancel")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant={tone === "danger" ? "danger" : "primary"}
            loading={isBusy}
            onClick={() => void confirm()}
          >
            {confirmLabel}
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <div className="text-sm text-fg">{body}</div>
    </Modal>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { CircleCheck, FileQuestionMark, Inbox, Info, type LucideIcon, SearchX } from "lucide-react";
import { motion } from "motion/react";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "./cn";

export type EmptyKind = "filter" | "empty" | "positive" | "state" | "notFound";

export interface EmptyStateProps {
  kind: EmptyKind;
  icon?: LucideIcon;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  /** The first step: a button or a link. */
  action?: ReactNode;
}

const DEFAULT_ICONS: Record<EmptyKind, LucideIcon> = {
  filter: SearchX,
  empty: Inbox,
  positive: CircleCheck,
  state: Info,
  notFound: FileQuestionMark,
};

const ICON_TONES: Record<EmptyKind, string> = {
  filter: "bg-surface-2 text-muted",
  empty: "bg-primary-50 text-primary",
  positive: "bg-surface-2 text-positive",
  state: "bg-info-soft text-info",
  notFound: "bg-surface-2 text-muted",
};

/**
 * Five of the seven empty states of UX doc §7: filter-empty, true-empty (say why and give the
 * first step), positive ("All good"), state-dependent and not found. The sixth is
 * `InlineEmpty` and the seventh, the error state, is the page's own error block.
 */
export function EmptyState({ kind, icon, title, description, action }: EmptyStateProps) {
  const Icon = icon ?? DEFAULT_ICONS[kind];
  return (
    <motion.div
      data-kind={kind}
      initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
      className="flex flex-col items-center px-6 py-12 text-center"
    >
      <span
        className={cn(
          "mb-4 inline-flex size-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl",
          ICON_TONES[kind],
        )}
      >
        <Icon aria-hidden size={22} strokeWidth={1.75} />
      </span>
      <p className="font-display text-base font-bold text-fg">{title}</p>
      {description ? <p className="mt-1 max-w-md text-sm text-muted">{description}</p> : null}
      {action ? <div className="mt-4">{action}</div> : null}
    </motion.div>
  );
}

export interface InlineEmptyProps {
  icon?: LucideIcon;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
}

/** A small empty inside a card or popover ("No notifications"). */
export function InlineEmpty({ icon: Icon = Inbox, title, description }: InlineEmptyProps) {
  return (
    <motion.div
      data-kind="inline"
      initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
      className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-6 text-sm text-muted"
    >
      <Icon aria-hidden size={18} strokeWidth={1.75} className="shrink-0" />
      <div>
        <p className="font-medium text-fg">{title}</p>
        {description ? <p>{description}</p> : null}
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { motion } from "motion/react";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

export interface CascadeProps {
  /** Position in the list; the delay is 35 ms per step, capped at 10 steps. */
  index: number;
  children: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Entry animation for cards and list items: 180 ms fade and rise, no exit. Reduced motion is
 * honoured by the `MotionConfig reducedMotion="user"` the app shell provides.
 */
export function Cascade({ index, children, className }: CascadeProps) {
  return (
    <motion.div
      className={className}
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.18, delay: 0.035 * Math.min(Math.max(0, index), 10) }}
    >
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 14: Run the tests to see them pass**

Run: `<prefix> && pnpm --filter @bursar/web test src/components src/lib/url-state.test.tsx src/lib/search.test.ts src/lib/format.test.tsx`

Expected: `Test Files  15 passed (15)` and `Tests  100 passed (100)`; no `act(...)` warnings and no unhandled errors in the output. If a count differs, a file was skipped or a test was lost: do not continue.

- [ ] **Step 15: Format, lint, type check, run everything and build**

Run: `<prefix> && pnpm format && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test`
Expected: Biome reports no errors (the `recommended` deprecation info line is harmless); both `tsc` runs exit 0; paste the `Test Files … Tests …` summary line of each package. The web package shows the previous web tests plus the 100 new ones; zero executed tests in any package counts as a failure.

Then check that Tailwind generated the utilities the primitives rely on, and that the build references no external font:

```bash
<prefix> && pnpm --filter @bursar/web build
<prefix> && for k in 'on-accent' 'max-md\:hidden' 'drawer-width' 'animate-spin' 'bg-primary-50'; do grep -qF -- "$k" apps/web/dist/assets/*.css && echo "ok $k" || echo "MISSING $k"; done
<prefix> && grep -R "fonts.googleapis" apps/web/dist || echo "no external fonts"
```

Expected: the build succeeds, five `ok …` lines, and `no external fonts`. A `MISSING` line means the class is not in any scanned source or the Tailwind scan root changed: investigate before continuing.

- [ ] **Step 16: Visual QA of the primitives (screenshots, desktop light and dark, 390 px)**

UX doc §9 makes the Playwright QA run the definition of done for a UI task, but the harness is built in Task 5 and visits shipped routes only, and no route uses these primitives yet. This step is therefore the visual gate for Task 3 itself: a throwaway gallery page renders every primitive in its states, a script builds it, serves it on loopback for the length of the script (a fixture started and stopped inside one command, like the Task 5 QA server) and photographs it with the system Chrome (no browser download, no new dependency). The 390 px shots load the gallery in a 390 px-wide iframe, because headless Chrome will not open a window narrower than about 500 px and the responsive classes need a real 390 px viewport. The temporary files are removed in the next step and are not committed. From Task 5 on, `pnpm --filter @bursar/web qa` covers the primitives in context, and every page task's reviewer looks at those screenshots.

Create the four temporary files exactly. The gallery uses Task 2's real tokens (`./styles.css`) and Task 1's formatters, so what you see is what the panel will show.

```tsx
const root = document.getElementById("root");
if (!root) throw new Error("Missing #root element");
if (params.get("frame") === "phone") {
  // A 390 px iframe gives the page a real 390 px viewport, so the responsive classes apply.

}
```

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Temporary Task 3 visual check. Builds the gallery, serves it on loopback for the length of this
# script, takes the screenshots with the system Chrome and stops the server. Never committed.
set -euo pipefail

CHROME="${CHROME_PATH:-/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome}"
OUT="$(mktemp -d)"
QA_GALLERY_OUT="$OUT/site" pnpm exec vite build -c vite.gallery.config.ts >/dev/null

PORT="$(python3 -c 'import socket; s = socket.socket(); s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0)); print(s.getsockname()[1])')"
python3 -m http.server "$PORT" --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory "$OUT/site" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
SERVER_PID=$!
trap 'kill "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
sleep 1

shoot() {
  local name="$1" width="$2" height="$3" query="$4"
  "$CHROME" --headless=new --disable-gpu --hide-scrollbars --window-size="$width,$height" \
```

**Implementation notes (read before Step 1):**
- `react-router` 8 exports the `<Router>` component under the name `Router`; the router instance type is `DataRouter`. `createAppRouter()` therefore returns `DataRouter` (the same object `createBrowserRouter` returns). `router.tsx` also exports `appRoutes(): RouteObject[]` so tests mount the real route tree in `createMemoryRouter`.
- `matchRoute(pathname, routes = shippedRoutes())`: the optional second argument lets the tests check precedence on routes that are not shipped yet; every caller in the app omits it.
- `ApiError` keeps the M0 constructor shape `(status, message)` and adds an optional third argument `{ code, retryAt, path, isJson }`. `path` and `isJson` are extra readonly fields the query client needs: a 401 counts as an expired session only outside `/api/auth/*`, and Cloudflare Access at the edge answers with an HTML 403 (not JSON).
- The palette's open state lives in a React context (`PaletteProvider` / `usePaletteControl()` exported from `CommandPalette.tsx`), because `useGlobalShortcuts()` takes no arguments and Zustand is reserved for preferences (UX doc §5 "Libraries").
- `RequireAuth` takes `area: "app" | "auth"` and renders `<Outlet />` when access is allowed. It also exports `safeNext`, `loginPath` and `expireSession(router, queryClient)`, which `main.tsx` passes to the query client as `onUnauthorized`.
- `Breadcrumbs` props: `{ routeId: RouteId; current?: string }` (`current` replaces the last label, for example an account name). `BackButton` props: `{ routeId: RouteId }`; it also treats a missing `history.state.idx` as a first entry, so it never leaves the app.
- `NotificationsPopover` already renders the list from its props (title with “N new” chip, 6 items, tone icon, unread dot, two-line body, relative time, “Mark all as read” disabled at zero); Task 22 only replaces the body of `useNotificationsFeed()`.
- Task 3 primitives used here, with the props from its Interfaces block: `Button` (`variant`, `loading`, `className`, `type`), `Badge`, `EmptyState`, `InlineEmpty`, `PageHeader`, `TextInput` (`label`, `hint`, input props), `RelativeTime`, `Toaster`, `SaveIndicator`, `feedback`, `FormatProvider`, `useFormatters`, `matchesQuery`, `normalizeForSearch`, `useFocusTrap`. `Sidebar` calls `useFocusTrap(drawerRef, drawerOpen)` with `useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)`, whose React 19 type is `RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>`: if Task 3 typed the parameter as `RefObject<HTMLElement>`, widen it to `RefObject<HTMLElement | null>` in `lib/focus-trap.ts` (one-line type change, no behaviour change) and say so in the commit body.
- Colours: semantic utilities only. Overlays use `bg-fg/30` with `backdrop-blur-sm`; the topbar uses `bg-surface/80 backdrop-blur-md`; the active nav bar is `before:bg-accent`. Sidebar widths are the spacing utilities `w-66` (264 px) and `w-19` (76 px), with `lg:pl-66` / `lg:pl-19` on the content column.
- Inline styles: only `motion` (entry transition) and `document.body.style.overflow` (palette scroll lock) set styles, both through the CSSOM, which `style-src 'self'` allows. Task 5's QA run is the check.

- [ ] **Step 2: Write the test helper and the failing tests**

A memory-router helper used by every router-aware test (it mirrors the app's query client: no retries) and a `fetch` stub keyed by `METHOD path`.

`apps/web/src/test/router.tsx`:

```tsx
import type { AuthStatus } from "@bursar/shared";
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { render } from "@testing-library/react";
import { createMemoryRouter, type RouteObject } from "react-router";
import { RouterProvider } from "react-router/dom";
import { vi } from "vitest";
import { queryKeys } from "../lib/query-keys";

/** A query client like the app's (no retries) with an optional auth status already cached. */
export function testQueryClient(authStatus?: AuthStatus): QueryClient {
  const client = new QueryClient({
    defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false }, mutations: { retry: false } },
  });
  if (authStatus) client.setQueryData(queryKeys.authStatus, authStatus);
  return client;
}

/** Renders a memory router over `routes` and returns it with the query client. */
export function renderRoutes(
  routes: RouteObject[],
  options: { initialEntries?: string[]; initialIndex?: number; client?: QueryClient } = {},
) {
  const client = options.client ?? testQueryClient();
  const router = createMemoryRouter(routes, {
    initialEntries: options.initialEntries ?? ["/"],
    initialIndex: options.initialIndex,
  });
  const view = render(
    <QueryClientProvider client={client}>
      <RouterProvider router={router} />
    </QueryClientProvider>,
  );
  return { router, client, ...view };
}

/** Stubs `fetch` with a handler per "METHOD path"; unknown requests answer 404 JSON. */
export function stubApi(
  handlers: Record<string, (body: unknown) => { status: number; body?: unknown }>,
) {
  const fetchMock = vi.fn(async (input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit) => {
    const key = `${init?.method ?? "GET"} ${String(input)}`;
    const handler = handlers[key];
    const parsed: unknown = typeof init?.body === "string" ? JSON.parse(init.body) : undefined;
    const result = handler ? handler(parsed) : { status: 404, body: { error: "Not found" } };
    return new Response(result.body === undefined ? null : JSON.stringify(result.body), {
      status: result.status,
      headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
    });
  });
  vi.stubGlobal("fetch", fetchMock);
  return fetchMock;
}
```

`apps/web/src/app/routes.test.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import en from "../i18n/en.json";
import it_ from "../i18n/it.json";
import {
  breadcrumbTrail,
  buildPath,
  matchRoute,
  NAV_GROUPS,
  ROUTES,
  routeById,
  shippedRoutes,
} from "./routes";

const allShipped = ROUTES.map((def) => ({ ...def, shipped: true }));

function lookup(tree: unknown, key: string): unknown {
  return key.split(".").reduce<unknown>((node, part) => {
    return typeof node === "object" && node !== null
      ? (node as Record<string, unknown>)[part]
      : undefined;
  }, tree);
}

describe("route registry", () => {
  it("registers every M1–M4 page once, with Home as the only shipped route", () => {
    expect(ROUTES.map((def) => def.id)).toEqual([
      "home",
      "accounts",
      "account",
      "connect",
      "connectCallback",
      "transactions",
      "documents",
      "reports",
      "chat",
      "agents",
      "activity",
      "settings",
    ]);
    expect(shippedRoutes().map((def) => def.id)).toEqual(["home"]);
    expect(new Set(ROUTES.map((def) => def.path)).size).toBe(ROUTES.length);
  });

  it("places routes in the UX doc's navigation groups", () => {
    const groups = Object.fromEntries(ROUTES.map((def) => [def.id, def.group]));
    expect(groups).toEqual({
      home: "top",
      accounts: "money",
      account: null,
      connect: null,
      connectCallback: null,
      transactions: "money",
      documents: "knowledge",
      reports: "knowledge",
      chat: "agents",
      agents: "agents",
      activity: "agents",
      settings: "bottom",
    });
    for (const id of ["account", "connect", "connectCallback"] as const) {
      expect(routeById(id).parent).toBe("accounts");
    }
    expect(NAV_GROUPS).toEqual(["top", "money", "knowledge", "agents", "bottom"]);
  });

  it("has a title, description and keywords in both languages for every route", () => {
    for (const def of ROUTES) {
      for (const key of [def.titleKey, def.descriptionKey, def.keywordsKey]) {
        expect(typeof lookup(en, key), `en ${key}`).toBe("string");
        expect(typeof lookup(it_, key), `it ${key}`).toBe("string");
      }
    }
  });
});

describe("matchRoute", () => {
  it("prefers the route with the most fixed segments", () => {
    expect(matchRoute("/connect", allShipped)?.route.id).toBe("connect");
    expect(matchRoute("/connect/callback", allShipped)?.route.id).toBe("connectCallback");
    expect(matchRoute("/accounts", allShipped)?.route.id).toBe("accounts");
    expect(matchRoute("/", allShipped)?.route.id).toBe("home");
  });

  it("extracts and decodes parameters", () => {
    const match = matchRoute("/accounts/12", allShipped);
    expect(match?.route.id).toBe("account");
    expect(match?.params).toEqual({ accountId: "12" });
    expect(matchRoute("/accounts/a%20b/", allShipped)?.params).toEqual({ accountId: "a b" });
  });

  it("returns null for unknown paths, malformed escapes and unshipped routes by default", () => {
    expect(matchRoute("/nowhere", allShipped)).toBeNull();
    expect(matchRoute("/accounts/12/extra", allShipped)).toBeNull();
    expect(matchRoute("/accounts/%E0%A4%A", allShipped)).toBeNull();
    expect(matchRoute("/accounts")).toBeNull();
    expect(matchRoute("/connect/callback")).toBeNull();
    expect(matchRoute("/")?.route.id).toBe("home");
  });
});

describe("breadcrumbTrail", () => {
  it("lists the ancestors from the top down and ends with the route", () => {
    expect(breadcrumbTrail("account").map((def) => def.id)).toEqual(["accounts", "account"]);
    expect(breadcrumbTrail("connectCallback").map((def) => def.id)).toEqual([
      "accounts",
      "connectCallback",
    ]);
    expect(breadcrumbTrail("home").map((def) => def.id)).toEqual(["home"]);
  });
});

describe("buildPath", () => {
  it("fills parameters and leaves out empty search values", () => {
    expect(buildPath("home")).toBe("/");
    expect(buildPath("account", { accountId: 12 })).toBe("/accounts/12");
    expect(buildPath("transactions", {}, { tab: "in", q: "", from: "2026-11-01" })).toBe(
      "/transactions?tab=in&from=2026-11-01",
    );
    expect(buildPath("account", { accountId: "a/b" })).toBe("/accounts/a%2Fb");
  });

  it("throws when a parameter is missing", () => {
    expect(() => buildPath("account")).toThrow("Missing route parameter accountId");
  });
});
```

```tsx
import { screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import i18n from "../i18n";
import { queryKeys } from "../lib/query-keys";
import { renderRoutes, stubApi, testQueryClient } from "../test/router";
import { expireSession, loginPath, RequireAuth, safeNext } from "./RequireAuth";

const routes = [
  {
    element: <RequireAuth area="auth" />,
    children: [
      { path: "/login", element: <p>login page</p> },
      { path: "/setup", element: <p>setup page</p> },
    ],
  },
  {
    element: <RequireAuth area="app" />,
    children: [{ path: "*", element: <p>app page</p> }],
  },
];

describe("safeNext and loginPath", () => {
  it("accepts in-app paths only", () => {
    expect(safeNext("/transactions?tab=in")).toBe("/transactions?tab=in");
    expect(safeNext(null)).toBe("/");
    expect(safeNext("https://example.invalid/")).toBe("/");
    expect(safeNext("//example.invalid/")).toBe("/");
    expect(safeNext("/\\example.invalid")).toBe("/");
    expect(safeNext("/login?next=/x")).toBe("/");
  });

  it("builds the login path with next and the expiry flag", () => {
    expect(loginPath("/")).toBe("/login");
    expect(loginPath("/settings?tab=backups")).toBe("/login?next=%2Fsettings%3Ftab%3Dbackups");
    expect(loginPath("/", { expired: true })).toBe("/login?expired=1");
  });
});

describe("RequireAuth", () => {
  beforeEach(async () => {
    await i18n.changeLanguage("en");
  });
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  });

  it("sends a signed-out owner to the login page with next", async () => {
    const { router } = renderRoutes(routes, {
      client: testQueryClient({ setupRequired: false, authenticated: false }),
      initialEntries: ["/transactions?tab=in"],
    });
    expect(await screen.findByText("login page")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(router.state.location.search).toBe("?next=%2Ftransactions%3Ftab%3Din");
  });

  it("sends everyone to setup while setup is required", async () => {
    const { router } = renderRoutes(routes, {
      client: testQueryClient({ setupRequired: true, authenticated: false }),
      initialEntries: ["/login"],
    });
    expect(await screen.findByText("setup page")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(router.state.location.pathname).toBe("/setup");
  });

  it("keeps setup closed once the owner exists", async () => {
    const { router } = renderRoutes(routes, {
      client: testQueryClient({ setupRequired: false, authenticated: false }),
      initialEntries: ["/setup"],
    });
    expect(await screen.findByText("login page")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(router.state.location.pathname).toBe("/login");
  });

  it("sends a signed-in owner from the login page to a safe next", async () => {
    const { router } = renderRoutes(routes, {
      client: testQueryClient({ setupRequired: false, authenticated: true }),
      initialEntries: ["/login?next=%2F%2Fexample.invalid"],
    });
    expect(await screen.findByText("app page")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(router.state.location.pathname).toBe("/");
  });

  it("offers a retry when the server is unreachable", async () => {
    stubApi({ "GET /api/auth/status": () => ({ status: 503, body: { error: "Unavailable" } }) });
    renderRoutes(routes, { initialEntries: ["/"] });
    expect((await screen.findByRole("alert")).textContent).toBe(
      "The server is not reachable. Try again in a moment.",
    );
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Try again" })).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it("expireSession marks the session as gone and opens the login page with the notice", async () => {
    const client = testQueryClient({ setupRequired: false, authenticated: true });
    const { router } = renderRoutes(routes, { client, initialEntries: ["/settings?tab=x"] });
    expect(await screen.findByText("app page")).toBeTruthy();
    expireSession(router, client);
    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(`${router.state.location.pathname}${router.state.location.search}`).toBe(
        "/login?expired=1&next=%2Fsettings%3Ftab%3Dx",
      ),
    );
    expect(await screen.findByText("login page")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(client.getQueryData(queryKeys.authStatus)).toEqual({
      setupRequired: false,
      authenticated: false,
    });
  });
});
```
