`apps/web/src/app/CommandPalette.test.tsx`:

```tsx
import { act, fireEvent, screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import { useEffect } from "react";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import i18n from "../i18n";
import { renderRoutes } from "../test/router";
import { CommandPalette, PaletteProvider, usePaletteControl } from "./CommandPalette";

// Every registry route counts as shipped here, so the palette has more than 8 pages to offer.
vi.mock("./routes", async (importOriginal) => {
  const actual = await importOriginal<typeof import("./routes")>();
  return {
    ...actual,
    shippedRoutes: () => actual.ROUTES.map((def) => ({ ...def, shipped: true })),
  };
});

function OpenOnMount() {
  const { open } = usePaletteControl();
  useEffect(() => open(), [open]);
  return null;
}

function renderPalette() {
  const element = (
    <PaletteProvider>
      <OpenOnMount />
      <CommandPalette />
    </PaletteProvider>
  );
  // One layout route stays mounted across navigations, like the AppShell.
  return renderRoutes([
    {
      path: "/",
      element,
      children: [
        { index: true, element: null },
        { path: "*", element: null },
      ],
    },
  ]);
}

function input(): HTMLInputElement {
  return screen.getByRole("combobox") as HTMLInputElement;
}

function optionTitles(): string[] {
  return screen
    .queryAllByRole("option")
    .map((option) => option.querySelector("span span")?.textContent ?? "");
}

describe("CommandPalette", () => {
  beforeEach(async () => {
    await i18n.changeLanguage("en");
  });
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.useRealTimers();
  });

  it("shows 8 pages with descriptions as subtitles when the query is empty", () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    renderPalette();
    act(() => vi.advanceTimersByTime(30));
    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(input());
    expect(screen.getAllByRole("option")).toHaveLength(8);
    expect(screen.queryByText("/transactions")).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.getByText("Every inflow and outflow across your accounts")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText("↑↓ navigate · ↵ open · esc close · 8 results")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(document.body.style.overflow).toBe("hidden");
  });

  it("matches without regard to accents or case and never lists pages that need a parameter", () => {
    renderPalette();
    fireEvent.change(input(), { target: { value: "TRÀNSACTIONS" } });
    expect(optionTitles()).toEqual(["Transactions"]);
    fireEvent.change(input(), { target: { value: "detail balance" } });
    expect(screen.queryAllByRole("option")).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it("moves the active option with the arrow keys and opens it with Enter", async () => {
    const { router } = renderPalette();
    const field = input();
    expect(field.getAttribute("aria-activedescendant")).toBe(screen.getAllByRole("option")[0]?.id);
    fireEvent.keyDown(field, { key: "ArrowDown" });
    fireEvent.keyDown(field, { key: "ArrowDown" });
    const third = screen.getAllByRole("option")[2];
    expect(third?.getAttribute("aria-selected")).toBe("true");
    expect(field.getAttribute("aria-activedescendant")).toBe(third?.id);
    fireEvent.keyDown(field, { key: "ArrowUp" });
    fireEvent.keyDown(field, { key: "ArrowUp" });
    fireEvent.keyDown(field, { key: "ArrowUp" });
    expect(screen.getAllByRole("option")[7]?.getAttribute("aria-selected")).toBe("true");
    fireEvent.change(field, { target: { value: "settings" } });
    fireEvent.keyDown(input(), { key: "Enter" });
    await waitFor(() => expect(router.state.location.pathname).toBe("/settings"));
    expect(screen.queryByRole("dialog")).toBeNull();
    expect(document.body.style.overflow).toBe("");
  });

  it("shows the empty text with typographic quotes and closes on Escape", () => {
    renderPalette();
    fireEvent.change(input(), { target: { value: "xyz" } });
    expect(screen.getByText("No results for “xyz”")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText("Try a name, a bank or the last digits of an IBAN.")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText("↑↓ navigate · ↵ open · esc close · 0 results")).toBeTruthy();
    fireEvent.keyDown(input(), { key: "Escape" });
    expect(screen.queryByRole("dialog")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("uses the Italian texts", async () => {
    await i18n.changeLanguage("it");
    renderPalette();
    fireEvent.change(input(), { target: { value: "attivita" } });
    expect(optionTitles()).toEqual(["Attività"]);
    expect(screen.getByText("↑↓ naviga · ↵ apri · esc chiudi · 1 risultato")).toBeTruthy();
  });
});
```

```tsx
import { fireEvent, screen, waitFor, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import i18n from "../i18n";
import { useUi } from "../store/ui";
import { renderRoutes, stubApi, testQueryClient } from "../test/router";
import { AppShell } from "./AppShell";
import { RouteErrorBoundary } from "./ErrorBoundary";
import { appRoutes } from "./router";

const signedIn = { setupRequired: false, authenticated: true };

function Boom(): never {
  throw new Error("page crashed");
}

describe("AppShell", () => {
  beforeEach(async () => {
    await i18n.changeLanguage("en");
    useUi.setState({ privacy: false, sidebarCollapsed: false });
    stubApi({ "GET /api/auth/status": () => ({ status: 200, body: signedIn }) });
  });
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllGlobals();
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
  });

  it("shows only shipped routes in the navigation and the route title in the topbar", async () => {
    renderRoutes(appRoutes(), { client: testQueryClient(signedIn), initialEntries: ["/"] });
    const nav = await screen.findByRole("navigation", { name: "Main navigation" });
    expect(
      within(nav)
        .getAllByRole("link")
        .map((link) => link.textContent),
    ).toEqual(["Home"]);
    expect(within(nav).queryByText("Accounts")).toBeNull();
    expect(within(nav).queryByText("Settings")).toBeNull();
    expect(await screen.findByRole("heading", { level: 1 })).toBeTruthy();
    // The topbar is the first banner landmark; its title comes from the registry.
    expect(screen.getAllByRole("banner")[0]?.textContent).toContain("Home");
  });

  it("renders unshipped and unknown paths as Page not found inside the shell", async () => {
    renderRoutes(appRoutes(), { client: testQueryClient(signedIn), initialEntries: ["/accounts"] });
    expect(await screen.findByText("This address does not match any page in Bursar.")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole("navigation", { name: "Main navigation" })).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole("link", { name: "Back to Home" }).getAttribute("href")).toBe("/");
  });

  it("closes the mobile drawer on a route change", async () => {
    const { router } = renderRoutes(appRoutes(), {
      client: testQueryClient(signedIn),
      initialEntries: ["/missing"],
    });
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "Open the menu" }));
    const drawer = screen.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Main navigation" });
    fireEvent.click(within(drawer).getByRole("link", { name: "Home" }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(router.state.location.pathname).toBe("/"));
    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(screen.queryByRole("dialog", { name: "Main navigation" })).toBeNull(),
    );
  });

  it("closes the mobile drawer on Escape", async () => {
    renderRoutes(appRoutes(), { client: testQueryClient(signedIn), initialEntries: ["/"] });
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "Open the menu" }));
    fireEvent.keyDown(document, { key: "Escape" });
    expect(screen.queryByRole("dialog", { name: "Main navigation" })).toBeNull();
  });

  it("opens the palette with Ctrl+K and toggles privacy with Ctrl+Shift+H", async () => {
    renderRoutes(appRoutes(), { client: testQueryClient(signedIn), initialEntries: ["/"] });
    await screen.findByRole("navigation", { name: "Main navigation" });
    fireEvent.keyDown(window, { key: "k", ctrlKey: true });
    expect(screen.getByRole("combobox")).toBeTruthy();
    fireEvent.keyDown(screen.getByRole("combobox"), { key: "Escape" });
    fireEvent.keyDown(window, { key: "H", ctrlKey: true, shiftKey: true });
    expect(useUi.getState().privacy).toBe(true);
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Show amounts" }).getAttribute("aria-pressed")).toBe(
      "true",
    );
  });

  it("collapses the sidebar into a rail with tooltips", async () => {
    renderRoutes(appRoutes(), { client: testQueryClient(signedIn), initialEntries: ["/"] });
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "Collapse the sidebar" }));
    expect(useUi.getState().sidebarCollapsed).toBe(true);
    const nav = screen.getByRole("navigation", { name: "Main navigation" });
    expect(within(nav).getByRole("link", { name: "Home" }).getAttribute("title")).toBe("Home");
  });

  it("shows the error boundary inside the shell when a page crashes", async () => {
    vi.spyOn(console, "error").mockImplementation(() => undefined);
    renderRoutes(
      [
        {
          element: <AppShell />,
          children: [
            { errorElement: <RouteErrorBoundary />, children: [{ path: "/", element: <Boom /> }] },
          ],
        },
      ],
      { client: testQueryClient(signedIn) },
    );
    expect(await screen.findByText("Something went wrong")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(document.querySelector("[data-error-boundary]")).not.toBeNull();
    expect(screen.getByRole("navigation", { name: "Main navigation" })).toBeTruthy();
  });
});
```

```tsx
import { fireEvent, screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import i18n from "../i18n";
import { renderRoutes } from "../test/router";
import { BackButton } from "./BackButton";

const routes = [
  { path: "/accounts/:accountId", element: <BackButton routeId="account" /> },
  { path: "*", element: <p>elsewhere</p> },
];

describe("BackButton", () => {
  beforeEach(async () => {
    await i18n.changeLanguage("en");
  });
  afterEach(() => {
    window.history.replaceState(null, "");
  });

  it("goes to the breadcrumb parent when the page was opened directly", async () => {
    window.history.replaceState({ idx: 0 }, "");
    const { router } = renderRoutes(routes, { initialEntries: ["/accounts/12"] });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Back" }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(router.state.location.pathname).toBe("/accounts"));
  });

  it("goes back one step when there is in-app history", async () => {
    window.history.replaceState({ idx: 1 }, "");
    const { router } = renderRoutes(routes, {
      initialEntries: ["/transactions", "/accounts/12"],
      initialIndex: 1,
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Back" }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(router.state.location.pathname).toBe("/transactions"));
  });
});
```

`apps/web/src/lib/query-client.test.ts`:

```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { ApiError, request } from "../api";
import { createQueryClient, isAccessDenied, isSessionExpired } from "./query-client";

function respond(status: number, body: string, contentType = "application/json") {
  vi.stubGlobal(
    "fetch",
    vi.fn(async () => new Response(body, { status, headers: { "content-type": contentType } })),
  );
}

function handlers() {
  return { onUnauthorized: vi.fn(), onAccessDenied: vi.fn() };
}

describe("error classification", () => {
  it("treats a 401 outside /api/auth as an expired session", () => {
    expect(isSessionExpired(new ApiError(401, "Not authenticated", { path: "/api/me" }))).toBe(
      true,
    );
    expect(isSessionExpired(new ApiError(401, "Invalid", { path: "/api/auth/login" }))).toBe(false);
    expect(isSessionExpired(new Error("401"))).toBe(false);
  });

  it("recognises Access 403s but not Bursar's own JSON 403s", () => {
    const json = { isJson: true, path: "/api/me" };
    expect(isAccessDenied(new ApiError(403, "Missing Cloudflare Access token", json))).toBe(true);
    expect(isAccessDenied(new ApiError(403, "Invalid Cloudflare Access token", json))).toBe(true);
    expect(isAccessDenied(new ApiError(403, "Forbidden", { isJson: false, path: "/api/me" }))).toBe(
      true,
    );
    expect(isAccessDenied(new ApiError(403, "Cross-origin request rejected", json))).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("createQueryClient", () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  });

  it("calls onUnauthorized when a query gets a 401", async () => {
    respond(401, JSON.stringify({ error: "Not authenticated" }));
    const h = handlers();
    const client = createQueryClient(h);
    await client
      .fetchQuery({ queryKey: ["me"], queryFn: () => request("GET", "/api/me") })
      .catch(() => undefined);
    expect(h.onUnauthorized).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(h.onAccessDenied).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("ignores a 401 from the login route", async () => {
    respond(401, JSON.stringify({ error: "Invalid credentials" }));
    const h = handlers();
    const client = createQueryClient(h);
    await client
      .getMutationCache()
      .build(client, { mutationFn: () => request("POST", "/api/auth/login", {}) })
      .execute(undefined)
      .catch(() => undefined);
    expect(h.onUnauthorized).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("calls onAccessDenied for the HTML 403 page of Cloudflare Access on a mutation", async () => {
    respond(403, "<html>Forbidden</html>", "text/html");
    const h = handlers();
    const client = createQueryClient(h);
    await client
      .getMutationCache()
      .build(client, { mutationFn: () => request("PATCH", "/api/settings", { a: 1 }) })
      .execute(undefined)
      .catch(() => undefined);
    expect(h.onAccessDenied).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it("does not retry and does not refetch on focus", () => {
    const options = createQueryClient(handlers()).getDefaultOptions();
    expect(options.queries?.retry).toBe(false);
    expect(options.queries?.refetchOnWindowFocus).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("request", () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  });

  it("reads code and retryAt from a JSON error", async () => {
    respond(
      429,
      JSON.stringify({ error: "Rate limited", code: "rate_limited", retryAt: 1_800_000 }),
    );
    const error = await request("POST", "/api/accounts/1/sync").catch((caught: unknown) => caught);
    expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(ApiError);
    expect(error).toMatchObject({
      status: 429,
      message: "Rate limited",
      code: "rate_limited",
      retryAt: 1_800_000,
      path: "/api/accounts/1/sync",
      isJson: true,
    });
  });

  it("keeps code null for a non-JSON error and uses the status text", async () => {
    vi.stubGlobal(
      "fetch",
      vi.fn(async () => new Response("<html></html>", { status: 502, statusText: "Bad Gateway" })),
    );
    const error = await request("GET", "/api/summary").catch((caught: unknown) => caught);
    expect(error).toMatchObject({ status: 502, message: "Bad Gateway", code: null, isJson: false });
  });

  it("sends PATCH and DELETE with a JSON body and returns undefined for 204", async () => {
    const fetchMock = vi.fn(async () => new Response(null, { status: 204 }));
    vi.stubGlobal("fetch", fetchMock);
    await expect(
      request("PATCH", "/api/accounts/1", { nickname: "Main" }),
    ).resolves.toBeUndefined();
    await expect(request("DELETE", "/api/connections/1")).resolves.toBeUndefined();
    expect(fetchMock).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(1, "/api/accounts/1", {
      method: "PATCH",
      credentials: "same-origin",
      headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ nickname: "Main" }),
    });
    expect(fetchMock).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(2, "/api/connections/1", {
      method: "DELETE",
      credentials: "same-origin",
      headers: undefined,
      body: undefined,
    });
  });

  it("rejects a successful response that is not JSON", async () => {
    respond(200, "<!doctype html>", "text/html");
    await expect(request("GET", "/api/summary")).rejects.toMatchObject({
      message: "Invalid JSON response",
    });
  });
});
```

`apps/web/src/lib/url-state.test.tsx`:

```tsx
import { fireEvent, render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import { MemoryRouter, useLocation } from "react-router";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { useUrlState } from "./url-state";

const DEFAULTS = { tab: "all", q: "", page: "1" };

function Probe() {
  const [state, setState] = useUrlState(DEFAULTS, {
    validate: { tab: (value) => ["all", "in", "out"].includes(value) },
    resetOnChange: ["page"],
  });
  const location = useLocation();
  return (
    <div>
      <output data-testid="state">{JSON.stringify(state)}</output>
      <output data-testid="search">{location.search}</output>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setState({ tab: "in" })}>
        tab in
      </button>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setState({ tab: "all" })}>
        tab all
      </button>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setState({ page: "3" })}>
        page 3
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

function renderAt(url: string) {
  render(
    <MemoryRouter initialEntries={[url]}>
      <Probe />
    </MemoryRouter>,
  );
}

const state = () => JSON.parse(screen.getByTestId("state").textContent ?? "{}");
const search = () => screen.getByTestId("search").textContent;

describe("useUrlState", () => {
  it("reads values and falls back to the default for invalid ones", () => {
    renderAt("/?tab=sideways&q=caff%C3%A8&page=2&other=keep");
    expect(state()).toEqual({ tab: "all", q: "caffè", page: "2" });
  });

  it("omits defaults, resets page when another key changes and keeps unknown parameters", () => {
    renderAt("/?page=2&other=keep");
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "tab in" }));
    expect(search()).toBe("?other=keep&tab=in");
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "page 3" }));
    expect(search()).toBe("?other=keep&tab=in&page=3");
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "tab all" }));
    expect(search()).toBe("?other=keep");
    expect(state()).toEqual({ tab: "all", q: "", page: "1" });
  });
});
```

```tsx
import { fireEvent, screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { RequireAuth } from "../app/RequireAuth";
import i18n from "../i18n";
import { renderRoutes, stubApi } from "../test/router";
import { LoginPage } from "./LoginPage";

const routes = [
  {
    element: <RequireAuth area="auth" />,
    children: [{ path: "/login", element: <LoginPage /> }],
  },
  { path: "*", element: <p>landed</p> },
];

function submit(password: string, code: string) {
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText("Password"), { target: { value: password } });
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText("Authenticator code"), { target: { value: code } });
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Sign in" }));
}

describe("LoginPage", () => {
  beforeEach(async () => {
    await i18n.changeLanguage("en");
  });
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  });

  it("posts the credentials and shows an error on 401", async () => {
    const fetchMock = stubApi({
      "GET /api/auth/status": () => ({
        status: 200,
        body: { setupRequired: false, authenticated: false },
      }),
      "POST /api/auth/login": () => ({ status: 401, body: { error: "Invalid credentials" } }),
    });
    renderRoutes(routes, { initialEntries: ["/login"] });
    await screen.findByLabelText("Password");
    submit("correct horse battery", "123456");
    expect((await screen.findByRole("alert")).textContent).toBe("Wrong password or code.");
    expect(fetchMock).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      "/api/auth/login",
      expect.objectContaining({
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify({ password: "correct horse battery", code: "123456" }),
      }),
    );
  });

  it("shows the lockout message on 429", async () => {
    stubApi({
      "GET /api/auth/status": () => ({
        status: 200,
        body: { setupRequired: false, authenticated: false },
      }),
      "POST /api/auth/login": () => ({ status: 429, body: { error: "Too many attempts" } }),
    });
    renderRoutes(routes, { initialEntries: ["/login"] });
    await screen.findByLabelText("Password");
    submit("whatever", "123456");
    expect((await screen.findByRole("alert")).textContent).toBe(
      "Too many attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again.",
    );
  });

  it("shows the session-expired notice and returns to next after signing in", async () => {
    let signedIn = false;
    stubApi({
      "GET /api/auth/status": () => ({
        status: 200,
        body: { setupRequired: false, authenticated: signedIn },
      }),
      "POST /api/auth/login": () => {
        signedIn = true;
        return { status: 200, body: { ok: true } };
      },
    });
    const { router } = renderRoutes(routes, {
      initialEntries: ["/login?expired=1&next=%2Fsettings%3Ftab%3Dbackups"],
    });
    expect((await screen.findByRole("status")).textContent).toBe(
      "Your session expired, sign in again.",
    );
    submit("correct horse battery", "123456");
    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(`${router.state.location.pathname}${router.state.location.search}`).toBe(
        "/settings?tab=backups",
      ),
    );
    expect(await screen.findByText("landed")).toBeTruthy();
  });
});
```

`apps/web/src/api.ts`:

```ts
import type {
  AuthStatus,
  LoginRequest,
  SetupConfirmRequest,
  SetupStartRequest,
  SetupStartResponse,
} from "@bursar/shared";
import { queryKeys } from "./lib/query-keys";

/** Kept for the M0 call sites; new code uses `queryKeys.authStatus`. */
export const AUTH_STATUS_KEY = queryKeys.authStatus;

export type HttpMethod = "GET" | "POST" | "PATCH" | "DELETE";

export interface ApiErrorDetails {
  code?: string | null;
  retryAt?: number | null;
  path?: string;
  isJson?: boolean;
}

/**
 * A non-2xx response from the API. `message` is the server's English `error`, `code` its stable
 * snake_case code (translated by the UI), `retryAt` an epoch-ms hint for rate limits. `isJson` is
 * false when the body was not a JSON object (for example an HTML page from Cloudflare Access).
 */
export class ApiError extends Error {
  readonly code: string | null;
  readonly retryAt: number | null;
  readonly path: string;
  readonly isJson: boolean;

  constructor(
    readonly status: number,
    message: string,
    details: ApiErrorDetails = {},
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "ApiError";
    this.code = details.code ?? null;
    this.retryAt = details.retryAt ?? null;
    this.path = details.path ?? "";
    this.isJson = details.isJson ?? false;
  }
}

function parseJson(text: string): unknown {
  if (text.length === 0) return undefined;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch {
    return undefined;
  }
}

function asObject(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | null {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)
    ? (value as Record<string, unknown>)
    : null;
}

/**
 * Calls the API with the session cookie. Resolves with the parsed JSON body (`undefined` for 204)
 * and rejects with `ApiError` for any non-2xx status or a 2xx body that is not JSON.
 */
export async function request<T>(method: HttpMethod, path: string, body?: unknown): Promise<T> {
  const response = await fetch(path, {
    method,
    credentials: "same-origin",
    headers: body === undefined ? undefined : { "content-type": "application/json" },
    body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  if (response.status === 204) return undefined as T;
  const text = await response.text().catch(() => "");
  const data = parseJson(text);
  if (!response.ok) {
    const object = asObject(data);
    const message = typeof object?.error === "string" ? object.error : response.statusText;
    throw new ApiError(response.status, message, {
      code: typeof object?.code === "string" ? object.code : null,
      retryAt: typeof object?.retryAt === "number" ? object.retryAt : null,
      path,
      isJson: object !== null,
    });
  }
  if (data === undefined) {
    throw new ApiError(response.status, "Invalid JSON response", { path, isJson: false });
  }
  return data as T;
}

export const api = {
  status: () => request<AuthStatus>("GET", "/api/auth/status"),
  setupStart: (body: SetupStartRequest) =>
    request<SetupStartResponse>("POST", "/api/auth/setup/start", body),
  setupConfirm: (body: SetupConfirmRequest) =>
    request<{ ok: true }>("POST", "/api/auth/setup/confirm", body),
  login: (body: LoginRequest) => request<{ ok: true }>("POST", "/api/auth/login", body),
  logout: () => request<{ ok: true }>("POST", "/api/auth/logout"),
};
```

`apps/web/src/lib/query-client.ts`:

```ts
import { MutationCache, QueryCache, QueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { ApiError } from "../api";

const ACCESS_ERROR_PREFIXES = [
  "Missing Cloudflare Access token",
  "Invalid Cloudflare Access token",
];

/** A 401 from an API route outside `/api/auth/*`: the session cookie expired or was revoked. */
export function isSessionExpired(error: unknown): boolean {
  return error instanceof ApiError && error.status === 401 && !error.path.startsWith("/api/auth/");
}

/**
 * A 403 from Cloudflare Access (its JSON messages, or the HTML page Access serves at the edge),
 * as opposed to Bursar's own JSON 403s such as the Origin check.
 */
export function isAccessDenied(error: unknown): boolean {
  if (!(error instanceof ApiError) || error.status !== 403) return false;
  if (!error.isJson) return true;
  return ACCESS_ERROR_PREFIXES.some((prefix) => error.message.startsWith(prefix));
}

export interface QueryClientHandlers {
  onUnauthorized(): void;
  onAccessDenied(): void;
}

export function createQueryClient(handlers: QueryClientHandlers): QueryClient {
  const onError = (error: unknown) => {
    if (isSessionExpired(error)) handlers.onUnauthorized();
    else if (isAccessDenied(error)) handlers.onAccessDenied();
  };
  return new QueryClient({
    queryCache: new QueryCache({ onError }),
    mutationCache: new MutationCache({ onError }),
    defaultOptions: {
      queries: { retry: false, refetchOnWindowFocus: false },
      mutations: { retry: false },
    },
  });
}
```

```ts
import {
  Activity,
  ArrowLeftRight,
  Bot,
  ChartColumn,
  FileText,
  House,
  Landmark,
  Link as LinkIcon,
  type LucideIcon,
  MessagesSquare,
  Settings,
  Wallet,
} from "lucide-react";

export type RouteId =
  | "home"
  | "accounts"
  | "account"
  | "connect"
  | "connectCallback"
  | "transactions"
  | "settings"
  | "documents"
  | "reports"
  | "chat"
  | "agents"
  | "activity";

export type NavGroup = "top" | "money" | "knowledge" | "agents" | "bottom";

export interface RouteDef {
  id: RouteId;
  path: string;
  titleKey: string;
  descriptionKey: string;
  keywordsKey: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  group: NavGroup | null;
  parent: RouteId | null;
  shipped: boolean;
}

/** Sidebar order of the navigation groups (UX doc §2). */
export const NAV_GROUPS: readonly NavGroup[] = ["top", "money", "knowledge", "agents", "bottom"];

function route(
  id: RouteId,
  path: string,
  icon: LucideIcon,
  group: NavGroup | null,
  parent: RouteId | null,
  shipped: boolean,
): RouteDef {
  return {
    id,
    path,
    titleKey: `routes.${id}.title`,
    descriptionKey: `routes.${id}.description`,
    keywordsKey: `routes.${id}.keywords`,
    icon,
    group,
    parent,
    shipped,
  };
}

/**
 * The single source of truth for the panel's pages: the router, the sidebar, the topbar title, the
 * breadcrumbs and the command palette all read it. A page task flips `shipped` to true when its page
 * exists; until then the route is invisible everywhere (hidden until shipped).
 */
export const ROUTES: readonly RouteDef[] = [
  route("home", "/", House, "top", null, true),
  route("accounts", "/accounts", Landmark, "money", null, false),
  route("account", "/accounts/:accountId", Wallet, null, "accounts", false),
  route("connect", "/connect", LinkIcon, null, "accounts", false),
  route("connectCallback", "/connect/callback", LinkIcon, null, "accounts", false),
  route("transactions", "/transactions", ArrowLeftRight, "money", null, false),
  route("documents", "/documents", FileText, "knowledge", null, false),
  route("reports", "/reports", ChartColumn, "knowledge", null, false),
  route("chat", "/chat", MessagesSquare, "agents", null, false),
  route("agents", "/agents", Bot, "agents", null, false),
  route("activity", "/activity", Activity, "agents", null, false),
  route("settings", "/settings", Settings, "bottom", null, false),
];

export function shippedRoutes(): RouteDef[] {
  return ROUTES.filter((def) => def.shipped);
}

export function routeById(id: RouteId): RouteDef {
  const def = ROUTES.find((candidate) => candidate.id === id);
  if (!def) throw new Error(`Unknown route id: ${id}`);
  return def;
}

function segments(path: string): string[] {
  return path.split("/").filter((segment) => segment.length > 0);
}

function decodeSegment(segment: string): string | null {
  try {
    return decodeURIComponent(segment);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Resolves a pathname to a route. When several routes match, the one with the most fixed (non-param)
 * segments wins (`/connect/callback` is `connectCallback`, `/accounts/12` is `account`). Only the
 * given routes are considered: shipped routes by default.
 */
export function matchRoute(
  pathname: string,
  routes: readonly RouteDef[] = shippedRoutes(),
): { route: RouteDef; params: Record<string, string> } | null {
  const actual = segments(pathname);
  let best: { route: RouteDef; params: Record<string, string>; fixed: number } | null = null;
  for (const def of routes) {
    const pattern = segments(def.path);
    if (pattern.length !== actual.length) continue;
    const params: Record<string, string> = {};
    let fixed = 0;
    let matches = true;
    for (const [index, part] of pattern.entries()) {
      const value = decodeSegment(actual[index] ?? "");
      if (value === null) {
        matches = false;
        break;
      }
      if (part.startsWith(":")) {
        params[part.slice(1)] = value;
      } else if (part === value) {
        fixed += 1;
      } else {
        matches = false;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (matches && (best === null || fixed > best.fixed)) best = { route: def, params, fixed };
  }
  return best ? { route: best.route, params: best.params } : null;
}

/** Ancestors from the top down, ending with the route itself (registry order, shipped or not). */
export function breadcrumbTrail(id: RouteId): RouteDef[] {
  const trail: RouteDef[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<RouteId>();
  let current: RouteDef | null = routeById(id);
  while (current && !seen.has(current.id)) {
    seen.add(current.id);
    trail.unshift(current);
    current = current.parent ? routeById(current.parent) : null;
  }
  return trail;
}

/**
 * Builds a path for a route: `:name` segments are filled from `params` (URL-encoded) and `search`
 * entries with an empty value are left out, matching the URL-state rule that defaults are absent.
 */
export function buildPath(
  id: RouteId,
  params: Record<string, string | number> = {},
  search: Record<string, string> = {},
): string {
  const path = segments(routeById(id).path)
    .map((part) => {
      if (!part.startsWith(":")) return part;
      const value = params[part.slice(1)];
      if (value === undefined || value === "") {
        throw new Error(`Missing route parameter ${part.slice(1)} for ${id}`);
      }
      return encodeURIComponent(String(value));
    })
    .join("/");
  const query = new URLSearchParams(
    Object.entries(search).filter(([, value]) => value.length > 0),
  ).toString();
  return `/${path}${query ? `?${query}` : ""}`;
}
```

```ts
import type { LucideIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { type ReactNode, useMemo } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { matchesQuery } from "../lib/search";
import { buildPath, type RouteId, shippedRoutes } from "./routes";

export interface PaletteItem {
  id: string;
  group: string;
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  to: string;
  /** Shown at the end of the row (Task 18: the account's 30-day `NetChip`). */
  trailing?: ReactNode;
}

export interface PaletteSource {
  id: string;
  /** Normalised query length below which the source contributes nothing. */
  minQueryLength: number;
  limit: number;
  /** A React hook: called on every render of the palette, in `PALETTE_SOURCES` order. */
  useItems(query: string): { items: PaletteItem[]; loading: boolean };
}

/** Routes that cannot be opened from the palette (they need a parameter or a bank redirect). */
const NOT_IN_PALETTE = new Set<RouteId>(["connectCallback"]);

const pagesSource: PaletteSource = {
  id: "pages",
  minQueryLength: 0,
  limit: 8,
  useItems(query) {
    // `t` changes identity on a language switch, so the memo follows the language.
    const { t } = useTranslation();
    const items = useMemo(() => {
      const group = t("palette.groups.pages");
      return shippedRoutes()
        .filter((def) => !def.path.includes(":") && !NOT_IN_PALETTE.has(def.id))
        .map((def) => ({
          def,
          title: t(def.titleKey),
          subtitle: t(def.descriptionKey),
          keywords: t(def.keywordsKey),
        }))
        .filter((entry) => matchesQuery([entry.title, entry.subtitle, entry.keywords], query))
        .map(
          (entry): PaletteItem => ({
            id: `page:${entry.def.id}`,
            group,
            title: entry.title,
            subtitle: entry.subtitle,
            icon: entry.def.icon,
            to: buildPath(entry.def.id),
          }),
        );
    }, [query, t]);
    return { items, loading: false };
  },
};

/** Result sources in display order. Later tasks append accounts (T18) and transactions (T21). */
export const PALETTE_SOURCES: readonly PaletteSource[] = [pagesSource];
```

`apps/web/src/app/RequireAuth.tsx`:

```tsx
import type { AuthStatus } from "@bursar/shared";
import { type QueryClient, useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { type DataRouter, Navigate, Outlet, useLocation } from "react-router";
import { api } from "../api";
import { Button } from "../components/ui";
import { queryKeys } from "../lib/query-keys";
import { ProductMark } from "./AuthShell";

const AUTH_PATHS = new Set(["/login", "/setup"]);

/** A same-origin in-app path to return to after sign-in, or `/` for anything else. */
export function safeNext(raw: string | null | undefined): string {
  if (!raw?.startsWith("/") || raw.startsWith("//") || raw.startsWith("/\\")) return "/";
  const pathname = raw.split(/[?#]/, 1)[0] ?? "/";
  return AUTH_PATHS.has(pathname) ? "/" : raw;
}

/** `/login`, with `next` when it is not Home and `expired=1` after a session expiry. */
export function loginPath(next: string, options: { expired?: boolean } = {}): string {
  const search = new URLSearchParams();
  if (options.expired) search.set("expired", "1");
  const target = safeNext(next);
  if (target !== "/") search.set("next", target);
  const query = search.toString();
  return query ? `/login?${query}` : "/login";
}

/**
 * Called by the query client on a 401: marks the session as gone in the cache (so the login page
 * does not bounce back) and sends the owner to the login page with the expiry notice.
 */
export function expireSession(router: DataRouter, queryClient: QueryClient): void {
  const { pathname, search } = router.state.location;
  if (AUTH_PATHS.has(pathname)) return;
  queryClient.setQueryData<AuthStatus>(queryKeys.authStatus, {
    setupRequired: false,
    authenticated: false,
  });
  void router.navigate(loginPath(`${pathname}${search}`, { expired: true }), { replace: true });
}

function FullPageStatus({ failed, onRetry }: { failed: boolean; onRetry: () => void }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  return (
    <div
      className="grid min-h-dvh place-items-center bg-bg px-4"
      aria-busy={failed ? undefined : "true"}
    >
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-4 text-center">
        <ProductMark size="lg" />
        {failed ? (
          <>
            <p role="alert" className="max-w-sm text-sm text-fg">
              {t("common.serverUnavailable")}
            </p>
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onRetry}>
              {t("shell.retry")}
            </Button>
          </>
        ) : (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted">{t("common.loading")}</p>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Route guard for both areas. `app`: setup first, then sign-in (with `next`). `auth`: `/setup` only
 * while setup is required, `/login` only while signed out; a signed-in owner goes to `next`.
 */
export function RequireAuth({ area }: { area: "app" | "auth" }) {
  const location = useLocation();
  const status = useQuery({ queryKey: queryKeys.authStatus, queryFn: api.status });

  if (status.isPending) return <FullPageStatus failed={false} onRetry={() => undefined} />;
  if (status.isError) return <FullPageStatus failed onRetry={() => void status.refetch()} />;

  const { setupRequired, authenticated } = status.data;
  const here = `${location.pathname}${location.search}`;

  if (area === "app") {
    if (setupRequired) return <Navigate to="/setup" replace />;
    if (!authenticated) return <Navigate to={loginPath(here)} replace />;
    return <Outlet />;
  }

  if (setupRequired) {
    return location.pathname === "/setup" ? <Outlet /> : <Navigate to="/setup" replace />;
  }
  if (authenticated) {
    const next = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("next");
    return <Navigate to={safeNext(next)} replace />;
  }
  if (location.pathname === "/setup") {
    return <Navigate to={`/login${location.search}`} replace />;
  }
  return <Outlet />;
}
```

```tsx
import { Monitor, Moon, Sun } from "lucide-react";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Outlet } from "react-router";
import { type Language, SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES, setLanguage } from "../i18n";
import { type ThemePreference, useUi } from "../store/ui";

const MARK_SIZES = {
  sm: "size-8 rounded-xl text-base",
  md: "size-10 rounded-xl text-lg",
  lg: "size-12 rounded-2xl text-xl",
} as const;

/** The product mark: a monogram on the primary colour (no external image, CSP-safe). */
export function ProductMark({ size = "md" }: { size?: keyof typeof MARK_SIZES }) {
  return (
    <span
      aria-hidden="true"
      className={`grid shrink-0 place-items-center bg-primary font-display font-bold text-surface ${MARK_SIZES[size]}`}
    >
      B
    </span>
  );
}

/** An inline error or notice inside an auth card. `alert` is announced immediately. */
export function AuthNotice({ tone, children }: { tone: "danger" | "info"; children: ReactNode }) {
  const classes = tone === "danger" ? "bg-danger-soft text-danger" : "bg-info-soft text-info";
  return (
    <p
      role={tone === "danger" ? "alert" : "status"}
      className={`mb-4 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm ${classes}`}
    >
      {children}
    </p>
  );
}

const LANGUAGE_LABELS: Record<Language, string> = { it: "Italiano", en: "English" };
const THEME_ICONS = { system: Monitor, light: Sun, dark: Moon } as const;
const THEMES: readonly ThemePreference[] = ["system", "light", "dark"];

const SEGMENT =
  "inline-flex min-h-9 min-w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg px-2 text-xs font-medium text-muted transition-colors hover:text-fg aria-pressed:bg-surface aria-pressed:text-fg aria-pressed:shadow-sm";

function LanguageSwitch() {
  const { t, i18n } = useTranslation();
  return (
    <fieldset className="flex gap-0.5 rounded-xl bg-surface-2 p-0.5">
      <legend className="sr-only">{t("common.language")}</legend>
      {SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.map((language) => (
        <button
          key={language}
          type="button"
          lang={language}
          aria-pressed={i18n.language === language}
          title={LANGUAGE_LABELS[language]}
          className={SEGMENT}
          onClick={() => setLanguage(language)}
        >
          {language.toUpperCase()}
        </button>
      ))}
    </fieldset>
  );
}

function ThemeSwitch() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const theme = useUi((state) => state.theme);
  const setTheme = useUi((state) => state.setTheme);
  return (
    <fieldset className="flex gap-0.5 rounded-xl bg-surface-2 p-0.5">
      <legend className="sr-only">{t("userMenu.theme")}</legend>
      {THEMES.map((value) => {
        const Icon = THEME_ICONS[value];
        const label = t(`userMenu.themes.${value}`);
        return (
          <button
            key={value}
            type="button"
            aria-pressed={theme === value}
            aria-label={label}
            title={label}
            className={SEGMENT}
            onClick={() => setTheme(value)}
          >
            <Icon aria-hidden size={16} strokeWidth={1.75} />
          </button>
        );
      })}
    </fieldset>
  );
}

/** Setup and login: a centred card with the product mark, a language switch and a theme switch. */
export function AuthShell() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-dvh flex-col bg-bg">
      <header className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 px-4 py-4 sm:px-6">
        <LanguageSwitch />
        <ThemeSwitch />
      </header>
      <main className="flex flex-1 items-start justify-center px-4 pb-16 pt-4 sm:pt-12">
        <div className="w-full max-w-md">
          <div className="mb-6 flex items-center justify-center gap-3">
            <ProductMark size="lg" />
            <span className="font-display text-2xl font-bold text-primary">{t("app.name")}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-subtle bg-surface p-6 shadow-sm sm:p-8">
            <Outlet />
          </div>
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { TriangleAlert } from "lucide-react";
import { Component, type ErrorInfo, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { isRouteErrorResponse, useRouteError } from "react-router";

export const HOME_LINK_CLASS =
  "inline-flex min-h-10 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-primary px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-surface transition-colors hover:bg-primary/90";

const SECONDARY_BUTTON_CLASS =
  "inline-flex min-h-10 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-subtle bg-surface px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-fg transition-colors hover:bg-surface-2";

/**
 * The styled message shown when a page crashes. It uses a plain link to Home (a full load) so it also
 * works outside the router. `data-error-boundary` lets the QA run detect it.
 */
export function ErrorFallback({ fullPage }: { fullPage: boolean }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  return (
    <div
      data-error-boundary=""
      className={`grid place-items-center px-4 ${fullPage ? "min-h-dvh bg-bg" : "py-16"}`}
    >
      <div
        role="alert"
        className="w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl border border-subtle bg-surface p-8 text-center shadow-sm"
      >
        <span className="mx-auto mb-4 grid size-12 place-items-center rounded-2xl bg-danger-soft text-danger">
          <TriangleAlert aria-hidden size={24} strokeWidth={1.75} />
        </span>
        <h1 className="font-display text-xl font-bold text-fg">{t("errors.crash.title")}</h1>
        <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted">{t("errors.crash.body")}</p>
        <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-3">
          <button
            type="button"
            className={SECONDARY_BUTTON_CLASS}
            onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
          >
            {t("errors.reload")}
          </button>
          <a href="/" className={HOME_LINK_CLASS}>
            {t("errors.backHome")}
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** `errorElement` of the router: a loader, lazy import or render error inside a route. */
export function RouteErrorBoundary() {
  const error = useRouteError();
  if (!isRouteErrorResponse(error)) console.error(error);
  return <ErrorFallback fullPage={false} />;
}

interface AppErrorBoundaryState {
  failed: boolean;
}

/** The last safety net around the whole router: a crash outside any route shows the same message. */
export class AppErrorBoundary extends Component<{ children: ReactNode }, AppErrorBoundaryState> {
  state: AppErrorBoundaryState = { failed: false };

  static getDerivedStateFromError(): AppErrorBoundaryState {
    return { failed: true };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error: Error, info: ErrorInfo): void {
    console.error(error, info.componentStack);
  }

  render(): ReactNode {
    return this.state.failed ? <ErrorFallback fullPage /> : this.props.children;
  }
}
```

`apps/web/src/app/useDismiss.ts`:

```ts
import { type RefObject, useEffect } from "react";

/**
 * Closes a popover on a pointer press outside `rootRef` and on Escape (which also returns focus to
 * the trigger). Active only while `open`.
 */
export function useDismiss(
  open: boolean,
  close: () => void,
  rootRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>,
  triggerRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>,
): void {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    function onPointerDown(event: PointerEvent) {
      if (event.target instanceof Node && !rootRef.current?.contains(event.target)) close();
    }
    function onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (event.key !== "Escape") return;
      close();
      triggerRef.current?.focus();
    }
    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    };
  }, [open, close, rootRef, triggerRef]);
}
```

```tsx
import { ChevronRight } from "lucide-react";
import { Fragment } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Link } from "react-router";
import { breadcrumbTrail, buildPath, type RouteId } from "./routes";

/**
 * Breadcrumb for an inner page: shipped ancestors as links, then the current page. `current`
 * replaces the route title for the last item (for example the account's display name).
 */
export function Breadcrumbs({ routeId, current }: { routeId: RouteId; current?: string }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const trail = breadcrumbTrail(routeId);
  const ancestors = trail.slice(0, -1).filter((def) => def.shipped);
  const self = trail[trail.length - 1];
  return (
    <nav aria-label={t("shell.breadcrumb")}>
      <ol className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1 text-sm text-muted">
        {ancestors.map((def) => (
          <Fragment key={def.id}>
            <li>
              <Link to={buildPath(def.id)} className="rounded-md hover:text-fg hover:underline">
                {t(def.titleKey)}
              </Link>
            </li>
            <li aria-hidden="true">
              <ChevronRight size={14} />
            </li>
          </Fragment>
        ))}
        <li aria-current="page" className="min-w-0 truncate font-medium text-fg">
          {current ?? (self ? t(self.titleKey) : "")}
        </li>
      </ol>
    </nav>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { ChevronLeft } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router";
import { buildPath, type RouteId, routeById } from "./routes";

/** True when this page was the first one loaded in the tab (no in-app entry to go back to). */
function isFirstEntry(): boolean {
  const state: unknown = window.history.state;
  return (
    typeof state !== "object" ||
    state === null ||
    !("idx" in state) ||
    (state as { idx: unknown }).idx === 0
  );
}

/**
 * Back for an inner page. With in-app history it goes back one step; on a page opened directly
 * (`history.state.idx === 0`) it goes to the breadcrumb parent, so it never leaves the app.
 */
export function BackButton({ routeId }: { routeId: RouteId }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const parent = routeById(routeId).parent;
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      className="inline-flex min-h-9 items-center gap-1 rounded-lg pr-2 text-sm font-medium text-muted transition-colors hover:text-fg"
      onClick={() => {
        if (isFirstEntry()) navigate(parent ? buildPath(parent) : "/", { replace: true });
        else navigate(-1);
      }}
    >
      <ChevronLeft aria-hidden size={16} />
      {t("shell.back")}
    </button>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { CornerDownLeft, Search } from "lucide-react";
import {
  createContext,
  type KeyboardEvent,
  type ReactNode,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useId,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  useState,
} from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router";
import { normalizeForSearch } from "../lib/search";
import { PALETTE_SOURCES, type PaletteItem } from "./palette-sources";

interface PaletteControl {
  isOpen: boolean;
  open(): void;
  close(): void;
}

const PaletteContext = createContext<PaletteControl | null>(null);

/** Holds the palette's open state for the shell, the topbar trigger and the ⌘K shortcut. */
export function PaletteProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const open = useCallback(() => setIsOpen(true), []);
  const close = useCallback(() => setIsOpen(false), []);
  const value = useMemo(() => ({ isOpen, open, close }), [isOpen, open, close]);
  return <PaletteContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</PaletteContext.Provider>;
}

export function usePaletteControl(): PaletteControl {
  const control = useContext(PaletteContext);
  if (!control) throw new Error("usePaletteControl must be used inside PaletteProvider");
  return control;
}

interface PaletteResults {
  groups: { name: string; items: PaletteItem[] }[];
  flat: PaletteItem[];
  loading: boolean;
}

function usePaletteResults(query: string): PaletteResults {
  const normalized = normalizeForSearch(query);
  const perSource = PALETTE_SOURCES.map((source) => ({
    source,
    // biome-ignore lint/correctness/useHookAtTopLevel: PALETTE_SOURCES is a module constant, so every render calls the same hooks in the same order.
    result: source.useItems(normalized),
  }));
  const groups: PaletteResults["groups"] = [];
  const flat: PaletteItem[] = [];
  let loading = false;
  for (const { source, result } of perSource) {
    if (normalized.length < source.minQueryLength) continue;
    loading ||= result.loading;
    const items = result.items.slice(0, source.limit);
    if (items.length === 0) continue;
    groups.push({ name: items[0]?.group ?? source.id, items });
    flat.push(...items);
  }
  return { groups, flat, loading };
}

/**
 * The ⌘K command palette: a modal dialog with a combobox and a listbox of results from
 * `PALETTE_SOURCES`. ↑↓ move, ↵ opens, Esc closes; focus returns to where it was.
 */
export function CommandPalette() {
  const { isOpen, close } = usePaletteControl();
  if (!isOpen) return null;
  return <PaletteDialog onClose={close} />;
}

function PaletteDialog({ onClose }: { onClose: () => void }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const listboxId = useId();
  const titleId = useId();
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [active, setActive] = useState(0);
  const { groups, flat, loading } = usePaletteResults(query);

  useEffect(() => {
    const previous = document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement ? document.activeElement : null;
    const overflow = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 30);
    return () => {
      window.clearTimeout(timer);
      document.body.style.overflow = overflow;
      previous?.focus();
    };
  }, []);

  const activeIndex = flat.length === 0 ? -1 : Math.min(active, flat.length - 1);
  const activeItem = activeIndex >= 0 ? flat[activeIndex] : undefined;

  function optionId(index: number): string {
    return `${listboxId}-option-${index}`;
  }

  function openItem(item: PaletteItem) {
    onClose();
    navigate(item.to);
  }

  function onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
    if (event.key === "ArrowDown" || event.key === "ArrowUp") {
      event.preventDefault();
      if (flat.length === 0) return;
      const step = event.key === "ArrowDown" ? 1 : -1;
      setActive((activeIndex + step + flat.length) % flat.length);
    } else if (event.key === "Enter") {
      event.preventDefault();
      if (activeItem) openItem(activeItem);
    } else if (event.key === "Escape") {
      event.preventDefault();
      onClose();
    } else if (event.key === "Tab") {
      // The input is the only focusable element of the dialog: keep focus inside it.
      event.preventDefault();
    }
  }

  let index = -1;
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-start justify-center px-4 pt-[12vh]">
      <div
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="absolute inset-0 bg-fg/30 backdrop-blur-sm"
        onClick={onClose}
      />
      <div
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby={titleId}
        className="relative flex max-h-[70vh] w-full max-w-xl flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-subtle bg-surface shadow-xl"
      >
        <h2 id={titleId} className="sr-only">
          {t("palette.title")}
        </h2>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-subtle px-4">
          <Search aria-hidden size={18} strokeWidth={1.75} className="shrink-0 text-muted" />
          <input
            ref={inputRef}
            role="combobox"
            aria-expanded="true"
            aria-controls={listboxId}
            aria-autocomplete="list"
            aria-activedescendant={activeIndex >= 0 ? optionId(activeIndex) : undefined}
            aria-label={t("palette.inputLabel")}
            placeholder={t("palette.placeholder")}
            autoComplete="off"
            spellCheck={false}
            className="h-14 w-full bg-transparent text-base text-fg outline-none placeholder:text-muted"
            value={query}
            onChange={(event) => {
              setQuery(event.target.value);
              setActive(0);
            }}
            onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
          />
        </div>
        <div
          id={listboxId}
          role="listbox"
          aria-label={t("palette.resultsLabel")}
          aria-busy={loading ? "true" : undefined}
          className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-2"
        >
          {groups.map((group) => (
            <div key={group.name} role="presentation" className="pb-1">
              <div
                role="presentation"
                className="px-3 pb-1 pt-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted"
              >
                {group.name}
              </div>
              {group.items.map((item) => {
                index += 1;
                const itemIndex = index;
                const selected = itemIndex === activeIndex;
                const Icon = item.icon;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={item.id}
                    id={optionId(itemIndex)}
                    role="option"
                    aria-selected={selected}
                    tabIndex={-1}
                    className={`flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-3 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 ${
                      selected ? "bg-primary-50 text-primary" : "text-fg"
                    }`}
                    onMouseMove={() => {
                      if (!selected) setActive(itemIndex);
                    }}
                    onClick={() => openItem(item)}
                    onKeyDown={(event) => {
                      if (event.key === "Enter") openItem(item);
                    }}
                  >
                    <Icon aria-hidden size={18} strokeWidth={1.75} className="shrink-0" />
                    <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <span className="block truncate text-sm font-medium">{item.title}</span>
                      <span className="block truncate text-xs text-muted">{item.subtitle}</span>
                    </span>
                    {item.trailing ? <span className="shrink-0">{item.trailing}</span> : null}
                    {selected ? (
                      <CornerDownLeft aria-hidden size={16} className="shrink-0 text-muted" />
                    ) : null}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        {flat.length === 0 && !loading && query.trim().length > 0 ? (
          <div className="px-6 pb-8 pt-2 text-center">
            <p className="text-sm font-medium text-fg">
              {t("palette.empty", { query: query.trim() })}
            </p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted">{t("palette.emptyHint")}</p>
          </div>
        ) : null}
        <div
          className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 border-t border-subtle px-4 py-2 text-xs text-muted"
          aria-live="polite"
        >
          {t("palette.footer", { count: flat.length })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```ts
import { useCallback, useEffect } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { feedback } from "../components/feedback";
import { useUi } from "../store/ui";
import { usePaletteControl } from "./CommandPalette";

/** True on macOS and iOS, where shortcuts use ⌘ instead of Ctrl. */
export function isApplePlatform(): boolean {
  const platform = globalThis.navigator?.platform ?? "";
  const agent = globalThis.navigator?.userAgent ?? "";
  return /Mac|iPhone|iPad/.test(platform) || /Mac OS X|iPhone|iPad/.test(agent);
}

/** Display labels for the two global shortcuts on the current platform. */
export function shortcutLabels(): { palette: string; privacy: string } {
  return isApplePlatform()
    ? { palette: "⌘K", privacy: "⇧⌘H" }
    : { palette: "Ctrl K", privacy: "Ctrl Shift H" };
}

/** Toggles privacy mode and announces the new state with an info toast. */
export function usePrivacyToggle(): () => void {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  return useCallback(() => {
    useUi.getState().togglePrivacy();
    const on = useUi.getState().privacy;
    const shortcut = shortcutLabels().privacy;
    feedback(
      t(on ? "privacy.on" : "privacy.off"),
      t(on ? "privacy.onDetail" : "privacy.offDetail", { shortcut }),
      "info",
    );
  }, [t]);
}

/** ⌘K / Ctrl+K opens the command palette; ⇧⌘H / Ctrl+Shift+H toggles privacy mode. */
export function useGlobalShortcuts(): void {
  const { open } = usePaletteControl();
  const togglePrivacy = usePrivacyToggle();
  useEffect(() => {
    function onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (event.isComposing || event.altKey || !(event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey)) return;
      const key = event.key.toLowerCase();
      if (key === "k" && !event.shiftKey) {
        event.preventDefault();
        open();
      } else if (key === "h" && event.shiftKey) {
        event.preventDefault();
        if (!event.repeat) togglePrivacy();
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  }, [open, togglePrivacy]);
}
```

```tsx
import { Bell, BellOff, CircleAlert, Info, TriangleAlert } from "lucide-react";
import { useCallback, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { InlineEmpty, RelativeTime } from "../components/ui";
import { useDismiss } from "./useDismiss";

export interface PopoverNotification {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  body: string;
  at: number;
  read: boolean;
  tone: "warning" | "danger" | "info";
  to: string | null;
}

export interface NotificationsPopoverProps {
  items: PopoverNotification[];
  unread: number;
  onOpenItem(id: number): void;
  onMarkAllRead(): void;
  loading?: boolean;
}

const NO_ITEMS: PopoverNotification[] = [];

/**
 * Data for the popover. This task has no notifications API yet, so the feed is empty; Task 22
 * replaces the body with the `notifications` query.
 */
export function useNotificationsFeed(): NotificationsPopoverProps {
  return {
    items: NO_ITEMS,
    unread: 0,
    onOpenItem: () => undefined,
    onMarkAllRead: () => undefined,
    loading: false,
  };
}

const TONE_ICON = { warning: TriangleAlert, danger: CircleAlert, info: Info } as const;
const TONE_CLASS = {
  warning: "bg-warning-soft text-warning",
  danger: "bg-danger-soft text-danger",
  info: "bg-info-soft text-info",
} as const;

/** Bell with an unread badge and a 380 px popover; closes on Esc and on a click outside. */
export function NotificationsPopover({
  items,
  unread,
  onOpenItem,
  onMarkAllRead,
  loading = false,
}: NotificationsPopoverProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const buttonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const panelId = useId();
  const titleId = useId();

  const close = useCallback(() => setOpen(false), []);
  useDismiss(open, close, rootRef, buttonRef);

  const visible = items.slice(0, 6);
  const bellLabel =
    unread > 0
      ? t("notifications.popover.bellUnread", { count: unread })
      : t("notifications.popover.title");

  return (
    <div ref={rootRef} className="relative">
      <button
        ref={buttonRef}
        type="button"
        aria-label={bellLabel}
        title={bellLabel}
        aria-expanded={open}
        aria-controls={open ? panelId : undefined}
        className="relative grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-xl text-muted transition-colors hover:bg-surface-2 hover:text-fg sm:size-9"
        onClick={() => setOpen((value) => !value)}
      >
        <Bell aria-hidden size={18} strokeWidth={1.75} />
        {unread > 0 ? (
          <span className="absolute right-1.5 top-1.5 size-2 rounded-full bg-accent ring-2 ring-surface" />
        ) : null}
      </button>
      {open ? (
        <div
          id={panelId}
          role="dialog"
          aria-labelledby={titleId}
          className="absolute right-0 top-full z-40 mt-2 w-[380px] max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] rounded-2xl border border-subtle bg-surface shadow-xl"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-subtle px-4 py-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <h2 id={titleId} className="font-display text-base font-semibold text-fg">
                {t("notifications.popover.title")}
              </h2>
              {unread > 0 ? (
                <span className="rounded-full bg-accent/15 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold text-fg">
                  {t("notifications.popover.newCount", { count: unread })}
                </span>
              ) : null}
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={unread === 0}
              className="rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-primary hover:bg-primary-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:text-muted disabled:hover:bg-transparent"
              onClick={onMarkAllRead}
            >
              {t("notifications.popover.markAllRead")}
            </button>
          </div>
          <div
            className="max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto p-2"
            aria-busy={loading ? "true" : undefined}
          >
            {visible.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="px-2 py-6">
                <InlineEmpty
                  icon={BellOff}
                  title={t("notifications.popover.emptyTitle")}
                  description={t("notifications.popover.emptyBody")}
                />
              </div>
            ) : (
              <ul className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                {visible.map((item) => {
                  const Icon = TONE_ICON[item.tone];
                  return (
                    <li key={item.id}>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="flex w-full items-start gap-3 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-left hover:bg-surface-2"
                        onClick={() => {
                          setOpen(false);
                          onOpenItem(item.id);
                        }}
                      >
                        <span
                          className={`mt-0.5 grid size-8 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg ${TONE_CLASS[item.tone]}`}
                        >
                          <Icon aria-hidden size={16} strokeWidth={1.75} />
                        </span>
                        <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                          <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <span className="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-fg">
                              {item.title}
                            </span>
                            {item.read ? null : (
                              <span className="size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-accent">
                                <span className="sr-only">{t("notifications.popover.unread")}</span>
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </span>
                          <span className="line-clamp-2 text-xs text-muted">{item.body}</span>
                          <span className="mt-1 block text-xs text-muted">
                            <RelativeTime at={item.at} />
                          </span>
                        </span>
                      </button>
                    </li>
                  );
                })}
              </ul>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { CircleUserRound, LogOut, Monitor, Moon, Sun } from "lucide-react";
import { type ReactNode, useCallback, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router";
import { api } from "../api";
import { type Language, SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES, setLanguage } from "../i18n";
import { queryKeys } from "../lib/query-keys";
import { type Density, type ThemePreference, useUi } from "../store/ui";
import { useDismiss } from "./useDismiss";

const LANGUAGE_LABELS: Record<Language, string> = { it: "Italiano", en: "English" };
const THEMES: readonly { value: ThemePreference; icon: typeof Sun }[] = [
  { value: "system", icon: Monitor },
  { value: "light", icon: Sun },
  { value: "dark", icon: Moon },
];
const DENSITIES: readonly Density[] = ["compact", "comfortable"];

const OPTION =
  "flex min-h-9 flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg px-2 text-xs font-medium text-muted transition-colors hover:text-fg aria-pressed:bg-surface aria-pressed:text-fg aria-pressed:shadow-sm";

function Segmented({ legend, children }: { legend: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <fieldset className="px-3 py-2">
      <legend className="mb-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-muted">{legend}</legend>
      <div className="flex gap-0.5 rounded-xl bg-surface-2 p-0.5">{children}</div>
    </fieldset>
  );
}

/** Topbar menu: language, theme, density and sign out. Closes on Esc and on a click outside. */
export function UserMenu() {
  const { t, i18n } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const theme = useUi((state) => state.theme);
  const density = useUi((state) => state.density);
  const setTheme = useUi((state) => state.setTheme);
  const setDensity = useUi((state) => state.setDensity);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const buttonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const panelId = useId();

  const logout = useMutation({
    mutationFn: api.logout,
    onSettled: async () => {
      queryClient.setQueryData(queryKeys.authStatus, {
        setupRequired: false,
        authenticated: false,
      });
      await navigate("/login", { replace: true });
      queryClient.removeQueries({
        predicate: (query) => query.queryKey[0] !== queryKeys.authStatus[0],
      });
      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.authStatus });
    },
  });

  const close = useCallback(() => setOpen(false), []);
  useDismiss(open, close, rootRef, buttonRef);

  return (
    <div ref={rootRef} className="relative">
      <button
        ref={buttonRef}
        type="button"
        aria-label={t("userMenu.open")}
        title={t("userMenu.open")}
        aria-expanded={open}
        aria-controls={open ? panelId : undefined}
        className="grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-xl text-muted transition-colors hover:bg-surface-2 hover:text-fg sm:size-9"
        onClick={() => setOpen((value) => !value)}
      >
        <CircleUserRound aria-hidden size={20} strokeWidth={1.75} />
      </button>
      {open ? (
        <div
          id={panelId}
          role="dialog"
          aria-label={t("userMenu.title")}
          className="absolute right-0 top-full z-40 mt-2 w-72 max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] rounded-2xl border border-subtle bg-surface py-2 shadow-xl"
        >
          <Segmented legend={t("common.language")}>
            {SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.map((language) => (
              <button
                key={language}
                type="button"
                lang={language}
                aria-pressed={i18n.language === language}
                className={OPTION}
                onClick={() => setLanguage(language)}
              >
                {LANGUAGE_LABELS[language]}
              </button>
            ))}
          </Segmented>
          <Segmented legend={t("userMenu.theme")}>
            {THEMES.map(({ value, icon: Icon }) => (
              <button
                key={value}
                type="button"
                aria-pressed={theme === value}
                className={OPTION}
                onClick={() => setTheme(value)}
              >
                <Icon aria-hidden size={14} />
                {t(`userMenu.themes.${value}`)}
              </button>
            ))}
          </Segmented>
          <Segmented legend={t("userMenu.density")}>
            {DENSITIES.map((value) => (
              <button
                key={value}
                type="button"
                aria-pressed={density === value}
                className={OPTION}
                onClick={() => setDensity(value)}
              >
                {t(`userMenu.densities.${value}`)}
              </button>
            ))}
          </Segmented>
          <div className="mt-1 border-t border-subtle px-2 pt-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={logout.isPending}
              className="flex min-h-10 w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-3 text-sm font-medium text-fg hover:bg-surface-2 disabled:opacity-60"
              onClick={() => logout.mutate()}
            >
              <LogOut aria-hidden size={16} />
              {t("userMenu.signOut")}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { PanelLeftClose, PanelLeftOpen, X } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { NavLink } from "react-router";
import { Badge } from "../components/ui";
import { useFocusTrap } from "../lib/focus-trap";
import { useUi } from "../store/ui";
import { ProductMark } from "./AuthShell";
import { type NavBadge, useNavBadges } from "./nav-badges";
import { NAV_GROUPS, type NavGroup, type RouteDef, shippedRoutes } from "./routes";

const LABELLED_GROUPS = new Set<NavGroup>(["money", "knowledge", "agents"]);

function NavItem({
  def,
  badge,
  collapsed,
}: {
  def: RouteDef;
  badge: NavBadge | undefined;
  collapsed: boolean;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const label = t(def.titleKey);
  const Icon = def.icon;
  return (
    <li>
      <NavLink
        to={def.path}
        end={def.path === "/"}
        title={collapsed ? label : undefined}
        aria-label={collapsed ? label : undefined}
        className={({ isActive }) =>
          [
            "relative flex min-h-11 items-center gap-3 rounded-xl text-sm transition-colors lg:min-h-10",
            collapsed ? "justify-center px-0" : "px-3",
            isActive
              ? "bg-primary-50 font-semibold text-primary before:absolute before:inset-y-2 before:left-0 before:w-[3px] before:rounded-full before:bg-accent"
              : "font-medium text-muted hover:bg-surface-2 hover:text-fg",
          ].join(" ")
        }
      >
        <Icon aria-hidden size={18} strokeWidth={1.75} className="shrink-0" />
        {collapsed ? null : <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">{label}</span>}
        {badge && !collapsed ? <Badge tone={badge.tone} count={badge.count} /> : null}
        {badge && collapsed && badge.tone === "accent" ? (
          <span className="absolute right-3 top-2 size-2 rounded-full bg-accent">
            <span className="sr-only">{t("nav.needsAction", { count: badge.count })}</span>
          </span>
        ) : null}
      </NavLink>
    </li>
  );
}

/** The navigation list (shipped routes only, grouped as in UX doc §2). */
function SidebarNav({ collapsed }: { collapsed: boolean }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const badges = useNavBadges();
  const routes = shippedRoutes().filter((def) => def.group !== null);
  const sections = NAV_GROUPS.map((group) => ({
    group,
    items: routes.filter((def) => def.group === group),
  })).filter((section) => section.items.length > 0);
  const main = sections.filter((section) => section.group !== "bottom");
  const bottom = sections.find((section) => section.group === "bottom");

  return (
    <nav aria-label={t("nav.label")} className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col">
      <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-3 pb-3">
        {main.map((section) => (
          <div key={section.group} className="pt-3 first:pt-1">
            {LABELLED_GROUPS.has(section.group) ? (
              collapsed ? (
                <div aria-hidden="true" className="mx-3 mb-2 border-t border-subtle" />
              ) : (
                <p className="px-3 pb-1 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted">
                  {t(`nav.groups.${section.group}`)}
                </p>
              )
            ) : null}
            <ul className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
              {section.items.map((def) => (
                <NavItem key={def.id} def={def} badge={badges[def.id]} collapsed={collapsed} />
              ))}
            </ul>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      {bottom ? (
        <ul className="flex flex-col gap-0.5 border-t border-subtle px-3 py-3">
          {bottom.items.map((def) => (
            <NavItem key={def.id} def={def} badge={badges[def.id]} collapsed={collapsed} />
          ))}
        </ul>
      ) : null}
    </nav>
  );
}

function Brand({ collapsed }: { collapsed: boolean }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  return (
    <div
      className={`flex h-16 shrink-0 items-center gap-3 ${collapsed ? "justify-center" : "px-5"}`}
    >
      <ProductMark size="sm" />
      {collapsed ? (
        <span className="sr-only">{t("app.name")}</span>
      ) : (
        <span className="font-display text-lg font-bold text-primary">{t("app.name")}</span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Desktop sidebar (from `lg`): 264 px, or a 76 px rail with native tooltips. Below `lg` the same
 * navigation opens as a drawer over a blurred backdrop; the shell closes it on every route change.
 */
export function Sidebar({
  drawerOpen,
  onCloseDrawer,
}: {
  drawerOpen: boolean;
  onCloseDrawer(): void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const collapsed = useUi((state) => state.sidebarCollapsed);
  const toggleSidebar = useUi((state) => state.toggleSidebar);
  const drawerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  useFocusTrap(drawerRef, drawerOpen);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!drawerOpen) return;
    function onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (event.key === "Escape") onCloseDrawer();
    }
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  }, [drawerOpen, onCloseDrawer]);

  const ToggleIcon = collapsed ? PanelLeftOpen : PanelLeftClose;
  const toggleLabel = collapsed ? t("nav.expand") : t("nav.collapse");

  return (
    <>
      <aside
        className={`fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-30 hidden flex-col border-r border-subtle bg-surface lg:flex ${
          collapsed ? "w-19" : "w-66"
        }`}
      >
        <Brand collapsed={collapsed} />
        <SidebarNav collapsed={collapsed} />
        <div className={`border-t border-subtle p-3 ${collapsed ? "flex justify-center" : ""}`}>
          <button
            type="button"
            aria-label={toggleLabel}
            title={toggleLabel}
            className="grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-xl text-muted transition-colors hover:bg-surface-2 hover:text-fg"
            onClick={toggleSidebar}
          >
            <ToggleIcon aria-hidden size={18} strokeWidth={1.75} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </aside>
      {drawerOpen ? (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 lg:hidden">
          <div
            aria-hidden="true"
            className="absolute inset-0 bg-fg/30 backdrop-blur-sm"
            onClick={onCloseDrawer}
          />
          <div
            ref={drawerRef}
            role="dialog"
            aria-modal="true"
            aria-label={t("nav.label")}
            className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 flex w-72 max-w-[85vw] flex-col bg-surface shadow-xl"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pr-3">
              <Brand collapsed={false} />
              <button
                type="button"
                aria-label={t("nav.close")}
                title={t("nav.close")}
                className="grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-xl text-muted hover:bg-surface-2 hover:text-fg"
                onClick={onCloseDrawer}
              >
                <X aria-hidden size={20} />
              </button>
            </div>
            <SidebarNav collapsed={false} />
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}
```
