```tsx
function ShortcutBindings() {
  useGlobalShortcuts();
  return null;
}

/**
 * Layout of every signed-in page: sidebar, topbar, the routed page (entry transition only, keyed by
 * pathname, no exit animation), the command palette and the toasts.
 */
export function AppShell() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { pathname } = useLocation();
  const collapsed = useUi((state) => state.sidebarCollapsed);
  const [drawerOpen, setDrawerOpen] = useState(false);
  const closeDrawer = useCallback(() => setDrawerOpen(false), []);

  // biome-ignore lint/correctness/useExhaustiveDependencies: the drawer closes on every route change.
  useEffect(() => {
    setDrawerOpen(false);
  }, [pathname]);

  return (
    <MotionConfig reducedMotion="user">
      <FormatProvider>
        <PaletteProvider>
          <ShortcutBindings />
          <div className="min-h-dvh bg-bg">
            <a
              href="#main"
              className="sr-only z-50 rounded-xl bg-surface px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-primary focus:not-sr-only focus:fixed focus:left-4 focus:top-4"

              <Topbar onOpenMenu={() => setDrawerOpen(true)} />
              <main id="main" className="mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl px-4 py-6 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
                <motion.div
                  key={pathname}
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }}

              </main>
            </div>
          </div>
          <CommandPalette />
          <Toaster />
        </PaletteProvider>
      </FormatProvider>
    </MotionConfig>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { createBrowserRouter, type DataRouter, type RouteObject } from "react-router";
import { LoginPage } from "../pages/LoginPage";
import { NotFoundPage } from "../pages/NotFoundPage";
import { SetupPage } from "../pages/SetupPage";
import { AppShell } from "./AppShell";
import { AuthShell } from "./AuthShell";
import { RouteErrorBoundary } from "./ErrorBoundary";
import { PAGE_LOADERS } from "./pages";
import { RequireAuth } from "./RequireAuth";
import { shippedRoutes } from "./routes";

function PendingPage() {
  return <div aria-busy="true" className="min-h-dvh bg-bg" />;
}

/** Shipped routes that have a page loader, as lazy route objects. */
function pageRoutes(): RouteObject[] {
  return shippedRoutes().flatMap((def) => {
    const loader = PAGE_LOADERS[def.id];
    return loader ? [{ path: def.path, lazy: loader }] : [];
  });
}

/**
 * The route tree: `/setup` and `/login` in the AuthShell, every shipped page plus the not-found page
 * in the AppShell, each area behind its `RequireAuth` guard. Exported for tests (memory router).
 */
export function appRoutes(): RouteObject[] {
  return [
    {
      errorElement: <RouteErrorBoundary />,
      hydrateFallbackElement: <PendingPage />,
      children: [
        {
          element: <RequireAuth area="auth" />,
          children: [
            {
              element: <AuthShell />,
              children: [
                { path: "/setup", element: <SetupPage /> },
                { path: "/login", element: <LoginPage /> },
              ],
            },
          ],
        },
        {
          element: <RequireAuth area="app" />,
          children: [
            {
              element: <AppShell />,
              children: [
                {
                  errorElement: <RouteErrorBoundary />,
                  children: [...pageRoutes(), { path: "*", element: <NotFoundPage /> }],
                },
              ],
            },
          ],
        },
      ],
    },
  ];
}

export function createAppRouter(): DataRouter {
  return createBrowserRouter(appRoutes());
}
```

```ts
import { useCallback, useMemo, useRef } from "react";
import { useSearchParams } from "react-router";

export interface UrlStateOptions<T extends Record<string, string>> {
  validate?: Partial<Record<keyof T, (value: string) => boolean>>;
  resetOnChange?: (keyof T)[];
}

/**
 * Filters, tabs and periods kept in the query string. Default values are absent from the URL, an
 * invalid value reads as its default, writes use `replace`, and the keys in `resetOnChange` (for
 * example `page`) return to their default whenever another key changes. Unknown parameters are kept.
 */
export function useUrlState<T extends Record<string, string>>(
  defaults: T,
  options: UrlStateOptions<T> = {},
): [T, (patch: Partial<T>) => void] {
  const [params, setParams] = useSearchParams();
  const defaultsRef = useRef(defaults);
  defaultsRef.current = defaults;
  const optionsRef = useRef(options);
  optionsRef.current = options;

  const search = params.toString();
  const defaultsKey = JSON.stringify(defaults);
  // biome-ignore lint/correctness/useExhaustiveDependencies: values change only when the query string or the defaults change; the refs hold the latest objects.
  const values = useMemo(() => {
    const current = new URLSearchParams(search);
    const result = { ...defaultsRef.current };
    for (const key of Object.keys(result) as (keyof T & string)[]) {
      const raw = current.get(key);
      if (raw === null) continue;
      const isValid = optionsRef.current.validate?.[key];
      if (!isValid || isValid(raw)) result[key] = raw as T[keyof T & string];
    }
    return result;
  }, [search, defaultsKey]);

  const update = useCallback(
    (patch: Partial<T>) => {
      setParams(
        (previous) => {
          const next = new URLSearchParams(previous);
          const fallback = defaultsRef.current;
          const reset = (optionsRef.current.resetOnChange ?? []) as string[];
          let otherChanged = false;
          for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(patch)) {
            if (value === undefined) continue;
            const before = previous.get(key) ?? fallback[key];
            if (value === fallback[key]) next.delete(key);
            else next.set(key, value);
            if (!reset.includes(key) && before !== value) otherChanged = true;
          }
          if (otherChanged) {
            for (const key of reset) if (!(key in patch)) next.delete(key);
          }
          return next;
        },
        { replace: true },
      );
    },
    [setParams],
  );

  return [values, update];
}
```

```tsx
import { localTimeOfDay, toLocalDate } from "@bursar/shared";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { PageHeader } from "../components/ui";
import { useFormatters } from "../lib/format";

/** Morning before 12:00, afternoon before 18:00, evening otherwise (owner's local time). */
export function greetingKey(
  timeOfDay: string,
): "home.greeting.morning" | "home.greeting.afternoon" | "home.greeting.evening" {
  const hour = Number.parseInt(timeOfDay.slice(0, 2), 10);
  if (hour >= 5 && hour < 12) return "home.greeting.morning";
  if (hour >= 12 && hour < 18) return "home.greeting.afternoon";
  return "home.greeting.evening";
}

/** Home in Task 4: the greeting with the local date. Task 17 adds the summary, KPIs and alerts. */
export function HomePage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const format = useFormatters();
  const now = format.now();
  const today = toLocalDate(now, format.timeZone);
  return (
    <PageHeader
      title={t(greetingKey(localTimeOfDay(now, format.timeZone)))}
      subtitle={format.localDate(today, "long")}
    />
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useSearchParams } from "react-router";
import { ApiError, api } from "../api";
import { AuthNotice } from "../app/AuthShell";
import { Button, TextInput } from "../components/ui";
import { queryKeys } from "../lib/query-keys";

/** Sign-in with password and authenticator code. The guard sends the owner on to `next`. */
export function LoginPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [code, setCode] = useState("");
  const login = useMutation({
    mutationFn: api.login,
    onSuccess: () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.authStatus }),
  });

  let errorMessage: string | null = null;
  if (login.error instanceof ApiError && login.error.status === 429)
    errorMessage = t("login.tooMany");
  else if (login.error) errorMessage = t("login.failed");
  const expired = searchParams.get("expired") === "1" && !login.isError;

  return (
    <>
      <h1 className="mb-1 font-display text-xl font-bold text-fg">{t("login.title")}</h1>
      <p className="mb-6 text-sm text-muted">{t("login.intro")}</p>
      {expired ? <AuthNotice tone="info">{t("login.sessionExpired")}</AuthNotice> : null}
      {errorMessage ? <AuthNotice tone="danger">{errorMessage}</AuthNotice> : null}
      <form
        className="flex flex-col gap-4"
        onSubmit={(event) => {
          event.preventDefault();
          login.mutate({ password, code });
        }}
      >
        <TextInput
          label={t("login.password")}
          type="password"
          autoComplete="current-password"
          required
          value={password}
          onChange={(event) => setPassword(event.target.value)}
        />
        <TextInput
          label={t("login.code")}
          inputMode="numeric"
          autoComplete="one-time-code"
          pattern="\d{6}"
          maxLength={6}
          required
          value={code}
          onChange={(event) => setCode(event.target.value.trim())}
        />
        <Button type="submit" className="mt-2 w-full" loading={login.isPending}>
          {t("login.submit")}
        </Button>
      </form>
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH, type SetupStartResponse } from "@bursar/shared";
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import QRCode from "qrcode";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { ApiError, api } from "../api";
import { AuthNotice } from "../app/AuthShell";
import { Button, TextInput } from "../components/ui";
import { queryKeys } from "../lib/query-keys";

function startErrorMessage(error: unknown, t: (key: string) => string): string | null {
  if (!error) return null;
  if (error instanceof ApiError && error.status === 429) return t("setup.tooMany");
  return t("setup.startFailed");
}

/** First run: setup code and password, then the authenticator enrolment (QR or manual key). */
export function SetupPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [setupCode, setSetupCode] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [passwordConfirm, setPasswordConfirm] = useState("");
  const [localError, setLocalError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [enrolment, setEnrolment] = useState<SetupStartResponse | null>(null);
  const [qr, setQr] = useState<{ url: string | null; failed: boolean }>({
    url: null,
    failed: false,
  });
  const [code, setCode] = useState("");

  const start = useMutation({ mutationFn: api.setupStart, onSuccess: setEnrolment });
  const confirm = useMutation({
    mutationFn: api.setupConfirm,
    onSuccess: () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.authStatus }),
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enrolment) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    QRCode.toDataURL(enrolment.otpauthUri, { margin: 1, width: 224 })
      .then((url) => {
        if (!cancelled) setQr({ url, failed: false });
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setQr({ url: null, failed: true });
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [enrolment]);

  if (!enrolment) {
    const error = localError ?? startErrorMessage(start.error, t);
    return (
      <>
        <h1 className="mb-1 font-display text-xl font-bold text-fg">{t("setup.title")}</h1>
        <p className="mb-6 text-sm text-muted">{t("setup.intro")}</p>
        {error ? <AuthNotice tone="danger">{error}</AuthNotice> : null}
        <form
          className="flex flex-col gap-4"
          onSubmit={(event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            if (password.length < PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH) {
              setLocalError(t("setup.passwordTooShort", { min: PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH }));
            } else if (password !== passwordConfirm) {
              setLocalError(t("setup.passwordMismatch"));
            } else {
              setLocalError(null);
              start.mutate({ setupCode, password });
            }
          }}
        >
          <TextInput
            label={t("setup.setupCode")}
            autoComplete="off"
            required
            value={setupCode}
            onChange={(event) => setSetupCode(event.target.value)}
          />
          <TextInput
            label={t("setup.password")}
            type="password"
            autoComplete="new-password"
            required
            value={password}
            onChange={(event) => setPassword(event.target.value)}
            hint={t("setup.passwordHint", { min: PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH })}
          />
          <TextInput
            label={t("setup.passwordConfirm")}
            type="password"
            autoComplete="new-password"
            required
            value={passwordConfirm}
            onChange={(event) => setPasswordConfirm(event.target.value)}
          />
          <Button type="submit" className="mt-2 w-full" loading={start.isPending}>
            {t("setup.continue")}
          </Button>
        </form>
      </>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <h1 className="mb-1 font-display text-xl font-bold text-fg">{t("setup.scanTitle")}</h1>
      <p className="mb-4 text-sm text-muted">{t("setup.scanHelp")}</p>
      {qr.failed ? <AuthNotice tone="danger">{t("setup.qrFailed")}</AuthNotice> : null}
      {qr.url ? (
        <img
          src={qr.url}
          alt={t("setup.qrAlt")}
          className="mx-auto mb-4 size-56 rounded-xl border border-subtle bg-surface p-2"
        />
      ) : null}
      <p className="mb-6 break-all rounded-xl bg-surface-2 p-3 font-mono text-xs text-fg">
        {t("setup.manualSecret")}: {enrolment.secret}
      </p>
      {confirm.error ? <AuthNotice tone="danger">{t("setup.confirmFailed")}</AuthNotice> : null}
      <form
        className="flex flex-col gap-4"
        onSubmit={(event) => {
          event.preventDefault();
          confirm.mutate({ setupToken: enrolment.setupToken, code });
        }}
      >
        <TextInput
          label={t("setup.code")}
          inputMode="numeric"
          autoComplete="one-time-code"
          pattern="\d{6}"
          maxLength={6}
          required
          value={code}
          onChange={(event) => setCode(event.target.value.trim())}
        />

        </Button>
      </form>
```

**Notes for the implementer:**
- `<prefix>` is the Global Constraints shell prefix. The QA server started by the harness is a loopback test fixture started and stopped inside the command, not a dev server: no owner gate.
- Nothing under `apps/server/src/qa/` is imported by `index.ts` or `server.ts`; the seed reaches the server only through `StartOverrides`. The tsup build entries do not include it.
- The QA server writes its logs to stderr; its stdout carries only the ready line. The ready line holds a session token for a throwaway database: the harness never prints it, and you must not paste it into reports (write `<token>`).
- Server-sent events (Task 7, `/api/events`) keep a request open forever, so the harness never uses Playwright's `networkidle`. It waits until no request other than an event stream is in flight for 500 ms (`Probe.waitForQuiet`).
- Console `Failed to load resource` errors for `/api/*` responses are not counted as console errors: 4xx responses are expected page states (a not-found account, an invalid callback state) and 5xx responses are reported once as `api5xx`. A missing `/favicon.ico` is ignored too. Any other failed resource (script, stylesheet, font, image) is a `console` failure.
- In full-page screenshots, sticky and fixed bars (the topbar) can appear in the middle of the image. That is a screenshot artefact, not a layout bug.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement the in-memory cache and the 404 rule**

Replace `apps/server/src/http/static.ts` with:

```ts
import { existsSync, readFileSync, statSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import type { Handler } from "hono";

const CONTENT_TYPES: Record<string, string> = {
  ".html": "text/html; charset=utf-8",
  ".js": "text/javascript; charset=utf-8",
  ".css": "text/css; charset=utf-8",
  ".json": "application/json",
  ".svg": "image/svg+xml",
  ".png": "image/png",
  ".ico": "image/x-icon",
  ".webmanifest": "application/manifest+json",
  ".woff2": "font/woff2",
  ".txt": "text/plain; charset=utf-8",
};

interface CachedFile {
  body: Buffer;
  contentType: string;
  cacheControl: string;
}

function resolveInside(root: string, requestPath: string): string | null {
  let decoded: string;
  try {
    decoded = decodeURIComponent(requestPath);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
  const relative = path.normalize(decoded).replace(/^[/\\]+/, "");
  if (!relative) return null;
  const file = path.join(root, relative);
  if (!file.startsWith(root + path.sep)) return null;
  return existsSync(file) && statSync(file).isFile() ? file : null;
}

/**
 * True when the request names a file rather than a panel route: anything under /assets/, or a
 * last path segment with an extension. A missing file must be a 404, never the panel's
 * index.html, or a stale hashed bundle would receive HTML instead of a script.
 */
function namesAFile(requestPath: string): boolean {
  if (requestPath.startsWith("/assets/")) return true;
  const lastSegment = requestPath.slice(requestPath.lastIndexOf("/") + 1);
  return /\.[A-Za-z0-9]+$/.test(lastSegment);
}

export function webAppHandler(webDistDir: string): Handler {
  const root = path.resolve(webDistDir);
  const indexFile = path.join(root, "index.html");
  if (!existsSync(indexFile)) throw new Error(`Web build not found: ${indexFile}`);
  const indexHtml = readFileSync(indexFile, "utf8");
  // The build directory does not change while the process runs (one build per deploy), so each
  // file is read once and then served from memory. Keys are resolved file paths, which bounds the
  // cache by the number of files in the build.
  const cache = new Map<string, CachedFile>();

  return (c) => {
    const file = resolveInside(root, c.req.path);
    if (!file) {
      if (namesAFile(c.req.path)) return c.text("Not found", 404, { "cache-control": "no-cache" });
      return c.html(indexHtml, 200, { "cache-control": "no-cache" });
    }
    let cached = cache.get(file);
    if (!cached) {
      const isAsset = path.relative(root, file).startsWith(`assets${path.sep}`);
      cached = {
        body: readFileSync(file),
        contentType: CONTENT_TYPES[path.extname(file)] ?? "application/octet-stream",
        cacheControl: isAsset ? "public, max-age=31536000, immutable" : "no-cache",
      };
      cache.set(file, cached);
    }
    return c.body(cached.body, 200, {
      "content-type": cached.contentType,
      "cache-control": cached.cacheControl,
    });
  };
}
```

```ts
  let ctx: SeedContext;

  beforeEach(() => {

    const config = loadConfig({

      BURSAR_MASTER_KEY: Buffer.alloc(32, 7).toString("base64"),
      BURSAR_DATA_DIR: t.dir,
      BURSAR_MIGRATIONS_DIR: MIGRATIONS_DIR,

    ctx = { db: t.db, sqlite: t.sqlite, config, now: () => NOW };
  });

  it("leaves the database without an owner and returns no token when asked", async () => {

    expect(sessionToken).toBeNull();
    expect(owners().exists()).toBe(false);
  });

  it("runs every registered seeder exactly once with the seed context", async () => {
    const calls: SeedContext[] = [];
    const spy: QaSeeder = (seedCtx) => {
      calls.push(seedCtx);
    };
    QA_SEEDERS.push(spy);
    try {
      await seedQa(ctx, { owner: true });
    } finally {
      QA_SEEDERS.splice(QA_SEEDERS.indexOf(spy), 1);
    }
    expect(calls).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(calls[0]).toBe(ctx);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { once } from "node:events";

  config: Config,
  logger: Logger,
  overrides: StartOverrides = {},
): Promise<RunningBursar> {
  if (!config.cfAccess && !isLoopbackHost(config.publicUrl.hostname)) {
    logger.warn(
      { publicUrl: config.publicUrl.origin },
      "Cloudflare Access is not configured: the panel is protected by the app login alone",
    );
  }
  mkdirSync(config.dataDir, { recursive: true });
  const database = openDatabase(
    path.join(config.dataDir, "bursar.db"),
    deriveKey(config.masterKey, "database").toString("hex"),
  );
  runMigrations(database.db, config.migrationsDir);

  if (overrides.seed) {
    try {
      await overrides.seed({ db: database.db, sqlite: database.sqlite, config, now: Date.now });
    } catch (error) {
      database.close();
      throw error;
    }
  }

  const owners = new OwnerStore(database.db, deriveKey(config.masterKey, "totp"));
  const sessions = new SessionStore(database.db);
  const setupCodeFile = path.join(config.dataDir, "setup-code");
  const setupCode = new SetupCode(setupCodeFile);
  if (!owners.exists()) {
    setupCode.issue();
    logger.warn({ file: setupCodeFile }, "No owner yet: open the panel and enter the setup code");
  }

  const queue = new JobQueue(database.sqlite);
  const worker = new JobWorker(queue, new Map<string, JobHandler>(), logger);
  const scheduler = new Scheduler([maintenanceTask(queue, sessions, logger)], logger);

  const app = createApp({
    config,
    logger,
    healthCheck: () => {
      try {
        database.sqlite.prepare("SELECT 1").get();
        return true;
      } catch {
        return false;
      }
    },
    auth: {
      owners,
      sessions,
      setupCode,
      // 5 failures per client and 20 for the account per 15 minutes; sessions stay valid.
      limiter: new FailureLimiter(5),
      accountLimiter: new FailureLimiter(20),
      secureCookies: config.publicUrl.protocol === "https:",
      now: Date.now,
      // CF-Connecting-IP is set by Cloudflare's edge; any other client could forge it.
      getClientIp: (c) =>
        (config.trustCfConnectingIp ? c.req.header("cf-connecting-ip")?.trim() : undefined) ||
        getConnInfo(c).remote.address ||
        "unknown",
    },
  });

  const server = serve({ fetch: app.fetch, port: config.port, hostname: config.host });
  await once(server, "listening");
  const address = server.address();
  const port = typeof address === "object" && address ? address.port : config.port;

  worker.start();
  scheduler.start();

  return {
    port,
    close: async () => {
      await scheduler.stop();
      await worker.stop();
      await new Promise<void>((resolve) => server.close(() => resolve()));
      database.close();
    },
  };
}
```

The seed runs before the owner check on purpose: a seeded owner must not leave a setup code behind.

- [ ] **Step 9: Write the seeder registry and `seedQa`**

Create `apps/server/src/qa/seeders.ts`:

```ts
import type { SeedContext } from "../server";

/**
 * Writes deterministic QA data into a freshly migrated database. Seeders are synchronous, use
 * `ctx.now()` for every date and never `Math.random`, so two runs with the same clock match.
 */
export type QaSeeder = (ctx: SeedContext) => void;

/** Seeders run in order by `seedQa`. Later tasks append theirs (Task 6: `seedBanking`). */
export const QA_SEEDERS: QaSeeder[] = [];
```

Create `apps/server/src/qa/seed.ts`:

```ts
import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
import { OwnerStore } from "../auth/owner";
import { hashPassword } from "../auth/passwords";
import { SessionStore } from "../auth/sessions";
import { createTotpSetup } from "../auth/totp";
import { deriveKey } from "../crypto";
import type { SeedContext } from "../server";
import { QA_SEEDERS } from "./seeders";

/**
 * Prepares a fresh QA database. With `owner`, it creates the owner with a random password and a
 * random TOTP secret that nobody needs to know, and opens a session whose raw token the QA
 * harness puts in its browser cookie. Then it runs every registered seeder once.
 */
export async function seedQa(
  ctx: SeedContext,
  options: { owner: boolean },
): Promise<{ sessionToken: string | null }> {
  let sessionToken: string | null = null;
  if (options.owner) {
    const owners = new OwnerStore(ctx.db, deriveKey(ctx.config.masterKey, "totp"));
    const { secret } = createTotpSetup("qa");
    owners.create(
      {
        passwordHash: await hashPassword(randomBytes(24).toString("base64url")),
        totpSecret: secret,
        lastTotpStep: 0,
      },
      new Date(ctx.now()),
    );
    sessionToken = new SessionStore(ctx.db, ctx.now).create("qa");
  }
  for (const seeder of QA_SEEDERS) seeder(ctx);
  return { sessionToken };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 11: Write the QA server entry point**

Create `apps/server/src/qa/qa-server.ts`:

```ts
import { mkdtempSync, rmSync } from "node:fs";
import { createServer } from "node:net";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { parseArgs } from "node:util";
import { pino } from "pino";
import { loadConfig } from "../config";
import { configSecrets, createLogger } from "../logger";
import { startBursar } from "../server";
import { seedQa } from "./seed";

/**
 * Ephemeral, seeded Bursar for the QA harness: loopback only, a temporary data directory that is
 * removed on exit, and a fixed master key. The key is not a secret: QA databases are throwaway.
 *
 * Usage (from apps/server): tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.runtime.json src/qa/qa-server.ts
 *   [--no-owner] [--web-dist <path>]
 * Prints exactly one JSON line on stdout once it listens:
 *   {"ready":true,"baseUrl":"http://127.0.0.1:<port>","sessionToken":"<token or null>"}
 * Logs go to stderr. Stops on SIGTERM, SIGINT or when stdin closes (the harness exited).
 */
const QA_MASTER_KEY = Buffer.alloc(32, 7).toString("base64");
const SERVER_DIR = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "../..");

function freeLoopbackPort(): Promise<number> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const probe = createServer();
    probe.once("error", reject);
    probe.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", () => {
      const address = probe.address();
      const port = typeof address === "object" && address ? address.port : 0;
      probe.close(() => (port > 0 ? resolve(port) : reject(new Error("No free port found"))));
    });
  });
}

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  const { values } = parseArgs({
    options: {
      "no-owner": { type: "boolean", default: false },
      "web-dist": { type: "string" },
    },
  });
  const webDist = path.resolve(values["web-dist"] ?? path.join(SERVER_DIR, "../web/dist"));
  const port = await freeLoopbackPort();
  const dataDir = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), "bursar-qa-"));
  const removeDataDir = () => rmSync(dataDir, { recursive: true, force: true });

  let sessionToken: string | null = null;
  const running = await (async () => {
    const config = loadConfig({
      BURSAR_PUBLIC_URL: `http://127.0.0.1:${port}`,
      BURSAR_HOST: "127.0.0.1",
      BURSAR_PORT: String(port),
      TZ: "Europe/Rome",
      BURSAR_MASTER_KEY: QA_MASTER_KEY,
      BURSAR_DATA_DIR: dataDir,
      BURSAR_MIGRATIONS_DIR: path.join(SERVER_DIR, "drizzle"),
      BURSAR_WEB_DIST: webDist,
      BURSAR_LOG_LEVEL: "warn",
    });
    const logger = createLogger(
      config.logLevel,
      pino.destination({ dest: 2, sync: true }),
      configSecrets(config),
    );
    return startBursar(config, logger, {
      seed: async (ctx) => {
        sessionToken = (await seedQa(ctx, { owner: values["no-owner"] !== true })).sessionToken;
      },
    });
  })().catch((error: unknown) => {
    removeDataDir();
    throw error;
  });

  let stopping = false;
  const shutdown = () => {
    if (stopping) return;
    stopping = true;
    running.close().finally(() => {
      removeDataDir();
      process.exit(0);
    });
  };
  process.once("SIGTERM", shutdown);
  process.once("SIGINT", shutdown);
  process.stdin.once("end", shutdown);
  process.stdin.resume();

  process.stdout.write(
    `${JSON.stringify({ ready: true, baseUrl: `http://127.0.0.1:${running.port}`, sessionToken })}\n`,
  );
}

main().catch((error: unknown) => {
  process.stderr.write(`QA server failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}\n`);
  process.exit(1);
});
```

`freeLoopbackPort` closes its probe before Bursar binds the port, so another process could take it in between; on a developer machine that window is negligible, and the harness reports a clear "exited before it was ready" error if it happens.

- [ ] **Step 14: Write the shared QA library**

Create `apps/web/qa/lib.ts`:

```ts
import { type ChildProcess, spawn, spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import { existsSync, mkdirSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { createInterface } from "node:readline";
import { setTimeout as delay } from "node:timers/promises";
import {
  type Browser,
  type BrowserContext,
  chromium,
  type Page,
  type Request as PwRequest,
} from "playwright-core";

declare global {
  interface Window {
    /** CSP violations recorded by the QA init script. */
    __qaCsp?: string[];
  }
}

export const WEB_DIR = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..");
export const SERVER_DIR = path.resolve(WEB_DIR, "../server");
export const WEB_DIST = path.join(WEB_DIR, "dist");
export const OUT_DIR = path.join(WEB_DIR, "qa", "out");

export type CaptureName = "desktop-light" | "desktop-dark" | "phone-light";

export interface Capture {
  name: CaptureName;
  viewport: "desktop" | "phone";
  theme: "light" | "dark";
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

/** UX doc §9: every route at 1440×900 light and dark, and at 390×844. */
export const CAPTURES: readonly Capture[] = [
  { name: "desktop-light", viewport: "desktop", theme: "light", width: 1440, height: 900 },
  { name: "desktop-dark", viewport: "desktop", theme: "dark", width: 1440, height: 900 },
  { name: "phone-light", viewport: "phone", theme: "light", width: 390, height: 844 },
];

/** The panel's default language and the QA server's time zone. */
const QA_LOCALE = "it-IT";
const QA_TIMEZONE = "Europe/Rome";

/** Pause after the page is quiet, so entry animations (≤ 530 ms) finish before the checks. */
const SETTLE_MS = 700;

/** Event streams stay open by design and never count as pending network work. */
const STREAM_PATHS = new Set(["/api/events"]);

/** Visible text that reveals a formatting bug. */
const BAD_VALUE_PATTERN = /\bundefined\b|\bNaN\b|Invalid Date/g;

/** Visible text that looks like an untranslated i18n key of a known prefix. */
const RAW_KEY_PATTERN =
  /\b(common|nav|shell|home|accounts|account|connect|transactions|settings|notifications|routes|empty|table|errors)\.[A-Za-z0-9_.]+\b/g;

const OS_DEFAULT_CHROME: Partial<Record<NodeJS.Platform, string>> = {
  darwin: "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome",
  linux: "/usr/bin/google-chrome",
  win32: "C:\\Program Files\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe",
};

export function errorMessage(error: unknown): string {
  return error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
}

const clip = (text: string, max = 300): string => text.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().slice(0, max);

const unique = (matches: RegExpMatchArray | null): string[] => [...new Set(matches ?? [])];

function pathOf(url: string): string {
  try {
    return new URL(url).pathname;
  } catch {
    return url;
  }
}

/** "/" → "root", "/accounts/1?tab=connection" → "accounts-1-tab-connection". */
export function slugify(urlPath: string): string {
  const slug = urlPath
    .replace(/^\/+/, "")
    .replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "")
    .toLowerCase();
  return slug || "root";
}

/** The system Chrome: CHROME_PATH, else the OS default location, else Playwright's "chrome" channel. Never downloads a browser. */
export async function launchBrowser(): Promise<Browser> {
  const configured = process.env.CHROME_PATH;
  if (configured) {
    if (!existsSync(configured)) throw new Error(`CHROME_PATH points to a missing file: ${configured}`);
    return chromium.launch({ executablePath: configured, headless: true });
  }
  const osDefault = OS_DEFAULT_CHROME[process.platform];
  if (osDefault && existsSync(osDefault)) {
    return chromium.launch({ executablePath: osDefault, headless: true });
  }
  return chromium.launch({ channel: "chrome", headless: true });
}

/** Production build of the panel into apps/web/dist. */
export function buildWeb(): void {
  const result = spawnSync("pnpm", ["run", "build"], { cwd: WEB_DIR, stdio: "inherit" });
  if (result.status !== 0) {
    throw new Error(`The web build failed (exit ${result.status ?? result.signal ?? "unknown"})`);
  }
}

export interface QaServer {
  baseUrl: string;
  sessionToken: string | null;
  stop(): Promise<void>;
}

interface ReadyLine {
  ready: true;
  baseUrl: string;
  sessionToken: string | null;
}

function parseReadyLine(line: string): ReadyLine | null {
  let value: unknown;
  try {
    value = JSON.parse(line);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
  if (typeof value !== "object" || value === null) return null;
  const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  const token = record.sessionToken;
  if (record.ready !== true || typeof record.baseUrl !== "string") return null;
  if (typeof token !== "string" && token !== null) return null;
  return { ready: true, baseUrl: record.baseUrl, sessionToken: token };
}

const liveServers = new Set<ChildProcess>();
process.once("exit", () => {
  for (const child of liveServers) child.kill("SIGTERM");
});

function waitForReady(child: ChildProcess, timeoutMs: number): Promise<ReadyLine> {
  const stdout = child.stdout;
  if (!stdout) return Promise.reject(new Error("The QA server has no stdout pipe"));
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    // The two callbacks reference each other; both run only after both constants exist.
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      child.off("exit", onExit);
      reject(new Error(`The QA server was not ready within ${timeoutMs} ms`));
    }, timeoutMs);
    const onExit = (code: number | null) => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      reject(new Error(`The QA server exited before it was ready (exit ${code ?? "signal"})`));
    };
    child.once("exit", onExit);
    // Keeps reading after the ready line so the pipe never fills up.
    createInterface({ input: stdout }).on("line", (line) => {
      const ready = parseReadyLine(line);
      if (!ready) return;
      clearTimeout(timer);
      child.off("exit", onExit);
      resolve(ready);
    });
  });
}

/** Starts apps/server/src/qa/qa-server.ts and waits for its ready line. */
export async function startQaServer(options: { owner: boolean; webDist?: string }): Promise<QaServer> {
  const tsx = path.join(SERVER_DIR, "node_modules", ".bin", "tsx");
  const args = [
    "--tsconfig",
    "tsconfig.runtime.json",
    "src/qa/qa-server.ts",
    "--web-dist",
    options.webDist ?? WEB_DIST,
  ];
  if (!options.owner) args.push("--no-owner");
  const child = spawn(tsx, args, { cwd: SERVER_DIR, stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "inherit"] });
  liveServers.add(child);
  const exited = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
    child.once("exit", () => {
      liveServers.delete(child);
      resolve();
    });
  });
  const ready = await waitForReady(child, 60_000).catch(async (error: unknown) => {
    child.kill("SIGKILL");
    await exited;
    throw error;
  });
  return {
    baseUrl: ready.baseUrl,
    sessionToken: ready.sessionToken,
    async stop() {
      if (!liveServers.has(child)) return;
      child.kill("SIGTERM");
      const force = setTimeout(() => child.kill("SIGKILL"), 10_000);
      await exited;
      clearTimeout(force);
    },
  };
}

export interface Session {
  baseUrl: string;
  token: string;
}

/**
 * A fresh browser context for one capture: viewport, colour scheme (the panel's theme
 * preference stays at its default "system"), Italian locale, Rome time zone, a CSP violation
 * recorder, and the owner's session cookie when `session` is given.
 */
export async function newCaptureContext(
  browser: Browser,
  capture: Capture,
  session: Session | null,
): Promise<BrowserContext> {
  const phone = capture.viewport === "phone";
  const context = await browser.newContext({
    viewport: { width: capture.width, height: capture.height },
    colorScheme: capture.theme,
    locale: QA_LOCALE,
    timezoneId: QA_TIMEZONE,
    deviceScaleFactor: phone ? 2 : 1,
    isMobile: phone,
    hasTouch: phone,
  });
  await context.addInitScript(() => {
    window.__qaCsp = [];
    document.addEventListener("securitypolicyviolation", (event) => {
      window.__qaCsp?.push(
        `${event.effectiveDirective} blocked ${event.blockedURI || "inline"} (${event.sourceFile || "document"}:${event.lineNumber})`,
      );
    });
  });
  if (session) {
    await context.addCookies([
      {
        name: "bursar_session",
        value: session.token,
        url: session.baseUrl,
        httpOnly: true,
        sameSite: "Strict",
      },
    ]);
  }
  return context;
}

export interface Probe {
  readonly failures: string[];
  reset(): void;
  waitForQuiet(timeoutMs?: number): Promise<void>;
}

/**
 * Console resource errors for the API are page states (4xx) or already reported as api5xx;
 * a missing favicon is noise. Every other failed resource is a console failure.
 */
function isReportedElsewhere(text: string, url: string): boolean {
  if (!text.startsWith("Failed to load resource")) return false;
  const pathname = pathOf(url);
  return pathname === "/favicon.ico" || pathname.startsWith("/api/");
}

/** Listens to a page for console errors, page errors, CSP console reports, API 5xx and pending requests. */
export function attachProbe(page: Page): Probe {
  const failures: string[] = [];
  const pending = new Set<PwRequest>();
  page.on("console", (message) => {
    if (message.type() !== "error") return;
    const text = message.text();
    if (/Content Security Policy/i.test(text)) failures.push(`csp: ${clip(text)}`);
    else if (!isReportedElsewhere(text, message.location().url)) failures.push(`console: ${clip(text)}`);
  });
  page.on("pageerror", (error) => {
    failures.push(`pageerror: ${clip(error.message)}`);
  });
  page.on("response", (response) => {
    const pathname = pathOf(response.url());
    if (pathname.startsWith("/api/") && response.status() >= 500) {
      failures.push(`api5xx: ${response.request().method()} ${pathname} -> ${response.status()}`);
    }
  });
  page.on("request", (request) => {
    if (request.resourceType() === "eventsource" || STREAM_PATHS.has(pathOf(request.url()))) return;
    pending.add(request);
  });
  const done = (request: PwRequest) => {
    pending.delete(request);
  };
  page.on("requestfinished", done);
  page.on("requestfailed", done);
  return {
    failures,
    reset: () => {
      failures.length = 0;
    },
    async waitForQuiet(timeoutMs = 15_000) {
      const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
      let quietSince: number | null = null;
      while (Date.now() < deadline) {
        if (pending.size === 0) {
          quietSince ??= Date.now();
          if (Date.now() - quietSince >= 500) return;
        } else {
          quietSince = null;
        }
        await delay(50);
      }
      const waiting = [...pending].map((request) => pathOf(request.url())).slice(0, 3);
      failures.push(`network: still waiting for ${waiting.join(", ")} after ${timeoutMs} ms`);
    },
  };
}

/** Waits for a quiet network, no aria-busy element, loaded fonts and finished entry animations. */
export async function settle(page: Page, probe: Probe, failures: string[]): Promise<void> {
  await probe.waitForQuiet();
  try {
    await page.waitForFunction(
      () => document.querySelector('[aria-busy="true"]') === null,
      undefined,
      { timeout: 10_000 },
    );
  } catch {
    failures.push('busy: an element is still aria-busy="true" after 10 s');
  }
  try {
    await page.evaluate(async () => {
      await document.fonts.ready;
    });
  } catch (error) {
    failures.push(`navigation: ${clip(errorMessage(error))}`);
  }
  await delay(SETTLE_MS);
}

export interface InspectTarget {
  /** Absolute URL to open. */
  url: string;
  capture: Capture;
  /** Pathname the page must end on (a redirect elsewhere is a failure); null skips the check. */
  expectPath: string | null;
  /** Require `<html data-theme>` to match the capture's theme. */
  checkTheme: boolean;
  /** Full-page screenshot destination; null takes none. */
  screenshotPath: string | null;
}

/** Opens a URL in a page that already has a probe attached, runs every check and takes the screenshot. */
export async function inspectPage(
  page: Page,
  probe: Probe,
  target: InspectTarget,
): Promise<{ failures: string[]; screenshotTaken: boolean }> {
  probe.reset();
  const failures: string[] = [];
  try {
    await page.goto(target.url, { waitUntil: "load", timeout: 30_000 });
  } catch (error) {
    return { failures: [`navigation: ${clip(errorMessage(error))}`], screenshotTaken: false };
  }
  await settle(page, probe, failures);

  const facts = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    const width = Math.min(window.innerWidth, root.clientWidth);
    const offenders: string[] = [];
    if (root.scrollWidth > width + 1) {
      for (const element of Array.from(document.body.querySelectorAll("*"))) {
        const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (rect.width === 0 || rect.right <= width + 1) continue;
        const parent = element.parentElement?.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (parent && parent.right > width + 1 && Math.abs(parent.right - rect.right) <= 4) continue;
        const classes = (element.getAttribute("class") ?? "")
          .split(/\s+/)
          .filter(Boolean)
          .slice(0, 4)
          .join(".");
        offenders.push(
          `${element.tagName.toLowerCase()}${classes ? `.${classes}` : ""} right=${Math.round(rect.right)}`,
        );
        if (offenders.length === 3) break;
      }
    }
    return {
      pathname: window.location.pathname,
      text: document.body.innerText,
      scrollWidth: root.scrollWidth,
      width,
      offenders,
      boundary: document.querySelector("[data-error-boundary]") !== null,
      theme: root.dataset.theme ?? null,
      csp: window.__qaCsp ?? [],
    };
  });

  if (target.capture.viewport === "phone" && facts.scrollWidth > facts.width + 1) {
    failures.push(
      `overflow: page is ${facts.scrollWidth}px wide at ${facts.width}px; widest: ${facts.offenders.join("; ") || "unknown"}`,
    );
  }
  const badValues = unique(facts.text.match(BAD_VALUE_PATTERN));
  if (badValues.length > 0) failures.push(`text: ${badValues.join(", ")}`);
  const rawKeys = unique(facts.text.match(RAW_KEY_PATTERN));
  if (rawKeys.length > 0) failures.push(`i18n: raw keys ${rawKeys.slice(0, 5).join(", ")}`);
  if (facts.boundary) failures.push("boundary: an error boundary is rendered");
  for (const violation of facts.csp) failures.push(`csp: ${violation}`);
  if (target.expectPath !== null && facts.pathname !== target.expectPath) {
    failures.push(`redirect: expected ${target.expectPath}, landed on ${facts.pathname}`);
  }
  if (target.checkTheme && facts.theme !== target.capture.theme) {
    failures.push(
      `theme: expected data-theme="${target.capture.theme}", found ${facts.theme ?? "none"}`,
    );
  }

  let screenshotTaken = false;
  if (target.screenshotPath) {
    mkdirSync(path.dirname(target.screenshotPath), { recursive: true });
    await page.screenshot({ path: target.screenshotPath, fullPage: true });
    screenshotTaken = true;
  }
  return { failures: [...new Set([...probe.failures, ...failures])], screenshotTaken };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 15: Write the monkey mode**

Create `apps/web/qa/monkey.ts`:

```ts
import { setTimeout as delay } from "node:timers/promises";
import type { Browser, Page } from "playwright-core";
import {
  attachProbe,
  CAPTURES,
  errorMessage,
  newCaptureContext,
  type Session,
  settle,
} from "./lib";

/** Interactive elements the monkey clicks: buttons and in-app links inside the page and the topbar. */
const CLICKABLE = 'main button, main a[href^="/"], header button, header a[href^="/"]';
const MAX_CLICKS_PER_ROUTE = 40;
/** Never clicked: they end the session or destroy data that later routes need. */
const NEVER_CLICK = /^(sign out|log ?out|esci|disconnect|disconnetti|purge|elimina|delete)\b/i;
/** Never clicked inside a dialog: the confirming action of a confirmation. */
const CONFIRM_ACTION = /^(yes|sì|si|confirm|conferma|ok)\b/i;

export interface MonkeyTarget {
  /** Path and query of an authenticated route. */
  path: string;
  session: Session;
}

const currentPath = (page: Page): string => {
  const url = new URL(page.url());
  return `${url.pathname}${url.search}`;
};

/**
 * Clicks every visible, enabled button and in-app link on each route (desktop, light), pressing
 * Escape after each click and returning to the route when a click navigated away. Records page
 * errors, error boundaries and blank pages (an empty `main`). Returns failures per route path.
 */
export async function runMonkey(
  browser: Browser,
  targets: readonly MonkeyTarget[],
): Promise<Map<string, string[]>> {
  const capture = CAPTURES.find((candidate) => candidate.name === "desktop-light");
  if (!capture) throw new Error("The desktop-light capture is missing");
  const results = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const target of targets) {
    const context = await newCaptureContext(browser, capture, target.session);
    const failures: string[] = [];
    try {
      const page = await context.newPage();
      const probe = attachProbe(page);
      const pageErrors: string[] = [];
      page.on("pageerror", (error) => {
        pageErrors.push(error.message);
      });
      const open = async (): Promise<string> => {
        await page.goto(`${target.session.baseUrl}${target.path}`, {
          waitUntil: "load",
          timeout: 30_000,
        });
        await settle(page, probe, []);
        return currentPath(page);
      };
      // URL state may drop default query values on load, so compare with the settled URL.
      const home = await open();
      let reload = false;
      const total = Math.min(MAX_CLICKS_PER_ROUTE, await page.locator(CLICKABLE).count());
      for (let index = 0; index < total; index += 1) {
        if (reload || currentPath(page) !== home) await open();
        reload = false;
        const element = page.locator(CLICKABLE).nth(index);
        if ((await element.count()) === 0) break;
        if (!(await element.isVisible()) || !(await element.isEnabled())) continue;
        const info = await element.evaluate((node) => {
          const el = node as HTMLElement;
          const label = (el.getAttribute("aria-label") || el.innerText || el.getAttribute("title") || "")
            .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
            .trim()
            .slice(0, 60);
          return {
            label,
            qaSkip: el.closest("[data-qa-skip]") !== null,
            newTab: el.getAttribute("target") === "_blank",
            inDialog: el.closest('[role="dialog"], [role="alertdialog"]') !== null,
          };
        });
        if (info.qaSkip || info.newTab || NEVER_CLICK.test(info.label)) continue;
        if (info.inDialog && CONFIRM_ACTION.test(info.label)) continue;
        const label = info.label || `#${index}`;
        pageErrors.length = 0;
        try {
          await element.click({ timeout: 2_000 });
        } catch {
          continue;
        }
        await probe.waitForQuiet(5_000);
        await delay(300);
        const state = await page.evaluate(() => {
          const main = document.querySelector("main");
          return {
            boundary: document.querySelector("[data-error-boundary]") !== null,
            blank: main === null || main.innerText.trim() === "",
          };
        });
        for (const message of pageErrors) {
          failures.push(`monkey: [${label}] pageerror: ${message.slice(0, 200)}`);
        }
        if (state.boundary) failures.push(`monkey: [${label}] error boundary`);
        if (state.blank) failures.push(`monkey: [${label}] blank page (empty main)`);
        reload = state.boundary || state.blank;
        await page.keyboard.press("Escape");
      }
    } catch (error) {
      failures.push(`monkey: ${target.path} could not be exercised: ${errorMessage(error)}`);
    } finally {
      await context.close();
    }
    results.set(target.path, failures);
  }
  return results;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 16: Write the runner with the self-test**

Create `apps/web/qa/run.ts`:

```ts
import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { parseArgs } from "node:util";
import { AxeBuilder } from "@axe-core/playwright";
import type { Browser } from "playwright-core";
import { type RouteDef, shippedRoutes } from "../src/app/routes";
import { QA_EXTRA_PATHS } from "./extra-paths";
import {
  attachProbe,
  buildWeb,
  CAPTURES,
  type Capture,
  errorMessage,
  inspectPage,
  launchBrowser,
  newCaptureContext,
  OUT_DIR,
  type QaServer,
  type Session,
  slugify,
  startQaServer,
} from "./lib";
import { runMonkey } from "./monkey";
import { QA_PARAMS } from "./params";

class UsageError extends Error {}

interface Options {
  skipBuild: boolean;
  routes: string[] | null;
  monkey: boolean;
  selfTest: boolean;
}

interface Visit {
  /** Name in the report: the path, or the path plus the server it runs against. */
  label: string;
  path: string;
  server: QaServer;
  auth: boolean;
  expectPath: string;
  slug: string;
}

interface UrlReport {
  url: string;
  viewport: Capture["viewport"];
  theme: Capture["theme"];
  failures: string[];
  axeViolations: number;
}

interface AxeEntry {
  url: string;
  theme: Capture["theme"];
  rule: string;
  impact: string | null;
  nodes: number;
  help: string;
}

function parseOptions(argv: string[]): Options {
  const { values } = parseArgs({
    args: argv.filter((arg) => arg !== "--"),
    options: {
      "skip-build": { type: "boolean", default: false },
      routes: { type: "string" },
      monkey: { type: "boolean", default: false },
      "self-test": { type: "boolean", default: false },
    },
    strict: true,
  });
  const routes = values.routes
    ?.split(",")
    .map((id) => id.trim())
    .filter((id) => id !== "");
  return {
    skipBuild: values["skip-build"] === true,
    routes: routes && routes.length > 0 ? routes : null,
    monkey: values.monkey === true,
    selfTest: values["self-test"] === true,
  };
}

function selectRoutes(options: Options): RouteDef[] {
  const shipped = shippedRoutes();
  const wanted = options.routes;
  if (!wanted) return shipped;
  const unknown = wanted.filter((id) => !shipped.some((route) => route.id === id));
  if (unknown.length > 0) {
    throw new UsageError(
      `Not a shipped route id: ${unknown.join(", ")} (shipped: ${shipped.map((r) => r.id).join(", ")})`,
    );
  }
  return shipped.filter((route) => wanted.includes(route.id));
}

function fillParams(route: RouteDef): string {
  return route.path.replace(/:[A-Za-z]+/g, (segment) => {
    const value = QA_PARAMS[segment];
    if (value === undefined) {
      throw new UsageError(`QA_PARAMS in qa/params.ts has no value for ${segment} (route ${route.id})`);
    }
    return encodeURIComponent(value);
  });
}

function planVisits(
  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
  includeExtras: boolean,
  owner: QaServer,
  noOwner: QaServer,
): Visit[] {
  const visits: Visit[] = routes.map((route) => {
    const filled = fillParams(route);
    return { label: filled, path: filled, server: owner, auth: true, expectPath: filled, slug: slugify(filled) };
  });
  if (!includeExtras) return visits;
  for (const extra of QA_EXTRA_PATHS) {
    visits.push({
      label: extra.path,
      path: extra.path,
      server: owner,
      auth: extra.auth,
      expectPath: new URL(extra.path, owner.baseUrl).pathname,
      slug: `${extra.auth ? "" : "public-"}${slugify(extra.path)}`,
    });
  }
  visits.push(
    { label: "/login", path: "/login", server: owner, auth: false, expectPath: "/login", slug: "public-login" },
    { label: "/ (no owner)", path: "/", server: noOwner, auth: false, expectPath: "/setup", slug: "public-setup" },
  );
  return visits;
}

async function captureVisit(
  browser: Browser,
  visit: Visit,
  session: Session | null,
  reports: UrlReport[],
  axeEntries: AxeEntry[],
): Promise<number> {
  let screenshots = 0;
  for (const capture of CAPTURES) {
    const context = await newCaptureContext(browser, capture, session);
    try {
      const page = await context.newPage();
      const probe = attachProbe(page);
      const result = await inspectPage(page, probe, {
        url: `${visit.server.baseUrl}${visit.path}`,
        capture,
        expectPath: visit.expectPath,
        checkTheme: true,
        screenshotPath: path.join(OUT_DIR, visit.slug, `${capture.name}.png`),
      });
      if (result.screenshotTaken) screenshots += 1;
      let axeViolations = 0;
      if (capture.viewport === "desktop" && result.screenshotTaken) {
        try {
          const axe = await new AxeBuilder({ page }).withTags(["wcag2a", "wcag2aa"]).analyze();
          axeViolations = axe.violations.length;
          for (const violation of axe.violations) {
            axeEntries.push({
              url: visit.label,
              theme: capture.theme,
              rule: violation.id,
              impact: violation.impact ?? null,
              nodes: violation.nodes.length,
              help: violation.help,
            });
          }
        } catch (error) {
          console.warn(`axe could not run on ${visit.label} (${capture.name}): ${errorMessage(error)}`);
        }
      }
      reports.push({
        url: visit.label,
        viewport: capture.viewport,
        theme: capture.theme,
        failures: result.failures,
        axeViolations,
      });
    } finally {
      await context.close();
    }
  }
  return screenshots;
}

async function runQa(
  browser: Browser,
  options: Options,
  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
  owner: QaServer,
  noOwner: QaServer,
): Promise<number> {
  const token = owner.sessionToken;
  if (!token) throw new Error("The owner QA server returned no session token");
  const session: Session = { baseUrl: owner.baseUrl, token };
  const visits = planVisits(routes, options.routes === null, owner, noOwner);
  const startedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  const reports: UrlReport[] = [];
  const axeEntries: AxeEntry[] = [];
  let screenshots = 0;

  for (const visit of visits) {
    const before = reports.length;
    screenshots += await captureVisit(browser, visit, visit.auth ? session : null, reports, axeEntries);
    const found = reports.slice(before).reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.failures.length, 0);
    console.log(`${found === 0 ? "ok  " : "FAIL"} ${visit.label}`);
  }

  if (options.monkey) {
    const targets = visits.filter((visit) => visit.auth).map((visit) => ({ path: visit.path, session }));
    const monkey = await runMonkey(browser, targets);
    for (const visit of visits.filter((candidate) => candidate.auth)) {
      const entry = reports.find(
        (report) => report.url === visit.label && report.viewport === "desktop" && report.theme === "light",
      );
      const found = monkey.get(visit.path) ?? [];
      if (entry) entry.failures.push(...found);
      console.log(`${found.length === 0 ? "ok  " : "FAIL"} monkey ${visit.label}`);
    }
  }

  const failures = reports.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.failures.length, 0);
  writeFileSync(
    path.join(OUT_DIR, "report.json"),
    `${JSON.stringify({ startedAt, urls: reports, failures }, null, 2)}\n`,
  );
  writeFileSync(path.join(OUT_DIR, "axe.json"), `${JSON.stringify(axeEntries, null, 2)}\n`);

  for (const entry of reports) {
    if (entry.failures.length === 0) continue;
    console.log(`\n${entry.url} [${entry.viewport}-${entry.theme}]`);
    for (const failure of entry.failures) console.log(`  - ${failure}`);
  }
  const relativeOut = path.relative(process.cwd(), OUT_DIR) || ".";
  console.log(`\naxe (report only): ${axeEntries.length} violations, details in ${relativeOut}/axe.json`);
  console.log(`Screenshots: ${relativeOut}`);
  console.log(`QA: ${visits.length} urls, ${screenshots} screenshots, ${failures} failures`);
  return failures > 0 ? 1 : 0;
}

/** The eight checks the self-test proves; each has one deliberate fault in the fixture. */
const SELF_TEST_CHECKS = [
  "console",
  "pageerror",
  "csp",
  "overflow",
  "text",
  "i18n",
  "api5xx",
  "boundary",
] as const;

const FAULTY_HTML = `<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <title>QA self-test</title>
    <style>body { outline: 1px solid red; }</style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <main>
      <h1>QA self-test</h1>
      <p>Total: NaN</p>
      <p>common.qaSelfTestKey</p>
      <div id="qa-wide"></div>
      <div data-error-boundary>Something went wrong</div>
    </main>
    <script src="/__qa_self_test.js"></script>
  </body>
</html>`;

const FAULTY_JS = `console.error("QA self-test: deliberate console error");
const wide = document.getElementById("qa-wide");
if (wide) { wide.style.width = "2000px"; wide.style.height = "8px"; }
void fetch("/api/__qa_self_test");
setTimeout(() => { throw new Error("QA self-test: deliberate page error"); }, 0);
`;

const CLEAN_HTML = `<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <title>QA self-test (clean)</title>
  </head>
  <body>
    <main><h1>QA self-test</h1><p>Everything on this page is fine.</p></main>
  </body>
</html>`;

/**
 * Serves fixture pages under the QA server's origin with its real CSP header and checks that
 * every check fires on the faulty page and none fires on the clean page.
 */
async function runSelfTest(browser: Browser, server: QaServer): Promise<number> {
  const live = await fetch(`${server.baseUrl}/login`);
  const csp = live.headers.get("content-security-policy");
  if (!csp) throw new Error("The QA server sent no content-security-policy header");
  const phone = CAPTURES.find((capture) => capture.viewport === "phone");
  if (!phone) throw new Error("The phone capture is missing");

  const context = await newCaptureContext(browser, phone, null);
  try {
    const page = await context.newPage();
    const html = (body: string) => ({
      status: 200,
      contentType: "text/html; charset=utf-8",
      headers: { "content-security-policy": csp },
      body,
    });
    await page.route(
      (url) => url.pathname === "/__qa_self_test",
      (route) => route.fulfill(html(FAULTY_HTML)),
    );
    await page.route(
      (url) => url.pathname === "/__qa_self_test.js",
      (route) =>
        route.fulfill({ status: 200, contentType: "text/javascript; charset=utf-8", body: FAULTY_JS }),
    );
    await page.route(
      (url) => url.pathname === "/api/__qa_self_test",
      (route) =>
        route.fulfill({ status: 500, contentType: "application/json", body: '{"error":"Internal error"}' }),
    );
    await page.route(
      (url) => url.pathname === "/__qa_self_test_clean",
      (route) => route.fulfill(html(CLEAN_HTML)),
    );
    const probe = attachProbe(page);
    const faulty = await inspectPage(page, probe, {
      url: `${server.baseUrl}/__qa_self_test`,
      capture: phone,
      expectPath: null,
      checkTheme: false,
      screenshotPath: null,
    });
    const clean = await inspectPage(page, probe, {
      url: `${server.baseUrl}/__qa_self_test_clean`,
      capture: phone,
      expectPath: null,
      checkTheme: false,
      screenshotPath: null,
    });

    let missed = 0;
    for (const check of SELF_TEST_CHECKS) {
      const hit = faulty.failures.some((failure) => failure.startsWith(`${check}:`));
      if (!hit) missed += 1;
      console.log(`${hit ? "detected" : "MISSED  "} ${check}`);
    }
    for (const failure of clean.failures) console.log(`unexpected on the clean page: ${failure}`);
    console.log(
      `QA self-test: ${SELF_TEST_CHECKS.length - missed}/${SELF_TEST_CHECKS.length} checks detected, clean page ${clean.failures.length} failures`,
    );
    return missed === 0 && clean.failures.length === 0 ? 0 : 1;
  } finally {
    await context.close();
  }
}

async function main(): Promise<number> {
  const options = parseOptions(process.argv.slice(2));
  const routes = selectRoutes(options);
  rmSync(OUT_DIR, { recursive: true, force: true });
  mkdirSync(OUT_DIR, { recursive: true });
  if (!options.skipBuild) buildWeb();

  const browser = await launchBrowser();
  const servers: QaServer[] = [];
  try {
    const owner = await startQaServer({ owner: true });
    servers.push(owner);
    if (options.selfTest) return await runSelfTest(browser, owner);
    const noOwner = await startQaServer({ owner: false });
    servers.push(noOwner);
    return await runQa(browser, options, routes, owner, noOwner);
  } finally {
    await browser.close();
    await Promise.all(servers.map((server) => server.stop()));
  }
}

main().then(
  (code) => process.exit(code),
  (error: unknown) => {
    console.error(error instanceof UsageError ? error.message : error);
    process.exit(error instanceof UsageError ? 2 : 1);
  },
);
```

Visits for the Task 4 panel: `/` (home, signed in), `/qa-unknown-page` (signed in), `/login?expired=1` and `/login` (signed out, owner server) and `/` on the no-owner server, which must land on `/setup`. `--routes home` visits only the listed shipped routes. The redirect check on signed-in routes is what catches a broken session cookie: without it, the run would screenshot the login page and pass.

- [ ] **Step 19: Acceptance run over the Task 4 panel (UI definition of done)**

Run: `<prefix> && pnpm --filter @bursar/web qa --skip-build`
Expected last line: `QA: 5 urls, 15 screenshots, 0 failures`, exit code 0. Screenshots in `apps/web/qa/out/` (`root/`, `qa-unknown-page/`, `public-login-expired-1/`, `public-login/`, `public-setup/`, each with `desktop-light.png`, `desktop-dark.png`, `phone-light.png`), plus `report.json` and `axe.json`.

If the run reports failures, fix each one in the panel file that causes it, never by weakening a check, adding an ignore pattern or relaxing the CSP in `apps/server/src/http/app.ts`. Then run `pnpm --filter @bursar/web qa` again (with the build). Known causes:
- `csp: style-src … blocked inline` with a `<style>` element: a library or component injected a stylesheet. Move the rules to `apps/web/src/styles/base.css` (or a Tailwind utility); for `motion`, `AnimatePresence mode="popLayout"` injects a `<style>` element, so use entry-only animation as the Global Constraints require.
- `csp: style-src-attr` or `Refused to apply inline style … attribute`: a `style="…"` attribute in markup (`apps/web/index.html`, `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, an SVG string). Replace it with a class. React's `style` prop and `motion` set styles through CSSOM, which the CSP allows.
- `csp: font-src` or `img-src` with an external URL: self-host the asset (fonts come from `@fontsource-variable/*`).
- `csp: script-src … inline`: move the script to a file in `apps/web/public/` loaded with `<script src>` (as `theme-init.js`).
- `theme: expected data-theme="dark"`: the dark capture relies on the default theme preference `system` (Task 2 `useUi`) and on `public/theme-init.js`; fix the default or the init script.

**Design decisions beyond the contract** (the contract's method list and signatures are unchanged; these settle what it leaves open, and later tasks rely on them):
- Timestamps and counters are plain `integer` columns holding epoch milliseconds, read back as JS `number` (the `jobs` table convention). The two `INTEGER 0/1` flags use Drizzle's `mode: "boolean"` (`with_psu_headers` is `boolean` in TypeScript).
- Row types are the Drizzle `$inferSelect` types, so every `status`-like column is a string union. `TransactionRow.bankCode` is parsed to `BankTransactionCode | null` (`{ code, subCode, description }`, the same shape Task 12 normalises to); `rawJson` stays a JSON string because parsing it for every list row would be wasted work. `notifications.params` is JSON text too, but notifications, `backup_runs`, `settings` and `audit_log` have no repository methods: their owners (Tasks 8, 9, 15) use Drizzle directly.
- Input types: `NewConnection` requires `aspspName`, `aspspCountry`, `providerSessionId`, `validUntil` (everything else optional: `status` defaults to `active`, `psuType` to `personal`, `createdAt`/`updatedAt` to the repository clock). `NewAccount` requires `connectionId`, `identificationHash`, `currency` (`status` defaults to `active`, `bgFetchCount` to 0). `NewSyncRun` is `{ accountId, trigger, withPsuHeaders?, startedAt?, status? (default running), skipReason?, finishedAt? }`, so a run that is skipped can be recorded in one call. `NewAuthRequest` is `{ stateHash, purpose, connectionId?, aspspName, aspspCountry, validUntil, expiresAt, createdAt? }`. `NewBalance` is the balance row without `id`; `NewTransaction` is the transaction row without `id`, exactly as in the contract.
- `updateConnection`, `updateAccount`, `updateTransaction` and `finishSyncRun` throw `Error("<thing> <id> does not exist")` when no row matches (an update that silently does nothing hides bugs); routes check existence first and map a missing row to 404 themselves. `updateConnection` and `updateAccount` stamp `updatedAt` with the repository clock unless the patch sets it; `finishSyncRun` stamps `finishedAt` the same way.
- `transaction(fn)` wraps Drizzle's synchronous transaction (a savepoint when nested). `fn` must be synchronous.
- `tryConsumeBackgroundFetch` refuses when `cap <= 0` and when the account does not exist; it does not touch `updatedAt`.
- `latestBalances` returns, per balance type, the row with the newest `reference_date` (ties broken by `as_of`, then id), ordered by type; `lastBookedDate` is the newest `sort_date` among booked rows; `purgeExpiredAuthRequests` deletes every request whose `expires_at` has passed, consumed or not; `failStaleSyncRuns` sets `status = 'failed'`, `error_code = 'interrupted'`, the given message and `finished_at`; `findAccountsByIdentity` matches accounts of any status on any connection and expects the IBAN already normalised.
- `AuditLog.record` stores `details` as JSON text and never receives secrets, identifiers or amounts (the type only allows flat primitives).
- `seedBanking` creates 6 connections (active, expiring, expired, revoked, error, and one disconnected by the owner) and 10 accounts, ids in creation order: 1 current EUR (active connection, ~120 days of history, 3 pending, daily closing balances), 2 savings EUR with a nickname, 3 rate-limited EUR, 4 USD without IBAN at the daily cap, 5 unavailable (no provider uid), 6 stale on the expired connection, 7 disabled card, 8 loan with a negative balance on the revoked connection, 9 failing on the error connection (four consecutive failed syncs), 10 removed with its transactions kept. Notification `params` use the same keys the server raises in Tasks 9, 13 and 14: `bankName` and `days` (`consent_expiring`) and `accountName` (`sync_failing`).

```ts
import { z } from "zod";
import { calendarDaysUntil } from "./dates";

export const storedConnectionStatusSchema = z.enum(["active", "expired", "revoked", "error"]);
export const connectionStatusSchema = z.enum(["active", "expiring", "expired", "revoked", "error"]);

export const syncRunStatusSchema = z.enum(["running", "succeeded", "failed", "skipped"]);

  "rate_limited",
  "daily_cap",
  "connection_inactive",
  "account_inactive",
  "no_provider_uid",
]);
export const transactionStatusSchema = z.enum(["booked", "pending"]);
export const notificationEventSchema = z.enum([
  "consent_expiring",
  "consent_expired",
  "connection_error",
  "sync_failing",
  "backup_failing",
]);
export const backupRunStatusSchema = z.enum(["running", "succeeded", "failed"]);

export type StoredConnectionStatus = z.infer<typeof storedConnectionStatusSchema>;
export type ConnectionStatus = z.infer<typeof connectionStatusSchema>;
export type AccountStatus = z.infer<typeof accountStatusSchema>;
export type SyncTrigger = z.infer<typeof syncTriggerSchema>;
export type SyncRunStatus = z.infer<typeof syncRunStatusSchema>;
export type SkipReason = z.infer<typeof skipReasonSchema>;
export type TransactionStatus = z.infer<typeof transactionStatusSchema>;
export type NotificationEvent = z.infer<typeof notificationEventSchema>;
export type BackupRunStatus = z.infer<typeof backupRunStatusSchema>;

/** A connection with this many calendar days (or fewer) left is shown as expiring. */
export const EXPIRING_THRESHOLD_DAYS = 14;
/** At this many calendar days (or fewer) the consent renewal is urgent. */
export const URGENT_THRESHOLD_DAYS = 3;

/**
 * Status shown in the panel: the stored status wins unless it is `active`, in which case the
 * consent end date decides between `expired`, `expiring` and `active`.
 */
export function effectiveConnectionStatus(
  stored: StoredConnectionStatus,
  validUntil: number,
  now: number,
  timeZone: string,
): ConnectionStatus {
  if (stored !== "active") return stored;
  if (validUntil <= now) return "expired";
  if (calendarDaysUntil(validUntil, now, timeZone) <= EXPIRING_THRESHOLD_DAYS) return "expiring";
  return "active";
}

/** Balance types in the order the panel prefers them as "the" balance of an account. */
export const PREFERRED_BALANCE_TYPES = [
  "ITBD",
  "CLBD",
  "ITAV",
  "CLAV",
  "XPCD",
  "OPBD",
  "OPAV",
  "PRCD",
  "FWAV",
  "VALU",
  "INFO",
  "OTHR",
] as const;

/** The most preferred balance; unknown types rank after every known one; ties keep input order. */
export function pickPreferredBalance<T extends { balanceType: string }>(
  balances: readonly T[],
): T | null {
  const rank = (balanceType: string): number => {
    const index = (PREFERRED_BALANCE_TYPES as readonly string[]).indexOf(balanceType);
    return index === -1 ? PREFERRED_BALANCE_TYPES.length : index;
  };
  let best: T | null = null;
  for (const balance of balances) {
    if (best === null || rank(balance.balanceType) < rank(best.balanceType)) best = balance;
  }
  return best;
}

/** Fallback names for accounts the bank gives no product name or description. */
export const CASH_ACCOUNT_TYPE_LABELS: Record<
  "it" | "en",
  Record<"CACC" | "CASH" | "CARD" | "LOAN" | "SVGS" | "OTHR", string>
> = {
  it: {
    CACC: "Conto corrente",
    CASH: "Conto di cassa",
    CARD: "Carta",
    LOAN: "Finanziamento",
    SVGS: "Risparmio",
    OTHR: "Conto",
  },
  en: {
    CACC: "Current account",
    CASH: "Cash account",
    CARD: "Card",
    LOAN: "Loan",
    SVGS: "Savings",
    OTHR: "Account",
  },
};

function filled(value: string | null): string | null {
  const trimmed = value?.trim();
  return trimmed ? trimmed : null;
}

/** nickname, then product, then details, then "<type label> ••<last4>". */
export function accountDisplayName(
  input: {
    nickname: string | null;
    product: string | null;
    details: string | null;
    cashAccountType: string | null;
    last4: string | null;
  },
  locale: "it" | "en",
): string {
  const named = filled(input.nickname) ?? filled(input.product) ?? filled(input.details);
  if (named) return named;
  const labels = CASH_ACCOUNT_TYPE_LABELS[locale];
  const label =
    input.cashAccountType !== null && Object.hasOwn(labels, input.cashAccountType)
      ? labels[input.cashAccountType as keyof typeof labels]
      : labels.OTHR;
  const last4 = filled(input.last4);
  return last4 ? `${label} ••${last4}` : label;
}

/** Accounts counted in totals: `active`, and `unavailable` ones keep their last known balance. */
export function isIncludedInTotals(status: AccountStatus): boolean {
  return status === "active" || status === "unavailable";
}
```

```ts
import {
  FinanceRepository,
  type NewAccount,
  type NewConnection,

const NOW = 1_800_000_000_000;
const DAY = 86_400_000;

function connectionInput(overrides: Partial<NewConnection> = {}): NewConnection {
  return {
    aspspName: "Banca Esempio",

    providerSessionId: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
```
