```ts
function accountInput(connectionId: number, overrides: Partial<NewAccount> = {}): NewAccount {
  return {
    connectionId,
    identificationHash: "hash-1",
    currency: "EUR",
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function transactionInput(
  accountId: number,
  overrides: Partial<NewTransaction> = {},
): NewTransaction {
  return {
    accountId,
    providerReference: "ref-1",
    fingerprint: "fp-1",
    status: "booked",
    bookingDate: "2026-05-10",
    valueDate: "2026-05-10",
    transactionDate: null,
    sortDate: "2026-05-10",
    amountMinor: -1250,
    currency: "EUR",
    counterparty: "Caffè Centrale",
    counterpartyAccount: null,
    remittance: "Colazione",
    bankCode: null,
    merchantCategoryCode: null,
    balanceAfterMinor: null,
    searchText: "caffe centrale colazione",
    rawJson: "{}",
    missingCount: 0,
    firstSeenAt: NOW,
    lastSeenAt: NOW,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

describe("FinanceRepository", () => {
  let t: TestDatabase;
  let now: number;
  let repo: FinanceRepository;

  beforeEach(() => {
    t = createTestDatabase();
    now = NOW;
    repo = new FinanceRepository(t.db, () => now);
  });
  afterEach(() => t.dispose());

  describe("connections", () => {
    it("creates a connection with defaults and reads it back", () => {
      const id = repo.createConnection(connectionInput());
      expect(repo.getConnection(id)).toEqual({
        id,
        aspspName: "Banca Esempio",
        aspspCountry: "IT",
        aspspLogoUrl: null,
        psuType: "personal",
        providerSessionId: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
        status: "active",
        validUntil: NOW + 90 * DAY,
        lastErrorCode: null,
        lastErrorMessage: null,
        lastErrorAt: null,
        statusCheckedAt: null,
        createdAt: NOW,
        updatedAt: NOW,
        renewedAt: null,
        removedAt: null,
      });
      expect(repo.getConnection(id + 1)).toBeNull();
    });

    it("updates fields and stamps updatedAt", () => {
      const id = repo.createConnection(connectionInput());
      now += 1_000;
      repo.updateConnection(id, { status: "expired", lastErrorCode: "EXPIRED_SESSION" });
      expect(repo.getConnection(id)).toMatchObject({
        status: "expired",
        lastErrorCode: "EXPIRED_SESSION",
        createdAt: NOW,
        updatedAt: NOW + 1_000,
      });
      expect(() => repo.updateConnection(999, { status: "error" })).toThrow(/does not exist/);
    });

    it("hides removed connections unless asked", () => {
      const kept = repo.createConnection(connectionInput());
      const removed = repo.createConnection(connectionInput({ providerSessionId: "s-2" }));
      repo.updateConnection(removed, { removedAt: now });
      expect(repo.listConnections().map((row) => row.id)).toEqual([kept]);
      expect(repo.listConnections({ includeRemoved: true }).map((row) => row.id)).toEqual([
        kept,
        removed,
      ]);
    });
  });

  describe("accounts", () => {
    it("creates, reads, updates and filters accounts", () => {
      const first = repo.createConnection(connectionInput());
      const second = repo.createConnection(connectionInput({ providerSessionId: "s-2" }));
      const a = repo.createAccount(accountInput(first, { nickname: "Main", iban: "IT00X" }));
      const b = repo.createAccount(
        accountInput(first, { identificationHash: "hash-2", status: "disabled" }),
      );
      const c = repo.createAccount(accountInput(second, { identificationHash: "hash-3" }));

      expect(repo.getAccount(a)).toMatchObject({
        id: a,
        connectionId: first,
        nickname: "Main",
        status: "active",
        bgFetchCount: 0,
        bgFetchDay: null,
        createdAt: NOW,
        updatedAt: NOW,
      });
      expect(repo.getAccount(999)).toBeNull();

      expect(repo.listAccounts().map((row) => row.id)).toEqual([a, b, c]);
      expect(repo.listAccounts({ connectionId: first }).map((row) => row.id)).toEqual([a, b]);
      expect(repo.listAccounts({ statuses: ["disabled"] }).map((row) => row.id)).toEqual([b]);
      expect(
        repo
          .listAccounts({ connectionId: first, statuses: ["active", "disabled"] })
          .map((row) => row.id),
      ).toEqual([a, b]);
      expect(repo.listAccounts({ statuses: [] })).toEqual([]);

      now += 500;
      repo.updateAccount(a, { nickname: "Renamed", rateLimitedUntil: now + 6 * 3_600_000 });
      expect(repo.getAccount(a)).toMatchObject({
        nickname: "Renamed",
        rateLimitedUntil: now + 6 * 3_600_000,
        updatedAt: NOW + 500,
      });
      expect(() => repo.updateAccount(999, { nickname: "x" })).toThrow(/does not exist/);
    });

    it("finds accounts by identification hash or IBAN across connections and statuses", () => {
      const first = repo.createConnection(connectionInput());
      const second = repo.createConnection(connectionInput({ providerSessionId: "s-2" }));
      const byHash = repo.createAccount(
        accountInput(first, { identificationHash: "h-a", iban: "IT60A" }),
      );
      const byIban = repo.createAccount(
        accountInput(second, { identificationHash: "h-b", iban: "DE89B", status: "removed" }),
      );
      repo.createAccount(accountInput(second, { identificationHash: "h-c", iban: "FR76C" }));

      expect(repo.findAccountsByIdentity(["h-a"], null).map((row) => row.id)).toEqual([byHash]);
      expect(repo.findAccountsByIdentity(["unknown"], "DE89B").map((row) => row.id)).toEqual([
        byIban,
      ]);
      expect(repo.findAccountsByIdentity(["h-a", "h-x"], "DE89B").map((row) => row.id)).toEqual([
        byHash,
        byIban,
      ]);
      expect(repo.findAccountsByIdentity([], null)).toEqual([]);
      expect(repo.findAccountsByIdentity(["nothing"], "XX00")).toEqual([]);
    });
  });

  describe("tryConsumeBackgroundFetch", () => {
    let accountId: number;
    beforeEach(() => {
      accountId = repo.createAccount(accountInput(repo.createConnection(connectionInput())));
    });

    it("allows exactly `cap` fetches per local day", () => {
      expect(repo.tryConsumeBackgroundFetch(accountId, "2026-11-09", 2)).toBe(true);
      expect(repo.tryConsumeBackgroundFetch(accountId, "2026-11-09", 2)).toBe(true);
      expect(repo.tryConsumeBackgroundFetch(accountId, "2026-11-09", 2)).toBe(false);
      expect(repo.tryConsumeBackgroundFetch(accountId, "2026-11-09", 2)).toBe(false);
      expect(repo.getAccount(accountId)).toMatchObject({
        bgFetchDay: "2026-11-09",
        bgFetchCount: 2,
      });
    });

    it("restarts the counter on a new day", () => {
      repo.tryConsumeBackgroundFetch(accountId, "2026-11-09", 1);
      expect(repo.tryConsumeBackgroundFetch(accountId, "2026-11-09", 1)).toBe(false);
      expect(repo.tryConsumeBackgroundFetch(accountId, "2026-11-10", 1)).toBe(true);
      expect(repo.getAccount(accountId)).toMatchObject({
        bgFetchDay: "2026-11-10",
        bgFetchCount: 1,
      });
      expect(repo.tryConsumeBackgroundFetch(accountId, "2026-11-10", 1)).toBe(false);
    });

    it("honours a cap that was lowered after fetches were counted", () => {
      repo.tryConsumeBackgroundFetch(accountId, "2026-11-09", 4);
      repo.tryConsumeBackgroundFetch(accountId, "2026-11-09", 4);
      expect(repo.tryConsumeBackgroundFetch(accountId, "2026-11-09", 2)).toBe(false);
    });

    it("refuses a cap of zero, even on a new day, and an unknown account", () => {
      expect(repo.tryConsumeBackgroundFetch(accountId, "2026-11-09", 0)).toBe(false);
      expect(repo.getAccount(accountId)).toMatchObject({ bgFetchDay: null, bgFetchCount: 0 });
      expect(repo.tryConsumeBackgroundFetch(999, "2026-11-09", 2)).toBe(false);
    });
  });

  describe("balances", () => {
    let accountId: number;
    beforeEach(() => {
      accountId = repo.createAccount(accountInput(repo.createConnection(connectionInput())));
    });

    const balance = (
      overrides: Partial<Parameters<FinanceRepository["upsertBalance"]>[0]> = {},
    ) => ({
      accountId,
      balanceType: "CLBD",
      amountMinor: 100_000,
      currency: "EUR",
      referenceDate: "2026-11-08",
      asOf: NOW,
      fetchedAt: NOW,
      ...overrides,
    });

    it("replaces the amounts of the same account, type and reference date", () => {
      repo.upsertBalance(balance());
      repo.upsertBalance(balance({ amountMinor: 123_456, asOf: NOW + 10, fetchedAt: NOW + 20 }));
      const rows = repo.latestBalances(accountId);
      expect(rows).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(rows[0]).toMatchObject({ amountMinor: 123_456, asOf: NOW + 10, fetchedAt: NOW + 20 });
    });

    it("returns the most recent balance of each type, ordered by type", () => {
      repo.upsertBalance(balance({ referenceDate: "2026-11-07", amountMinor: 1 }));
      repo.upsertBalance(balance({ referenceDate: "2026-11-09", amountMinor: 3 }));
      repo.upsertBalance(balance({ referenceDate: "2026-11-08", amountMinor: 2 }));
      repo.upsertBalance(
        balance({ balanceType: "ITAV", referenceDate: "2026-11-06", amountMinor: 9 }),
      );
      const other = repo.createAccount(
        accountInput(repo.createConnection(connectionInput({ providerSessionId: "s-2" })), {
          identificationHash: "other",
        }),
      );
      repo.upsertBalance(balance({ accountId: other, amountMinor: 777 }));

      expect(
        repo
          .latestBalances(accountId)
          .map((row) => [row.balanceType, row.referenceDate, row.amountMinor]),
      ).toEqual([
        ["CLBD", "2026-11-09", 3],
        ["ITAV", "2026-11-06", 9],
      ]);
      expect(repo.latestBalances(9999)).toEqual([]);
    });

    it("breaks reference-date ties with the as-of time", () => {
      repo.upsertBalance(
        balance({ balanceType: "ITBD", referenceDate: "2026-11-08", asOf: 1, amountMinor: 10 }),
      );
      repo.upsertBalance(
        balance({ balanceType: "ITBD", referenceDate: "2026-11-08", asOf: 2, amountMinor: 20 }),
      );
      expect(repo.latestBalances(accountId)[0]?.amountMinor).toBe(20);
    });

    it("stores negative amounts exactly", () => {
      repo.upsertBalance(balance({ amountMinor: -8_432_045 }));
      expect(repo.latestBalances(accountId)[0]?.amountMinor).toBe(-8_432_045);
    });
  });

  describe("transactions", () => {
    let accountId: number;
    beforeEach(() => {
      accountId = repo.createAccount(accountInput(repo.createConnection(connectionInput())));
    });

    it("round-trips a transaction including the parsed bank code", () => {
      const bankCode = {
        code: "RCDT",
        subCode: "ESCT",
        description: "SEPA credit transfer received",
      };
      const id = repo.insertTransaction(transactionInput(accountId, { bankCode }));
      const rows = repo.transactionsSince(accountId, null);
      expect(rows).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(rows[0]).toEqual({ ...transactionInput(accountId, { bankCode }), id });
    });

    it("rejects a second row with the same account and fingerprint", () => {
      repo.insertTransaction(transactionInput(accountId));
      expect(() =>
        repo.insertTransaction(transactionInput(accountId, { providerReference: "ref-2" })),
      ).toThrow();
    });

    it("updates fields, including setting and clearing the bank code", () => {
      const id = repo.insertTransaction(
        transactionInput(accountId, { status: "pending", bookingDate: null }),
      );
      repo.updateTransaction(id, {
        status: "booked",
        bookingDate: "2026-05-11",
        bankCode: { code: "ICDT", subCode: null, description: null },
        missingCount: 0,
        lastSeenAt: NOW + 5,
      });
      expect(repo.transactionsSince(accountId, null)[0]).toMatchObject({
        status: "booked",
        bookingDate: "2026-05-11",
        bankCode: { code: "ICDT", subCode: null, description: null },
        lastSeenAt: NOW + 5,
      });
      repo.updateTransaction(id, { bankCode: null });
      expect(repo.transactionsSince(accountId, null)[0]?.bankCode).toBeNull();
      repo.updateTransaction(id, {});
      expect(() => repo.updateTransaction(999, { missingCount: 1 })).toThrow(/does not exist/);
    });

    it("deletes by id and reports how many rows went", () => {
      const a = repo.insertTransaction(transactionInput(accountId, { fingerprint: "a" }));
      const b = repo.insertTransaction(transactionInput(accountId, { fingerprint: "b" }));
      repo.insertTransaction(transactionInput(accountId, { fingerprint: "c" }));
      expect(repo.deleteTransactions([])).toBe(0);
      expect(repo.deleteTransactions([a, b, 999])).toBe(2);
      expect(repo.countTransactions(accountId).total).toBe(1);
    });

    it("lists newest first and honours the start date", () => {
      repo.insertTransaction(
        transactionInput(accountId, { fingerprint: "old", sortDate: "2026-04-01" }),
      );
      const mid = repo.insertTransaction(
        transactionInput(accountId, { fingerprint: "mid", sortDate: "2026-05-01" }),
      );
      const newest = repo.insertTransaction(
        transactionInput(accountId, { fingerprint: "new", sortDate: "2026-05-20" }),
      );
      repo.insertTransaction(
        transactionInput(repo.createAccount(accountInput(1, { identificationHash: "x" })), {
          fingerprint: "other-account",
          sortDate: "2026-05-30",
        }),
      );
      expect(repo.transactionsSince(accountId, null).map((row) => row.fingerprint)).toEqual([
        "new",
        "mid",
        "old",
      ]);
      expect(repo.transactionsSince(accountId, "2026-05-01").map((row) => row.id)).toEqual([
        newest,
        mid,
      ]);
      expect(repo.transactionsSince(accountId, "2026-06-01")).toEqual([]);
    });

    it("finds the last booked date and ignores pending rows", () => {
      expect(repo.lastBookedDate(accountId)).toBeNull();
      repo.insertTransaction(
        transactionInput(accountId, { fingerprint: "a", sortDate: "2026-05-10" }),
      );
      repo.insertTransaction(
        transactionInput(accountId, { fingerprint: "b", sortDate: "2026-05-14" }),
      );
      repo.insertTransaction(
        transactionInput(accountId, {
          fingerprint: "p",
          status: "pending",
          sortDate: "2026-05-20",
          bookingDate: null,
        }),
      );
      expect(repo.lastBookedDate(accountId)).toBe("2026-05-14");
    });

    it("counts totals and pending rows", () => {
      expect(repo.countTransactions(accountId)).toEqual({ total: 0, pending: 0 });
      repo.insertTransaction(transactionInput(accountId, { fingerprint: "a" }));
      repo.insertTransaction(transactionInput(accountId, { fingerprint: "p1", status: "pending" }));
      repo.insertTransaction(transactionInput(accountId, { fingerprint: "p2", status: "pending" }));
      expect(repo.countTransactions(accountId)).toEqual({ total: 3, pending: 2 });
    });
  });

  describe("sync runs", () => {
    let accountId: number;
    beforeEach(() => {
      accountId = repo.createAccount(accountInput(repo.createConnection(connectionInput())));
    });

    it("starts a run, finishes it and lists newest first", () => {
      const first = repo.startSyncRun({ accountId, trigger: "initial" });
      now += 60_000;
      repo.finishSyncRun(first, { status: "succeeded", fetched: 12, inserted: 10, updated: 2 });
      now += 60_000;
      const second = repo.startSyncRun({ accountId, trigger: "manual", withPsuHeaders: true });
      now += 1_000;
      repo.finishSyncRun(second, {
        status: "failed",
        errorCode: "ASPSP_ERROR",
        errorMessage: "The bank returned an error",
      });

      const runs = repo.listSyncRuns(accountId, 10);
      expect(runs.map((run) => run.id)).toEqual([second, first]);
      expect(runs[1]).toMatchObject({
        status: "succeeded",
        trigger: "initial",
        withPsuHeaders: false,
        startedAt: NOW,
        finishedAt: NOW + 60_000,
        fetched: 12,
        inserted: 10,
        updated: 2,
        removed: 0,
      });
      expect(runs[0]).toMatchObject({
        status: "failed",
        withPsuHeaders: true,
        errorCode: "ASPSP_ERROR",
        finishedAt: now,
      });
      expect(repo.listSyncRuns(accountId, 1).map((run) => run.id)).toEqual([second]);
      expect(() => repo.finishSyncRun(999, { status: "failed" })).toThrow(/does not exist/);
    });

    it("records a run that is skipped in one call", () => {
      const id = repo.startSyncRun({
        accountId,
        trigger: "background",
        status: "skipped",
        skipReason: "daily_cap",
        finishedAt: NOW,
      });
      expect(repo.listSyncRuns(accountId, 5)[0]).toMatchObject({
        id,
        status: "skipped",
        skipReason: "daily_cap",
        finishedAt: NOW,
      });
    });

    it("fails the runs left running by a previous process", () => {
      const running = repo.startSyncRun({ accountId, trigger: "background" });
      const done = repo.startSyncRun({ accountId, trigger: "manual" });
      repo.finishSyncRun(done, { status: "succeeded" });
      now += 5_000;
      expect(repo.failStaleSyncRuns("Interrupted by a restart")).toBe(1);
      expect(repo.failStaleSyncRuns("Interrupted by a restart")).toBe(0);
      const byId = new Map(repo.listSyncRuns(accountId, 10).map((run) => [run.id, run]));
      expect(byId.get(running)).toMatchObject({
        status: "failed",
        errorCode: "interrupted",
        errorMessage: "Interrupted by a restart",
        finishedAt: NOW + 5_000,
      });
      expect(byId.get(done)?.status).toBe("succeeded");
    });
  });

  describe("purgeAccount", () => {
    it("removes the account with its data and reports the counts measured before", () => {
      const connectionId = repo.createConnection(connectionInput());
      const accountId = repo.createAccount(accountInput(connectionId));
      const otherId = repo.createAccount(
        accountInput(connectionId, { identificationHash: "hash-2" }),
      );
      repo.insertTransaction(transactionInput(accountId, { fingerprint: "a" }));
      repo.insertTransaction(transactionInput(accountId, { fingerprint: "b" }));
      repo.insertTransaction(transactionInput(otherId, { fingerprint: "a" }));
      repo.upsertBalance({
        accountId,
        balanceType: "CLBD",
        amountMinor: 1,
        currency: "EUR",
        referenceDate: "2026-11-08",
        asOf: NOW,
        fetchedAt: NOW,
      });
      repo.startSyncRun({ accountId, trigger: "initial" });
      repo.startSyncRun({ accountId, trigger: "manual" });
      repo.startSyncRun({ accountId, trigger: "background" });

      expect(repo.purgeAccount(accountId)).toEqual({ transactions: 2, balances: 1, syncRuns: 3 });
      expect(repo.getAccount(accountId)).toBeNull();
      expect(repo.countTransactions(accountId).total).toBe(0);
      expect(repo.latestBalances(accountId)).toEqual([]);
      expect(repo.listSyncRuns(accountId, 10)).toEqual([]);
      expect(repo.countTransactions(otherId).total).toBe(1);
      expect(repo.purgeAccount(accountId)).toEqual({ transactions: 0, balances: 0, syncRuns: 0 });
    });

    it("purges an active account too: status checks belong to the caller", () => {
      const accountId = repo.createAccount(accountInput(repo.createConnection(connectionInput())));
      repo.purgeAccount(accountId);
      expect(repo.getAccount(accountId)).toBeNull();
    });
  });

  describe("authorisation requests", () => {
    const request = (
      overrides: Partial<Parameters<FinanceRepository["createAuthRequest"]>[0]> = {},
    ) => ({
      stateHash: "a".repeat(64),
      purpose: "connect" as const,
      aspspName: "Banca Esempio",
      aspspCountry: "IT",
      validUntil: NOW + 90 * DAY,
      expiresAt: NOW + 600_000,
      ...overrides,
    });

    it("consumes a request exactly once", () => {
      repo.createAuthRequest(request());
      const first = repo.consumeAuthRequest("a".repeat(64));
      expect(first).toMatchObject({
        purpose: "connect",
        connectionId: null,
        aspspName: "Banca Esempio",
        createdAt: NOW,
        consumedAt: NOW,
      });
      expect(repo.consumeAuthRequest("a".repeat(64))).toBeNull();
    });

    it("refuses unknown and expired state hashes", () => {
      repo.createAuthRequest(request({ stateHash: "b".repeat(64), expiresAt: NOW + 1_000 }));
      expect(repo.consumeAuthRequest("c".repeat(64))).toBeNull();
      now += 1_000;
      expect(repo.consumeAuthRequest("b".repeat(64))).toBeNull();
    });

    it("keeps the connection of a renewal request", () => {
      const connectionId = repo.createConnection(connectionInput());
      repo.createAuthRequest(request({ purpose: "renew", connectionId }));
      expect(repo.consumeAuthRequest("a".repeat(64))?.connectionId).toBe(connectionId);
    });

    it("rejects a duplicate state hash", () => {
      repo.createAuthRequest(request());
      expect(() => repo.createAuthRequest(request())).toThrow();
    });

    it("purges the requests past their expiry", () => {
      repo.createAuthRequest(request({ stateHash: "d".repeat(64), expiresAt: NOW + 1_000 }));
      repo.createAuthRequest(request({ stateHash: "e".repeat(64), expiresAt: NOW + 10_000 }));
      now += 2_000;
      expect(repo.purgeExpiredAuthRequests()).toBe(1);
      expect(repo.consumeAuthRequest("e".repeat(64))).not.toBeNull();
    });
  });

  describe("transaction", () => {
    it("commits on success and returns the value", () => {
      const id = repo.transaction(() => repo.createConnection(connectionInput()));
      expect(repo.getConnection(id)).not.toBeNull();
    });

    it("rolls back everything when the callback throws", () => {
      expect(() =>
        repo.transaction(() => {
          repo.createConnection(connectionInput());
          throw new Error("boom");
        }),
      ).toThrow("boom");
      expect(repo.listConnections({ includeRemoved: true })).toEqual([]);
    });

    it("nests: an inner failure that is caught keeps the outer work", () => {
      repo.transaction(() => {
        repo.createConnection(connectionInput());
        try {
          repo.transaction(() => {
            repo.createConnection(connectionInput({ providerSessionId: "s-2" }));
            throw new Error("inner");
          });
        } catch {
          // The inner savepoint is rolled back; the outer transaction goes on.
        }
      });
      expect(repo.listConnections().map((row) => row.providerSessionId)).toEqual([
        "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
      ]);
    });
  });
});
```

```ts
import type {
  AccountStatus,
  LocalDate,
  SkipReason,
  SyncRunStatus,
  SyncTrigger,
} from "@bursar/shared";
import { and, asc, count, desc, eq, gt, gte, inArray, isNull, lte, or, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { BursarDb } from "../db";
import {
  accounts,
  balances,
  bankAuthRequests,
  bankConnections,
  syncRuns,
  transactions,
} from "../db/schema";

/** The bank's own classification of a transaction (ISO 20022 style), as the sync stores it. */
export interface BankTransactionCode {
  code: string | null;
  subCode: string | null;
  description: string | null;
}

export type ConnectionRow = typeof bankConnections.$inferSelect;
export type AccountRow = typeof accounts.$inferSelect;
export type BalanceRow = typeof balances.$inferSelect;
export type TransactionRow = Omit<typeof transactions.$inferSelect, "bankCode"> & {
  bankCode: BankTransactionCode | null;
};
export type SyncRunRow = typeof syncRuns.$inferSelect;
export type AuthRequestRow = typeof bankAuthRequests.$inferSelect;

type WithOptional<T, K extends keyof T> = Omit<T, K> & Partial<Pick<T, K>>;

/** `status` defaults to `active`, `psuType` to `personal`, timestamps to the repository clock. */
export type NewConnection = WithOptional<
  Omit<ConnectionRow, "id">,
  | "aspspLogoUrl"
  | "psuType"
  | "status"
  | "lastErrorCode"
  | "lastErrorMessage"
  | "lastErrorAt"
  | "statusCheckedAt"
  | "createdAt"
  | "updatedAt"
  | "renewedAt"
  | "removedAt"
>;

/** Only the connection, the identification hash and the currency are required. */
export type NewAccount = Pick<AccountRow, "connectionId" | "identificationHash" | "currency"> &
  Partial<Omit<AccountRow, "id" | "connectionId" | "identificationHash" | "currency">>;

export type NewBalance = Omit<BalanceRow, "id">;

export type NewTransaction = Omit<TransactionRow, "id">;

export interface NewSyncRun {
  accountId: number;
  trigger: SyncTrigger;
  withPsuHeaders?: boolean;
  startedAt?: number;
  /** Defaults to `running`; a run that is recorded already finished (for example skipped) sets all of these. */
  status?: SyncRunStatus;
  skipReason?: SkipReason | null;
  finishedAt?: number | null;
}

export interface NewAuthRequest {
  stateHash: string;
  purpose: AuthRequestRow["purpose"];
  connectionId?: number | null;
  aspspName: string;
  aspspCountry: string;
  validUntil: number;
  expiresAt: number;
  createdAt?: number;
}

function parseBankCode(value: string | null): BankTransactionCode | null {
  if (value === null) return null;
  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(value);
    if (typeof parsed !== "object" || parsed === null) return null;
    const record = parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
    const text = (key: string): string | null =>
      typeof record[key] === "string" ? (record[key] as string) : null;
    return { code: text("code"), subCode: text("subCode"), description: text("description") };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function toTransactionRow(row: typeof transactions.$inferSelect): TransactionRow {
  return { ...row, bankCode: parseBankCode(row.bankCode) };
}

function hasValues(values: Record<string, unknown>): boolean {
  return Object.values(values).some((value) => value !== undefined);
}

export class FinanceRepository {
  constructor(
    private readonly db: BursarDb,
    private readonly now: () => number = Date.now,
  ) {}

  /**
   * Runs `fn` in one SQLite transaction (a savepoint when already inside one). `fn` must be
   * synchronous: the database driver is synchronous and a returned promise would escape the
   * transaction.
   */
  transaction<T>(fn: () => T): T {
    return this.db.transaction(() => fn());
  }

  // Connections

  createConnection(input: NewConnection): number {
    const now = this.now();
    const row = this.db
      .insert(bankConnections)
      .values({ ...input, createdAt: input.createdAt ?? now, updatedAt: input.updatedAt ?? now })
      .returning({ id: bankConnections.id })
      .get();
    return row.id;
  }

  getConnection(id: number): ConnectionRow | null {
    return this.db.select().from(bankConnections).where(eq(bankConnections.id, id)).get() ?? null;
  }

  /** Connections the owner has not removed, oldest first; `includeRemoved` adds the removed ones. */
  listConnections(options: { includeRemoved?: boolean } = {}): ConnectionRow[] {
    return this.db
      .select()
      .from(bankConnections)
      .where(options.includeRemoved ? undefined : isNull(bankConnections.removedAt))
      .orderBy(asc(bankConnections.id))
      .all();
  }

  updateConnection(id: number, patch: Partial<Omit<ConnectionRow, "id" | "createdAt">>): void {
    const result = this.db
      .update(bankConnections)
      .set({ ...patch, updatedAt: patch.updatedAt ?? this.now() })
      .where(eq(bankConnections.id, id))
      .run();
    if (result.changes === 0) throw new Error(`Connection ${id} does not exist`);
  }

  // Accounts

  createAccount(input: NewAccount): number {
    const now = this.now();
    const row = this.db
      .insert(accounts)
      .values({ ...input, createdAt: input.createdAt ?? now, updatedAt: input.updatedAt ?? now })
      .returning({ id: accounts.id })
      .get();
    return row.id;
  }

  getAccount(id: number): AccountRow | null {
    return this.db.select().from(accounts).where(eq(accounts.id, id)).get() ?? null;
  }

  /** Accounts in creation order; without a filter every account including removed ones. */
  listAccounts(
    filter: { connectionId?: number; statuses?: readonly AccountStatus[] } = {},
  ): AccountRow[] {
    const conditions = [];
    if (filter.connectionId !== undefined) {
      conditions.push(eq(accounts.connectionId, filter.connectionId));
    }
    if (filter.statuses !== undefined) {
      if (filter.statuses.length === 0) return [];
      conditions.push(inArray(accounts.status, [...filter.statuses]));
    }
    return this.db
      .select()
      .from(accounts)
      .where(conditions.length > 0 ? and(...conditions) : undefined)
      .orderBy(asc(accounts.id))
      .all();
  }

  updateAccount(id: number, patch: Partial<Omit<AccountRow, "id" | "createdAt">>): void {
    const result = this.db
      .update(accounts)
      .set({ ...patch, updatedAt: patch.updatedAt ?? this.now() })
      .where(eq(accounts.id, id))
      .run();
    if (result.changes === 0) throw new Error(`Account ${id} does not exist`);
  }

  /**
   * Accounts (of any status, on any connection) whose identification hash is one of the given
   * hashes or whose IBAN equals `iban`. Callers pass the IBAN already normalised.
   */
  findAccountsByIdentity(
    identificationHashes: readonly string[],
    iban: string | null,
  ): AccountRow[] {
    const matches = [];
    if (identificationHashes.length > 0) {
      matches.push(inArray(accounts.identificationHash, [...identificationHashes]));
    }
    if (iban !== null) matches.push(eq(accounts.iban, iban));
    if (matches.length === 0) return [];
    return this.db
      .select()
      .from(accounts)
      .where(or(...matches))
      .orderBy(asc(accounts.id))
      .all();
  }

  /**
   * Claims one unattended (background) bank fetch for the account on `localDate`. One atomic
   * statement: the counter restarts at 1 on a new day and the claim is refused once `cap`
   * fetches were already claimed that day, so concurrent callers can never exceed the cap.
   */
  tryConsumeBackgroundFetch(accountId: number, localDate: LocalDate, cap: number): boolean {
    const claimed = this.db
      .update(accounts)
      .set({
        bgFetchCount: sql`CASE WHEN bg_fetch_day IS ${localDate} THEN bg_fetch_count + 1 ELSE 1 END`,
        bgFetchDay: localDate,
      })
      .where(
        and(
          eq(accounts.id, accountId),
          sql`${cap} > 0`,
          sql`(bg_fetch_day IS NOT ${localDate} OR bg_fetch_count < ${cap})`,
        ),
      )
      .returning({ id: accounts.id })
      .get();
    return claimed !== undefined;
  }

  // Balances

  /** Inserts the balance, or replaces the amounts of the same account, type and reference date. */
  upsertBalance(input: NewBalance): void {
    this.db
      .insert(balances)
      .values(input)
      .onConflictDoUpdate({
        target: [balances.accountId, balances.balanceType, balances.referenceDate],
        set: {
          amountMinor: input.amountMinor,
          currency: input.currency,
          asOf: input.asOf,
          fetchedAt: input.fetchedAt,
        },
      })
      .run();
  }

  /** The most recent balance of each type (by reference date, then as-of time), ordered by type. */
  latestBalances(accountId: number): BalanceRow[] {
    return this.db
      .select()
      .from(balances)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(balances.accountId, accountId),
          eq(
            balances.id,
            sql`(SELECT newer.id FROM balances AS newer
                 WHERE newer.account_id = ${balances.accountId}
                   AND newer.balance_type = ${balances.balanceType}
                 ORDER BY newer.reference_date DESC, newer.as_of DESC, newer.id DESC
                 LIMIT 1)`,
          ),
        ),
      )
      .orderBy(asc(balances.balanceType))
      .all();
  }

  // Transactions

  insertTransaction(input: NewTransaction): number {
    const row = this.db
      .insert(transactions)
      .values({ ...input, bankCode: input.bankCode ? JSON.stringify(input.bankCode) : null })
      .returning({ id: transactions.id })
      .get();
    return row.id;
  }

  updateTransaction(id: number, patch: Partial<Omit<TransactionRow, "id" | "accountId">>): void {
    const { bankCode, ...rest } = patch;
    const values: Partial<typeof transactions.$inferInsert> = { ...rest };
    if (bankCode !== undefined) values.bankCode = bankCode ? JSON.stringify(bankCode) : null;
    if (!hasValues(values)) return;
    const result = this.db.update(transactions).set(values).where(eq(transactions.id, id)).run();
    if (result.changes === 0) throw new Error(`Transaction ${id} does not exist`);
  }

  deleteTransactions(ids: readonly number[]): number {
    if (ids.length === 0) return 0;
    return this.db
      .delete(transactions)
      .where(inArray(transactions.id, [...ids]))
      .run().changes;
  }

  /** Newest first; `fromDate` keeps rows whose sort date is on or after it. */
  transactionsSince(accountId: number, fromDate: LocalDate | null): TransactionRow[] {
    return this.db
      .select()
      .from(transactions)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(transactions.accountId, accountId),
          fromDate === null ? undefined : gte(transactions.sortDate, fromDate),
        ),
      )
      .orderBy(desc(transactions.sortDate), desc(transactions.id))
      .all()
      .map(toTransactionRow);
  }

  /** The newest sort date among booked transactions, or null when there are none. */
  lastBookedDate(accountId: number): LocalDate | null {
    const row = this.db
      .select({ latest: sql<string | null>`max(${transactions.sortDate})` })
      .from(transactions)
      .where(and(eq(transactions.accountId, accountId), eq(transactions.status, "booked")))
      .get();
    return row?.latest ?? null;
  }

  countTransactions(accountId: number): { total: number; pending: number } {
    const row = this.db
      .select({
        total: count(),
        pending: sql<number>`coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN ${transactions.status} = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)`,
      })
      .from(transactions)
      .where(eq(transactions.accountId, accountId))
      .get();
    return { total: Number(row?.total ?? 0), pending: Number(row?.pending ?? 0) };
  }

  // Sync runs

  startSyncRun(input: NewSyncRun): number {
    const row = this.db
      .insert(syncRuns)
      .values({
        accountId: input.accountId,
        trigger: input.trigger,
        status: input.status ?? "running",
        skipReason: input.skipReason ?? null,
        withPsuHeaders: input.withPsuHeaders ?? false,
        startedAt: input.startedAt ?? this.now(),
        finishedAt: input.finishedAt ?? null,
      })
      .returning({ id: syncRuns.id })
      .get();
    return row.id;
  }

  /** Applies the patch and stamps `finishedAt` with the repository clock unless the patch sets it. */
  finishSyncRun(
    id: number,
    patch: Partial<Omit<SyncRunRow, "id" | "accountId" | "trigger" | "startedAt">>,
  ): void {
    const result = this.db
      .update(syncRuns)
      .set({ ...patch, finishedAt: patch.finishedAt ?? this.now() })
      .where(eq(syncRuns.id, id))
      .run();
    if (result.changes === 0) throw new Error(`Sync run ${id} does not exist`);
  }

  /** Newest first. */
  listSyncRuns(accountId: number, limit: number): SyncRunRow[] {
    return this.db
      .select()
      .from(syncRuns)
      .where(eq(syncRuns.accountId, accountId))
      .orderBy(desc(syncRuns.startedAt), desc(syncRuns.id))
      .limit(limit)
      .all();
  }

  /** Marks every run still `running` as failed (the process that ran it is gone). */
  failStaleSyncRuns(message: string): number {
    return this.db
      .update(syncRuns)
      .set({
        status: "failed",
        errorCode: "interrupted",
        errorMessage: message,
        finishedAt: this.now(),
      })
      .where(eq(syncRuns.status, "running"))
      .run().changes;
  }

  /**
   * Deletes the account; its transactions, balances and sync runs go with it through the foreign
   * keys. Returns the counts measured before the delete. It does not check the account status:
   * callers decide whether a purge is allowed.
   */
  purgeAccount(accountId: number): { transactions: number; balances: number; syncRuns: number } {
    return this.transaction(() => {
      const countRows = (table: typeof transactions | typeof balances | typeof syncRuns): number =>
        Number(
          this.db.select({ n: count() }).from(table).where(eq(table.accountId, accountId)).get()
            ?.n ?? 0,
        );
      const removed = {
        transactions: countRows(transactions),
        balances: countRows(balances),
        syncRuns: countRows(syncRuns),
      };
      this.db.delete(accounts).where(eq(accounts.id, accountId)).run();
      return removed;
    });
  }

  // Authorisation requests

  createAuthRequest(input: NewAuthRequest): number {
    const row = this.db
      .insert(bankAuthRequests)
      .values({
        ...input,
        connectionId: input.connectionId ?? null,
        createdAt: input.createdAt ?? this.now(),
      })
      .returning({ id: bankAuthRequests.id })
      .get();
    return row.id;
  }

  /**
   * Returns the request for this state hash and marks it consumed, or null when the hash is
   * unknown, already consumed or expired. One atomic statement: a state value works once.
   */
  consumeAuthRequest(stateHash: string): AuthRequestRow | null {
    const now = this.now();
    return (
      this.db
        .update(bankAuthRequests)
        .set({ consumedAt: now })
        .where(
          and(
            eq(bankAuthRequests.stateHash, stateHash),
            isNull(bankAuthRequests.consumedAt),
            gt(bankAuthRequests.expiresAt, now),
          ),
        )
        .returning()
        .get() ?? null
    );
  }

  /** Deletes the requests past their expiry, consumed or not. */
  purgeExpiredAuthRequests(): number {
    return this.db.delete(bankAuthRequests).where(lte(bankAuthRequests.expiresAt, this.now())).run()
      .changes;
  }
}
```

`apps/server/src/audit.ts`:

```ts
import type { BursarDb } from "./db";
import { auditLog } from "./db/schema";

export type AuditAction =
  | "connection.create"
  | "connection.renew"
  | "connection.remove"
  | "account.rename"
  | "account.disable"
  | "account.enable"
  | "account.purge"
  | "settings.update"
  | "backup.run";

export interface AuditEntry {
  actor: "user" | "system";
  action: AuditAction;
  /** What the action touched, as a short reference such as `account:12`. Never a secret. */
  target?: string;
  /** Flat, non-sensitive facts about the action. Never secrets, identifiers or amounts. */
  details?: Record<string, string | number | boolean | null>;
}

export class AuditLog {
  constructor(
    private readonly db: BursarDb,
    private readonly now: () => number = Date.now,
  ) {}

  record(entry: AuditEntry): void {
    this.db
      .insert(auditLog)
      .values({
        actor: entry.actor,
        action: entry.action,
        target: entry.target ?? null,
        details: entry.details ? JSON.stringify(entry.details) : null,
        at: this.now(),
      })
      .run();
  }
}
```

```ts
  pickPreferredBalance,
} from "@bursar/shared";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { loadConfig } from "../config";
import { FinanceRepository } from "../finance/repository";
import type { SeedContext } from "../server";
import { createTestDatabase, MIGRATIONS_DIR, type TestDatabase } from "../test/db";
import { seedBanking } from "./seed-banking";
import { QA_SEEDERS } from "./seeders";

const NOW = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 9, 10, 0, 0);
const TIME_ZONE = "Europe/Rome";

function contextFor(t: TestDatabase, now = NOW): SeedContext {
  const config = loadConfig({
    BURSAR_PUBLIC_URL: "https://bursar.example.test",
    TZ: TIME_ZONE,
    BURSAR_MASTER_KEY: Buffer.alloc(32, 3).toString("base64"),
    BURSAR_DATA_DIR: t.dir,
    BURSAR_MIGRATIONS_DIR: MIGRATIONS_DIR,
  });
  return { db: t.db, sqlite: t.sqlite, config, now: () => now };
}

function dump(t: TestDatabase): Record<string, unknown[]> {
  const tables = [
    "bank_connections",
    "accounts",
    "balances",
    "transactions",
    "sync_runs",
    "notifications",
    "backup_runs",
  ];
  return Object.fromEntries(
    tables.map((table) => [table, t.sqlite.prepare(`SELECT * FROM ${table} ORDER BY id`).all()]),
  );
}

describe("seedBanking", () => {
  let t: TestDatabase;

    const stale = repo.listAccounts().find((a) => a.product === "Conto Libero");
    expect(NOW - (stale?.lastSyncedAt ?? NOW)).toBeGreaterThan(72 * 3_600_000);
    const loan = repo.listAccounts().find((a) => a.cashAccountType === "LOAN");
    expect(repo.latestBalances(loan?.id ?? 0)[0]?.amountMinor).toBeLessThan(0);
  });

  it("records succeeded, failed and skipped sync runs, with every skip reason", () => {
    const runs = repo.listAccounts().flatMap((a) => repo.listSyncRuns(a.id, 50));
    const count = (status: string): number => runs.filter((r) => r.status === status).length;
    expect(count("running")).toBe(0);
    expect(count("failed")).toBe(7);
    expect(count("succeeded")).toBeGreaterThan(10);
    expect(new Set(runs.filter((r) => r.status === "skipped").map((r) => r.skipReason))).toEqual(
      new Set([
        "rate_limited",
        "daily_cap",
        "connection_inactive",
        "account_inactive",
        "no_provider_uid",
      ]),
    );
    expect(runs.some((r) => r.withPsuHeaders)).toBe(true);
    expect(
      runs.filter((r) => r.status === "failed").every((r) => r.errorCode && r.errorMessage),
    ).toBe(true);
    expect(runs.every((r) => r.finishedAt !== null && r.finishedAt >= r.startedAt)).toBe(true);
    const failing = repo.listAccounts().find((a) => a.product === "Compte Courant");
    expect(
      repo
        .listSyncRuns(failing?.id ?? 0, 10)
        .slice(0, 4)
        .map((r) => r.status),
    ).toEqual(["failed", "failed", "failed", "failed"]);
  });

  it("adds two notifications, one unread, and a successful backup run", () => {
    const rows = t.sqlite
      .prepare("SELECT event, read_at AS readAt FROM notifications ORDER BY id")
      .all() as {
      event: string;
      readAt: number | null;
    }[];
    expect(rows.map((r) => r.event)).toEqual(["consent_expiring", "sync_failing"]);
    expect(rows.filter((r) => r.readAt === null)).toHaveLength(1);
    const backups = t.sqlite
      .prepare("SELECT status, target, size_bytes AS size FROM backup_runs")
      .all();
    expect(backups).toEqual([{ status: "succeeded", target: "local", size: 1_843_200 }]);
  });

  it("holds only fictional data", () => {
    const text = JSON.stringify(dump(t));
    expect(text).not.toMatch(/@/);
    expect(text).not.toMatch(/https?:\/\//);
  });

  it("is identical across two runs with the same clock", () => {
    const other = createTestDatabase();
    try {
      seedBanking(contextFor(other));
      expect(dump(other)).toEqual(dump(t));
    } finally {
      other.dispose();
    }
  });

  it("moves with the clock but keeps the same shape", () => {
    const other = createTestDatabase();
    try {
      seedBanking(contextFor(other, NOW + 30 * 86_400_000));
      const shifted = new FinanceRepository(other.db, () => NOW + 30 * 86_400_000);
      expect(shifted.listAccounts()).toHaveLength(10);
      expect(shifted.countTransactions(1).pending).toBe(3);
      const states = shifted
        .listConnections()
        .map((c) =>
          effectiveConnectionStatus(c.status, c.validUntil, NOW + 30 * 86_400_000, TIME_ZONE),
        )
        .sort();
      expect(states).toEqual(["active", "error", "expired", "expiring", "revoked"]);
    } finally {
      other.dispose();
    }
  });
});
```

`apps/server/src/qa/seed-banking.ts` (all names, banks, IBANs and counterparties are invented; IBANs are generated with valid check digits on unassigned bank codes; the only randomness is a seeded PRNG, and every date is relative to `ctx.now()`):

```ts
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import {
  accountDisplayName,
  addDays,
  identifierLast4,
  type LocalDate,
  maskIban,
  maskIdentifier,
  minorToDecimalString,
  normalizeForSearch,
  startOfLocalDay,
  toLocalDate,
} from "@bursar/shared";
import { backupRuns, notifications } from "../db/schema";
import {
  type BankTransactionCode,
  FinanceRepository,
  type NewAccount,
  type NewConnection,
} from "../finance/repository";
import type { SeedContext } from "../server";

/**
 * Deterministic, fictional banking data for the QA harness and local demos: every connection and
 * account state, mixed currencies, pending transactions, failed and skipped syncs, notifications
 * and a backup run. Nothing here comes from a real bank: names are invented, IBANs are generated
 * with valid check digits on unassigned bank codes, and all dates are relative to `ctx.now()`.
 */

const HOUR = 3_600_000;
const DAY = 24 * HOUR;

/** Small seeded PRNG (mulberry32): the same seed always yields the same sequence. */
function mulberry32(seed: number): () => number {
  let state = seed >>> 0;
  return () => {
    state = (state + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
    let t = state;
    t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
    t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4_294_967_296;
  };
}

function ibanCheckDigits(country: string, bban: string): string {
  let remainder = 0;
  for (const char of `${bban}${country}00`) {
    const digits = /\d/.test(char) ? char : String(char.charCodeAt(0) - 55);
    for (const digit of digits) remainder = (remainder * 10 + Number(digit)) % 97;
  }
  return String(98 - remainder).padStart(2, "0");
}

function makeIban(country: string, bban: string): string {
  return `${country}${ibanCheckDigits(country, bban)}${bban}`;
}

const sha256 = (value: string): string => createHash("sha256").update(value).digest("hex");

const uuidFor = (n: number): string => `00000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(n).padStart(12, "0")}`;

interface RecurringSpec {
  dayOfMonth: number;
  amountMinor: number;
  counterparty: string;
  lines: string[];
  counterpartyAccount?: string;
  bankCode?: BankTransactionCode;
  mcc?: string;
  card?: boolean;
}

interface PoolSpec {
  probability: number;
  minMinor: number;
  maxMinor: number;
  direction: 1 | -1;
  counterparties: readonly string[];
  lines: string[];
  mcc: string | null;
  card: boolean;
}

interface FixedSpec {
  daysAgo: number;
  amountMinor: number;
  counterparty: string | null;
  lines?: string[];
  mcc?: string;
  card?: boolean;
  pending?: boolean;
}

interface LedgerSpec {
  /** Recurring and pooled transactions are generated for each day from `fromDaysAgo` down to `toDaysAgo`. */
  fromDaysAgo?: number;
  toDaysAgo?: number;
  recurring?: RecurringSpec[];
  pools?: PoolSpec[];
  fixed?: FixedSpec[];
}

interface Entry {
  date: LocalDate;
  pending: boolean;
  amountMinor: number;
  counterparty: string | null;
  counterpartyAccount: string | null;
  lines: string[];
  mcc: string | null;
  bankCode: BankTransactionCode | null;
  card: boolean;
}

const SEPA_CREDIT: BankTransactionCode = {
  code: "RCDT",
  subCode: "ESCT",
  description: "SEPA credit transfer received",
};

const GROCERIES: PoolSpec = {
  probability: 0.35,
  minMinor: 800,
  maxMinor: 9_500,
  direction: -1,
  counterparties: ["Supermercato Centrale", "Mercato Rionale", "Alimentari Sole"],
  lines: ["Acquisto con carta"],
  mcc: "5411",
  card: true,
};

const CAFES: PoolSpec = {
  probability: 0.28,
  minMinor: 350,
  maxMinor: 6_500,
  direction: -1,
  counterparties: ["Caffè Centrale", "Trattoria Il Porto", "Pizzeria Margherita", "Bar Stazione"],
  lines: ["Acquisto con carta"],
  mcc: "5812",
  card: true,
};

const TRANSPORT: PoolSpec = {
  probability: 0.15,
  minMinor: 150,
  maxMinor: 2_800,
  direction: -1,
  counterparties: ["Trasporti Urbani", "Taxi Città", "Parcheggio Centro"],
  lines: ["Acquisto con carta"],
  mcc: "4111",
  card: true,
};

export function seedBanking(ctx: SeedContext): void {
  const now = ctx.now();
  const timeZone = ctx.config.timezone;
  const today = toLocalDate(now, timeZone);
  const rng = mulberry32(20_261_109);
  const repo = new FinanceRepository(ctx.db, ctx.now);

  const ago = (ms: number): number => now - ms;
  /** About noon of the local day `days` from today: stays on that calendar day across DST. */
  const localNoon = (days: number): number =>
    startOfLocalDay(addDays(today, days), timeZone) + 12 * HOUR;
  const intBetween = (min: number, max: number): number =>
    min + Math.floor(rng() * (max - min + 1));
  const pick = <T>(items: readonly T[]): T => items[Math.floor(rng() * items.length)] as T;

  function buildEntries(spec: LedgerSpec): Entry[] {
    const entries: Entry[] = [];
    const first = spec.fromDaysAgo ?? -1;
    const last = spec.toDaysAgo ?? 0;
    for (let daysAgo = first; daysAgo >= last; daysAgo--) {
      const date = addDays(today, -daysAgo);
      const dayOfMonth = Number(date.slice(8, 10));
      for (const item of spec.recurring ?? []) {
        if (item.dayOfMonth !== dayOfMonth) continue;
        entries.push({
          date,
          pending: false,
          amountMinor: item.amountMinor,
          counterparty: item.counterparty,
          counterpartyAccount: item.counterpartyAccount ?? null,
          lines: item.lines,
          mcc: item.mcc ?? null,
          bankCode: item.bankCode ?? null,
          card: item.card ?? false,
        });
      }
      for (const pool of spec.pools ?? []) {
        if (rng() >= pool.probability) continue;
        entries.push({
          date,
          pending: false,
          amountMinor: pool.direction * intBetween(pool.minMinor, pool.maxMinor),
          counterparty: pick(pool.counterparties),
          counterpartyAccount: null,
          lines: pool.lines,
          mcc: pool.mcc,
          bankCode: null,
          card: pool.card,
        });
      }
    }
    for (const item of spec.fixed ?? []) {
      entries.push({
        date: addDays(today, -item.daysAgo),
        pending: item.pending ?? false,
        amountMinor: item.amountMinor,
        counterparty: item.counterparty,
        counterpartyAccount: null,
        lines: item.lines ?? [],
        mcc: item.mcc ?? null,
        bankCode: null,
        card: item.card ?? false,
      });
    }
    return entries.sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date));
  }

  /** Inserts the entries oldest first; returns the net of the booked ones. */
  function insertLedger(
    accountId: number,
    currency: string,
    entries: readonly Entry[],
    lastSeenAt: number,
    openingMinor: number | null,
  ): number {
    let running = openingMinor;
    let net = 0;
    entries.forEach((entry, index) => {
      const bookingDate = entry.pending ? null : entry.date;
      const transactionDate = entry.card
        ? entry.pending
          ? entry.date
          : addDays(entry.date, -1)
        : null;
      const reference = `E${accountId}${String(index + 1).padStart(6, "0")}`;
      const providerReference = entry.pending || rng() >= 0.8 ? null : reference;
      if (!entry.pending) {
        net += entry.amountMinor;
        if (running !== null) running += entry.amountMinor;
      }
      const remittance = entry.lines.length > 0 ? entry.lines.join(" ") : null;
      const firstSeenAt = Math.min(
        lastSeenAt,
        startOfLocalDay(entry.date, timeZone) + 7 * HOUR + intBetween(0, 3 * HOUR),
      );
      repo.insertTransaction({
        accountId,
        providerReference,
        fingerprint: sha256(
          [accountId, index, entry.date, entry.amountMinor, entry.counterparty ?? ""].join("|"),
        ),
        status: entry.pending ? "pending" : "booked",
        bookingDate,
        valueDate: bookingDate,
        transactionDate,
        sortDate: bookingDate ?? transactionDate ?? entry.date,
        amountMinor: entry.amountMinor,
        currency,
        counterparty: entry.counterparty,
        counterpartyAccount: entry.counterpartyAccount,
        remittance,
        bankCode: entry.bankCode,
        merchantCategoryCode: entry.mcc,
        balanceAfterMinor: entry.pending ? null : running,
        searchText: normalizeForSearch([entry.counterparty, remittance].filter(Boolean).join(" ")),
        rawJson: JSON.stringify({
          entry_reference: providerReference,
          transaction_amount: {
            currency,
            amount: minorToDecimalString(Math.abs(entry.amountMinor), currency),
          },
          credit_debit_indicator: entry.amountMinor < 0 ? "DBIT" : "CRDT",
          status: entry.pending ? "PDNG" : "BOOK",
          booking_date: bookingDate,
          value_date: bookingDate,
          transaction_date: transactionDate,
          remittance_information: entry.lines,
          [entry.amountMinor < 0 ? "creditor" : "debtor"]: entry.counterparty
            ? { name: entry.counterparty }
            : null,
          bank_transaction_code: entry.bankCode
            ? {
                code: entry.bankCode.code,
                sub_code: entry.bankCode.subCode,
                description: entry.bankCode.description,
              }
            : undefined,
          merchant_category_code: entry.mcc,
        }),
        missingCount: 0,
        firstSeenAt,
        lastSeenAt,
      });
    });
    return net;
  }

  function addBalance(
    accountId: number,
    balanceType: string,
    amountMinor: number,
    currency: string,
    referenceDate: LocalDate,
    asOf: number,
    fetchedAt: number,
  ): void {
    repo.upsertBalance({
      accountId,
      balanceType,
      amountMinor,
      currency,
      referenceDate,
      asOf,
      fetchedAt,
    });
  }

  function addRun(
    accountId: number,
    agoMs: number,
    trigger: "initial" | "manual" | "background" | "renewal",
    outcome:
      | {
          status: "succeeded";
          fetched: number;
          inserted: number;
          updated?: number;
          removed?: number;
        }
      | { status: "failed"; errorCode: string; errorMessage: string }
      | {
          status: "skipped";
          skipReason:
            | "rate_limited"
            | "daily_cap"
            | "connection_inactive"
            | "account_inactive"
            | "no_provider_uid";
        },
    withPsuHeaders = false,
  ): void {
    const startedAt = ago(agoMs);
    const finishedAt = startedAt + intBetween(3_000, 40_000);
    const id = repo.startSyncRun({ accountId, trigger, withPsuHeaders, startedAt });
    if (outcome.status === "succeeded") {
      repo.finishSyncRun(id, {
        status: "succeeded",
        finishedAt,
        fetched: outcome.fetched,
        inserted: outcome.inserted,
        updated: outcome.updated ?? 0,
        removed: outcome.removed ?? 0,
      });
    } else if (outcome.status === "failed") {
      repo.finishSyncRun(id, {
        status: "failed",
        finishedAt,
        errorCode: outcome.errorCode,
        errorMessage: outcome.errorMessage,
      });
    } else {
      repo.finishSyncRun(id, {
        status: "skipped",
        finishedAt: startedAt,
        skipReason: outcome.skipReason,
      });
    }
  }

  repo.transaction(() => {
    // Fictional counterparties' accounts, shown masked on transfers.
    const salaryIban = makeIban("IT", "X9999999999000000770001");
    const landlordIban = makeIban("IT", "X9999999999000000770002");

    // Connections -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const connection = (

      repo.createConnection({
        aspspName,
        aspspCountry,
        providerSessionId: uuidFor(900 + n),
        validUntil,
        statusCheckedAt: ago(6 * HOUR),
        createdAt: ago(createdDaysAgo * DAY),
        updatedAt: ago(6 * HOUR),
        ...extra,
      });

    const bancaEsempio = connection(1, "Banca Esempio", "IT", 125, localNoon(88));
    const northwind = connection(2, "Northwind Bank", "DE", 171, localNoon(9));
    const orizzonte = connection(3, "Banca Orizzonte", "IT", 175, localNoon(-5), {
      status: "expired",
      lastErrorCode: "EXPIRED_SESSION",
      lastErrorMessage: "The consent has expired and needs to be renewed",
      lastErrorAt: ago(100 * HOUR),
    });
    const credito = connection(4, "Credito Fittizio", "IT", 60, localNoon(120), {
      status: "revoked",
      lastErrorCode: "REVOKED_SESSION",
      lastErrorMessage: "The consent was withdrawn at the bank",
      lastErrorAt: ago(12 * DAY),
    });
    const polaris = connection(5, "Polaris Finance", "FR", 40, localNoon(140), {
      status: "error",
      lastErrorCode: "ACCESS_DENIED",
      lastErrorMessage: "The bank refused access to the account data",
      lastErrorAt: ago(10 * HOUR),
    });
    const disconnected = connection(6, "Banca Esempio", "IT", 110, localNoon(70), {
      status: "revoked",
      removedAt: ago(20 * DAY),
      updatedAt: ago(20 * DAY),
    });

    // Accounts ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const account = (
      n: number,
      connectionId: number,
      identifier: { iban: string } | { other: string },
      fields: Partial<NewAccount> = {},
    ): number => {
      const iban = "iban" in identifier ? identifier.iban : null;
      const raw = "iban" in identifier ? identifier.iban : identifier.other;
      return repo.createAccount({
```

**Files:**

- Test: `apps/server/src/jobs/queue.test.ts`, `apps/server/src/jobs/worker.test.ts`, `apps/server/src/jobs/types.test.ts`, `apps/server/src/events/bus.test.ts`, `apps/server/src/http/events.test.ts`, `apps/server/src/maintenance.test.ts`, `apps/server/src/auth/rate-limit.test.ts`, `apps/server/src/auth/sessions.test.ts`, `apps/server/src/http/app.test.ts`, `apps/server/src/server.test.ts`, `packages/shared/src/events.test.ts`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: Task 6 `jobs.dedupe_key`, `FinanceRepository.failStaleSyncRuns`, shared enums.
- Produces:
  - `queue.ts`: `enqueueUnique(type: string, dedupeKey: string, payload: unknown, options?: { runAfter?: number; maxAttempts?: number }): { id: number; created: boolean }` (returns the active job when one with the same key is queued or running); `findActive(dedupeKey: string): { id: number; status: "queued" | "running" } | null`; `activeKeys(prefix: string): Set<string>`; `cancelQueued(dedupeKey: string): number`; `complete` and `fail` only affect rows with `status = 'running'` (return without change otherwise and log nothing); `fail` runs in one transaction; a payload that is not valid JSON is failed permanently at claim time instead of stranding the job; `purgeFinished(olderThanMs: number): number` (deletes succeeded/failed jobs older than the threshold). `enqueue` keeps its signature.
  - `worker.ts`: `class PermanentJobError extends Error` (handler throws it → `fail(…, permanent = true)`); failure logs include the error stack (deferred minor).
  - `jobs/types.ts`: `SYNC_ACCOUNT_JOB = "bank.sync-account"`, `syncAccountPayloadSchema = z.object({ accountId: z.number().int().positive(), trigger: syncTriggerSchema, psu: z.object({ ipAddress: z.string(), userAgent: z.string(), accept: z.string().optional(), acceptLanguage: z.string().optional() }).optional() })`, `syncDedupeKey(accountId: number): string` (`sync:<id>`); `EMAIL_JOB = "notify.email"`, `emailPayloadSchema = z.object({ notificationId: z.number().int().positive() })`, `emailDedupeKey(id)` (`email:<id>`); `BACKUP_JOB = "backup.run"`, `backupPayloadSchema = z.object({ trigger: z.enum(["scheduled", "manual"]) })`, `BACKUP_DEDUPE_KEY = "backup"`; `DELETE_SESSION_JOB = "bank.delete-session"`, `deleteSessionPayloadSchema = z.object({ providerSessionId: z.string().min(1) })`; inferred payload types; `parsePayload<T>(schema: z.ZodType<T>, job: JobRecord): T` (throws `PermanentJobError` on invalid payload).
  - `@bursar/shared` `events.ts`: `serverEventSchema` (discriminated union on `type`) and `type ServerEvent =` `{ type: "sync.started"; accountId: number; connectionId: number; trigger: SyncTrigger }` | `{ type: "sync.progress"; accountId: number; fetched: number }` | `{ type: "sync.finished"; accountId: number; connectionId: number; trigger: SyncTrigger; status: "succeeded" | "failed" | "skipped"; inserted: number; updated: number; removed: number; errorCode: string | null; skipReason: SkipReason | null; retryAt: number | null }` | `{ type: "connection.updated"; connectionId: number; status: ConnectionStatus }` | `{ type: "notification.created"; id: number; event: NotificationEvent }` | `{ type: "backup.finished"; status: "succeeded" | "failed" }` | `{ type: "settings.updated" }`; `SERVER_EVENT_TYPES` (array of the `type` literals).
  - `events/bus.ts`: `class EventBus { publish(event: ServerEvent): void; subscribe(listener: (event: ServerEvent) => void): () => void; listenerCount(): number }` (a throwing listener never breaks others).
  - `http/events.ts`: `eventsRoute(deps: { bus: EventBus; sessions: SessionStore; heartbeatMs?: number; maxStreams?: number }): Hono<AppEnv>` mounted at `/api/events` (GET): `text/event-stream`, `Cache-Control: no-cache, no-transform`, `X-Accel-Buffering: no`; sends `event: ready` then each bus event as `event: <type>\ndata: <json>\n\n`; `: ping` comment every `heartbeatMs` (default 25 000); every heartbeat checks the session with `SessionStore.peek` and closes the stream when it is no longer valid; at most `maxStreams` (default 10) concurrent streams, the oldest closed first; unsubscribes on abort.
  - `sessions.ts`: `peek(token: string): number | null` (validates without sliding the expiry).
  - `rate-limit.ts`: `FailureLimiter` constructor gains `maxEntries = 10_000` (4th parameter, after `now`); `sweep(): number` removes expired windows; when inserting beyond `maxEntries`, evict the oldest entry (deferred minor).
  - `maintenance.ts`: `interface MaintenanceDeps { queue: JobQueue; sessions: SessionStore; limiters: readonly FailureLimiter[]; logger: Logger; cleanups?: ReadonlyArray<{ name: string; run(): number }> }`; `maintenanceTask(deps: MaintenanceDeps): ScheduledTask` (purge sessions, sweep limiters, `queue.purgeFinished(30 days)`, then each cleanup; logs counts when any is positive). It does **not** call `recoverStale` at run time: the single in-process worker may still be running a long job (an initial `strategy=longest` sync of up to 500 pages, a backup upload), and requeueing it would run it twice (two bank fetches charged against the cap, a backup recorded `failed` although it succeeded). Crash recovery is the boot-time `recoverStale(0)` in `server.ts`, which is complete for a single process. Later tasks add cleanups in `server.ts`.
  - `http/app.ts`: `interface MountedRouter { prefix: string; router: Hono<AppEnv> }`; `AppDeps` gains `routers?: MountedRouter[]` (mounted after `requireSession`, before the `/api/*` 404) and `publicRouters?: MountedRouter[]` (mounted after the body limit and before `/api/auth` and `requireSession`); a middleware sets `Cache-Control: no-store` on every `/api/*` response that has none (deferred minor).
  - `server.ts`: before `worker.start()`: `queue.recoverStale(0)` (every running job at boot is orphaned in a single process) and `repo.failStaleSyncRuns("Interrupted by a restart")`, logged with counts; creates `bus = new EventBus()`, `repo = new FinanceRepository(db)`, `audit = new AuditLog(db)`; mounts `eventsRoute` at `/api/events`; `handlers` becomes a `Map<string, JobHandler>` built in one place (`const handlers = new Map<string, JobHandler>()`) that later tasks extend; passes the auth limiters to `maintenanceTask`.
  - `test/app.ts`: `interface TestApp { app: Hono<AppEnv>; cookie: string; origin: string; sessions: SessionStore; json(path: string, init?: { method?: string; body?: unknown }): Promise<{ status: number; body: unknown; headers: Headers }> }`; `createTestApp(options: { database: TestDatabase; routers?: MountedRouter[]; publicRouters?: MountedRouter[]; now?: () => number }): Promise<TestApp>` (builds `createApp` with real auth stores, completes setup through the API like `auth/routes.test.ts`, returns the session cookie; `json()` adds `origin`, `content-type` and the cookie).

**Additions to the contract (all optional parameters or extra fields; every Interface above stays exactly as written):**
- `JobQueue.complete(id, attempt?)` and `JobQueue.fail(id, error, permanent?, attempt?)`: when `attempt` is given the row must still be on that attempt, so a slow handler of attempt 1 cannot finish a job that was recovered and claimed again as attempt 2. `JobWorker` always passes `job.attempts`. `fail` returns `"retry" | "failed" | "ignored"`; `"ignored"` means nothing changed (job not running, or a different attempt).
- `new JobQueue(sqlite, now?, onCorruptPayload?)`: the optional callback is told about a job that was failed because its payload was not valid JSON (`server.ts` logs it).
- `new EventBus(onListenerError?)`: the optional callback receives errors thrown by listeners (`server.ts` logs them).
- `eventsRoute({ ..., signal? })`: aborting the signal closes every open stream and makes new connections answer 503. `server.ts` aborts it first in `close()`, otherwise `server.close()` waits for the panel to disconnect.
- `JobQueue.recoverStale` compares `locked_at <= now - olderThanMs` (was `<`), so `recoverStale(0)` also recovers a job claimed in the current millisecond.
- `activeKeys(prefix)` returns the full dedupe keys (`"sync:12"`), not the suffixes. `cancelQueued` deletes the queued rows.
- `test/app.ts` also exports `TEST_ORIGIN` and `TEST_PASSWORD`.
- `server.ts` does not construct `AuditLog` in this task (nothing uses it yet, and Biome flags an unused binding); Task 8 adds `const audit = new AuditLog(database.db)` next to the settings store.
- No UI in this task: the Playwright QA step of the UI definition of done does not apply.

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement the union and export it**

Create `packages/shared/src/events.ts`:

```ts
import { z } from "zod";
import {
  connectionStatusSchema,
  notificationEventSchema,
  skipReasonSchema,
  syncTriggerSchema,
} from "./finance";

const id = z.number().int().positive();
const count = z.number().int().nonnegative();

/** Payloads pushed to the panel over GET /api/events (one SSE event per member, named after `type`). */
export const serverEventSchema = z.discriminatedUnion("type", [
  z.object({
    type: z.literal("sync.started"),
    accountId: id,
    connectionId: id,
    trigger: syncTriggerSchema,
  }),
  z.object({ type: z.literal("sync.progress"), accountId: id, fetched: count }),
  z.object({
    type: z.literal("sync.finished"),
    accountId: id,
    connectionId: id,
    // Carried so a panel that connects mid-sync (and missed `sync.started`) still knows it.
    trigger: syncTriggerSchema,
    status: z.enum(["succeeded", "failed", "skipped"]),
    inserted: count,
    updated: count,
    removed: count,
    errorCode: z.string().nullable(),
    skipReason: skipReasonSchema.nullable(),
    retryAt: z.number().int().nullable(),
  }),
  z.object({
    type: z.literal("connection.updated"),
    connectionId: id,
    status: connectionStatusSchema,
  }),
  z.object({
    type: z.literal("notification.created"),
    id,
    event: notificationEventSchema,
  }),
  z.object({ type: z.literal("backup.finished"), status: z.enum(["succeeded", "failed"]) }),
  z.object({ type: z.literal("settings.updated") }),
]);
export type ServerEvent = z.infer<typeof serverEventSchema>;
export type ServerEventType = ServerEvent["type"];

/** Every `type` literal of {@link ServerEvent}; the panel registers one listener per entry. */
export const SERVER_EVENT_TYPES = [
  "sync.started",
  "sync.progress",
  "sync.finished",
  "connection.updated",
  "notification.created",
  "backup.finished",
  "settings.updated",
] as const satisfies readonly ServerEventType[];
```

