Replace the whole of `apps/server/src/jobs/queue.test.ts` (the first seven tests are the existing ones, unchanged):

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { createTestDatabase, type TestDatabase } from "../test/db";
import { backoffMs, JobQueue } from "./queue";

describe("JobQueue", () => {
  let t: TestDatabase;
  let now: number;
  let queue: JobQueue;

  beforeEach(() => {
    t = createTestDatabase();
    now = 1_000_000;
    queue = new JobQueue(t.sqlite, () => now);
  });
  afterEach(() => t.dispose());

  it("claims due jobs in order and leaves future ones queued", () => {
    const later = queue.enqueue("b", {}, { runAfter: now + 60_000 });
    const first = queue.enqueue("a", { n: 1 });
    expect(queue.claimNext()).toMatchObject({
      id: first,
      type: "a",
      payload: { n: 1 },
      attempts: 1,
    });
    expect(queue.claimNext()).toBeNull();
    now += 60_000;
    expect(queue.claimNext()?.id).toBe(later);
  });

  it("retries with backoff, then fails after the last attempt", () => {
    const id = queue.enqueue("a", null, { maxAttempts: 2 });
    queue.claimNext();
    expect(queue.fail(id, "boom")).toBe("retry");
    expect(queue.get(id)).toMatchObject({
      status: "queued",
      lastError: "boom",
      runAfter: now + backoffMs(1),
    });
    now += backoffMs(1);
    queue.claimNext();
    expect(queue.fail(id, "boom again")).toBe("failed");
    expect(queue.get(id)?.status).toBe("failed");
  });

  it("fails permanently when asked to", () => {
    const id = queue.enqueue("a", null);
    queue.claimNext();
    expect(queue.fail(id, "no handler", true)).toBe("failed");
  });

  it("marks completed jobs as succeeded", () => {
    const id = queue.enqueue("a", null);
    queue.claimNext();
    queue.complete(id);
    expect(queue.get(id)).toMatchObject({ status: "succeeded", lastError: null });
  });

  it("requeues jobs whose lock is stale", () => {
    const id = queue.enqueue("a", null);
    queue.claimNext();
    now += 11 * 60_000;
    expect(queue.recoverStale(10 * 60_000)).toBe(1);
    expect(queue.get(id)?.status).toBe("queued");
  });

  it("fails stale jobs that have used all their attempts instead of requeueing", () => {
    const id = queue.enqueue("a", null, { maxAttempts: 1 });
    queue.claimNext();
    now += 11 * 60_000;
    expect(queue.recoverStale(10 * 60_000)).toBe(1);
    expect(queue.get(id)).toMatchObject({ status: "failed" });
    expect(queue.get(id)?.lastError).toContain("attempts exhausted");
    expect(queue.claimNext()).toBeNull();
  });
  it("recoverStale(0) recovers a job claimed at the same instant", () => {
    const id = queue.enqueue("a", null);
    queue.claimNext();
    expect(queue.recoverStale(0)).toBe(1);
    expect(queue.get(id)?.status).toBe("queued");
  });

  describe("enqueueUnique", () => {
    it("returns the active job instead of creating a second one", () => {
      const first = queue.enqueueUnique("sync", "sync:1", { accountId: 1 });
      expect(first.created).toBe(true);
      expect(queue.enqueueUnique("sync", "sync:1", { accountId: 1 })).toEqual({
        id: first.id,
        created: false,
      });
      expect(queue.enqueueUnique("sync", "sync:2", { accountId: 2 }).created).toBe(true);
    });

    it("dedupes while the job is running", () => {
      const first = queue.enqueueUnique("sync", "sync:1", {});
      expect(queue.claimNext()?.id).toBe(first.id);
      expect(queue.enqueueUnique("sync", "sync:1", {})).toEqual({ id: first.id, created: false });
    });

    it("allows a new job once the previous one succeeded or failed", () => {
      const first = queue.enqueueUnique("sync", "sync:1", {});
      queue.claimNext();
      queue.complete(first.id);
      const second = queue.enqueueUnique("sync", "sync:1", {});
      expect(second.created).toBe(true);
      expect(second.id).not.toBe(first.id);
      queue.claimNext();
      queue.fail(second.id, "boom", true);
      expect(queue.enqueueUnique("sync", "sync:1", {}).created).toBe(true);
    });

    it("keeps the key while a failed job waits for its retry", () => {
      const first = queue.enqueueUnique("sync", "sync:1", {});
      queue.claimNext();
      expect(queue.fail(first.id, "boom")).toBe("retry");
      expect(queue.enqueueUnique("sync", "sync:1", {}).created).toBe(false);
    });

    it("stores the payload and honours runAfter and maxAttempts", () => {
      const { id } = queue.enqueueUnique(
        "sync",
        "sync:1",
        { accountId: 1 },
        {
          runAfter: now + 5_000,
          maxAttempts: 1,
        },
      );
      expect(queue.claimNext()).toBeNull();
      now += 5_000;
      expect(queue.claimNext()).toMatchObject({
        id,
        payload: { accountId: 1 },
        maxAttempts: 1,
      });
    });

    it("maps a unique-index violation raised by a racing writer to the existing job", () => {
      // The select misses a row that another writer committed first: the insert must hit the
      // partial unique index and the call must still return that row.
      const winner = queue.enqueueUnique("sync", "sync:9", {});
      const spy = vi.spyOn(queue, "findActive").mockImplementationOnce(() => null);
      expect(queue.enqueueUnique("sync", "sync:9", {})).toEqual({ id: winner.id, created: false });
      expect(spy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
      spy.mockRestore();
    });

    it("works inside an outer transaction", () => {
      const results = t.sqlite.transaction(() => [
        queue.enqueueUnique("sync", "sync:1", {}),
        queue.enqueueUnique("sync", "sync:1", {}),
      ])();
      expect(results.map((r) => r.created)).toEqual([true, false]);
    });

    it("does not dedupe plain enqueue calls", () => {
      expect(queue.enqueue("a", null)).not.toBe(queue.enqueue("a", null));
    });
  });

  describe("findActive, activeKeys and cancelQueued", () => {
    it("finds queued and running jobs only", () => {
      const { id } = queue.enqueueUnique("sync", "sync:1", {});
      expect(queue.findActive("sync:1")).toEqual({ id, status: "queued" });
      queue.claimNext();
      expect(queue.findActive("sync:1")).toEqual({ id, status: "running" });
      queue.complete(id);
      expect(queue.findActive("sync:1")).toBeNull();
      expect(queue.findActive("sync:404")).toBeNull();
    });

    it("lists the active keys that start with a prefix, treating it literally", () => {
      queue.enqueueUnique("sync", "sync:1", {});
      queue.enqueueUnique("sync", "sync:2", {});
      queue.enqueueUnique("email", "email:1", {});
      queue.enqueueUnique("sync", "sync_3", {});
      queue.enqueue("plain", null);
      expect(queue.activeKeys("sync:")).toEqual(new Set(["sync:1", "sync:2"]));
      expect(queue.activeKeys("s%")).toEqual(new Set());
      expect(queue.activeKeys("sync_")).toEqual(new Set(["sync_3"]));
      expect(queue.activeKeys("nothing:")).toEqual(new Set());
      queue.claimNext();
      expect(queue.activeKeys("sync:")).toEqual(new Set(["sync:1", "sync:2"]));
    });

    it("leaves finished jobs out of the active keys", () => {
      const { id } = queue.enqueueUnique("sync", "sync:1", {});
      queue.claimNext();
      queue.complete(id);
      expect(queue.activeKeys("sync:")).toEqual(new Set());
    });

    it("cancels queued jobs but never a running one", () => {
      queue.enqueueUnique("sync", "sync:1", {});
      expect(queue.cancelQueued("sync:1")).toBe(1);
      expect(queue.claimNext()).toBeNull();
      expect(queue.cancelQueued("sync:1")).toBe(0);

      const running = queue.enqueueUnique("sync", "sync:2", {});
      queue.claimNext();
      expect(queue.cancelQueued("sync:2")).toBe(0);
      expect(queue.get(running.id)?.status).toBe("running");
    });
  });

  describe("running guard", () => {
    it("ignores complete and fail for a job that is not running", () => {
      const id = queue.enqueue("a", null);
      queue.complete(id);
      expect(queue.get(id)?.status).toBe("queued");
      expect(queue.fail(id, "late")).toBe("ignored");
      expect(queue.get(id)).toMatchObject({ status: "queued", lastError: null, attempts: 0 });
      expect(queue.fail(9_999, "no such job")).toBe("ignored");
    });

    it("ignores a late result for a job that was recovered", () => {
      const id = queue.enqueue("a", null);
      queue.claimNext();
      queue.recoverStale(0);
      queue.complete(id, 1);
      expect(queue.fail(id, "late", false, 1)).toBe("ignored");
      expect(queue.get(id)).toMatchObject({ status: "queued", lastError: null });
    });

    it("ignores the result of an earlier attempt for a job that was reclaimed", () => {
      const id = queue.enqueue("a", null);
      queue.claimNext();
      queue.recoverStale(0);
      expect(queue.claimNext()).toMatchObject({ id, attempts: 2 });
      queue.complete(id, 1);
      expect(queue.fail(id, "stale handler", true, 1)).toBe("ignored");
      expect(queue.get(id)?.status).toBe("running");
      queue.complete(id, 2);
      expect(queue.get(id)?.status).toBe("succeeded");
    });

    it("does not resurrect a finished job", () => {
      const id = queue.enqueue("a", null);
      queue.claimNext();
      queue.complete(id);
      expect(queue.fail(id, "late")).toBe("ignored");
      expect(queue.get(id)).toMatchObject({ status: "succeeded", lastError: null });
    });

    it("rolls the whole failure back when the update throws", () => {
      const id = queue.enqueue("a", null);
      queue.claimNext();
      t.sqlite.exec(
        "CREATE TRIGGER block_fail BEFORE UPDATE ON jobs WHEN NEW.last_error = 'boom' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'blocked'); END",
      );
      expect(() => queue.fail(id, "boom")).toThrow("blocked");
      expect(t.sqlite.inTransaction).toBe(false);
      expect(queue.get(id)?.status).toBe("running");
    });
  });

  describe("corrupt payloads", () => {
    const insertCorrupt = (payload: string): number =>
      Number(
        t.sqlite
          .prepare(
            `INSERT INTO jobs (type, payload, status, attempts, max_attempts, run_after, created_at, updated_at)
             VALUES ('broken', ?, 'queued', 0, 3, ?, ?, ?)`,
          )
          .run(payload, now - 10, now, now).lastInsertRowid,
      );

    it("fails a job whose payload is not JSON and still claims the next one", () => {
      const corrupt = insertCorrupt("{not json");
      const good = queue.enqueue("ok", { fine: true });
      expect(queue.claimNext()).toMatchObject({ id: good, payload: { fine: true } });
      expect(queue.get(corrupt)).toMatchObject({ status: "failed" });
      expect(queue.get(corrupt)?.lastError).toContain("not valid JSON");
    });

    it("never leaves a corrupt job running", () => {
      const corrupt = insertCorrupt("");
      expect(queue.claimNext()).toBeNull();
      expect(queue.get(corrupt)?.status).toBe("failed");
      expect(queue.recoverStale(0)).toBe(0);
    });

    it("reports the corrupt job to the callback", () => {
      const seen: { id: number; type: string }[] = [];
      const reporting = new JobQueue(
        t.sqlite,
        () => now,
        (job) => seen.push(job),
      );
      const corrupt = insertCorrupt("nope");
      expect(reporting.claimNext()).toBeNull();
      expect(seen).toEqual([{ id: corrupt, type: "broken" }]);
    });
  });

  describe("purgeFinished", () => {
    it("deletes succeeded and failed jobs older than the threshold only", () => {
      const day = 24 * 60 * 60_000;
      const oldDone = queue.enqueue("a", null);
      queue.claimNext();
      queue.complete(oldDone);
      const oldFailed = queue.enqueue("b", null, { maxAttempts: 1 });
      queue.claimNext();
      queue.fail(oldFailed, "boom");
      const oldRunning = queue.enqueue("c", null);
      queue.claimNext();
      const oldQueued = queue.enqueue("d", null, { runAfter: now + 90 * day });
      now += 40 * day;
      const recentDone = queue.enqueue("e", null);
      queue.claimNext();
      queue.complete(recentDone);

      expect(queue.purgeFinished(30 * day)).toBe(2);
      expect(queue.get(oldDone)).toBeNull();
      expect(queue.get(oldFailed)).toBeNull();
      expect(queue.get(recentDone)?.status).toBe("succeeded");
      expect(queue.get(oldRunning)?.status).toBe("running");
      expect(queue.get(oldQueued)?.status).toBe("queued");
      expect(queue.purgeFinished(30 * day)).toBe(0);
    });
  });
});

describe("backoffMs", () => {
  it("grows four times per attempt and caps at one hour", () => {
    expect(backoffMs(1)).toBe(30_000);
    expect(backoffMs(2)).toBe(120_000);
    expect(backoffMs(10)).toBe(3_600_000);
  });
});

```ts
import type { Sqlite } from "../db";

export type JobStatus = "queued" | "running" | "succeeded" | "failed";

export interface JobRecord {
  id: number;
  type: string;
  payload: unknown;
  attempts: number;
  maxAttempts: number;
}

export interface JobState {
  status: JobStatus;
  attempts: number;
  runAfter: number;
  lastError: string | null;
}

interface ClaimedRow {
  id: number;
  type: string;
  payload: string;
  attempts: number;
  max_attempts: number;
}

export interface EnqueueOptions {
  runAfter?: number;
  maxAttempts?: number;
}

export function backoffMs(attempt: number): number {
  return Math.min(30_000 * 4 ** (attempt - 1), 3_600_000);
}

const ACTIVE_STATUSES = "('queued', 'running')";

function isUniqueViolation(error: unknown): boolean {
  return (
    error instanceof Error &&
    "code" in error &&
    typeof error.code === "string" &&
    error.code.startsWith("SQLITE_CONSTRAINT")
  );
}

export class JobQueue {
  /**
   * `onCorruptPayload` is called for a claimed job whose stored payload is not valid JSON; the
   * queue has already failed that job permanently by then.
   */
  constructor(
    private readonly sqlite: Sqlite,
    private readonly now: () => number = Date.now,
    private readonly onCorruptPayload: (job: { id: number; type: string }) => void = () => {},
  ) {}

  enqueue(type: string, payload: unknown, options: EnqueueOptions = {}): number {
    return this.insert(type, null, payload, options);
  }

  /**
   * Enqueues unless a queued or running job already carries `dedupeKey`, in which case that job is
   * returned. A key is free again once its job has succeeded or failed.
   */
  enqueueUnique(
    type: string,
    dedupeKey: string,
    payload: unknown,
    options: EnqueueOptions = {},
  ): { id: number; created: boolean } {
    try {
      return this.sqlite
        .transaction((): { id: number; created: boolean } => {
          const existing = this.findActive(dedupeKey);
          if (existing) return { id: existing.id, created: false };
          return { id: this.insert(type, dedupeKey, payload, options), created: true };
        })
        .immediate();
    } catch (error) {
      // The partial unique index is the safety net for a writer that raced the select.
      if (isUniqueViolation(error)) {
        const existing = this.findActive(dedupeKey);
        if (existing) return { id: existing.id, created: false };
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  findActive(dedupeKey: string): { id: number; status: "queued" | "running" } | null {
    const row = this.sqlite
      .prepare(
        `SELECT id, status FROM jobs
         WHERE dedupe_key = ? AND status IN ${ACTIVE_STATUSES}
         ORDER BY id LIMIT 1`,
      )
      .get(dedupeKey) as { id: number; status: "queued" | "running" } | undefined;
    return row ?? null;
  }

  /** Dedupe keys of every queued or running job whose key starts with `prefix`. */
  activeKeys(prefix: string): Set<string> {
    const rows = this.sqlite
      .prepare(
        `SELECT dedupe_key FROM jobs
         WHERE dedupe_key IS NOT NULL AND substr(dedupe_key, 1, ?) = ?
           AND status IN ${ACTIVE_STATUSES}`,
      )
      .all(prefix.length, prefix) as { dedupe_key: string }[];
    return new Set(rows.map((row) => row.dedupe_key));
  }

  /** Removes queued (not yet running) jobs with this key and returns how many were removed. */
  cancelQueued(dedupeKey: string): number {
    return this.sqlite
      .prepare("DELETE FROM jobs WHERE dedupe_key = ? AND status = 'queued'")
      .run(dedupeKey).changes;
  }

  /** Deletes succeeded and failed jobs last touched more than `olderThanMs` ago. */
  purgeFinished(olderThanMs: number): number {
    return this.sqlite
      .prepare("DELETE FROM jobs WHERE status IN ('succeeded', 'failed') AND updated_at < ?")
      .run(this.now() - olderThanMs).changes;
  }

  claimNext(): JobRecord | null {
    for (;;) {
      const ts = this.now();
      const row = this.sqlite
        .prepare(
          `UPDATE jobs SET status = 'running', attempts = attempts + 1, locked_at = ?, updated_at = ?
           WHERE id = (
             SELECT id FROM jobs WHERE status = 'queued' AND run_after <= ?
             ORDER BY run_after, id LIMIT 1
           )
           RETURNING id, type, payload, attempts, max_attempts`,
        )
        .get(ts, ts, ts) as ClaimedRow | undefined;
      if (!row) return null;
      let payload: unknown;
      try {
        payload = JSON.parse(row.payload);
      } catch {
        // Never strand the job as running: fail it for good and look at the next one.
        this.fail(row.id, "Job payload is not valid JSON", true, row.attempts);
        this.onCorruptPayload({ id: row.id, type: row.type });
        continue;
      }
      return {
        id: row.id,
        type: row.type,
        payload,
        attempts: row.attempts,
        maxAttempts: row.max_attempts,
      };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Marks a running job succeeded. Does nothing when the job is no longer running (for example
   * after `recoverStale` requeued it) or, when `attempt` is given, when it has been claimed again
   * since: a slow handler must not complete somebody else's run.
   */
  complete(id: number, attempt?: number): void {
    this.sqlite
      .prepare(
        `UPDATE jobs SET status = 'succeeded', locked_at = NULL, last_error = NULL, updated_at = ?
         WHERE id = ? AND status = 'running' AND (? IS NULL OR attempts = ?)`,
      )
      .run(this.now(), id, attempt ?? null, attempt ?? null);
  }

  /**
   * Records a failure of a running job in one transaction: requeued with backoff while attempts
   * remain, failed otherwise or when `permanent`. Returns "ignored" (and changes nothing) when the
   * job is not running, or when `attempt` is given and no longer matches.
   */
  fail(
    id: number,
    error: string,
    permanent = false,
    attempt?: number,
  ): "retry" | "failed" | "ignored" {
    return this.sqlite
      .transaction((): "retry" | "failed" | "ignored" => {
        const row = this.sqlite
          .prepare(
            `SELECT attempts, max_attempts FROM jobs
             WHERE id = ? AND status = 'running' AND (? IS NULL OR attempts = ?)`,
          )
          .get(id, attempt ?? null, attempt ?? null) as
          | { attempts: number; max_attempts: number }
          | undefined;
        if (!row) return "ignored";
        const ts = this.now();
        if (!permanent && row.attempts < row.max_attempts) {
          this.sqlite
            .prepare(
              `UPDATE jobs SET status = 'queued', locked_at = NULL, last_error = ?, run_after = ?, updated_at = ?
               WHERE id = ?`,
            )
            .run(error, ts + backoffMs(row.attempts), ts, id);
          return "retry";
        }
        this.sqlite
          .prepare(
            `UPDATE jobs SET status = 'failed', locked_at = NULL, last_error = ?, updated_at = ?
             WHERE id = ?`,
          )
          .run(error, ts, id);
        return "failed";
      })
      .immediate();
  }

  /**
   * Requeues (or fails, once attempts are exhausted) running jobs locked `olderThanMs` ago or more.
   * `recoverStale(0)` recovers every running job: at boot nothing can still be running.
   */
  recoverStale(olderThanMs: number): number {
    const ts = this.now();
    const cutoff = ts - olderThanMs;
    return this.sqlite.transaction(() => {
      const exhausted = this.sqlite
        .prepare(
          `UPDATE jobs SET status = 'failed', locked_at = NULL, updated_at = ?,
             last_error = 'Interrupted while running; attempts exhausted'
           WHERE status = 'running' AND locked_at <= ? AND attempts >= max_attempts`,
        )
        .run(ts, cutoff);
      const requeued = this.sqlite
        .prepare(
          `UPDATE jobs SET status = 'queued', locked_at = NULL, updated_at = ?
           WHERE status = 'running' AND locked_at <= ? AND attempts < max_attempts`,
        )
        .run(ts, cutoff);
      return exhausted.changes + requeued.changes;
    })();
  }

  get(id: number): JobState | null {
    const row = this.sqlite
      .prepare("SELECT status, attempts, run_after, last_error FROM jobs WHERE id = ?")
      .get(id) as
      | { status: JobStatus; attempts: number; run_after: number; last_error: string | null }
      | undefined;
    if (!row) return null;
    return {
      status: row.status,
      attempts: row.attempts,
      runAfter: row.run_after,
      lastError: row.last_error,
    };
  }

  private insert(
    type: string,
    dedupeKey: string | null,
    payload: unknown,
    options: EnqueueOptions,
  ): number {
    const ts = this.now();
    const result = this.sqlite
      .prepare(
        `INSERT INTO jobs (type, payload, status, attempts, max_attempts, run_after, dedupe_key, created_at, updated_at)
         VALUES (?, ?, 'queued', 0, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
      )
      .run(
        type,
        JSON.stringify(payload ?? null),
        options.maxAttempts ?? 3,
        options.runAfter ?? ts,
        dedupeKey,
        ts,
        ts,
      );
    return Number(result.lastInsertRowid);
  }
}

```ts
import { Writable } from "node:stream";
import { pino } from "pino";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { createTestDatabase, type TestDatabase } from "../test/db";
import { JobQueue } from "./queue";
import { type JobHandler, JobWorker, PermanentJobError } from "./worker";

const logger = pino({ level: "silent" });

describe("JobWorker", () => {
  let t: TestDatabase;
  let queue: JobQueue;
  let started: JobWorker[];

  /** Starts a polling worker that afterEach stops, even when the test fails. */
  const startWorker = (handlers: ReadonlyMap<string, JobHandler>): JobWorker => {
    const worker = new JobWorker(queue, handlers, logger, 10);
    started.push(worker);
    worker.start();
    return worker;
  };

  beforeEach(() => {
    t = createTestDatabase();
    queue = new JobQueue(t.sqlite);
    started = [];
  });
  afterEach(async () => {
    // Stop polling before the database goes away.
    for (const worker of started) await worker.stop();
    t.dispose();
  });

  it("runs the handler and completes the job", async () => {
    const seen: unknown[] = [];
    const handlers = new Map<string, JobHandler>([
      [
        "echo",
        async (job) => {
          seen.push(job.payload);
        },
      ],
    ]);
    const worker = new JobWorker(queue, handlers, logger);
    const id = queue.enqueue("echo", { hello: "world" });
    expect(await worker.runOnce()).toBe(true);
    expect(seen).toEqual([{ hello: "world" }]);
    expect(queue.get(id)?.status).toBe("succeeded");
    expect(await worker.runOnce()).toBe(false);
  });

  it("records handler errors for a retry", async () => {
    const handlers = new Map<string, JobHandler>([
      [
        "boom",
        async () => {
          throw new Error("exploded");
        },
      ],
    ]);
    const worker = new JobWorker(queue, handlers, logger);
    const id = queue.enqueue("boom", null);
    await worker.runOnce();
    expect(queue.get(id)).toMatchObject({ status: "queued", lastError: "exploded" });
  });

  it("fails jobs without a handler permanently", async () => {
    const worker = new JobWorker(queue, new Map(), logger);
    const id = queue.enqueue("unknown", null);
    await worker.runOnce();
    expect(queue.get(id)).toMatchObject({ status: "failed" });
    expect(queue.get(id)?.lastError).toContain("unknown");
  });

  it("fails a job for good when the handler throws PermanentJobError", async () => {
    const handlers = new Map<string, JobHandler>([
      [
        "bad",
        async () => {
          throw new PermanentJobError("payload is wrong");
        },
      ],
    ]);
    const worker = new JobWorker(queue, handlers, logger);
    const id = queue.enqueue("bad", null);
    await worker.runOnce();
    expect(queue.get(id)).toMatchObject({
      status: "failed",
      attempts: 1,
      lastError: "payload is wrong",
    });
    expect(await worker.runOnce()).toBe(false);
  });

  it("keeps retrying ordinary errors until the attempts run out", async () => {
    let now = 1_000_000;
    const clocked = new JobQueue(t.sqlite, () => now);
    const handlers = new Map<string, JobHandler>([
      [
        "flaky",
        async () => {
          throw new Error("temporary");
        },
      ],
    ]);
    const worker = new JobWorker(clocked, handlers, logger);
    const id = clocked.enqueue("flaky", null, { maxAttempts: 2 });
    await worker.runOnce();
    expect(clocked.get(id)?.status).toBe("queued");
    now += 3_600_000;
    await worker.runOnce();
    expect(clocked.get(id)).toMatchObject({
      status: "failed",
      attempts: 2,
      lastError: "temporary",
    });
  });

  it("does not let a recovered job be completed or failed by its old handler", async () => {
    let release: () => void = () => {};
    const gate = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      release = resolve;
    });
    const handlers = new Map<string, JobHandler>([["slow", () => gate]]);
    const worker = new JobWorker(queue, handlers, logger);
    const id = queue.enqueue("slow", null);
    const running = worker.runOnce();
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(queue.get(id)?.status).toBe("running"));
    expect(queue.recoverStale(0)).toBe(1);
    expect(queue.claimNext()).toMatchObject({ id, attempts: 2 });
    release();
    await running;
    // The first run finished, but the job now belongs to the second claim.
    expect(queue.get(id)).toMatchObject({ status: "running", attempts: 2 });
  });

  it("logs the stack of a failing handler and flags the final failure as an error", async () => {
    const lines: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
    const capturing = pino(
      { level: "info" },
      new Writable({
        write(chunk, _encoding, callback) {
          lines.push(JSON.parse(chunk.toString()));
          callback();
        },
      }),
    );
    const handlers = new Map<string, JobHandler>([
      [
        "boom",
        async () => {
          throw new Error("exploded");
        },
      ],
    ]);
    const worker = new JobWorker(queue, handlers, capturing);
    queue.enqueue("boom", null, { maxAttempts: 1 });
    await worker.runOnce();
    expect(lines).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(lines[0]).toMatchObject({
      level: 50,
      msg: "Job failed for good",
      type: "boom",
      attempt: 1,
      outcome: "failed",
      permanent: false,
      error: "exploded",
    });
    expect(String(lines[0]?.stack)).toContain("worker.test.ts");
  });

  it("logs a retry as a warning", async () => {
    const lines: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
    const capturing = pino(
      { level: "info" },
      new Writable({
        write(chunk, _encoding, callback) {
          lines.push(JSON.parse(chunk.toString()));
          callback();
        },
      }),
    );
    const handlers = new Map<string, JobHandler>([
      [
        "boom",
        async () => {
          throw new Error("exploded");
        },
      ],
    ]);
    const worker = new JobWorker(queue, handlers, capturing);
    queue.enqueue("boom", null);
    await worker.runOnce();
    expect(lines[0]).toMatchObject({ level: 40, msg: "Job failed", outcome: "retry" });
  });

  it("drains the queue after start and stops cleanly", async () => {
    let count = 0;
    const handlers = new Map<string, JobHandler>([
      [
        "count",
        async () => {
          count += 1;
        },
      ],
    ]);
    queue.enqueue("count", null);
    queue.enqueue("count", null);
    const worker = startWorker(handlers);
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(count).toBe(2));
    await worker.stop();
  });

  it("survives queue errors during drain without an unhandled rejection", async () => {
    const claim = vi.spyOn(queue, "claimNext").mockImplementationOnce(() => {
      throw new Error("db locked");
    });
    const unhandled = vi.fn();
    process.on("unhandledRejection", unhandled);
    try {
      const id = queue.enqueue("ok", null);
      const worker = startWorker(new Map([["ok", async () => {}]]));
      await vi.waitFor(() => expect(queue.get(id)?.status).toBe("succeeded"));
      expect(claim).toHaveBeenCalled();
      await expect(worker.stop()).resolves.toBeUndefined();
      await new Promise((resolve) => setImmediate(resolve));
    } finally {
      process.off("unhandledRejection", unhandled);
    }
    expect(unhandled).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

```ts
import type { Logger } from "pino";
import type { JobQueue, JobRecord } from "./queue";

export type JobHandler = (job: JobRecord) => Promise<void>;

/**
 * Thrown by a handler (or by `parsePayload`) when retrying cannot help: the job is failed at once
 * and its message becomes the job's `last_error`, so keep it free of secrets and personal data.
 */
export class PermanentJobError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string, options?: ErrorOptions) {
    super(message, options);
    this.name = "PermanentJobError";
  }
}

export class JobWorker {
  private timer: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;
  private draining: Promise<void> | null = null;
  private stopped = true;

  constructor(
    private readonly queue: JobQueue,
    private readonly handlers: ReadonlyMap<string, JobHandler>,
    private readonly logger: Logger,
    private readonly pollMs = 1_000,
  ) {}

  async runOnce(): Promise<boolean> {
    const job = this.queue.claimNext();
    if (!job) return false;
    const handler = this.handlers.get(job.type);
    if (!handler) {
      this.queue.fail(
        job.id,
        `No handler registered for job type "${job.type}"`,
        true,
        job.attempts,
      );
      this.logger.error({ jobId: job.id, type: job.type }, "Job has no handler");
      return true;
    }
    try {
      await handler(job);
      this.queue.complete(job.id, job.attempts);
    } catch (error) {
      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
      const permanent = error instanceof PermanentJobError;
      const outcome = this.queue.fail(job.id, message, permanent, job.attempts);
      const fields = {
        jobId: job.id,
        type: job.type,
        attempt: job.attempts,
        outcome,
        permanent,
        error: message,
        stack: error instanceof Error ? error.stack : undefined,
      };
      if (outcome === "failed") this.logger.error(fields, "Job failed for good");
      else this.logger.warn(fields, "Job failed");
    }
    return true;
  }

  start(): void {
    if (!this.stopped) return;
    this.stopped = false;
    this.schedule(0);
  }

  async stop(): Promise<void> {
    this.stopped = true;
    if (this.timer) clearTimeout(this.timer);
    this.timer = null;
    await this.draining;
  }

  private schedule(delayMs: number): void {
    this.timer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.draining = this.drain().finally(() => {
        this.draining = null;
        if (!this.stopped) this.schedule(this.pollMs);
      });
    }, delayMs);
  }

  private async drain(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      while (!this.stopped) {
        const ran = await this.runOnce();
        if (!ran) break;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      // Queue/database errors outside the handler: log and retry on the next poll.
      this.logger.error(
        { error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) },
        "Job worker drain failed",
      );
    }
  }
}
```

import { syncTriggerSchema } from "@bursar/shared";
import { z } from "zod";
import type { JobRecord } from "./queue";
import { PermanentJobError } from "./worker";

/** Synchronises one bank account (Task 13). */
export const SYNC_ACCOUNT_JOB = "bank.sync-account";
export const syncAccountPayloadSchema = z.object({
  accountId: z.number().int().positive(),
  trigger: syncTriggerSchema,
  psu: z
    .object({
      ipAddress: z.string(),
      userAgent: z.string(),
      accept: z.string().optional(),
      acceptLanguage: z.string().optional(),
    })
    .optional(),
});
export type SyncAccountPayload = z.infer<typeof syncAccountPayloadSchema>;
export const syncDedupeKey = (accountId: number): string => `sync:${accountId}`;

/** Sends the e-mail of one stored notification (Task 9). */
export const EMAIL_JOB = "notify.email";
export const emailPayloadSchema = z.object({ notificationId: z.number().int().positive() });
export type EmailPayload = z.infer<typeof emailPayloadSchema>;
export const emailDedupeKey = (notificationId: number): string => `email:${notificationId}`;

/** Creates an encrypted backup set (Task 15). */
export const BACKUP_JOB = "backup.run";
export const backupPayloadSchema = z.object({ trigger: z.enum(["scheduled", "manual"]) });
export type BackupPayload = z.infer<typeof backupPayloadSchema>;
export const BACKUP_DEDUPE_KEY = "backup";

/** Deletes an Enable Banking session at the provider after a local disconnect (Task 14). */
export const DELETE_SESSION_JOB = "bank.delete-session";
export const deleteSessionPayloadSchema = z.object({ providerSessionId: z.string().min(1) });
export type DeleteSessionPayload = z.infer<typeof deleteSessionPayloadSchema>;

/**
 * Validates a claimed job's payload. An invalid payload never becomes valid by retrying, so it
 * throws {@link PermanentJobError}. The message lists field paths and rules only, never values:
 * payloads can carry provider session ids and client addresses.
 */
export function parsePayload<T>(schema: z.ZodType<T>, job: JobRecord): T {
  const result = schema.safeParse(job.payload);
  if (result.success) return result.data;
  const problems = result.error.issues
    .map((issue) => `${issue.path.join(".") || "(root)"}: ${issue.message}`)
    .join("; ");
  throw new PermanentJobError(`Invalid payload for job "${job.type}" (#${job.id}): ${problems}`);
}
```

import type { ServerEvent } from "@bursar/shared";
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { EventBus } from "./bus";

const event: ServerEvent = { type: "sync.progress", accountId: 1, fetched: 10 };

describe("EventBus", () => {
  it("delivers an event to every subscriber in subscription order", () => {
    const bus = new EventBus();
    const seen: string[] = [];
    bus.subscribe((e) => seen.push(`a:${e.type}`));
    bus.subscribe((e) => seen.push(`b:${e.type}`));
    bus.publish(event);
    expect(seen).toEqual(["a:sync.progress", "b:sync.progress"]);
    expect(bus.listenerCount()).toBe(2);
  });

  it("stops delivering after unsubscribe, which is safe to call twice", () => {
    const bus = new EventBus();
    const listener = vi.fn();
    const unsubscribe = bus.subscribe(listener);
    unsubscribe();
    unsubscribe();
    bus.publish(event);
    expect(listener).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(bus.listenerCount()).toBe(0);
  });

  it("keeps notifying the others when a listener throws, and reports the error", () => {
    const onError = vi.fn();
    const bus = new EventBus(onError);
    const after = vi.fn();
    bus.subscribe(() => {
      throw new Error("listener bug");
    });
    bus.subscribe(after);
    expect(() => bus.publish(event)).not.toThrow();
    expect(after).toHaveBeenCalledWith(event);
    expect(onError).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(onError).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ message: "listener bug" }));
  });

  it("survives a listener that unsubscribes while being notified", () => {
    const bus = new EventBus();
    const second = vi.fn();
    const unsubscribeFirst = bus.subscribe(() => unsubscribeFirst());
    bus.subscribe(second);
    bus.publish(event);
    expect(second).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(bus.listenerCount()).toBe(1);
  });

  it("treats the same function subscribed twice as two subscriptions", () => {
    const bus = new EventBus();
    const listener = vi.fn();
    const first = bus.subscribe(listener);
    bus.subscribe(listener);
    first();
    bus.publish(event);
    expect(listener).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it("has no listeners initially and ignores publishing to nobody", () => {
    const bus = new EventBus();
    expect(bus.listenerCount()).toBe(0);
    expect(() => bus.publish(event)).not.toThrow();
  });
});

import { Writable } from "node:stream";
import { pino } from "pino";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { FailureLimiter } from "./auth/rate-limit";
import { SESSION_IDLE_MS, SessionStore } from "./auth/sessions";
import { JobQueue } from "./jobs/queue";
import { maintenanceTask } from "./maintenance";
import { createTestDatabase, type TestDatabase } from "./test/db";

const silent = pino({ level: "silent" });

describe("maintenanceTask", () => {
  let t: TestDatabase;
  let now: number;
  let queue: JobQueue;
  let sessions: SessionStore;

  beforeEach(() => {
    t = createTestDatabase();
    now = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 9);
    queue = new JobQueue(t.sqlite, () => now);
    sessions = new SessionStore(t.db, () => now);
  });
  afterEach(() => t.dispose());

  function capture() {
    const lines: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
    const logger = pino(
      { level: "info" },
      new Writable({
        write(chunk, _encoding, callback) {
          lines.push(JSON.parse(chunk.toString()));
          callback();
        },
      }),
    );
    return { lines, logger };
  }

  it("leaves a long-running job alone and purges expired sessions", async () => {
    const id = queue.enqueue("x", null);
    queue.claimNext();
    const token = sessions.create(null);
    now += SESSION_IDLE_MS + 1;
    await maintenanceTask({ queue, sessions, limiters: [], logger: silent }).run(new Date(now));
    // The worker of this process may still be running it: it is neither requeued nor failed, and
    // its handler completes it exactly once.
    expect(queue.get(id)?.status).toBe("running");
    queue.complete(id);
    expect(queue.get(id)?.status).toBe("succeeded");
    expect(sessions.validate(token)).toBeNull();
    expect(sessions.purgeExpired()).toBe(0);
  });

  it("sweeps every limiter and purges finished jobs older than 30 days", async () => {
    const day = 24 * 60 * 60_000;
    const first = new FailureLimiter(1, 1_000, () => now);
    const second = new FailureLimiter(1, 1_000, () => now);
    first.recordFailure("a");
    second.recordFailure("b");
    second.recordFailure("c");
    const done = queue.enqueue("x", null);
    queue.claimNext();
    queue.complete(done);
    const recent = queue.enqueue("y", null);
    queue.claimNext();
    now += 31 * day;
    queue.complete(recent);
    const { lines, logger } = capture();
    await maintenanceTask({ queue, sessions, limiters: [first, second], logger }).run(
      new Date(now),
    );
    expect(queue.get(done)).toBeNull();
    expect(queue.get(recent)?.status).toBe("succeeded");
    expect(first.sweep() + second.sweep()).toBe(0);
    expect(lines).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(lines[0]).toMatchObject({
      msg: "Maintenance done",
      limiterEntriesSwept: 3,
      finishedJobsPurged: 1,
    });
  });

  it("runs each cleanup, logs its count and survives a cleanup that throws", async () => {
    const { lines, logger } = capture();
    const ran: string[] = [];
    await maintenanceTask({
      queue,
      sessions,
      limiters: [],
      logger,
      cleanups: [
        {
          name: "brokenCleanup",
          run: () => {
            ran.push("brokenCleanup");
            throw new Error("disk full");
          },
        },
        {
          name: "expiredAuthRequests",
          run: () => {
            ran.push("expiredAuthRequests");
            return 4;
          },
        },
      ],
    }).run(new Date(now));
    expect(ran).toEqual(["brokenCleanup", "expiredAuthRequests"]);
    expect(lines).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(lines[0]).toMatchObject({
      msg: "Maintenance cleanup failed",
      cleanup: "brokenCleanup",
      error: "disk full",
    });
    expect(lines[1]).toMatchObject({ msg: "Maintenance done", expiredAuthRequests: 4 });
  });

  it("logs nothing when there was nothing to do", async () => {
    const { lines, logger } = capture();
    await maintenanceTask({

      sessions,
      limiters: [new FailureLimiter()],

  });

  it("is named maintenance", () => {
    expect(maintenanceTask({ queue, sessions, limiters: [], logger: silent }).name).toBe(
      "maintenance",
    );
  });
});

Create `apps/server/src/events/bus.ts`:

```ts
import type { ServerEvent } from "@bursar/shared";

type Listener = (event: ServerEvent) => void;

/** In-process publish/subscribe for the events the panel receives over SSE. */
export class EventBus {
  private readonly listeners = new Set<Listener>();

  /** `onListenerError` is told about a listener that threw; the other listeners still run. */
  constructor(private readonly onListenerError: (error: unknown) => void = () => {}) {}

  publish(event: ServerEvent): void {
    // Iterate a copy: a listener may unsubscribe itself (or another) while being notified.
    for (const listener of [...this.listeners]) {
      try {
        listener(event);
      } catch (error) {
        this.onListenerError(error);
      }
    }
  }

  /** Registers a listener and returns the function that removes it (safe to call twice). */
  subscribe(listener: Listener): () => void {
    // A fresh wrapper per subscription, so subscribing the same function twice stays independent.
    const entry: Listener = (event) => listener(event);
    this.listeners.add(entry);
    return () => {
      this.listeners.delete(entry);
    };
  }

  listenerCount(): number {
    return this.listeners.size;
  }
}
```

```ts
  /** Removes every window that has expired and returns how many were removed. */
  sweep(): number {
    let removed = 0;
    for (const [key, entry] of this.failures) {
      if (this.now() - entry.startedAt >= this.windowMs) {
        this.failures.delete(key);
        removed += 1;
      }
    }
    return removed;
  }

  /**
   * Starts a window for a new key. Past `maxEntries` the oldest window is dropped (a Map iterates
   * in insertion order and a window is only inserted when it starts), so a flood of distinct keys
   * cannot grow memory without bound.
   */
  private insert(key: string): void {
    if (this.failures.size >= this.maxEntries) {
      const oldest = this.failures.keys().next();
      if (!oldest.done) this.failures.delete(oldest.value);
    }
    this.failures.set(key, { count: 1, startedAt: this.now() });
  }

Replace the whole of `apps/server/src/maintenance.ts`:

```ts
import type { Logger } from "pino";
import type { FailureLimiter } from "./auth/rate-limit";
import type { SessionStore } from "./auth/sessions";
import type { JobQueue } from "./jobs/queue";
import type { ScheduledTask } from "./scheduler";

export const FINISHED_JOB_RETENTION_MS = 30 * 24 * 60 * 60_000;

export interface MaintenanceDeps {
  queue: JobQueue;
  sessions: SessionStore;
  limiters: readonly FailureLimiter[];
  logger: Logger;
  /** Extra housekeeping from later features; `run` returns how many rows or entries it removed. */
  cleanups?: ReadonlyArray<{ name: string; run(): number }>;
}

export function maintenanceTask(deps: MaintenanceDeps): ScheduledTask {
  const { queue, sessions, limiters, logger, cleanups = [] } = deps;
  return {
    name: "maintenance",
    run: () => {
      // No `queue.recoverStale` here: a running job may be in flight in this very process (a long
      // sync or a backup upload). Boot-time `recoverStale(0)` in server.ts handles crashes.
      const counts: Record<string, number> = {
        sessionsPurged: sessions.purgeExpired(),
        limiterEntriesSwept: limiters.reduce((total, limiter) => total + limiter.sweep(), 0),
        finishedJobsPurged: queue.purgeFinished(FINISHED_JOB_RETENTION_MS),
      };
      for (const cleanup of cleanups) {
        try {
          counts[cleanup.name] = cleanup.run();
        } catch (error) {
          // One failing cleanup must not stop the others (or the next tick).
          logger.warn(
            {
              cleanup: cleanup.name,
              error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
            },
            "Maintenance cleanup failed",
          );
        }
      }
      if (Object.values(counts).some((count) => count > 0)) {
        logger.info(counts, "Maintenance done");
      }
    },
  };
}
```

import type { ServerEvent } from "@bursar/shared";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { SESSION_IDLE_MS, SessionStore } from "../auth/sessions";
import { EventBus } from "../events/bus";
import { createTestApp, type TestApp } from "../test/app";
import { createTestDatabase, type TestDatabase } from "../test/db";
import { type EventsRouteDeps, eventsRoute } from "./events";

const withTimeout = <T>(promise: Promise<T>, ms: number, what: string): Promise<T> =>
  Promise.race([
    promise,
    new Promise<never>((_, reject) =>
      setTimeout(() => reject(new Error(`Timed out after ${ms} ms ${what}`)), ms),
    ),
  ]);

/** Reads a streaming response incrementally and remembers everything received. */
function collect(response: Response) {
  if (!response.body) throw new Error("response has no body");
  const reader = response.body.getReader();
  const decoder = new TextDecoder();
  let text = "";
  return {
    get text() {
      return text;
    },
    async until(needle: string, timeoutMs = 2_000): Promise<void> {
      const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
      while (!text.includes(needle)) {
        const chunk = await withTimeout(
          reader.read(),
          Math.max(1, deadline - Date.now()),
          `waiting for ${needle}`,
        );
        if (chunk.done) throw new Error(`Stream ended before ${needle}; received ${text}`);
        text += decoder.decode(chunk.value, { stream: true });
      }
    },
    async ended(timeoutMs = 2_000): Promise<boolean> {
      const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
      for (;;) {
        const chunk = await withTimeout(
          reader.read(),
          Math.max(1, deadline - Date.now()),
          "waiting for the stream to end",
        );
        if (chunk.done) return true;
        text += decoder.decode(chunk.value, { stream: true });
      }
    },
    cancel: () => reader.cancel(),
  };
}

const progress = (fetched: number): ServerEvent => ({
  type: "sync.progress",
  accountId: 1,
  fetched,
});

describe("eventsRoute", () => {
  let t: TestDatabase;
  let now: number;
  let bus: EventBus;
  let ta: TestApp;
  let streams: ReturnType<typeof collect>[];

  async function setup(options: Partial<EventsRouteDeps> = {}) {
    const sessions = new SessionStore(t.db, () => now);
    ta = await createTestApp({
      database: t,
      now: () => now,
      routers: [
        {
          prefix: "/api/events",
          router: eventsRoute({ bus, sessions, heartbeatMs: 25, ...options }),
        },
      ],
    });
  }

  async function open(init: RequestInit = {}) {
    const response = await ta.app.request("/api/events", {
      ...init,
      headers: { cookie: ta.cookie, ...(init.headers as Record<string, string> | undefined) },
    });
    return response;
  }

  async function connect() {
    const stream = collect(await open());
    streams.push(stream);
    await stream.until("event: ready\ndata: {}\n\n");
    return stream;
  }

  beforeEach(() => {
    t = createTestDatabase();
    now = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 9, 9, 0, 0);
    bus = new EventBus();
    streams = [];
  });
  afterEach(async () => {
    for (const stream of streams) await stream.cancel().catch(() => {});
    t.dispose();
  });

  it("rejects a request without a session", async () => {
    await setup();
    const res = await ta.app.request("/api/events");
    expect(res.status).toBe(401);
    expect(bus.listenerCount()).toBe(0);
  });

  it("opens an event stream with the headers a proxy needs and sends ready first", async () => {
    await setup({ heartbeatMs: 60_000 });
    const res = await open();
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.headers.get("content-type")).toContain("text/event-stream");
    expect(res.headers.get("cache-control")).toBe("no-cache, no-transform");
    expect(res.headers.get("x-accel-buffering")).toBe("no");
    const stream = collect(res);
    streams.push(stream);
    await stream.until("event: ready\ndata: {}\n\n");
    expect(stream.text.startsWith("event: ready")).toBe(true);
  });

  it("forwards published events as named SSE events", async () => {
    await setup({ heartbeatMs: 60_000 });
    const stream = await connect();
    bus.publish(progress(40));
    bus.publish({ type: "settings.updated" });
    await stream.until("event: settings.updated\n");
    expect(stream.text).toContain(
      'event: sync.progress\ndata: {"type":"sync.progress","accountId":1,"fetched":40}\n\n',
    );
    expect(stream.text).toContain('event: settings.updated\ndata: {"type":"settings.updated"}\n\n');
  });

  it("sends a ping comment every heartbeat", async () => {
    await setup({ heartbeatMs: 20 });
    const stream = await connect();
    await stream.until(": ping\n\n: ping\n\n");
  });

  it("closes the stream at the next heartbeat once the session is revoked", async () => {
    await setup({ heartbeatMs: 20 });
    const stream = await connect();
    expect(bus.listenerCount()).toBe(1);
    ta.sessions.revoke(ta.cookie.slice("bursar_session=".length));
    await expect(stream.ended()).resolves.toBe(true);
    expect(bus.listenerCount()).toBe(0);
  });

  it("closes the stream when the session has expired", async () => {
    await setup({ heartbeatMs: 20 });
    const stream = await connect();
    now += SESSION_IDLE_MS + 1;
    await expect(stream.ended()).resolves.toBe(true);
    expect(bus.listenerCount()).toBe(0);
  });

  it("does not extend the session while pinging", async () => {
    await setup({ heartbeatMs: 20 });
    const stream = await connect();
    now += SESSION_IDLE_MS - 1_000;
    await stream.until(": ping\n\n: ping\n\n");
    now += 2_000;
    await expect(stream.ended()).resolves.toBe(true);
  });

  it("closes the oldest stream when more than maxStreams are open", async () => {
    await setup({ heartbeatMs: 60_000, maxStreams: 2 });
    const first = await connect();
    const second = await connect();
    expect(bus.listenerCount()).toBe(2);
    const third = await connect();
    await expect(first.ended()).resolves.toBe(true);
    expect(bus.listenerCount()).toBe(2);
    bus.publish(progress(1));
    await second.until("event: sync.progress");
    await third.until("event: sync.progress");
  });

  it("unsubscribes when the client cancels the stream", async () => {
    await setup({ heartbeatMs: 60_000 });
    const stream = await connect();
    expect(bus.listenerCount()).toBe(1);
    await stream.cancel();
    expect(bus.listenerCount()).toBe(0);
  });

  it("unsubscribes when the request is aborted", async () => {
    await setup({ heartbeatMs: 60_000 });
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const stream = collect(await open({ signal: controller.signal }));
    streams.push(stream);
    await stream.until("event: ready");
    expect(bus.listenerCount()).toBe(1);
    controller.abort();
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(bus.listenerCount()).toBe(0));
  });

  it("closes every stream on shutdown and refuses new ones", async () => {
    const shutdown = new AbortController();
    await setup({ heartbeatMs: 60_000, signal: shutdown.signal });
    const first = await connect();
    const second = await connect();
    shutdown.abort();
    await expect(first.ended()).resolves.toBe(true);
    await expect(second.ended()).resolves.toBe(true);
    expect(bus.listenerCount()).toBe(0);
    expect((await open()).status).toBe(503);
  });

  it("keeps serving other streams when one listener write fails", async () => {
    await setup({ heartbeatMs: 60_000 });
    const first = await connect();
    const second = await connect();
    await first.cancel();
    bus.publish(progress(2));
    await second.until("event: sync.progress");
    expect(bus.listenerCount()).toBe(1);
  });
});

Create `apps/server/src/http/events.ts`:

```ts
import type { ServerEvent } from "@bursar/shared";
import { Hono } from "hono";
import { getCookie } from "hono/cookie";
import { SESSION_COOKIE } from "../auth/routes";
import type { SessionStore } from "../auth/sessions";
import type { EventBus } from "../events/bus";
import type { AppEnv } from "./app";

export const EVENTS_HEARTBEAT_MS = 25_000;
export const EVENTS_MAX_STREAMS = 10;

export interface EventsRouteDeps {
  bus: EventBus;
  sessions: SessionStore;
  heartbeatMs?: number;
  maxStreams?: number;
  /** Aborting it closes every open stream, so a graceful shutdown does not wait for the panel. */
  signal?: AbortSignal;
}

interface OpenStream {
  close(): void;
}

/**
 * GET / (mounted at /api/events behind `requireSession`): a server-sent events stream of bus
 * events. `: ping` comments keep proxies from idling the connection out, and every ping first
 * checks that the session still exists (without extending it) so a logout ends the stream.
 */
export function eventsRoute(deps: EventsRouteDeps): Hono<AppEnv> {
  const heartbeatMs = deps.heartbeatMs ?? EVENTS_HEARTBEAT_MS;
  const maxStreams = deps.maxStreams ?? EVENTS_MAX_STREAMS;
  const encoder = new TextEncoder();
  // A Set iterates in insertion order, so the first member is the oldest stream.
  const open = new Set<OpenStream>();
  const routes = new Hono<AppEnv>();

  routes.get("/", (c) => {
    const token = getCookie(c, SESSION_COOKIE);
    if (!token) return c.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
    if (deps.signal?.aborted) return c.json({ error: "Shutting down" }, 503);
    const requestSignal = c.req.raw.signal;

    let teardown = (): void => {};
    const body = new ReadableStream<Uint8Array>({
      start(controller) {
        let closed = false;
        const handle: OpenStream = { close };
        const timer = setInterval(() => {
          if (deps.sessions.peek(token) === null) close();
          else send(": ping\n\n");
        }, heartbeatMs);
        const unsubscribe = deps.bus.subscribe((event: ServerEvent) =>
          send(`event: ${event.type}\ndata: ${JSON.stringify(event)}\n\n`),
        );

        function send(chunk: string): void {
          if (closed) return;
          try {
            controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(chunk));
          } catch {
            // The consumer went away without telling us.
            close();
          }
        }

        function close(): void {
          if (closed) return;
          closed = true;
          clearInterval(timer);
          unsubscribe();
          open.delete(handle);
          requestSignal.removeEventListener("abort", close);
          deps.signal?.removeEventListener("abort", close);
          try {
            controller.close();
          } catch {
            // Already closed or cancelled.
          }
        }

        teardown = close;
        while (open.size >= maxStreams) {
          const oldest = open.values().next();
          if (oldest.done) break;
          oldest.value.close();
        }
        open.add(handle);
        requestSignal.addEventListener("abort", close);
        deps.signal?.addEventListener("abort", close);
        send("event: ready\ndata: {}\n\n");
      },
      cancel() {
        teardown();
      },
    });

    return new Response(body, {
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "text/event-stream; charset=utf-8",
        "Cache-Control": "no-cache, no-transform",
        "X-Accel-Buffering": "no",
      },
    });
  });

  return routes;
}
```

```ts
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import type { SetupStartResponse } from "@bursar/shared";
import type { Hono } from "hono";
import { pino } from "pino";
import { OwnerStore } from "../auth/owner";
import { FailureLimiter } from "../auth/rate-limit";
import { SESSION_COOKIE } from "../auth/routes";
import { SessionStore } from "../auth/sessions";
import { SetupCode } from "../auth/setup-code";
import { generateTotpCode } from "../auth/totp";
import { type AppEnv, createApp, type MountedRouter } from "../http/app";
import type { TestDatabase } from "./db";

export const TEST_ORIGIN = "https://bursar.example.test";
export const TEST_PASSWORD = "correct horse battery staple";

export interface TestApp {
  app: Hono<AppEnv>;
  /** `bursar_session=<token>` of an authenticated owner session. */
  cookie: string;
  origin: string;
  sessions: SessionStore;
  /** Sends a request as the signed-in owner and parses a JSON (or empty) response body. */
  json(
    path: string,
    init?: { method?: string; body?: unknown },
  ): Promise<{ status: number; body: unknown; headers: Headers }>;
}

export interface CreateTestAppOptions {
  database: TestDatabase;
  routers?: MountedRouter[];
  publicRouters?: MountedRouter[];
  now?: () => number;
}

/**
 * Builds the real application (real auth stores over `database`), completes owner setup through
 * the API and returns the session cookie, so a route test starts already signed in.
 */
export async function createTestApp(options: CreateTestAppOptions): Promise<TestApp> {
  const { database } = options;
  const now = options.now ?? Date.now;
  const sessions = new SessionStore(database.db, now);
  const setupCodeFile = path.join(database.dir, "setup-code");
  const setupCode = new SetupCode(setupCodeFile);
  setupCode.issue();
  const app = createApp({
    config: { publicUrl: new URL(TEST_ORIGIN), cfAccess: null, webDistDir: null },
    logger: pino({ level: "silent" }),
    healthCheck: () => true,
    auth: {
      owners: new OwnerStore(database.db, Buffer.alloc(32, 1)),
      sessions,
      setupCode,
      limiter: new FailureLimiter(5, 15 * 60_000, now),
      accountLimiter: new FailureLimiter(20, 15 * 60_000, now),
      secureCookies: true,
      now,
      getClientIp: () => "203.0.113.7",
    },
    routers: options.routers,
    publicRouters: options.publicRouters,
  });

  const post = (route: string, body: unknown) =>
    app.request(route, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { origin: TEST_ORIGIN, "content-type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
    });
  const start = await post("/api/auth/setup/start", {
    setupCode: readFileSync(setupCodeFile, "utf8").trim(),
    password: TEST_PASSWORD,
  });
  if (start.status !== 200) throw new Error(`Test setup/start failed with ${start.status}`);
  const { setupToken, secret } = (await start.json()) as SetupStartResponse;
  const confirm = await post("/api/auth/setup/confirm", {
    setupToken,
    code: generateTotpCode(secret, now()),
  });
  if (confirm.status !== 200) throw new Error(`Test setup/confirm failed with ${confirm.status}`);
  const match = new RegExp(`${SESSION_COOKIE}=([^;]+)`).exec(
    confirm.headers.get("set-cookie") ?? "",
  );
  if (!match) throw new Error("Test setup did not return a session cookie");
  const cookie = `${SESSION_COOKIE}=${match[1]}`;

  return {
    app,
    cookie,
    origin: TEST_ORIGIN,
    sessions,
    async json(route, init = {}) {
      const response = await app.request(route, {
        method: init.method ?? "GET",
        headers: { origin: TEST_ORIGIN, "content-type": "application/json", cookie },
        body: init.body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(init.body),
      });
      const text = await response.text();
      let body: unknown = null;
      if (text) {
        try {
          body = JSON.parse(text);
        } catch {
          body = text;
        }
      }
      return { status: response.status, body, headers: response.headers };
    },
  };
}

It prepares a database the way a crashed process would leave it (a job still `running`, a sync run still `running`, inserted with SQL that uses the column names of the Task 6 contract; if a Task 6 column differs, adjust the `INSERT` statements and nothing else), boots the real server over it, and then checks the SSE route over a real socket:

```ts
describe("startBursar startup recovery and live events", () => {
  let dir: string;
  let running: RunningBursar[];
  let masterKey: string;

  beforeEach(() => {
    dir = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), "bursar-recover-"));
    running = [];
    masterKey = Buffer.alloc(32, 3).toString("base64");
  });
  afterEach(async () => {
    for (const instance of running) await instance.close();
    rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  });

  const config = () =>
    loadConfig({
      BURSAR_PUBLIC_URL: "http://127.0.0.1",
      TZ: "UTC",
      BURSAR_MASTER_KEY: masterKey,
      BURSAR_DATA_DIR: dir,
      BURSAR_MIGRATIONS_DIR: MIGRATIONS_DIR,
    });

  /** Opens the data directory's database the way the server does, to prepare or inspect it. */
  function withDatabase<T>(fn: (database: OpenedDatabase) => T): T {
    const database = openDatabase(
      path.join(dir, "bursar.db"),
      deriveKey(config().masterKey, "database").toString("hex"),
    );
    try {
      runMigrations(database.db, MIGRATIONS_DIR);
      return fn(database);
    } finally {
      database.close();
    }
  }

  async function boot(logLines: string[] = []) {
    const logger = pino(
      { level: "info" },
      new Writable({
        write(chunk, _encoding, callback) {
          logLines.push(chunk.toString());
          callback();
        },
      }),
    );
    const instance = await startBursar({ ...config(), port: 0 }, logger);
    running.push(instance);
    return { base: `http://127.0.0.1:${instance.port}`, origin: "http://127.0.0.1" };
  }

  async function signIn(base: string, origin: string): Promise<string> {
    const post = (route: string, body: unknown) =>
      fetch(`${base}${route}`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { origin, "content-type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(body),
      });
    const setupCode = readFileSync(path.join(dir, "setup-code"), "utf8").trim();
    const start = await post("/api/auth/setup/start", {
      setupCode,
      password: "correct horse battery staple",
    });
    const { setupToken, secret } = (await start.json()) as SetupStartResponse;
    const confirm = await post("/api/auth/setup/confirm", {
      setupToken,
      code: generateTotpCode(secret, Date.now()),
    });
    expect(confirm.status).toBe(200);
    return (confirm.headers.get("set-cookie") ?? "").split(";")[0] ?? "";
  }

  it("requeues running jobs and fails running sync runs left by the previous process", async () => {
    const syncRunId = withDatabase(({ sqlite }) => {
      const queue = new JobQueue(sqlite);
      const jobId = queue.enqueue("test.never-registered", {});
      expect(queue.claimNext()?.id).toBe(jobId);
      const ts = Date.now();
      const connection = sqlite
        .prepare(
          `INSERT INTO bank_connections (aspsp_name, aspsp_country, provider_session_id, valid_until, created_at, updated_at)
           VALUES ('Banca Esempio', 'IT', 'session-fixture', ?, ?, ?)`,
        )
        .run(ts + 86_400_000, ts, ts);
      const account = sqlite
        .prepare(
          `INSERT INTO accounts (connection_id, identification_hash, currency, created_at, updated_at)
           VALUES (?, 'hash-fixture', 'EUR', ?, ?)`,
        )
        .run(connection.lastInsertRowid, ts, ts);
      const run = sqlite
        .prepare(
          `INSERT INTO sync_runs (account_id, trigger, status, started_at) VALUES (?, 'manual', 'running', ?)`,
        )
        .run(account.lastInsertRowid, ts);
      return Number(run.lastInsertRowid);
    });

    const lines: string[] = [];
    await boot(lines);

    const recovery = lines
      .map((line) => JSON.parse(line))
      .find((l) => l.msg?.startsWith("Recovered"));
    expect(recovery).toMatchObject({ level: 40, requeuedJobs: 1, failedSyncRuns: 1 });
    const run = withDatabase(({ sqlite }) =>
      sqlite
        .prepare("SELECT status, error_message, finished_at FROM sync_runs WHERE id = ?")
        .get(syncRunId),
    );
    expect(run).toMatchObject({ status: "failed", error_message: "Interrupted by a restart" });
    expect((run as { finished_at: number }).finished_at).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  it("does not log a recovery on a clean start", async () => {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    await boot(lines);
    expect(lines.filter((line) => line.includes("Recovered work"))).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it("serves /api/events to a signed-in client, never caches /api and still shuts down", async () => {
    const { base, origin } = await boot();
    const cookie = await signIn(base, origin);

    expect((await fetch(`${base}/api/events`)).status).toBe(401);
    const me = await fetch(`${base}/api/me`, { headers: { cookie } });
    expect(me.headers.get("cache-control")).toBe("no-store");

    const abort = new AbortController();
    const res = await fetch(`${base}/api/events`, { headers: { cookie }, signal: abort.signal });
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.headers.get("content-type")).toContain("text/event-stream");
    expect(res.headers.get("cache-control")).toBe("no-cache, no-transform");
    const reader = (res.body as ReadableStream<Uint8Array>).getReader();
    let received = "";
    while (!received.includes("event: ready")) {
      const chunk = await reader.read();
      if (chunk.done) break;
      received += new TextDecoder().decode(chunk.value);
    }
    expect(received).toContain("event: ready\ndata: {}\n\n");

    // Leave the stream open: close() in afterEach must not wait for this client to go away.
    const closing = running.pop()?.close();
    await expect(closing).resolves.toBeUndefined();
    abort.abort();
  });
});
```

### Task 8: M1 configuration and settings

**Files:**
- Create: `packages/shared/src/settings.ts`, `apps/server/src/settings/store.ts`, `apps/server/src/settings/routes.ts`
- Modify: `apps/server/src/config.ts`, `apps/server/src/logger.ts`, `apps/server/src/server.ts`, `apps/server/.env.example`, `packages/shared/src/index.ts`
- Test: `packages/shared/src/settings.test.ts`, `apps/server/src/settings/store.test.ts`, `apps/server/src/settings/routes.test.ts`, `apps/server/src/config.test.ts`, `apps/server/src/logger.test.ts`, `apps/server/src/server.test.ts` (the last one is modified only: two end-to-end tests for the mounted route)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: Task 6 `settings` table, `AuditLog`; Task 7 `EventBus`, `MountedRouter`, `createTestApp`.
- Produces:
  - `Config` gains: `enableBanking: { applicationId: string; privateKeyPem: string; apiBaseUrl: string } | null` (`EB_APPLICATION_ID` uuid + `EB_PRIVATE_KEY`/`EB_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE`; both or neither; the PEM must parse with `crypto.createPrivateKey` as an RSA key (PKCS#1 or PKCS#8) and is never echoed in a problem; `EB_API_BASE_URL` optional, default `https://api.enablebanking.com`, https only); `smtp: { host: string; port: number; security: "tls" | "starttls" | "none"; user: string | null; password: string | null; from: string } | null` (`SMTP_HOST`, `SMTP_PORT` default 587, `SMTP_SECURITY` default `starttls`, `SMTP_USER`, `SMTP_PASSWORD`/`_FILE`, `SMTP_FROM` required when the host is set; user and password both or neither; `none` only with a loopback host); `backup: { dir: string; s3: { endpoint: URL; region: string; bucket: string; prefix: string; accessKeyId: string; secretAccessKey: string } | null }` (`BURSAR_BACKUP_DIR` default `<dataDir>/backups`; `BACKUP_S3_ENDPOINT` https URL, `BACKUP_S3_BUCKET`, `BACKUP_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `BACKUP_S3_SECRET_KEY`/`_FILE` all or none; `BACKUP_S3_REGION` default `auto`; `BACKUP_S3_PREFIX` default `bursar`, no leading or trailing slash).
  - `logger.ts`: `configSecrets(config: Pick<Config, "masterKey" | "claude" | "enableBanking" | "smtp" | "backup">): string[]` adds the PEM (raw and each non-header PEM line of ≥ 16 chars), the SMTP password and the S3 secret key; `SECRET_KEYS` adds `privateKeyPem`, `secretAccessKey`, `providerSessionId`, `provider_session_id`, `session_id`, `authorizationCode`, `stateToken`, `iban`, `headers["psu-ip-address"]`. The generic key `code` is not redacted because log lines carry Enable Banking error codes under `errorCode`/`code`; code that handles the authorisation code or `state` never logs them, and uses the names `authorizationCode`/`stateToken` if an object holding them could reach a logger.
  - `@bursar/shared` `settings.ts`: `settingsValuesSchema = z.object({ locale: z.enum(["it", "en"]), country: z.string().regex(/^[A-Z]{2}$/).nullable(), consentDays: z.number().int().min(1).max(365), backgroundSyncCap: z.number().int().min(1).max(4), dailySyncTime: timeOfDaySchema, backupTime: timeOfDaySchema, notificationEmail: z.string().email().max(254).nullable(), emailNotifications: z.boolean(), highlightNegativeNet: z.boolean() })`; `timeOfDaySchema` (`HH:MM`, 00:00–23:59); `type SettingsValues`; `SETTINGS_DEFAULTS: SettingsValues = { locale: "it", country: null, consentDays: 180, backgroundSyncCap: 2, dailySyncTime: "06:00", backupTime: "03:00", notificationEmail: null, emailNotifications: true, highlightNegativeNet: true }`; `settingsPatchSchema = settingsValuesSchema.partial().strict()`; `type SettingsPatch`; `settingsResponseSchema` → `SettingsResponse { values: SettingsValues; system: { timezone: string; publicUrl: string; enableBankingConfigured: boolean; smtpConfigured: boolean; backupTarget: "s3" | "local" } }`.
  - `settings/store.ts`: `class SettingsStore { constructor(db: BursarDb, now?: () => number); get(): SettingsValues; update(patch: SettingsPatch): { values: SettingsValues; changed: (keyof SettingsValues)[] } }` (one row per key, JSON value; an invalid or unknown stored value falls back to the default for that key; `update` writes only changed keys in one transaction).
  - `settings/routes.ts`: `settingsRoutes(deps: { store: SettingsStore; audit: AuditLog; bus: EventBus; system: SettingsResponse["system"] }): Hono<AppEnv>` mounted at `/api/settings`: `GET /` → `SettingsResponse`; `PATCH /` (body `SettingsPatch`) → `SettingsResponse`, 400 `{ error: "Invalid settings", code: "invalid_settings" }`; on change records `settings.update` with the changed key names (no values) and publishes `{ type: "settings.updated" }`.
  - `server.ts`: constructs `settings = new SettingsStore(db)` and mounts the router with `system` built from config.

**Context for the implementer:**
- This task has no UI, so there is no Playwright run. The Settings page that consumes `GET`/`PATCH /api/settings` is Task 22.
- Tasks 6 and 7 are already merged on the branch: the `settings` and `audit_log` tables, `AuditLog`, `EventBus`, the `settings.updated` member of `ServerEvent`, `MountedRouter`, `AppDeps.routers` and `createTestApp` exist. Read `apps/server/src/db/schema.ts` and `apps/server/src/test/app.ts` first. The code below uses the Drizzle table object `settings` with the columns `key`, `value` (JSON text) and `updatedAt` (epoch milliseconds, a plain integer). If Task 6 named the table object or a column differently, adapt only those identifiers in `store.ts`.
- Every configuration problem names variables, never values. A secret reaches the log only through `configSecrets` (value scrubbing) and `SECRET_KEYS` (field-name redaction); this task extends both. All redaction and "no secret in a problem message" claims are proved by the tests below, nothing is asserted without a test.
- Settings are owner preferences kept in the database. Connection facts (`EB_*`, `SMTP_*`, `BACKUP_*`) stay environment-only and are shown read-only as `system`.

Create `packages/shared/src/settings.ts`:


```ts
import { z } from "zod";

/** A wall-clock time of day, `HH:MM`, 00:00 to 23:59. */
export const timeOfDaySchema = z
  .string()
  .regex(/^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$/, "Time must be HH:MM between 00:00 and 23:59");

export const settingsValuesSchema = z.object({
  locale: z.enum(["it", "en"]),
  /** ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the preselected bank country in the connect flow. */
  country: z
    .string()
    .regex(/^[A-Z]{2}$/)
    .nullable(),
  /** Requested consent length in days; the connect flow caps it at the bank's maximum. */
  consentDays: z.number().int().min(1).max(365),
  /** Background fetches allowed per account and local day (the PSD2 limit is 4 a day). */
  backgroundSyncCap: z.number().int().min(1).max(4),
  dailySyncTime: timeOfDaySchema,
  backupTime: timeOfDaySchema,
  notificationEmail: z.string().email().max(254).nullable(),
  emailNotifications: z.boolean(),
  highlightNegativeNet: z.boolean(),
});
export type SettingsValues = z.infer<typeof settingsValuesSchema>;

export const SETTINGS_DEFAULTS: SettingsValues = {
  locale: "it",
  country: null,
  consentDays: 180,
  backgroundSyncCap: 2,
  dailySyncTime: "06:00",
  backupTime: "03:00",
  notificationEmail: null,
  emailNotifications: true,
  highlightNegativeNet: true,
};

/** Any subset of the settings; unknown keys are rejected so a typo never passes silently. */
export const settingsPatchSchema = settingsValuesSchema.partial().strict();
export type SettingsPatch = z.infer<typeof settingsPatchSchema>;

export const settingsResponseSchema = z.object({
  values: settingsValuesSchema,
  /** Read-only facts about the deployment, shown on the Settings page. */
  system: z.object({
    timezone: z.string(),
    publicUrl: z.string(),
    enableBankingConfigured: z.boolean(),
    smtpConfigured: z.boolean(),
    backupTarget: z.enum(["s3", "local"]),
  }),
});
export type SettingsResponse = z.infer<typeof settingsResponseSchema>;
```

```
