`packages/shared/src/notifications.ts`:

```ts
import { z } from "zod";
import { notificationEventSchema } from "./finance";

/** Default and maximum page size of `GET /api/notifications`. */
export const NOTIFICATION_DEFAULT_LIMIT = 6;
export const NOTIFICATION_MAX_LIMIT = 50;

/**
 * Values the panel needs to build the notification text (bank name, number of days, ...).
 * They are shown in the panel only and never copied into an email.
 */
export const notificationParamsSchema = z.record(z.string(), z.union([z.string(), z.number()]));

export const notificationItemSchema = z.object({
  id: z.number().int().positive(),
  event: notificationEventSchema,
  params: notificationParamsSchema,
  /** A panel path such as `/accounts/12` or `/settings#backups`. */
  link: z.string().nullable(),
  createdAt: z.number().int(),
  readAt: z.number().int().nullable(),
});
export type NotificationItem = z.infer<typeof notificationItemSchema>;

export const notificationListQuerySchema = z.object({
  limit: z
    .string()
    .regex(/^\d{1,3}$/)
    .transform(Number)
    .pipe(z.number().int().min(1).max(NOTIFICATION_MAX_LIMIT))
    .optional(),
});
export type NotificationListQuery = z.infer<typeof notificationListQuerySchema>;

export const notificationListResponseSchema = z.object({
  items: z.array(notificationItemSchema),
  unread: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
});
export type NotificationListResponse = z.infer<typeof notificationListResponseSchema>;

export const testEmailResponseSchema = z.object({ sent: z.literal(true) });
export type TestEmailResponse = z.infer<typeof testEmailResponseSchema>;
```

`apps/server/src/notifications/keys.ts`:

```ts
import type { LocalDate } from "@bursar/shared";

/**
 * Stable dedupe strings for `notifications.dedupe_key`. A key identifies one real-world fact
 * (this consent, with this expiry date, crossed this threshold), so raising it twice is a no-op
 * and a renewed consent (a new `validUntil`) produces a new key.
 */
export const notificationKeys = {
  consentExpiring: (connectionId: number, validUntil: number, threshold: 14 | 3): string =>
    `consent-expiring:${connectionId}:${validUntil}:${threshold}`,
  consentExpired: (connectionId: number, validUntil: number): string =>
    `consent-expired:${connectionId}:${validUntil}`,
  connectionError: (connectionId: number, at: number): string =>
    `connection-error:${connectionId}:${at}`,
  syncFailing: (accountId: number, since: LocalDate | "never"): string =>
    `sync-failing:${accountId}:${since}`,
  backupFailing: (localDate: LocalDate): string => `backup-failing:${localDate}`,
} as const;
```

`apps/server/src/notifications/mailer.ts`. The three modes map to nodemailer exactly as in the research notes: `secure` for `tls`, `requireTLS` for `starttls` (the message is never sent in clear text), `ignoreTLS` for `none` (configuration already restricts it to a loopback host):

```ts
import nodemailer, { type SMTPTransportOptions } from "nodemailer";
import type { Config } from "../config";

export interface MailMessage {
  to: string;
  subject: string;
  text: string;
}

export interface Mailer {
  send(message: MailMessage): Promise<void>;
  /** Connects and authenticates without sending anything. */
  verify(): Promise<void>;
}

/**
 * Maps the three security modes to nodemailer options:
 * - `tls`: implicit TLS (usually port 465);
 * - `starttls`: the upgrade is mandatory, a message is never sent in clear text;
 * - `none`: no encryption (the configuration only allows it for a loopback host).
 */
export function smtpTransportOptions(smtp: NonNullable<Config["smtp"]>): SMTPTransportOptions {
  return {
    host: smtp.host,
    port: smtp.port,
    secure: smtp.security === "tls",
    requireTLS: smtp.security === "starttls",
    ignoreTLS: smtp.security === "none",
    auth:
      smtp.user !== null && smtp.password !== null
        ? { user: smtp.user, pass: smtp.password }
        : undefined,
    tls: { minVersion: "TLSv1.2" },
    connectionTimeout: 10_000,
    greetingTimeout: 10_000,
    socketTimeout: 20_000,
  };
}

export function createSmtpMailer(smtp: NonNullable<Config["smtp"]>): Mailer {
  const transport = nodemailer.createTransport(smtpTransportOptions(smtp));
  return {
    async send(message) {
      await transport.sendMail({
        from: smtp.from,
        to: message.to,
        subject: message.subject,
        text: message.text,
      });
    },
    async verify() {
      await transport.verify();
    },
  };
}

/** Collects messages in memory: used by tests and by the QA server (no network). */
export class MemoryMailer implements Mailer {
  readonly sent: MailMessage[] = [];
  /** The next `send` or `verify` rejects with this error, then the mailer works again. */
  failNext?: Error;

  async send(message: MailMessage): Promise<void> {
    this.throwIfFailing();
    this.sent.push({ ...message });
  }

  async verify(): Promise<void> {
    this.throwIfFailing();
  }

  private throwIfFailing(): void {
    const error = this.failNext;
    if (error) {
      this.failNext = undefined;
      throw error;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * A message that is safe to store, log and return: only the nodemailer error code and the SMTP
 * status number. The server's response text (it can contain addresses or account names) and
 * anything that could hold credentials are dropped.
 */
export function describeMailError(error: unknown): string {
  const details: string[] = [];
  if (typeof error === "object" && error !== null) {
    const { code, responseCode } = error as { code?: unknown; responseCode?: unknown };
    if (typeof code === "string" && /^[A-Z0-9_]{1,32}$/.test(code)) details.push(code);
    if (typeof responseCode === "number" && Number.isInteger(responseCode)) {
      details.push(String(responseCode));
    }
  }
  return details.length > 0
    ? `SMTP delivery failed (${details.join(", ")})`
    : "SMTP delivery failed";
}
```

`apps/server/src/notifications/templates.ts`. `renderEmail` takes no params on purpose, so a leak is impossible by construction; the tests still check the output:

```ts
import type { NotificationEvent } from "@bursar/shared";

export type EmailLocale = "it" | "en";
export type EmailEvent = NotificationEvent | "test";

/**
 * Email text is deliberately generic: an event title and a link to the panel. `renderEmail`
 * never receives the notification params, so no amount, bank name, account name or date can end
 * up in a mailbox. The titles contain no digits; the only digits in a message come from the
 * panel URL.
 */
const TITLES: Record<EmailLocale, Record<EmailEvent, string>> = {
  en: {
    consent_expiring: "A bank connection is about to expire",
    consent_expired: "A bank connection has expired",
    connection_error: "A bank connection needs attention",
    sync_failing: "Account synchronisation keeps failing",
    backup_failing: "Backups are failing",
    test: "Test message",
  },
  it: {
    consent_expiring: "Un collegamento bancario sta per scadere",
    consent_expired: "Un collegamento bancario è scaduto",
    connection_error: "Un collegamento bancario richiede attenzione",
    sync_failing: "La sincronizzazione dei conti continua a fallire",
    backup_failing: "I backup non vanno a buon fine",
    test: "Messaggio di prova",
  },
};

const COPY: Record<EmailLocale, { open: string; footer: string }> = {
  en: {
    open: "Open Bursar for the details:",
    footer: "This message contains no financial data. Everything else is in the panel.",
  },
  it: {
    open: "Apri Bursar per i dettagli:",
    footer: "Questo messaggio non contiene dati finanziari. Il resto è nel pannello.",
  },
};

export function emailTitle(event: EmailEvent, locale: EmailLocale): string {
  return TITLES[locale][event];
}

export function renderEmail(input: { event: EmailEvent; locale: EmailLocale; panelUrl: string }): {
  subject: string;
  text: string;
} {
  const title = emailTitle(input.event, input.locale);
  const copy = COPY[input.locale];
  return {
    subject: `Bursar: ${title}`,
    text: [`${title}.`, "", copy.open, input.panelUrl, "", copy.footer, ""].join("\n"),
  };
}

/**
 * Absolute panel URL for a stored link. Links are panel paths written by the server; anything
 * else (an absolute URL, a protocol-relative `//host`, a backslash form) falls back to the panel
 * home, so a notification can never point an email reader outside the panel.
 */
export function panelUrlFor(publicUrl: URL, link: string | null): string {
  const isPanelPath = link !== null && /^\/(?![/\\])/.test(link);
  return new URL(isPanelPath ? link : "/", publicUrl).toString();
}
```

`apps/server/src/notifications/service.ts`. The only Drizzle names assumed from Task 6 are the `notifications` table export and its camelCase columns (`dedupeKey`, `createdAt`, `readAt`, `emailStatus`, `emailSentAt`, `emailError`), with the timestamps declared as plain `integer(...)` (epoch milliseconds as `number`, like `jobs`), not `mode: "timestamp_ms"`:

```ts
import {
  type NotificationEvent,
  type NotificationItem,
  type NotificationListResponse,
  notificationEventSchema,
  notificationParamsSchema,
} from "@bursar/shared";
import { desc, eq, isNull, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { BursarDb } from "../db";
import { notifications } from "../db/schema";
import type { EventBus } from "../events/bus";
import type { JobQueue } from "../jobs/queue";
import { EMAIL_JOB, emailDedupeKey } from "../jobs/types";
import type { SettingsStore } from "../settings/store";

/** Total delivery attempts for one email (retried after 30 s, 2 min and 8 min). */
export const EMAIL_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 4;

/** Longest `email_error` kept in the database. */
const MAX_EMAIL_ERROR_LENGTH = 200;

export interface RaiseInput {
  event: NotificationEvent;
  dedupeKey: string;
  params: Record<string, string | number>;
  /** A panel path, for example `/accounts/12` or `/settings#backups`. */
  link: string | null;
}

export interface NotificationServiceDeps {
  db: BursarDb;
  queue: JobQueue;
  bus: EventBus;
  settings: SettingsStore;
  /** True when a mailer exists (SMTP configured or injected). */
  emailEnabled: () => boolean;
  now?: () => number;
}

type NotificationRow = typeof notifications.$inferSelect;

export class NotificationService {
  private readonly now: () => number;

  constructor(private readonly deps: NotificationServiceDeps) {
    this.now = deps.now ?? Date.now;
  }

  /**
   * Stores a notification unless one with the same dedupe key exists, tells the panel, and queues
   * an email when email is available, switched on in the settings and a recipient is set.
   * Returns the new id, or `null` on a dedupe hit. It opens no transaction of its own, so it can
   * run inside a caller's transaction (Drizzle's top-level `transaction` cannot be nested). If
   * queueing the email fails, the notification stays (marked `skipped`) and the error is rethrown.
   */
  raise(input: RaiseInput): number | null {
    const sendEmail = this.shouldEmail();
    const [row] = this.deps.db
      .insert(notifications)
      .values({
        event: input.event,
        dedupeKey: input.dedupeKey,
        params: JSON.stringify(input.params),
        link: input.link,
        createdAt: this.now(),
        readAt: null,
        emailStatus: sendEmail ? "pending" : "skipped",
      })
      .onConflictDoNothing({ target: notifications.dedupeKey })
      .returning({ id: notifications.id })
      .all();
    if (!row) return null;
    if (sendEmail) {
      try {
        this.deps.queue.enqueueUnique(
          EMAIL_JOB,
          emailDedupeKey(row.id),
          { notificationId: row.id },
          { maxAttempts: EMAIL_MAX_ATTEMPTS },
        );
      } catch (error) {
        this.setEmailStatus(row.id, "skipped");
        throw error;
      }
    }
    this.deps.bus.publish({ type: "notification.created", id: row.id, event: input.event });
    return row.id;
  }

  list(limit: number): NotificationListResponse {
    const rows = this.deps.db
      .select()
      .from(notifications)
      .orderBy(desc(notifications.createdAt), desc(notifications.id))
      .limit(limit)
      .all();
    const unread = this.deps.db
      .select({ count: sql<number>`count(*)` })
      .from(notifications)
      .where(isNull(notifications.readAt))
      .get();
    return {
      items: rows.flatMap((row) => {
        const item = toItem(row);
        return item ? [item] : [];
      }),
      unread: unread?.count ?? 0,
    };
  }

  get(id: number): NotificationItem | null {
    const row = this.deps.db.select().from(notifications).where(eq(notifications.id, id)).get();
    return row ? toItem(row) : null;
  }

  /** Marks one notification read. Idempotent: `true` whenever it exists, `false` when it does not. */
  markRead(id: number): boolean {
    const rows = this.deps.db
      .update(notifications)
      .set({ readAt: sql`coalesce(${notifications.readAt}, ${this.now()})` })
      .where(eq(notifications.id, id))
      .returning({ id: notifications.id })
      .all();
    return rows.length > 0;
  }

  /** Marks every unread notification read and returns how many changed. */
  markAllRead(): number {
    return this.deps.db
      .update(notifications)
      .set({ readAt: this.now() })
      .where(isNull(notifications.readAt))
      .returning({ id: notifications.id })
      .all().length;
  }

  setEmailStatus(id: number, status: "sent" | "failed" | "skipped", error?: string): void {
    this.deps.db
      .update(notifications)
      .set({
        emailStatus: status,
        emailSentAt: status === "sent" ? this.now() : null,
        emailError: status === "failed" ? (error ?? "").slice(0, MAX_EMAIL_ERROR_LENGTH) : null,
      })
      .where(eq(notifications.id, id))
      .run();
  }

  private shouldEmail(): boolean {
    if (!this.deps.emailEnabled()) return false;
    const { emailNotifications, notificationEmail } = this.deps.settings.get();
    return emailNotifications && notificationEmail !== null;
  }
}

/** Rows with an event this build does not know (for example from a newer version) are hidden. */
function toItem(row: NotificationRow): NotificationItem | null {
  const event = notificationEventSchema.safeParse(row.event);
  if (!event.success) return null;
  return {
    id: row.id,
    event: event.data,
    params: parseParams(row.params),
    link: row.link,
    createdAt: row.createdAt,
    readAt: row.readAt,
  };
}

function parseParams(raw: string): Record<string, string | number> {
  try {
    const parsed = notificationParamsSchema.safeParse(JSON.parse(raw));
    return parsed.success ? parsed.data : {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}
```

`apps/server/src/notifications/email-job.ts`:

```ts
import { emailPayloadSchema, parsePayload } from "../jobs/types";
import type { JobHandler } from "../jobs/worker";
import type { SettingsStore } from "../settings/store";
import { describeMailError, type Mailer } from "./mailer";
import type { NotificationService } from "./service";
import { panelUrlFor, renderEmail } from "./templates";

export interface EmailJobDeps {
  service: NotificationService;
  /** `null` when SMTP is not configured. */
  mailer: Mailer | null;
  settings: SettingsStore;
  publicUrl: URL;
}

/**
 * Handler of the `notify.email` job. The recipient, the language and the on/off switch are read
 * when the job runs, so a change in the settings applies to messages still waiting in the queue.
 * A delivery failure is rethrown with a reduced message so the queue retries it with backoff; on
 * the last attempt the notification is marked `failed` first. The panel notification itself is
 * never affected by email problems.
 */
export function emailJobHandler(deps: EmailJobDeps): JobHandler {
  return async (job) => {
    const { notificationId } = parsePayload(emailPayloadSchema, job);
    const notification = deps.service.get(notificationId);
    if (!notification) return;

    const { notificationEmail, emailNotifications, locale } = deps.settings.get();
    if (deps.mailer === null || !emailNotifications || notificationEmail === null) {
      deps.service.setEmailStatus(notificationId, "skipped");
      return;
    }

    const { subject, text } = renderEmail({
      event: notification.event,
      locale,
      panelUrl: panelUrlFor(deps.publicUrl, notification.link),
    });
    try {
      await deps.mailer.send({ to: notificationEmail, subject, text });
    } catch (error) {
      const reduced = describeMailError(error);
      if (job.attempts >= job.maxAttempts) {
        deps.service.setEmailStatus(notificationId, "failed", reduced);
      }
      throw new Error(reduced);
    }
    deps.service.setEmailStatus(notificationId, "sent");
  };
}
```

`apps/server/src/notifications/routes.ts`. The fixed paths (`/read-all`, `/test-email`) are registered before the `/:notificationId/read` pattern:

```ts
import {
  NOTIFICATION_DEFAULT_LIMIT,
  notificationListQuerySchema,
  type TestEmailResponse,
} from "@bursar/shared";
import { Hono } from "hono";
import type { AppEnv } from "../http/app";
import type { SettingsStore } from "../settings/store";
import type { Mailer } from "./mailer";
import type { NotificationService } from "./service";
import { panelUrlFor, renderEmail } from "./templates";

export interface NotificationRoutesDeps {
  service: NotificationService;
  /** `null` when SMTP is not configured. */
  mailer: Mailer | null;
  settings: SettingsStore;
  publicUrl: URL;
}

export function notificationRoutes(deps: NotificationRoutesDeps): Hono<AppEnv> {
  const routes = new Hono<AppEnv>();

  routes.get("/", (c) => {
    const query = notificationListQuerySchema.safeParse({ limit: c.req.query("limit") });
    if (!query.success) return c.json({ error: "Invalid request" }, 400);
    return c.json(deps.service.list(query.data.limit ?? NOTIFICATION_DEFAULT_LIMIT));
  });

  routes.post("/read-all", (c) => c.json({ updated: deps.service.markAllRead() }));

  routes.post("/test-email", async (c) => {
    if (deps.mailer === null) {
      return c.json({ error: "SMTP is not configured", code: "smtp_not_configured" }, 409);
    }
    const { notificationEmail, locale } = deps.settings.get();
    if (notificationEmail === null) {
      return c.json(
        { error: "No notification email address is set", code: "recipient_missing" },
        409,
      );
    }
    const { subject, text } = renderEmail({
      event: "test",
      locale,
      panelUrl: panelUrlFor(deps.publicUrl, "/settings"),
    });
    try {
      await deps.mailer.send({ to: notificationEmail, subject, text });
    } catch {
      // The server's answer can hold addresses or account names: never echo it.
      return c.json({ error: "The mail server refused the message", code: "smtp_failed" }, 502);
    }
    const body: TestEmailResponse = { sent: true };
    return c.json(body, 202);
  });

  routes.post("/:notificationId/read", (c) => {
    const raw = c.req.param("notificationId");
    const id = /^\d{1,15}$/.test(raw) ? Number(raw) : 0;
    if (id === 0 || !deps.service.markRead(id)) return c.json({ error: "Not found" }, 404);
    return c.body(null, 204);
  });

  return routes;
}
```

scheme_name: string; issuer?: string | null }`; `EbAccountResource { uid?: string | null; account_id?: { iban?: string | null; other?: EbGenericIdentification | null } | null; all_account_ids?: EbGenericIdentification[] | null; account_servicer?: { bic_fi?: string | null; name?: string | null } | null; name?: string | null; details?: string | null; product?: string | null; cash_account_type: string; currency: string; identification_hash: string; identification_hashes: string[]; usage?: string | null }`; `EbSession { session_id: string; accounts: EbAccountResource[]; aspsp: { name: string; country: string }; psu_type: string; access: { valid_until: string } }`; `EbSessionStatus { status: "INVALID" | "PENDING_AUTHORIZATION" | "RETURNED_FROM_BANK" | "AUTHORIZED" | "EXPIRED" | "CLOSED" | "REVOKED" | "CANCELLED"; accounts: string[]; access: { valid_until: string } }`; `EbBalance { name: string; balance_amount: { currency: string; amount: string }; balance_type: string; last_change_date_time?: string | null; reference_date?: string | null }`; `EbTransaction { entry_reference?: string | null; transaction_id?: string | null; transaction_amount: { currency: string; amount: string }; credit_debit_indicator: "CRDT" | "DBIT"; status: string; booking_date?: string | null; value_date?: string | null; transaction_date?: string | null; creditor?: { name?: string | null } | null; debtor?: { name?: string | null } | null; creditor_account?: { iban?: string | null; other?: EbGenericIdentification | null } | null; debtor_account?: (same) | null; remittance_information?: string[] | null; bank_transaction_code?: { description?: string | null; code?: string | null; sub_code?: string | null } | null; merchant_category_code?: string | null; balance_after_transaction?: { currency: string; amount: string } | null; reference_number?: string | null }`; `EbTransactionsPage { transactions: EbTransaction[]; continuation_key?: string | null }`.
  - `eb/jwt.ts`: `createJwtSigner(options: { applicationId: string; privateKeyPem: string; now?: () => number; ttlSeconds?: number }): { token(): Promise<string> }` (RS256, header `{ typ: "JWT", alg: "RS256", kid: applicationId }`, claims `iss: "enablebanking.com"`, `aud: "api.enablebanking.com"`, `iat`, `exp = iat + ttlSeconds` (default 3600, max 86400 enforced); cached and re-signed when fewer than 300 s remain; key loaded with `crypto.createPrivateKey`).
  - `eb/allowlist.ts`: `interface EbOperation { name: string; method: "GET" | "POST" | "DELETE"; pattern: RegExp }`; `EB_ALLOWED_OPERATIONS: readonly EbOperation[]` = `GET /application`, `GET /aspsps`, `POST /auth`, `POST /sessions`, `GET /sessions/{uuid}`, `DELETE /sessions/{uuid}`, `GET /accounts/{uuid}/balances`, `GET /accounts/{uuid}/transactions` (anchored regexes, uuid segment `[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}`); `class DisallowedOperationError extends Error`; `assertAllowed(method: string, path: string): EbOperation`.
  - `eb/errors.ts`: `type EbErrorKind = "reauth" | "account" | "rate_limited" | "retry" | "fatal"`; `class EnableBankingError extends Error { status: number; code: string | null; detail: string | null; kind: EbErrorKind }`; `classifyEbError(status: number, code: string | null): EbErrorKind` (reauth: `EXPIRED_SESSION`, `CLOSED_SESSION`, `REVOKED_SESSION`, `SESSION_DOES_NOT_EXIST`, `WRONG_SESSION_STATUS`; account: `ACCOUNT_DOES_NOT_EXIST`, `ASPSP_ACCOUNT_NOT_ACCESSIBLE`; rate_limited: `ASPSP_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` or status 429; retry: `ASPSP_ERROR`, `ASPSP_TIMEOUT`, status 0 (network/timeout), 408, ≥ 500; everything else fatal); `parseEbErrorBody(status: number, body: unknown): EnableBankingError`.
  - `eb/client.ts`: `interface PsuHeaders { ipAddress: string; userAgent: string; accept?: string; acceptLanguage?: string }`; `interface TransactionsQuery { dateFrom?: LocalDate; dateTo?: LocalDate; strategy?: "default" | "longest"; continuationKey?: string }`; `interface EnableBankingApi { getApplication(): Promise<EbApplication>; listAspsps(country: string): Promise<EbAspsp[]>; startAuthorization(request: EbStartAuthorizationRequest): Promise<EbStartAuthorizationResponse>; createSession(code: string): Promise<EbSession>; getSession(sessionId: string): Promise<EbSessionStatus>; deleteSession(sessionId: string): Promise<void>; getBalances(accountUid: string, psu?: PsuHeaders): Promise<EbBalance[]>; getTransactions(accountUid: string, query: TransactionsQuery, psu?: PsuHeaders): Promise<EbTransactionsPage> }`; `class EnableBankingClient implements EnableBankingApi { constructor(options: { applicationId: string; privateKeyPem: string; baseUrl?: string; fetch?: typeof fetch; now?: () => number; timeoutMs?: number }) }` (single private `call(method, path, { query?, body?, psu? })` that runs `assertAllowed` first; `listAspsps` sends `country`, `psu_type=personal`, `service=AIS`; PSU headers sent as `Psu-Ip-Address`, `Psu-User-Agent`, `Psu-Accept`, `Psu-Accept-Language` only when `psu` is given and only on balances/transactions/delete; timeout default 30 000 ms via `AbortSignal.timeout`; responses validated with the schemas; errors → `EnableBankingError`).
  - `eb/fake.ts`: `class FakeEnableBanking implements EnableBankingApi { constructor(options: { publicUrl: URL; now?: () => number; seed?: number }); failNext(method: keyof EnableBankingApi, error: EnableBankingError): void; sessions: Map<string, { status: EbSessionStatus["status"]; accounts: EbAccountResource[] }> }` (deterministic; two fictional ASPSPs per country; `startAuthorization` returns `url = <redirect_url>?state=<state>&code=fake-<n>` so the QA run and stories complete a round trip locally; `createSession("fake-empty-…")` returns no accounts; accounts reuse stable `identification_hash` values across sessions so renewal mapping can be exercised; transactions paginate with `continuation_key`).
  - `eb/aspsp-cache.ts`: `class AspspCache { constructor(api: EnableBankingApi, now?: () => number, ttlMs?: number); list(country: string): Promise<EbAspsp[]>; find(country: string, name: string): Promise<EbAspsp | null> }` (24 h TTL per country; concurrent calls share one request).
  - `eb/logo.ts`: `fetchLogo(url: string, fetchImpl: typeof fetch): Promise<{ body: Buffer; contentType: string } | null>` (https only, 256 KiB cap, content type `image/png|jpeg|webp|gif|svg+xml`, 10 s timeout; in-memory LRU of 200 entries for 24 h).
  - `@bursar/shared` `banks.ts`: `AspspSummary { name: string; country: string; maximumConsentDays: number; beta: boolean; hasLogo: boolean }`; `AspspListResponse { aspsps: AspspSummary[] }`; `BankStatusResponse { configured: boolean; environment: "SANDBOX" | "PRODUCTION" | null; active: boolean | null; redirectUrlAllowed: boolean | null; countries: string[]; error: string | null }`; `aspspQuerySchema = z.object({ country: z.string().regex(/^[A-Z]{2}$/) })`; `logoQuerySchema = z.object({ country, name: z.string().min(1).max(200) })`.
  - `eb/routes.ts`: `bankRoutes(deps: { api: EnableBankingApi | null; aspsps: AspspCache | null; publicUrl: URL; fetchLogo?: typeof fetch; now?: () => number }): Hono<AppEnv>` mounted at `/api/banks`: `GET /status` → `BankStatusResponse` (calls `getApplication` cached 10 min; `redirectUrlAllowed` = `redirect_urls` contains `<publicUrl>/api/banks/callback`; when `api` is null → `configured: false`, others null); `GET /aspsps?country=XX` → `AspspListResponse` sorted with a natural collator (503 `{ error, code: "banking_not_configured" }` when `api` is null; 502 `{ error, code: "bank_list_unavailable" }` on an EB error); `GET /logo?country=&name=` → image bytes from the ASPSP's `logo` URL (never a client-supplied URL) with `Content-Type`, `Cache-Control: private, max-age=86400`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'`; 404 when unknown or not fetchable.
  - `server.ts`: `StartOverrides` gains `bankingClient?: EnableBankingApi | null`; `ebApi = overrides.bankingClient !== undefined ? overrides.bankingClient : config.enableBanking ? new EnableBankingClient(config.enableBanking) : null`; `aspsps = ebApi ? new AspspCache(ebApi) : null`; mounts the router. `qa-server.ts` passes `new FakeEnableBanking({ publicUrl })`.

Additive exports this task defines beyond the contract (no contract name changes): `EnableBankingError` constructor `(status: number, code: string | null, message: string, detail?: string | null)`; schema constants `eb*Schema` in `schemas.ts`; `EB_JWT_ISSUER`, `EB_JWT_AUDIENCE`, `EB_JWT_DEFAULT_TTL_SECONDS`, `EB_JWT_MAX_TTL_SECONDS`, `EB_JWT_RENEW_BEFORE_SECONDS` in `jwt.ts`; `EB_DEFAULT_BASE_URL`, `EB_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS` in `client.ts`; `ASPSP_CACHE_TTL_MS`; `LOGO_MAX_BYTES`, `clearLogoCache()` in `logo.ts`; `BANK_CALLBACK_PATH`, `APPLICATION_CACHE_MS` in `routes.ts`; `FAKE_ASPSP_NAMES`, `FAKE_COUNTRIES`, `FAKE_PAGE_SIZE`, `FAKE_TRANSACTION_COUNT`, `fakeAccountIdentity()` in `fake.ts`. The `server.ts` wiring maps `config.enableBanking.apiBaseUrl` to the constructor's `baseUrl` explicitly, because passing `config.enableBanking` as is would silently drop the configured base URL (the field names differ).

Security notes for the implementer (read before coding):
- The allowlist is the only door to the network. `assertAllowed` is the first statement of the private `call`, before the JWT is signed and before `fetch`. There is no other code path to `fetch` in `client.ts`, and the class exposes exactly the eight `EnableBankingApi` methods on its prototype. `call` is an instance arrow property, not a prototype method, so the prototype test can assert the exact method list while the allowlist test can still reach `call` with a cast.
- `redirect: "error"` on every API request: a redirect must never carry the `Authorization` header to another host.
- Error messages carry only the HTTP status, the Enable Banking `error` code and the API's `message` (truncated to 200 characters). Never the JWT, PSU headers, request URLs, response bodies or `detail`. Nothing in `src/eb` logs.
- The logo proxy fetches only the `logo` URL of an ASPSP found by `country` + `name` in the cached Enable Banking list. Query parameters other than `country` and `name` are ignored. https only (each redirect hop too), 256 KiB cap enforced while streaming, image content types only.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the shared DTOs, the response schemas and the fixtures**

These are data definitions and documented response shapes (`eb-api-notes.md` §1–§9), exercised by every test below. All data is fictional: generated IBANs with valid checksums, invented bank names, `*.example.test` hosts, random UUIDs.

`packages/shared/src/banks.ts`:

```ts
import { z } from "zod";

const countryCodeSchema = z.string().regex(/^[A-Z]{2}$/);

export const aspspSummarySchema = z.object({
  name: z.string(),
  country: z.string(),
  maximumConsentDays: z.number().int(),
  beta: z.boolean(),
  hasLogo: z.boolean(),
});
export type AspspSummary = z.infer<typeof aspspSummarySchema>;

export const aspspListResponseSchema = z.object({ aspsps: z.array(aspspSummarySchema) });
export type AspspListResponse = z.infer<typeof aspspListResponseSchema>;

export const bankStatusResponseSchema = z.object({
  configured: z.boolean(),
  environment: z.enum(["SANDBOX", "PRODUCTION"]).nullable(),
  active: z.boolean().nullable(),
  redirectUrlAllowed: z.boolean().nullable(),
  countries: z.array(z.string()),
  error: z.string().nullable(),
});
export type BankStatusResponse = z.infer<typeof bankStatusResponseSchema>;

export const aspspQuerySchema = z.object({ country: countryCodeSchema });
export type AspspQuery = z.infer<typeof aspspQuerySchema>;

export const logoQuerySchema = z.object({
  country: countryCodeSchema,
  name: z.string().min(1).max(200),
});
export type LogoQuery = z.infer<typeof logoQuerySchema>;
```

`apps/server/src/eb/schemas.ts`:

```ts
import { z } from "zod";

/**
 * Enable Banking response shapes (eb-api-notes.md §1–§7). Objects pass unknown fields through so
 * a new provider field never breaks a sync; optional fields accept `null` as well as absence.
 */

export const ebGenericIdentificationSchema = z
  .object({
    identification: z.string(),
    scheme_name: z.string(),
    issuer: z.string().nullish(),
  })
  .passthrough();
export type EbGenericIdentification = z.infer<typeof ebGenericIdentificationSchema>;

export const ebAccountIdentificationSchema = z
  .object({
    iban: z.string().nullish(),
    other: ebGenericIdentificationSchema.nullish(),
  })
  .passthrough();
export type EbAccountIdentification = z.infer<typeof ebAccountIdentificationSchema>;

export const ebAmountSchema = z.object({ currency: z.string(), amount: z.string() }).passthrough();
export type EbAmount = z.infer<typeof ebAmountSchema>;

export const ebApplicationSchema = z
  .object({
    name: z.string(),
    kid: z.string(),
    environment: z.enum(["SANDBOX", "PRODUCTION"]),
    redirect_urls: z.array(z.string()),
    active: z.boolean(),
    countries: z.array(z.string()),
  })
  .passthrough();
export type EbApplication = z.infer<typeof ebApplicationSchema>;

export const ebAspspSchema = z
  .object({
    name: z.string(),
    country: z.string(),
    logo: z.string(),
    psu_types: z.array(z.string()),
    maximum_consent_validity: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
    beta: z.boolean(),
    bic: z.string().nullish(),
    required_psu_headers: z.array(z.string()).nullish(),
  })
  .passthrough();
export type EbAspsp = z.infer<typeof ebAspspSchema>;

export const ebAspspListSchema = z.object({ aspsps: z.array(ebAspspSchema) }).passthrough();

export const ebStartAuthorizationRequestSchema = z.object({
  access: z.object({
    valid_until: z.string(),
    balances: z.boolean().optional(),
    transactions: z.boolean().optional(),
  }),
  aspsp: z.object({ name: z.string(), country: z.string() }),
  state: z.string(),
  redirect_url: z.string(),
  psu_type: z.literal("personal"),
  language: z.string().optional(),
});
export type EbStartAuthorizationRequest = z.infer<typeof ebStartAuthorizationRequestSchema>;

export const ebStartAuthorizationResponseSchema = z
  .object({
    url: z.string(),
    authorization_id: z.string(),
    psu_id_hash: z.string().nullish(),
  })
  .passthrough();
export type EbStartAuthorizationResponse = z.infer<typeof ebStartAuthorizationResponseSchema>;

export const ebAccountResourceSchema = z
  .object({
    uid: z.string().nullish(),
    account_id: ebAccountIdentificationSchema.nullish(),
    all_account_ids: z.array(ebGenericIdentificationSchema).nullish(),
    account_servicer: z
      .object({ bic_fi: z.string().nullish(), name: z.string().nullish() })
      .passthrough()
      .nullish(),
    name: z.string().nullish(),
    details: z.string().nullish(),
    product: z.string().nullish(),
    cash_account_type: z.string(),
    currency: z.string(),
    identification_hash: z.string(),
    identification_hashes: z.array(z.string()),
    usage: z.string().nullish(),
  })
  .passthrough();
export type EbAccountResource = z.infer<typeof ebAccountResourceSchema>;

const ebAspspRefSchema = z.object({ name: z.string(), country: z.string() }).passthrough();
const ebAccessSchema = z.object({ valid_until: z.string() }).passthrough();

export const ebSessionSchema = z
  .object({
    session_id: z.string(),
    accounts: z.array(ebAccountResourceSchema),
    aspsp: ebAspspRefSchema,
    psu_type: z.string(),
    access: ebAccessSchema,
  })
  .passthrough();
export type EbSession = z.infer<typeof ebSessionSchema>;

export const ebSessionStatusSchema = z
  .object({
    status: z.enum([
      "INVALID",
      "PENDING_AUTHORIZATION",
      "RETURNED_FROM_BANK",
      "AUTHORIZED",
      "EXPIRED",
      "CLOSED",
      "REVOKED",
      "CANCELLED",
    ]),
    accounts: z.array(z.string()),
    access: ebAccessSchema,
  })
  .passthrough();
export type EbSessionStatus = z.infer<typeof ebSessionStatusSchema>;

export const ebBalanceSchema = z
  .object({
    name: z.string(),
    balance_amount: ebAmountSchema,
    balance_type: z.string(),
    last_change_date_time: z.string().nullish(),
    reference_date: z.string().nullish(),
  })
  .passthrough();
export type EbBalance = z.infer<typeof ebBalanceSchema>;

/**
 * The balances envelope. Items are checked one by one in the client (`ebBalanceSchema.safeParse`),
 * so one malformed balance is dropped instead of failing the whole account sync.
 */
export const ebBalancesResponseSchema = z
  .object({ balances: z.array(z.unknown()) })
  .passthrough();

const ebPartySchema = z.object({ name: z.string().nullish() }).passthrough();

export const ebTransactionSchema = z
  .object({
    entry_reference: z.string().nullish(),
    transaction_id: z.string().nullish(),
    transaction_amount: ebAmountSchema,
    credit_debit_indicator: z.enum(["CRDT", "DBIT"]),
    status: z.string(),
    booking_date: z.string().nullish(),
    value_date: z.string().nullish(),
    transaction_date: z.string().nullish(),
    creditor: ebPartySchema.nullish(),
    debtor: ebPartySchema.nullish(),
    creditor_account: ebAccountIdentificationSchema.nullish(),
    debtor_account: ebAccountIdentificationSchema.nullish(),
    remittance_information: z.array(z.string()).nullish(),
    bank_transaction_code: z
      .object({
        description: z.string().nullish(),
        code: z.string().nullish(),
        sub_code: z.string().nullish(),
      })
      .passthrough()
      .nullish(),
    merchant_category_code: z.string().nullish(),
    balance_after_transaction: ebAmountSchema.nullish(),
    reference_number: z.string().nullish(),
  })
  .passthrough();
export type EbTransaction = z.infer<typeof ebTransactionSchema>;

export const ebTransactionsPageSchema = z
  .object({
    transactions: z.array(ebTransactionSchema),
    continuation_key: z.string().nullish(),
  })
  .passthrough();

/**
 * The page envelope as it arrives: items are checked one by one in the client
 * (`ebTransactionSchema.safeParse`), so one deviating entry (an unknown `credit_debit_indicator`,
 * a missing amount) is dropped and counted instead of failing the whole account sync.
 */
export const ebTransactionsPageEnvelopeSchema = z
  .object({
    transactions: z.array(z.unknown()),
    continuation_key: z.string().nullish(),
  })
  .passthrough();

export type EbTransactionsPage = z.infer<typeof ebTransactionsPageSchema> & {
  /** Items of this page the client dropped because they did not match `ebTransactionSchema`. */
  skipped?: number;
};
```

```ts
import { createPublicKey, generateKeyPairSync } from "node:crypto";
import { decodeProtectedHeader, jwtVerify } from "jose";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { createJwtSigner, EB_JWT_AUDIENCE, EB_JWT_ISSUER } from "./jwt";

const APPLICATION_ID = "e1d1e636-f2a9-4410-9173-2f86f638e24b";
const START_MS = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 9, 8, 0, 0);

function rsaKeys(type: "pkcs1" | "pkcs8") {
  const { privateKey, publicKey } = generateKeyPairSync("rsa", {
    modulusLength: 2048,
    publicKeyEncoding: { type: "spki", format: "pem" },
    privateKeyEncoding: { type, format: "pem" },
  });
  return { privateKeyPem: privateKey, publicKey: createPublicKey(publicKey) };
}

const PKCS8 = rsaKeys("pkcs8");
const PKCS1 = rsaKeys("pkcs1");

describe("createJwtSigner", () => {
  it("signs an RS256 token with the Enable Banking header and claims", async () => {
    const signer = createJwtSigner({
      applicationId: APPLICATION_ID,
      privateKeyPem: PKCS8.privateKeyPem,
      now: () => START_MS,
    });
    const token = await signer.token();
    const { payload, protectedHeader } = await jwtVerify(token, PKCS8.publicKey, {
      algorithms: ["RS256"],
      issuer: "enablebanking.com",
      audience: "api.enablebanking.com",
      currentDate: new Date(START_MS),
    });
    expect(protectedHeader).toEqual({ typ: "JWT", alg: "RS256", kid: APPLICATION_ID });
    expect(payload.iss).toBe(EB_JWT_ISSUER);
    expect(payload.aud).toBe(EB_JWT_AUDIENCE);
    expect(payload.iat).toBe(START_MS / 1000);
    expect((payload.exp ?? 0) - (payload.iat ?? 0)).toBe(3600);
  });

  it("reuses the cached token until fewer than 300 seconds remain", async () => {
    let now = START_MS;
    const signer = createJwtSigner({
      applicationId: APPLICATION_ID,
      privateKeyPem: PKCS8.privateKeyPem,
      now: () => now,
    });
    const first = await signer.token();
    now = START_MS + 3_299_000; // 301 s left
    expect(await signer.token()).toBe(first);
    now = START_MS + 3_300_000; // 300 s left: renew
    const renewed = await signer.token();
    expect(renewed).not.toBe(first);
    const { payload } = await jwtVerify(renewed, PKCS8.publicKey, {
      issuer: EB_JWT_ISSUER,
      audience: EB_JWT_AUDIENCE,
      currentDate: new Date(now),
    });
    expect(payload.iat).toBe((START_MS + 3_300_000) / 1000);
  });

  it("accepts PKCS#1 and PKCS#8 private keys", async () => {
    for (const keys of [PKCS1, PKCS8]) {
      const signer = createJwtSigner({
        applicationId: APPLICATION_ID,
        privateKeyPem: keys.privateKeyPem,
        now: () => START_MS,
      });
      const token = await signer.token();
      expect(decodeProtectedHeader(token).kid).toBe(APPLICATION_ID);
      await expect(
        jwtVerify(token, keys.publicKey, { currentDate: new Date(START_MS) }),
      ).resolves.toBeDefined();
    }
    expect(PKCS1.privateKeyPem).toContain("BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY");
    expect(PKCS8.privateKeyPem).toContain("BEGIN PRIVATE KEY");
  });

  it("refuses a TTL above 24 hours", () => {
    const { privateKeyPem } = PKCS8;
    const options = { applicationId: APPLICATION_ID, privateKeyPem };
    expect(() => createJwtSigner({ ...options, ttlSeconds: 86_401 })).toThrow(RangeError);
    expect(() => createJwtSigner({ ...options, ttlSeconds: 86_400 })).not.toThrow();
  });

  it("refuses a key that is not RSA", () => {
    const { privateKey } = generateKeyPairSync("ec", {
      namedCurve: "P-256",
      publicKeyEncoding: { type: "spki", format: "pem" },
      privateKeyEncoding: { type: "pkcs8", format: "pem" },
    });
    expect(() => createJwtSigner({ applicationId: APPLICATION_ID, privateKeyPem: privateKey })).toThrow(
      /RSA/,
    );
  });

  it("refuses an unreadable key without echoing it", () => {
    const pem = "-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----\nnot-a-key-0123456789\n-----END PRIVATE KEY-----";
    let message = "";
    try {
      createJwtSigner({ applicationId: APPLICATION_ID, privateKeyPem: pem });
    } catch (error) {
      message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    }
    expect(message).toMatch(/cannot be parsed/);
    expect(message).not.toContain("not-a-key");
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { classifyEbError, EnableBankingError, parseEbErrorBody } from "./errors";
import expiredSession from "./fixtures/error-expired-session.json";
import psuHeader from "./fixtures/error-psu-header.json";
import rateLimit from "./fixtures/error-rate-limit.json";

describe("classifyEbError", () => {
  it("asks for re-authorisation when the session is gone", () => {
    for (const code of [
      "EXPIRED_SESSION",
      "CLOSED_SESSION",
      "REVOKED_SESSION",
      "SESSION_DOES_NOT_EXIST",
      "WRONG_SESSION_STATUS",
    ]) {
      expect(classifyEbError(401, code)).toBe("reauth");
      expect(classifyEbError(400, code)).toBe("reauth");
    }
  });

  it("flags account-level problems", () => {
    expect(classifyEbError(404, "ACCOUNT_DOES_NOT_EXIST")).toBe("account");
    expect(classifyEbError(403, "ASPSP_ACCOUNT_NOT_ACCESSIBLE")).toBe("account");
  });

  it("recognises the bank rate limit by code or by status", () => {
    expect(classifyEbError(429, "ASPSP_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED")).toBe("rate_limited");
    expect(classifyEbError(400, "ASPSP_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED")).toBe("rate_limited");
    expect(classifyEbError(429, null)).toBe("rate_limited");
  });

  it("retries transient failures", () => {
    expect(classifyEbError(500, "ASPSP_ERROR")).toBe("retry");
    expect(classifyEbError(408, "ASPSP_TIMEOUT")).toBe("retry");
    expect(classifyEbError(0, null)).toBe("retry");
    expect(classifyEbError(408, null)).toBe("retry");
    expect(classifyEbError(500, null)).toBe("retry");
    expect(classifyEbError(503, null)).toBe("retry");
  });

  it("treats configuration and request errors as fatal", () => {
    expect(classifyEbError(401, "AUTHORIZATION_NOT_PROVIDED")).toBe("fatal");
    expect(classifyEbError(400, "REDIRECT_URI_NOT_ALLOWED")).toBe("fatal");
    expect(classifyEbError(422, "PSU_HEADER_NOT_PROVIDED")).toBe("fatal");
    expect(classifyEbError(422, "WRONG_TRANSACTIONS_PERIOD")).toBe("fatal");
    expect(classifyEbError(400, "ALREADY_AUTHORIZED")).toBe("fatal");
    expect(classifyEbError(401, null)).toBe("fatal");
    expect(classifyEbError(404, null)).toBe("fatal");
  });
});

describe("parseEbErrorBody", () => {
  it("reads the documented error bodies", () => {
    const expired = parseEbErrorBody(401, expiredSession);
    expect(expired).toBeInstanceOf(EnableBankingError);
    expect(expired).toBeInstanceOf(Error);
    expect(expired.name).toBe("EnableBankingError");
    expect([expired.status, expired.code, expired.kind]).toEqual([401, "EXPIRED_SESSION", "reauth"]);
    expect(expired.message).toBe("Enable Banking error 401 EXPIRED_SESSION: Session expired");

    const limited = parseEbErrorBody(429, rateLimit);
    expect([limited.code, limited.kind]).toEqual(["ASPSP_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED", "rate_limited"]);

    const psu = parseEbErrorBody(422, psuHeader);
    expect([psu.code, psu.kind]).toEqual(["PSU_HEADER_NOT_PROVIDED", "fatal"]);
    expect(psu.detail).toBe("PSU header psuIpAddress is not provided");
    expect(psu.message).toBe(
      "Enable Banking error 422 PSU_HEADER_NOT_PROVIDED: Required PSU header is not provided",
    );
    expect(psu.message).not.toContain("psuIpAddress");
  });

  it("tolerates missing or malformed fields", () => {
    const noCode = parseEbErrorBody(400, { message: "Bad request" });
    expect([noCode.code, noCode.detail, noCode.kind]).toEqual([null, null, "fatal"]);

    const empty = parseEbErrorBody(502, null);
    expect(empty.message).toBe("Enable Banking error 502: Unexpected response");
    expect(empty.kind).toBe("retry");

    const odd = parseEbErrorBody(400, { error: "<script>", message: 42 });
    expect(odd.code).toBeNull();
    expect(odd.message).toBe("Enable Banking error 400: Unexpected response");
  });

  it("truncates long provider messages", () => {
    const long = parseEbErrorBody(400, { message: "x".repeat(5000), error: "WRONG_REQUEST_PARAMETERS" });
    expect(long.message.length).toBeLessThan(260);
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement the JWT signer and the error classification**

`apps/server/src/eb/jwt.ts`:

```ts
import { createPrivateKey, type KeyObject } from "node:crypto";
import { SignJWT } from "jose";

export const EB_JWT_ISSUER = "enablebanking.com";
export const EB_JWT_AUDIENCE = "api.enablebanking.com";
export const EB_JWT_DEFAULT_TTL_SECONDS = 3600;
/** Enable Banking rejects tokens that live longer than 24 hours. */
export const EB_JWT_MAX_TTL_SECONDS = 86_400;
/** A cached token is replaced once it has this many seconds left or fewer. */
export const EB_JWT_RENEW_BEFORE_SECONDS = 300;

interface SignedToken {
  token: string;
  exp: number;
}

function loadRsaKey(pem: string): KeyObject {
  let key: KeyObject;
  try {
    key = createPrivateKey(pem);
  } catch {
    // Never include the PEM or the parser's message: it can quote the input.
    throw new Error("The Enable Banking private key cannot be parsed");
  }
  if (key.asymmetricKeyType !== "rsa") {
    throw new Error("The Enable Banking private key must be an RSA key");
  }
  return key;
}

/**
 * Signs the application JWT that authenticates every Enable Banking request (eb-api-notes.md §1).
 * PKCS#1 ("BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY") and PKCS#8 ("BEGIN PRIVATE KEY") PEMs both load.
 */
export function createJwtSigner(options: {
  applicationId: string;
  privateKeyPem: string;
  now?: () => number;
  ttlSeconds?: number;
}): { token(): Promise<string> } {
  const ttl = options.ttlSeconds ?? EB_JWT_DEFAULT_TTL_SECONDS;
  if (!Number.isInteger(ttl) || ttl <= EB_JWT_RENEW_BEFORE_SECONDS || ttl > EB_JWT_MAX_TTL_SECONDS) {
    throw new RangeError(
      `ttlSeconds must be an integer between ${EB_JWT_RENEW_BEFORE_SECONDS + 1} and ${EB_JWT_MAX_TTL_SECONDS}`,
    );
  }
  const now = options.now ?? Date.now;
  const key = loadRsaKey(options.privateKeyPem);
  let cached: SignedToken | null = null;
  let pending: Promise<SignedToken> | null = null;

  async function sign(iat: number): Promise<SignedToken> {
    const exp = iat + ttl;
    const token = await new SignJWT({})
      .setProtectedHeader({ typ: "JWT", alg: "RS256", kid: options.applicationId })
      .setIssuer(EB_JWT_ISSUER)
      .setAudience(EB_JWT_AUDIENCE)
      .setIssuedAt(iat)
      .setExpirationTime(exp)
      .sign(key);
    return { token, exp };
  }

  return {
    async token() {
      const nowSeconds = Math.floor(now() / 1000);
      if (cached && cached.exp - nowSeconds > EB_JWT_RENEW_BEFORE_SECONDS) return cached.token;
      if (!pending) {
        pending = sign(nowSeconds)
          .then((signed) => {
            cached = signed;
            return signed;
          })
          .finally(() => {
            pending = null;
          });
      }
      return (await pending).token;
    },
  };
}
```

`apps/server/src/eb/errors.ts`:

```ts
export type EbErrorKind = "reauth" | "account" | "rate_limited" | "retry" | "fatal";

const REAUTH_CODES = new Set([
  "EXPIRED_SESSION",
  "CLOSED_SESSION",
  "REVOKED_SESSION",
  "SESSION_DOES_NOT_EXIST",
  "WRONG_SESSION_STATUS",
]);
const ACCOUNT_CODES = new Set(["ACCOUNT_DOES_NOT_EXIST", "ASPSP_ACCOUNT_NOT_ACCESSIBLE"]);
const RETRY_CODES = new Set(["ASPSP_ERROR", "ASPSP_TIMEOUT"]);
const ERROR_CODE_PATTERN = /^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{1,63}$/;
/** Provider messages are cut to this length before they reach an error message. */
export const EB_MESSAGE_MAX_LENGTH = 200;
const DETAIL_MAX_LENGTH = 500;

/**
 * Maps an Enable Banking failure to what Bursar does next (eb-api-notes.md §9). Logic keys on the
 * `error` code first because the same HTTP status can mean different things. Status 0 means the
 * request never got an HTTP answer (network failure or timeout).
 */
export function classifyEbError(status: number, code: string | null): EbErrorKind {
  if (code && REAUTH_CODES.has(code)) return "reauth";
  if (code && ACCOUNT_CODES.has(code)) return "account";
  if (code === "ASPSP_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED" || status === 429) return "rate_limited";
  if ((code && RETRY_CODES.has(code)) || status === 0 || status === 408 || status >= 500) {
    return "retry";
  }
  return "fatal";
}

/**
 * The message holds only the HTTP status, the Enable Banking error code and the API's own message:
 * never request data, headers, tokens or the rest of the response body.
 */
export class EnableBankingError extends Error {
  readonly status: number;
  readonly code: string | null;
  readonly detail: string | null;
  readonly kind: EbErrorKind;

  constructor(status: number, code: string | null, message: string, detail: string | null = null) {
    const apiMessage = message.slice(0, EB_MESSAGE_MAX_LENGTH);
    super(`Enable Banking error ${status}${code ? ` ${code}` : ""}: ${apiMessage}`);
    this.name = "EnableBankingError";
    this.status = status;
    this.code = code;
    this.detail = detail;
    this.kind = classifyEbError(status, code);
  }
}

export function parseEbErrorBody(status: number, body: unknown): EnableBankingError {
  const record =
    typeof body === "object" && body !== null ? (body as Record<string, unknown>) : {};
  const code =
    typeof record.error === "string" && ERROR_CODE_PATTERN.test(record.error) ? record.error : null;
  const message =
    typeof record.message === "string" && record.message.trim() !== ""
      ? record.message.trim()
      : "Unexpected response";
  const detail = typeof record.detail === "string" ? record.detail.slice(0, DETAIL_MAX_LENGTH) : null;
  return new EnableBankingError(status, code, message, detail);
}
```

```ts
import transactionsPage2 from "./fixtures/transactions-page-2.json";

  modulusLength: 2048,
  publicKeyEncoding: { type: "spki", format: "pem" },
  privateKeyEncoding: { type: "pkcs8", format: "pem" },
});
const PUBLIC_KEY = createPublicKey(keys.publicKey);
const APPLICATION_ID = application.kid;
const NOW_MS = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 9, 9, 0, 0);

};

interface Reply {
  status?: number;
  body?: unknown;
  text?: string;
}

function replying(...replies: Reply[]) {
  const queue = [...replies];
  return vi.fn<typeof fetch>(async () => {
    const reply = queue.shift() ?? { status: 500, body: { message: "Unexpected call" } };
    return new Response(reply.text ?? JSON.stringify(reply.body ?? {}), {
      status: reply.status ?? 200,
      headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
    });
  });
}

function clientWith(fetchImpl: typeof fetch, extra: { timeoutMs?: number; baseUrl?: string } = {}) {
  return new EnableBankingClient({
    applicationId: APPLICATION_ID,
    privateKeyPem: keys.privateKey,
    fetch: fetchImpl,
    now: () => NOW_MS,
    ...extra,
  });
}

function sent(spy: ReturnType<typeof replying>, index = 0) {
  const call = spy.mock.calls[index];
  if (!call) throw new Error(`fetch call ${index} is missing`);
  const [input, init] = call;
  return {
    url: new URL(String(input)),
    init,
    method: init?.method,
    headers: new Headers(init?.headers),
    body: typeof init?.body === "string" ? JSON.parse(init.body) : undefined,
  };
}

function psuHeaderNames(headers: Headers): string[] {
  return [...headers.keys()].filter((name) => name.startsWith("psu-")).sort();
}

async function rejection(promise: Promise<unknown>): Promise<EnableBankingError> {
  try {
    await promise;
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof EnableBankingError) return error;
    throw error;
  }
  throw new Error("Expected an EnableBankingError");
}
```

`apps/server/src/eb/allowlist.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The only Enable Banking operations Bursar may call: account information, never payments
 * (spec §6.3, eb-api-notes.md §11). `EnableBankingClient` checks this list before signing a token
 * or touching the network. Adding an entry is a security-relevant change.
 */
export interface EbOperation {
  name: string;
  method: "GET" | "POST" | "DELETE";
  pattern: RegExp;
}

const UUID = "[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}";

const OPERATIONS: EbOperation[] = [
  { name: "getApplication", method: "GET", pattern: /^\/application$/ },
  { name: "listAspsps", method: "GET", pattern: /^\/aspsps$/ },
  { name: "startAuthorization", method: "POST", pattern: /^\/auth$/ },
  { name: "createSession", method: "POST", pattern: /^\/sessions$/ },
  { name: "getSession", method: "GET", pattern: new RegExp(`^/sessions/${UUID}$`) },
  { name: "deleteSession", method: "DELETE", pattern: new RegExp(`^/sessions/${UUID}$`) },
  { name: "getBalances", method: "GET", pattern: new RegExp(`^/accounts/${UUID}/balances$`) },
  { name: "getTransactions", method: "GET", pattern: new RegExp(`^/accounts/${UUID}/transactions$`) },
];

export const EB_ALLOWED_OPERATIONS: readonly EbOperation[] = Object.freeze(
  OPERATIONS.map((operation) => Object.freeze(operation)),
);

const UUID_GLOBAL = /[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}/g;

export class DisallowedOperationError extends Error {
  constructor(method: string, path: string) {
    const shown = JSON.stringify(path.slice(0, 120).replace(UUID_GLOBAL, "{id}"));
    super(`Enable Banking operation not allowed: ${JSON.stringify(method.slice(0, 10))} ${shown}`);
    this.name = "DisallowedOperationError";
  }
}

/** Throws unless `method` and `path` (no query string, no host) match an allowed operation. */
export function assertAllowed(method: string, path: string): EbOperation {
  const operation = EB_ALLOWED_OPERATIONS.find(
    (candidate) => candidate.method === method && candidate.pattern.test(path),
  );
  if (!operation) throw new DisallowedOperationError(method, path);
  return operation;
}
```

```ts
import type { LocalDate } from "@bursar/shared";
import type { z } from "zod";
import { assertAllowed } from "./allowlist";
import { EnableBankingError, parseEbErrorBody } from "./errors";
import { createJwtSigner } from "./jwt";
import {
  type EbApplication,
  type EbAspsp,
  type EbBalance,
  type EbSession,
  type EbSessionStatus,
  type EbStartAuthorizationRequest,
  type EbStartAuthorizationResponse,
  type EbTransaction,
  type EbTransactionsPage,
  ebApplicationSchema,
  ebAspspListSchema,
  ebBalanceSchema,
  ebBalancesResponseSchema,
  ebSessionSchema,
  ebSessionStatusSchema,
  ebStartAuthorizationResponseSchema,
  ebTransactionSchema,
  ebTransactionsPageEnvelopeSchema,
} from "./schemas";

export const EB_DEFAULT_BASE_URL = "https://api.enablebanking.com";
export const EB_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000;
const PSU_HEADER_MAX_LENGTH = 512;

/** Present only when the owner triggered the fetch from the panel (eb-api-notes.md §8). */
export interface PsuHeaders {
  ipAddress: string;
  userAgent: string;
  accept?: string;
  acceptLanguage?: string;
}

export interface TransactionsQuery {
  dateFrom?: LocalDate;
  dateTo?: LocalDate;
  strategy?: "default" | "longest";
  continuationKey?: string;
}

export interface EnableBankingApi {
  getApplication(): Promise<EbApplication>;
  listAspsps(country: string): Promise<EbAspsp[]>;
  startAuthorization(request: EbStartAuthorizationRequest): Promise<EbStartAuthorizationResponse>;
  createSession(code: string): Promise<EbSession>;
  getSession(sessionId: string): Promise<EbSessionStatus>;
  deleteSession(sessionId: string): Promise<void>;
  getBalances(accountUid: string, psu?: PsuHeaders): Promise<EbBalance[]>;
  getTransactions(
    accountUid: string,
    query: TransactionsQuery,
    psu?: PsuHeaders,
  ): Promise<EbTransactionsPage>;
}

type Method = "GET" | "POST" | "DELETE";

interface CallOptions {
  query?: Record<string, string | undefined>;
  body?: unknown;
  psu?: PsuHeaders;
}

interface CallResult {
  status: number;
  data: unknown;
}

function headerValue(value: string): string {
  // Control characters would make fetch throw; the bank needs a single printable line.
  let clean = "";
  for (const char of value.slice(0, PSU_HEADER_MAX_LENGTH)) {
    const code = char.charCodeAt(0);
    clean += code < 0x20 || code === 0x7f ? " " : char;
  }
  return clean;
}

function psuHeaders(psu: PsuHeaders): Record<string, string> {
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    "Psu-Ip-Address": headerValue(psu.ipAddress),
    "Psu-User-Agent": headerValue(psu.userAgent),
  };
  if (psu.accept) headers["Psu-Accept"] = headerValue(psu.accept);
  if (psu.acceptLanguage) headers["Psu-Accept-Language"] = headerValue(psu.acceptLanguage);
  return headers;
}

function isTimeout(error: unknown): boolean {
  return (
    typeof error === "object" &&
    error !== null &&
    "name" in error &&
    (error.name === "TimeoutError" || error.name === "AbortError")
  );
}

function transportError(error: unknown): EnableBankingError {
  // The original error can contain the URL or socket details: keep only the category.
  return new EnableBankingError(0, null, isTimeout(error) ? "Request timed out" : "Network error");
}

function validate<S extends z.ZodType>(schema: S, result: CallResult): z.output<S> {
  const parsed = schema.safeParse(result.data);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    throw new EnableBankingError(result.status, null, "Unexpected response from Enable Banking");
  }
  return parsed.data;
}

/**
 * Read-only Enable Banking client. Every request goes through the private `call`, which checks the
 * allowlist first. The prototype carries exactly the eight `EnableBankingApi` methods.
 */
export class EnableBankingClient implements EnableBankingApi {
  private readonly baseUrl: string;
  private readonly fetchImpl: typeof fetch;
  private readonly timeoutMs: number;
  private readonly signer: { token(): Promise<string> };

  constructor(options: {
    applicationId: string;
    privateKeyPem: string;
    baseUrl?: string;
    fetch?: typeof fetch;
    now?: () => number;
    timeoutMs?: number;
  }) {
    const base = new URL(options.baseUrl ?? EB_DEFAULT_BASE_URL);
    if (base.protocol !== "https:") {
      throw new Error("The Enable Banking API base URL must use https");
    }
    this.baseUrl = base.href.replace(/\/+$/, "");
    this.fetchImpl = options.fetch ?? ((input, init) => globalThis.fetch(input, init));
    this.timeoutMs = options.timeoutMs ?? EB_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS;
    this.signer = createJwtSigner({
      applicationId: options.applicationId,
      privateKeyPem: options.privateKeyPem,
      now: options.now,
    });
  }

  async getApplication(): Promise<EbApplication> {
    return validate(ebApplicationSchema, await this.call("GET", "/application"));
  }

  async listAspsps(country: string): Promise<EbAspsp[]> {
    const result = await this.call("GET", "/aspsps", {
      query: { country, psu_type: "personal", service: "AIS" },
    });
    return validate(ebAspspListSchema, result).aspsps;
  }

  async startAuthorization(
    request: EbStartAuthorizationRequest,
  ): Promise<EbStartAuthorizationResponse> {
    const result = await this.call("POST", "/auth", { body: request });
    return validate(ebStartAuthorizationResponseSchema, result);
  }

  async createSession(code: string): Promise<EbSession> {
    return validate(ebSessionSchema, await this.call("POST", "/sessions", { body: { code } }));
  }

  async getSession(sessionId: string): Promise<EbSessionStatus> {
    return validate(ebSessionStatusSchema, await this.call("GET", `/sessions/${sessionId}`));
  }

  async deleteSession(sessionId: string): Promise<void> {
    // The body is a free-form `{ message }`; only the status matters.
    await this.call("DELETE", `/sessions/${sessionId}`);
  }

  /** Balances that match `ebBalanceSchema`; a malformed item is dropped, never the response. */
  async getBalances(accountUid: string, psu?: PsuHeaders): Promise<EbBalance[]> {
    const result = await this.call("GET", `/accounts/${accountUid}/balances`, { psu });
    const balances: EbBalance[] = [];
    for (const item of validate(ebBalancesResponseSchema, result).balances) {
      const parsed = ebBalanceSchema.safeParse(item);
      if (parsed.success) balances.push(parsed.data);
    }
    return balances;
  }

  async getTransactions(
    accountUid: string,
    query: TransactionsQuery,
    psu?: PsuHeaders,
  ): Promise<EbTransactionsPage> {
    const result = await this.call("GET", `/accounts/${accountUid}/transactions`, {
      query: {
        date_from: query.dateFrom,
        date_to: query.dateTo,
        strategy: query.strategy,
        continuation_key: query.continuationKey,
      },
      psu,
    });
    const page = validate(ebTransactionsPageEnvelopeSchema, result);
    const transactions: EbTransaction[] = [];
    for (const item of page.transactions) {
      const parsed = ebTransactionSchema.safeParse(item);
      if (parsed.success) transactions.push(parsed.data);
    }
    return {
      transactions,
      continuation_key: page.continuation_key,
      skipped: page.transactions.length - transactions.length,
    };
  }

  /**
   * The single network path. An instance property (not a prototype method) so the class prototype
   * holds only the API methods. The allowlist check is the first statement.
   */
  private readonly call = async (
    method: Method,
    path: string,
    options: CallOptions = {},
  ): Promise<CallResult> => {
    assertAllowed(method, path);
    const url = new URL(`${this.baseUrl}${path}`);
    for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(options.query ?? {})) {
      if (value !== undefined) url.searchParams.set(name, value);
    }
    const headers: Record<string, string> = {
      accept: "application/json",
      authorization: `Bearer ${await this.signer.token()}`,
    };
    if (options.body !== undefined) headers["content-type"] = "application/json";
    if (options.psu) Object.assign(headers, psuHeaders(options.psu));

    let response: Response;
    let text: string;
    try {
      response = await this.fetchImpl(url.href, {
        method,
        headers,
        body: options.body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(options.body),
        redirect: "error",
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(this.timeoutMs),
      });
      text = await response.text();
    } catch (error) {
      throw transportError(error);
    }

    let data: unknown;
    try {
      data = text === "" ? null : JSON.parse(text);
    } catch {
      data = undefined;
    }
    if (!response.ok) throw parseEbErrorBody(response.status, data);
    return { status: response.status, data };
  };
}
```

```ts
import { isValidIban } from "@bursar/shared";

const PUBLIC_URL = new URL("http://127.0.0.1:4100");

  });
}

async function connect(
  bank: FakeEnableBanking,
  options: { aspspName?: string; validUntil?: string } = {},
) {
  const started = await bank.startAuthorization({
    access: { valid_until: options.validUntil ?? VALID_UNTIL },
    aspsp: { name: options.aspspName ?? FAKE_ASPSP_NAMES[0], country: "IT" },
    state: "state-0123456789abcdef",
    redirect_url: CALLBACK,
    psu_type: "personal",
    language: "it",
  });
  const redirect = new URL(started.url);
  const code = redirect.searchParams.get("code") ?? "";
  return { redirect, code, session: await bank.createSession(code) };
}

async function allTransactions(bank: FakeEnableBanking, uid: string) {
  const transactions: EbTransaction[] = [];
  let key: string | undefined;
  let pages = 0;
  do {
    const page = await bank.getTransactions(uid, key ? { continuationKey: key } : {});
    ebTransactionsPageSchema.parse(page);
    transactions.push(...page.transactions);
    key = page.continuation_key ?? undefined;
    pages += 1;
  } while (key && pages < 20);
  return { transactions, pages };
}

async function rejection(promise: Promise<unknown>): Promise<EnableBankingError> {
  try {
    await promise;
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof EnableBankingError) return error;
    throw error;
  }
  throw new Error("Expected an EnableBankingError");
}

    const wrongBank = await rejection(

    const expiredError = await rejection(

    expect([expiredError.code, expiredError.kind]).toEqual(["EXPIRED_SESSION", "reauth"]);
    expect((await bank.getSession(shortLived.session.session_id)).status).toBe("EXPIRED");
  });

  it("is deterministic for a seed and a clock", async () => {
    const amounts = async (seed: number) => {
      const bank = fakeBank({ seed });
      const { session } = await connect(bank);
      const { transactions } = await allTransactions(bank, session.accounts[0]?.uid ?? "");
      return transactions.map((tx) => tx.transaction_amount.amount);

    expect(await amounts(7)).toEqual(await amounts(7));
    expect(await amounts(7)).not.toEqual(await amounts(8));

  it("serves data for accounts and sessions it did not create (QA seed data)", async () => {
    const bank = fakeBank();
    const uid = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000abcd";
    const balances = await bank.getBalances(uid);

    expect((await bank.getTransactions(uid, {})).transactions).toHaveLength(FAKE_PAGE_SIZE);
    const status = await bank.getSession("00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000ff");
    expect(status.status).toBe("AUTHORIZED");
  });
});
```
