`apps/server/src/eb/fake.ts`:

```ts
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import type { EnableBankingApi, TransactionsQuery } from "./client";
import { EnableBankingError } from "./errors";
import type {
  EbAccountResource,
  EbApplication,
  EbAspsp,
  EbBalance,
  EbSession,
  EbSessionStatus,
  EbStartAuthorizationRequest,
  EbStartAuthorizationResponse,
  EbTransaction,
  EbTransactionsPage,
} from "./schemas";

/**
 * Deterministic, offline Enable Banking used by the QA server and the stories. All data is
 * fictional. Authorisation redirects straight back to Bursar's callback, so a connect completes
 * without leaving the machine. It never touches the network.
 */

const DAY_MS = 86_400_000;
const CALLBACK_PATH = "/api/banks/callback";
const UNKNOWN_SESSION_VALIDITY_MS = 90 * DAY_MS;

export const FAKE_COUNTRIES = ["IT", "DE", "FI"] as const;
export const FAKE_ASPSP_NAMES = ["Banca Esempio", "Northwind Bank"] as const;
export const FAKE_PAGE_SIZE = 10;
export const FAKE_TRANSACTION_COUNT = 25;

type FakeAspspName = (typeof FAKE_ASPSP_NAMES)[number];
type SessionStatusValue = EbSessionStatus["status"];

interface AccountTemplate {
  product: string;
  details: string;
  cashAccountType: "CACC" | "SVGS";
  currency: string;
}

const ACCOUNT_TEMPLATES: Record<FakeAspspName, readonly AccountTemplate[]> = {
  "Banca Esempio": [
    { product: "Conto Esempio", details: "Current account", cashAccountType: "CACC", currency: "EUR" },
    { product: "Deposito Esempio", details: "Savings account", cashAccountType: "SVGS", currency: "EUR" },
  ],
  "Northwind Bank": [
    { product: "Everyday Account", details: "Current account", cashAccountType: "CACC", currency: "EUR" },
    { product: "Dollar Account", details: "Foreign currency account", cashAccountType: "CACC", currency: "USD" },
  ],
};

const COUNTERPARTIES = [
  "Grocery Market",
  "City Utilities",
  "Coffee Corner",
  "Online Bookshop",
  "Fuel Station",
  "Pharmacy Central",
  "Mobile Operator",
  "Rail Tickets",
] as const;

function isFakeAspsp(name: string): name is FakeAspspName {
  return (FAKE_ASPSP_NAMES as readonly string[]).includes(name);
}

function sha256(text: string): Buffer {
  return createHash("sha256").update(text).digest();
}

function fakeUuid(kind: number, n: number): string {
  return `${kind.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}-0000-4000-8000-${n.toString(16).padStart(12, "0")}`;
}

function isoDate(ms: number): string {
  return new Date(ms).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

/** Non-negative integer minor units (2 decimals) to the provider's decimal string. */
function minorToAmount(minor: number): string {
  return `${Math.floor(minor / 100)}.${String(minor % 100).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

function ibanCheckDigits(country: string, bban: string): string {
  let remainder = 0;
  for (const char of `${bban}${country}00`.toUpperCase()) {
    const value = /[A-Z]/.test(char) ? char.charCodeAt(0) - 55 : Number(char);
    remainder = value >= 10 ? (remainder * 100 + value) % 97 : (remainder * 10 + value) % 97;
  }
  return String(98 - remainder).padStart(2, "0");
}

function mulberry32(seed: number): () => number {
  let state = seed >>> 0;
  return () => {
    state = (state + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
    let t = state;
    t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
    t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4_294_967_296;
  };
}

export interface FakeAccountIdentity {
  identificationHash: string;
  identificationHashes: string[];
  /** Italian IBAN with a valid checksum for `IT`, otherwise null (the account uses `bban`). */
  iban: string | null;
  bban: string;
}

/**
 * The identity of the `index`-th account the fake returns for a bank. Stable across sessions and
 * runs, so renewals map to the same Bursar accounts (eb-api-notes.md §5).
 */
export function fakeAccountIdentity(
  country: string,
  aspspName: string,
  index: number,
): FakeAccountIdentity {
  const digest = sha256(`bursar-fake:${country}:${aspspName}:${index}`);
  const identificationHash = digest.toString("base64url");
  const alternateHash = sha256(`bursar-fake-bban:${country}:${aspspName}:${index}`).toString(
    "base64url",
  );
  const accountNumber = String(
    (digest.readUInt32BE(0) % 1_000_000_000) * 1000 + (digest.readUInt16BE(4) % 1000),
  ).padStart(12, "0");
  if (country === "IT") {
    const bban = `X0999901600${accountNumber}`;
    return {
      identificationHash,
      identificationHashes: [identificationHash, alternateHash],
      iban: `IT${ibanCheckDigits("IT", bban)}${bban}`,
      bban,
    };
  }
  return {
    identificationHash,
    identificationHashes: [identificationHash, alternateHash],
    iban: null,
    bban: `${country}${accountNumber}`,
  };
}

function sessionEndedError(status: SessionStatusValue): EnableBankingError {
  switch (status) {
    case "EXPIRED":
      return new EnableBankingError(401, "EXPIRED_SESSION", "Session expired");
    case "CLOSED":
      return new EnableBankingError(400, "CLOSED_SESSION", "Session is closed");
    case "REVOKED":
      return new EnableBankingError(400, "REVOKED_SESSION", "Session is revoked");
    default:
      return new EnableBankingError(400, "WRONG_SESSION_STATUS", "Wrong session status");
  }
}

function transactionDate(tx: EbTransaction): string {
  return tx.booking_date ?? tx.value_date ?? tx.transaction_date ?? "";
}

interface IssuedCode {
  aspsp: { name: FakeAspspName; country: string };
  validUntil: string;
  used: boolean;
}

export class FakeEnableBanking implements EnableBankingApi {
  readonly sessions = new Map<string, { status: SessionStatusValue; accounts: EbAccountResource[] }>();
  private readonly publicUrl: URL;
  private readonly now: () => number;
  private readonly seed: number;
  private readonly failures = new Map<keyof EnableBankingApi, EnableBankingError[]>();
  private readonly codes = new Map<string, IssuedCode>();
  private readonly validity = new Map<string, string>();
  private counter = 0;

  constructor(options: { publicUrl: URL; now?: () => number; seed?: number }) {
    this.publicUrl = options.publicUrl;
    this.now = options.now ?? Date.now;
    this.seed = options.seed ?? 1;
  }

  failNext(method: keyof EnableBankingApi, error: EnableBankingError): void {
    const queued = this.failures.get(method) ?? [];
    queued.push(error);
    this.failures.set(method, queued);
  }

  async getApplication(): Promise<EbApplication> {
    this.takeFailure("getApplication");
    return {
      name: "Bursar (fake bank)",
      kid: fakeUuid(0xfa, 1),
      environment: "SANDBOX",
      redirect_urls: [this.callbackUrl()],
      active: true,
      countries: [...FAKE_COUNTRIES],
    };
  }

  async listAspsps(country: string): Promise<EbAspsp[]> {
    this.takeFailure("listAspsps");
    const code = country.toUpperCase();
    return FAKE_ASPSP_NAMES.map((name, index) => ({
      name,
      country: code,
      // Empty logo: the panel shows initials and the logo proxy never reaches the network in QA.
      logo: "",
      psu_types: ["personal"],
      maximum_consent_validity: (index === 0 ? 180 : 90) * 86_400,
      beta: index === 1,
      bic: null,
      required_psu_headers: ["Psu-Ip-Address", "Psu-User-Agent"],
    }));
  }

  async startAuthorization(
    request: EbStartAuthorizationRequest,
  ): Promise<EbStartAuthorizationResponse> {
    this.takeFailure("startAuthorization");
    const name = request.aspsp.name;
    if (!isFakeAspsp(name)) {
      throw new EnableBankingError(400, "WRONG_ASPSP_PROVIDED", "Wrong ASPSP provided");
    }
    if (request.redirect_url !== this.callbackUrl()) {
      throw new EnableBankingError(400, "REDIRECT_URI_NOT_ALLOWED", "Redirect URI not allowed");
    }
    this.counter += 1;
    const code = `fake-${this.counter}`;
    this.codes.set(code, {
      aspsp: { name, country: request.aspsp.country },
      validUntil: request.access.valid_until,
      used: false,
    });
    const redirect = new URL(request.redirect_url);
    redirect.searchParams.set("state", request.state);
    redirect.searchParams.set("code", code);
    return {
      url: redirect.href,
      authorization_id: fakeUuid(0xa1, this.counter),
      psu_id_hash: `fake-psu-${this.seed}`,
    };
  }

  async createSession(code: string): Promise<EbSession> {
    this.takeFailure("createSession");
    if (code.startsWith("fake-empty-")) {
      this.counter += 1;
      const sessionId = fakeUuid(0x5e, this.counter);
      const validUntil = new Date(this.now() + UNKNOWN_SESSION_VALIDITY_MS).toISOString();
      this.sessions.set(sessionId, { status: "AUTHORIZED", accounts: [] });
      this.validity.set(sessionId, validUntil);
      return {
        session_id: sessionId,
        accounts: [],
        aspsp: { name: FAKE_ASPSP_NAMES[0], country: "IT" },
        psu_type: "personal",
        access: { valid_until: validUntil },
      };
    }
    const issued = this.codes.get(code);
    if (!issued) {
      throw new EnableBankingError(400, "WRONG_AUTHORIZATION_CODE", "Wrong authorization code");
    }
    if (issued.used) {
      throw new EnableBankingError(400, "ALREADY_AUTHORIZED", "Session is already authorized");
    }
    issued.used = true;
    this.counter += 1;
    const sessionId = fakeUuid(0x5e, this.counter);
    const accounts = ACCOUNT_TEMPLATES[issued.aspsp.name].map((template, index) =>
      this.accountResource(issued.aspsp, template, index, fakeUuid(0xac, this.counter * 16 + index)),
    );
    this.sessions.set(sessionId, { status: "AUTHORIZED", accounts });
    this.validity.set(sessionId, issued.validUntil);
    return {
      session_id: sessionId,
      accounts,
      aspsp: { ...issued.aspsp },
      psu_type: "personal",
      access: { valid_until: issued.validUntil },
    };
  }

  async getSession(sessionId: string): Promise<EbSessionStatus> {
    this.takeFailure("getSession");
    const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId);
    if (!session) {
      // Sessions seeded directly into the QA database are unknown here: report them as healthy.
      return {
        status: "AUTHORIZED",
        accounts: [],
        access: { valid_until: new Date(this.now() + UNKNOWN_SESSION_VALIDITY_MS).toISOString() },
      };
    }
    this.expireIfDue(sessionId, session);
    return {
      status: session.status,
      accounts: session.accounts.flatMap((account) => (account.uid ? [account.uid] : [])),
      access: { valid_until: this.validity.get(sessionId) ?? new Date(this.now()).toISOString() },
    };
  }

  async deleteSession(sessionId: string): Promise<void> {
    this.takeFailure("deleteSession");
    const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId);
    if (session) session.status = "CLOSED";
  }

  async getBalances(accountUid: string): Promise<EbBalance[]> {
    this.takeFailure("getBalances");
    const { hash, currency } = this.accountFor(accountUid);
    const random = mulberry32(this.seedFor(hash));
    const booked = 50_000 + Math.floor(random() * 900_000);
    const available = booked - Math.floor(random() * 20_000);
    const now = this.now();
    return [
      {
        name: "Closing booked",
        balance_amount: { currency, amount: minorToAmount(booked) },
        balance_type: "CLBD",
        reference_date: isoDate(now - DAY_MS),
      },
      {
        name: "Interim available",
        balance_amount: { currency, amount: minorToAmount(available) },
        balance_type: "ITAV",
        reference_date: isoDate(now),
        last_change_date_time: new Date(now).toISOString(),
      },
    ];
  }

  async getTransactions(accountUid: string, query: TransactionsQuery): Promise<EbTransactionsPage> {
    this.takeFailure("getTransactions");
    const { hash, currency } = this.accountFor(accountUid);
    let all = this.transactionsFor(hash, currency);
    const { dateFrom, dateTo } = query;
    if (dateFrom) all = all.filter((tx) => transactionDate(tx) >= dateFrom);
    // Like the real API, `longest` ignores date_to (eb-api-notes.md §7).
    if (dateTo && query.strategy !== "longest") {
      all = all.filter((tx) => transactionDate(tx) <= dateTo);
    }
    let offset = 0;
    if (query.continuationKey !== undefined) {
      const match = /^fake-page-(\d+)$/.exec(query.continuationKey);
      if (!match) {
        throw new EnableBankingError(400, "WRONG_CONTINUATION_KEY", "Wrong continuation key");
      }
      offset = Number(match[1]);
    }
    const next = offset + FAKE_PAGE_SIZE;
    return {
      transactions: all.slice(offset, next),
      continuation_key: next < all.length ? `fake-page-${next}` : null,
    };
  }

  private callbackUrl(): string {
    return new URL(CALLBACK_PATH, this.publicUrl).href;
  }

  private takeFailure(method: keyof EnableBankingApi): void {
    const next = this.failures.get(method)?.shift();
    if (next) throw next;
  }

  private seedFor(hash: string): number {
    return sha256(`${this.seed}:${hash}`).readUInt32BE(0);
  }

  private expireIfDue(
    sessionId: string,
    session: { status: SessionStatusValue; accounts: EbAccountResource[] },
  ): void {
    const validUntil = Date.parse(this.validity.get(sessionId) ?? "");
    if (session.status === "AUTHORIZED" && Number.isFinite(validUntil) && validUntil <= this.now()) {
      session.status = "EXPIRED";
    }
  }

  private accountFor(uid: string): { hash: string; currency: string } {
    for (const [sessionId, session] of this.sessions) {
      const resource = session.accounts.find((account) => account.uid === uid);
      if (!resource) continue;
      this.expireIfDue(sessionId, session);
      if (session.status !== "AUTHORIZED") throw sessionEndedError(session.status);
      return { hash: resource.identification_hash, currency: resource.currency };
    }
    // Accounts seeded directly into the QA database: serve deterministic EUR data for them.
    return { hash: `unknown:${uid}`, currency: "EUR" };
  }

  private accountResource(
    aspsp: { name: FakeAspspName; country: string },
    template: AccountTemplate,
    index: number,
    uid: string,
  ): EbAccountResource {
    const identity = fakeAccountIdentity(aspsp.country, aspsp.name, index);
    const primary = identity.iban
      ? { identification: identity.iban, scheme_name: "IBAN" }
      : { identification: identity.bban, scheme_name: "BBAN" };
    return {
      uid,
      account_id: identity.iban ? { iban: identity.iban } : { other: primary },
      all_account_ids: [primary],
      account_servicer: { bic_fi: null, name: aspsp.name },
      name: "Example Holder",
      details: template.details,
      product: template.product,
      cash_account_type: template.cashAccountType,
      currency: template.currency,
      identification_hash: identity.identificationHash,
      identification_hashes: identity.identificationHashes,
      usage: "PRIV",
    };
  }

  private transactionsFor(hash: string, currency: string): EbTransaction[] {
    const random = mulberry32(this.seedFor(hash));
    const prefix = hash.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, "").slice(0, 8).toUpperCase();
    const now = this.now();
    const transactions: EbTransaction[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < FAKE_TRANSACTION_COUNT; i += 1) {
      const date = isoDate(now - i * 2 * DAY_MS);
      const pending = i === 0;
      const salary = i % 10 === 5;
      const minor = salary ? 215_000 : 150 + Math.floor(random() * 12_000);
      const counterparty = salary
        ? "Example Employer Ltd"
        : (COUNTERPARTIES[Math.floor(random() * COUNTERPARTIES.length)] ?? COUNTERPARTIES[0]);
      transactions.push({
        entry_reference: pending ? null : `${prefix}-${String(FAKE_TRANSACTION_COUNT - i).padStart(4, "0")}`,
        transaction_id: null,
        transaction_amount: { currency, amount: minorToAmount(minor) },
        credit_debit_indicator: salary ? "CRDT" : "DBIT",
        status: pending ? "PDNG" : "BOOK",
        booking_date: pending ? null : date,
        value_date: date,
        transaction_date: date,
        creditor: salary ? null : { name: counterparty },
        debtor: salary ? { name: counterparty } : null,
        remittance_information: salary
          ? ["Salary", `Period ${date.slice(0, 7)}`]
          : [`Card payment ${counterparty}`],
        bank_transaction_code: salary
          ? { description: "Credit transfer", code: "RCDT", sub_code: "ESCT" }
          : { description: "Card payment", code: "CCRD", sub_code: "POSD" },
      });
    }
    return transactions;
  }
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { AspspCache } from "./aspsp-cache";
import type { EnableBankingApi } from "./client";
import { EnableBankingError } from "./errors";
import aspspsFixture from "./fixtures/aspsps.json";
import { type EbAspsp, ebAspspListSchema } from "./schemas";

const ASPSPS = ebAspspListSchema.parse(aspspsFixture).aspsps;
const DAY_MS = 86_400_000;

const notStubbed = () => Promise.reject(new Error("not stubbed"));

function stubApi(overrides: Partial<EnableBankingApi>): EnableBankingApi {
  return {
    getApplication: notStubbed,
    listAspsps: notStubbed,
    startAuthorization: notStubbed,
    createSession: notStubbed,
    getSession: notStubbed,
    deleteSession: notStubbed,
    getBalances: notStubbed,
    getTransactions: notStubbed,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

describe("AspspCache", () => {
  it("caches the list per country for 24 hours", async () => {
    let now = 1_000;
    const listAspsps = vi.fn(async (country: string) =>
      ASPSPS.map((aspsp) => ({ ...aspsp, country })),
    );
    const cache = new AspspCache(stubApi({ listAspsps }), () => now);
    expect(await cache.list("IT")).toHaveLength(4);
    await cache.list("IT");
    expect(listAspsps).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    await cache.list("FI");
    expect(listAspsps).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    now += DAY_MS;
    await cache.list("IT");
    expect(listAspsps).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
  });

  it("shares one request between concurrent callers", async () => {
    let release: (value: EbAspsp[]) => void = () => {};
    const listAspsps = vi.fn(
      () =>
        new Promise<EbAspsp[]>((resolve) => {
          release = resolve;
        }),
    );
    const cache = new AspspCache(stubApi({ listAspsps }));
    const all = Promise.all([cache.list("IT"), cache.list("IT"), cache.list("IT")]);
    release(ASPSPS);
    const results = await all;
    expect(listAspsps).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(results.map((list) => list.length)).toEqual([4, 4, 4]);
  });

  it("does not cache failures", async () => {
    const listAspsps = vi
      .fn<(country: string) => Promise<EbAspsp[]>>()
      .mockRejectedValueOnce(new EnableBankingError(500, "ASPSP_ERROR", "Bank unavailable"))
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(ASPSPS);
    const cache = new AspspCache(stubApi({ listAspsps }));
    await expect(cache.list("IT")).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(EnableBankingError);
    expect(await cache.list("IT")).toHaveLength(4);
    expect(listAspsps).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  });

  it("finds a bank by its exact name", async () => {
    const cache = new AspspCache(stubApi({ listAspsps: async () => ASPSPS }));
    expect((await cache.find("IT", "Banca Esempio"))?.maximum_consent_validity).toBe(7_776_000);
    expect(await cache.find("IT", "banca esempio")).toBeNull();
    expect(await cache.find("IT", "Unknown Bank")).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

```ts
import { Hono } from "hono";
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";

const PUBLIC_URL = new URL("https://bursar.example.test");
const APPLICATION = ebApplicationSchema.parse(applicationFixture);
const ASPSPS = ebAspspListSchema.parse(aspspsFixture).aspsps;
const PNG = new Uint8Array([0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a]);

  return {
    getApplication: notStubbed,
    listAspsps: notStubbed,
    startAuthorization: notStubbed,
    createSession: notStubbed,
    getSession: notStubbed,
    deleteSession: notStubbed,
    getBalances: notStubbed,
    getTransactions: notStubbed,
    ...overrides,
  };

function bare(deps: Parameters<typeof bankRoutes>[0]) {
  return new Hono<AppEnv>().route("/api/banks", bankRoutes(deps));

function configured(extra: { logoFetch?: typeof fetch; now?: () => number } = {}) {

const png = () => new Response(PNG, { status: 200, headers: { "content-type": "image/png" } });

  it("caches the application for ten minutes", async () => {

  it("reports an Enable Banking error code on the status without failing", async () => {

    expect(res.status).toBe(200);

  it("never fetches a client-supplied URL", async () => {
    const logoFetch = imageFetch(png);

    expect(smuggled.status).toBe(200);
    const asName = await app.request(

    expect(asName.status).toBe(404);
    expect(logoFetch.mock.calls.map((call) => String(call[0]))).toEqual([NORTHWIND_LOGO]);

  it("answers 404 for unknown banks, insecure logos and unfetchable images", async () => {

    expect((await app.request("/api/banks/logo?country=IT&name=Cassa%20Demo%202")).status).toBe(404);
    expect(logoFetch).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect((await app.request("/api/banks/logo?country=IT&name=Banca%20Esempio")).status).toBe(404);
    expect(logoFetch).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect((await app.request("/api/banks/logo?country=IT")).status).toBe(400);
    const unconfigured = bare({ api: null, aspsps: null, publicUrl: PUBLIC_URL });
    expect((await unconfigured.request("/api/banks/logo?country=IT&name=Banca%20Esempio")).status).toBe(

  it("rejects an oversize logo", async () => {

    expect((await app.request("/api/banks/logo?country=IT&name=Cassa%20Demo%2010")).status).toBe(404);

  it("rejects a logo that is not an image", async () => {
    const logoFetch = imageFetch(
      () => new Response("<html></html>", { status: 200, headers: { "content-type": "text/html" } }),
    );
    const { app } = configured({ logoFetch });
    expect((await app.request("/api/banks/logo?country=IT&name=Northwind%20Bank")).status).toBe(404);

  it("follows https redirects only", async () => {
    const redirectTo = (location: string) =>
      new Response(null, { status: 302, headers: { location } });

      .fn<typeof fetch>()

    const second = configured({ logoFetch: insecure });
    expect(
      (await second.app.request("/api/banks/logo?country=IT&name=Northwind%20Bank")).status,
    ).toBe(404);
    expect(insecure).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);

  it("requires a session when mounted in the app", async () => {
    const database = createTestDatabase();
    try {
      const api = stubApi({ getApplication: async () => APPLICATION });
      const t = await createTestApp({

```

The per-route `Content-Security-Policy` is asserted on a bare router: inside `createApp`, Hono's `secureHeaders` middleware writes its headers after `next()` and replaces the route's CSP with the panel CSP (`default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; …`, which still blocks inline script in an SVG opened directly). This is reported to the reviewer; Task 10 does not modify `http/app.ts`.

`apps/server/src/eb/aspsp-cache.ts`:

```ts
import type { EnableBankingApi } from "./client";
import type { EbAspsp } from "./schemas";

export const ASPSP_CACHE_TTL_MS = 24 * 3_600_000;

/** Bank lists per country, kept for a day; failures are not cached. */
export class AspspCache {
  private readonly entries = new Map<string, { fetchedAt: number; aspsps: EbAspsp[] }>();
  private readonly inflight = new Map<string, Promise<EbAspsp[]>>();

  constructor(
    private readonly api: EnableBankingApi,
    private readonly now: () => number = Date.now,
    private readonly ttlMs: number = ASPSP_CACHE_TTL_MS,
  ) {}

  async list(country: string): Promise<EbAspsp[]> {
    const key = country.toUpperCase();
    const entry = this.entries.get(key);
    if (entry && this.now() - entry.fetchedAt < this.ttlMs) return entry.aspsps;
    const running = this.inflight.get(key);
    if (running) return running;
    const request = this.api
      .listAspsps(key)
      .then((aspsps) => {
        this.entries.set(key, { fetchedAt: this.now(), aspsps });
        return aspsps;
      })
      .finally(() => {
        this.inflight.delete(key);
      });
    this.inflight.set(key, request);
    return request;
  }

  async find(country: string, name: string): Promise<EbAspsp | null> {
    return (await this.list(country)).find((aspsp) => aspsp.name === name) ?? null;
  }
}
```

`apps/server/src/eb/logo.ts`:

```ts
export const LOGO_MAX_BYTES = 256 * 1024;
export const LOGO_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;
export const LOGO_CACHE_ENTRIES = 200;
export const LOGO_CACHE_TTL_MS = 24 * 3_600_000;
const MAX_REDIRECTS = 3;
const IMAGE_TYPES = new Set(["image/png", "image/jpeg", "image/webp", "image/gif", "image/svg+xml"]);

interface CachedLogo {
  body: Buffer;
  contentType: string;
  expiresAt: number;
}

/** Least recently used first (Map keeps insertion order; a hit is re-inserted at the end). */
const cache = new Map<string, CachedLogo>();

/** For tests: forget every cached logo. */
export function clearLogoCache(): void {
  cache.clear();
}

function httpsUrl(value: string, base?: URL): URL | null {
  try {
    const url = new URL(value, base);
    return url.protocol === "https:" && url.username === "" && url.password === "" ? url : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

async function readCapped(response: Response, limit: number): Promise<Buffer | null> {
  const declared = Number(response.headers.get("content-length") ?? "0");
  if (declared > limit || !response.body) {
    await response.body?.cancel();
    return null;
  }
  const reader = response.body.getReader();
  const chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
  let total = 0;
  for (;;) {
    const { done, value } = await reader.read();
    if (done) break;
    total += value.byteLength;
    if (total > limit) {
      await reader.cancel();
      return null;
    }
    chunks.push(value);
  }
  return Buffer.concat(chunks, total);
}

function remember(url: string, body: Buffer, contentType: string, now: number): void {
  cache.set(url, { body, contentType, expiresAt: now + LOGO_CACHE_TTL_MS });
  while (cache.size > LOGO_CACHE_ENTRIES) {
    const oldest = cache.keys().next().value;
    if (oldest === undefined) break;
    cache.delete(oldest);
  }
}

/**
 * Fetches a bank logo for the panel (the CSP allows only same-origin images). The URL must come
 * from Enable Banking's ASPSP data, never from a client. https only, also on redirects; image types
 * only; at most 256 KiB, enforced while reading. Returns null on any failure.
 */
export async function fetchLogo(
  url: string,
  fetchImpl: typeof fetch,
): Promise<{ body: Buffer; contentType: string } | null> {
  const now = Date.now();
  const hit = cache.get(url);
  if (hit) {
    cache.delete(url);
    if (hit.expiresAt > now) {
      cache.set(url, hit);
      return { body: hit.body, contentType: hit.contentType };
    }
  }
  const first = httpsUrl(url);
  if (!first) return null;
  let target = first;
  try {
    const signal = AbortSignal.timeout(LOGO_TIMEOUT_MS);
    for (let hop = 0; hop <= MAX_REDIRECTS; hop += 1) {
      const response = await fetchImpl(target.href, {
        redirect: "manual",
        signal,
        headers: { accept: "image/*" },
      });
      if (response.status >= 300 && response.status < 400) {
        await response.body?.cancel();
        const next = httpsUrl(response.headers.get("location") ?? "", target);
        if (!next) return null;
        target = next;
        continue;
      }
      if (response.status !== 200) {
        await response.body?.cancel();
        return null;
      }
      const contentType = (response.headers.get("content-type") ?? "")
        .split(";")[0]
        ?.trim()
        .toLowerCase();
      if (!contentType || !IMAGE_TYPES.has(contentType)) {
        await response.body?.cancel();
        return null;
      }
      const body = await readCapped(response, LOGO_MAX_BYTES);
      if (!body || body.length === 0) return null;
      remember(url, body, contentType, now);
      return { body, contentType };
    }
    return null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}
```

`apps/server/src/eb/routes.ts`:

```ts
import {
  type AspspListResponse,
  type AspspSummary,
  aspspQuerySchema,
  type BankStatusResponse,
  logoQuerySchema,
} from "@bursar/shared";
import { Hono } from "hono";
import type { AppEnv } from "../http/app";
import type { AspspCache } from "./aspsp-cache";
import type { EnableBankingApi } from "./client";
import { EnableBankingError } from "./errors";
import { fetchLogo } from "./logo";
import type { EbApplication, EbAspsp } from "./schemas";

export const BANK_CALLBACK_PATH = "/api/banks/callback";
export const APPLICATION_CACHE_MS = 10 * 60_000;
const LOGO_CSP = "default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'";
const SECONDS_PER_DAY = 86_400;

const NOT_FOUND = { error: "Not found" } as const;
const INVALID_REQUEST = { error: "Invalid request", code: "invalid_request" } as const;

function hasHttpsLogo(logo: string): boolean {
  try {
    return new URL(logo).protocol === "https:";
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function sameUrl(candidate: string, expected: string): boolean {
  try {
    return new URL(candidate).href === expected;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function toSummary(aspsp: EbAspsp): AspspSummary {
  return {
    name: aspsp.name,
    country: aspsp.country,
    maximumConsentDays: Math.floor(aspsp.maximum_consent_validity / SECONDS_PER_DAY),
    beta: aspsp.beta,
    hasLogo: hasHttpsLogo(aspsp.logo),
  };
}

function statusErrorCode(error: EnableBankingError): string {
  if (error.code) return error.code;
  return error.status === 0 ? "unreachable" : `http_${error.status}`;
}

export function bankRoutes(deps: {
  api: EnableBankingApi | null;
  aspsps: AspspCache | null;
  publicUrl: URL;
  fetchLogo?: typeof fetch;
  now?: () => number;
}): Hono<AppEnv> {
  const router = new Hono<AppEnv>();
  const now = deps.now ?? Date.now;
  const logoFetch: typeof fetch = deps.fetchLogo ?? ((input, init) => globalThis.fetch(input, init));
  const callbackUrl = new URL(BANK_CALLBACK_PATH, deps.publicUrl).href;
  const collator = new Intl.Collator("en", { numeric: true, sensitivity: "base" });
  let application: { fetchedAt: number; value: EbApplication } | null = null;

  router.get("/status", async (c) => {
    const api = deps.api;
    if (!api) {
      const body: BankStatusResponse = {
        configured: false,
        environment: null,
        active: null,
        redirectUrlAllowed: null,
        countries: [],
        error: null,
      };
      return c.json(body);
    }
    try {
      if (!application || now() - application.fetchedAt >= APPLICATION_CACHE_MS) {
        application = { fetchedAt: now(), value: await api.getApplication() };
      }
      const value = application.value;
      const body: BankStatusResponse = {
        configured: true,
        environment: value.environment,
        active: value.active,
        redirectUrlAllowed: value.redirect_urls.some((url) => sameUrl(url, callbackUrl)),
        countries: [...value.countries].sort(),
        error: null,
      };
      return c.json(body);
    } catch (error) {
      if (!(error instanceof EnableBankingError)) throw error;
      const body: BankStatusResponse = {
        configured: true,
        environment: null,
        active: null,
        redirectUrlAllowed: null,
        countries: [],
        error: statusErrorCode(error),
      };
      return c.json(body);
    }
  });

  router.get("/aspsps", async (c) => {
    const parsed = aspspQuerySchema.safeParse({ country: c.req.query("country") });
    if (!parsed.success) return c.json(INVALID_REQUEST, 400);
    if (!deps.api || !deps.aspsps) {
      return c.json(
        { error: "Enable Banking is not configured", code: "banking_not_configured" },
        503,
      );
    }
    let list: EbAspsp[];
    try {
      list = await deps.aspsps.list(parsed.data.country);
    } catch (error) {
      if (!(error instanceof EnableBankingError)) throw error;
      return c.json({ error: "The bank list is unavailable", code: "bank_list_unavailable" }, 502);
    }
    const body: AspspListResponse = {
      aspsps: list.map(toSummary).sort((a, b) => collator.compare(a.name, b.name)),
    };
    return c.json(body);
  });

  router.get("/logo", async (c) => {
    const parsed = logoQuerySchema.safeParse({
      country: c.req.query("country"),
      name: c.req.query("name"),
    });
    if (!parsed.success) return c.json(INVALID_REQUEST, 400);
    if (!deps.aspsps) return c.json(NOT_FOUND, 404);
    let aspsp: EbAspsp | null;
    try {
      aspsp = await deps.aspsps.find(parsed.data.country, parsed.data.name);
    } catch (error) {
      if (!(error instanceof EnableBankingError)) throw error;
      return c.json(NOT_FOUND, 404);
    }
    if (!aspsp || !hasHttpsLogo(aspsp.logo)) return c.json(NOT_FOUND, 404);
    const logo = await fetchLogo(aspsp.logo, logoFetch);
    if (!logo) return c.json(NOT_FOUND, 404);
    return c.body(new Uint8Array(logo.body), 200, {
      "Content-Type": logo.contentType,
      "Cache-Control": "private, max-age=86400",
      "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff",
      "Content-Security-Policy": LOGO_CSP,
    });
  });

  return router;
}
```

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: Task 6 repository, `AuditLog`, `accountDisplayName`; Task 7 `enqueueUnique`, `SYNC_ACCOUNT_JOB`, `syncDedupeKey`, `DELETE_SESSION_JOB`, `EventBus`, `MountedRouter`; Task 8 `SettingsStore`; Task 10 `EnableBankingApi`, `AspspCache`, `EnableBankingError`, `EbAccountResource`; Task 1 `maskIban`, `maskIdentifier`, `identifierLast4`, `normalizeIban`.
- Produces:
  - `@bursar/shared` `connect.ts`: `startConnectionRequestSchema = z.object({ aspspName: z.string().min(1).max(200), aspspCountry: z.string().regex(/^[A-Z]{2}$/), consentDays: z.number().int().min(1).max(365).optional() })`; `renewConnectionRequestSchema = z.object({ consentDays: z.number().int().min(1).max(365).optional() })`; `StartConnectionResponse { redirectUrl: string }`; `completeConnectionRequestSchema = z.object({ state: z.string().min(16).max(256), code: z.string().max(512).optional(), error: z.string().max(200).optional(), errorDescription: z.string().max(512).optional() })`; `ConnectedAccount { id: number; name: string; maskedIdentifier: string | null; currency: string; status: AccountStatus }`; `CompleteConnectionResponse { outcome: "connected" | "renewed" | "no_accounts" | "denied" | "failed"; connectionId: number | null; bankName: string; accounts: ConnectedAccount[]; errorCode: string | null }`.
  - `finance/account-mapping.ts`: `interface MappableAccount { id: number; identificationHash: string; iban: string | null; status: AccountStatus }`; `mapAccounts(existing: readonly MappableAccount[], incoming: readonly EbAccountResource[]): { matched: { accountId: number; resource: EbAccountResource }[]; created: EbAccountResource[]; missing: number[] }` (match by `identification_hash` ∈ existing hash, or any of `identification_hashes` equal to the existing hash, else normalised IBAN equality; each existing account matched at most once; `missing` excludes `removed`); `accountFieldsFromResource(resource: EbAccountResource): { providerAccountUid: string | null; identificationHash: string; iban: string | null; maskedIdentifier: string | null; last4: string | null; product: string | null; details: string | null; currency: string; cashAccountType: string | null }` (holder `name` is not stored).
  - `finance/connect.ts`: `class ConnectService { constructor(deps: { repo: FinanceRepository; api: EnableBankingApi; aspsps: AspspCache; queue: JobQueue; bus: EventBus; audit: AuditLog; settings: SettingsStore; publicUrl: URL; timezone: string; now?: () => number; randomState?: () => string }); start(input: StartConnectionRequest): Promise<StartConnectionResponse>; renew(connectionId: number, input: RenewConnectionRequest): Promise<StartConnectionResponse>; complete(input: CompleteConnectionRequest): Promise<CompleteConnectionResponse> }`; `class ConnectError extends Error { status: 400 | 404 | 409 | 410 | 502 | 503; code: string }`; `AUTH_REQUEST_TTL_MS = 30 * 60_000`; `CONSENT_SAFETY_MARGIN_MS = 10 * 60_000`.
  - `finance/callback.ts`: `bankCallbackRoutes(): Hono<AppEnv>` mounted as a public router at `/api/banks/callback` (`GET /`): 303 to `/connect/callback?` with only `state`, `code`, `error`, `error_description` copied (each truncated to 512 chars), headers `Cache-Control: no-store`, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`; no session required; never logs the query.
  - `finance/connect-routes.ts`: `connectRoutes(deps: { service: ConnectService | null }): Hono<AppEnv>` mounted at `/api/connections`: `POST /` (body `StartConnectionRequest`) → `StartConnectionResponse`; `POST /complete` (body `CompleteConnectionRequest`) → `CompleteConnectionResponse`; `POST /:connectionId/renew` (body `RenewConnectionRequest`) → `StartConnectionResponse`; errors: 400 `invalid_request`, 404 `not_found` (connection) or `unknown_bank` (ASPSP not in the list), 409 `connection_removed`, 410 `state_invalid` (unknown, expired or used state), 502 `bank_error` (with the EB `error` code in `code` when it is one of `REDIRECT_URI_NOT_ALLOWED`, `WRONG_ASPSP_PROVIDED`), 503 `banking_not_configured` when the service is null.
  - `server.ts`: constructs `ConnectService` when `ebApi` exists; mounts `bankCallbackRoutes` in `publicRouters` and `connectRoutes` in `routers`; adds the cleanup `{ name: "auth-requests", run: () => repo.purgeExpiredAuthRequests() }`.

**Requirements:**
- `start`: ASPSP from `AspspCache.find` (404 `unknown_bank` when missing); `valid_until = now + min(maximum_consent_validity s, (consentDays ?? settings.consentDays) days) − CONSENT_SAFETY_MARGIN_MS`, formatted RFC 3339 with `+00:00`; `state` = 32 random bytes base64url, stored as sha256 hex with `purpose: "connect"`, expiry 30 min; `redirect_url = new URL("/api/banks/callback", publicUrl)`; `language = settings.locale`; `psu_type: "personal"`; saves `settings.country` when it is null. `renew` does the same with `purpose: "renew"` and the connection's ASPSP; 409 for a removed connection.
- `complete` (spec §6.3 step 3; the code exchange runs on an authenticated, Origin-checked POST because `SameSite=Strict` cookies are not sent on the bank's cross-site redirect): consume the state (410 otherwise); `error` present → `denied` for `access_denied`, else `failed` with `errorCode = error`; `createSession(code)` errors → `failed` with the EB code (`EXPIRED_AUTHORIZATION_CODE`, `WRONG_AUTHORIZATION_CODE`, `ALREADY_AUTHORIZED`…); empty `accounts` → best-effort `deleteSession` (enqueue `DELETE_SESSION_JOB` on failure) and outcome `no_accounts` (restricted-mode guidance in the UI), the renewed connection unchanged.
- Connect purpose: if any returned account maps (by `mapAccounts`) to an account of a non-removed connection of the same ASPSP, handle the completion as a renewal of that connection; otherwise create the connection (status `active`, `valid_until` from the session response, `aspsp_logo_url` from the cache) and its accounts; accounts that match a `removed` account still holding data are re-attached (status `active`, history kept). Accounts without `uid` are created with status `unavailable`.
- Renewal purpose: update the connection's `provider_session_id`, `valid_until`, `status = active`, clear `last_error_*`, `renewed_at = now`; matched accounts get the new `provider_account_uid` and status `active` (unless `disabled`, which stays); created accounts are added; `missing` accounts become `unavailable`; the old session is closed through `DELETE_SESSION_JOB` (never synchronously blocking the response); publish `connection.updated`.
- Enqueue one sync per active account with `enqueueUnique`: trigger `initial` for a new connection and for created or re-attached accounts with no transactions, `renewal` otherwise. Audit `connection.create` or `connection.renew` with counts only.
- All writes for one completion run in `repo.transaction`; the EB calls happen outside it.
- Tests (stub `EnableBankingApi`, injected clock and state generator): valid-until clamp by bank maximum and by settings; margin; state hashing and single use (second complete → 410); expired state; denied and failed outcomes; empty accounts with session deletion; connect creating accounts and enqueueing `initial` syncs; connect turning into renewal for known accounts; re-attaching a removed account; renewal mapping by hash, by alternate hash and by IBAN; missing → `unavailable`; disabled stays disabled; callback redirect copies only the allowed params and sets the headers; `/api/banks/callback` works without a session cookie while `/api/connections/complete` requires one.
- Commit: `feat(server): add the bank connect flow and consent renewal`.

**Implementation notes (read before starting):**
- Prerequisites: Tasks 1, 6, 7, 8 and 10 are committed on `feat/m1-accounts`. This task touches no UI, so no Playwright QA run applies (the panel side is Task 20).
- Security model, in one place:
  - The bank redirects the browser to `GET /api/banks/callback`. That request is cross-site, so the `SameSite=Strict` session cookie is not sent (codebase-map §1.12). The route is therefore public, does no work and only answers `303` to the panel page `/connect/callback` with the four known parameters re-encoded (nothing else is forwarded, values are cut to 512 characters, the target is always a relative path), plus `Cache-Control: no-store` and `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`. The request log already records only the path, never the query.
  - The code exchange runs in `POST /api/connections/complete`, an ordinary `/api` route behind `requireSession` and the Origin check. The panel page posts the parameters once it is same-site again.
  - The `state` is 32 random bytes (base64url, 43 characters). Only its sha256 hex is stored (`bank_auth_requests.state_hash`). `consumeAuthRequest` (Task 6) is a single atomic `UPDATE … RETURNING` that checks `consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > now`, so the state is single-use and valid for 30 minutes (`AUTH_REQUEST_TTL_MS`). It is consumed only after the request body proved to carry a `code` or an `error`.
  - Nothing in this task logs. Error responses are generic English messages plus a stable `code`. The `state`, the authorisation code, provider session ids and IBANs never appear in a response body or an error message. The account holder `name` from Enable Banking is never stored.
  - `startAuthorization`'s `url` is checked before the panel navigates to it: `https:`, or the panel's own origin (the local fake bank of Task 10 redirects straight back to an `http://127.0.0.1` QA server). A `javascript:` or plain-http third-party URL becomes `502 bank_error`.
- `valid_until` = `now + min(maximum_consent_validity × 1000, (request consentDays ?? settings.consentDays) days) − 10 min`, formatted `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sss+00:00`. A bank maximum that is not longer than the margin is refused with `502 bank_error` before any call. The connection stores the `valid_until` echoed by `POST /sessions` (Enable Banking examples use microseconds, `Date.parse` accepts them). When that value is not parsable the requested end stored on the auth request is used.
- Completion rules (`ConnectService.complete`):
  - `error=access_denied` → `denied`; any other `error` → `failed` with `errorCode = error`; no code exchange in either case.
  - `createSession` throws an `EnableBankingError` → `failed` with its `code` (`bank_error` when the body had none). The one exception is `NO_ACCOUNTS_ADDED` → `no_accounts` (eb-api-notes §10: restricted mode, no linked account). Any other error is a bug and propagates (500 through `app.onError`).
  - Empty `accounts` → `deleteSession` right away. If that fails, a `bank.delete-session` job is queued. Outcome `no_accounts`. A renewed connection is left untouched.
  - Target connection: for a renewal, the connection it was started for while it is not removed. Otherwise (a connect, or a renewal whose connection was disconnected in the meantime), a live connection of the same ASPSP (name and country) that already holds at least one of the returned accounts according to `mapAccounts`. The one holding most of them wins, the newest on a tie. With a target the completion is a renewal (`renewed`), otherwise a new connection (`connected`).
  - New accounts first look for a `removed` account with the same identity (`findAccountsByIdentity`, then `mapAccounts` so each removed row is re-attached at most once). A match is re-attached: same row, new `connection_id`, status `active` (or `unavailable` without `uid`), `removed_at` cleared, history kept. Otherwise a row is created. Accounts without `uid` are `unavailable`.
  - Renewal: matched accounts get every bank-provided field again (new uid, refreshed hash, product, details, masked identifier), status `active`/`unavailable`, except `disabled`, which stays `disabled`. Missing accounts lose their uid (it died with the old session) and become `unavailable`, except `disabled` ones, which stay `disabled` so a renewal never brings an excluded account back into the totals. The connection gets the new session id, `valid_until`, `status = active`, cleared `last_error_*`, `renewed_at` and `status_checked_at = now` (Task 14's daily `getSession` check starts from here). The old session id goes into a `bank.delete-session` job, so closing it never blocks the response.
  - Sync trigger, one rule for every case: an `active` account with no stored transaction gets `initial` (longest history), otherwise `renewal`. Accounts that are not `active` get no sync. Jobs go through `enqueueUnique(SYNC_ACCOUNT_JOB, syncDedupeKey(id), …)`, so an already queued sync is reused (it reads the new uid when it runs).
  - Every database write of one completion (connection, accounts, jobs, audit) runs inside `repo.transaction`. The Enable Banking calls (`createSession`, the ASPSP lookup for the logo) happen before it, and there is no `await` between choosing the target and committing. Audit rows hold counts only: `connection.create` `{ accounts, reattached, syncsQueued }`, `connection.renew` `{ matched, created, reattached, missing, syncsQueued }`, with target `connection:<id>`. After the commit `connection.updated` is published with the effective status.
- `start` saves `settings.country` when it is still null and publishes `settings.updated`.
- `connectRoutes` answers 503 inside each handler, never through `routes.use("*")`. A wildcard middleware mounted at `/api/connections` would also run for Task 13's `POST /api/connections/:id/sync` and Task 14's `DELETE /api/connections/:id`, which must work without Enable Banking. `POST /:connectionId/renew` accepts an empty body (the configured duration applies).
- Assumptions about earlier tasks, checked by the type checker. If one differs, keep the values and adapt only the object shape, then record it in the commit body:
  - Task 6 `NewConnection` and `NewAccount` are the row types without `id`, `createdAt` and `updatedAt`; `NewAuthRequest` is `AuthRequestRow` without `id`, `createdAt` and `consumedAt`. The repository stamps `createdAt`/`updatedAt` with its injected clock. `listAccounts` returns rows ordered by id. `AuthRequestRow.purpose` is `"connect" | "renew"`.
  - Task 10 `EbAspsp` is a passthrough object (index signature). The fixture carries the documented `auth_methods: []`; drop that one line if the type rejects unknown keys.
  - Task 10 `EnableBankingError` instances are built with `parseEbErrorBody(status, body)`, which reads `error` into `code` and leaves `code` null for a non-JSON body.
  - Task 7 `TestApp.cookie` is a ready `Cookie` header value (`bursar_session=<token>`), and `createTestApp` mounts `publicRouters` before `requireSession`.
- Fixtures follow `eb-api-notes.md` §2, §3, §5 and §9 (field names, uuid formats, microsecond `valid_until`, `ErrorResponse` bodies) with fictional data only. The IBANs use the unassigned Italian bank code 99001 with valid check digits (`IT89X9900101600000000001001`, `IT28X9900101600000000002002`, `IT64X9900101600000000003003`). The card number is `5100000000005678`, the holder is "Alex Example", and the logo hosts are under `example.test`.

- [ ] **Step 2: Add the shared connect DTOs**

Create `packages/shared/src/connect.ts`:

```ts
import { z } from "zod";
import type { AccountStatus } from "./finance";

/** Body of `POST /api/connections`: the bank exactly as `GET /api/banks/aspsps` lists it. */
export const startConnectionRequestSchema = z.object({
  aspspName: z.string().min(1).max(200),
  aspspCountry: z.string().regex(/^[A-Z]{2}$/),
  consentDays: z.number().int().min(1).max(365).optional(),
});
export type StartConnectionRequest = z.infer<typeof startConnectionRequestSchema>;

/** Body of `POST /api/connections/:connectionId/renew`. */
export const renewConnectionRequestSchema = z.object({
  consentDays: z.number().int().min(1).max(365).optional(),
});
export type RenewConnectionRequest = z.infer<typeof renewConnectionRequestSchema>;

export interface StartConnectionResponse {
  /** The bank's consent page; the panel navigates the whole window to it. */
  redirectUrl: string;
}

/** Body of `POST /api/connections/complete`: the callback parameters the panel page received. */
export const completeConnectionRequestSchema = z.object({
  state: z.string().min(16).max(256),
  code: z.string().max(512).optional(),
  error: z.string().max(200).optional(),
  errorDescription: z.string().max(512).optional(),
});
export type CompleteConnectionRequest = z.infer<typeof completeConnectionRequestSchema>;

export type ConnectOutcome = "connected" | "renewed" | "no_accounts" | "denied" | "failed";

export interface ConnectedAccount {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  maskedIdentifier: string | null;
  currency: string;
  status: AccountStatus;
}

export interface CompleteConnectionResponse {
  outcome: ConnectOutcome;
  connectionId: number | null;
  bankName: string;
  accounts: ConnectedAccount[];
  /** Enable Banking or callback error code for `failed`; null otherwise. */
  errorCode: string | null;
}
```

In `packages/shared/src/index.ts` add the line `export * from "./connect";` next to the other `export *` lines (Biome sorts them in Step 18).

These are declarations only (schemas copied from the contract); their behaviour is covered by the route tests in Step 12.

Create `apps/server/src/test/bank-stub.ts`:

```ts
import type { EnableBankingApi } from "../eb/client";
import { type EnableBankingError, parseEbErrorBody } from "../eb/errors";
import type {
  EbAccountResource,
  EbApplication,
  EbAspsp,
  EbBalance,
  EbSession,
  EbSessionStatus,
  EbStartAuthorizationRequest,
  EbStartAuthorizationResponse,
  EbTransactionsPage,
} from "../eb/schemas";

/**
 * Test kit for the connect flow: an in-memory `EnableBankingApi` and fixtures shaped like the
 * documented Enable Banking responses (eb-api-notes §2, §3, §5, §9). All data is fictional: the
 * IBANs use the unassigned bank code 99001 with valid check digits.
 */

export const BANK_NAME = "Banca Esempio";
export const OTHER_BANK_NAME = "Northwind Bank";
export const AUTH_URL =
  "https://auth.enablebanking.com/ais/start?sessionid=7d1f0c3e-2b4a-4c5d-8e6f-000000000001";

export const IBAN_CURRENT = "IT89X9900101600000000001001";
export const IBAN_SAVINGS = "IT28X9900101600000000002002";
export const IBAN_USD = "IT64X9900101600000000003003";
export const CARD_NUMBER = "5100000000005678";

export const HASH_CURRENT = "hash-current";
export const HASH_SAVINGS = "hash-savings";
export const HASH_USD = "hash-usd";
export const HASH_CARD = "hash-card";

/** Account uid as returned by `POST /sessions` (uuid). */
export function testUid(n: number): string {
  return `00000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(n).padStart(12, "0")}`;
}

/** Session id as returned by `POST /sessions` (uuid4). */
export function testSessionId(n: number): string {
  return `5e550000-0000-4000-8000-${String(n).padStart(12, "0")}`;
}

export function aspspFixture(overrides: Partial<EbAspsp> = {}): EbAspsp {
  return {
    name: BANK_NAME,
    country: "IT",
    logo: "https://logos.example.test/banca-esempio.png",
    psu_types: ["personal", "business"],
    auth_methods: [],
    maximum_consent_validity: 15_552_000,
    beta: false,
    bic: "BESPITM1XXX",
    required_psu_headers: null,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

export type AccountKind = "current" | "savings" | "usd" | "card";

const SERVICER = { bic_fi: "BESPITM1XXX", name: BANK_NAME };

function ibanAccount(
  uid: number,
  iban: string,
  hash: string,
  product: string,
  cashAccountType: string,
  currency: string,
): EbAccountResource {
  return {
    uid: testUid(uid),
    account_id: { iban },
    all_account_ids: [{ identification: iban, scheme_name: "IBAN" }],
    account_servicer: SERVICER,
    name: "Alex Example",
    details: null,
    product,
    cash_account_type: cashAccountType,
    currency,
    identification_hash: hash,
    identification_hashes: [hash, `${hash}-bban`],
    usage: "PRIV",
  };
}

const ACCOUNTS: Record<AccountKind, () => EbAccountResource> = {
  current: () =>
    ibanAccount(1, IBAN_CURRENT, HASH_CURRENT, "Conto Corrente Esempio", "CACC", "EUR"),
  savings: () =>
    ibanAccount(2, IBAN_SAVINGS, HASH_SAVINGS, "Libretto Risparmio Esempio", "SVGS", "EUR"),
  usd: () => ibanAccount(3, IBAN_USD, HASH_USD, "Conto Valuta Esempio", "CACC", "USD"),
  // A card the bank cannot serve data for: no uid (eb-api-notes §5).
  card: () => ({
    uid: null,
    account_id: { other: { identification: CARD_NUMBER, scheme_name: "CPAN" } },
    all_account_ids: [{ identification: CARD_NUMBER, scheme_name: "CPAN" }],
    account_servicer: SERVICER,
    name: "Alex Example",
    details: "Carta di credito",
    product: "Carta Esempio",
    cash_account_type: "CARD",
    currency: "EUR",
    identification_hash: HASH_CARD,
    identification_hashes: [HASH_CARD],
    usage: "PRIV",
  }),
};

export function accountResource(
  kind: AccountKind,
  overrides: Partial<EbAccountResource> = {},
): EbAccountResource {
  return { ...ACCOUNTS[kind](), ...overrides };
}

/** `POST /sessions` response; `valid_until` uses the microsecond format of the API examples. */
export function sessionFixture(
  n: number,
  accounts: EbAccountResource[],
  options: { aspspName?: string; validUntil?: string } = {},
): EbSession {
  return {
    session_id: testSessionId(n),
    accounts,
    aspsp: { name: options.aspspName ?? BANK_NAME, country: "IT" },
    psu_type: "personal",
    access: { valid_until: options.validUntil ?? "2027-05-08T09:50:00.000000+00:00" },
  };
}

/** An Enable Banking error built from a documented `ErrorResponse` body. */
export function ebError(status: number, error: string, message: string): EnableBankingError {
  return parseEbErrorBody(status, { message, code: status, error });
}

export class StubBank implements EnableBankingApi {
  aspspList: EbAspsp[] = [
    aspspFixture(),
    aspspFixture({
      name: OTHER_BANK_NAME,
      logo: "https://logos.example.test/northwind.png",
      maximum_consent_validity: 7_776_000,
      bic: "NWBKITM1XXX",
    }),
  ];
  authUrl = AUTH_URL;
  listError: Error | null = null;
  startError: Error | null = null;
  createSessionError: Error | null = null;
  deleteSessionError: Error | null = null;
  readonly startCalls: EbStartAuthorizationRequest[] = [];
  readonly exchangedCodes: string[] = [];
  readonly deletedSessions: string[] = [];
  private readonly sessionsByCode = new Map<string, EbSession>();

  /** The session the exchange of `code` returns. */
  willReturn(code: string, session: EbSession): void {
    this.sessionsByCode.set(code, session);
  }

  /** The `state` of the last `startAuthorization` call (what the bank would send back). */
  lastState(): string {
    const call = this.startCalls.at(-1);
    if (!call) throw new Error("startAuthorization was not called");
    return call.state;
  }

  async getApplication(): Promise<EbApplication> {
    throw new Error("getApplication is not used by the connect flow");
  }

  async listAspsps(country: string): Promise<EbAspsp[]> {
    if (this.listError) throw this.listError;
    return this.aspspList.filter((aspsp) => aspsp.country === country);
  }

  async startAuthorization(
    request: EbStartAuthorizationRequest,
  ): Promise<EbStartAuthorizationResponse> {
    this.startCalls.push(request);
    if (this.startError) throw this.startError;
    return {
      url: this.authUrl,
      authorization_id: "a0a0a0a0-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
      psu_id_hash: "psu-hash-0001",
    };
  }

  async createSession(code: string): Promise<EbSession> {
    this.exchangedCodes.push(code);
    if (this.createSessionError) throw this.createSessionError;
    const session = this.sessionsByCode.get(code);
    if (!session) throw ebError(400, "WRONG_AUTHORIZATION_CODE", "Wrong authorization code");
    return session;
  }

  async getSession(): Promise<EbSessionStatus> {
    throw new Error("getSession is not used by the connect flow");
  }

  async deleteSession(sessionId: string): Promise<void> {
    this.deletedSessions.push(sessionId);
    if (this.deleteSessionError) throw this.deleteSessionError;
  }

  async getBalances(): Promise<EbBalance[]> {
    throw new Error("getBalances is not used by the connect flow");
  }

  async getTransactions(): Promise<EbTransactionsPage> {
    throw new Error("getTransactions is not used by the connect flow");
  }
}
```

```ts
import type { AccountStatus } from "@bursar/shared";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  accountResource,
  HASH_CARD,
  HASH_CURRENT,
  HASH_SAVINGS,
  IBAN_CURRENT,
  IBAN_SAVINGS,
  testUid,
} from "../test/bank-stub";
import { accountFieldsFromResource, type MappableAccount, mapAccounts } from "./account-mapping";

function stored(
  id: number,
  identificationHash: string,
  iban: string | null,
  status: AccountStatus = "active",
): MappableAccount {
  return { id, identificationHash, iban, status };
}

describe("mapAccounts", () => {
  it("matches an account by its identification hash", () => {
    const current = accountResource("current", { uid: testUid(11) });
    expect(mapAccounts([stored(1, HASH_CURRENT, IBAN_CURRENT)], [current])).toEqual({
      matched: [{ accountId: 1, resource: current }],
      created: [],
      missing: [],
    });
  });

  it("matches by one of the alternate hashes of the incoming account", () => {
    const savings = accountResource("savings", {
      identification_hash: "hash-savings-v2",
      identification_hashes: ["hash-savings-v2", HASH_SAVINGS],
      account_id: null,
      all_account_ids: null,
    });
    expect(mapAccounts([stored(2, HASH_SAVINGS, null)], [savings]).matched).toEqual([
      { accountId: 2, resource: savings },
    ]);
  });

  it("falls back to the IBAN, ignoring spaces and case", () => {
    const moved = accountResource("current", {
      identification_hash: "hash-current-v2",
      identification_hashes: ["hash-current-v2"],
      account_id: { iban: "it89 x990 0101 6000 0000 0001 001" },
    });
    expect(mapAccounts([stored(1, HASH_CURRENT, IBAN_CURRENT)], [moved]).matched).toEqual([
      { accountId: 1, resource: moved },
    ]);
  });

  it("prefers a hash match over an IBAN match", () => {
    // Same hash as account 1, but the IBAN of account 2.
    const incoming = accountResource("current", { account_id: { iban: IBAN_SAVINGS } });
    const result = mapAccounts(
      [stored(2, HASH_SAVINGS, IBAN_SAVINGS), stored(1, HASH_CURRENT, IBAN_CURRENT)],
      [incoming],
    );
    expect(result).toEqual({
      matched: [{ accountId: 1, resource: incoming }],
      created: [],
      missing: [2],
    });
  });

  it("matches each stored account at most once", () => {
    const first = accountResource("current");
    const second = accountResource("current", { uid: testUid(21) });
    expect(mapAccounts([stored(1, HASH_CURRENT, IBAN_CURRENT)], [first, second])).toEqual({
      matched: [{ accountId: 1, resource: first }],
      created: [second],
      missing: [],
    });
  });

  it("can match removed accounts but never reports them as missing", () => {
    const current = accountResource("current");
    const result = mapAccounts(
      [
        stored(1, HASH_CURRENT, IBAN_CURRENT, "removed"),
        stored(2, HASH_SAVINGS, IBAN_SAVINGS, "removed"),
        stored(3, "hash-other", null, "disabled"),
      ],
      [current],
    );
    expect(result).toEqual({
      matched: [{ accountId: 1, resource: current }],
      created: [],
      missing: [3],
    });
  });

  it("creates every incoming account when nothing matches", () => {
    const savings = accountResource("savings");
    expect(mapAccounts([stored(1, "hash-old", null)], [savings])).toEqual({
      matched: [],
      created: [savings],
      missing: [1],
    });
  });
});

describe("accountFieldsFromResource", () => {
  it("extracts the stored fields of an IBAN account", () => {
    expect(accountFieldsFromResource(accountResource("current"))).toEqual({
      providerAccountUid: testUid(1),

  it("stores nulls for blank values and never the holder name", () => {
```

- [ ] **Step 6: Implement `account-mapping.ts`**

Create `apps/server/src/finance/account-mapping.ts`:

```ts
import {
  type AccountStatus,
  identifierLast4,
  maskIban,
  maskIdentifier,
  normalizeIban,
} from "@bursar/shared";
import type { EbAccountResource } from "../eb/schemas";

/** The identity of a stored account, as far as matching a bank's account list needs it. */
export interface MappableAccount {
  id: number;
  identificationHash: string;
  iban: string | null;
  status: AccountStatus;
}

export interface AccountMapping {
  /** Incoming accounts that are an existing account, in the bank's order. */
  matched: { accountId: number; resource: EbAccountResource }[];
  /** Incoming accounts that match no existing account, in the bank's order. */
  created: EbAccountResource[];
  /** Existing accounts (not `removed`) that the bank no longer returns. */
  missing: number[];
}

/** The account columns that come from the bank. The holder `name` is never stored. */
export interface AccountFields {
  providerAccountUid: string | null;
  identificationHash: string;
  iban: string | null;
  maskedIdentifier: string | null;
  last4: string | null;
  product: string | null;
  details: string | null;
  currency: string;
  cashAccountType: string | null;
}

type Matcher = (account: MappableAccount, resource: EbAccountResource) => boolean;

function nonEmpty(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  const trimmed = value?.trim();
  return trimmed ? trimmed : null;
}

/** The account's IBAN (normalised), from `account_id` or else from `all_account_ids`. */
function resourceIban(resource: EbAccountResource): string | null {
  const iban =
    nonEmpty(resource.account_id?.iban) ??
    nonEmpty(resource.all_account_ids?.find((id) => id.scheme_name === "IBAN")?.identification);
  return iban === null ? null : normalizeIban(iban);
}

/** A non-IBAN identifier (card number, BBAN…), used only for the masked label. */
function resourceOtherIdentifier(resource: EbAccountResource): string | null {
  return (
    nonEmpty(resource.account_id?.other?.identification) ??
    nonEmpty(resource.all_account_ids?.find((id) => id.scheme_name !== "IBAN")?.identification)
  );
}

/**
 * Matching passes, strongest first: the bank's stable `identification_hash`, then any of the
 * alternate `identification_hashes`, then the IBAN. A later pass only sees what is still unmatched,
 * so a hash match always wins over an IBAN match.
 */
const MATCHERS: readonly Matcher[] = [
  (account, resource) => account.identificationHash === resource.identification_hash,
  (account, resource) => resource.identification_hashes.includes(account.identificationHash),
  (account, resource) => {
    const iban = resourceIban(resource);
    return iban !== null && account.iban !== null && normalizeIban(account.iban) === iban;
  },
];

/**
 * Maps the accounts a bank returned for a new session onto stored accounts. Each stored account is
 * matched at most once; `removed` accounts can be matched (re-attachment) but are never `missing`.
 */
export function mapAccounts(
  existing: readonly MappableAccount[],
  incoming: readonly EbAccountResource[],
): AccountMapping {
  const assigned = new Map<number, number>();
  const used = new Set<number>();
  for (const matches of MATCHERS) {
    for (const [index, resource] of incoming.entries()) {
      if (assigned.has(index)) continue;
      const account = existing.find(
        (candidate) => !used.has(candidate.id) && matches(candidate, resource),
      );
      if (!account) continue;
      used.add(account.id);
      assigned.set(index, account.id);
    }
  }
  const matched: AccountMapping["matched"] = [];
  const created: EbAccountResource[] = [];
  for (const [index, resource] of incoming.entries()) {
    const accountId = assigned.get(index);
    if (accountId === undefined) created.push(resource);
    else matched.push({ accountId, resource });
  }
  const missing = existing
    .filter((account) => !used.has(account.id) && account.status !== "removed")
    .map((account) => account.id);
  return { matched, created, missing };
}

/** The columns to store for a bank account: masked identifier and last four only for display. */
export function accountFieldsFromResource(resource: EbAccountResource): AccountFields {
  const iban = resourceIban(resource);
  const other = iban === null ? resourceOtherIdentifier(resource) : null;
  const shown = iban ?? other;
  let maskedIdentifier: string | null = null;
  if (iban !== null) maskedIdentifier = maskIban(iban);
  else if (other !== null) maskedIdentifier = maskIdentifier(other);
  return {
    providerAccountUid: nonEmpty(resource.uid),
    identificationHash: resource.identification_hash,
    iban,
    maskedIdentifier,
    last4: shown === null ? null : identifierLast4(shown),
    product: nonEmpty(resource.product),
    details: nonEmpty(resource.details),
    currency: resource.currency,
    cashAccountType: nonEmpty(resource.cash_account_type),
  };
}
```

```ts
  const reason = await promise.then(

  return reason as ConnectError;
}

function connectionIdOf(result: CompleteConnectionResponse): number {
  if (result.connectionId === null) throw new Error(`no connection for outcome ${result.outcome}`);
  return result.connectionId;
}

function accountIdAt(result: CompleteConnectionResponse, index: number): number {
  const account = result.accounts[index];
  if (!account) throw new Error(`no account at index ${index}`);

}

    it("closes a session without accounts and reports no_accounts", async () => {
      const result = await connect([]);
      expect(result).toEqual({
        outcome: "no_accounts",
        connectionId: null,
        bankName: BANK_NAME,

      expect(bank.deletedSessions).toEqual([testSessionId(1)]);
      expect(repo.listConnections({ includeRemoved: true })).toEqual([]);
      expect(jobs()).toEqual([]);
    });

    it("queues the deletion when closing an empty session fails", async () => {
      bank.deleteSessionError = ebError(500, "ASPSP_TIMEOUT", "ASPSP timeout");
      expect((await connect([])).outcome).toBe("no_accounts");
      expect(jobs()).toEqual([
        {
          type: DELETE_SESSION_JOB,
          payload: { providerSessionId: testSessionId(1) },
          dedupeKey: null,
          status: "queued",
        },
```
