```ts
    expect(counts).toEqual({ inserted: 0, updated: 0, removed: 1 });

  it("deletes a pending row cancelled without a reference by fingerprint", () => {
    sync([pending()]);

    const { plan } = sync([pending({ status: "RJCT" })]);
    expect(plan.deletes).toEqual([id]);

  it("never inserts a cancelled entry", () => {
    const { counts } = sync([

    expect(counts).toEqual({ inserted: 0, updated: 0, removed: 0 });

  });

  it("never deletes booked rows", () => {
    sync([booked({ entry_reference: "E-1" }), booked()]);
    for (let round = 0; round < 3; round += 1) {
      const { plan } = sync([]);

    expect(plan.deletes).toEqual([]);
    expect(rows().map((row) => row.status)).toEqual(["booked", "booked"]);
  });

  it("does not downgrade a booked row reported again as pending", () => {
    sync([booked({ entry_reference: "E-1" })]);
    const { plan } = sync([pending({ entry_reference: "E-1" })]);
    expect(plan.updates).toEqual([]);
    expect(plan.inserts).toEqual([]);
    expect(rows()).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ status: "booked", lastSeenAt: T0 })]);
  });

  it("is pure: the same input gives the same plan and stays untouched", () => {
    sync([pending()]);
    const existing = rows();
    const fetched = fingerprint([booked(), pending({ entry_reference: "E-5" })]);
    const snapshot = structuredClone({ existing, fetched });
    const first = planReconciliation({ existing, fetched, windowStart: null });
    const second = planReconciliation({ existing, fetched, windowStart: null });
    expect(second).toEqual(first);
    expect({ existing, fetched }).toEqual(snapshot);
  });

  it("honours a custom pendingMatchDays", () => {
    sync([pending({ transaction_date: "2026-11-02" })]);
    const existing = rows();
    const fetched = fingerprint([booked({ booking_date: "2026-11-05" })]);
    expect(
      planReconciliation({ existing, fetched, windowStart: null, pendingMatchDays: 2 }).updates,
    ).toEqual([]);
    expect(planReconciliation({ existing, fetched, windowStart: null }).updates).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it("rolls back the whole plan when one write fails", () => {
    sync([booked({ entry_reference: "E-1" }), pending({ entry_reference: "P-1" })]);
    const before = rows();
    const plan = planReconciliation({
      existing: before,
      fetched: fingerprint([
        booked({
          entry_reference: "E-2",
          transaction_amount: { currency: "EUR", amount: "99.00" },
          creditor: { name: "Contoso Pharmacy" },
        }),
        pending({ entry_reference: "P-1", status: "CNCL" }),
      ]),
      windowStart: null,
    });
    expect(plan.deletes).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(plan.inserts).toHaveLength(1);
    // A second insert with the fingerprint of an existing row violates the unique index.
    const broken: ReconcilePlan = {
      ...plan,
      inserts: [...plan.inserts, at(fingerprint([booked({ entry_reference: "E-1" })]), 0)],
    };
    expect(() => applyReconciliation(repo, accountId, broken, clock)).toThrow();
    expect(rows()).toEqual(before);
    expect(applyReconciliation(repo, accountId, plan, clock)).toEqual({
      inserted: 1,
      updated: 0,
      removed: 1,
    });
    expect(rows().map((row) => row.providerReference)).toEqual(["E-1", "E-2"]);
  });

  it("keeps one row and its first day for a date-less pending entry synced on two days", () => {
    const hold = pending({ transaction_date: null });
    const round = (today: LocalDate) => {
      const plan = planReconciliation({
        existing: repo.transactionsSince(accountId, null),
        fetched: assignFingerprints(accountId, [normalizeTransaction(hold, today)]),
        windowStart: null,
      });
      const counts = applyReconciliation(repo, accountId, plan, clock);
      clock += 24 * HOUR;
      return counts;
    };
    expect(round("2026-11-09")).toEqual({ inserted: 1, updated: 0, removed: 0 });
    expect(round("2026-11-10")).toEqual({ inserted: 0, updated: 1, removed: 0 });
    expect(rows()).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(at(rows(), 0)).toMatchObject({
      status: "pending",
      sortDate: "2026-11-09",
      firstSeenAt: T0,
      lastSeenAt: T0 + 24 * HOUR,
      missingCount: 0,
    });
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Implement `reconcile.ts`**

Create `apps/server/src/finance/reconcile.ts`:

```ts
import { diffDays, type LocalDate } from "@bursar/shared";
import { type FingerprintedTransaction, hasProviderDate, normalizeCounterparty } from "./normalize";
import type { FinanceRepository, NewTransaction, TransactionRow } from "./repository";

/**
 * Reconciliation of one fetched batch with the stored transactions of an account (spec §6.3).
 *
 * `planReconciliation` is pure: it decides what to insert, refresh, count as missing and delete.
 * `applyReconciliation` writes that plan in one database transaction. Booked rows are never deleted;
 * pending rows are replaced in place by their booked counterpart (same row id and first-seen time),
 * deleted when a cancellation names them, or deleted after `PENDING_REMOVAL_THRESHOLD` consecutive
 * syncs that cover their date without listing them.
 */

export const PENDING_REMOVAL_THRESHOLD = 2;
export const DEFAULT_PENDING_MATCH_DAYS = 7;

export interface ReconcilePlan {
  inserts: FingerprintedTransaction[];
  updates: { id: number; tx: FingerprintedTransaction; replacedPending: boolean }[];
  /** Ids of pending rows the batch still lists as pending (also present in `updates`). */
  seenPending: number[];
  missingPending: { id: number; missingCount: number }[];
  deletes: number[];
}

/** Which entry survives when a batch lists the same fingerprint twice. */
const PRECEDENCE: Readonly<Record<FingerprintedTransaction["status"], number>> = {
  pending: 0,
  cancelled: 1,
  booked: 2,
};

function dedupeByFingerprint(
  fetched: readonly FingerprintedTransaction[],
): FingerprintedTransaction[] {
  const byFingerprint = new Map<string, FingerprintedTransaction>();
  for (const tx of fetched) {
    const current = byFingerprint.get(tx.fingerprint);
    if (current === undefined || PRECEDENCE[tx.status] > PRECEDENCE[current.status]) {
      byFingerprint.set(tx.fingerprint, tx);
    }
  }
  return [...byFingerprint.values()];
}

function compareDates(a: LocalDate, b: LocalDate): number {
  if (a === b) return 0;
  return a < b ? -1 : 1;
}

function sameCounterparty(tx: FingerprintedTransaction, row: TransactionRow): boolean {
  const name = normalizeCounterparty(tx.counterparty);
  if (name !== normalizeCounterparty(row.counterparty)) return false;
  // Two unnamed entries are the same counterparty only when their remittance text is equal
  // (equal text is equivalent to the equal remittance hash used by the fingerprint).
  return name !== "" || (tx.remittance ?? "") === (row.remittance ?? "");
}

function isHeuristicMatch(
  tx: FingerprintedTransaction,
  row: TransactionRow,
  matchDays: number,
): boolean {
  return (
    tx.amountMinor === row.amountMinor &&
    tx.currency === row.currency &&
    Math.abs(diffDays(tx.sortDate, row.sortDate)) <= matchDays &&
    sameCounterparty(tx, row)
  );
}

export function planReconciliation(input: {
  existing: readonly TransactionRow[];
  fetched: readonly FingerprintedTransaction[];
  windowStart: LocalDate | null;
  pendingMatchDays?: number;
}): ReconcilePlan {
  const matchDays = input.pendingMatchDays ?? DEFAULT_PENDING_MATCH_DAYS;
  const fetched = dedupeByFingerprint(input.fetched);
  const byFingerprint = new Map<string, TransactionRow>();
  for (const row of input.existing) byFingerprint.set(row.fingerprint, row);
  const pendingRows = input.existing
    .filter((row) => row.status === "pending")
    .sort((a, b) => compareDates(a.sortDate, b.sortDate) || a.id - b.id);
  const claimed = new Set<number>();
  const plan: ReconcilePlan = {
    inserts: [],
    updates: [],
    seenPending: [],
    missingPending: [],
    deletes: [],
  };

  // 1. Pending entries refresh their row or are inserted; cancelled entries delete their pending row.
  for (const tx of fetched) {
    if (tx.status === "booked") continue;
    const row = byFingerprint.get(tx.fingerprint);
    if (tx.status === "pending") {
      if (row === undefined) {
        plan.inserts.push(tx);
      } else if (row.status === "pending" && !claimed.has(row.id)) {
        claimed.add(row.id);
        plan.updates.push({ id: row.id, tx, replacedPending: false });
        plan.seenPending.push(row.id);
      }
      // A booked row reported again as pending is left as it is.
      continue;
    }
    const target =
      row !== undefined
        ? row
        : pendingRows.find(
            (candidate) =>
              tx.providerReference !== null && candidate.providerReference === tx.providerReference,
          );
    if (target !== undefined && target.status === "pending" && !claimed.has(target.id)) {
      claimed.add(target.id);
      plan.deletes.push(target.id);
    }
  }

  // 2. Booked entries whose fingerprint is stored refresh that row (a pending row with the same
  //    reference becomes booked here).
  const unmatched: FingerprintedTransaction[] = [];
  for (const tx of fetched) {
    if (tx.status !== "booked") continue;
    const row = byFingerprint.get(tx.fingerprint);
    if (row === undefined) {
      unmatched.push(tx);
      continue;
    }
    if (claimed.has(row.id)) continue;
    claimed.add(row.id);
    plan.updates.push({ id: row.id, tx, replacedPending: row.status === "pending" });
  }

  // 3. Other booked entries replace a pending row: by reference first, then by the heuristic,
  //    oldest booked entry and oldest pending row first, each pending row once.
  const replaced = new Set<FingerprintedTransaction>();
  const oldestFirst = [...unmatched].sort((a, b) => compareDates(a.sortDate, b.sortDate));
  const replace = (tx: FingerprintedTransaction, row: TransactionRow): void => {
    claimed.add(row.id);
    replaced.add(tx);
    plan.updates.push({ id: row.id, tx, replacedPending: true });
  };
  for (const tx of oldestFirst) {
    if (tx.providerReference === null) continue;
    const row = pendingRows.find(
      (candidate) =>
        !claimed.has(candidate.id) && candidate.providerReference === tx.providerReference,
    );
    if (row !== undefined) replace(tx, row);
  }
  for (const tx of oldestFirst) {
    if (replaced.has(tx)) continue;
    const row = pendingRows.find(
      (candidate) => !claimed.has(candidate.id) && isHeuristicMatch(tx, candidate, matchDays),
    );
    if (row !== undefined) replace(tx, row);
  }
  for (const tx of unmatched) {
    if (!replaced.has(tx)) plan.inserts.push(tx);
  }

  // 4. Pending rows inside the fetched window that the batch did not list.
  for (const row of pendingRows) {
    if (claimed.has(row.id)) continue;
    if (input.windowStart !== null && row.sortDate < input.windowStart) continue;
    const missingCount = row.missingCount + 1;
    if (missingCount >= PENDING_REMOVAL_THRESHOLD) plan.deletes.push(row.id);
    else plan.missingPending.push({ id: row.id, missingCount });
  }

  plan.seenPending.sort((a, b) => a - b);
  plan.missingPending.sort((a, b) => a.id - b.id);
  plan.deletes.sort((a, b) => a - b);
  return plan;
}

type StoredFields = Omit<
  NewTransaction,
  "accountId" | "missingCount" | "firstSeenAt" | "lastSeenAt"
>;

function storedFields(tx: FingerprintedTransaction): StoredFields {
  if (tx.status === "cancelled") throw new Error("A cancelled transaction is never stored");
  return {
    providerReference: tx.providerReference,
    fingerprint: tx.fingerprint,
    status: tx.status,
    bookingDate: tx.bookingDate,
    valueDate: tx.valueDate,
    transactionDate: tx.transactionDate,
    sortDate: tx.sortDate,
    amountMinor: tx.amountMinor,
    currency: tx.currency,
    counterparty: tx.counterparty,
    counterpartyAccount: tx.counterpartyAccount,
    remittance: tx.remittance,
    bankCode: tx.bankCode,
    merchantCategoryCode: tx.merchantCategoryCode,
    balanceAfterMinor: tx.balanceAfterMinor,
    searchText: tx.searchText,
    rawJson: JSON.stringify(tx.raw),
  };
}

/**
 * The fields a refresh writes. Without any provider date the stored `sortDate` is the day the
 * entry was first seen: keep it, so a date-less pending entry does not move forward every day.
 */
function refreshFields(tx: FingerprintedTransaction): Partial<StoredFields> {
  const { sortDate, ...rest } = storedFields(tx);
  return hasProviderDate(tx) ? { ...rest, sortDate } : rest;
}

/**
 * Writes a plan in one repository transaction: deletes, refreshes (which reset `missingCount` and
 * keep `firstSeenAt`), miss counters, inserts. Any failure rolls back every write of the plan.
 */
export function applyReconciliation(
  repo: FinanceRepository,
  accountId: number,
  plan: ReconcilePlan,
  now: number,
): { inserted: number; updated: number; removed: number } {
  return repo.transaction(() => {
    const removed = plan.deletes.length > 0 ? repo.deleteTransactions(plan.deletes) : 0;
    for (const update of plan.updates) {
      repo.updateTransaction(update.id, {
        ...refreshFields(update.tx),
        missingCount: 0,
        lastSeenAt: now,
      });
    }
    for (const missing of plan.missingPending) {
      repo.updateTransaction(missing.id, { missingCount: missing.missingCount });
    }
    for (const tx of plan.inserts) {
      repo.insertTransaction({
        ...storedFields(tx),
        accountId,
        missingCount: 0,
        firstSeenAt: now,
        lastSeenAt: now,
      });
    }
    return { inserted: plan.inserts.length, updated: plan.updates.length, removed };
  });
}
```

**Additions beyond the contract** (new names only; nothing above is renamed or changed):
- `@bursar/shared` `sync.ts`: `syncQueuedResponseSchema` (the contract type is inferred from it), `syncConflictCodeSchema` (`sync_in_progress | account_inactive | connection_inactive | rate_limited | nothing_to_sync`) and `type SyncConflictCode`, so the panel (Tasks 18 and 19) can translate the 409 codes from one list.
- `finance/sync.ts`: `SYNC_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3` (sync jobs are enqueued with `maxAttempts: 3`: one run plus two retries after 30 s and 2 min, the queue's `backoffMs`); `PAGINATION_LOOP = "PAGINATION_LOOP"`, `INTERNAL_ERROR = "INTERNAL_ERROR"` and `INVALID_PROVIDER_DATA = "INVALID_PROVIDER_DATA"` (error codes Bursar raises itself; they share the `errorCode` field with Enable Banking codes; Task 17's `syncErrors` translates them); `PENDING_LOOKBACK_DAYS = 90` (how far an incremental window may reach back to the oldest stored pending entry); `unconfiguredSyncHandler(): JobHandler` (the handler `server.ts` registers when `ebApi` is null: it throws `PermanentJobError("banking_not_configured")`).
- `finance/connection-status.ts`: `interface ConnectionStatusDeps` (the contract's `deps` object type, named).
- `finance/sync-routes.ts`: `interface SyncRoutesDeps` (the contract's `deps` object type, named).
- Test support (not shipped): `apps/server/src/test/sync-fixture.ts` with `insertConnection`, `insertAccount` (raw SQL on the contract's column names, so the tests do not depend on the exact shape of `NewConnection`/`NewAccount`), the Enable Banking fixtures, `ebError`, `StubBank`, `eventsOf` and `createSyncHarness`. `sync-wiring.test.ts` boots the real server once per test to prove the wiring in `startBursar`.

**Behaviour decided here** (the contract leaves it open):
- **Skips.** A missing account (deleted between enqueue and run) returns a `skipped`/`account_inactive` outcome with no sync run and no event (both need a valid account and connection), logged at warn. Every other skip writes a `skipped` sync run with its `skip_reason`, publishes `sync.finished` (no `sync.started`), calls nothing at Enable Banking and leaves `last_sync_error_*` untouched. Skip order: account not `active` → `account_inactive`; connection missing, removed or effectively `expired|revoked|error` → `connection_inactive`; `provider_account_uid` null → `no_provider_uid`; `rate_limited_until > now` → `rate_limited` with `retryAt = rate_limited_until`; then the background cap → `daily_cap`.
- **PSU headers.** Only a `manual` payload whose `psu.ipAddress` passes `isPublicIp` sends them (checked again in the job, not only in the route). The route adds `psu` only with a public client IP and a non-empty `User-Agent`; header values are trimmed and clipped to 512 characters; `accept` and `acceptLanguage` are omitted when absent. The payload sits in the encrypted `jobs` table and is purged with finished jobs after 30 days (Task 7 maintenance); it is never logged.
- **PSU fallback.** `PSU_HEADER_NOT_PROVIDED` or `PSU_HEADER_INVALID` on any call of a run that sent headers restarts the whole fetch (balances, then transactions) once without headers in the same sync run, after consuming one background fetch; when the cap is exhausted the run finishes `skipped`/`daily_cap`. The run's `with_psu_headers` records what the successful (or last) fetch used.
- **Retries consume the cap.** Every attempt of a background job charges `tryConsumeBackgroundFetch`, because the bank counts each unattended call. With the default cap 2 a background job whose first two attempts hit a 5xx ends its third attempt `skipped`/`daily_cap` (job completed) instead of `failed`. This keeps Bursar under the bank's limit; see contract issues.
- **Transactions window.** `dateFrom = min(lastBookedDate − 7 days, oldest stored pending sortDate, today)`, where the pending term only counts pending rows of the last `PENDING_LOOKBACK_DAYS` (90) days, so a card hold older than the booked window is inside the window and is removed after two misses (spec §6.3); `strategy: "longest"` sends no `dateFrom`. After the `WRONG_TRANSACTIONS_PERIOD` fallback the reconciliation window is `null` (the whole history was fetched). The existing rows handed to `planReconciliation` are **all** rows of the account (`transactionsSince(accountId, null)`, Task 12's precondition): the bank may ignore `date_from` (the Mock ASPSP does, eb-api-notes §7) or filter on another date, so a stored entry it returns from before the window must be matched, never inserted again (that would hit the unique `(account_id, fingerprint)` index and roll back every sync). Pending removal stays limited to the window by `planReconciliation` itself.
- **Writes after the network.** `fetchAccountData` only talks to the bank; `storeAccountData` then writes balances and transactions in one synchronous block that first checks the account still exists and is not `removed` (a disconnect or purge can land while the bank answers). A removed or purged account gets no balance, no transaction and no status patch; the run ends `skipped`/`account_inactive`.
- **Unreadable provider items.** The client (Task 10) drops items that do not match the schema and reports the count per page; `storeAccountData` skips a balance or transaction whose amount or currency cannot be read (`MoneyParseError`, `RangeError`). The run still succeeds and records `"<n> provider entries skipped"` in `errorMessage`.
- **Initial sync and the cap.** An `initial` job is charged against the background cap on its first attempt only; its retries run even when the cap is spent, because the full history is often available only for about an hour after the consent (spec §3). Every other trigger is charged per attempt.
- **Pagination guard.** A repeated `continuation_key`, or a 501st page, stops the run with `PAGINATION_LOOP`: nothing is reconciled (balances already written stay), the run and the account record the code, and the job fails permanently (`PermanentJobError("PAGINATION_LOOP")`); the next daily sync tries again.
- **Errors.** Enable Banking codes are stored as received (`error.code`, or `HTTP_<status>` when the body had no `error`); messages are `error.message` clipped to 500 characters (Task 10 already reduces them to status, code and the API's `message`). A `MoneyParseError` that escapes the per-item checks finishes the run `failed` with `INVALID_PROVIDER_DATA` and throws `PermanentJobError` (the data is the same on a retry). Any other exception (a database error) finishes the run `failed` with `INTERNAL_ERROR` and is rethrown so the queue retries it like a `retry` kind. `retryAt` in `sync.finished` is the next attempt time (`now + backoffMs(attempt)`) for retried failures, `null` on the last attempt, `now + 6 h` for a bank rate limit.
- **Account fields per outcome.** `succeeded`: `last_synced_at = now`, `last_sync_error_* = null`. Any outcome carrying an `errorCode` (failures and the bank rate-limit skip): `last_sync_error_code`, `last_sync_error_at = now`. `account` errors also set `status = 'unavailable'`; a bank 429 sets `rate_limited_until = now + 6 h`.
- **`markConnectionEnded`** is a no-op for an unknown or removed connection and when the stored status already equals the target (no second notification, no event). Without an `error` argument it clears `last_error_*`. The status update and the notification run in one `repo.transaction` (`NotificationService.raise` opens no transaction of its own, Task 9); the event is published after it.
- **Daily task.** Runs on every scheduler tick, acts once the local time reaches `settings.dailySyncTime`. Accounts are considered only when `active`, with a provider uid, not paused, of a non-removed connection whose effective status is `active` or `expiring`. A paused account is not marked for the day, so it is queued on the first tick after its pause ends; `last_scheduled_sync_day` is set for every account it queues (also when `enqueueUnique` returns an already-active job).
- **Manual routes.** Account route check order: unknown → 404; account not `active` or without provider uid → `account_inactive`; connection removed or not `active|expiring` → `connection_inactive`; paused → `rate_limited` + `retryAt`; active job → `sync_in_progress`. Connection route: unknown → 404; inactive → `connection_inactive`; queues each eligible `active` account; when none was queued the 409 is `sync_in_progress` if any account is already syncing, else `rate_limited` with the earliest `retryAt` if any is paused, else `nothing_to_sync`. Ids must match `^[1-9]\d{0,15}$` (anything else is a 404 that does not echo the id).

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import type { AccountStatus, ServerEvent, StoredConnectionStatus } from "@bursar/shared";
import { pino } from "pino";
import type { Sqlite } from "../db";
import type { EnableBankingApi, PsuHeaders, TransactionsQuery } from "../eb/client";

  EbApplication,

export const DAY_MS = 86_400_000;
export const SYNC_TEST_TIMEZONE = "Europe/Rome";
/** Monday 9 November 2026, 10:00 in Rome (09:00 UTC). */
export const SYNC_TEST_NOW = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 9, 9, 0, 0);

export interface ConnectionSeed {
  now: number;
  aspspName?: string;
  status?: StoredConnectionStatus;
  validUntil?: number;
  removedAt?: number | null;
}

/** Inserts a bank connection with raw SQL (column names from the M1 schema). */
export function insertConnection(sqlite: Sqlite, seed: ConnectionSeed): number {
  const result = sqlite
    .prepare(
      `INSERT INTO bank_connections
         (aspsp_name, aspsp_country, psu_type, provider_session_id, status, valid_until,
          created_at, updated_at, removed_at)
       VALUES (?, 'IT', 'personal', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
    )
    .run(
      seed.aspspName ?? "Banca Esempio",
      randomUUID(),
      seed.status ?? "active",
      seed.validUntil ?? seed.now + 90 * DAY_MS,
      seed.now,
      seed.now,
      seed.removedAt ?? null,
    );
  return Number(result.lastInsertRowid);
}

export interface AccountSeed {
  connectionId: number;
  now: number;
  /** `undefined` generates a uid; `null` stores none. */
  providerAccountUid?: string | null;
  status?: AccountStatus;
  currency?: string;
  rateLimitedUntil?: number | null;
}

/** Inserts an account with raw SQL (column names from the M1 schema). */
export function insertAccount(sqlite: Sqlite, seed: AccountSeed): number {
  const result = sqlite
    .prepare(
      `INSERT INTO accounts
         (connection_id, provider_account_uid, identification_hash, masked_identifier, last4,
          product, currency, cash_account_type, status, rate_limited_until, created_at, updated_at)
       VALUES (?, ?, ?, '•••• 0042', '0042', 'Conto Esempio', ?, 'CACC', ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
    )
    .run(
      seed.connectionId,
      seed.providerAccountUid === undefined ? randomUUID() : seed.providerAccountUid,
      `test-identification-${randomUUID()}`,
      seed.currency ?? "EUR",
      seed.status ?? "active",
      seed.rateLimitedUntil ?? null,
      seed.now,
      seed.now,
    );
  return Number(result.lastInsertRowid);
}

/** An `EnableBankingError` built from an error body shaped like `eb-api-notes.md` §9. */
export function ebError(status: number, code: string, message: string): EnableBankingError {
  return parseEbErrorBody(status, { message, code: status, error: code });
}

/** Scripted bank: balances and paged transactions, queued errors, recorded calls. */
export class StubBank implements EnableBankingApi {
  balances: EbBalance[] = BALANCES;
  pages: EbTransactionsPage[] = [PAGE_1, PAGE_2];
  /** Replaces the page lookup when set (pagination guard tests). */
  transactionsImpl: ((query: TransactionsQuery) => EbTransactionsPage) | null = null;
  readonly balanceErrors: EnableBankingError[] = [];
  readonly transactionErrors: EnableBankingError[] = [];
  readonly balanceCalls: { accountUid: string; psu: PsuHeaders | undefined }[] = [];
  readonly transactionCalls: {
    accountUid: string;
    query: TransactionsQuery;
    psu: PsuHeaders | undefined;
  }[] = [];

  async getBalances(accountUid: string, psu?: PsuHeaders): Promise<EbBalance[]> {
    this.balanceCalls.push({ accountUid, psu });
    const error = this.balanceErrors.shift();
    if (error) throw error;
    return this.balances;
  }

  async getTransactions(
    accountUid: string,
    query: TransactionsQuery,
    psu?: PsuHeaders,
  ): Promise<EbTransactionsPage> {
    this.transactionCalls.push({ accountUid, query: { ...query }, psu });
    const error = this.transactionErrors.shift();
    if (error) throw error;
    if (this.transactionsImpl) return this.transactionsImpl(query);
    const index = query.continuationKey
      ? Number(query.continuationKey.slice("page-".length)) - 1
      : 0;
    return this.pages[index] ?? { transactions: [], continuation_key: null };
  }

  async getApplication(): Promise<EbApplication> {
    throw new Error("getApplication is not used by the sync");
  }

  async listAspsps(_country: string): Promise<EbAspsp[]> {
    throw new Error("listAspsps is not used by the sync");
  }

  async startAuthorization(
    _request: EbStartAuthorizationRequest,
  ): Promise<EbStartAuthorizationResponse> {
    throw new Error("startAuthorization is not used by the sync");
  }

  async createSession(_code: string): Promise<EbSession> {
    throw new Error("createSession is not used by the sync");
  }

  async getSession(_sessionId: string): Promise<EbSessionStatus> {
    throw new Error("getSession is not used by the sync");
  }

  async deleteSession(_sessionId: string): Promise<void> {
    throw new Error("deleteSession is not used by the sync");
  }
}

/** Narrows the recorded bus events to one type. */
export function eventsOf<T extends ServerEvent["type"]>(
  events: readonly ServerEvent[],
  type: T,
): Extract<ServerEvent, { type: T }>[] {
  return events.filter((event): event is Extract<ServerEvent, { type: T }> => event.type === type);
}

export interface SyncHarness {
  t: TestDatabase;
  repo: FinanceRepository;
  queue: JobQueue;
  bus: EventBus;
  settings: SettingsStore;
  notifications: NotificationService;
  bank: StubBank;
  /** Every event published on the bus, in order. */
  events: ServerEvent[];
  /** Mutable clock shared by every component. */
  clock: { now: number };
  deps: SyncDeps;
  dispose(): void;
}

/** Real database, repository, queue, bus, settings and notifications; a scripted bank. */
export function createSyncHarness(start: number = SYNC_TEST_NOW): SyncHarness {
  const t = createTestDatabase();
  const clock = { now: start };
  const now = () => clock.now;
  const repo = new FinanceRepository(t.db, now);
  const queue = new JobQueue(t.sqlite, now);
  const bus = new EventBus();
  const events: ServerEvent[] = [];
  bus.subscribe((event) => {
    events.push(event);
  });
  const settings = new SettingsStore(t.db, now);
  const notifications = new NotificationService({
    db: t.db,
    queue,
    bus,
    settings,
    emailEnabled: () => false,
    now,
  });
  const bank = new StubBank();
  const deps: SyncDeps = {
    repo,
    api: bank,
    bus,
    notifications,
    settings,
    timezone: SYNC_TEST_TIMEZONE,
    now,
    logger: pino({ level: "silent" }),
  };
  return {
    t,
    repo,
    queue,
    bus,
    settings,
    notifications,
    bank,
    events,
    clock,
    deps,
    dispose: () => t.dispose(),
  };
}
```

```ts
  app.get("/", (c) => c.text(resolve(c)));

}

/** The bindings `@hono/node-server` passes to the app (only the socket part is read). */
function socket(remoteAddress: string | undefined) {

      socket("10.0.0.3"),
    );
    expect(await blank.text()).toBe("10.0.0.3");
  });

  it("answers unknown without connection information", async () => {
    const noBindings = await probe(false).request("/");
    expect(await noBindings.text()).toBe("unknown");
    const noAddress = await probe(false).request("/", {}, socket(undefined));
    expect(await noAddress.text()).toBe("unknown");
  });
});

describe("isPublicIp", () => {
  it.each([
```

`apps/server/src/finance/connection-status.test.ts`:

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  createSyncHarness,
  DAY_MS,
  eventsOf,
  insertConnection,
  SYNC_TEST_TIMEZONE,
  type SyncHarness,
} from "../test/sync-fixture";
import { type ConnectionStatusDeps, markConnectionEnded } from "./connection-status";

describe("markConnectionEnded", () => {
  let h: SyncHarness;
  let connectionId: number;

  beforeEach(() => {
    h = createSyncHarness();
    connectionId = insertConnection(h.t.sqlite, { now: h.clock.now, aspspName: "Banca Esempio" });
  });
  afterEach(() => h.dispose());

  function deps(): ConnectionStatusDeps {
    return {
      repo: h.repo,
      notifications: h.notifications,
      bus: h.bus,
      now: () => h.clock.now,
      timezone: SYNC_TEST_TIMEZONE,
    };
  }

  it("marks a connection expired, raises consent_expired and publishes the change", () => {
    markConnectionEnded(deps(), connectionId, "expired", {
      code: "EXPIRED_SESSION",
      message: "401 EXPIRED_SESSION: Session expired",
    });
    expect(h.repo.getConnection(connectionId)).toMatchObject({
      status: "expired",
      lastErrorCode: "EXPIRED_SESSION",
      lastErrorMessage: "401 EXPIRED_SESSION: Session expired",
      lastErrorAt: h.clock.now,
    });
    const items = h.notifications.list(10).items;
    expect(items).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(items[0]).toMatchObject({
      event: "consent_expired",
      params: { bankName: "Banca Esempio" },
      link: "/accounts",
    });
    expect(eventsOf(h.events, "connection.updated")).toEqual([
      { type: "connection.updated", connectionId, status: "expired" },
    ]);
  });

  it.each([{ status: "revoked" as const }, { status: "error" as const }])(
    "marks a connection $status and raises connection_error",
    ({ status }) => {
      markConnectionEnded(deps(), connectionId, status, {
        code: "REVOKED_SESSION",
        message: "401 REVOKED_SESSION: Session revoked",
      });
      expect(h.repo.getConnection(connectionId)).toMatchObject({
        status,
        lastErrorCode: "REVOKED_SESSION",
        lastErrorAt: h.clock.now,
      });
      const items = h.notifications.list(10).items;
      expect(items.map((item) => item.event)).toEqual(["connection_error"]);
      expect(items[0]).toMatchObject({ params: { bankName: "Banca Esempio" }, link: "/accounts" });
      expect(eventsOf(h.events, "connection.updated")).toEqual([
        { type: "connection.updated", connectionId, status },
      ]);
    },
  );

  it("does nothing when the stored status already matches", () => {
    markConnectionEnded(deps(), connectionId, "expired");
    h.clock.now += DAY_MS;
    markConnectionEnded(deps(), connectionId, "expired", {
      code: "EXPIRED_SESSION",
      message: "401 EXPIRED_SESSION: Session expired",
    });
    expect(h.notifications.list(10).items).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(eventsOf(h.events, "connection.updated")).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(h.repo.getConnection(connectionId)?.lastErrorCode).toBeNull();
  });

  it("ignores unknown and removed connections", () => {
    const removed = insertConnection(h.t.sqlite, { now: h.clock.now, removedAt: h.clock.now });
    markConnectionEnded(deps(), 9_999, "error");
    markConnectionEnded(deps(), removed, "error");
    expect(h.repo.getConnection(removed)?.status).toBe("active");
    expect(h.notifications.list(10).items).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(h.events).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it("stores no error details when none is given", () => {
    markConnectionEnded(deps(), connectionId, "expired");
    expect(h.repo.getConnection(connectionId)).toMatchObject({
      status: "expired",
      lastErrorCode: null,
      lastErrorMessage: null,
      lastErrorAt: null,
    });
  });
});
```

```ts
import type { SkipReason, SyncTrigger } from "@bursar/shared";
import { pino } from "pino";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { PsuHeaders } from "../eb/client";
import type { EbTransaction } from "../eb/schemas";
import { SYNC_ACCOUNT_JOB } from "../jobs/types";
import { type JobHandler, JobWorker, PermanentJobError } from "../jobs/worker";
import {
  type AccountSeed,
  type ConnectionSeed,
  createSyncHarness,
  DAY_MS,
  ebError,
  eventsOf,
  GROCERIES,
  insertAccount,
  insertConnection,
  PENDING_COFFEE,
  SALARY,
  SYNC_TEST_NOW,
  type SyncHarness,
} from "../test/sync-fixture";
import {
  enqueueAccountSync,
  MAX_TRANSACTION_PAGES,
  RATE_LIMIT_PAUSE_MS,
  runAccountSync,
  syncAccountHandler,
  unconfiguredSyncHandler,
} from "./sync";

const HOUR_MS = 3_600_000;
const FIRST_ATTEMPT = { number: 1, max: 3 };
const PUBLIC_PSU: PsuHeaders = {
  ipAddress: "203.0.113.24",
  userAgent: "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) ExampleBrowser/1.0",
  acceptLanguage: "it-IT,it;q=0.9",
};
const PRIVATE_PSU: PsuHeaders = { ...PUBLIC_PSU, ipAddress: "10.0.0.4" };

let h: SyncHarness;
let connectionId: number;
let accountId: number;

beforeEach(() => {
  h = createSyncHarness();
  connectionId = insertConnection(h.t.sqlite, { now: h.clock.now });
  accountId = insertAccount(h.t.sqlite, { connectionId, now: h.clock.now });
});
afterEach(() => h.dispose());

function sync(trigger: SyncTrigger, psu?: PsuHeaders, id: number = accountId) {
  return runAccountSync(
    h.deps,
    psu ? { accountId: id, trigger, psu } : { accountId: id, trigger },
    FIRST_ATTEMPT,
  );
}

function lastRun(id: number = accountId) {
  return h.repo.listSyncRuns(id, 100).reduce((latest, run) => (run.id > latest.id ? run : latest));
}

function createWorker(handler: JobHandler): JobWorker {
  return new JobWorker(
    h.queue,
    new Map([[SYNC_ACCOUNT_JOB, handler]]),
    pino({ level: "silent" }),
  );
}

describe("runAccountSync: fetching and storing", () => {
  it("runs the first sync with strategy longest, stores balances and inserts every transaction", async () => {
    const outcome = await sync("initial");
    expect(outcome).toEqual({
      status: "succeeded",
      fetched: 3,
      inserted: 3,
      updated: 0,
      removed: 0,
      errorCode: null,
      skipReason: null,
      retryAt: null,
    });
    expect(h.bank.transactionCalls.map((call) => call.query)).toEqual([
      { strategy: "longest" },
      { strategy: "longest", continuationKey: "page-2" },
    ]);
    expect(h.bank.balanceCalls).toEqual([{ accountUid: expect.any(String), psu: undefined }]);
    const balances = h.repo.latestBalances(accountId);
    expect(balances).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(balances).toEqual(
      expect.arrayContaining([
        expect.objectContaining({
          balanceType: "CLBD",
          amountMinor: 152_040,
          currency: "EUR",
          referenceDate: "2026-11-08",
        }),
        expect.objectContaining({
          balanceType: "ITAV",
          amountMinor: 149_015,
          currency: "EUR",
          referenceDate: "2026-11-09",
        }),
      ]),
    );
    expect(h.repo.countTransactions(accountId)).toEqual({ total: 3, pending: 1 });
    expect(h.repo.getAccount(accountId)).toMatchObject({
      lastSyncedAt: SYNC_TEST_NOW,
      lastSyncErrorCode: null,
      bgFetchCount: 1,
    });
    expect(lastRun()).toMatchObject({
      trigger: "initial",
      status: "succeeded",
      withPsuHeaders: false,
      fetched: 3,
      inserted: 3,
      finishedAt: SYNC_TEST_NOW,
    });
  });

  it("publishes started, one progress event per page and finished", async () => {
    await sync("initial");
    expect(h.events.map((event) => event.type)).toEqual([
      "sync.started",
      "sync.progress",
      "sync.progress",
      "sync.finished",
    ]);
    expect(eventsOf(h.events, "sync.started")).toEqual([
      { type: "sync.started", accountId, connectionId, trigger: "initial" },
    ]);
    expect(eventsOf(h.events, "sync.progress").map((event) => event.fetched)).toEqual([2, 3]);
    expect(eventsOf(h.events, "sync.finished")).toEqual([
      {
        type: "sync.finished",
        accountId,
        connectionId,
        trigger: "initial",
        status: "succeeded",
        inserted: 3,
        updated: 0,
        removed: 0,
        errorCode: null,
        skipReason: null,
        retryAt: null,
      },
    ]);
  });

  it("uses strategy longest for any trigger while the account has no booked transaction", async () => {
    await sync("background");
    expect(h.bank.transactionCalls[0]?.query).toEqual({ strategy: "longest" });
  });

  it("fetches incrementally from the last booked date minus seven days", async () => {
    await sync("initial");
    const outcome = await sync("background");
    expect(h.bank.transactionCalls.slice(2).map((call) => call.query)).toEqual([
      { strategy: "default", dateFrom: "2026-10-31" },
      { strategy: "default", dateFrom: "2026-10-31", continuationKey: "page-2" },
    ]);
    expect(outcome).toMatchObject({ status: "succeeded", fetched: 3, inserted: 0 });
    expect(h.repo.countTransactions(accountId)).toEqual({ total: 3, pending: 1 });
  });

  it("never asks for a start date in the future", async () => {
    h.bank.pages = [
      {
        transactions: [
          {
            ...GROCERIES,
            entry_reference: "ENTRY-0099",
            booking_date: "2026-11-20",
            value_date: "2026-11-20",
          },
        ],
        continuation_key: null,
      },
    ];
    await sync("initial");
    await sync("background");
    expect(h.bank.transactionCalls[1]?.query).toEqual({
      strategy: "default",
      dateFrom: "2026-11-09",
    });
  });

  it("matches a stored entry the bank returns from before the window when it ignores date_from", async () => {
    const old: EbTransaction = {
      ...GROCERIES,
      entry_reference: "ENTRY-OLD",
      transaction_id: "tx-old",
      booking_date: "2026-09-20",
      value_date: "2026-09-20",
    };
    // Like the Mock ASPSP: every request returns the whole list, whatever date_from says.
    h.bank.pages = [{ transactions: [PENDING_COFFEE, GROCERIES, SALARY, old], continuation_key: null }];
    expect(await sync("initial")).toMatchObject({ status: "succeeded", inserted: 4 });
    const outcome = await sync("background");
    expect(h.bank.transactionCalls[1]?.query).toEqual({
      strategy: "default",
      dateFrom: "2026-10-31",
    });
    expect(outcome).toMatchObject({ status: "succeeded", fetched: 4, inserted: 0 });
    expect(h.repo.countTransactions(accountId)).toEqual({ total: 4, pending: 1 });
  });

  it("reaches back to an old pending entry so it is removed after two missed syncs", async () => {
    h.settings.update({ backgroundSyncCap: 4 });
    const hold: EbTransaction = {
      ...PENDING_COFFEE,
      transaction_amount: { currency: "EUR", amount: "150.00" },
      creditor: { name: "Hotel Esempio" },
      transaction_date: "2026-10-20",
    };
    h.bank.pages = [{ transactions: [hold, GROCERIES, SALARY], continuation_key: null }];
    await sync("initial");
    h.bank.pages = [{ transactions: [GROCERIES, SALARY], continuation_key: null }];
    expect(await sync("background")).toMatchObject({ status: "succeeded", removed: 0 });
    // lastBooked − 7 would be 2026-10-31; the stored hold of 2026-10-20 widens the window.
    expect(h.bank.transactionCalls[1]?.query).toEqual({
      strategy: "default",
      dateFrom: "2026-10-20",
    });
    expect(await sync("background")).toMatchObject({ status: "succeeded", removed: 1 });
    expect(h.repo.countTransactions(accountId)).toEqual({ total: 2, pending: 0 });
  });

  it("skips unreadable provider items, stores the rest and says how many it skipped", async () => {
    const malformed: EbTransaction = {
      ...GROCERIES,
      entry_reference: "ENTRY-0003",
      transaction_amount: { currency: "EUR", amount: "42.805" },
    };
    // `skipped: 1` is the client's count of an item with an unknown credit_debit_indicator.
    h.bank.pages = [{ transactions: [malformed, SALARY], continuation_key: null, skipped: 1 }];
    expect(await sync("initial")).toMatchObject({ status: "succeeded", fetched: 2, inserted: 1 });
    expect(h.repo.countTransactions(accountId)).toEqual({ total: 1, pending: 0 });
    expect(lastRun()).toMatchObject({
      status: "succeeded",
      errorMessage: "2 provider entries skipped",
    });
    expect(h.repo.getAccount(accountId)?.lastSyncErrorCode).toBeNull();
  });

  it("writes nothing for an account removed while the bank was answering", async () => {
    h.bank.transactionsImpl = () => {
      h.repo.updateAccount(accountId, { status: "removed" });
      return { transactions: [SALARY], continuation_key: null };
    };
    expect(await sync("initial")).toMatchObject({
      status: "skipped",
      skipReason: "account_inactive",
    });
    expect(h.repo.getAccount(accountId)?.status).toBe("removed");
    expect(h.repo.countTransactions(accountId)).toEqual({ total: 0, pending: 0 });
    expect(h.repo.latestBalances(accountId)).toEqual([]);

    // A late account-level error does not turn the removed account back into an unavailable one.
    h.repo.updateAccount(accountId, { status: "active" });
    h.bank.transactionsImpl = () => {
      h.repo.updateAccount(accountId, { status: "removed" });
      throw ebError(404, "ACCOUNT_DOES_NOT_EXIST", "Account does not exist");
    };
    expect(await sync("background")).toMatchObject({
      status: "skipped",
      skipReason: "account_inactive",
    });
    expect(h.repo.getAccount(accountId)?.status).toBe("removed");
  });

  it("falls back to strategy longest once when the bank rejects the period", async () => {
    await sync("initial");
    h.bank.transactionErrors.push(
      ebError(422, "WRONG_TRANSACTIONS_PERIOD", "Wrong transactions period requested"),
    );
    const outcome = await sync("background");
    expect(h.bank.transactionCalls.slice(2).map((call) => call.query)).toEqual([
      { strategy: "default", dateFrom: "2026-10-31" },
      { strategy: "longest" },
      { strategy: "longest", continuationKey: "page-2" },
    ]);
    expect(outcome).toMatchObject({ status: "succeeded", inserted: 0 });
  });

  it("stops with PAGINATION_LOOP when a continuation key repeats", async () => {
    h.bank.transactionsImpl = () => ({ transactions: [], continuation_key: "same-key" });
    const error = await sync("initial").catch((caught: unknown) => caught);
    expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(PermanentJobError);
    expect((error as Error).message).toBe("PAGINATION_LOOP");
    expect(h.bank.transactionCalls).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(lastRun()).toMatchObject({ status: "failed", errorCode: "PAGINATION_LOOP" });
    expect(h.repo.getAccount(accountId)?.lastSyncErrorCode).toBe("PAGINATION_LOOP");
    expect(eventsOf(h.events, "sync.finished")[0]).toMatchObject({
      status: "failed",
      errorCode: "PAGINATION_LOOP",
    });
  });

  it("stops after MAX_TRANSACTION_PAGES pages", async () => {
    let page = 0;
    h.bank.transactionsImpl = () => {
      page += 1;
      return { transactions: [], continuation_key: `key-${page}` };
    };
    await expect(sync("initial")).rejects.toThrow("PAGINATION_LOOP");
    expect(h.bank.transactionCalls).toHaveLength(MAX_TRANSACTION_PAGES);
    expect(h.repo.countTransactions(accountId)).toEqual({ total: 0, pending: 0 });
  });
});

interface SkipCase {
  label: string;
  connection: Omit<Partial<ConnectionSeed>, "now">;
  account: Omit<Partial<AccountSeed>, "connectionId" | "now">;
  reason: SkipReason;
}

const SKIP_CASES: SkipCase[] = [
  {
    label: "a disabled account",
    connection: {},
    account: { status: "disabled" },
    reason: "account_inactive",
  },
  {
    label: "an account without a provider id",
    connection: {},
    account: { providerAccountUid: null },
    reason: "no_provider_uid",
  },
  {
    label: "a revoked connection",
    connection: { status: "revoked" },
    account: {},
    reason: "connection_inactive",
  },
  {
    label: "a consent past its end date",
    connection: { validUntil: SYNC_TEST_NOW - HOUR_MS },
    account: {},
    reason: "connection_inactive",
  },
  {
    label: "a removed connection",
    connection: { removedAt: SYNC_TEST_NOW - DAY_MS },
    account: {},
    reason: "connection_inactive",
  },
];

describe("runAccountSync: skips", () => {
  it.each(SKIP_CASES)("skips $label without calling the bank", async (skipCase) => {
    const otherConnection = insertConnection(h.t.sqlite, {
      now: h.clock.now,
      ...skipCase.connection,
    });
    const otherAccount = insertAccount(h.t.sqlite, {
      connectionId: otherConnection,
      now: h.clock.now,
      ...skipCase.account,
    });
    const outcome = await sync("background", undefined, otherAccount);
    expect(outcome).toMatchObject({
      status: "skipped",
      skipReason: skipCase.reason,
      retryAt: null,
    });
    expect(h.bank.balanceCalls).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(lastRun(otherAccount)).toMatchObject({
      status: "skipped",
      skipReason: skipCase.reason,
    });
    expect(eventsOf(h.events, "sync.started")).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(eventsOf(h.events, "sync.finished")).toEqual([
      expect.objectContaining({
        accountId: otherAccount,
        status: "skipped",
        skipReason: skipCase.reason,
      }),
    ]);
    expect(h.repo.getAccount(otherAccount)?.bgFetchCount).toBe(0);
  });

  it("skips a paused account until the pause ends", async () => {
    const pausedUntil = SYNC_TEST_NOW + 2 * HOUR_MS;
    const paused = insertAccount(h.t.sqlite, {
      connectionId,
      now: h.clock.now,
      rateLimitedUntil: pausedUntil,
    });
    expect(await sync("background", undefined, paused)).toMatchObject({
      status: "skipped",
      skipReason: "rate_limited",
      retryAt: pausedUntil,
    });
    expect(h.bank.balanceCalls).toHaveLength(0);
    h.clock.now = pausedUntil;
    expect((await sync("background", undefined, paused)).status).toBe("succeeded");
  });
});

describe("runAccountSync: background cap", () => {
  it("caps background fetches per local day and resets at local midnight", async () => {
    h.clock.now = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 9, 22, 30); // 23:30 on 9 November in Rome
    expect((await sync("background")).status).toBe("succeeded");
    expect((await sync("background")).status).toBe("succeeded");
    expect(await sync("background")).toMatchObject({ status: "skipped", skipReason: "daily_cap" });
    expect(h.bank.balanceCalls).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(lastRun()).toMatchObject({ status: "skipped", skipReason: "daily_cap" });
    h.clock.now += HOUR_MS; // 00:30 on 10 November in Rome, still 9 November in UTC
    expect((await sync("background")).status).toBe("succeeded");
    expect(h.repo.getAccount(accountId)).toMatchObject({
      bgFetchDay: "2026-11-10",
      bgFetchCount: 1,
    });
  });

  it("counts initial and renewal syncs against the cap", async () => {
    h.settings.update({ backgroundSyncCap: 1 });
    expect((await sync("initial")).status).toBe("succeeded");
    expect(await sync("renewal")).toMatchObject({ status: "skipped", skipReason: "daily_cap" });
  });

  it("charges an initial sync once, so its retries run even when the cap is spent", async () => {
    h.settings.update({ backgroundSyncCap: 1 });
    h.bank.balanceErrors.push(
      ebError(500, "ASPSP_ERROR", "Bank error"),
      ebError(500, "ASPSP_ERROR", "Bank error"),
    );
    const payload = { accountId, trigger: "initial" as const };
    await expect(runAccountSync(h.deps, payload, { number: 1, max: 3 })).rejects.toThrow();
    await expect(runAccountSync(h.deps, payload, { number: 2, max: 3 })).rejects.toThrow();
    expect(await runAccountSync(h.deps, payload, { number: 3, max: 3 })).toMatchObject({
      status: "succeeded",
    });
    expect(h.repo.getAccount(accountId)?.bgFetchCount).toBe(1);
    expect(await sync("background")).toMatchObject({ status: "skipped", skipReason: "daily_cap" });
  });
});

describe("runAccountSync: manual sync and PSU headers", () => {
  it("sends PSU headers for a manual sync from a public address and leaves the cap untouched", async () => {
    h.settings.update({ backgroundSyncCap: 1 });
    await sync("background");
    const outcome = await sync("manual", PUBLIC_PSU);
    expect(outcome.status).toBe("succeeded");
    expect(h.bank.balanceCalls[1]?.psu).toEqual(PUBLIC_PSU);
    expect(h.bank.transactionCalls.at(-1)?.psu).toEqual(PUBLIC_PSU);
    expect(lastRun()).toMatchObject({
      trigger: "manual",
      status: "succeeded",
      withPsuHeaders: true,
    });
    expect(h.repo.getAccount(accountId)?.bgFetchCount).toBe(1);
  });

  it("treats a manual sync from a private address as a background fetch", async () => {
    h.settings.update({ backgroundSyncCap: 1 });
    expect((await sync("manual", PRIVATE_PSU)).status).toBe("succeeded");
    expect(h.bank.balanceCalls[0]?.psu).toBeUndefined();
    expect(lastRun()).toMatchObject({ trigger: "manual", withPsuHeaders: false });
    expect(await sync("manual", PRIVATE_PSU)).toMatchObject({
      status: "skipped",
      skipReason: "daily_cap",
    });
  });

  it("never forwards PSU headers for a trigger other than manual", async () => {
    await sync("background", PUBLIC_PSU);
    expect(h.bank.balanceCalls[0]?.psu).toBeUndefined();
    expect(h.bank.transactionCalls.every((call) => call.psu === undefined)).toBe(true);
    expect(h.repo.getAccount(accountId)?.bgFetchCount).toBe(1);
  });

  it("retries once without PSU headers when the bank refuses them", async () => {
    h.bank.balanceErrors.push(
      ebError(422, "PSU_HEADER_NOT_PROVIDED", "Required PSU header is not provided"),
    );
    const outcome = await sync("manual", PUBLIC_PSU);
    expect(outcome.status).toBe("succeeded");
    expect(h.bank.balanceCalls.map((call) => call.psu)).toEqual([PUBLIC_PSU, undefined]);
    expect(h.bank.transactionCalls.every((call) => call.psu === undefined)).toBe(true);
    expect(lastRun()).toMatchObject({ status: "succeeded", withPsuHeaders: false });
    expect(h.repo.getAccount(accountId)?.bgFetchCount).toBe(1);
  });

  it("skips with daily_cap when the fallback has no background fetch left", async () => {
    h.settings.update({ backgroundSyncCap: 1 });
    await sync("background");
    h.bank.balanceErrors.push(ebError(422, "PSU_HEADER_INVALID", "Invalid PSU header"));
    expect(await sync("manual", PUBLIC_PSU)).toMatchObject({
      status: "skipped",
      skipReason: "daily_cap",
    });
    expect(h.bank.balanceCalls).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(lastRun()).toMatchObject({
      status: "skipped",
      skipReason: "daily_cap",
      withPsuHeaders: false,
    });
  });
});

describe("runAccountSync: bank errors", () => {
  it("pauses the account for six hours on a bank rate limit", async () => {
    h.bank.balanceErrors.push(ebError(429, "ASPSP_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED", "Rate limit exceeded"));
    const retryAt = SYNC_TEST_NOW + RATE_LIMIT_PAUSE_MS;
    expect(await sync("background")).toEqual({
      status: "skipped",
      fetched: 0,
      inserted: 0,
      updated: 0,
      removed: 0,
      errorCode: "ASPSP_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED",
      skipReason: "rate_limited",
      retryAt,
    });
    expect(h.repo.getAccount(accountId)).toMatchObject({
      rateLimitedUntil: retryAt,
      lastSyncErrorCode: "ASPSP_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED",
      lastSyncErrorAt: SYNC_TEST_NOW,
    });
    h.clock.now = SYNC_TEST_NOW + HOUR_MS;
    expect(await sync("background")).toMatchObject({
      status: "skipped",
      skipReason: "rate_limited",
      retryAt,
    });
    expect(h.bank.balanceCalls).toHaveLength(1);
    h.clock.now = retryAt;
    expect((await sync("background")).status).toBe("succeeded");
  });

  it("marks the connection expired on EXPIRED_SESSION, notifies and publishes the change", async () => {
    h.bank.balanceErrors.push(ebError(401, "EXPIRED_SESSION", "Session expired"));
    expect(await sync("background")).toMatchObject({
      status: "failed",
      errorCode: "EXPIRED_SESSION",
      retryAt: null,
    });
    expect(h.repo.getConnection(connectionId)).toMatchObject({
      status: "expired",
      lastErrorCode: "EXPIRED_SESSION",
    });
    const items = h.notifications.list(10).items;
    expect(items.map((item) => item.event)).toEqual(["consent_expired"]);
    expect(items[0]?.params).toEqual({ bankName: "Banca Esempio" });
    expect(eventsOf(h.events, "connection.updated")).toEqual([
      { type: "connection.updated", connectionId, status: "expired" },
    ]);
    expect(h.repo.getAccount(accountId)).toMatchObject({
      status: "active",
      lastSyncErrorCode: "EXPIRED_SESSION",
    });
    expect(await sync("background")).toMatchObject({
      status: "skipped",
      skipReason: "connection_inactive",
    });
  });

  it.each([
    { code: "REVOKED_SESSION", status: "revoked" },
    { code: "CLOSED_SESSION", status: "error" },
  ])("marks the connection $status on $code", async ({ code, status }) => {
    h.bank.balanceErrors.push(ebError(401, code, "Session ended"));
    expect(await sync("background")).toMatchObject({ status: "failed", errorCode: code });
    expect(h.repo.getConnection(connectionId)?.status).toBe(status);
    expect(h.notifications.list(10).items.map((item) => item.event)).toEqual(["connection_error"]);
  });

  it("marks the account unavailable when the bank no longer exposes it", async () => {
    h.bank.balanceErrors.push(ebError(404, "ACCOUNT_DOES_NOT_EXIST", "Account does not exist"));
    expect(await sync("background")).toMatchObject({
      status: "failed",
      errorCode: "ACCOUNT_DOES_NOT_EXIST",
    });
    expect(h.repo.getAccount(accountId)?.status).toBe("unavailable");
    expect(h.repo.getConnection(connectionId)?.status).toBe("active");
  });

  it("throws PermanentJobError for a fatal bank error", async () => {
    h.bank.balanceErrors.push(
      ebError(400, "WRONG_REQUEST_PARAMETERS", "Wrong request parameters provided"),
    );
    const error = await sync("background").catch((caught: unknown) => caught);
    expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(PermanentJobError);
    expect((error as Error).message).toBe("WRONG_REQUEST_PARAMETERS");
    expect(lastRun()).toMatchObject({ status: "failed", errorCode: "WRONG_REQUEST_PARAMETERS" });
  });
});

describe("syncAccountHandler", () => {
  it("retries a retryable bank error with backoff and fails after the last attempt", async () => {
    h.settings.update({ backgroundSyncCap: 4 });
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt += 1) {
      h.bank.balanceErrors.push(ebError(500, "ASPSP_ERROR", "Bank error"));
    }
    const { id } = enqueueAccountSync(h.queue, accountId, "background");
    const worker = createWorker(syncAccountHandler(h.deps));

    await worker.runOnce();
    expect(h.queue.get(id)).toMatchObject({
      status: "queued",
      attempts: 1,
      runAfter: SYNC_TEST_NOW + 30_000,
    });
    h.clock.now += 30_000;
    await worker.runOnce();
    expect(h.queue.get(id)).toMatchObject({ status: "queued", attempts: 2 });
    h.clock.now += 120_000;
    await worker.runOnce();
    expect(h.queue.get(id)).toMatchObject({ status: "failed", attempts: 3 });

    expect(eventsOf(h.events, "sync.finished").map((event) => event.retryAt)).toEqual([
      SYNC_TEST_NOW + 30_000,
      SYNC_TEST_NOW + 30_000 + 120_000,
      null,
    ]);
    expect(
      h.repo.listSyncRuns(accountId, 10).map((run) => [run.status, run.errorCode]),
    ).toEqual([
      ["failed", "ASPSP_ERROR"],
      ["failed", "ASPSP_ERROR"],
      ["failed", "ASPSP_ERROR"],
    ]);
  });

  it("fails the job permanently for a fatal bank error", async () => {
    h.bank.balanceErrors.push(
      ebError(400, "WRONG_REQUEST_PARAMETERS", "Wrong request parameters provided"),
    );
    const { id } = enqueueAccountSync(h.queue, accountId, "background");
    await createWorker(syncAccountHandler(h.deps)).runOnce();
    const state = h.queue.get(id);
    expect(state).toMatchObject({ status: "failed", attempts: 1 });
    expect(state?.lastError).toContain("WRONG_REQUEST_PARAMETERS");
  });

  it("fails a job with an invalid payload permanently without calling the bank", async () => {
    const id = h.queue.enqueue(SYNC_ACCOUNT_JOB, { accountId: "one", trigger: "manual" });
    await createWorker(syncAccountHandler(h.deps)).runOnce();
    expect(h.queue.get(id)).toMatchObject({ status: "failed", attempts: 1 });
    expect(h.bank.balanceCalls).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it("completes the job when the connection needs a new consent", async () => {
    h.bank.balanceErrors.push(ebError(401, "EXPIRED_SESSION", "Session expired"));
    const { id } = enqueueAccountSync(h.queue, accountId, "background");
    await createWorker(syncAccountHandler(h.deps)).runOnce();
    expect(h.queue.get(id)).toMatchObject({ status: "succeeded", attempts: 1 });
  });

  it("fails every job permanently when Enable Banking is not configured", async () => {
    const { id } = enqueueAccountSync(h.queue, accountId, "manual");
    await createWorker(unconfiguredSyncHandler()).runOnce();
    const state = h.queue.get(id);
    expect(state).toMatchObject({ status: "failed", attempts: 1 });
    expect(state?.lastError).toContain("banking_not_configured");
  });
});

describe("enqueueAccountSync", () => {
  it("dedupes by account and stores PSU headers only when given", () => {
    const first = enqueueAccountSync(h.queue, accountId, "manual", PUBLIC_PSU);
    expect(first.created).toBe(true);
    expect(enqueueAccountSync(h.queue, accountId, "background")).toEqual({
      id: first.id,
      created: false,
    });
    const other = insertAccount(h.t.sqlite, { connectionId, now: h.clock.now });
    enqueueAccountSync(h.queue, other, "background");
    expect([h.queue.claimNext()?.payload, h.queue.claimNext()?.payload]).toEqual([
      { accountId, trigger: "manual", psu: PUBLIC_PSU },
      { accountId: other, trigger: "background" },
    ]);
  });
});
```

`apps/server/src/finance/sync-task.test.ts`:

```ts
import { pino } from "pino";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { ScheduledTask } from "../scheduler";
import { JobQueue } from "../jobs/queue";
import { syncDedupeKey } from "../jobs/types";
import { SettingsStore } from "../settings/store";
import { createTestDatabase, type TestDatabase } from "../test/db";
import { DAY_MS, insertAccount, insertConnection, SYNC_TEST_TIMEZONE } from "../test/sync-fixture";
import { FinanceRepository } from "./repository";
import { dailySyncTask } from "./sync-task";

/** A wall-clock time in Rome during November 2026 (UTC+1). */
function rome(day: number, hour: number, minute: number): Date {
  return new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 10, day, hour - 1, minute));
}

describe("dailySyncTask", () => {
  let t: TestDatabase;
  let clock: { now: number };
  let repo: FinanceRepository;
  let queue: JobQueue;
  let settings: SettingsStore;
  let task: ScheduledTask;
  const ids = {
    syncable: 0,
    disabled: 0,
    noUid: 0,
    paused: 0,
    expiring: 0,
    expired: 0,
    removed: 0,
    revoked: 0,
  };

  beforeEach(() => {
    t = createTestDatabase();
    clock = { now: rome(1, 12, 0).getTime() };
    const now = () => clock.now;
    repo = new FinanceRepository(t.db, now);
    queue = new JobQueue(t.sqlite, now);
    settings = new SettingsStore(t.db, now);
    task = dailySyncTask({
      repo,
      queue,
      settings,
      timezone: SYNC_TEST_TIMEZONE,
      logger: pino({ level: "silent" }),
    });

    const created = clock.now;
    const active = insertConnection(t.sqlite, { now: created, validUntil: created + 120 * DAY_MS });
    ids.syncable = insertAccount(t.sqlite, { connectionId: active, now: created });
    ids.disabled = insertAccount(t.sqlite, { connectionId: active, now: created, status: "disabled" });
    ids.noUid = insertAccount(t.sqlite, {
      connectionId: active,
      now: created,
      providerAccountUid: null,
    });
    ids.paused = insertAccount(t.sqlite, {
      connectionId: active,
      now: created,
      rateLimitedUntil: rome(9, 8, 0).getTime(),
    });
    const expiring = insertConnection(t.sqlite, {
      now: created,
      validUntil: rome(14, 12, 0).getTime(),
    });
    ids.expiring = insertAccount(t.sqlite, { connectionId: expiring, now: created });
    const expired = insertConnection(t.sqlite, {
      now: created,
      validUntil: rome(8, 12, 0).getTime(),
    });
    ids.expired = insertAccount(t.sqlite, { connectionId: expired, now: created });
    const removed = insertConnection(t.sqlite, { now: created, removedAt: created });
    ids.removed = insertAccount(t.sqlite, { connectionId: removed, now: created });
    const revoked = insertConnection(t.sqlite, { now: created, status: "revoked" });
    ids.revoked = insertAccount(t.sqlite, { connectionId: revoked, now: created });
  });
  afterEach(() => t.dispose());

  async function tick(at: Date): Promise<void> {
    clock.now = at.getTime();
    await task.run(at);
  }

  function queuedKeys(): Set<string> {
    return queue.activeKeys("sync:");
  }

  /** Completes every queued job and returns the payloads in queue order. */
  function drain(): unknown[] {
    const payloads: unknown[] = [];
    for (let job = queue.claimNext(); job !== null; job = queue.claimNext()) {
      payloads.push(job.payload);
      queue.complete(job.id);
    }
    return payloads;
  }

  it("is named bank-daily-sync", () => {
    expect(task.name).toBe("bank-daily-sync");
  });

  it("does nothing before the configured time", async () => {
    await tick(rome(9, 5, 59));
    expect(queuedKeys().size).toBe(0);
  });

  it("queues one background sync per eligible account at the configured time and marks the day", async () => {
    await tick(rome(9, 6, 0));
    expect(queuedKeys()).toEqual(
      new Set([syncDedupeKey(ids.syncable), syncDedupeKey(ids.expiring)]),
    );
    expect(drain()).toEqual([
      { accountId: ids.syncable, trigger: "background" },
      { accountId: ids.expiring, trigger: "background" },
    ]);
    expect(repo.getAccount(ids.syncable)?.lastScheduledSyncDay).toBe("2026-11-09");
    expect(repo.getAccount(ids.paused)?.lastScheduledSyncDay).toBeNull();
    expect(repo.getAccount(ids.expired)?.lastScheduledSyncDay).toBeNull();
  });

  it("queues nothing more on later ticks of the same day", async () => {
    await tick(rome(9, 6, 0));
    drain();
    await tick(rome(9, 6, 1));
    await tick(rome(9, 7, 30));
    expect(queuedKeys().size).toBe(0);
  });

  it("picks up a paused account once its pause ends", async () => {
    await tick(rome(9, 6, 0));
    drain();
    await tick(rome(9, 8, 1));
    expect(queuedKeys()).toEqual(new Set([syncDedupeKey(ids.paused)]));
  });

  it("runs again on the next local day", async () => {
    await tick(rome(9, 6, 0));
    drain();
    await tick(rome(10, 5, 59));
    expect(queuedKeys().size).toBe(0);
    await tick(rome(10, 6, 0));
    expect(queuedKeys()).toEqual(
      new Set([
        syncDedupeKey(ids.syncable),
        syncDedupeKey(ids.paused),
        syncDedupeKey(ids.expiring),
      ]),
    );
  });

  it("honours a custom daily sync time", async () => {
    settings.update({ dailySyncTime: "21:30" });
    await tick(rome(9, 21, 29));
    expect(queuedKeys().size).toBe(0);
    await tick(rome(9, 21, 30));
    expect(queuedKeys()).toEqual(
      new Set([
        syncDedupeKey(ids.syncable),
        syncDedupeKey(ids.paused),
        syncDedupeKey(ids.expiring),
      ]),
    );
  });
});
```

`apps/server/src/finance/sync-routes.test.ts`:

```ts
import { syncQueuedResponseSchema } from "@bursar/shared";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { JobQueue } from "../jobs/queue";
import { syncDedupeKey } from "../jobs/types";
import { createTestApp, type TestApp } from "../test/app";
import { createTestDatabase, type TestDatabase } from "../test/db";
import {
  insertAccount,
  insertConnection,
  SYNC_TEST_NOW,
  SYNC_TEST_TIMEZONE,
} from "../test/sync-fixture";
import { FinanceRepository } from "./repository";
import { enqueueAccountSync } from "./sync";
import { syncRoutes } from "./sync-routes";

const HOUR_MS = 3_600_000;
const BROWSER_UA = "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) ExampleBrowser/1.0";

describe("sync routes", () => {
  let t: TestDatabase;
  let clock: { now: number };
  let queue: JobQueue;
  let clientIp: string;
  let api: TestApp;
  let connectionId: number;
  let accountId: number;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    t = createTestDatabase();
    clock = { now: SYNC_TEST_NOW };
    const now = () => clock.now;
    const repo = new FinanceRepository(t.db, now);
    queue = new JobQueue(t.sqlite, now);
    clientIp = "10.0.0.8";
    api = await createTestApp({
      database: t,
      routers: [
        {
          prefix: "/api",
          router: syncRoutes({
            repo,
            queue,
            clientIp: () => clientIp,
            timezone: SYNC_TEST_TIMEZONE,
            now,
          }),
        },
      ],
      now,
    });
    connectionId = insertConnection(t.sqlite, { now: clock.now });
    accountId = insertAccount(t.sqlite, { connectionId, now: clock.now });
  });
  afterEach(() => t.dispose());

  function post(path: string) {
    return api.json(path, { method: "POST" });
  }

  /** POST with explicit browser headers (the `json()` helper sends none of these). */
  function postWithHeaders(path: string, headers: Record<string, string>) {
    return api.app.request(path, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { cookie: api.cookie, origin: api.origin, ...headers },
    });
  }

  function nextPayload(): unknown {
    return queue.claimNext()?.payload;
  }

  it("queues a manual sync without PSU headers for a private client address", async () => {
    const response = await post(`/api/accounts/${accountId}/sync`);
    expect(response.status).toBe(202);
    expect(syncQueuedResponseSchema.parse(response.body)).toEqual({ queued: 1 });
    expect(nextPayload()).toEqual({ accountId, trigger: "manual" });
  });

  it("attaches PSU headers for a public client address", async () => {
    clientIp = "203.0.113.9";
    const response = await postWithHeaders(`/api/accounts/${accountId}/sync`, {
      "user-agent": BROWSER_UA,
      accept: "application/json",
      "accept-language": "it-IT,it;q=0.9",
    });
    expect(response.status).toBe(202);
    expect(nextPayload()).toEqual({
      accountId,
      trigger: "manual",
      psu: {
        ipAddress: "203.0.113.9",
        userAgent: BROWSER_UA,
        accept: "application/json",
        acceptLanguage: "it-IT,it;q=0.9",
      },
    });
  });

  it("sends no PSU headers without a user agent", async () => {
    clientIp = "203.0.113.9";
    const response = await postWithHeaders(`/api/accounts/${accountId}/sync`, {});
    expect(response.status).toBe(202);
    expect(nextPayload()).toEqual({ accountId, trigger: "manual" });
  });

  it("answers 409 sync_in_progress while a sync is queued", async () => {
    expect((await post(`/api/accounts/${accountId}/sync`)).status).toBe(202);
    expect(await post(`/api/accounts/${accountId}/sync`)).toMatchObject({
      status: 409,
      body: { code: "sync_in_progress" },
    });
  });

  it("answers 404 for an unknown or malformed account id", async () => {
    for (const path of ["/api/accounts/999/sync", "/api/accounts/abc/sync", "/api/accounts/0/sync"]) {
      expect(await post(path)).toMatchObject({
        status: 404,
        body: { error: "Not found", code: "not_found" },
      });
    }
  });

  interface RefusalCase {
    label: string;
    code: string;
    setup: () => number;
    retryAt?: number;
  }

  it.each<RefusalCase>([
    {
      label: "a disabled account",
      code: "account_inactive",
      setup: () => insertAccount(t.sqlite, { connectionId, now: clock.now, status: "disabled" }),
    },
    {
      label: "an account without a provider id",
      code: "account_inactive",
      setup: () =>
        insertAccount(t.sqlite, { connectionId, now: clock.now, providerAccountUid: null }),
    },
    {
      label: "an account of an expired connection",
      code: "connection_inactive",
      setup: () =>
        insertAccount(t.sqlite, {
          connectionId: insertConnection(t.sqlite, {
            now: clock.now,
            validUntil: clock.now - HOUR_MS,
          }),
          now: clock.now,
        }),
    },
    {
      label: "a paused account",
      code: "rate_limited",
      setup: () =>
        insertAccount(t.sqlite, {
          connectionId,
          now: clock.now,
          rateLimitedUntil: SYNC_TEST_NOW + 3 * HOUR_MS,
        }),
      retryAt: SYNC_TEST_NOW + 3 * HOUR_MS,
    },
  ])("refuses $label with $code", async ({ setup, code, retryAt }) => {
    const id = setup();
    const response = await post(`/api/accounts/${id}/sync`);
    expect(response.status).toBe(409);
    expect(response.body).toEqual(
      retryAt === undefined
        ? { error: expect.any(String), code }
        : { error: expect.any(String), code, retryAt },
    );
    expect(queue.findActive(syncDedupeKey(id))).toBeNull();
  });

  it("queues every eligible account of a connection", async () => {
    const second = insertAccount(t.sqlite, { connectionId, now: clock.now });
    insertAccount(t.sqlite, { connectionId, now: clock.now, status: "disabled" });
    const response = await post(`/api/connections/${connectionId}/sync`);
    expect(response).toMatchObject({ status: 202, body: { queued: 2 } });
    expect(queue.activeKeys("sync:")).toEqual(
      new Set([syncDedupeKey(accountId), syncDedupeKey(second)]),
    );
  });

  it("skips accounts that are already syncing", async () => {
    const second = insertAccount(t.sqlite, { connectionId, now: clock.now });
    enqueueAccountSync(queue, accountId, "background");
    expect(await post(`/api/connections/${connectionId}/sync`)).toMatchObject({
      status: 202,
      body: { queued: 1 },
    });
    expect(queue.findActive(syncDedupeKey(second))).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it("answers nothing_to_sync when a connection has no eligible account", async () => {
    const lonely = insertConnection(t.sqlite, { now: clock.now });
    insertAccount(t.sqlite, { connectionId: lonely, now: clock.now, status: "disabled" });
    expect(await post(`/api/connections/${lonely}/sync`)).toMatchObject({
      status: 409,
      body: { code: "nothing_to_sync" },
    });
  });

  it("answers sync_in_progress when every account of a connection is already syncing", async () => {
    enqueueAccountSync(queue, accountId, "background");
    expect(await post(`/api/connections/${connectionId}/sync`)).toMatchObject({
      status: 409,
      body: { code: "sync_in_progress" },
    });
  });

  it("answers rate_limited with the earliest retryAt when every account is paused", async () => {
    const paused = insertConnection(t.sqlite, { now: clock.now });
    insertAccount(t.sqlite, {
      connectionId: paused,
      now: clock.now,
      rateLimitedUntil: SYNC_TEST_NOW + 3 * HOUR_MS,
    });
    insertAccount(t.sqlite, {
      connectionId: paused,
      now: clock.now,
      rateLimitedUntil: SYNC_TEST_NOW + HOUR_MS,
    });
    expect(await post(`/api/connections/${paused}/sync`)).toMatchObject({
      status: 409,
      body: { code: "rate_limited", retryAt: SYNC_TEST_NOW + HOUR_MS },
    });
  });

  it("answers 404 for an unknown connection and 409 for an inactive one", async () => {
    expect(await post("/api/connections/999/sync")).toMatchObject({
      status: 404,
      body: { code: "not_found" },
    });
    const revoked = insertConnection(t.sqlite, { now: clock.now, status: "revoked" });
    insertAccount(t.sqlite, { connectionId: revoked, now: clock.now });
    expect(await post(`/api/connections/${revoked}/sync`)).toMatchObject({
      status: 409,
      body: { code: "connection_inactive" },
    });
  });

  it("requires a session", async () => {
    const response = await api.app.request(`/api/accounts/${accountId}/sync`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { origin: api.origin },
    });
    expect(response.status).toBe(401);
    expect(queue.findActive(syncDedupeKey(accountId))).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

`apps/server/src/finance/sync-wiring.test.ts` boots the real server through `startBursar` (Task 5 seed hook, Task 9 `mailer`, Task 10 `bankingClient` overrides). The seed keeps a reference to the server's own SQLite handle so the test can read the job row; the job worker polls once a second, hence the `waitFor` timeout:

```ts
import { mkdtempSync, rmSync } from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { pino } from "pino";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { SESSION_COOKIE } from "../auth/routes";
import { SessionStore } from "../auth/sessions";
import { loadConfig } from "../config";
import type { Sqlite } from "../db";
import { JobQueue } from "../jobs/queue";
import { SYNC_ACCOUNT_JOB } from "../jobs/types";
import { type RunningBursar, startBursar } from "../server";
import { MIGRATIONS_DIR } from "../test/db";
import { insertAccount, insertConnection } from "../test/sync-fixture";

describe("sync wiring in startBursar", () => {
  let dir: string;
  let running: RunningBursar[];

  beforeEach(() => {
    dir = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), "bursar-sync-"));
    running = [];
  });
  afterEach(async () => {
    for (const instance of running) await instance.close();
    rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  });

  async function boot(overrides: Parameters<typeof startBursar>[2]): Promise<RunningBursar> {
    const config = loadConfig({
      BURSAR_PUBLIC_URL: "http://127.0.0.1",
      TZ: "UTC",
      BURSAR_MASTER_KEY: Buffer.alloc(32, 3).toString("base64"),
      BURSAR_DATA_DIR: dir,
      BURSAR_MIGRATIONS_DIR: MIGRATIONS_DIR,
    });
    const instance = await startBursar({ ...config, port: 0 }, pino({ level: "silent" }), overrides);
    running.push(instance);
    return instance;
  }

  it("mounts the manual sync route behind the session check", async () => {
    const seeded = { token: "", accountId: 0 };
    const instance = await boot({
      bankingClient: null,
      mailer: null,
      seed: ({ db, sqlite, now }) => {
        const connectionId = insertConnection(sqlite, { now: now() });
        // Disabled: the daily sync task never queues it, so the route answer is deterministic.
        seeded.accountId = insertAccount(sqlite, { connectionId, now: now(), status: "disabled" });
        seeded.token = new SessionStore(db).create("sync-wiring-test");
      },
    });
    const url = `http://127.0.0.1:${instance.port}/api/accounts/${seeded.accountId}/sync`;
    const anonymous = await fetch(url, { method: "POST", headers: { origin: "http://127.0.0.1" } });
    expect(anonymous.status).toBe(401);
    const response = await fetch(url, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { origin: "http://127.0.0.1", cookie: `${SESSION_COOKIE}=${seeded.token}` },
    });
    expect(response.status).toBe(409);
    expect(await response.json()).toMatchObject({ code: "account_inactive" });
  });

  it("fails sync jobs permanently when Enable Banking is not configured", async () => {
    const captured: { sqlite?: Sqlite; jobId: number } = { jobId: 0 };
    await boot({
      bankingClient: null,
      mailer: null,
      seed: ({ sqlite, now }) => {
        captured.sqlite = sqlite;
        const connectionId = insertConnection(sqlite, { now: now() });
        const accountId = insertAccount(sqlite, { connectionId, now: now(), status: "disabled" });
        captured.jobId = new JobQueue(sqlite).enqueue(SYNC_ACCOUNT_JOB, {
          accountId,
          trigger: "manual",
        });
      },
    });
    await vi.waitFor(
      () => {
        const row = captured.sqlite
          ?.prepare("SELECT status, attempts, last_error AS lastError FROM jobs WHERE id = ?")
          .get(captured.jobId) as
          | { status: string; attempts: number; lastError: string | null }
          | undefined;
        expect(row).toMatchObject({ status: "failed", attempts: 1 });
        expect(row?.lastError).toContain("banking_not_configured");
      },
      { timeout: 10_000, interval: 100 },
    );
  });
});
```
