```ts
import { BlockList, isIP } from "node:net";
import { getConnInfo } from "@hono/node-server/conninfo";
import type { Context } from "hono";

/**
 * Resolves the client address for rate limiting (auth) and PSU headers (manual sync).
 * CF-Connecting-IP is set by Cloudflare's edge; any other client could forge it, so it is
 * honoured only when the operator says the app is reachable through Cloudflare alone.
 */
export function createClientIpResolver(trustCfConnectingIp: boolean): (c: Context) => string {
  return (c) => {
    const forwarded = trustCfConnectingIp ? c.req.header("cf-connecting-ip")?.trim() : undefined;
    if (forwarded) return forwarded;
    try {
      return getConnInfo(c).remote.address || "unknown";
    } catch {
      // No Node socket bindings (in-process `app.request` in tests).
      return "unknown";
    }
  };
}

const NON_PUBLIC = new BlockList();
for (const [network, prefix] of [
  ["0.0.0.0", 8], // "this network", includes the unspecified 0.0.0.0
  ["10.0.0.0", 8], // private
  ["100.64.0.0", 10], // carrier-grade NAT
  ["127.0.0.0", 8], // loopback
  ["169.254.0.0", 16], // link-local
  ["172.16.0.0", 12], // private
  ["192.0.0.0", 24], // IETF protocol assignments
  ["192.168.0.0", 16], // private
  ["198.18.0.0", 15], // benchmarking
  ["224.0.0.0", 4], // multicast
  ["240.0.0.0", 4], // reserved, includes broadcast
] as const) {
  NON_PUBLIC.addSubnet(network, prefix, "ipv4");
}
NON_PUBLIC.addAddress("::", "ipv6"); // unspecified
NON_PUBLIC.addAddress("::1", "ipv6"); // loopback
for (const [network, prefix] of [
  ["fc00::", 7], // unique local
  ["fe80::", 10], // link-local
  ["ff00::", 8], // multicast
  ["100::", 64], // discard-only
] as const) {
  NON_PUBLIC.addSubnet(network, prefix, "ipv6");
}

/**
 * True when the address can be a real user's public address, so forwarding it to the bank as
 * `Psu-Ip-Address` is meaningful. IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses are checked against the IPv4
 * rules (Node's BlockList does that). Documentation ranges (192.0.2/24, 198.51.100/24,
 * 203.0.113/24, 2001:db8::/32) are deliberately not excluded: they never occur on real
 * traffic and tests use them as fictional public addresses.
 */
export function isPublicIp(ip: string): boolean {
  let value = ip.trim();
  if (value.startsWith("[") && value.endsWith("]")) value = value.slice(1, -1);
  const zone = value.indexOf("%");
  if (zone !== -1) value = value.slice(0, zone);
  const family = isIP(value);
  if (family === 4) return !NON_PUBLIC.check(value, "ipv4");
  if (family === 6) return !NON_PUBLIC.check(value, "ipv6");
  return false;
}
```

`apps/server/src/finance/connection-status.ts`:

```ts
import { effectiveConnectionStatus } from "@bursar/shared";
import type { EventBus } from "../events/bus";
import { notificationKeys } from "../notifications/keys";
import type { NotificationService } from "../notifications/service";
import type { FinanceRepository } from "./repository";

export interface ConnectionStatusDeps {
  repo: FinanceRepository;
  notifications: NotificationService;
  bus: EventBus;
  now: () => number;
  timezone: string;
}

/**
 * Records that a connection can no longer be used until the owner renews the consent.
 * No-op for unknown or removed connections and when the stored status is already `status`,
 * so repeated failures raise one notification and one event.
 */
export function markConnectionEnded(
  deps: ConnectionStatusDeps,
  connectionId: number,
  status: "expired" | "revoked" | "error",
  error?: { code: string | null; message: string | null },
): void {
  const connection = deps.repo.getConnection(connectionId);
  if (!connection || connection.removedAt !== null || connection.status === status) return;
  const at = deps.now();
  const params = { bankName: connection.aspspName };
  deps.repo.transaction(() => {
    deps.repo.updateConnection(connectionId, {
      status,
      lastErrorCode: error?.code ?? null,
      lastErrorMessage: error?.message ?? null,
      lastErrorAt: error ? at : null,
      updatedAt: at,
    });
    if (status === "expired") {
      deps.notifications.raise({
        event: "consent_expired",
        dedupeKey: notificationKeys.consentExpired(connectionId, connection.validUntil),
        params,
        link: "/accounts",
      });
    } else {
      deps.notifications.raise({
        event: "connection_error",
        dedupeKey: notificationKeys.connectionError(connectionId, at),
        params,
        link: "/accounts",
      });
    }
  });
  deps.bus.publish({
    type: "connection.updated",
    connectionId,
    status: effectiveConnectionStatus(status, connection.validUntil, at, deps.timezone),
  });
}
```

```ts
import {
  addDays,
  effectiveConnectionStatus,
  type LocalDate,
  MoneyParseError,
  type SkipReason,
  type SyncTrigger,
  toLocalDate,
} from "@bursar/shared";
import type { Logger } from "pino";
import type { EnableBankingApi, PsuHeaders, TransactionsQuery } from "../eb/client";
import { EnableBankingError } from "../eb/errors";
import type { EbBalance, EbTransaction } from "../eb/schemas";
import type { EventBus } from "../events/bus";
import { isPublicIp } from "../http/client-ip";
import { backoffMs, type JobQueue } from "../jobs/queue";
import {
  parsePayload,
  SYNC_ACCOUNT_JOB,
  type SyncAccountPayload,
  syncAccountPayloadSchema,
  syncDedupeKey,
} from "../jobs/types";
import { type JobHandler, PermanentJobError } from "../jobs/worker";
import type { NotificationService } from "../notifications/service";
import type { SettingsStore } from "../settings/store";
import { type ConnectionStatusDeps, markConnectionEnded } from "./connection-status";
import {
  assignFingerprints,
  type NormalizedTransaction,
  normalizeBalance,
  normalizeTransaction,
} from "./normalize";
import { applyReconciliation, planReconciliation } from "./reconcile";
import type { AccountRow, ConnectionRow, FinanceRepository, NewSyncRun } from "./repository";

export const MAX_TRANSACTION_PAGES = 500;
export const RATE_LIMIT_PAUSE_MS = 6 * 3_600_000;
export const SYNC_LOOKBACK_DAYS = 7;
/**
 * An incremental fetch reaches back to the oldest stored pending entry (so a pending row the bank
 * stopped listing is counted missing and removed, spec §6.3), but never further than this.
 */
export const PENDING_LOOKBACK_DAYS = 90;
/** One run plus two retries, after 30 s and 2 min (the queue's `backoffMs`). */
export const SYNC_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3;
/** Error codes raised by Bursar itself; they share `errorCode` with Enable Banking codes. */
export const PAGINATION_LOOP = "PAGINATION_LOOP";
export const INTERNAL_ERROR = "INTERNAL_ERROR";
/** Provider data Bursar cannot read (a malformed amount that escaped the per-item checks). */
export const INVALID_PROVIDER_DATA = "INVALID_PROVIDER_DATA";

const PSU_HEADER_ERRORS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set([
  "PSU_HEADER_NOT_PROVIDED",
  "PSU_HEADER_INVALID",
]);
const MAX_ERROR_MESSAGE_LENGTH = 500;

export interface SyncDeps {
  repo: FinanceRepository;
  api: EnableBankingApi;
  bus: EventBus;
  notifications: NotificationService;
  settings: SettingsStore;
  timezone: string;
  now: () => number;
  logger: Logger;
}

export interface SyncOutcome {
  status: "succeeded" | "failed" | "skipped";
  fetched: number;
  inserted: number;
  updated: number;
  removed: number;
  errorCode: string | null;
  skipReason: SkipReason | null;
  retryAt: number | null;
}

type AccountPatch = Parameters<FinanceRepository["updateAccount"]>[1];

interface ActiveRun {
  id: number;
  account: AccountRow;
  trigger: SyncTrigger;
  /** Headers used by the current fetch; cleared by the PSU fallback. */
  psu: PsuHeaders | undefined;
}

interface TransactionWindow {
  strategy: "default" | "longest";
  dateFrom: LocalDate | null;
}

interface FetchedData {
  balances: EbBalance[];
  transactions: EbTransaction[];
  /** Start of the requested period; null when the longest history was fetched. */
  windowStart: LocalDate | null;
  /** Provider items the client already dropped (schema mismatch). */
  skipped: number;
}

type Preflight =
  | { kind: "skip"; reason: SkipReason; retryAt: number | null }
  | { kind: "run"; uid: string };

/** A run stopped by a guard of Bursar's own (not by an Enable Banking error). */
class SyncAbortError extends Error {
  constructor(readonly code: string) {
    super(code);
    this.name = "SyncAbortError";
  }
}

function emptyOutcome(
  status: SyncOutcome["status"],
  patch: Partial<Omit<SyncOutcome, "status">> = {},
): SyncOutcome {
  return {
    status,
    fetched: 0,
    inserted: 0,
    updated: 0,
    removed: 0,
    errorCode: null,
    skipReason: null,
    retryAt: null,
    ...patch,
  };
}

function newRun(
  accountId: number,
  trigger: SyncTrigger,
  startedAt: number,
  overrides: Pick<NewSyncRun, "status"> & Partial<NewSyncRun>,
): NewSyncRun {
  return {
    accountId,
    trigger,
    skipReason: null,
    withPsuHeaders: false,
    startedAt,
    finishedAt: null,
    fetched: 0,
    inserted: 0,
    updated: 0,
    removed: 0,
    errorCode: null,
    errorMessage: null,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function statusDeps(deps: SyncDeps): ConnectionStatusDeps {
  return {
    repo: deps.repo,
    notifications: deps.notifications,
    bus: deps.bus,
    now: deps.now,
    timezone: deps.timezone,
  };
}

function preflight(
  deps: SyncDeps,
  account: AccountRow,
  connection: ConnectionRow | null,
  now: number,
): Preflight {
  if (account.status !== "active") {
    return { kind: "skip", reason: "account_inactive", retryAt: null };
  }
  if (!connection || connection.removedAt !== null) {
    return { kind: "skip", reason: "connection_inactive", retryAt: null };
  }
  const status = effectiveConnectionStatus(
    connection.status,
    connection.validUntil,
    now,
    deps.timezone,
  );
  if (status === "expired" || status === "revoked" || status === "error") {
    return { kind: "skip", reason: "connection_inactive", retryAt: null };
  }
  if (account.providerAccountUid === null) {
    return { kind: "skip", reason: "no_provider_uid", retryAt: null };
  }
  if (account.rateLimitedUntil !== null && account.rateLimitedUntil > now) {
    return { kind: "skip", reason: "rate_limited", retryAt: account.rateLimitedUntil };
  }
  return { kind: "run", uid: account.providerAccountUid };
}

/** PSU headers are forwarded only for a manual sync from a public client address. */
function forwardedPsu(payload: SyncAccountPayload): PsuHeaders | undefined {
  if (payload.trigger !== "manual" || !payload.psu) return undefined;
  return isPublicIp(payload.psu.ipAddress) ? payload.psu : undefined;
}

function isPsuHeaderError(error: unknown): error is EnableBankingError {
  return (
    error instanceof EnableBankingError && error.code !== null && PSU_HEADER_ERRORS.has(error.code)
  );
}

function publishFinished(
  deps: SyncDeps,
  account: AccountRow,
  trigger: SyncTrigger,
  outcome: SyncOutcome,
): void {
  deps.bus.publish({
    type: "sync.finished",
    accountId: account.id,
    connectionId: account.connectionId,
    trigger,
    status: outcome.status,
    inserted: outcome.inserted,
    updated: outcome.updated,
    removed: outcome.removed,
    errorCode: outcome.errorCode,
    skipReason: outcome.skipReason,
    retryAt: outcome.retryAt,
  });
}

function recordSkip(
  deps: SyncDeps,
  account: AccountRow,
  trigger: SyncTrigger,
  reason: SkipReason,
  retryAt: number | null,
): SyncOutcome {
  const now = deps.now();
  deps.repo.startSyncRun(
    newRun(account.id, trigger, now, { status: "skipped", skipReason: reason, finishedAt: now }),
  );
  const outcome = emptyOutcome("skipped", { skipReason: reason, retryAt });
  publishFinished(deps, account, trigger, outcome);
  deps.logger.debug({ accountId: account.id, trigger, skipReason: reason }, "Account sync skipped");
  return outcome;
}

function lastSyncPatch(outcome: SyncOutcome, now: number): AccountPatch {
  if (outcome.status === "succeeded") {
    return { lastSyncedAt: now, lastSyncErrorCode: null, lastSyncErrorAt: null };
  }
  if (outcome.errorCode !== null) {
    return { lastSyncErrorCode: outcome.errorCode, lastSyncErrorAt: now };
  }
  return {};
}

/**
 * True while the account still exists and is not removed. A disconnect or a purge can land while
 * a sync waits on the bank (`cancelQueued` only drops queued jobs); every write after the network
 * calls checks this first. The check and the writes that follow run synchronously, with no
 * `await` in between, so no request handler can interleave.
 */
function isLiveAccount(deps: SyncDeps, accountId: number): boolean {
  const current = deps.repo.getAccount(accountId);
  return current !== null && current.status !== "removed";
}

function finishRun(
  deps: SyncDeps,
  run: ActiveRun,
  outcome: SyncOutcome,
  extra: { errorMessage?: string; accountPatch?: AccountPatch } = {},
): SyncOutcome {
  const now = deps.now();
  const live = isLiveAccount(deps, run.account.id);
  // After a purge the run row is gone and this update touches nothing.
  deps.repo.finishSyncRun(run.id, {
    status: outcome.status,
    skipReason: outcome.skipReason,
    withPsuHeaders: run.psu !== undefined,
    finishedAt: now,
    fetched: outcome.fetched,
    inserted: outcome.inserted,
    updated: outcome.updated,
    removed: outcome.removed,
    errorCode: outcome.errorCode,
    errorMessage: extra.errorMessage ?? null,
  });
  // A removed or purged account is never patched: a late `unavailable` or a sync timestamp would
  // bring it back to life in the panel.
  if (live) {
    deps.repo.updateAccount(run.account.id, {
      ...lastSyncPatch(outcome, now),
      ...extra.accountPatch,
      updatedAt: now,
    });
  }
  publishFinished(deps, run.account, run.trigger, outcome);
  deps.logger.info(
    {
      accountId: run.account.id,
      trigger: run.trigger,
      status: outcome.status,
      fetched: outcome.fetched,
      inserted: outcome.inserted,
      updated: outcome.updated,
      removed: outcome.removed,
      errorCode: outcome.errorCode,
      skipReason: outcome.skipReason,
    },
    "Account sync finished",
  );
  return outcome;
}

/** The oldest stored pending entry not older than `floor`, or null. */
function oldestPendingSince(
  repo: FinanceRepository,
  accountId: number,
  floor: LocalDate,
): LocalDate | null {
  let oldest: LocalDate | null = null;
  for (const row of repo.transactionsSince(accountId, floor)) {
    if (row.status === "pending" && (oldest === null || row.sortDate < oldest)) {
      oldest = row.sortDate;
    }
  }
  return oldest;
}

/**
 * The incremental window starts at `lastBooked − 7` or at the oldest stored pending entry
 * (bounded to `PENDING_LOOKBACK_DAYS`), whichever is earlier: a card hold older than the booked
 * window must be inside the window, or its absence is never counted and it is never removed.
 */
function transactionWindow(
  repo: FinanceRepository,
  accountId: number,
  trigger: SyncTrigger,
  today: LocalDate,
): TransactionWindow {
  const lastBooked = trigger === "initial" ? null : repo.lastBookedDate(accountId);
  if (lastBooked === null) return { strategy: "longest", dateFrom: null };
  const fromBooked = addDays(lastBooked, -SYNC_LOOKBACK_DAYS);
  const oldestPending = oldestPendingSince(
    repo,
    accountId,
    addDays(today, -PENDING_LOOKBACK_DAYS),
  );
  // LocalDate strings (YYYY-MM-DD) compare chronologically.
  const from = oldestPending !== null && oldestPending < fromBooked ? oldestPending : fromBooked;
  return { strategy: "default", dateFrom: from > today ? today : from };
}

async function fetchTransactionPages(
  deps: SyncDeps,
  run: ActiveRun,
  uid: string,
  window: TransactionWindow,
): Promise<{ transactions: EbTransaction[]; skipped: number }> {
  const base: TransactionsQuery =
    window.dateFrom === null
      ? { strategy: window.strategy }
      : { strategy: window.strategy, dateFrom: window.dateFrom };
  const transactions: EbTransaction[] = [];
  let skipped = 0;
  const seenKeys = new Set<string>();
  let continuationKey: string | undefined;
  for (let page = 1; page <= MAX_TRANSACTION_PAGES; page += 1) {
    const query = continuationKey === undefined ? base : { ...base, continuationKey };
    const result = await deps.api.getTransactions(uid, query, run.psu);
    transactions.push(...result.transactions);
    skipped += result.skipped ?? 0;
    deps.bus.publish({
      type: "sync.progress",
      accountId: run.account.id,
      fetched: transactions.length,
    });
    const next = result.continuation_key;
    if (next === null || next === undefined || next === "") return { transactions, skipped };
    if (seenKeys.has(next)) throw new SyncAbortError(PAGINATION_LOOP);
    seenKeys.add(next);
    continuationKey = next;
  }
  throw new SyncAbortError(PAGINATION_LOOP);
}

/** Network only: balances and transaction pages. Nothing is written until `storeAccountData`. */
async function fetchAccountData(
  deps: SyncDeps,
  run: ActiveRun,
  uid: string,
  today: LocalDate,
): Promise<FetchedData> {
  const balances = await deps.api.getBalances(uid, run.psu);
  const window = transactionWindow(deps.repo, run.account.id, run.trigger, today);
  try {
    const pages = await fetchTransactionPages(deps, run, uid, window);
    return { balances, ...pages, windowStart: window.dateFrom };
  } catch (error) {
    const periodRefused =
      window.strategy === "default" &&
      error instanceof EnableBankingError &&
      error.code === "WRONG_TRANSACTIONS_PERIOD";
    if (!periodRefused) throw error;
    deps.logger.info(
      { accountId: run.account.id },
      "The bank refused the incremental period; fetching the longest available history",
    );
    const longest: TransactionWindow = { strategy: "longest", dateFrom: null };
    const pages = await fetchTransactionPages(deps, run, uid, longest);
    return { balances, ...pages, windowStart: null };
  }
}

/** A provider value Bursar cannot turn into a number or a currency: skip that item only. */
function isProviderDataError(error: unknown): boolean {
  return error instanceof MoneyParseError || error instanceof RangeError;
}

interface StoredCounts {
  inserted: number;
  updated: number;
  removed: number;
  /** Provider items left out: dropped by the client plus those normalisation could not read. */
  skipped: number;
}

/**
 * Writes balances and transactions, or returns null when the account was removed or purged while
 * the bank answered (nothing is written then). One unreadable item (a malformed amount, an
 * unknown currency) is skipped and counted; it never fails the run, because the same item comes
 * back every day and would otherwise stop the account from syncing for good.
 *
 * `existing` is every stored row of the account (Task 12's precondition): the bank may ignore
 * `date_from` (the Mock ASPSP does, eb-api-notes §7) or filter on another date, and a stored
 * entry it returns from before the window must be matched, not inserted a second time.
 */
function storeAccountData(
  deps: SyncDeps,
  run: ActiveRun,
  data: FetchedData,
  today: LocalDate,
): StoredCounts | null {
  const accountId = run.account.id;
  if (!isLiveAccount(deps, accountId)) return null;
  let skipped = data.skipped;
  const fetchedAt = deps.now();
  for (const balance of data.balances) {
    try {
      const normalized = normalizeBalance(balance, fetchedAt, deps.timezone);
      deps.repo.upsertBalance({ accountId, ...normalized, fetchedAt });
    } catch (error) {
      if (!isProviderDataError(error)) throw error;
      skipped += 1;
    }
  }
  const normalized: NormalizedTransaction[] = [];
  for (const tx of data.transactions) {
    try {
      normalized.push(normalizeTransaction(tx, today));
    } catch (error) {
      if (!isProviderDataError(error)) throw error;
      skipped += 1;
    }
  }
  const plan = planReconciliation({
    existing: deps.repo.transactionsSince(accountId, null),
    fetched: assignFingerprints(accountId, normalized),
    windowStart: data.windowStart,
  });
  return { ...applyReconciliation(deps.repo, accountId, plan, deps.now()), skipped };
}

function nextAttemptAt(now: number, attempt: { number: number; max: number }): number | null {
  return attempt.number < attempt.max ? now + backoffMs(attempt.number) : null;
}

function reauthStatus(code: string): "expired" | "revoked" | "error" {
  if (code === "EXPIRED_SESSION") return "expired";
  if (code === "REVOKED_SESSION") return "revoked";
  return "error";
}

/** Finishes the run for a thrown error; returns the outcome or rethrows for the queue. */
function failRun(
  deps: SyncDeps,
  run: ActiveRun,
  error: unknown,
  attempt: { number: number; max: number },
): SyncOutcome {
  const now = deps.now();
  if (!isLiveAccount(deps, run.account.id)) {
    // Removed or purged while the bank answered: record the run, no side effect, no retry.
    return finishRun(deps, run, emptyOutcome("skipped", { skipReason: "account_inactive" }));
  }
  if (error instanceof MoneyParseError) {
    finishRun(deps, run, emptyOutcome("failed", { errorCode: INVALID_PROVIDER_DATA }), {
      errorMessage: "The bank sent an amount Bursar cannot read",
    });
    // Deterministic: the same data comes back on a retry, so retrying only spends the cap.
    throw new PermanentJobError(INVALID_PROVIDER_DATA);
  }
  if (error instanceof SyncAbortError) {
    finishRun(deps, run, emptyOutcome("failed", { errorCode: error.code }), {
      errorMessage: "The bank kept returning more transaction pages",
    });
    throw new PermanentJobError(error.code);
  }
  if (!(error instanceof EnableBankingError)) {
    deps.logger.error(
      { accountId: run.account.id, errorName: error instanceof Error ? error.name : "unknown" },
      "Account sync failed unexpectedly",
    );
    finishRun(
      deps,
      run,
      emptyOutcome("failed", { errorCode: INTERNAL_ERROR, retryAt: nextAttemptAt(now, attempt) }),
      { errorMessage: "Unexpected error while syncing" },
    );
    throw error;
  }
  const code = error.code ?? `HTTP_${error.status}`;
  const errorMessage = error.message.slice(0, MAX_ERROR_MESSAGE_LENGTH);
  switch (error.kind) {
    case "reauth":
      markConnectionEnded(statusDeps(deps), run.account.connectionId, reauthStatus(code), {
        code,
        message: errorMessage,
      });
      return finishRun(deps, run, emptyOutcome("failed", { errorCode: code }), { errorMessage });
    case "account":
      return finishRun(deps, run, emptyOutcome("failed", { errorCode: code }), {
        errorMessage,
        accountPatch: { status: "unavailable" },
      });
    case "rate_limited": {
      const retryAt = now + RATE_LIMIT_PAUSE_MS;
      return finishRun(
        deps,
        run,
        emptyOutcome("skipped", { errorCode: code, skipReason: "rate_limited", retryAt }),
        { errorMessage, accountPatch: { rateLimitedUntil: retryAt } },
      );
    }
    case "retry":
      finishRun(
        deps,
        run,
        emptyOutcome("failed", { errorCode: code, retryAt: nextAttemptAt(now, attempt) }),
        { errorMessage },
      );
      throw error;
    default:
      // "fatal": a request Bursar should not have made; retrying cannot help.
      finishRun(deps, run, emptyOutcome("failed", { errorCode: code }), { errorMessage });
      throw new PermanentJobError(code);
  }
}

/**
 * One sync of one account: preflight skips, background cap, balances, paged transactions,
 * reconciliation. Resolves with the outcome; rejects (after recording the run) with the bank
 * error for retryable failures and with `PermanentJobError` for fatal ones.
 */
export async function runAccountSync(
  deps: SyncDeps,
  payload: SyncAccountPayload,
  attempt: { number: number; max: number },
): Promise<SyncOutcome> {
  const account = deps.repo.getAccount(payload.accountId);
  if (!account) {
    deps.logger.warn({ accountId: payload.accountId }, "Account sync skipped: unknown account");
    return emptyOutcome("skipped", { skipReason: "account_inactive" });
  }
  const now = deps.now();
  const check = preflight(deps, account, deps.repo.getConnection(account.connectionId), now);
  if (check.kind === "skip") {
    return recordSkip(deps, account, payload.trigger, check.reason, check.retryAt);
  }

  const today = toLocalDate(now, deps.timezone);
  const cap = deps.settings.get().backgroundSyncCap;
  const psu = forwardedPsu(payload);
  // The initial sync is charged once per job, not per attempt: full history is often available
  // only for about an hour after the consent (spec §3), so its retries must not hit the cap.
  const charge = !(payload.trigger === "initial" && attempt.number > 1);
  if (!psu && charge && !deps.repo.tryConsumeBackgroundFetch(account.id, today, cap)) {
    return recordSkip(deps, account, payload.trigger, "daily_cap", null);
  }

  const run: ActiveRun = {
    id: deps.repo.startSyncRun(
      newRun(account.id, payload.trigger, now, {
        status: "running",
        withPsuHeaders: psu !== undefined,
      }),
    ),
    account,
    trigger: payload.trigger,
    psu,
  };
  deps.bus.publish({
    type: "sync.started",
    accountId: account.id,
    connectionId: account.connectionId,
    trigger: payload.trigger,
  });

  try {
    let data: FetchedData;
    try {
      data = await fetchAccountData(deps, run, check.uid, today);
    } catch (error) {
      if (run.psu === undefined || !isPsuHeaderError(error)) throw error;
      deps.logger.warn(
        { accountId: account.id, errorCode: error.code },
        "The bank refused the PSU headers; retrying as a background fetch",
      );
      run.psu = undefined;
      if (!deps.repo.tryConsumeBackgroundFetch(account.id, today, cap)) {
        return finishRun(deps, run, emptyOutcome("skipped", { skipReason: "daily_cap" }));
      }
      data = await fetchAccountData(deps, run, check.uid, today);
    }
    const stored = storeAccountData(deps, run, data, today);
    if (stored === null) {
      return finishRun(deps, run, emptyOutcome("skipped", { skipReason: "account_inactive" }));
    }
    const { skipped, ...counts } = stored;
    return finishRun(
      deps,
      run,
      emptyOutcome("succeeded", { fetched: data.transactions.length, ...counts }),
      skipped > 0 ? { errorMessage: `${skipped} provider entries skipped` } : {},
    );
  } catch (error) {
    return failRun(deps, run, error, attempt);
  }
}

export function syncAccountHandler(deps: SyncDeps): JobHandler {
  return async (job) => {
    const payload = parsePayload(syncAccountPayloadSchema, job);
    await runAccountSync(deps, payload, { number: job.attempts, max: job.maxAttempts });
  };
}

/** Registered instead of `syncAccountHandler` when Enable Banking is not configured. */
export function unconfiguredSyncHandler(): JobHandler {
  return async () => {
    throw new PermanentJobError("banking_not_configured");
  };
}

export function enqueueAccountSync(
  queue: JobQueue,
  accountId: number,
  trigger: SyncTrigger,
  psu?: PsuHeaders,
): { id: number; created: boolean } {
  const payload: SyncAccountPayload = psu ? { accountId, trigger, psu } : { accountId, trigger };
  return queue.enqueueUnique(SYNC_ACCOUNT_JOB, syncDedupeKey(accountId), payload, {
    maxAttempts: SYNC_MAX_ATTEMPTS,
  });
}
```

Notes for the implementer:
- `NewSyncRun` is assumed to be `Omit<SyncRunRow, "id">` and `upsertBalance` to take `Omit<BalanceRow, "id">` (Task 6 names both input types without spelling them out). If Task 6 defined narrower input types, keep `newRun`'s signature and drop only the fields the repository does not accept (the repository's column defaults cover them), and record the difference in the commit body.
- `EnableBankingError.code` is the Enable Banking `error` field of the body (`parseEbErrorBody`), `null` when the body had none.
- The PSU fallback restarts `fetchAccountData` from the balances; nothing was written by the failed attempt, because every write happens in `storeAccountData` after the network calls.
- `MoneyParseError` (Task 1) is the error `parseDecimalToMinor` throws; `normalizeTransaction`/`normalizeBalance` also throw `RangeError` for an invalid currency code. Both are per-item provider-data errors in `storeAccountData`. The `INVALID_PROVIDER_DATA` branch of `failRun` is a backstop for a `MoneyParseError` raised anywhere else; its panel text is in Task 17's `syncErrors`.
- A succeeded run with skipped items keeps `status: "succeeded"` and records `errorMessage: "<n> provider entries skipped"`; the stored numbers never include a value Bursar could not read.

`apps/server/src/finance/sync-task.ts`:

```ts
import { effectiveConnectionStatus, localTimeOfDay, toLocalDate } from "@bursar/shared";
import type { Logger } from "pino";
import type { JobQueue } from "../jobs/queue";
import type { ScheduledTask } from "../scheduler";
import type { SettingsStore } from "../settings/store";
import type { FinanceRepository } from "./repository";
import { enqueueAccountSync } from "./sync";

/**
 * Once per local day, at or after `settings.dailySyncTime`, queues a background sync for each
 * active account of a usable connection. The scheduler ticks every minute; the account's
 * `last_scheduled_sync_day` makes the task idempotent within a day. The background cap is
 * enforced by the job, not here.
 */
export function dailySyncTask(deps: {
  repo: FinanceRepository;
  queue: JobQueue;
  settings: SettingsStore;
  timezone: string;
  logger: Logger;
}): ScheduledTask {
  return {
    name: "bank-daily-sync",
    run(now: Date) {
      const at = now.getTime();
      // "HH:MM" strings compare chronologically.
      if (localTimeOfDay(at, deps.timezone) < deps.settings.get().dailySyncTime) return;
      const today = toLocalDate(at, deps.timezone);
      let queued = 0;
      for (const connection of deps.repo.listConnections()) {
        if (connection.removedAt !== null) continue;
        const status = effectiveConnectionStatus(
          connection.status,
          connection.validUntil,
          at,
          deps.timezone,
        );
        if (status !== "active" && status !== "expiring") continue;
        for (const account of deps.repo.listAccounts({
          connectionId: connection.id,
          statuses: ["active"],
        })) {
          if (account.lastScheduledSyncDay === today) continue;
          if (account.providerAccountUid === null) continue;
          // Not marked for the day: picked up on the first tick after the pause ends.
          if (account.rateLimitedUntil !== null && account.rateLimitedUntil > at) continue;
          enqueueAccountSync(deps.queue, account.id, "background");
          deps.repo.updateAccount(account.id, { lastScheduledSyncDay: today, updatedAt: at });
          queued += 1;
        }
      }
      if (queued > 0) deps.logger.info({ queued, day: today }, "Daily bank sync queued");
    },
  };
}
```

`apps/server/src/finance/sync-routes.ts`:

```ts
import {
  effectiveConnectionStatus,
  type SyncConflictCode,
  type SyncQueuedResponse,
} from "@bursar/shared";
import { type Context, Hono } from "hono";
import type { PsuHeaders } from "../eb/client";
import type { AppEnv } from "../http/app";
import { isPublicIp } from "../http/client-ip";
import type { JobQueue } from "../jobs/queue";
import { syncDedupeKey } from "../jobs/types";
import type { AccountRow, ConnectionRow, FinanceRepository } from "./repository";
import { enqueueAccountSync } from "./sync";

export interface SyncRoutesDeps {
  repo: FinanceRepository;
  queue: JobQueue;
  clientIp: (c: Context) => string;
  timezone: string;
  now?: () => number;
}

interface Conflict {
  error: string;
  code: SyncConflictCode;
  retryAt?: number;
}

const NOT_FOUND = { error: "Not found", code: "not_found" } as const;
const ACCOUNT_INACTIVE: Conflict = {
  error: "This account cannot be synced",
  code: "account_inactive",
};
const CONNECTION_INACTIVE: Conflict = {
  error: "This bank connection needs a new consent before it can sync",
  code: "connection_inactive",
};
const IN_PROGRESS: Conflict = {
  error: "A sync is already running for this account",
  code: "sync_in_progress",
};
const NOTHING_TO_SYNC: Conflict = {
  error: "No account of this connection can be synced now",
  code: "nothing_to_sync",
};
const ID_PATTERN = /^[1-9]\d{0,15}$/;
const MAX_HEADER_LENGTH = 512;

function parseId(value: string): number | null {
  if (!ID_PATTERN.test(value)) return null;
  const id = Number(value);
  return Number.isSafeInteger(id) ? id : null;
}

function connectionConflict(
  connection: ConnectionRow,
  now: number,
  timezone: string,
): Conflict | null {
  if (connection.removedAt !== null) return CONNECTION_INACTIVE;
  const status = effectiveConnectionStatus(connection.status, connection.validUntil, now, timezone);
  return status === "active" || status === "expiring" ? null : CONNECTION_INACTIVE;
}

function accountConflict(account: AccountRow): Conflict | null {
  return account.status === "active" && account.providerAccountUid !== null
    ? null
    : ACCOUNT_INACTIVE;
}

function availabilityConflict(account: AccountRow, now: number, queue: JobQueue): Conflict | null {
  if (account.rateLimitedUntil !== null && account.rateLimitedUntil > now) {
    return {
      error: "The bank asked to pause syncing this account",
      code: "rate_limited",
      retryAt: account.rateLimitedUntil,
    };
  }
  return queue.findActive(syncDedupeKey(account.id)) ? IN_PROGRESS : null;
}

function clip(value: string | undefined): string | undefined {
  const trimmed = value?.trim();
  return trimmed ? trimmed.slice(0, MAX_HEADER_LENGTH) : undefined;
}

/** The user is present: forward who they are, but only with a public address and a browser. */
function psuHeaders(
  c: Context<AppEnv>,
  clientIp: (c: Context) => string,
): PsuHeaders | undefined {
  const ipAddress = clientIp(c);
  const userAgent = clip(c.req.header("user-agent"));
  if (!userAgent || !isPublicIp(ipAddress)) return undefined;
  const headers: PsuHeaders = { ipAddress, userAgent };
  const accept = clip(c.req.header("accept"));
  const acceptLanguage = clip(c.req.header("accept-language"));
  if (accept) headers.accept = accept;
  if (acceptLanguage) headers.acceptLanguage = acceptLanguage;
  return headers;
}

/** The 409 to answer when a connection had accounts but none could be queued. */
function connectionRefusal(conflicts: readonly Conflict[]): Conflict {
  if (conflicts.some((conflict) => conflict.code === "sync_in_progress")) return IN_PROGRESS;
  let earliest: Conflict | null = null;
  for (const conflict of conflicts) {
    if (conflict.code !== "rate_limited" || conflict.retryAt === undefined) continue;
    if (earliest === null || conflict.retryAt < (earliest.retryAt ?? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY)) {
      earliest = conflict;
    }
  }
  return earliest ?? NOTHING_TO_SYNC;
}

export function syncRoutes(deps: SyncRoutesDeps): Hono<AppEnv> {
  const now = deps.now ?? Date.now;
  const routes = new Hono<AppEnv>();

  routes.post("/accounts/:accountId/sync", (c) => {
    const id = parseId(c.req.param("accountId"));
    const account = id === null ? null : deps.repo.getAccount(id);
    const connection = account ? deps.repo.getConnection(account.connectionId) : null;
    if (!account || !connection) return c.json(NOT_FOUND, 404);
    const at = now();
    const conflict =
      accountConflict(account) ??
      connectionConflict(connection, at, deps.timezone) ??
      availabilityConflict(account, at, deps.queue);
    if (conflict) return c.json(conflict, 409);
    enqueueAccountSync(deps.queue, account.id, "manual", psuHeaders(c, deps.clientIp));
    return c.json({ queued: 1 } satisfies SyncQueuedResponse, 202);
  });

  routes.post("/connections/:connectionId/sync", (c) => {
    const id = parseId(c.req.param("connectionId"));
    const connection = id === null ? null : deps.repo.getConnection(id);
    if (!connection) return c.json(NOT_FOUND, 404);
    const at = now();
    const inactive = connectionConflict(connection, at, deps.timezone);
    if (inactive) return c.json(inactive, 409);
    const psu = psuHeaders(c, deps.clientIp);
    const conflicts: Conflict[] = [];
    let queued = 0;
    for (const account of deps.repo.listAccounts({
      connectionId: connection.id,
      statuses: ["active"],
    })) {
      const conflict = accountConflict(account) ?? availabilityConflict(account, at, deps.queue);
      if (conflict) {
        conflicts.push(conflict);
        continue;
      }
      enqueueAccountSync(deps.queue, account.id, "manual", psu);
      queued += 1;
    }
    if (queued === 0) return c.json(connectionRefusal(conflicts), 409);
    return c.json({ queued } satisfies SyncQueuedResponse, 202);
  });

  return routes;
}
```

  - `finance/lifecycle.ts`: `class ConnectionLifecycle { constructor(deps: { repo: FinanceRepository; api: EnableBankingApi | null; queue: JobQueue; bus: EventBus; audit: AuditLog; now?: () => number }); removalPreview(connectionId: number): RemovalPreview | null; disconnect(connectionId: number): Promise<DisconnectResponse | null>; purgeAccount(accountId: number): PurgeResponse | "not_removed" | null }`; `deleteSessionJobHandler(deps: { api: EnableBankingApi | null }): JobHandler` (treats `CLOSED_SESSION`, `EXPIRED_SESSION`, `SESSION_DOES_NOT_EXIST`, `REVOKED_SESSION` as done; retries `retry` kinds; permanent otherwise).
  - `finance/consent-task.ts`: `consentTask(deps: { repo: FinanceRepository; api: EnableBankingApi | null; notifications: NotificationService; bus: EventBus; timezone: string; now: () => number; logger: Logger }): ScheduledTask` (name `consent-lifecycle`).
  - `finance/health-task.ts`: `syncHealthTask(deps: { repo: FinanceRepository; notifications: NotificationService; settings: SettingsStore; timezone: string; now: () => number }): ScheduledTask` (name `sync-health`; `settings` is an additive field, like Task 13's, so the account name in the notification follows the panel language).
  - `finance/lifecycle-routes.ts`: `lifecycleRoutes(deps: { lifecycle: ConnectionLifecycle }): Hono<AppEnv>` mounted at `/api`: `GET /connections/:connectionId/removal-preview` → `RemovalPreview` (404); `DELETE /connections/:connectionId` → `DisconnectResponse` (404; 409 `already_removed`); `POST /accounts/:accountId/purge` (body `{ confirm: true }`) → `PurgeResponse` (404; 409 `account_not_removed`; 400 without the confirmation).
  - `server.ts`: registers `DELETE_SESSION_JOB`, adds both tasks to the scheduler, mounts the router.

**Additions beyond the contract** (new names only; nothing above is renamed or changed):
- `@bursar/shared` `lifecycle.ts`: the types above are inferred from `removalPreviewSchema`, `disconnectResponseSchema`, `purgeResponseSchema`; `type PurgeRequest`.
- `FinanceRepository.deleteConnection(id: number): boolean` (Task 6's class has no way to delete a connection row, which `purgeAccount` needs; `bank_auth_requests` rows cascade, a connection still referenced by accounts makes it throw).
- `finance/lifecycle.ts`: `class AlreadyRemovedError extends Error` (thrown by `disconnect` for a connection whose `removed_at` is set; the contract's return type `DisconnectResponse | null` has no value for the 409 case); `SESSION_ENDED_CODES`; `isSessionEnded(error: unknown): boolean`; `DELETE_SESSION_RETRY_DELAY_MS = 5 * 60_000`; `DELETE_SESSION_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 6`; `deleteSessionDedupeKey(providerSessionId: string): string` (`delete-session:<first 32 hex chars of sha256(id)>`, so the raw session id never appears in an index or a log); `enqueueSessionDeletion(queue: JobQueue, providerSessionId: string, now: number): { id: number; created: boolean }`; `interface ConnectionLifecycleDeps`.
- `finance/consent-task.ts`: `SESSION_STATUS_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS = 24 h`; `SESSION_STATUS_OUTCOMES` (session status → ended connection status); `endedStatusForReauthCode(code: string | null)`; `interface ConsentTaskDeps`.
- `finance/health-task.ts`: `SYNC_FAILING_AFTER_MS = 48 h`; `interface SyncHealthTaskDeps`.
- Test support (not shipped): `apps/server/src/test/lifecycle.ts` with `createLifecycleFixture()` (builds on Task 9's `createNotificationFixture()`), raw-SQL insert helpers that depend only on the SQL column names fixed by Task 6, row readers and `stubBankingApi()`.

**Behaviour decided here** (the contract leaves it open):
- Order inside one `consentTask` evaluation of an `active`, non-removed connection: (1) `validUntil <= now` → `markConnectionEnded(expired)` and stop; (2) when `api` exists and the last check is 24 h old or more (`status_checked_at` null counts as due), set `status_checked_at = now` **before** calling `getSession`, so a failing check is retried the next day and not on every tick; a mapped ended status → `markConnectionEnded(…, { code: "SESSION_<STATUS>", message: null })` and stop; (3) otherwise raise the most urgent expiry notice. A connection that the bank reports as revoked therefore never gets a "consent expiring" notice in the same evaluation.
- `PENDING_AUTHORIZATION` and `RETURNED_FROM_BANK` change nothing (like `AUTHORIZED`).
- `getSession` errors of kind `reauth` are not "retried next day": they mean the session is gone, so they map like the sync job (Task 13) maps them: `EXPIRED_SESSION` → `expired`, `REVOKED_SESSION` → `revoked`, the other reauth codes → `error`, with `last_error_code` = the EB code. Every other error (including a non-`EnableBankingError`) is logged as `{ connectionId, status, code }` (no session id, no message) and retried after 24 h.
- `consentTask` reads the clock from `deps.now()` (the scheduler's `Date` argument is ignored) so tests and production share one clock source.
- `removalPreview` counts accounts that are not `removed` and their transactions; a removed connection yields `accounts: 0`. Only an unknown connection returns `null`.
- `disconnect` calls `deleteSession` for any stored status (an already ended session answers with an "already ended" code, treated as done). Any other failure, including a network error, enqueues the retry job with `runAfter = now + 5 min` and `maxAttempts: 6` (backoff 30 s, 2 min, 8 min, 32 min, 1 h). With `api = null` nothing is called and nothing is queued. The local removal runs in one `repo.transaction` that re-reads the connection (a second, concurrent disconnect that waited on the bank gets `AlreadyRemovedError`). `disabled` and `unavailable` accounts become `removed` too. Audit details: `{ accounts: <n>, remoteSession: "closed" | "already_ended" | "queued" | "local_only" }`, target `connection:<id>`.
- The `connection.updated` event after a disconnect carries the **stored** status (`active|expired|revoked|error`, all valid `ConnectionStatus` values): `ConnectionLifecycle` has no time zone in its contract, so it cannot compute `expiring`. The panel refetches on this event anyway.
- `purgeAccount` does not wrap its steps in `repo.transaction` (Task 6's `repo.purgeAccount` is free to open its own transaction, and nested Drizzle transactions are avoided as in Task 9). The sequence is synchronous, so nothing can interleave in the single process; a crash between the purge and the connection deletion leaves an empty removed connection that the next purge attempt or a later cleanup can delete. It also cancels a queued sync for the account. Audit details: `{ transactions, balances, syncRuns, connectionDeleted }`, target `account:<id>`.
- `deleteSessionJobHandler` also retries `rate_limited` errors (closing a session later is always better than never); a non-`EnableBankingError` is permanent with a fixed message (the real client turns network failures into status-0 `EnableBankingError`s, so anything else is a bug).
- `syncHealthTask` names the account with `accountDisplayName(account, settings.get().locale)`: an account without nickname or product gets the fallback label ("Current account ••1234" / "Conto corrente ••1234") in the language the panel uses when the task runs. "Older than 48 h" means `now − (lastSyncedAt ?? createdAt) >= 48 h`. It reads the latest run with `repo.listSyncRuns(accountId, 1)[0]`, which must be the newest run (Step 1 checks this).
- Route errors: 404 `{ "error": "Not found", "code": "not_found" }` (also for a malformed id, never echoing it); 409 `{ "error": "The connection is already removed", "code": "already_removed" }`; 409 `{ "error": "Only a removed account can be purged", "code": "account_not_removed" }`; 400 `{ "error": "Purging needs an explicit confirmation", "code": "confirmation_required" }`. The purge body is validated before the account is looked up.
- No UI in this task: the Playwright QA step of the UI definition of done does not apply. The QA server smoke test in Step 12 checks the wiring.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement the shared DTOs**

`packages/shared/src/lifecycle.ts`:

```ts
import { z } from "zod";

const count = z.number().int().nonnegative();

/** What a disconnect affects, shown with real counts in the level-3 confirmation (UX doc §7). */
export const removalPreviewSchema = z.object({
  bankName: z.string(),
  /** Accounts of the connection that are not removed yet. */
  accounts: count,
  /** Transactions of those accounts; they are kept after the disconnect until purged. */
  transactions: count,
});
export type RemovalPreview = z.infer<typeof removalPreviewSchema>;

export const disconnectResponseSchema = z.object({ removedAccounts: count });
export type DisconnectResponse = z.infer<typeof disconnectResponseSchema>;

/** Purging is permanent, so the body must say so explicitly (spec §6.3). */
export const purgeRequestSchema = z.object({ confirm: z.literal(true) });
export type PurgeRequest = z.infer<typeof purgeRequestSchema>;

export const purgeResponseSchema = z.object({ transactions: count, balances: count });
export type PurgeResponse = z.infer<typeof purgeResponseSchema>;
```

All names, ids and hashes are fictional.

```ts
import type { AccountStatus, StoredConnectionStatus, SyncRunStatus } from "@bursar/shared";
import { AuditLog } from "../audit";
import type { EnableBankingApi } from "../eb/client";
import sessionStatusFixture from "../eb/fixtures/session-status.json";
import type { EbSessionStatus } from "../eb/schemas";
import { FinanceRepository } from "../finance/repository";
import { createNotificationFixture, type NotificationFixture } from "./notifications";

/** 2026-11-09 10:00 in Europe/Rome (UTC+1 in November, no DST change in the following weeks). */
export const NOW = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 9, 9, 0);
export const HOUR_MS = 3_600_000;
export const DAY_MS = 24 * HOUR_MS;
export const TIMEZONE = "Europe/Rome";
/** A fictional Enable Banking session id (uuid4 shape). */
export const SESSION_ID = "1c7a9d42-5b8e-4f0a-9d3c-2e6f8a1b4c70";
export const BANK_NAME = "Banca Esempio";

export interface LifecycleFixture extends NotificationFixture {
  repo: FinanceRepository;
  audit: AuditLog;
}

/** Task 9's notification fixture (real DB, queue, bus, settings, service) plus repository and audit log. */
export function createLifecycleFixture(): LifecycleFixture {
  const fx = createNotificationFixture();
  fx.clock.now = NOW;
  const now = () => fx.clock.now;
  return Object.assign(fx, {
    repo: new FinanceRepository(fx.t.db, now),
    audit: new AuditLog(fx.t.db, now),
  });
}

function unexpected(method: keyof EnableBankingApi): () => Promise<never> {
  return () => Promise.reject(new Error(`Unexpected Enable Banking call: ${method}`));
}

/** An `EnableBankingApi` whose methods reject unless overridden. */
export function stubBankingApi(overrides: Partial<EnableBankingApi> = {}): EnableBankingApi {
  return {
    getApplication: unexpected("getApplication"),
    listAspsps: unexpected("listAspsps"),
    startAuthorization: unexpected("startAuthorization"),
    createSession: unexpected("createSession"),
    getSession: unexpected("getSession"),
    deleteSession: unexpected("deleteSession"),
    getBalances: unexpected("getBalances"),
    getTransactions: unexpected("getTransactions"),
    ...overrides,
  };
}

/** The documented `GET /sessions/{id}` fixture (eb-api-notes.md §6) with another status. */
export function sessionStatus(status: EbSessionStatus["status"]): EbSessionStatus {
  return { ...(sessionStatusFixture as unknown as EbSessionStatus), status };
}

let sequence = 0;

export function insertConnection(
  fx: LifecycleFixture,
  input: {
    validUntil: number;
    status?: StoredConnectionStatus;
    aspspName?: string;
    providerSessionId?: string;
    statusCheckedAt?: number | null;
    removedAt?: number | null;
  },
): number {
  const at = fx.clock.now;
  const result = fx.t.sqlite
    .prepare(
      `INSERT INTO bank_connections (aspsp_name, aspsp_country, aspsp_logo_url, psu_type,
         provider_session_id, status, valid_until, status_checked_at, created_at, updated_at, removed_at)
       VALUES (?, 'IT', NULL, 'personal', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
    )
    .run(
      input.aspspName ?? BANK_NAME,
      input.providerSessionId ?? SESSION_ID,
      input.status ?? "active",
      input.validUntil,
      input.statusCheckedAt ?? null,
      at,
      at,
      input.removedAt ?? null,
    );
  return Number(result.lastInsertRowid);
}

export interface AccountInput {
  status?: AccountStatus;
  nickname?: string | null;
  product?: string | null;
  cashAccountType?: string | null;
  last4?: string | null;
  lastSyncedAt?: number | null;
  createdAt?: number;
  removedAt?: number | null;
}

export function insertAccount(
  fx: LifecycleFixture,
  connectionId: number,
  input: AccountInput = {},
): number {
  sequence += 1;
  const createdAt = input.createdAt ?? fx.clock.now;
  const last4 = input.last4 === undefined ? String(1000 + sequence) : input.last4;
  const result = fx.t.sqlite
    .prepare(
      `INSERT INTO accounts (connection_id, provider_account_uid, identification_hash, iban,
         masked_identifier, last4, product, details, nickname, currency, cash_account_type, status,
         last_synced_at, created_at, updated_at, removed_at)
       VALUES (?, NULL, ?, NULL, ?, ?, ?, NULL, ?, 'EUR', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
    )
    .run(
      connectionId,
      `fixture-account-${sequence}`,
      last4 === null ? null : `•••• ${last4}`,
      last4,
      input.product === undefined ? "Conto corrente" : input.product,
      input.nickname ?? null,
      input.cashAccountType === undefined ? "CACC" : input.cashAccountType,
      input.status ?? "active",
      input.lastSyncedAt ?? null,
      createdAt,
      createdAt,
      input.removedAt ?? null,
    );
  return Number(result.lastInsertRowid);
}

export function insertTransactions(fx: LifecycleFixture, accountId: number, count: number): void {
  const at = fx.clock.now;
  const statement = fx.t.sqlite.prepare(
    `INSERT INTO transactions (account_id, provider_reference, fingerprint, status, booking_date,
       value_date, sort_date, amount_minor, currency, counterparty, search_text, raw_json,
       missing_count, first_seen_at, last_seen_at)
     VALUES (?, NULL, ?, 'booked', '2026-11-02', '2026-11-02', '2026-11-02', -1250, 'EUR',
       'Generic Grocery', 'generic grocery', '{}', 0, ?, ?)`,
  );
  for (let index = 0; index < count; index++) {
    statement.run(accountId, `fixture-${accountId}-${index}`, at, at);
  }
}

export function insertBalance(fx: LifecycleFixture, accountId: number): void {
  fx.t.sqlite
    .prepare(
      `INSERT INTO balances (account_id, balance_type, amount_minor, currency, reference_date, as_of, fetched_at)
       VALUES (?, 'CLBD', 152000, 'EUR', '2026-11-08', ?, ?)`,
    )
    .run(accountId, fx.clock.now, fx.clock.now);
}

export function insertSyncRun(
  fx: LifecycleFixture,
  accountId: number,
  status: SyncRunStatus,
  startedAt: number,
  errorCode: string | null = null,
): number {
  const result = fx.t.sqlite
    .prepare(
      `INSERT INTO sync_runs (account_id, "trigger", status, with_psu_headers, started_at, finished_at, error_code)
       VALUES (?, 'background', ?, 0, ?, ?, ?)`,
    )
    .run(accountId, status, startedAt, status === "running" ? null : startedAt + 1_000, errorCode);
  return Number(result.lastInsertRowid);
}

export interface NotificationRow {
  event: string;
  dedupeKey: string;
  params: Record<string, string | number>;
  link: string | null;
}

export function notificationRows(fx: LifecycleFixture): NotificationRow[] {
  const rows = fx.t.sqlite
    .prepare("SELECT event, dedupe_key AS dedupeKey, params, link FROM notifications ORDER BY id")
    .all() as { event: string; dedupeKey: string; params: string; link: string | null }[];
  return rows.map((row) => ({ ...row, params: JSON.parse(row.params) }));
}

export interface AuditRow {
  actor: string;
  action: string;
  target: string | null;
  details: Record<string, unknown> | null;
}

export function auditRows(fx: LifecycleFixture): AuditRow[] {
  const rows = fx.t.sqlite
    .prepare("SELECT actor, action, target, details FROM audit_log ORDER BY id")
    .all() as { actor: string; action: string; target: string | null; details: string | null }[];
  return rows.map((row) => ({
    ...row,
    details: row.details === null ? null : JSON.parse(row.details),
  }));
}

export interface JobRow {
  payload: unknown;
  status: string;
  runAfter: number;
  maxAttempts: number;
  dedupeKey: string | null;
}

export function jobRows(fx: LifecycleFixture, type: string): JobRow[] {
  const rows = fx.t.sqlite
    .prepare(
      `SELECT payload, status, run_after AS runAfter, max_attempts AS maxAttempts, dedupe_key AS dedupeKey
       FROM jobs WHERE type = ? ORDER BY id`,
    )
    .all(type) as (Omit<JobRow, "payload"> & { payload: string })[];
  return rows.map((row) => ({ ...row, payload: JSON.parse(row.payload) }));
}
```

```ts
    await lifecycle(closingBank().api).disconnect(connectionId);

    expect(fx.queue.findActive(syncDedupeKey(first))).toMatchObject({ status: "running" });
    expect(fx.queue.findActive(syncDedupeKey(second))).toBeNull();
  });

  it("queues a retry when the bank cannot close the session", async () => {
    const { connectionId } = seedBank();
    const api = stubBankingApi({ deleteSession: () => Promise.reject(aspspError()) });

    expect(await lifecycle(api).disconnect(connectionId)).toEqual({ removedAccounts: 2 });

    const jobs = jobRows(fx, DELETE_SESSION_JOB);
    expect(jobs).toEqual([
      {
        payload: { providerSessionId: SESSION_ID },
        status: "queued",
        runAfter: NOW + DELETE_SESSION_RETRY_DELAY_MS,
        maxAttempts: DELETE_SESSION_MAX_ATTEMPTS,
        dedupeKey: deleteSessionDedupeKey(SESSION_ID),
      },
    ]);
    expect(jobs[0]?.dedupeKey).not.toContain(SESSION_ID);
    expect(auditRows(fx)[0]?.details).toEqual({ accounts: 2, remoteSession: "queued" });
    expect(fx.repo.getConnection(connectionId)?.removedAt).toBe(NOW);
  });

  it("queues a retry after a network failure", async () => {
    const { connectionId } = seedBank();
    const api = stubBankingApi({
      deleteSession: () => Promise.reject(new TypeError("fetch failed")),
    });
    await lifecycle(api).disconnect(connectionId);
    expect(jobRows(fx, DELETE_SESSION_JOB)).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it.each(ENDED_CODES)("treats %s as an already closed session", async (code) => {
    const { connectionId } = seedBank();
    const api = stubBankingApi({ deleteSession: () => Promise.reject(endedError(code)) });
    await lifecycle(api).disconnect(connectionId);
    expect(jobRows(fx, DELETE_SESSION_JOB)).toEqual([]);
    expect(auditRows(fx)[0]?.details).toEqual({ accounts: 2, remoteSession: "already_ended" });
  });

  it("removes locally when banking is not configured", async () => {
    const { connectionId, first } = seedBank();
    expect(await lifecycle(null).disconnect(connectionId)).toEqual({ removedAccounts: 2 });
    expect(fx.repo.getAccount(first)?.status).toBe("removed");
    expect(jobRows(fx, DELETE_SESSION_JOB)).toEqual([]);
    expect(auditRows(fx)[0]?.details).toEqual({ accounts: 2, remoteSession: "local_only" });
  });

  it("refuses a second disconnect without calling the bank again", async () => {
    const { connectionId } = seedBank();
    const { api, deleteSession } = closingBank();
    await lifecycle(api).disconnect(connectionId);
    await expect(lifecycle(api).disconnect(connectionId)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(
      AlreadyRemovedError,
    );
    expect(deleteSession).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(auditRows(fx)).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it("returns null for an unknown connection", async () => {
    const { api, deleteSession } = closingBank();
    expect(await lifecycle(api).disconnect(999)).toBeNull();
    expect(deleteSession).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

describe("ConnectionLifecycle.purgeAccount", () => {
  it("refuses an account that is not removed", () => {
    const { first } = seedBank();
    expect(lifecycle(null).purgeAccount(first)).toBe("not_removed");
    expect(fx.repo.countTransactions(first).total).toBe(3);
    expect(auditRows(fx)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("purges removed accounts and deletes the connection after the last one", async () => {
    const { connectionId, first, second } = seedBank();
    await lifecycle(null).disconnect(connectionId);

    expect(lifecycle(null).purgeAccount(first)).toEqual({ transactions: 3, balances: 1 });
    expect(fx.repo.getAccount(first)).toBeNull();
    expect(fx.repo.getConnection(connectionId)).not.toBeNull();

    expect(lifecycle(null).purgeAccount(second)).toEqual({ transactions: 2, balances: 0 });
    expect(fx.repo.getConnection(connectionId)).toBeNull();

    expect(auditRows(fx).filter((row) => row.action === "account.purge")).toEqual([
      {
        actor: "user",
        action: "account.purge",
        target: `account:${first}`,
        details: { transactions: 3, balances: 1, syncRuns: 1, connectionDeleted: false },
      },
      {
        actor: "user",
        action: "account.purge",
        target: `account:${second}`,
        details: { transactions: 2, balances: 0, syncRuns: 0, connectionDeleted: true },
      },
    ]);
  });

  it("cancels a queued sync of the purged account", async () => {
    const { connectionId, first } = seedBank();
    await lifecycle(null).disconnect(connectionId);
    fx.queue.enqueueUnique(SYNC_ACCOUNT_JOB, syncDedupeKey(first), {
      accountId: first,
      trigger: "background",
    });
    lifecycle(null).purgeAccount(first);
    expect(fx.queue.findActive(syncDedupeKey(first))).toBeNull();
  });

  it("returns null for an unknown account", () => {
    expect(lifecycle(null).purgeAccount(999)).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe("deleteSessionJobHandler", () => {
  it("closes the session", async () => {
    const { api, deleteSession } = closingBank();
    await deleteSessionJobHandler({ api })(deleteJob({ providerSessionId: SESSION_ID }));
    expect(deleteSession).toHaveBeenCalledWith(SESSION_ID);
  });

  it.each(ENDED_CODES)("is done when the bank answers %s", async (code) => {
    const api = stubBankingApi({ deleteSession: () => Promise.reject(endedError(code)) });
    await expect(
      deleteSessionJobHandler({ api })(deleteJob({ providerSessionId: SESSION_ID })),
    ).resolves.toBeUndefined();
  });

  it.each([
    ["ASPSP_ERROR", aspspError],
    ["the bank rate limit", () => parseEbErrorBody(429, rateLimitError)],
    ["no HTTP answer", () => parseEbErrorBody(0, null)],
  ] as const)("lets the queue retry after %s", async (_label, makeError) => {
    const api = stubBankingApi({ deleteSession: () => Promise.reject(makeError()) });
    const error = await deleteSessionJobHandler({ api })(
      deleteJob({ providerSessionId: SESSION_ID }),
    ).catch((caught: unknown) => caught);
    expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(EnableBankingError);
    expect(error).not.toBeInstanceOf(PermanentJobError);
  });

  it("fails permanently on other Enable Banking errors", async () => {
    const api = stubBankingApi({
      deleteSession: () =>
        Promise.reject(
          parseEbErrorBody(400, {
            message: "Wrong request parameters",
            code: 400,
            error: "WRONG_REQUEST_PARAMETERS",
          }),
        ),
    });
    await expect(
      deleteSessionJobHandler({ api })(deleteJob({ providerSessionId: SESSION_ID })),
    ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(PermanentJobError);
  });

  it("fails permanently when banking is not configured", async () => {
    await expect(
      deleteSessionJobHandler({ api: null })(deleteJob({ providerSessionId: SESSION_ID })),
    ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(PermanentJobError);
  });

  it("fails permanently on an invalid payload", async () => {
    const { api, deleteSession } = closingBank();
    await expect(
      deleteSessionJobHandler({ api })(deleteJob({ providerSessionId: "" })),
    ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(PermanentJobError);
    expect(deleteSession).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("fails permanently on an unexpected error without echoing it", async () => {
    const api = stubBankingApi({
      deleteSession: () => Promise.reject(new TypeError(`boom ${SESSION_ID}`)),
    });
    const error = await deleteSessionJobHandler({ api })(
      deleteJob({ providerSessionId: SESSION_ID }),
    ).catch((caught: unknown) => caught);
    expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(PermanentJobError);
    expect((error as Error).message).not.toContain(SESSION_ID);
  });

  it("runs the queued retry through the worker", async () => {
    const { connectionId } = seedBank();
    await lifecycle(stubBankingApi({ deleteSession: () => Promise.reject(aspspError()) })).disconnect(
      connectionId,
    );
    const { api, deleteSession } = closingBank();
    const worker = new JobWorker(
      fx.queue,
      new Map<string, JobHandler>([[DELETE_SESSION_JOB, deleteSessionJobHandler({ api })]]),
      pino({ level: "silent" }),
    );

    expect(await worker.runOnce()).toBe(false);
    fx.clock.now += DELETE_SESSION_RETRY_DELAY_MS;
    expect(await worker.runOnce()).toBe(true);

    expect(deleteSession).toHaveBeenCalledWith(SESSION_ID);
    expect(jobRows(fx, DELETE_SESSION_JOB)[0]?.status).toBe("succeeded");
  });
});

describe("FinanceRepository.deleteConnection", () => {
  it("deletes the row and its pending auth requests", () => {
    const connectionId = insertConnection(fx, { validUntil: NOW + DAY_MS });
    fx.t.sqlite
      .prepare(
        `INSERT INTO bank_auth_requests (state_hash, purpose, connection_id, aspsp_name, aspsp_country,
           valid_until, created_at, expires_at)
         VALUES (?, 'renew', ?, ?, 'IT', ?, ?, ?)`,
      )
      .run("a".repeat(64), connectionId, BANK_NAME, NOW + DAY_MS, NOW, NOW + 30 * 60_000);

    expect(fx.repo.deleteConnection(connectionId)).toBe(true);
    expect(fx.repo.getConnection(connectionId)).toBeNull();
    expect(
      fx.t.sqlite.prepare("SELECT count(*) AS n FROM bank_auth_requests").get(),
    ).toEqual({ n: 0 });
    expect(fx.repo.deleteConnection(connectionId)).toBe(false);
  });

  it("refuses while accounts still reference the connection", () => {
    const { connectionId } = seedBank();
    expect(() => fx.repo.deleteConnection(connectionId)).toThrow();
    expect(fx.repo.getConnection(connectionId)).not.toBeNull();
  });
});
```

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { createTestApp, type TestApp } from "../test/app";
import {
  BANK_NAME,
  createLifecycleFixture,
  DAY_MS,
  insertAccount,
  insertBalance,
  insertConnection,
  insertTransactions,
  type LifecycleFixture,
  NOW,
  stubBankingApi,
} from "../test/lifecycle";
import { ConnectionLifecycle } from "./lifecycle";
import { lifecycleRoutes } from "./lifecycle-routes";

const NOT_FOUND = { error: "Not found", code: "not_found" };

let fx: LifecycleFixture;
let ta: TestApp;
let connectionId: number;
let first: number;

beforeEach(async () => {
  fx = createLifecycleFixture();
  connectionId = insertConnection(fx, { validUntil: NOW + 90 * DAY_MS });
  first = insertAccount(fx, connectionId, { nickname: "Conto spese" });
  const second = insertAccount(fx, connectionId);
  insertTransactions(fx, first, 3);
  insertTransactions(fx, second, 2);
  insertBalance(fx, first);
  const lifecycle = new ConnectionLifecycle({
    repo: fx.repo,
    api: stubBankingApi({ deleteSession: async () => {} }),
    queue: fx.queue,
    bus: fx.bus,
    audit: fx.audit,
    now: () => fx.clock.now,
  });
  ta = await createTestApp({
    database: fx.t,
    routers: [{ prefix: "/api", router: lifecycleRoutes({ lifecycle }) }],
    now: () => fx.clock.now,
  });
});
afterEach(() => fx.dispose());

describe("lifecycle routes", () => {
  it("previews a disconnect", async () => {
    expect(await ta.json(`/api/connections/${connectionId}/removal-preview`)).toMatchObject({
      status: 200,
      body: { bankName: BANK_NAME, accounts: 2, transactions: 5 },
    });
  });

  it("answers 404 for unknown or malformed connection ids without echoing them", async () => {
    for (const id of ["999", "abc", "0", "-1", "1.5"]) {
      const response = await ta.json(`/api/connections/${id}/removal-preview`);
      expect(response).toMatchObject({ status: 404, body: NOT_FOUND });
    }
  });

  it("disconnects once and answers 409 afterwards", async () => {
    const path = `/api/connections/${connectionId}`;
    expect(await ta.json(path, { method: "DELETE" })).toMatchObject({
      status: 200,
      body: { removedAccounts: 2 },
    });
    expect(await ta.json(path, { method: "DELETE" })).toMatchObject({
      status: 409,
      body: { error: "The connection is already removed", code: "already_removed" },
    });
  });

  it("answers 404 when disconnecting an unknown connection", async () => {
    expect(await ta.json("/api/connections/999", { method: "DELETE" })).toMatchObject({
      status: 404,
      body: NOT_FOUND,
    });
  });

  it("rejects a disconnect without the panel origin", async () => {
    const response = await ta.app.request(`/api/connections/${connectionId}`, {
      method: "DELETE",
      headers: { cookie: ta.cookie },
    });
    expect(response.status).toBe(403);
    expect(fx.repo.getConnection(connectionId)?.removedAt).toBeNull();
  });

  it("requires an explicit confirmation to purge", async () => {
    await ta.json(`/api/connections/${connectionId}`, { method: "DELETE" });
    const path = `/api/accounts/${first}/purge`;
    for (const body of [undefined, {}, { confirm: "yes" }, { confirm: false }]) {
      expect(await ta.json(path, { method: "POST", body })).toMatchObject({
        status: 400,
        body: { error: "Purging needs an explicit confirmation", code: "confirmation_required" },
      });
    }
    expect(fx.repo.countTransactions(first).total).toBe(3);
  });

  it("refuses to purge an account that is not removed", async () => {
    expect(
      await ta.json(`/api/accounts/${first}/purge`, { method: "POST", body: { confirm: true } }),
    ).toMatchObject({
      status: 409,
      body: { error: "Only a removed account can be purged", code: "account_not_removed" },
    });
  });

  it("purges a removed account and answers 404 for an unknown one", async () => {
    await ta.json(`/api/connections/${connectionId}`, { method: "DELETE" });
    expect(
      await ta.json(`/api/accounts/${first}/purge`, { method: "POST", body: { confirm: true } }),
    ).toMatchObject({ status: 200, body: { transactions: 3, balances: 1 } });
    expect(
      await ta.json("/api/accounts/999/purge", { method: "POST", body: { confirm: true } }),
    ).toMatchObject({ status: 404, body: NOT_FOUND });
  });

  it("marks every response as not cacheable", async () => {
    const preview = await ta.json(`/api/connections/${connectionId}/removal-preview`);
    const missing = await ta.json("/api/connections/999/removal-preview");
    expect(preview.headers.get("cache-control")).toBe("no-store");
    expect(missing.headers.get("cache-control")).toBe("no-store");
  });
});
```

```ts
import { Writable } from "node:stream";
import pino, { type Logger } from "pino";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import type { EnableBankingApi } from "../eb/client";
import { parseEbErrorBody } from "../eb/errors";
import expiredSession from "../eb/fixtures/error-expired-session.json";
import {
  BANK_NAME,
  createLifecycleFixture,
  DAY_MS,
  HOUR_MS,
  insertConnection,
  type LifecycleFixture,
  NOW,
  notificationRows,
  SESSION_ID,
  sessionStatus,
  stubBankingApi,
  TIMEZONE,
} from "../test/lifecycle";
import { consentTask, SESSION_STATUS_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS } from "./consent-task";

let fx: LifecycleFixture;
let logLines: string[];
let logger: Logger;

beforeEach(() => {
  fx = createLifecycleFixture();
  logLines = [];
  logger = pino(
    { level: "info" },
    new Writable({
      write(chunk, _encoding, done) {
        logLines.push(String(chunk));
        done();
      },
    }),
  );
});
afterEach(() => fx.dispose());

function makeTask(api: EnableBankingApi | null) {
  return consentTask({
    repo: fx.repo,
    api,
    notifications: fx.service,
    bus: fx.bus,
    timezone: TIMEZONE,
    now: () => fx.clock.now,
    logger,
  });
}

async function tick(api: EnableBankingApi | null = null): Promise<void> {
  await makeTask(api).run(new Date(fx.clock.now));
}

const expiringKeys = () =>
  notificationRows(fx)
    .filter((row) => row.event === "consent_expiring")
    .map((row) => row.dedupeKey);

function bankWith(getSession: EnableBankingApi["getSession"]) {
  const spy = vi.fn(getSession);
  return { api: stubBankingApi({ getSession: spy }), spy };
}

describe("consentTask thresholds", () => {
  it("is the consent-lifecycle task", () => {
    expect(makeTask(null).name).toBe("consent-lifecycle");
  });

  it("raises nothing 15 days before the consent ends", async () => {
    insertConnection(fx, { validUntil: NOW + 15 * DAY_MS });
    await tick();
    expect(notificationRows(fx)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("raises the 14-day notice 14 days before", async () => {
    const validUntil = NOW + 14 * DAY_MS;
    const id = insertConnection(fx, { validUntil });
    await tick();
    expect(notificationRows(fx)).toEqual([
      {
        event: "consent_expiring",
        dedupeKey: `consent-expiring:${id}:${validUntil}:14`,
        params: { bankName: BANK_NAME, days: 14 },
        link: "/accounts",
      },
    ]);
  });

  it("keeps the 14-day notice down to 4 days", async () => {
    const validUntil = NOW + 4 * DAY_MS;
    const id = insertConnection(fx, { validUntil });
    await tick();
    expect(notificationRows(fx)).toEqual([
      {
        event: "consent_expiring",
        dedupeKey: `consent-expiring:${id}:${validUntil}:14`,
        params: { bankName: BANK_NAME, days: 4 },
        link: "/accounts",
      },
    ]);
  });

  it.each([3, 2])(
    "raises only the 3-day notice when the first evaluation finds %i days",
    async (days) => {
      const validUntil = NOW + days * DAY_MS;
      const id = insertConnection(fx, { validUntil });
      await tick();
      expect(notificationRows(fx)).toEqual([
        {
          event: "consent_expiring",
          dedupeKey: `consent-expiring:${id}:${validUntil}:3`,
          params: { bankName: BANK_NAME, days },
          link: "/accounts",
        },
      ]);
    },
  );

  it("uses the 3-day notice on the last day", async () => {
    const validUntil = NOW + 2 * HOUR_MS;
    const id = insertConnection(fx, { validUntil });
    await tick();
    expect(notificationRows(fx)).toEqual([
      {
        event: "consent_expiring",
        dedupeKey: `consent-expiring:${id}:${validUntil}:3`,
        params: { bankName: BANK_NAME, days: 0 },
        link: "/accounts",
      },
    ]);
  });

  it("counts local calendar days in the configured time zone", async () => {
    fx.clock.now = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 9, 22, 30); // 23:30 in Rome
    // 24 November 00:15 in Rome: 14 days and 45 minutes away, but 15 calendar days.
    insertConnection(fx, { validUntil: Date.UTC(2026, 10, 23, 23, 15), aspspName: "Northwind Bank" });
    // 23 November 23:45 in Rome: 14 calendar days.
    const validUntil = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 23, 22, 45);
    const id = insertConnection(fx, { validUntil });
    await tick();
    expect(expiringKeys()).toEqual([`consent-expiring:${id}:${validUntil}:14`]);
  });

  it("marks the connection expired once validUntil has passed", async () => {
    const validUntil = NOW - 60_000;
    const id = insertConnection(fx, { validUntil });
    await tick();
    expect(fx.repo.getConnection(id)?.status).toBe("expired");
    expect(notificationRows(fx).map((row) => [row.event, row.dedupeKey])).toEqual([
      ["consent_expired", `consent-expired:${id}:${validUntil}`],
    ]);
    expect(fx.events).toContainEqual({ type: "connection.updated", connectionId: id, status: "expired" });
  });

  it("raises each notice once and escalates from 14 days to 3 days to expired", async () => {
    const validUntil = NOW + 14 * DAY_MS;
    const id = insertConnection(fx, { validUntil });
    await tick();
    await tick();
    expect(expiringKeys()).toEqual([`consent-expiring:${id}:${validUntil}:14`]);

    fx.clock.now += 11 * DAY_MS;
    await tick();
    await tick();
    expect(expiringKeys()).toEqual([
      `consent-expiring:${id}:${validUntil}:14`,
      `consent-expiring:${id}:${validUntil}:3`,
    ]);

    fx.clock.now = validUntil;
    await tick();
    await tick();
    expect(notificationRows(fx).map((row) => row.event)).toEqual([
      "consent_expiring",
      "consent_expiring",
      "consent_expired",
    ]);
  });

  it("starts the thresholds over after a renewal", async () => {
    const first = NOW + 3 * DAY_MS;
    const id = insertConnection(fx, { validUntil: first });
    await tick();

    const renewed = NOW + 90 * DAY_MS;
    fx.repo.updateConnection(id, { validUntil: renewed, renewedAt: NOW });
    await tick();
    expect(expiringKeys()).toEqual([`consent-expiring:${id}:${first}:3`]);

    fx.clock.now += 76 * DAY_MS;
    await tick();
    expect(expiringKeys()).toEqual([
      `consent-expiring:${id}:${first}:3`,
      `consent-expiring:${id}:${renewed}:14`,
    ]);
  });

  it("ignores removed connections and connections that already ended", async () => {
    insertConnection(fx, { validUntil: NOW + 2 * DAY_MS, removedAt: NOW - DAY_MS });
    const revoked = insertConnection(fx, { validUntil: NOW + 2 * DAY_MS, status: "revoked" });
    const failed = insertConnection(fx, { validUntil: NOW - DAY_MS, status: "error" });
    await tick();
    expect(notificationRows(fx)).toEqual([]);
    expect(fx.repo.getConnection(revoked)?.status).toBe("revoked");
    expect(fx.repo.getConnection(failed)?.status).toBe("error");
  });
});

describe("consentTask session status check", () => {
  it.each([
    ["EXPIRED", "expired", "consent_expired"],
    ["REVOKED", "revoked", "connection_error"],
    ["CLOSED", "error", "connection_error"],
    ["CANCELLED", "error", "connection_error"],
    ["INVALID", "error", "connection_error"],
  ] as const)("maps a %s session to %s", async (state, expected, event) => {
    const id = insertConnection(fx, { validUntil: NOW + 60 * DAY_MS });
    const { api, spy } = bankWith(async () => sessionStatus(state));
    await tick(api);
    expect(spy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(SESSION_ID);
    const connection = fx.repo.getConnection(id);
    expect(connection?.status).toBe(expected);
    expect(connection?.statusCheckedAt).toBe(NOW);
    expect(connection?.lastErrorCode).toBe(`SESSION_${state}`);
    expect(notificationRows(fx).map((row) => row.event)).toEqual([event]);
    expect(fx.events).toContainEqual({ type: "connection.updated", connectionId: id, status: expected });
  });

  it.each(["AUTHORIZED", "PENDING_AUTHORIZATION", "RETURNED_FROM_BANK"] as const)(
    "leaves a %s session alone",
    async (state) => {
      const id = insertConnection(fx, { validUntil: NOW + 60 * DAY_MS });
      const { api } = bankWith(async () => sessionStatus(state));
      await tick(api);
      const connection = fx.repo.getConnection(id);
      expect(connection?.status).toBe("active");
      expect(connection?.statusCheckedAt).toBe(NOW);
      expect(notificationRows(fx)).toEqual([]);
    },
  );

  it("asks the bank at most once every 24 hours", async () => {
    expect(SESSION_STATUS_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS).toBe(24 * HOUR_MS);
    insertConnection(fx, { validUntil: NOW + 60 * DAY_MS });
    const { api, spy } = bankWith(async () => sessionStatus("AUTHORIZED"));
    await tick(api);
    fx.clock.now += 23 * HOUR_MS;
    await tick(api);
    expect(spy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    fx.clock.now += HOUR_MS;
    await tick(api);
    expect(spy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  });

  it("treats a re-authorisation error like the matching session state", async () => {
    const id = insertConnection(fx, { validUntil: NOW + 60 * DAY_MS });
    const { api } = bankWith(async () => {
      throw parseEbErrorBody(401, expiredSession);
    });
    await tick(api);
    expect(fx.repo.getConnection(id)).toMatchObject({
      status: "expired",
      lastErrorCode: "EXPIRED_SESSION",
    });
    expect(notificationRows(fx).map((row) => row.event)).toEqual(["consent_expired"]);
  });

  it("logs other errors with the code only and retries the next day", async () => {
    const id = insertConnection(fx, { validUntil: NOW + 60 * DAY_MS });
    const { api, spy } = bankWith(async () => {
      throw parseEbErrorBody(500, { message: "ASPSP error", code: 500, error: "ASPSP_ERROR" });
    });
    await tick(api);

    expect(fx.repo.getConnection(id)).toMatchObject({ status: "active", statusCheckedAt: NOW });
    const line = logLines.find((entry) => entry.includes("Bank session status check failed"));
    expect(JSON.parse(line ?? "{}")).toMatchObject({
      connectionId: id,
      status: 500,
      code: "ASPSP_ERROR",
    });
    expect(logLines.join("")).not.toContain(SESSION_ID);

    fx.clock.now += HOUR_MS;
    await tick(api);
    expect(spy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    fx.clock.now += 24 * HOUR_MS;
    await tick(api);
    expect(spy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  });

  it("logs a failure without an HTTP answer with null status and code", async () => {
    const id = insertConnection(fx, { validUntil: NOW + 60 * DAY_MS });
    const { api } = bankWith(async () => {
      throw new TypeError("fetch failed");
    });
    await tick(api);
    expect(fx.repo.getConnection(id)?.status).toBe("active");
    const line = logLines.find((entry) => entry.includes("Bank session status check failed"));
    expect(JSON.parse(line ?? "{}")).toMatchObject({ connectionId: id, status: null, code: null });
  });

  it("does not ask the bank about a consent that has lapsed by date", async () => {
    const id = insertConnection(fx, { validUntil: NOW - 1 });
    const { api, spy } = bankWith(async () => sessionStatus("AUTHORIZED"));
    await tick(api);
    expect(spy).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(fx.repo.getConnection(id)?.status).toBe("expired");
  });

  it("checks the session before raising an expiry notice", async () => {
    insertConnection(fx, { validUntil: NOW + 3 * DAY_MS });
    const { api } = bankWith(async () => sessionStatus("REVOKED"));
    await tick(api);
    expect(notificationRows(fx).map((row) => row.event)).toEqual(["connection_error"]);
  });
});
```
