- [ ] **Step 13: Implement the queries**

`apps/server/src/finance/queries.ts`. Everything is raw SQL through `sqlite.prepare` (codebase map §1.3): the list query joins `accounts` for the scope and the display name, the facets are one conditional aggregate, and every request reads the locale once. Do not log a query's parameters: they can contain the owner's search text.

```ts
import {
  type AccountDetailResponse,
  type AccountPatch,
  type AccountStatus,
  type AccountSummary,
  accountDisplayName,
  addDays,
  type BalanceHistoryResponse,
  type CashFlowBucket,
  type CashFlowResponse,
  type CashflowQuery,
  type ConnectionStatus,
  type ConnectionSummary,
  type ConnectionsResponse,
  calendarDaysUntil,
  diffDays,
  effectiveConnectionStatus,
  type HomeAlert,
  type HomeSummary,
  isIncludedInTotals,
  type LocalDate,
  normalizeForSearch,
  parseDecimalToMinor,
  pickPreferredBalance,
  type RemovedAccountSummary,
  type SearchResponse,
  type SkipReason,
  type StoredConnectionStatus,
  type SyncRunItem,
  type SyncRunStatus,
  type SyncTrigger,
  sumMinor,
  type TransactionDetail,
  type TransactionItem,
  type TransactionListResponse,
  type TransactionQuery,
  type TransactionStatus,
  type TransactionTab,
  toLocalDate,
} from "@bursar/shared";
import type { AuditLog } from "../audit";
import type { BursarDb, Sqlite } from "../db";
import type { JobQueue } from "../jobs/queue";
import { syncDedupeKey } from "../jobs/types";
import { buildCashFlow, type CashFlowRow, defaultCurrency } from "./cashflow";

export interface QueryDeps {
  db: BursarDb;
  sqlite: Sqlite;
  queue: JobQueue;
  timezone: string;
  now: () => number;
  locale: () => "it" | "en";
}

type SqlParam = string | number;

/** Shown when nothing in the database says which currency a flow is in (no account at all). */
const FALLBACK_CURRENCY = "EUR";
/** Accounts whose transactions count in lists, totals, the summary and the search. */
const INCLUDED_ACCOUNTS_SQL = "a.status IN ('active', 'unavailable')";
const SYNC_FAILING_AFTER_MS = 48 * 3_600_000;
const NET_WINDOW_DAYS = 30;
const SEARCH_LIMIT = 6;
const SYNC_RUN_LIMIT = 20;
const BACKUP_FAILING_THRESHOLD = 2;

interface ConnectionRow {
  id: number;
  aspsp_name: string;
  aspsp_country: string;
  aspsp_logo_url: string | null;
  status: StoredConnectionStatus;
  valid_until: number;
  last_error_code: string | null;
  last_error_message: string | null;
  last_error_at: number | null;
  created_at: number;
  renewed_at: number | null;
  removed_at: number | null;
}

interface AccountRow {
  id: number;
  connection_id: number;
  iban: string | null;
  masked_identifier: string | null;
  last4: string | null;
  product: string | null;
  details: string | null;
  nickname: string | null;
  currency: string;
  cash_account_type: string | null;
  status: AccountStatus;
  last_synced_at: number | null;
  last_sync_error_code: string | null;
  last_sync_error_at: number | null;
  rate_limited_until: number | null;
  created_at: number;
  updated_at: number;
  removed_at: number | null;
}

interface AccountBrief {
  id: number;
  currency: string;
  status: AccountStatus;
}

type PreferredBalance = NonNullable<AccountSummary["balance"]>;

function all<T>(deps: QueryDeps, sql: string, ...params: SqlParam[]): T[] {
  return deps.sqlite.prepare(sql).all(...params) as T[];
}

function get<T>(deps: QueryDeps, sql: string, ...params: SqlParam[]): T | undefined {
  return deps.sqlite.prepare(sql).get(...params) as T | undefined;
}

/**
 * The locale setting costs a database read, so each public query reads it once and every row of
 * that query reuses the answer.
 */
function pinLocale(deps: QueryDeps): QueryDeps {
  const locale = deps.locale();
  return { ...deps, locale: () => locale };
}

function today(deps: QueryDeps): LocalDate {
  return toLocalDate(deps.now(), deps.timezone);
}

function displayName(
  row: {
    nickname: string | null;
    product: string | null;
    details: string | null;
    cash_account_type: string | null;
    last4: string | null;
  },
  deps: QueryDeps,
): string {
  return accountDisplayName(
    {
      nickname: row.nickname,
      product: row.product,
      details: row.details,
      cashAccountType: row.cash_account_type,
      last4: row.last4,
    },
    deps.locale(),
  );
}

// Account and connection views

function loadPreferredBalances(deps: QueryDeps): Map<number, PreferredBalance> {
  const rows = all<{
    account_id: number;
    balance_type: string;
    amount_minor: number;
    currency: string;
    as_of: number;
  }>(
    deps,
    `SELECT account_id, balance_type, amount_minor, currency, as_of FROM (
       SELECT b.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
         PARTITION BY b.account_id, b.balance_type
         ORDER BY b.reference_date DESC, b.as_of DESC, b.id DESC
       ) AS rn FROM balances b
     ) WHERE rn = 1`,
  );
  const byAccount = new Map<
    number,
    { balanceType: string; amountMinor: number; currency: string; asOf: number }[]
  >();
  for (const row of rows) {
    const list = byAccount.get(row.account_id) ?? [];
    list.push({
      balanceType: row.balance_type,
      amountMinor: row.amount_minor,
      currency: row.currency,
      asOf: row.as_of,
    });
    byAccount.set(row.account_id, list);
  }
  const preferred = new Map<number, PreferredBalance>();
  for (const [accountId, candidates] of byAccount) {
    const pick = pickPreferredBalance(candidates);
    if (pick) {
      preferred.set(accountId, {
        amountMinor: pick.amountMinor,
        currency: pick.currency,
        type: pick.balanceType,
        asOf: pick.asOf,
      });
    }
  }
  return preferred;
}

interface Window30d {
  net30d: AccountSummary["net30d"];
  daily30d: CashFlowBucket[];
}

function emptyWindow(from: LocalDate): Window30d {
  return {
    net30d: { inMinor: 0, outMinor: 0, netMinor: 0 },
    daily30d: Array.from({ length: NET_WINDOW_DAYS }, (_, index) => {
      const date = addDays(from, index);
      return { date, end: date, inMinor: 0, outMinor: 0, netMinor: 0, count: 0, balanceMinor: null };
    }),
  };
}

/** `net30d` and `daily30d` of every account from one query grouped by account and day. */
function loadWindow30d(deps: QueryDeps): { from: LocalDate; byAccount: Map<number, Window30d> } {
  const to = today(deps);
  const from = addDays(to, -(NET_WINDOW_DAYS - 1));
  const rows = all<{
    account_id: number;
    sort_date: LocalDate;
    in_minor: number;
    out_minor: number;
    n: number;
  }>(
    deps,
    `SELECT account_id, sort_date,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN amount_minor > 0 THEN amount_minor ELSE 0 END), 0) AS in_minor,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN amount_minor < 0 THEN -amount_minor ELSE 0 END), 0) AS out_minor,
            COUNT(*) AS n
       FROM transactions WHERE sort_date >= ? AND sort_date <= ?
      GROUP BY account_id, sort_date`,
    from,
    to,
  );
  const byAccount = new Map<number, Window30d>();
  for (const row of rows) {
    let entry = byAccount.get(row.account_id);
    if (!entry) {
      entry = emptyWindow(from);
      byAccount.set(row.account_id, entry);
    }
    entry.net30d.inMinor += row.in_minor;
    entry.net30d.outMinor += row.out_minor;
    entry.net30d.netMinor += row.in_minor - row.out_minor;
    const day = entry.daily30d[diffDays(row.sort_date, from)];
    if (day) {
      day.inMinor = row.in_minor;
      day.outMinor = row.out_minor;
      day.netMinor = row.in_minor - row.out_minor;
      day.count = row.n;
    }
  }
  return { from, byAccount };
}

interface AccountContext {
  balances: Map<number, PreferredBalance>;
  window30d: { from: LocalDate; byAccount: Map<number, Window30d> };
  syncing: Set<string>;
}

function loadAccountContext(deps: QueryDeps): AccountContext {
  return {
    balances: loadPreferredBalances(deps),
    window30d: loadWindow30d(deps),
    syncing: deps.queue.activeKeys("sync:"),
  };
}

function toAccountSummary(row: AccountRow, ctx: AccountContext, deps: QueryDeps): AccountSummary {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    connectionId: row.connection_id,
    name: displayName(row, deps),
    nickname: row.nickname,
    bankProduct: row.product,
    maskedIdentifier: row.masked_identifier,
    iban: row.iban,
    last4: row.last4,
    currency: row.currency,
    cashAccountType: row.cash_account_type,
    status: row.status,
    balance: ctx.balances.get(row.id) ?? null,
    ...(ctx.window30d.byAccount.get(row.id) ?? emptyWindow(ctx.window30d.from)),
    lastSyncedAt: row.last_synced_at,
    lastSyncError:
      row.last_sync_error_at === null
        ? null
        : { code: row.last_sync_error_code, at: row.last_sync_error_at },
    rateLimitedUntil: row.rate_limited_until,
    syncInProgress: ctx.syncing.has(syncDedupeKey(row.id)),
  };
}

function toConnectionBase(
  row: ConnectionRow,
  deps: QueryDeps,
): Omit<ConnectionSummary, "accounts"> {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    bankName: row.aspsp_name,
    country: row.aspsp_country,
    hasLogo: row.aspsp_logo_url !== null,
    status: effectiveConnectionStatus(row.status, row.valid_until, deps.now(), deps.timezone),
    validUntil: row.valid_until,
    createdAt: row.created_at,
    renewedAt: row.renewed_at,
    lastError:
      row.last_error_at === null
        ? null
        : { code: row.last_error_code, message: row.last_error_message, at: row.last_error_at },
  };
}

export function listConnectionsView(input: QueryDeps): ConnectionsResponse {
  const deps = pinLocale(input);
  const connectionRows = all<ConnectionRow>(deps, "SELECT * FROM bank_connections ORDER BY id");
  const accountRows = all<AccountRow>(deps, "SELECT * FROM accounts ORDER BY id");
  const ctx = loadAccountContext(deps);

  const connections: ConnectionSummary[] = connectionRows
    .filter((connection) => connection.removed_at === null)
    .map((connection) => ({
      ...toConnectionBase(connection, deps),
      accounts: accountRows
        .filter((a) => a.connection_id === connection.id && a.status !== "removed")
        .map((a) => toAccountSummary(a, ctx, deps)),
    }));

  const bankNames = new Map(connectionRows.map((c) => [c.id, c.aspsp_name]));
  const counts = new Map(
    all<{ account_id: number; total: number }>(
      deps,
      `SELECT t.account_id, COUNT(*) AS total FROM transactions t
         WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE status = 'removed')
         GROUP BY t.account_id`,
    ).map((row) => [row.account_id, row.total]),
  );
  const removedAccounts: RemovedAccountSummary[] = accountRows
    .filter((a) => a.status === "removed")
    .map((a) => ({
      id: a.id,
      name: displayName(a, deps),
      maskedIdentifier: a.masked_identifier,
      bankName: bankNames.get(a.connection_id) ?? "",
      transactionCount: counts.get(a.id) ?? 0,
      removedAt: a.removed_at ?? a.updated_at,
    }));

  return { connections, removedAccounts };
}

/** The currency of an account in any status, or null once the account is gone (purged). */
export function accountCurrency(deps: QueryDeps, accountId: number): string | null {
  return (
    get<{ currency: string }>(deps, "SELECT currency FROM accounts WHERE id = ?", accountId)
      ?.currency ?? null
  );
}

function summaryOf(deps: QueryDeps, row: AccountRow): AccountSummary {
  return toAccountSummary(row, loadAccountContext(deps), deps);
}

export function getAccountDetail(
  input: QueryDeps,
  accountId: number,
): AccountDetailResponse | null {
  const deps = pinLocale(input);
  const row = get<AccountRow>(deps, "SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE id = ?", accountId);
  if (!row) return null;
  const connection = get<ConnectionRow>(
    deps,
    "SELECT * FROM bank_connections WHERE id = ?",
    row.connection_id,
  );
  if (!connection) return null;
  const syncRuns = all<{
    id: number;
    trigger: SyncTrigger;
    status: SyncRunStatus;
    started_at: number;
    finished_at: number | null;
    inserted: number;
    updated: number;
    removed: number;
    error_code: string | null;
    skip_reason: SkipReason | null;
  }>(
    deps,
    `SELECT id, trigger, status, started_at, finished_at, inserted, updated, removed, error_code, skip_reason
       FROM sync_runs WHERE account_id = ? ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT ${SYNC_RUN_LIMIT}`,
    accountId,
  ).map(
    (run): SyncRunItem => ({
      id: run.id,
      trigger: run.trigger,
      status: run.status,
      startedAt: run.started_at,
      finishedAt: run.finished_at,
      inserted: run.inserted,
      updated: run.updated,
      removed: run.removed,
      errorCode: run.error_code,
      skipReason: run.skip_reason,
    }),
  );
  const count = get<{ total: number }>(
    deps,
    "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM transactions WHERE account_id = ?",
    accountId,
  );
  return {
    account: summaryOf(deps, row),
    connection: toConnectionBase(connection, deps),
    syncRuns,
    transactionCount: count?.total ?? 0,
  };
}

/**
 * Daily balances for the last `days` local days, computed backwards from the current preferred
 * balance by undoing the booked transactions of each day. Null when the account is unknown or has
 * no balance.
 */
export function balanceHistory(
  deps: QueryDeps,
  accountId: number,
  days: 30 | 90 | 365,
): BalanceHistoryResponse | null {
  if (accountCurrency(deps, accountId) === null) return null;
  const current = loadPreferredBalances(deps).get(accountId);
  if (!current) return null;

  const end = today(deps);
  const start = addDays(end, -(days - 1));
  const netByDate = new Map(
    all<{ sort_date: string; net: number }>(
      deps,
      `SELECT sort_date, SUM(amount_minor) AS net FROM transactions
         WHERE account_id = ? AND status = 'booked' AND sort_date >= ? AND sort_date <= ?
         GROUP BY sort_date`,
      accountId,
      start,
      end,
    ).map((row) => [row.sort_date, row.net]),
  );

  // Walk from today back to the first day: the balance at the end of the previous day is the
  // balance at the end of this day minus this day's booked flow.
  const points: BalanceHistoryResponse["points"] = [];
  let balance = current.amountMinor;
  for (let offset = 0; offset < days; offset += 1) {
    const date = addDays(end, -offset);
    points.push({ date, balanceMinor: balance });
    balance -= netByDate.get(date) ?? 0;
  }
  points.reverse();
  return { currency: current.currency, points };
}

// Transaction filters

interface RowFilter {
  q?: string | undefined;
  accountId?: number | undefined;
  from?: LocalDate | undefined;
  to?: LocalDate | undefined;
  currency?: string | undefined;
}

interface SqlFragment {
  where: string[];
  params: SqlParam[];
}

/** True when `part` is digits grouped by `separator` as thousands: 1 to 3 digits, then groups of 3. */
function isThousandsGrouped(part: string, separator: string): boolean {
  const groups = part.split(separator);
  const [head = "", ...rest] = groups;
  return /^\d{1,3}$/u.test(head) && rest.every((group) => /^\d{3}$/u.test(group));
}

/**
 * Turns a typed amount into a canonical decimal string. `1.234,56`, `1,234.56`, `12,5` and `12`
 * are understood. When both separators appear the last one is the decimal point and the other
 * must group thousands. A single separator that occurs once is a decimal point, except a lone `.`
 * followed by exactly three digits after 1 to 3 digits, which groups thousands (`1.234` is 1234).
 * A separator that occurs several times must group thousands. Returns null for anything else.
 */
export function canonicalizeAmount(
  input: string,
): { sign: "+" | "-" | null; decimal: string } | null {
  const match = /^([+-])?\s*(\d[\d.,\s]*)$/u.exec(input.trim());
  if (!match) return null;
  const sign = match[1] === "-" || match[1] === "+" ? match[1] : null;
  const body = (match[2] ?? "").replace(/\s+/gu, "");
  const lastDot = body.lastIndexOf(".");
  const lastComma = body.lastIndexOf(",");

  let integer = body;
  let fraction = "";
  if (lastDot >= 0 && lastComma >= 0) {
    const decimalAt = Math.max(lastDot, lastComma);
    const decimalChar = body.charAt(decimalAt);
    const thousandsChar = decimalChar === "." ? "," : ".";
    integer = body.slice(0, decimalAt);
    fraction = body.slice(decimalAt + 1);
    if (!isThousandsGrouped(integer, thousandsChar)) return null;
  } else if (lastDot >= 0 || lastComma >= 0) {
    const separator = lastComma >= 0 ? "," : ".";
    const at = body.lastIndexOf(separator);
    const occurrences = body.split(separator).length - 1;
    if (occurrences > 1) {
      if (!isThousandsGrouped(body, separator)) return null;
    } else if (
      separator === "." &&
      /^\d{3}$/u.test(body.slice(at + 1)) &&
      /^[1-9]\d{0,2}$/u.test(body.slice(0, at))
    ) {
      // "1.234" reads as 1234: a thousands separator, not a decimal point.
    } else {
      integer = body.slice(0, at);
      fraction = body.slice(at + 1);
    }
  }
  integer = integer.replace(/[.,]/gu, "");
  if (!/^\d+$/u.test(integer) || !/^\d*$/u.test(fraction)) return null;
  integer = integer.replace(/^0+(?=\d)/u, "");
  return { sign, decimal: fraction === "" ? integer : `${integer}.${fraction}` };
}

function escapeLike(value: string): string {
  return value.replace(/[\\%_]/gu, (char) => `\\${char}`);
}

function distinctCurrencies(deps: QueryDeps): string[] {
  return all<{ currency: string }>(deps, "SELECT DISTINCT currency FROM accounts").map(
    (row) => row.currency,
  );
}

/**
 * Matches the normalised text in `search_text`, or an amount equal to the typed number in any
 * currency of the database (using that currency's minor digits). An unsigned number matches
 * inflows and outflows alike; a signed one matches only that direction.
 */
function searchCondition(deps: QueryDeps, q: string): { sql: string; params: SqlParam[] } {
  const clauses: string[] = [];
  const params: SqlParam[] = [];
  const text = normalizeForSearch(q);
  if (text !== "") {
    clauses.push("t.search_text LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\'");
    params.push(`%${escapeLike(text)}%`);
  }
  const amount = canonicalizeAmount(q);
  if (amount) {
    for (const currency of distinctCurrencies(deps)) {
      let minor: number;
      try {
        minor = parseDecimalToMinor(amount.decimal, currency);
      } catch {
        continue;
      }
      if (amount.sign === null) {
        clauses.push("(t.currency = ? AND ABS(t.amount_minor) = ?)");
        params.push(currency, minor);
      } else {
        clauses.push("(t.currency = ? AND t.amount_minor = ?)");
        params.push(currency, amount.sign === "-" ? -minor : minor);
      }
    }
  }
  if (clauses.length === 0) return { sql: "0", params: [] };
  return { sql: `(${clauses.join(" OR ")})`, params };
}

/**
 * The WHERE conditions shared by every transaction query (alias `t` for transactions and `a` for
 * accounts). Without an explicit account only accounts counted in the totals are searched; an
 * explicit account may be any account that still exists.
 */
function transactionFilter(
  deps: QueryDeps,
  filter: RowFilter,
  options: { currency: boolean },
): SqlFragment {
  const where: string[] = [];
  const params: SqlParam[] = [];
  if (filter.accountId !== undefined) {
    where.push("t.account_id = ?");
    params.push(filter.accountId);
  } else {
    where.push(INCLUDED_ACCOUNTS_SQL);
  }
  if (filter.from !== undefined) {
    where.push("t.sort_date >= ?");
    params.push(filter.from);
  }
  if (filter.to !== undefined) {
    where.push("t.sort_date <= ?");
    params.push(filter.to);
  }
  if (options.currency && filter.currency !== undefined) {
    where.push("t.currency = ?");
    params.push(filter.currency);
  }
  if (filter.q !== undefined) {
    const search = searchCondition(deps, filter.q);
    where.push(search.sql);
    params.push(...search.params);
  }
  return { where, params };
}

function tabCondition(tab: TransactionTab): string | null {
  switch (tab) {
    case "in":
      return "t.amount_minor > 0";
    case "out":
      return "t.amount_minor < 0";
    case "pending":
      return "t.status = 'pending'";
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

const FROM_TRANSACTIONS = "FROM transactions t JOIN accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id";
const ITEM_COLUMNS = `t.id, t.account_id, t.status, t.sort_date, t.booking_date, t.value_date,
  t.amount_minor, t.currency, t.counterparty, t.remittance,
  a.nickname, a.product, a.details, a.cash_account_type, a.last4`;

const registeredFold = new WeakSet<Sqlite>();

/**
 * better-sqlite3 has no custom collations, so ordering by counterparty goes through a scalar
 * function that folds case and accents, which also matches the panel's search normalisation.
 */
function ensureFoldFunction(sqlite: Sqlite): void {
  if (registeredFold.has(sqlite)) return;
  sqlite.function("bursar_fold", { deterministic: true }, (value: unknown) =>
    typeof value === "string" ? normalizeForSearch(value) : null,
  );
  registeredFold.add(sqlite);
}

function orderClause(sort: TransactionQuery["sort"], order: TransactionQuery["order"]): string {
  const direction = order === "asc" ? "ASC" : "DESC";
  switch (sort) {
    case "amount":
      return `t.amount_minor ${direction}, t.sort_date DESC, t.id DESC`;
    case "counterparty":
      return `t.counterparty IS NULL, bursar_fold(t.counterparty) ${direction}, t.sort_date DESC, t.id DESC`;
    default:
      return `t.sort_date ${direction}, t.id ${direction}`;
  }
}

/** The SQL and parameters of one page of the transaction list (exported for the query-plan test). */
export function buildTransactionListSql(
  deps: QueryDeps,
  query: TransactionQuery,
): { sql: string; params: SqlParam[] } {
  ensureFoldFunction(deps.sqlite);
  const filter = transactionFilter(deps, query, { currency: true });
  const tab = tabCondition(query.tab);
  if (tab) filter.where.push(tab);
  return {
    sql: `SELECT ${ITEM_COLUMNS} ${FROM_TRANSACTIONS}
            WHERE ${filter.where.join(" AND ")}
            ORDER BY ${orderClause(query.sort, query.order)}
            LIMIT ? OFFSET ?`,
    params: [...filter.params, query.pageSize, (query.page - 1) * query.pageSize],
  };
}

interface ItemRow {
  id: number;
  account_id: number;
  status: TransactionStatus;
  sort_date: LocalDate;
  booking_date: LocalDate | null;
  value_date: LocalDate | null;
  amount_minor: number;
  currency: string;
  counterparty: string | null;
  remittance: string | null;
  nickname: string | null;
  product: string | null;
  details: string | null;
  cash_account_type: string | null;
  last4: string | null;
}

function toTransactionItem(row: ItemRow, deps: QueryDeps): TransactionItem {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    accountId: row.account_id,
    accountName: displayName(row, deps),
    status: row.status,
    date: row.sort_date,
    bookingDate: row.booking_date,
    valueDate: row.value_date,
    amountMinor: row.amount_minor,
    currency: row.currency,
    counterparty: row.counterparty,
    description: row.remittance,
  };
}

function facetCounts(deps: QueryDeps, query: TransactionQuery): Record<TransactionTab, number> {
  const filter = transactionFilter(deps, query, { currency: true });
  const row = get<{
    all_count: number;
    in_count: number;
    out_count: number;
    pending_count: number;
  }>(
    deps,
    `SELECT COUNT(*) AS all_count,
            COALESCE(SUM(t.amount_minor > 0), 0) AS in_count,
            COALESCE(SUM(t.amount_minor < 0), 0) AS out_count,
            COALESCE(SUM(t.status = 'pending'), 0) AS pending_count
       ${FROM_TRANSACTIONS} WHERE ${filter.where.join(" AND ")}`,
    ...filter.params,
  );
  return {
    all: row?.all_count ?? 0,
    in: row?.in_count ?? 0,
    out: row?.out_count ?? 0,
    pending: row?.pending_count ?? 0,
  };
}

function loadAccountBriefs(deps: QueryDeps): AccountBrief[] {
  return all<AccountBrief>(deps, "SELECT id, currency, status FROM accounts ORDER BY id");
}

/**
 * The cash flow of everything the list filters match except the tab, in one currency (no FX):
 * the requested one, else the default currency when it appears, else the first that does.
 */
function listAggregate(deps: QueryDeps, query: TransactionQuery): CashFlowResponse {
  const unconstrained = transactionFilter(deps, query, { currency: false });
  const currencies = all<{ currency: string }>(
    deps,
    `SELECT DISTINCT t.currency ${FROM_TRANSACTIONS} WHERE ${unconstrained.where.join(" AND ")} ORDER BY t.currency`,
    ...unconstrained.params,
  ).map((row) => row.currency);
  const preferred = defaultCurrency(loadAccountBriefs(deps));
  const currency =
    query.currency ??
    (preferred !== null && currencies.includes(preferred) ? preferred : undefined) ??
    currencies[0] ??
    preferred ??
    FALLBACK_CURRENCY;

  const filter = transactionFilter(deps, { ...query, currency }, { currency: true });
  const rows = all<CashFlowRow>(
    deps,
    `SELECT t.sort_date AS date, t.amount_minor AS amountMinor, t.status AS status
       ${FROM_TRANSACTIONS} WHERE ${filter.where.join(" AND ")}`,
    ...filter.params,
  );

  const day = today(deps);
  if (rows.length === 0) {
    return buildCashFlow([], {
      from: day,
      to: day,
      currency,
      currencies,
      currentBalanceMinor: null,
    });
  }
  let first = rows[0]?.date ?? day;
  let last = first;
  for (const row of rows) {
    if (row.date < first) first = row.date;
    if (row.date > last) last = row.date;
  }
  return buildCashFlow(rows, {
    from: query.from ?? first,
    to: query.to ?? last,
    currency,
    currencies,
    currentBalanceMinor: null,
  });
}

export function listTransactions(
  input: QueryDeps,
  query: TransactionQuery,
): TransactionListResponse {
  const deps = pinLocale(input);
  const facets = facetCounts(deps, query);
  const { sql, params } = buildTransactionListSql(deps, query);
  const items = all<ItemRow>(deps, sql, ...params).map((row) => toTransactionItem(row, deps));
  return {
    items,
    total: facets[query.tab],
    page: query.page,
    pageSize: query.pageSize,
    facets,
    aggregate: listAggregate(deps, query),
  };
}

function parseBankCode(value: string | null): TransactionDetail["bankCode"] {
  if (value === null) return null;
  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(value);
    if (typeof parsed !== "object" || parsed === null) return null;
    const record = parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
    const text = (key: string): string | null =>
      typeof record[key] === "string" ? (record[key] as string) : null;
    return { code: text("code"), subCode: text("subCode"), description: text("description") };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** The bank's own remittance lines, kept as delivered; falls back to the joined text. */
function remittanceLines(rawJson: string, remittance: string | null): string[] {
  try {
    const raw: unknown = JSON.parse(rawJson);
    if (typeof raw === "object" && raw !== null) {
      const lines = (raw as Record<string, unknown>).remittance_information;
      if (Array.isArray(lines)) {
        const kept = lines
          .filter((line): line is string => typeof line === "string")
          .map((line) => line.trim())
          .filter((line) => line !== "");
        if (kept.length > 0) return kept;
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Unreadable raw payload: use the stored text below.
  }
  return remittance ? [remittance] : [];
}

export function getTransaction(input: QueryDeps, id: number): TransactionDetail | null {
  const deps = pinLocale(input);
  const row = get<
    ItemRow & {
      transaction_date: LocalDate | null;
      provider_reference: string | null;
      counterparty_account: string | null;
      bank_code: string | null;
      merchant_category_code: string | null;
      balance_after_minor: number | null;
      raw_json: string;
      first_seen_at: number;
      last_seen_at: number;
      bank_name: string;
    }
  >(
    deps,
    `SELECT t.id, t.account_id, t.status, t.sort_date, t.booking_date, t.value_date, t.transaction_date,
            t.amount_minor, t.currency, t.counterparty, t.remittance, t.provider_reference,
            t.counterparty_account, t.bank_code, t.merchant_category_code, t.balance_after_minor,
            t.raw_json, t.first_seen_at, t.last_seen_at,
            a.nickname, a.product, a.details, a.cash_account_type, a.last4,
            c.aspsp_name AS bank_name
       FROM transactions t
       JOIN accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id
       JOIN bank_connections c ON c.id = a.connection_id
      WHERE t.id = ?`,
    id,
  );
  if (!row) return null;
  return {
    ...toTransactionItem(row, deps),
    transactionDate: row.transaction_date,
    providerReference: row.provider_reference,
    counterpartyAccount: row.counterparty_account,
    remittanceLines: remittanceLines(row.raw_json, row.remittance),
    bankCode: parseBankCode(row.bank_code),
    merchantCategoryCode: row.merchant_category_code,
    balanceAfter:
      row.balance_after_minor === null
        ? null
        : { amountMinor: row.balance_after_minor, currency: row.currency },
    firstSeenAt: row.first_seen_at,
    lastSeenAt: row.last_seen_at,
    bankName: row.bank_name,
  };
}

// Cash flow

/**
 * The strip for a scope (one account, or every account counted in the totals) and one currency.
 * The period defaults to the 30 local days ending today. The running balance starts from the sum
 * of the preferred balances and undoes the booked transactions dated after the period, so it
 * stays correct for a period that ended in the past. It is null when any account of the currency
 * has no balance. With `nullWhenEmpty` a scope without any transaction (or without accounts)
 * answers null so the route can reply 204.
 */
function computeCashflow(
  deps: QueryDeps,
  query: CashflowQuery,
  options: { nullWhenEmpty: boolean },
): CashFlowResponse | null {
  const briefs = loadAccountBriefs(deps);
  const scope =
    query.accountId !== undefined
      ? briefs.filter((a) => a.id === query.accountId)
      : briefs.filter((a) => isIncludedInTotals(a.status));
  if (scope.length === 0) return null;

  const currencies = [...new Set(scope.map((a) => a.currency))].sort();
  const currency =
    query.currency ??
    (query.accountId !== undefined ? scope[0]?.currency : defaultCurrency(scope)) ??
    currencies[0] ??
    FALLBACK_CURRENCY;

  const day = today(deps);
  const to = query.to ?? (query.from !== undefined && query.from > day ? query.from : day);
  const from = query.from ?? addDays(to, -(NET_WINDOW_DAYS - 1));

  const scopeFilter = transactionFilter(
    deps,
    { accountId: query.accountId, currency },
    { currency: true },
  );
  if (options.nullWhenEmpty) {
    const any = get(
      deps,
      `SELECT 1 AS found ${FROM_TRANSACTIONS} WHERE ${scopeFilter.where.join(" AND ")} LIMIT 1`,
      ...scopeFilter.params,
    );
    if (any === undefined) return null;
  }

  const periodFilter = transactionFilter(
    deps,
    { accountId: query.accountId, currency, from, to },
    { currency: true },
  );
  const rows = all<CashFlowRow>(
    deps,
    `SELECT t.sort_date AS date, t.amount_minor AS amountMinor, t.status AS status
       ${FROM_TRANSACTIONS} WHERE ${periodFilter.where.join(" AND ")}`,
    ...periodFilter.params,
  );

  let currentBalanceMinor: number | null = null;
  const balances = loadPreferredBalances(deps);
  const sameCurrency = scope.filter((a) => a.currency === currency);
  const known = sameCurrency.flatMap((a) => {
    const balance = balances.get(a.id);
    return balance && balance.currency === currency ? [balance.amountMinor] : [];
  });
  if (sameCurrency.length > 0 && known.length === sameCurrency.length) {
    const after = get<{ total: number }>(
      deps,
      `SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount_minor), 0) AS total ${FROM_TRANSACTIONS}
        WHERE ${scopeFilter.where.join(" AND ")} AND t.status = 'booked' AND t.sort_date > ?`,
      ...scopeFilter.params,
      to,
    );
    currentBalanceMinor = sumMinor(known) - (after?.total ?? 0);
  }

  return buildCashFlow(rows, { from, to, currency, currencies, currentBalanceMinor });
}

export function cashflow(deps: QueryDeps, query: CashflowQuery): CashFlowResponse | null {
  return computeCashflow(deps, query, { nullWhenEmpty: true });
}

// Home summary

function buildAlerts(
  deps: QueryDeps,
  backup: { target: "local" | "s3"; consecutiveFailures: number },
  connections: ConnectionRow[],
  accounts: AccountRow[],
): HomeAlert[] {
  const now = deps.now();
  const broken: HomeAlert[] = [];
  const expiring: { days: number; alert: HomeAlert }[] = [];
  const usable = new Set<number>();
  const bankNames = new Map<number, string>();

  for (const connection of connections) {
    bankNames.set(connection.id, connection.aspsp_name);
    const status: ConnectionStatus = effectiveConnectionStatus(
      connection.status,
      connection.valid_until,
      now,
      deps.timezone,
    );
    const base = { connectionId: connection.id, bankName: connection.aspsp_name };
    if (status === "active" || status === "expiring") usable.add(connection.id);
    if (status === "revoked" || status === "error") {
      broken.push({ kind: "connection_error", ...base });
    } else if (status === "expired") {
      broken.push({ kind: "consent_expired", ...base });
    } else if (status === "expiring") {
      const days = Math.max(0, calendarDaysUntil(connection.valid_until, now, deps.timezone));
      expiring.push({ days, alert: { kind: "consent_expiring", ...base, days } });
    }
  }
  expiring.sort((a, b) => a.days - b.days);

  const lastRunStatus = new Map(
    all<{ id: number; last_status: SyncRunStatus | null }>(
      deps,
      `SELECT a.id, (SELECT r.status FROM sync_runs r WHERE r.account_id = a.id
                      ORDER BY r.started_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_status
         FROM accounts a WHERE a.status = 'active'`,
    ).map((row) => [row.id, row.last_status]),
  );
  const cutoff = now - SYNC_FAILING_AFTER_MS;
  const syncFailing: HomeAlert[] = [];
  const rateLimited: HomeAlert[] = [];
  for (const account of accounts) {
    if (account.status !== "active" || !usable.has(account.connection_id)) continue;
    const name = displayName(account, deps);
    const stale =
      account.last_synced_at !== null
        ? account.last_synced_at < cutoff
        : account.created_at < cutoff;
    if (stale && lastRunStatus.get(account.id) === "failed") {
      syncFailing.push({
        kind: "sync_failing",
        accountId: account.id,
        accountName: name,
        since: account.last_synced_at,
      });
    }
    if (account.rate_limited_until !== null && account.rate_limited_until > now) {
      rateLimited.push({
        kind: "rate_limited",
        accountId: account.id,
        accountName: name,
        until: account.rate_limited_until,
      });
    }
  }

  const alerts: HomeAlert[] = [
    ...broken,
    ...expiring.map((entry) => entry.alert),
    ...syncFailing,
    ...rateLimited,
  ];
  if (backup.consecutiveFailures >= BACKUP_FAILING_THRESHOLD) {
    alerts.push({ kind: "backup_failing", failures: backup.consecutiveFailures });
  }
  if (backup.target === "local") alerts.push({ kind: "backup_local_only" });
  return alerts;
}

export function homeSummary(
  input: QueryDeps,
  backup: { target: "local" | "s3"; consecutiveFailures: number },
): HomeSummary {
  const deps = pinLocale(input);
  const connections = all<ConnectionRow>(
    deps,
    "SELECT * FROM bank_connections WHERE removed_at IS NULL ORDER BY id",
  );
  const connectionIds = new Set(connections.map((c) => c.id));
  const accounts = all<AccountRow>(
    deps,
    "SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE status != 'removed' ORDER BY id",
  ).filter((a) => connectionIds.has(a.connection_id));
  const included = accounts.filter((a) => isIncludedInTotals(a.status));
  const ctx = loadAccountContext(deps);

  const perCurrency = new Map<string, { amounts: number[] }>();
  for (const account of included) {
    const balance = ctx.balances.get(account.id);
    if (!balance) continue;
    const entry = perCurrency.get(balance.currency) ?? { amounts: [] };
    entry.amounts.push(balance.amountMinor);
    perCurrency.set(balance.currency, entry);
  }
  const balances = [...perCurrency]
    .map(([currency, entry]) => ({
      currency,
      amountMinor: sumMinor(entry.amounts),
      accountCount: entry.amounts.length,
    }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.accountCount - a.accountCount || a.currency.localeCompare(b.currency, "en"));

  return {
    generatedAt: deps.now(),
    balances,
    cashflow30d: computeCashflow(deps, {}, { nullWhenEmpty: false }),
    accounts: included.map((a) => toAccountSummary(a, ctx, deps)),
    alerts: buildAlerts(deps, backup, connections, accounts),
    hasConnections: connections.length > 0,
  };
}

// Search

export function searchAll(input: QueryDeps, q: string): SearchResponse {
  const deps = pinLocale(input);
  const needle = normalizeForSearch(q);
  const compact = needle.replaceAll(" ", "");
  const accounts = all<AccountRow & { bank_name: string }>(
    deps,
    `SELECT a.*, c.aspsp_name AS bank_name FROM accounts a
       JOIN bank_connections c ON c.id = a.connection_id
      WHERE a.status != 'removed' ORDER BY a.id`,
  )
    .filter((a) => {
      const haystack = normalizeForSearch(
        [displayName(a, deps), a.bank_name, a.last4 ?? "", a.iban ?? ""].join(" "),
      );
      return haystack.includes(needle) || (a.iban?.toLowerCase().includes(compact) ?? false);
    })
    .slice(0, SEARCH_LIMIT)
    .map((a) => ({ id: a.id, name: displayName(a, deps), bankName: a.bank_name, last4: a.last4 }));

  const filter = transactionFilter(deps, { q }, { currency: false });
  const transactions = all<ItemRow>(
    deps,
    `SELECT ${ITEM_COLUMNS} ${FROM_TRANSACTIONS}
      WHERE ${filter.where.join(" AND ")}
      ORDER BY t.sort_date DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT ${SEARCH_LIMIT}`,
    ...filter.params,
  ).map((row) => ({
    id: row.id,
    counterparty: (row.counterparty ?? row.remittance ?? "").slice(0, 120),
    date: row.sort_date,
    amountMinor: row.amount_minor,
    currency: row.currency,
    accountName: displayName(row, deps),
  }));

  return { accounts, transactions };
}

// Account update

/**
 * Renames, disables or enables an account. A removed account cannot change. Enabling an account
 * the bank reported as unavailable sets it back to active so the next sync tries it again. Audit
 * rows name the action and the account but never carry the nickname text.
 */
export function updateAccount(
  input: QueryDeps & { audit: AuditLog },
  accountId: number,
  patch: AccountPatch,
): AccountSummary | null | "not_allowed" {
  const deps = { ...pinLocale(input), audit: input.audit };
  const row = get<AccountRow>(deps, "SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE id = ?", accountId);
  if (!row) return null;
  if (row.status === "removed") return "not_allowed";

  const assignments: string[] = [];
  const params: (string | number | null)[] = [];
  const audits: Parameters<AuditLog["record"]>[0][] = [];
  const target = `account:${accountId}`;
  if (patch.nickname !== undefined && patch.nickname !== row.nickname) {
    assignments.push("nickname = ?");
    params.push(patch.nickname);
    audits.push({
      actor: "user",
      action: "account.rename",
      target,
      details: { cleared: patch.nickname === null },
    });
  }
  if (patch.status !== undefined && patch.status !== row.status) {
    assignments.push("status = ?");
    params.push(patch.status);
    audits.push({
      actor: "user",
      action: patch.status === "disabled" ? "account.disable" : "account.enable",
      target,
    });
  }

  if (assignments.length > 0) {
    deps.sqlite.transaction(() => {
      deps.sqlite
        .prepare(`UPDATE accounts SET ${assignments.join(", ")}, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?`)
        .run(...params, deps.now(), accountId);
      for (const entry of audits) deps.audit.record(entry);
    })();
  }

  const updated = get<AccountRow>(deps, "SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE id = ?", accountId);
  return updated ? summaryOf(deps, updated) : null;
}
```

`apps/server/src/finance/routes.ts`:

```ts
import {
  accountPatchSchema,
  balanceHistoryQuerySchema,
  cashflowQuerySchema,
  searchQuerySchema,
  transactionQuerySchema,
} from "@bursar/shared";
import { type Context, Hono } from "hono";
import type { AuditLog } from "../audit";
import type { AppEnv } from "../http/app";
import {
  accountCurrency,
  balanceHistory,
  cashflow,
  getAccountDetail,
  getTransaction,
  homeSummary,
  listConnectionsView,
  listTransactions,
  type QueryDeps,
  searchAll,
  updateAccount,
} from "./queries";

export interface FinanceRouteDeps extends QueryDeps {
  audit: AuditLog;
  backup: () => { target: "local" | "s3"; consecutiveFailures: number };
}

/** A positive integer id from a URL segment; anything else cannot name a row. */
function parseId(value: string | undefined): number | null {
  if (value === undefined || !/^[1-9]\d{0,14}$/u.test(value)) return null;
  return Number(value);
}

const notFound = (c: Context) => c.json({ error: "Not found", code: "not_found" }, 404);
const invalidQuery = (c: Context) => c.json({ error: "Invalid query", code: "invalid_query" }, 400);

/**
 * The read API of the panel plus the owner's account edits, mounted at `/api`. Ids appear only in
 * URLs and payloads, never in error messages.
 */
export function financeRoutes(deps: FinanceRouteDeps): Hono<AppEnv> {
  const routes = new Hono<AppEnv>();

  routes.get("/connections", (c) => c.json(listConnectionsView(deps)));

  routes.get("/accounts/:accountId", (c) => {
    const accountId = parseId(c.req.param("accountId"));
    const detail = accountId === null ? null : getAccountDetail(deps, accountId);
    return detail ? c.json(detail) : notFound(c);
  });

  routes.patch("/accounts/:accountId", async (c) => {
    const accountId = parseId(c.req.param("accountId"));
    if (accountId === null) return notFound(c);
    const parsed = accountPatchSchema.safeParse(await c.req.json().catch(() => null));
    if (!parsed.success)
      return c.json({ error: "Invalid account update", code: "invalid_body" }, 400);
    const result = updateAccount(deps, accountId, parsed.data);
    if (result === null) return notFound(c);
    if (result === "not_allowed") {
      return c.json({ error: "A removed account cannot be changed", code: "not_allowed" }, 409);
    }
    return c.json(result);
  });

  routes.get("/accounts/:accountId/balance-history", (c) => {
    const accountId = parseId(c.req.param("accountId"));
    const currency = accountId === null ? null : accountCurrency(deps, accountId);
    if (accountId === null || currency === null) return notFound(c);
    const query = balanceHistoryQuerySchema.safeParse(c.req.query());
    if (!query.success) return invalidQuery(c);
    // An account that has never reported a balance has no history yet: an empty series.
    return c.json(balanceHistory(deps, accountId, query.data.days) ?? { currency, points: [] });
  });

  routes.get("/transactions", (c) => {
    const query = transactionQuerySchema.safeParse(c.req.query());
    return query.success ? c.json(listTransactions(deps, query.data)) : invalidQuery(c);
  });

  routes.get("/transactions/:transactionId", (c) => {
    const transactionId = parseId(c.req.param("transactionId"));
    const detail = transactionId === null ? null : getTransaction(deps, transactionId);
    return detail ? c.json(detail) : notFound(c);
  });

  routes.get("/cashflow", (c) => {
    const query = cashflowQuerySchema.safeParse(c.req.query());
    if (!query.success) return invalidQuery(c);
    const result = cashflow(deps, query.data);
    return result ? c.json(result) : c.body(null, 204);
  });

  routes.get("/summary", (c) => c.json(homeSummary(deps, deps.backup())));

  routes.get("/search", (c) => {
    const query = searchQuerySchema.safeParse(c.req.query());
    return query.success ? c.json(searchAll(deps, query.data.q)) : invalidQuery(c);
  });

  return routes;
}
```

Add this block above `main` (the output is one line of JSON with masked identifiers, counts and ISO dates: no account name, nickname, amount, remittance or full IBAN):

```ts
export interface BankingStatusReport {
  connections: {
    id: number;
    bank: string;
    country: string;
    status: string;
    validUntil: string;
    renewedAt: string | null;
    accounts: {
      id: number;
      masked: string;
      currency: string;
      status: string;
      transactions: number;
      pending: number;
      lastSyncedAt: string | null;
    }[];
  }[];
}

const iso = (epochMs: number | null): string | null =>
  epochMs === null ? null : new Date(epochMs).toISOString();

/**
 * What `bursar banking status` prints: connections and accounts with masked identifiers and
 * counts. No account names, nicknames, amounts or transaction text, and never a full IBAN.
 */
export function bankingStatus(
  repo: FinanceRepository,
  now: number,
  timeZone: string,
): BankingStatusReport {
  return {
    connections: repo.listConnections().map((connection) => ({
      id: connection.id,
      bank: connection.aspspName,
      country: connection.aspspCountry,
      status: effectiveConnectionStatus(connection.status, connection.validUntil, now, timeZone),
      validUntil: new Date(connection.validUntil).toISOString(),
      renewedAt: iso(connection.renewedAt),
      accounts: repo.listAccounts({ connectionId: connection.id }).map((account) => {
        const counts = repo.countTransactions(account.id);
        return {
          id: account.id,
          masked: account.maskedIdentifier ?? `•••• ${account.last4 ?? "••••"}`,
          currency: account.currency,
          status: account.status,
          transactions: counts.total,
          pending: counts.pending,
          lastSyncedAt: iso(account.lastSyncedAt),
        };
      }),
    })),
  };
}

/** `bursar banking status [--data-dir <dir>]`: prints the report as one line of JSON. */
export function bankingCommand(
  args: string[],
  log: (line: string) => void = console.log,
  env: Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env,
  now: () => number = Date.now,
): number {
  const [subcommand, ...rest] = args;
  if (subcommand !== "status") {
    log(BANKING_USAGE);
    return 2;
  }
  let dataDir: string | undefined;
  const flag = rest.indexOf("--data-dir");
  if (flag >= 0) {
    dataDir = rest[flag + 1];
    if (!dataDir) {
      log(BANKING_USAGE);
      return 2;
    }
  }

  let config: ReturnType<typeof loadConfig>;
  try {
    config = loadConfig(dataDir ? { ...env, BURSAR_DATA_DIR: dataDir } : env);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof ConfigError) {
      log(error.message);
      return 1;
    }
    throw error;
  }

  const file = path.join(config.dataDir, "bursar.db");
  if (!existsSync(file)) {
    log(`No database found in ${config.dataDir}`);
    return 1;
  }
  let database: OpenedDatabase;
  try {
    database = openDatabase(file, deriveKey(config.masterKey, "database").toString("hex"));
  } catch (error) {
    log(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
    return 1;
  }
  try {
    const report = bankingStatus(new FinanceRepository(database.db, now), now(), config.timezone);
    log(JSON.stringify(report));
    return 0;
  } catch (error) {
    log(
      `Cannot read the banking status: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`,
    );
    return 1;
  } finally {
    database.close();
  }
}
```

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: Tasks 2–5 (tokens, primitives, registry, shell, QA); shared `HomeSummary`, `HomeAlert`, `CashFlowResponse`, `CashFlowBucket`, `SettingsResponse`, `ServerEvent`, `serverEventSchema`; server `GET /api/summary`, `GET /api/settings`, `GET /api/events`.
- Produces:
  - `api.ts`: `api.summary(): Promise<HomeSummary>`; `api.settings(): Promise<SettingsResponse>`.
  - `useSettingsQuery(): UseQueryResult<SettingsResponse>` (key `queryKeys.settings`, `staleTime` 5 min).
  - `AppShell` wiring: `FormatProvider timeZone={settings.system.timezone}`; when `settings.values.locale` differs from `i18n.language`, call `setLanguage(locale)` once after load; `useLiveEvents()` mounted once.
  - `useLiveEvents(): void`: `EventSource("/api/events")` (same origin, cookies), parses each event with `serverEventSchema` (ignores invalid), reconnects with backoff 1 s → 30 s; on error checks `queryKeys.authStatus` (401 handling is the query client's). Invalidation map: `sync.started` → patch `connections` cache (`syncInProgress: true`) and invalidate `account(id)`; `sync.progress` → no network call; `sync.finished` → invalidate `connections`, `account(id)`, `summary`, every `["transactions"]`, every `["cashflow"]`, `notifications`, and show a toast (`succeeded` → success "Sync completed" with the account name and inserted count (plural); `skipped` with `rate_limited` → warning with the retry time; `daily_cap` → warning; `failed` → error with a translated `errorCode` or a generic message); `connection.updated` → invalidate `connections`, `summary`, `["accounts"]`; `notification.created` → invalidate `notifications`, `summary`; `backup.finished` → invalidate `backups`, `summary`; `settings.updated` → invalidate `settings`.
  - `CashFlowStrip` props: `{ buckets: CashFlowBucket[]; currency: string; variant: "full" | "mini" | "aggregate"; showBalance?: boolean; highlightNegativeNet: boolean; selectedDate?: LocalDate | null; onSelectBucket?: (bucket: CashFlowBucket) => void; height?: number; summaryLabel: string }` (Recharts `ComposedChart`: inflow bars `positive` above zero, outflow bars `ink` below zero (outflows plotted as negative), optional running-balance line, zero line; `mini` has no axes/tooltip (account cards, 30 days); `full` (Home) shows axes, tooltip with formatted money and privacy masking, balance line; `aggregate` (Transactions) shows bars only, selectable; negative net bucket and negative balance use `danger` only per `amountTone`; colours from CSS variables through `chart-colors.ts`; an `sr-only` text summary; keyboard: buckets are focusable buttons in an overlay list for `onSelectBucket`).
  - `NetChip` props `{ netMinor: number; currency: string }` ("+470 €" with an up/down arrow icon, tone from `amountTone(net, "net")`, privacy-aware).
  - Home: route `home` stays shipped; i18n prefixes `home.*`, `cashflow.*`, `live.*`, `alerts.*`, `consent.*`, `freshness.*`, `status.connection.*`, `status.account.*`, `syncErrors.*` (translations for known `errorCode`/`code` values).

**Additions to the contract (additive; every name above keeps its exact signature):**
- `api.ts` also gets `api.cashflow(params: { accountId?: number; from?: string; to?: string; currency?: string }): Promise<CashFlowResponse | null>` with exactly the signature the skeleton gives Task 19 (204 → `null`). Home needs it for the currency switch. Task 19 reuses it and must not add it a second time.
- `NetChip` takes an optional third prop `highlightNegativeNet?: boolean` (default `true`), so callers can honour the "highlight negative net" setting; with the two contract props it behaves exactly as specified.
- `useSettingsQuery.ts` also exports `SETTINGS_STALE_MS = 300_000` and `useLocaleSync(settings: SettingsResponse | undefined): void` (the "once after load" language sync, used by `AppShell`). The query function validates the response with `settingsResponseSchema` (Task 8), so a malformed response becomes a query error instead of a crash in the shell.
- `useLiveEvents.ts` also exports `LiveEvents` (a component that only calls `useLiveEvents()`; `AppShell` renders it inside `FormatProvider` so toasts use the server time zone), `EVENTS_URL`, `RECONNECT_MIN_MS`, `RECONNECT_MAX_MS`, `reconnectDelay(failures: number): number`, `applyServerEvent(event: ServerEvent, ctx: LiveContext): void`, `interface LiveContext`, `accountNameFromCache(queryClient, accountId): string | null` and `syncErrorText(t, code): string` (Task 18 reuses the last one for the 409 toasts of "Sync now").
- `CashFlowStrip.tsx` also exports `toChartRows(buckets)` and `STRIP_HEIGHT` (`{ full: 220, mini: 40, aggregate: 96 }`). `chart-colors.ts` holds every chart helper that must not pull Recharts into the main bundle: `type ChartVariant`, `interface ChartRow`, `interface ChartColors`, `tokenColor`, `readChartColors`, `useChartColors`, `toneColor`, `CHART_LAYOUT`, `overlayInset`, `dayMonthLabel`, `bucketLabel`.
- New `apps/web/src/app/ShippedLink.tsx`: `ShippedLink` props `{ route: RouteId; params?: Record<string, string | number>; search?: Record<string, string>; hash?: string; className?: string; plainClassName?: string; whenUnshipped?: "plain" | "hide"; children: ReactNode }` and `isRouteShipped(route: RouteId): boolean`. It renders a router `Link` to `buildPath(route, params, search)` (+ `#hash`) when the route is shipped, otherwise plain text (`"plain"`, default) or nothing (`"hide"`). Tasks 18–22 get working Home links automatically when they flip `shipped`.
- New i18n keys follow the Task 2 plural convention: Italian plural keys carry `_one`, `_many` and `_other`, English `_one` and `_other`.

**Contract deviations (all also reported to the plan reviewer):**
- Hidden until shipped: when this task runs, only `home` is shipped. Every Home link the Requirements ask for (`/accounts`, `/accounts/<id>`, `/transactions?…`, `/settings#backups`) targets a route that ships in Tasks 18–22. The global rule "no link to a missing route" wins: those links go through `ShippedLink` and render as plain text (KPI tiles, account rows, the summary sentence) or not at all (alert actions, "See N transactions on …") until their route ships. The Home tests mock `routeById` to report every route as shipped, so they check the final hrefs and stay green as later tasks flip the flags; `ShippedLink.test.tsx` covers the unshipped behaviour with `documents`, which never ships in M1.
- `full` variant has no visible Y axis. Global Constraints require every displayed amount to go through `formatMoney`; full-precision tick labels ("−1.500,00 €") do not fit a phone, and compact ticks would break that rule. Values are available in the tooltip, the keyboard labels and the screen-reader summary. The X axis (dates) is shown.
- The tooltip is not Recharts' `<Tooltip>`: the keyboard overlay buttons sit above the plot (they must, to receive clicks), so the strip renders its own tooltip for the hovered or focused bucket. It is masked in privacy mode like everything else.
- Sign convention (Task 16, JSDoc on `CashFlowBucket`): `inMinor` and `outMinor` are non-negative magnitudes and `netMinor = inMinor - outMinor`. The fixtures of this task follow it. The components still plot `-Math.abs(outMinor)` and show `Math.abs(outMinor)`, which is the same value for API data.
- `sync.finished` carries the trigger (Task 7 schema, set by Task 13) but not the account name. The toast takes the name from the `connections`, `account(id)` or `summary` cache (fallback "Account"/"Conto"). A `background` success shows no toast (the 06:00 daily sync would otherwise toast once per account); background failures and skips still toast. Reading the trigger from the event, not from a remembered `sync.started`, keeps this right when the panel connects or reconnects in the middle of a sync.
- The locale sync follows the contract (server locale wins once per page load). Consequence for Task 4's `UserMenu` / Task 22: a language picked in the user menu survives a reload only if it is also saved to `PATCH /api/settings` `{ locale }`. Task 22 (Step 10) makes the user-menu language switch patch the setting.
- The HomePage empty-state test asserts there is no button at all; Task 20 changes that assertion when it adds "Connect a bank".

**Notes for the implementer:**
- `<prefix>` is the Global Constraints shell prefix. The plan parts of Tasks 3 and 4 were not available when this task was written: the code below uses only their contract names (`Button`, `Cascade`, `DeadlineChip`, `EmptyState`, `InlineEmpty`, `MaskedIban`, `Money`, `StatusPill` from `components/ui`; `FormatProvider`, `useFormatters` from `lib/format.tsx`; `useUrlState`; `queryKeys`; `routeById`, `buildPath`, `RouteId`; `request<T>` inside `api.ts`). Step 1 checks they exist. If a prop name differs from the contract, keep this task's behaviour and adapt the call, and record it in the commit body.
- Components never set colours outside the semantic utilities (Task 2's `rules.test.ts` fails on palette colours or hex literals). Chart colours are read at runtime from the CSS variables of `tokens.css` and re-read when `data-theme` changes.
- No amount arithmetic in floating point: sums use `sumMinor`; the only non-integer maths is pixel positions and chart scales.

```tsx
    expect(buttons.map((button) => button.tabIndex)).toEqual([-1, -1, 0]);
    expect(at(buttons, 0).getAttribute("aria-label")).toBe(
      "1 Nov: in €2,500.00, out €12.00, net +€2,488.00, 2 transactions",
    );

    at(buttons, 2).focus();
    fireEvent.keyDown(at(buttons, 2), { key: "ArrowLeft" });
    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(at(buttons, 1));
    fireEvent.keyDown(at(buttons, 1), { key: "Home" });
    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(at(buttons, 0));
    fireEvent.click(at(buttons, 0));
    expect(onSelect).toHaveBeenCalledWith(at(BUCKETS, 0));
  });

  it("marks the selected period as pressed and starts the tab order there", () => {
    renderStrip({ onSelectBucket: vi.fn(), selectedDate: "2026-11-02" });
    const buttons = periodButtons();
    expect(buttons.map((button) => button.getAttribute("aria-pressed"))).toEqual([
      "false",
      "true",
      "false",
    ]);
    expect(buttons.map((button) => button.tabIndex)).toEqual([-1, 0, -1]);
  });

  it("shows a tooltip with the figures of the focused period", () => {
    renderStrip({ onSelectBucket: vi.fn() });
    expect(screen.queryByText("+€2,488.00")).toBeNull();
    at(periodButtons(), 0).focus();
    expect(screen.getByText("+€2,488.00")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText("€7,488.00")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText("2 transactions")).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it("masks every amount in privacy mode", () => {
    useUi.setState({ privacy: true });
    renderStrip({ onSelectBucket: vi.fn() });
    const summary = screen.getByText(/^Cash flow, from/);
    expect(summary.textContent).toContain("•••••");
    expect(summary.textContent).not.toContain("€");
    expect(at(periodButtons(), 0).getAttribute("aria-label")).not.toContain("€");
  });

  it("renders the mini variant without the period list or the balance sentence", () => {
    renderStrip({ variant: "mini" });
    expect(screen.queryByRole("list")).toBeNull();
    const summary = screen.getByText(/^Cash flow, from/);
    expect(summary.textContent).not.toContain("Balance");
  });

  it("draws the chart once the lazily loaded module arrives", async () => {
    const { container } = renderStrip();
    await waitFor(() => expect(container.querySelector(".recharts-surface")).not.toBeNull());
  });
});
```

`apps/web/src/components/charts/NetChip.test.tsx`:

```tsx
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import i18n from "../../i18n";
import { FormatProvider } from "../../lib/format";
import { useUi } from "../../store/ui";
import { NetChip } from "./NetChip";

function chip(netMinor: number, highlightNegativeNet?: boolean) {
  render(
    <FormatProvider timeZone="Europe/Rome">
      <NetChip netMinor={netMinor} currency="EUR" highlightNegativeNet={highlightNegativeNet} />
    </FormatProvider>,
  );
  const root = document.querySelector("[data-net-chip]");
  if (!(root instanceof HTMLElement)) throw new Error("NetChip not rendered");
  return root;
}

beforeEach(async () => {
  await i18n.changeLanguage("en");
  useUi.setState({ privacy: false });
});

afterEach(() => {
  useUi.setState({ privacy: false });
});

describe("NetChip", () => {
  it("shows a positive net with a plus sign in the positive tone", () => {
    const root = chip(47_000);
    expect(screen.getByText("+€470.00")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(root.dataset.tone).toBe("positive");
    expect(root.className).toContain("text-positive");
    expect(screen.getByText("Net, last 30 days: +€470.00")).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it("shows a negative net in the danger tone by default", () => {
    const root = chip(-1_200);
    expect(screen.getByText("-€12.00")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(root.dataset.tone).toBe("danger");
  });

  it("uses the ink tone for a negative net when highlighting is off", () => {
    const root = chip(-1_200, false);
    expect(root.dataset.tone).toBe("ink");
    expect(root.className).toContain("text-ink");
  });

  it("shows a zero net as muted without a sign", () => {
    const root = chip(0);
    expect(screen.getByText("€0.00")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(root.dataset.tone).toBe("muted");
  });

  it("masks the amount in privacy mode", () => {
    useUi.setState({ privacy: true });
    const root = chip(47_000);
    expect(root.textContent).not.toContain("470");
    expect(screen.getByText("•••••")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText("Net, last 30 days: Amount hidden")).toBeTruthy();
  });
});
```

`apps/web/src/app/ShippedLink.test.tsx`:

```tsx
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import { MemoryRouter } from "react-router";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { isRouteShipped, ShippedLink } from "./ShippedLink";

describe("ShippedLink", () => {
  it("links to a shipped route with its search and hash", () => {
    render(
      <MemoryRouter>
        <ShippedLink route="home" search={{ day: "2026-11-05" }} hash="top">
          Home
        </ShippedLink>
      </MemoryRouter>,
    );
    expect(isRouteShipped("home")).toBe(true);
    expect(screen.getByRole("link", { name: "Home" }).getAttribute("href")).toBe(
      "/?day=2026-11-05#top",
    );
  });

  it("renders plain text for a route that is not shipped", () => {
    render(
      <MemoryRouter>
        <ShippedLink route="documents" className="link" plainClassName="plain">
          Documents
        </ShippedLink>
      </MemoryRouter>,
    );
    expect(isRouteShipped("documents")).toBe(false);
    expect(screen.queryByRole("link")).toBeNull();
    const text = screen.getByText("Documents");
    expect(text.tagName).toBe("SPAN");
    expect(text.className).toBe("plain");
  });

  it("renders nothing for an unshipped route when asked to hide", () => {
    render(
      <MemoryRouter>
        <ShippedLink route="documents" whenUnshipped="hide">
          Hidden action
        </ShippedLink>
      </MemoryRouter>,
    );
    expect(screen.queryByText("Hidden action")).toBeNull();
  });
});
```
