```ts
import type { LocalDate } from "@bursar/shared";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import type { AmountTone } from "../../lib/tones";

/*
 * Chart helpers shared by the cash-flow strip and its lazily loaded Recharts module:
 * colours read from the theme variables, layout constants and label formatters.
 * Nothing here imports Recharts, so the main bundle stays small.
 */

export type ChartVariant = "full" | "mini" | "aggregate";

/** One bucket as the chart draws it: inflow above zero, outflow below zero (always ≤ 0). */
export interface ChartRow {
  date: LocalDate;
  inflow: number;
  outflow: number;
  net: number;
  balance: number | null;
}

export interface ChartColors {
  positive: string;
  ink: string;
  danger: string;
  muted: string;
  primary: string;
  grid: string;
  surface: string;
}

const COLOR_VARIABLES: Record<keyof ChartColors, string> = {
  positive: "--positive",
  ink: "--ink",
  danger: "--danger",
  muted: "--muted",
  primary: "--primary",
  grid: "--border",
  surface: "--surface",
};

const TRIPLET = /^(\d{1,3})\s+(\d{1,3})\s+(\d{1,3})$/;

/**
 * tokens.css stores colours as RGB triplets ("21 128 61"). SVG attributes get a resolved
 * `rgb(…)` value; when the variable is not set (jsdom) the CSS reference is kept.
 */
export function tokenColor(value: string, variable: string): string {
  const match = TRIPLET.exec(value.trim());
  return match ? `rgb(${match[1]} ${match[2]} ${match[3]})` : `rgb(var(${variable}))`;
}

export function readChartColors(root: HTMLElement = document.documentElement): ChartColors {
  const style = getComputedStyle(root);
  const read = (name: keyof ChartColors) =>
    tokenColor(style.getPropertyValue(COLOR_VARIABLES[name]), COLOR_VARIABLES[name]);
  return {
    positive: read("positive"),
    ink: read("ink"),
    danger: read("danger"),
    muted: read("muted"),
    primary: read("primary"),
    grid: read("grid"),
    surface: read("surface"),
  };
}

/** Theme colours for SVG attributes, re-read whenever `data-theme` changes on <html>. */
export function useChartColors(): ChartColors {
  const [colors, setColors] = useState<ChartColors>(() => readChartColors());
  useEffect(() => {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    setColors(readChartColors(root));
    const observer = new MutationObserver(() => setColors(readChartColors(root)));
    observer.observe(root, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["data-theme"] });
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);
  return colors;
}

export function toneColor(colors: ChartColors, tone: AmountTone): string {
  switch (tone) {
    case "positive":
      return colors.positive;
    case "danger":
      return colors.danger;
    case "muted":
      return colors.muted;
    default:
      return colors.ink;
  }
}

export interface ChartLayout {
  margin: { top: number; right: number; bottom: number; left: number };
  /** Height reserved for the visible date axis; 0 when the axis is hidden. */
  xAxisHeight: number;
}

/** Shared by the chart and the keyboard overlay so that the overlay buttons sit on the bars. */
export const CHART_LAYOUT: Record<ChartVariant, ChartLayout> = {
  full: { margin: { top: 12, right: 8, bottom: 0, left: 8 }, xAxisHeight: 24 },
  aggregate: { margin: { top: 6, right: 4, bottom: 6, left: 4 }, xAxisHeight: 0 },
  mini: { margin: { top: 2, right: 0, bottom: 2, left: 0 }, xAxisHeight: 0 },
};

/** The plot area inside the chart box, in pixels from each edge. */
export function overlayInset(variant: ChartVariant): {
  top: number;
  right: number;
  bottom: number;
  left: number;
} {
  const { margin, xAxisHeight } = CHART_LAYOUT[variant];
  return {
    top: margin.top,
    right: margin.right,
    bottom: margin.bottom + xAxisHeight,
    left: margin.left,
  };
}

const dayMonthFormats = new Map<string, Intl.DateTimeFormat>();

/** "5 Nov" / "5 nov": a calendar date without the year, never shifted by a time zone. */
export function dayMonthLabel(date: LocalDate, locale: string): string {
  const [year, month, day] = date.split("-").map(Number);
  if (!year || !month || !day) return date;
  let format = dayMonthFormats.get(locale);
  if (!format) {
    format = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { timeZone: "UTC", day: "numeric", month: "short" });
    dayMonthFormats.set(locale, format);
  }
  return format.format(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day));
}

/** A day bucket is its date; a week or month bucket is its first and last day. */
export function bucketLabel(bucket: { date: LocalDate; end: LocalDate }, locale: string): string {
  if (bucket.date === bucket.end) return dayMonthLabel(bucket.date, locale);
  return `${dayMonthLabel(bucket.date, locale)} – ${dayMonthLabel(bucket.end, locale)}`;
}
```

`apps/web/src/components/charts/CashFlowChart.tsx` (default export, loaded with `React.lazy` only; the only file of the panel that imports Recharts in this task):

```tsx
import type { ReactElement } from "react";
import {
  Bar,
  Cell,
  ComposedChart,
  Line,
  ReferenceLine,
  ResponsiveContainer,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
} from "recharts";
import { amountTone } from "../../lib/tones";
import {
  CHART_LAYOUT,
  type ChartRow,
  type ChartVariant,
  dayMonthLabel,
  toneColor,
  useChartColors,
} from "./chart-colors";

export interface CashFlowChartProps {
  rows: ChartRow[];
  variant: ChartVariant;
  showBalance: boolean;
  highlightNegativeNet: boolean;
  selectedIndex: number | null;
  height: number;
  locale: string;
}

/** The props Recharts passes to a custom dot renderer that this chart reads. */
interface DotRenderProps {
  cx?: number;
  cy?: number;
  index?: number;
  payload?: ChartRow;
}

/**
 * Diverging bars around zero: inflows in the positive tone above, outflows in ink below.
 * Red appears only for a negative net (a dot per bucket, through amountTone) and for a
 * negative running balance (a dot on the balance line). The chart is decorative for
 * assistive technology: CashFlowStrip provides the text summary and the keyboard list.
 */
export default function CashFlowChart({
  rows,
  variant,
  showBalance,
  highlightNegativeNet,
  selectedIndex,
  height,
  locale,
}: CashFlowChartProps) {
  const colors = useChartColors();
  const layout = CHART_LAYOUT[variant];
  const opacity = (index: number) =>
    selectedIndex === null || selectedIndex === index ? 1 : 0.35;

  const netDot = ({ cx, cy, index, payload }: DotRenderProps): ReactElement => {
    const key = `net-${index ?? 0}`;
    if (cx === undefined || cy === undefined || !payload || payload.net === 0) {
      return <g key={key} />;
    }
    const tone = amountTone(payload.net, "net", { highlightNegativeNet });
    return (
      <circle
        key={key}
        cx={cx}
        cy={cy}
        r={3}
        fill={toneColor(colors, tone)}
        stroke={colors.surface}
        strokeWidth={1.5}
      />
    );
  };

  const balanceDot = ({ cx, cy, index, payload }: DotRenderProps): ReactElement => {
    const key = `balance-${index ?? 0}`;
    if (
      cx === undefined ||
      cy === undefined ||
      !payload ||
      payload.balance === null ||
      payload.balance >= 0
    ) {
      return <g key={key} />;
    }
    return <circle key={key} cx={cx} cy={cy} r={2.5} fill={colors.danger} />;
  };

  return (
    <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={height}>
      <ComposedChart
        data={rows}
        margin={layout.margin}
        stackOffset="sign"
        barCategoryGap={variant === "mini" ? "12%" : "24%"}
        accessibilityLayer={false}
      >
        <XAxis
          dataKey="date"
          hide={variant !== "full"}
          height={layout.xAxisHeight}
          tickLine={false}
          axisLine={false}
          tickMargin={6}
          minTickGap={24}
          tick={{ fill: colors.muted, fontSize: 12 }}
          tickFormatter={(value: string) => dayMonthLabel(value, locale)}
        />
        <YAxis yAxisId="flow" hide />
        <YAxis yAxisId="balance" orientation="right" hide domain={["dataMin", "dataMax"]} />
        <ReferenceLine yAxisId="flow" y={0} stroke={colors.grid} />
        <Bar
          yAxisId="flow"
          dataKey="inflow"
          stackId="flow"
          fill={colors.positive}
          isAnimationActive={false}
        >
          {rows.map((row, index) => (
            <Cell key={`in-${row.date}`} fillOpacity={opacity(index)} />
          ))}
        </Bar>
        <Bar
          yAxisId="flow"
          dataKey="outflow"
          stackId="flow"
          fill={colors.ink}
          isAnimationActive={false}
        >
          {rows.map((row, index) => (
            <Cell key={`out-${row.date}`} fillOpacity={opacity(index)} />
          ))}
        </Bar>
        {variant === "mini" ? null : (
          <Line
            yAxisId="flow"
            dataKey="net"
            stroke="none"
            dot={netDot}
            activeDot={false}
            isAnimationActive={false}
          />
        )}
        {showBalance ? (
          <Line
            yAxisId="balance"
            type="monotone"
            dataKey="balance"
            stroke={colors.primary}
            strokeWidth={2}
            dot={balanceDot}
            activeDot={false}
            connectNulls
            isAnimationActive={false}
          />
        ) : null}
      </ComposedChart>
    </ResponsiveContainer>
  );
}
```

`apps/web/src/components/charts/CashFlowStrip.tsx`:

```tsx
import { type CashFlowBucket, type LocalDate, sumMinor } from "@bursar/shared";
import {
  type CSSProperties,
  type KeyboardEvent,
  lazy,
  Suspense,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  useState,
} from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useFormatters } from "../../lib/format";
import { type AmountTone, amountTone, toneTextClass } from "../../lib/tones";
import { useUi } from "../../store/ui";
import { bucketLabel, type ChartRow, type ChartVariant, overlayInset } from "./chart-colors";

const CashFlowChart = lazy(() => import("./CashFlowChart"));

export interface CashFlowStripProps {
  buckets: CashFlowBucket[];
  currency: string;
  variant: "full" | "mini" | "aggregate";
  showBalance?: boolean;
  highlightNegativeNet: boolean;
  selectedDate?: LocalDate | null;
  onSelectBucket?: (bucket: CashFlowBucket) => void;
  height?: number;
  summaryLabel: string;
}

export const STRIP_HEIGHT: Record<ChartVariant, number> = { full: 220, mini: 40, aggregate: 96 };

/** `outMinor` is a non-negative magnitude (Task 16); outflows are plotted below zero. */
export function toChartRows(buckets: readonly CashFlowBucket[]): ChartRow[] {
  return buckets.map((bucket) => ({
    date: bucket.date,
    inflow: Math.abs(bucket.inMinor),
    outflow: -Math.abs(bucket.outMinor),
    net: bucket.netMinor,
    balance: bucket.balanceMinor,
  }));
}

function tooltipPosition(index: number, total: number): CSSProperties {
  const ratio = (index + 0.5) / Math.max(1, total);
  const shift = ratio < 0.2 ? "0%" : ratio > 0.8 ? "-100%" : "-50%";
  return { left: `${ratio * 100}%`, transform: `translateX(${shift})` };
}

function TooltipRow({ label, value, tone }: { label: string; value: string; tone: AmountTone }) {
  return (
    <p className="flex justify-between gap-4">
      <span className="text-muted">{label}</span>
      <span className={`tabular font-medium ${toneTextClass(tone)}`}>{value}</span>
    </p>
  );
}

/**
 * The iconic cash-flow strip (UX doc §3). `full` is the Home form (dates, balance line,
 * tooltip, selectable days), `aggregate` the Transactions form (bars only, selectable),
 * `mini` the account-card form (bars only, no interaction). Every form has a text summary
 * for screen readers, and every amount honours privacy mode.
 */
export function CashFlowStrip({
  buckets,
  currency,
  variant,
  showBalance,
  highlightNegativeNet,
  selectedDate = null,
  onSelectBucket,
  height,
  summaryLabel,
}: CashFlowStripProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { money, localDate, locale } = useFormatters();
  const privacy = useUi((state) => state.privacy);
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [focusIndex, setFocusIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const buttons = useRef<(HTMLButtonElement | null)[]>([]);
  const rows = useMemo(() => toChartRows(buckets), [buckets]);

  const withBalance = showBalance ?? variant === "full";
  const chartHeight = height ?? STRIP_HEIGHT[variant];
  const interactive = variant !== "mini" && buckets.length > 0;
  const selectedIndex = selectedDate ? buckets.findIndex((b) => b.date === selectedDate) : -1;
  const rovingIndex = focusIndex ?? (selectedIndex >= 0 ? selectedIndex : buckets.length - 1);
  const inset = overlayInset(variant);
  const insetStyle: CSSProperties = { ...inset };

  const format = (minor: number, sign: "auto" | "always" = "auto") =>
    money(minor, currency, { sign, masked: privacy });
  const netTone = (minor: number) => amountTone(minor, "net", { highlightNegativeNet });

  const first = buckets[0];
  const last = buckets[buckets.length - 1];
  let summary = t("cashflow.srEmpty", { label: summaryLabel });
  if (first && last) {
    summary = t("cashflow.srSummary", {
      label: summaryLabel,
      from: localDate(first.date, "medium"),
      to: localDate(last.end, "medium"),
      in: format(sumMinor(buckets.map((b) => Math.abs(b.inMinor)))),
      out: format(sumMinor(buckets.map((b) => Math.abs(b.outMinor)))),
      net: format(sumMinor(buckets.map((b) => b.netMinor)), "always"),
    });
    if (withBalance && last.balanceMinor !== null) {
      summary += ` ${t("cashflow.srBalance", { balance: format(last.balanceMinor) })}`;
    }
  }

  const bucketName = (bucket: CashFlowBucket) =>
    t("cashflow.bucket", {
      count: bucket.count,
      date: bucketLabel(bucket, locale),
      in: format(Math.abs(bucket.inMinor)),
      out: format(Math.abs(bucket.outMinor)),
      net: format(bucket.netMinor, "always"),
    });

  const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>, index: number) => {
    const lastIndex = buckets.length - 1;
    let target: number | null = null;
    if (event.key === "ArrowRight") target = index + 1;
    else if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") target = index - 1;
    else if (event.key === "Home") target = 0;
    else if (event.key === "End") target = lastIndex;
    if (target === null) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    const next = Math.max(0, Math.min(lastIndex, target));
    setFocusIndex(next);
    buttons.current[next]?.focus();
  };

  const active = activeIndex === null ? null : (buckets[activeIndex] ?? null);

  return (
    <figure aria-label={summaryLabel} className="relative m-0 w-full">
      <p className="sr-only">{summary}</p>
      <div className="relative w-full" style={{ height: chartHeight }}>
        <div aria-hidden="true" className="absolute inset-0">
          <Suspense fallback={<div className="h-full w-full animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-surface-2" />}>
            <CashFlowChart
              rows={rows}
              variant={variant}
              showBalance={withBalance}
              highlightNegativeNet={highlightNegativeNet}
              selectedIndex={selectedIndex >= 0 ? selectedIndex : null}
              height={chartHeight}
              locale={locale}
            />
          </Suspense>
        </div>
        {interactive ? (
          <ol
            aria-label={t("cashflow.periods", { label: summaryLabel })}
            className="absolute flex"
            style={insetStyle}
          >
            {buckets.map((bucket, index) => (
              <li key={bucket.date} className="flex min-w-0 flex-1">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  ref={(element) => {
                    buttons.current[index] = element;
                  }}
                  tabIndex={index === rovingIndex ? 0 : -1}
                  aria-label={bucketName(bucket)}
                  aria-pressed={onSelectBucket ? index === selectedIndex : undefined}
                  onClick={() => onSelectBucket?.(bucket)}
                  onKeyDown={(event) => onKeyDown(event, index)}
                  onFocus={() => {
                    setFocusIndex(index);
                    setActiveIndex(index);
                  }}
                  onBlur={() => setActiveIndex(null)}
                  onMouseEnter={() => setActiveIndex(index)}
                  onMouseLeave={() => setActiveIndex(null)}
                  className={`w-full rounded-md transition-colors ${
                    index === selectedIndex ? "bg-primary/10" : "hover:bg-fg/5"
                  }`}
                />
              </li>
            ))}
          </ol>
        ) : null}
        {interactive && active && activeIndex !== null ? (
          <div aria-hidden="true" className="pointer-events-none absolute" style={insetStyle}>
            <div
              className="absolute top-0 z-10 w-max max-w-56 rounded-xl border border-subtle bg-surface px-3 py-2 text-xs shadow-lg"
              style={tooltipPosition(activeIndex, buckets.length)}
            >
              <p className="mb-1 font-medium text-fg">{bucketLabel(active, locale)}</p>
              <TooltipRow
                label={t("cashflow.in")}
                value={format(Math.abs(active.inMinor))}
                tone={amountTone(Math.abs(active.inMinor))}
              />
              <TooltipRow
                label={t("cashflow.out")}
                value={format(Math.abs(active.outMinor))}
                tone={active.outMinor === 0 ? "muted" : "ink"}
              />
              <TooltipRow
                label={t("cashflow.net")}
                value={format(active.netMinor, "always")}
                tone={netTone(active.netMinor)}
              />
              {withBalance && active.balanceMinor !== null ? (
                <TooltipRow
                  label={t("cashflow.balance")}
                  value={format(active.balanceMinor)}
                  tone={amountTone(active.balanceMinor, "balance")}
                />
              ) : null}
              <p className="mt-1 text-muted">{t("cashflow.count", { count: active.count })}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </figure>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { ArrowDownRight, ArrowUpRight, Minus } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useFormatters } from "../../lib/format";
import { amountTone, toneTextClass } from "../../lib/tones";
import { useUi } from "../../store/ui";

export interface NetChipProps {
  netMinor: number;
  currency: string;
  /** The "highlight negative net" setting; default on, as in the settings defaults. */
  highlightNegativeNet?: boolean;
}

/** The mini form of the cash-flow element: the net of the last 30 days with a direction arrow. */
export function NetChip({ netMinor, currency, highlightNegativeNet = true }: NetChipProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { money } = useFormatters();
  const privacy = useUi((state) => state.privacy);
  const tone = amountTone(netMinor, "net", { highlightNegativeNet });
  const Icon = netMinor > 0 ? ArrowUpRight : netMinor < 0 ? ArrowDownRight : Minus;
  const amount = money(netMinor, currency, { sign: "always", masked: privacy });
  const label = t("cashflow.netChip", {
    amount: privacy ? t("privacy.maskedAmount") : amount,
  });
  return (
    <span
      data-net-chip=""
      data-tone={tone}
      title={label}
      className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-surface-2 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold tabular ${toneTextClass(tone)}`}
    >
      <Icon aria-hidden="true" size={14} strokeWidth={2.25} />
      <span className="sr-only">{label}</span>
      <span aria-hidden="true">{amount}</span>
    </span>
  );
}
```

`apps/web/src/app/ShippedLink.tsx`:

```tsx
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router";
import { buildPath, type RouteId, routeById } from "./routes";

export interface ShippedLinkProps {
  route: RouteId;
  params?: Record<string, string | number>;
  search?: Record<string, string>;
  hash?: string;
  className?: string;
  /** Classes for the plain-text rendering; defaults to `className`. */
  plainClassName?: string;
  /** What to render while the route is not shipped: its text (default) or nothing. */
  whenUnshipped?: "plain" | "hide";
  children: ReactNode;
}

export function isRouteShipped(route: RouteId): boolean {
  return routeById(route).shipped;
}

/**
 * "Hidden until shipped" for links: a link to a page that does not exist yet would be a
 * dead end, so it renders as text (or not at all) until its route is shipped.
 */
export function ShippedLink({
  route,
  params,
  search,
  hash,
  className,
  plainClassName,
  whenUnshipped = "plain",
  children,
}: ShippedLinkProps) {
  if (!isRouteShipped(route)) {
    if (whenUnshipped === "hide") return null;
    return <span className={plainClassName ?? className}>{children}</span>;
  }
  const path = buildPath(route, params, search);
  return (
    <Link to={hash ? `${path}#${hash}` : path} className={className}>
      {children}
    </Link>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { SETTINGS_DEFAULTS, type SettingsResponse } from "@bursar/shared";
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { act, renderHook, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import i18n from "../i18n";
import { useLocaleSync, useSettingsQuery } from "./useSettingsQuery";

function settingsWith(locale: "it" | "en"): SettingsResponse {
  return {
    values: { ...SETTINGS_DEFAULTS, locale },
    system: {
      timezone: "Europe/Rome",
      publicUrl: "https://bursar.example.test",
      enableBankingConfigured: true,
      smtpConfigured: false,
      backupTarget: "local",
    },
  };
}

function wrapper({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const client = new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false } } });
  return <QueryClientProvider client={client}>{children}</QueryClientProvider>;
}

function stubFetch(body: unknown) {
  const fetchMock = vi.fn(
    async (_input: RequestInfo | URL) =>
      new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
        status: 200,
        headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
      }),
  );
  vi.stubGlobal("fetch", fetchMock);
  return fetchMock;
}

beforeEach(async () => {
  await i18n.changeLanguage("en");
});

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  globalThis.localStorage.clear();
});

describe("useSettingsQuery", () => {
  it("loads the settings from /api/settings", async () => {
    const fetchMock = stubFetch(settingsWith("it"));
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useSettingsQuery(), { wrapper });
    await waitFor(() => expect(result.current.isSuccess).toBe(true));
    expect(result.current.data?.system.timezone).toBe("Europe/Rome");
    expect(String(fetchMock.mock.calls[0]?.[0])).toBe("/api/settings");
  });

  it("turns a malformed response into a query error instead of a crash", async () => {
    stubFetch({ values: {} });

    await waitFor(() => expect(result.current.isError).toBe(true));
  });
});

describe("useLocaleSync", () => {
  it("applies the server language once, after the settings arrive", async () => {
    const { rerender } = renderHook(
      ({ settings }: { settings: SettingsResponse | undefined }) => useLocaleSync(settings),
      { initialProps: { settings: undefined as SettingsResponse | undefined } },
    );
    expect(i18n.language).toBe("en");

    rerender({ settings: settingsWith("it") });
    await waitFor(() => expect(i18n.language).toBe("it"));

    await act(async () => {
      await i18n.changeLanguage("en");
    });
    rerender({ settings: settingsWith("it") });
    expect(i18n.language).toBe("en");
  });
});
```

```tsx
import type { AccountSummary, ConnectionsResponse } from "@bursar/shared";

import { RECONNECT_MAX_MS, reconnectDelay, useLiveEvents } from "./useLiveEvents";

vi.mock("../components/feedback", () => ({ feedback: vi.fn() }));

type Listener = (event: MessageEvent) => void;

/** Stands in for the browser EventSource; tests push named events with `emit`. */
class FakeEventSource {
  static instances: FakeEventSource[] = [];
  readonly url: string;
  closed = false;
  onerror: ((event: Event) => void) | null = null;
  private readonly listeners = new Map<string, Listener[]>();

  constructor(url: string | URL) {
    this.url = String(url);
    FakeEventSource.instances.push(this);
  }

  static latest(): FakeEventSource {
    const source = FakeEventSource.instances.at(-1);
    if (!source) throw new Error("No EventSource was opened");
    return source;
  }

  addEventListener(type: string, listener: Listener): void {
    this.listeners.set(type, [...(this.listeners.get(type) ?? []), listener]);
  }

  removeEventListener(): void {}

  close(): void {
    this.closed = true;
  }

  emit(type: string, data: unknown): void {
    const message = new MessageEvent(type, {
      data: typeof data === "string" ? data : JSON.stringify(data),
    });
    for (const listener of this.listeners.get(type) ?? []) listener(message);
  }

  fail(): void {
    this.onerror?.(new Event("error"));
  }
}
```

`apps/web/src/app/useSettingsQuery.ts`:

```ts
import { type SettingsResponse, settingsResponseSchema } from "@bursar/shared";
import { type UseQueryResult, useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { api } from "../api";
import i18n, { setLanguage } from "../i18n";
import { queryKeys } from "../lib/query-keys";

export const SETTINGS_STALE_MS = 5 * 60_000;

/**
 * Server settings (values and deployment facts). The response is validated so that a
 * malformed answer becomes a query error, never a crash in the shell.
 */
export function useSettingsQuery(): UseQueryResult<SettingsResponse> {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.settings,
    queryFn: async () => settingsResponseSchema.parse(await api.settings()),
    staleTime: SETTINGS_STALE_MS,
  });
}

/** Applies the server's language once per page load, after the settings first arrive. */
export function useLocaleSync(settings: SettingsResponse | undefined): void {
  const done = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (done.current || !settings) return;
    done.current = true;
    if (settings.values.locale !== i18n.language) setLanguage(settings.values.locale);
  }, [settings]);
}
```

`apps/web/src/app/useLiveEvents.ts`:

```ts
import {
  type AccountDetailResponse,
  type ConnectionsResponse,
  type HomeSummary,
  SERVER_EVENT_TYPES,
  type ServerEvent,
  serverEventSchema,
} from "@bursar/shared";
import { type QueryClient, type QueryKey, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import type { TFunction } from "i18next";
import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { feedback } from "../components/feedback";
import { useFormatters } from "../lib/format";
import { queryKeys } from "../lib/query-keys";

export const EVENTS_URL = "/api/events";
export const RECONNECT_MIN_MS = 1_000;
export const RECONNECT_MAX_MS = 30_000;

type SyncFinishedEvent = Extract<ServerEvent, { type: "sync.finished" }>;

export interface LiveContext {
  queryClient: QueryClient;
  t: TFunction;
  /** Absolute date and time in the server time zone. */
  formatTime(at: number): string;
}

/** 1 s, 2 s, 4 s … capped at 30 s; `failures` counts consecutive stream errors (≥ 1). */
export function reconnectDelay(failures: number): number {
  return Math.min(RECONNECT_MAX_MS, RECONNECT_MIN_MS * 2 ** Math.max(0, failures - 1));
}

/** Everything that may have changed while the stream was down. */
const RESYNC_KEYS: readonly QueryKey[] = [
  queryKeys.connections,
  queryKeys.summary,
  ["accounts"],
  ["transactions"],
  ["cashflow"],
  queryKeys.notifications,
  queryKeys.backups,
];

function invalidate(queryClient: QueryClient, keys: readonly QueryKey[]): void {
  for (const queryKey of keys) void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey });
}

/** The account name as the panel last saw it; events carry ids only. */
export function accountNameFromCache(queryClient: QueryClient, accountId: number): string | null {
  const connections = queryClient.getQueryData<ConnectionsResponse>(queryKeys.connections);
  for (const connection of connections?.connections ?? []) {
    const match = connection.accounts.find((account) => account.id === accountId);
    if (match) return match.name;
  }
  const detail = queryClient.getQueryData<AccountDetailResponse>(queryKeys.account(accountId));
  if (detail) return detail.account.name;
  const summary = queryClient.getQueryData<HomeSummary>(queryKeys.summary);
  return summary?.accounts.find((account) => account.id === accountId)?.name ?? null;
}

/** Translated text for an Enable Banking error code or a Bursar skip/error code. */
export function syncErrorText(t: TFunction, code: string | null): string {
  const generic = t("syncErrors.generic");
  if (!code || !/^[A-Za-z_]+$/.test(code)) return generic;
  return t(`syncErrors.${code}`, { defaultValue: generic });
}

function withSyncing<T extends { id: number; syncInProgress: boolean }>(
  accounts: T[],
  accountId: number,
): T[] {
  return accounts.map((account) =>
    account.id === accountId ? { ...account, syncInProgress: true } : account,
  );
}

function markSyncing(queryClient: QueryClient, accountId: number): void {
  queryClient.setQueryData<ConnectionsResponse>(queryKeys.connections, (old) =>
    old
      ? {
          ...old,
          connections: old.connections.map((connection) => ({
            ...connection,
            accounts: withSyncing(connection.accounts, accountId),
          })),
        }
      : old,
  );
  queryClient.setQueryData<HomeSummary>(queryKeys.summary, (old) =>
    old ? { ...old, accounts: withSyncing(old.accounts, accountId) } : old,
  );
}

function notifySyncFinished(event: SyncFinishedEvent, ctx: LiveContext): void {
  const { t } = ctx;
  const account =
    accountNameFromCache(ctx.queryClient, event.accountId) ?? t("live.unknownAccount");
  if (event.status === "succeeded") {
    // The 06:00 daily sync would otherwise toast once per account.
    if (event.trigger === "background") return;
    feedback(
      t("live.syncCompleted"),
      event.inserted > 0
        ? t("live.syncCompletedDetail", { account, count: event.inserted })
        : t("live.syncNoNew", { account }),
      "success",
    );
    return;
  }
  if (event.status === "skipped") {
    if (event.skipReason === "rate_limited") {
      feedback(
        t("live.rateLimited"),
        event.retryAt === null
          ? t("live.rateLimitedNoTime", { account })
          : t("live.rateLimitedDetail", { account, time: ctx.formatTime(event.retryAt) }),
        "warning",
      );
      return;
    }
    if (event.skipReason === "daily_cap") {
      feedback(t("live.dailyCap"), t("live.dailyCapDetail", { account }), "warning");
      return;
    }
    feedback(
      t("live.syncSkipped"),
      t("live.syncSkippedDetail", { account, reason: syncErrorText(t, event.skipReason) }),
      "warning",
    );
    return;
  }
  feedback(
    t("live.syncFailed"),
    t("live.syncFailedDetail", { account, reason: syncErrorText(t, event.errorCode) }),
    "error",
  );
}

/** The invalidation map of the live panel (one place, tested event by event). */
export function applyServerEvent(event: ServerEvent, ctx: LiveContext): void {
  const { queryClient } = ctx;
  switch (event.type) {
    case "sync.started":
      markSyncing(queryClient, event.accountId);
      invalidate(queryClient, [queryKeys.account(event.accountId)]);
      return;
    case "sync.progress":
      return;
    case "sync.finished": {
      invalidate(queryClient, [
        queryKeys.connections,
        queryKeys.account(event.accountId),
        queryKeys.summary,
        ["transactions"],
        ["cashflow"],
        queryKeys.notifications,
      ]);
      notifySyncFinished(event, ctx);
      return;
    }
    case "connection.updated":
      invalidate(queryClient, [queryKeys.connections, queryKeys.summary, ["accounts"]]);
      return;
    case "notification.created":
      invalidate(queryClient, [queryKeys.notifications, queryKeys.summary]);
      return;
    case "backup.finished":
      invalidate(queryClient, [queryKeys.backups, queryKeys.summary]);
      return;
    case "settings.updated":
      invalidate(queryClient, [queryKeys.settings]);
      return;
  }
}

/**
 * Keeps the panel in step with the server over GET /api/events (server-sent events).
 * Mount once, inside FormatProvider (AppShell renders <LiveEvents />).
 */
export function useLiveEvents(): void {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { absolute } = useFormatters();
  const latest = useRef({ t, absolute });

  useEffect(() => {
    latest.current = { t, absolute };
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof EventSource === "undefined") return;
    const ctx: LiveContext = {
      queryClient,
      get t() {
        return latest.current.t;
      },
      formatTime: (at) => latest.current.absolute(at, true),
    };
    let source: EventSource | null = null;
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
    let failures = 0;
    let missedEvents = false;
    let stopped = false;

    const onEvent = (message: MessageEvent) => {
      if (typeof message.data !== "string") return;
      let data: unknown;
      try {
        data = JSON.parse(message.data);
      } catch {
        return;
      }
      const parsed = serverEventSchema.safeParse(data);
      if (!parsed.success || parsed.data.type !== message.type) return;
      applyServerEvent(parsed.data, ctx);
    };

    const onReady = () => {
      failures = 0;
      if (missedEvents) {
        missedEvents = false;
        invalidate(queryClient, RESYNC_KEYS);
      }
    };

    const connect = () => {
      if (stopped) return;
      const stream = new EventSource(EVENTS_URL);
      source = stream;
      stream.addEventListener("ready", onReady);
      for (const type of SERVER_EVENT_TYPES) stream.addEventListener(type, onEvent);
      stream.onerror = () => {
        stream.close();
        source = null;
        failures += 1;
        missedEvents = true;
        // A stream that fails because the session ended: the auth status query notices
        // and RequireAuth sends the owner to the login page.
        void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.authStatus });
        timer = setTimeout(connect, reconnectDelay(failures));
      };
    };

    connect();
    return () => {
      stopped = true;
      if (timer !== null) clearTimeout(timer);
      source?.close();
    };
  }, [queryClient]);
}

/** Mount point for useLiveEvents inside the shell's providers. */
export function LiveEvents(): null {
  useLiveEvents();
  return null;
}
```

```tsx
function cashflowFor(currency: string, currencies: string[], activity: Activity): CashFlowResponse {
  const buckets: CashFlowBucket[] = [];
  let balance = 500_000;
  for (let day = 0; day < 30; day += 1) {
    const date = addDays("2026-10-11", day);

      date,
      end: date,
      inMinor: flow.in,
      outMinor: flow.out,
      netMinor: flow.in - flow.out,
      count: flow.count,
      balanceMinor: balance,
    });
  }
  const sum = (pick: (bucket: CashFlowBucket) => number) =>
    buckets.reduce((total, bucket) => total + pick(bucket), 0);

      netMinor: sum((b) => b.netMinor),

  };
```

```tsx
import type { HomeAlert } from "@bursar/shared";
import { CircleAlert, CircleCheck, Info, type LucideIcon, TriangleAlert } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import type { RouteId } from "../../app/routes";
import { ShippedLink } from "../../app/ShippedLink";
import { InlineEmpty } from "../../components/ui";
import { useFormatters } from "../../lib/format";
import { CONSENT_THRESHOLDS } from "../../lib/thresholds";

export type AlertSeverity = "danger" | "warning" | "info";

export function alertSeverity(alert: HomeAlert): AlertSeverity {
  switch (alert.kind) {
    case "consent_expired":
    case "connection_error":
    case "sync_failing":
    case "backup_failing":
      return "danger";
    case "consent_expiring":
      return alert.days <= CONSENT_THRESHOLDS.dangerDays ? "danger" : "warning";
    case "rate_limited":
      return "warning";
    default:
      return "info";
  }
}

const SEVERITY_RANK: Record<AlertSeverity, number> = { danger: 0, warning: 1, info: 2 };
const KIND_RANK: Record<HomeAlert["kind"], number> = {
  consent_expired: 0,
  connection_error: 1,
  sync_failing: 2,
  consent_expiring: 3,
  backup_failing: 4,
  rate_limited: 5,
  backup_local_only: 6,
};

/** Most urgent first: severity, then kind, then the nearest consent expiry. */
export function sortAlerts(alerts: readonly HomeAlert[]): HomeAlert[] {
  const days = (alert: HomeAlert) => (alert.kind === "consent_expiring" ? alert.days : 0);
  return [...alerts].sort(
    (a, b) =>
      SEVERITY_RANK[alertSeverity(a)] - SEVERITY_RANK[alertSeverity(b)] ||
      KIND_RANK[a.kind] - KIND_RANK[b.kind] ||
      days(a) - days(b),
  );
}

export interface AlertTarget {
  route: RouteId;
  params?: Record<string, number>;
  hash?: string;
}

/** Where each alert is fixed. */
export function alertTarget(alert: HomeAlert): AlertTarget {
  switch (alert.kind) {
    case "consent_expiring":
    case "consent_expired":
    case "connection_error":
      return { route: "accounts" };
    case "sync_failing":
    case "rate_limited":
      return { route: "account", params: { accountId: alert.accountId } };
    default:
      return { route: "settings", hash: "backups" };
  }
}

export interface AlertCopy {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  action: string;
}

export function useAlertCopy(): (alert: HomeAlert) => AlertCopy {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { relative, absolute } = useFormatters();
  return (alert) => {
    switch (alert.kind) {
      case "consent_expiring":
        return {
          title:
            alert.days <= 0
              ? t("alerts.consentExpiresToday", { bank: alert.bankName })
              : t("alerts.consentExpiring", { bank: alert.bankName, count: alert.days }),
          description: t("alerts.consentExpiringDetail"),
          action: t("alerts.renewConsent"),
        };
      case "consent_expired":
        return {
          title: t("alerts.consentExpired", { bank: alert.bankName }),
          description: t("alerts.consentExpiredDetail"),
          action: t("alerts.renewConsent"),
        };
      case "connection_error":
        return {
          title: t("alerts.connectionError", { bank: alert.bankName }),
          description: t("alerts.connectionErrorDetail"),
          action: t("alerts.reviewConnection"),
        };
      case "sync_failing":
        return {
          title: t("alerts.syncFailing", { account: alert.accountName }),
          description:
            alert.since === null
              ? t("alerts.syncFailingNeverDetail")
              : t("alerts.syncFailingDetail", { when: relative(alert.since) }),
          action: t("alerts.openAccount"),
        };
      case "rate_limited":
        return {
          title: t("alerts.rateLimited", {
            account: alert.accountName,
            time: absolute(alert.until, true),
          }),
          description: t("alerts.rateLimitedDetail"),
          action: t("alerts.openAccount"),
        };
      case "backup_local_only":
        return {
          title: t("alerts.backupLocalOnly"),
          description: t("alerts.backupLocalOnlyDetail"),
          action: t("alerts.openBackups"),
        };
      case "backup_failing":
        return {
          title: t("alerts.backupFailing", { count: alert.failures }),
          description: t("alerts.backupFailingDetail"),
          action: t("alerts.openBackups"),
        };
    }
  };
}

function alertKey(alert: HomeAlert): string {
  switch (alert.kind) {
    case "consent_expiring":
    case "consent_expired":
    case "connection_error":
      return `${alert.kind}-${alert.connectionId}`;
    case "sync_failing":
    case "rate_limited":
      return `${alert.kind}-${alert.accountId}`;
    default:
      return alert.kind;
  }
}

const SEVERITY_STYLE: Record<AlertSeverity, { icon: LucideIcon; classes: string }> = {
  danger: { icon: CircleAlert, classes: "text-danger bg-danger-soft" },
  warning: { icon: TriangleAlert, classes: "text-warning bg-warning-soft" },
  info: { icon: Info, classes: "text-info bg-info-soft" },
};

/** Home alert list: most urgent first, each with the action that fixes it. */
export function AlertList({ alerts }: { alerts: readonly HomeAlert[] }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const copy = useAlertCopy();
  const sorted = sortAlerts(alerts);
  return (
    <section
      aria-labelledby="home-alerts"
      className="rounded-2xl border border-subtle bg-surface p-4 sm:p-6"
    >
      <h2 id="home-alerts" className="font-display text-base font-semibold text-fg">
        {t("home.alerts.title")}
      </h2>
      {sorted.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="mt-4">
          <InlineEmpty icon={CircleCheck} title={t("home.alerts.empty")} />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <ul className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-3">
          {sorted.map((alert) => {
            const style = SEVERITY_STYLE[alertSeverity(alert)];
            const Icon = style.icon;
            const text = copy(alert);
            const target = alertTarget(alert);
            return (
              <li key={alertKey(alert)} className="flex gap-3 rounded-xl bg-surface-2 p-3">
                <span
                  className={`flex size-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full ${style.classes}`}
                >
                  <Icon aria-hidden="true" size={16} strokeWidth={2} />
                </span>
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-fg">{text.title}</p>
                  <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-muted">{text.description}</p>
                  <ShippedLink
                    route={target.route}
                    params={target.params}
                    hash={target.hash}
                    whenUnshipped="hide"
                    className="mt-2 inline-flex min-h-6 items-center text-xs font-medium text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline"
                  >
                    {text.action}
                  </ShippedLink>
                </div>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
```

`apps/web/src/pages/home/Greeting.tsx`:

```tsx
import {
  formatLocalDate,
  type HomeAlert,
  type HomeSummary,
  localTimeOfDay,
  toLocalDate,
} from "@bursar/shared";
import { CircleCheck } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { ShippedLink } from "../../app/ShippedLink";
import { useFormatters } from "../../lib/format";
import { alertSeverity, alertTarget, sortAlerts, useAlertCopy } from "./AlertList";

export type GreetingPeriod = "morning" | "afternoon" | "evening";

export function greetingPeriod(now: number, timeZone: string): GreetingPeriod {
  const hour = Number(localTimeOfDay(now, timeZone).slice(0, 2));
  if (hour >= 5 && hour < 12) return "morning";
  if (hour >= 12 && hour < 18) return "afternoon";
  return "evening";
}

export type SummaryStatus =
  | { kind: "attention"; count: number; top: HomeAlert }
  | { kind: "allGood" }
  | { kind: "calm"; oldest: number | null }
  | { kind: "none" };

/** The one-sentence summary: urgent alerts first (info alerts never block "All good"). */
export function summaryStatus(summary: HomeSummary, now: number, timeZone: string): SummaryStatus {
  if (!summary.hasConnections || summary.accounts.length === 0) return { kind: "none" };
  const urgent = sortAlerts(summary.alerts).filter((alert) => alertSeverity(alert) !== "info");
  const top = urgent[0];
  if (top) return { kind: "attention", count: urgent.length, top };
  const today = toLocalDate(now, timeZone);
  const synced = summary.accounts.map((account) => account.lastSyncedAt);
  if (synced.every((at) => at !== null && toLocalDate(at, timeZone) === today)) {
    return { kind: "allGood" };
  }
  const known = synced.filter((at): at is number => at !== null);
  return { kind: "calm", oldest: known.length === synced.length ? Math.min(...known) : null };
}

function SummarySentence({ status }: { status: SummaryStatus }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { relative } = useFormatters();
  const copy = useAlertCopy();
  switch (status.kind) {
    case "attention": {
      const target = alertTarget(status.top);
      return (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted sm:text-base">
          <span>{t("home.summary.attention", { count: status.count })}</span>{" "}
          <ShippedLink
            route={target.route}
            params={target.params}
            hash={target.hash}
            className="font-medium text-primary underline underline-offset-4"
            plainClassName="font-medium text-fg"
          >
            {copy(status.top).title}
          </ShippedLink>
        </p>
      );
    }
    case "allGood":
      return (
        <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-positive sm:text-base">
          <CircleCheck aria-hidden="true" size={16} strokeWidth={2} />
          <span>{t("home.summary.allGood")}</span>
        </p>
      );
    case "calm":
      return (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted sm:text-base">
          {status.oldest === null
            ? t("home.summary.calmNever")
            : t("home.summary.calm", { when: relative(status.oldest) })}
        </p>
      );
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

/** Greeting with the local date and, once the summary is in, what needs attention. */
export function Greeting({ summary }: { summary: HomeSummary | undefined }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { locale, timeZone, now } = useFormatters();
  const current = now();
  const today = formatLocalDate(toLocalDate(current, timeZone), locale, {
    style: "long",
    weekday: true,
  });
  const status = summary ? summaryStatus(summary, current, timeZone) : null;
  return (
    <header className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
      <p className="text-sm text-muted first-letter:uppercase">{today}</p>
      <h1 className="font-display text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-fg sm:text-3xl">
        {t(`home.greeting.${greetingPeriod(current, timeZone)}`)}
      </h1>
      {status ? <SummarySentence status={status} /> : null}
    </header>
  );
}
```

`apps/web/src/pages/home/KpiRow.tsx`:

```tsx
import type { CashFlowResponse, HomeSummary } from "@bursar/shared";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import type { RouteId } from "../../app/routes";
import { ShippedLink } from "../../app/ShippedLink";
import { Money } from "../../components/ui";
import { amountTone } from "../../lib/tones";

export interface KpiRowProps {
  balances: HomeSummary["balances"];
  /** The 30-day cash flow of the currency on screen; null hides the flow figures. */
  cashflow: CashFlowResponse | null;
  /** Added to the Transactions links when several currencies exist. */
  currencyParam: string | null;
  highlightNegativeNet: boolean;
}

function KpiTile({
  route,
  search,
  label,
  hint,
  className = "",
  children,
}: {
  route: RouteId;
  search?: Record<string, string>;
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  className?: string;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  const base = `flex flex-col rounded-2xl border border-subtle bg-surface p-3 sm:p-4 ${className}`;
  return (
    <ShippedLink
      route={route}
      search={search}
      className={`${base} transition-colors hover:border-primary/40 hover:bg-surface-2`}
      plainClassName={base}
    >
      <span className="text-xs font-medium text-muted">{label}</span>
      <span className="mt-2 font-display text-base font-semibold tabular sm:text-xl lg:text-2xl">
        {children}
      </span>
      {hint ? <span className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted">{hint}</span> : null}
    </ShippedLink>
  );
}

/** Balance per currency and the 30-day in, out and net; each tile opens the filtered list. */
export function KpiRow({ balances, cashflow, currencyParam, highlightNegativeNet }: KpiRowProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const accountCount = balances.reduce((total, balance) => total + balance.accountCount, 0);
  const withCurrency = (search: Record<string, string>): Record<string, string> =>
    currencyParam ? { ...search, currency: currencyParam } : search;
  const totals = cashflow?.totals ?? null;
  const outflow = totals ? Math.abs(totals.outMinor) : 0;
  return (
    <section aria-label={t("home.kpi.label")} className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 lg:grid-cols-4">
      <KpiTile
        route="accounts"
        label={t("home.kpi.balance")}
        hint={t("home.kpi.accounts", { count: accountCount })}
        className="col-span-3 lg:col-span-1"
      >
        {balances.length === 0 ? (
          <span className="text-sm font-medium text-muted">{t("home.kpi.noBalance")}</span>
        ) : (
          balances.map((balance) => (
            <span key={balance.currency} className="block">
              <Money minor={balance.amountMinor} currency={balance.currency} tone="auto-balance" />
            </span>
          ))
        )}
      </KpiTile>
      {cashflow && totals ? (
        <>
          <KpiTile
            route="transactions"
            search={withCurrency({ tab: "in" })}
            label={t("home.kpi.in")}
          >
            <Money minor={Math.abs(totals.inMinor)} currency={cashflow.currency} tone="auto-flow" />
          </KpiTile>
          <KpiTile
            route="transactions"
            search={withCurrency({ tab: "out" })}
            label={t("home.kpi.out")}
          >
            <Money
              minor={outflow}
              currency={cashflow.currency}
              tone={outflow === 0 ? "muted" : "ink"}
            />
          </KpiTile>
          <KpiTile
            route="transactions"
            search={currencyParam ? withCurrency({}) : undefined}
            label={t("home.kpi.net")}
            hint={t("home.kpi.transactions", { count: totals.count })}
          >
            <Money
              minor={totals.netMinor}
              currency={cashflow.currency}
              sign="always"
              tone={amountTone(totals.netMinor, "net", { highlightNegativeNet })}
            />
          </KpiTile>
        </>
      ) : null}
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { AccountStatus, AccountSummary } from "@bursar/shared";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { ShippedLink } from "../../app/ShippedLink";
import { NetChip } from "../../components/charts/NetChip";
import { DeadlineChip, InlineEmpty, MaskedIban, Money, StatusPill } from "../../components/ui";
import { useFormatters } from "../../lib/format";
import { freshnessUrgency } from "../../lib/thresholds";

const STATUS_TONE: Record<AccountStatus, "positive" | "warning" | "neutral"> = {
  active: "positive",
  unavailable: "warning",
  disabled: "neutral",
  removed: "neutral",
};

const ROW =
  "flex min-h-14 items-center gap-3 rounded-xl px-2 py-3 sm:px-3";

/** Accounts on Home: name, masked identifier, freshness chip, balance and 30-day net. */
export function AccountFreshnessList({
  accounts,
  highlightNegativeNet,
}: {
  accounts: readonly AccountSummary[];
  highlightNegativeNet: boolean;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { relative, absolute, now } = useFormatters();
  const current = now();
  return (
    <section
      aria-labelledby="home-accounts"
      className="rounded-2xl border border-subtle bg-surface p-4 sm:p-6"
    >
      <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
        <h2 id="home-accounts" className="font-display text-base font-semibold text-fg">
          {t("home.accounts.title")}
        </h2>
        <span className="text-sm text-muted tabular">{accounts.length}</span>
      </div>
      {accounts.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="mt-4">
          <InlineEmpty title={t("home.accounts.empty")} />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <ul className="mt-2 divide-y divide-subtle">
          {accounts.map((account) => {
            const freshness = freshnessUrgency(account.lastSyncedAt, current);
            const label =
              account.lastSyncedAt === null
                ? t("freshness.never")
                : t("freshness.updated", { when: relative(account.lastSyncedAt) });
            return (
              <li key={account.id}>
                <ShippedLink
                  route="account"
                  params={{ accountId: account.id }}
                  className={`${ROW} transition-colors hover:bg-surface-2`}
                  plainClassName={ROW}
                >
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <div className="truncate text-sm font-medium text-fg">{account.name}</div>
                    <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                      {account.maskedIdentifier ? (
                        <MaskedIban masked={account.maskedIdentifier} />
                      ) : null}
                      {account.syncInProgress ? (
                        <StatusPill tone="info" label={t("freshness.syncing")} />
                      ) : (
                        <DeadlineChip
                          urgency={freshness.urgency}
                          label={label}
                          title={
                            account.lastSyncedAt === null
                              ? undefined
                              : absolute(account.lastSyncedAt, true)
                          }
                        />
                      )}
                      {account.status === "active" ? null : (
                        <StatusPill
                          tone={STATUS_TONE[account.status]}
                          label={t(`status.account.${account.status}`)}
                        />
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex shrink-0 flex-col items-end gap-1 text-sm font-semibold">
                    {account.balance ? (
                      <Money
                        minor={account.balance.amountMinor}
                        currency={account.balance.currency}
                        tone="auto-balance"
                      />
                    ) : (
                      <span className="text-xs font-normal text-muted">
                        {t("home.accounts.noBalance")}
                      </span>
                    )}
                    <NetChip
                      netMinor={account.net30d.netMinor}
                      currency={account.currency}
                      highlightNegativeNet={highlightNegativeNet}
                    />
                  </div>
                </ShippedLink>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import {
  type CashFlowBucket,
  type CashFlowResponse,
  type HomeSummary,
  localDateSchema,
} from "@bursar/shared";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Landmark, TriangleAlert } from "lucide-react";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { api } from "../api";
import { ShippedLink } from "../app/ShippedLink";
import { useSettingsQuery } from "../app/useSettingsQuery";
import { CashFlowStrip } from "../components/charts/CashFlowStrip";
import { dayMonthLabel } from "../components/charts/chart-colors";
import { Button, Cascade, EmptyState, InlineEmpty, Money } from "../components/ui";
import { useFormatters } from "../lib/format";
import { queryKeys } from "../lib/query-keys";
import { amountTone } from "../lib/tones";
import { useUrlState } from "../lib/url-state";
import { AccountFreshnessList } from "./home/AccountFreshnessList";
import { AlertList } from "./home/AlertList";
import { Greeting } from "./home/Greeting";
import { KpiRow } from "./home/KpiRow";

function HomeSkeleton() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  return (
    <div aria-busy="true" className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <span className="sr-only">{t("home.loading")}</span>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <div className="col-span-3 h-24 animate-pulse rounded-2xl bg-surface-2 lg:col-span-1" />
        <div className="h-24 animate-pulse rounded-2xl bg-surface-2" />
        <div className="h-24 animate-pulse rounded-2xl bg-surface-2" />
        <div className="h-24 animate-pulse rounded-2xl bg-surface-2" />
      </div>
      <div className="h-72 animate-pulse rounded-2xl bg-surface-2" />
      <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-5">
        <div className="h-56 animate-pulse rounded-2xl bg-surface-2 lg:col-span-3" />
        <div className="h-56 animate-pulse rounded-2xl bg-surface-2 lg:col-span-2" />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function CurrencySwitch({
  currencies,
  value,
  onChange,
}: {
  currencies: readonly string[];
  value: string;
  onChange: (currency: string) => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  return (
    <fieldset className="inline-flex rounded-xl border border-subtle bg-surface-2 p-0.5">
      <legend className="sr-only">{t("home.cashflow.currency")}</legend>
      {currencies.map((currency) => (
        <button
          key={currency}
          type="button"
          aria-pressed={currency === value}
          onClick={() => onChange(currency)}
          className={`min-h-11 rounded-lg px-3 text-xs font-semibold tabular transition-colors sm:min-h-8 ${
            currency === value ? "bg-surface text-fg shadow-sm" : "text-muted hover:text-fg"
          }`}
        >
          {currency}
        </button>
      ))}
    </fieldset>
  );
}

function StripLegend() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  return (
    <ul aria-hidden="true" className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-xs text-muted">
      <li className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
        <span className="size-2.5 rounded-sm bg-positive" />
        {t("cashflow.in")}
      </li>
      <li className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
        <span className="size-2.5 rounded-sm bg-ink" />
        {t("cashflow.out")}
      </li>
      <li className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
        <span className="h-0.5 w-3 rounded-full bg-primary" />
        {t("cashflow.balance")}
      </li>
    </ul>
  );
}

function SelectionFooter({
  bucket,
  currency,
  currencyParam,
  highlightNegativeNet,
  onClear,
}: {
  bucket: CashFlowBucket | null;
  currency: string;
  currencyParam: string | null;
  highlightNegativeNet: boolean;
  onClear: () => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { locale } = useFormatters();
  if (!bucket) return <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-muted">{t("home.cashflow.hint")}</p>;
  const date = dayMonthLabel(bucket.date, locale);
  const search: Record<string, string> = { from: bucket.date, to: bucket.end };
  if (currencyParam) search.currency = currencyParam;
  return (
    <div className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-xl bg-surface-2 p-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-fg">
          {date}
          <span className="ml-2 font-normal text-muted">
            {t("cashflow.count", { count: bucket.count })}
          </span>
        </p>
        <dl className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-5 gap-y-1 text-sm">
          <div className="flex gap-1.5">
            <dt className="text-muted">{t("cashflow.in")}</dt>
            <dd>
              <Money minor={Math.abs(bucket.inMinor)} currency={currency} tone="auto-flow" />
            </dd>
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-1.5">
            <dt className="text-muted">{t("cashflow.out")}</dt>
            <dd>
              <Money
                minor={Math.abs(bucket.outMinor)}
                currency={currency}
                tone={bucket.outMinor === 0 ? "muted" : "ink"}
              />
            </dd>
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-1.5">
            <dt className="text-muted">{t("cashflow.net")}</dt>
            <dd>
              <Money
                minor={bucket.netMinor}
                currency={currency}
                sign="always"
                tone={amountTone(bucket.netMinor, "net", { highlightNegativeNet })}
              />
            </dd>
          </div>
        </dl>
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        {bucket.count === 0 ? (
          <span className="text-sm text-muted">{t("home.cashflow.none", { date })}</span>
        ) : (
          <ShippedLink
            route="transactions"
            search={search}
            whenUnshipped="hide"
            className="text-sm font-medium text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline"
          >
            {t("home.cashflow.see", { count: bucket.count, date })}
          </ShippedLink>
        )}
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={onClear}>
          {t("home.cashflow.clear")}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function HomeContent({
  summary,
  highlightNegativeNet,
}: {
  summary: HomeSummary;
  highlightNegativeNet: boolean;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const base = summary.cashflow30d;
  const currencies = base?.currencies ?? [];
  const [url, setUrl] = useUrlState(
    { currency: "", day: "" },
    {
      validate: {
        currency: (value) => currencies.includes(value),
        day: (value) => localDateSchema.safeParse(value).success,
      },
      resetOnChange: ["day"],
    },
  );
  const currency = url.currency || base?.currency || "";
  const isDefault = base !== null && currency === base.currency;
  const other = useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.cashflow({ currency, from: base?.from ?? "", to: base?.to ?? "" }),
    queryFn: () => api.cashflow({ currency, from: base?.from, to: base?.to }),
    enabled: base !== null && currency !== "" && !isDefault,
  });
  const cashflow: CashFlowResponse | null = isDefault ? base : (other.data ?? null);
  const mixed = currencies.length > 1;
  const currencyParam = mixed && cashflow ? cashflow.currency : null;
  const selected = cashflow?.buckets.find((bucket) => bucket.date === url.day) ?? null;

  return (
    <>
      <Cascade index={1}>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          <KpiRow
            balances={summary.balances}
            cashflow={cashflow}
            currencyParam={currencyParam}
            highlightNegativeNet={highlightNegativeNet}
          />
          {summary.balances.length > 1 ? (
            <p className="text-xs text-muted">{t("home.kpi.mixedCurrencies")}</p>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </Cascade>
      {base ? (
        <Cascade index={2}>
          <section
            aria-labelledby="home-cashflow"
            className="rounded-2xl border border-subtle bg-surface p-4 sm:p-6"
          >
            <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <h2 id="home-cashflow" className="font-display text-base font-semibold text-fg">
                {t("home.cashflow.title")}
              </h2>
              {mixed ? (
                <CurrencySwitch
                  currencies={currencies}
                  value={currency}
                  onChange={(next) => setUrl({ currency: next === base.currency ? "" : next })}
                />
              ) : null}
            </div>
            {cashflow ? (
              <>
                <CashFlowStrip
                  buckets={cashflow.buckets}
                  currency={cashflow.currency}
                  variant="full"
                  showBalance
                  highlightNegativeNet={highlightNegativeNet}
                  selectedDate={selected?.date ?? null}
                  onSelectBucket={(bucket) =>
                    setUrl({ day: bucket.date === url.day ? "" : bucket.date })
                  }
                  summaryLabel={t("home.cashflow.title")}
                />
                <StripLegend />
                <SelectionFooter
                  bucket={selected}
                  currency={cashflow.currency}
                  currencyParam={currencyParam}
                  highlightNegativeNet={highlightNegativeNet}
                  onClear={() => setUrl({ day: "" })}
                />
              </>
            ) : other.isError ? (
              <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-3">
                <InlineEmpty icon={TriangleAlert} title={t("home.cashflow.error", { currency })} />
                <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={() => void other.refetch()}>
                  {t("home.cashflow.retry")}
                </Button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div aria-busy="true" className="h-56 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-surface-2">
                <span className="sr-only">{t("home.cashflow.loading")}</span>
              </div>
            )}
          </section>
        </Cascade>
      ) : null}
      <Cascade index={3}>
        <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-5">
          <div className="lg:col-span-3">
            <AccountFreshnessList
              accounts={summary.accounts}
              highlightNegativeNet={highlightNegativeNet}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="lg:col-span-2">
            <AlertList alerts={summary.alerts} />
          </div>
        </div>
      </Cascade>
    </>
  );
}

/** Role home (UX doc §4): greeting, key figures, 30-day cash-flow strip, accounts, alerts. */
export function HomePage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const summary = useQuery({ queryKey: queryKeys.summary, queryFn: () => api.summary() });
  const settings = useSettingsQuery();
  const highlightNegativeNet = settings.data?.values.highlightNegativeNet ?? true;

  let body: ReactNode;
  if (summary.data === undefined) {
    body = summary.isError ? (
      <Cascade index={1}>
        <EmptyState
          kind="state"
          icon={TriangleAlert}
          title={t("home.error.title")}
          description={t("home.error.description")}
          action={
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              loading={summary.isFetching}
              onClick={() => void summary.refetch()}
            >
              {t("home.error.retry")}
            </Button>
          }
        />
      </Cascade>
    ) : (
      <HomeSkeleton />
    );
  } else if (!summary.data.hasConnections) {
    // Task 20 adds the "Connect a bank" action here when /connect ships.
    body = (
      <Cascade index={1}>
        <EmptyState
          kind="empty"
          icon={Landmark}
          title={t("home.empty.title")}
          description={t("home.empty.description")}
        />
      </Cascade>
    );
  } else {
    body = <HomeContent summary={summary.data} highlightNegativeNet={highlightNegativeNet} />;
  }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-6xl flex-col gap-6 pb-8 sm:gap-8">
      <Cascade index={0}>
        <Greeting summary={summary.data} />
      </Cascade>
      {body}
    </div>
  );
}
```

**Implementation notes (read before Step 1):**
- **Prerequisites.** Tasks 1–17 are merged: `NetChip` (`apps/web/src/components/charts/NetChip.tsx`, named export, props `{ netMinor: number; currency: string }`), the Task 3 primitives (`apps/web/src/components/ui/index.ts` barrel), `feedback`/`clearToasts` (`apps/web/src/components/feedback.ts`), `useFormatters`/`FormatProvider`, `consentUrgency`/`freshnessUrgency`/`Urgency`, `useDismiss` (`apps/web/src/app/useDismiss.ts`), the test helpers `renderRoutes`/`stubApi`/`testQueryClient` (`apps/web/src/test/router.tsx`) and the shared types listed in Interfaces (Tasks 11, 14, 16: `AccountPatch` and `RenewConnectionRequest` are the inferred types of `accountPatchSchema` and `renewConnectionRequestSchema`).
- **Interpretation of the brief (stated once).** “Grouped by bank” is one card per connection (a second connection to the same bank is its own card; every card shows its “connected on” date so two cards of one bank are distinguishable). Cards needing attention (expired, revoked, error, then expiring) come before healthy ones, then alphabetical by bank with the natural collator. Disabling an account asks for a level-1 confirmation that says it can be undone; enabling it again is immediate (a confirmation for a harmless action would be noise). Each account row shows the `NetChip` and, from `sm` up, the 30-day mini `CashFlowStrip` (UX doc §3, "account cards (a 30-day mini strip)"), drawn from `AccountSummary.daily30d` (Task 16: 30 day buckets from the same grouped query as `net30d`, so no request per row). A row with no transaction in the window (`daily30d` empty or every `count` zero) shows no strip.
- **Sync progress.** `useLiveEvents` (mounted once in `AppShell`, Task 17) patches `syncInProgress: true` into the `connections` cache on `sync.started` and invalidates `connections` on `sync.finished`. The row therefore renders “Syncing…” from `account.syncInProgress` alone. After a manual sync is queued the page invalidates `connections` too, and the server reports queued and running syncs through `syncInProgress` (`JobQueue.activeKeys`), so the row switches to “Syncing…” immediately. `sync.progress` carries a page count only and is not shown.
- **Toast and error grammar.** Titles name the outcome, details name the real object (account or bank name, never an id) and the consequence; tones as in UX doc §7. Known `ApiError.code` values map to translated `warning` toasts; anything else is a generic `error` toast. A 404 or 409 also refreshes the lists so the page stops showing the stale row.
- **Dialogs.** `ConfirmDialog` (Task 3) closes itself when `onConfirm` resolves and stays open when it rejects; the disable and purge flows rely on that. The disconnect dialog is built on `Dialog` instead, because its confirm button must stay disabled until the removal preview has loaded while Cancel stays enabled (`ConfirmDialog`'s `busy` would also disable Cancel).
- **Colours.** `text-accent` is below 4.5:1 for small text, so the accent colour is used only for the progress bar of a syncing row. The “…” menus are positioned `absolute` inside `Card` (a plain `div` without `overflow-hidden`), so nothing clips them.
- **Layout.** Rows are a CSS grid: three columns below `xl` (name, balance, menu on the first line, IBAN and chips on their own lines, which is the 390 px layout) and five columns from `xl` (name, IBAN, chips, balance, menu). `min-w-0` and `truncate` on the name keep long names from widening the page; the global `.grid > * { min-width: 0 }` rule also applies.
- **Logos.** `BankLogo` requests `/api/banks/logo` only when `hasLogo` is true and falls back to initials when the image fails. A failed image load is a console error in Chrome, so the QA seed (Task 6) must keep `aspsp_logo_url` null for its fictional banks; if Step 19 reports a failed resource, fix the seed, not the harness.
- **Biome.** If Biome's `useSemanticElements` or `noArrayIndexKey` flags a line below, apply its suggestion (for example `<output>` for a live status) and keep the behaviour; `pnpm format` runs first and fixes import order. If `useHookAtTopLevel` flags `source.useItems(...)` inside `renderHook` in `accounts-sources.test.tsx`, add a `biome-ignore` comment on that line with the reason “renderHook callback”.

`apps/web/src/lib/connection-state.test.ts`:

```ts
import type { ConnectionStatus } from "@bursar/shared";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  accountFixture,
  connectionFixture,
  DAY,
  FIXED_NOW,
  HOUR,
} from "../test/accounts-fixtures";
import {
  accountSyncBlock,
  allUpdatedToday,
  attentionRank,
  bankInitials,
  type ConnectionActionPlan,
  connectionActions,
  connectionTone,
  countNeedingAction,
  formatCount,
  isSafeRedirect,
  needsAction,
} from "./connection-state";

const ZONE = "Europe/Rome";

describe("connectionActions", () => {
  const table: [ConnectionStatus, ConnectionActionPlan][] = [
    ["active", { primary: "sync", allowed: ["sync", "renew", "disconnect"], blocked: {} }],
    ["expiring", { primary: "renew", allowed: ["renew", "sync", "disconnect"], blocked: {} }],
    [
      "expired",
      {
        primary: "renew",
        allowed: ["renew", "disconnect"],
        blocked: { sync: "connection.blocked.syncExpired" },
      },
    ],
    [
      "revoked",
      {
        primary: "renew",
        allowed: ["renew", "disconnect"],
        blocked: { sync: "connection.blocked.syncRevoked" },
      },
    ],
    [
      "error",
      {
        primary: "renew",
        allowed: ["renew", "disconnect"],
        blocked: { sync: "connection.blocked.syncError" },
      },
    ],
  ];

  it.each(table)("plans the actions of a %s connection", (status, expected) => {
    expect(connectionActions(status)).toEqual(expected);
  });

  it("never allows an action it also blocks, and always allows disconnecting", () => {
    for (const [status] of table) {
      const plan = connectionActions(status);
      for (const blocked of Object.keys(plan.blocked)) {
        expect(plan.allowed).not.toContain(blocked);
      }
      expect(plan.allowed).toContain("disconnect");
      expect(plan.allowed).toContain(plan.primary);
    }
  });
});

describe("connectionTone, needsAction and attentionRank", () => {
  it("maps every status to a tone", () => {
    expect(connectionTone("active")).toBe("positive");
    expect(connectionTone("expiring")).toBe("warning");
    expect(connectionTone("expired")).toBe("danger");
    expect(connectionTone("revoked")).toBe("danger");
    expect(connectionTone("error")).toBe("danger");
  });

  it("counts the connections that need the owner's attention", () => {
    expect(needsAction("active")).toBe(false);
    for (const status of ["expiring", "expired", "revoked", "error"] as const) {
      expect(needsAction(status)).toBe(true);
    }
    expect(
      countNeedingAction([
        { status: "active" },
        { status: "expiring" },
        { status: "revoked" },
        { status: "active" },
      ]),
    ).toBe(2);
    expect(countNeedingAction([])).toBe(0);
  });

  it("ranks broken connections before expiring ones before healthy ones", () => {
    const ranked = (["active", "expiring", "error", "expired", "revoked"] as const)
      .map((status) => ({ status, rank: attentionRank(status) }))
      .sort((a, b) => a.rank - b.rank);
    expect(ranked.map((item) => item.status)).toEqual([
      "error",
      "expired",
      "revoked",
      "expiring",
      "active",
    ]);
  });
});

describe("accountSyncBlock", () => {
  const healthy = accountFixture();

  it("does not block a healthy account of an active connection", () => {
    expect(accountSyncBlock(healthy, "active", FIXED_NOW)).toBeNull();
    expect(accountSyncBlock(healthy, "expiring", FIXED_NOW)).toBeNull();
  });

  it("blocks by the state of the connection first", () => {
    const disabled = accountFixture({ status: "disabled" });
    expect(accountSyncBlock(disabled, "expired", FIXED_NOW)).toEqual({
      key: "connection.blocked.syncExpired",
    });
    expect(accountSyncBlock(healthy, "revoked", FIXED_NOW)).toEqual({
      key: "connection.blocked.syncRevoked",
    });
  });

  it("blocks disabled and unavailable accounts", () => {
    expect(accountSyncBlock(accountFixture({ status: "disabled" }), "active", FIXED_NOW)).toEqual({
      key: "accounts.blocked.disabled",
    });
    expect(
      accountSyncBlock(accountFixture({ status: "unavailable" }), "active", FIXED_NOW),
    ).toEqual({ key: "accounts.blocked.unavailable" });
  });

  it("reports the rate limit with its retry time, but only while it lasts", () => {
    const limited = accountFixture({ rateLimitedUntil: FIXED_NOW + 5 * HOUR });
    expect(accountSyncBlock(limited, "active", FIXED_NOW)).toEqual({
      key: "accounts.blocked.rateLimited",
      retryAt: FIXED_NOW + 5 * HOUR,
    });
    expect(accountSyncBlock(limited, "active", FIXED_NOW + 6 * HOUR)).toBeNull();
  });

  it("reports a sync that is already running", () => {
    expect(
      accountSyncBlock(accountFixture({ syncInProgress: true }), "active", FIXED_NOW),
    ).toEqual({ key: "accounts.blocked.running" });
  });
});

describe("allUpdatedToday", () => {
  const fresh = accountFixture({ lastSyncedAt: FIXED_NOW - HOUR });

  it("is true when every active account of healthy connections was updated today", () => {
    expect(allUpdatedToday([connectionFixture({ accounts: [fresh] })], FIXED_NOW, ZONE)).toBe(
      true,
    );
  });

  it("is false when one active account is stale or has never synced", () => {
    const stale = accountFixture({ id: 2, lastSyncedAt: FIXED_NOW - 2 * DAY });
    const never = accountFixture({ id: 3, lastSyncedAt: null });
    expect(
      allUpdatedToday([connectionFixture({ accounts: [fresh, stale] })], FIXED_NOW, ZONE),
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(
      allUpdatedToday([connectionFixture({ accounts: [fresh, never] })], FIXED_NOW, ZONE),
    ).toBe(false);
  });

  it("ignores disabled accounts but needs every connection to be active and one account", () => {
    const disabledStale = accountFixture({ id: 2, status: "disabled", lastSyncedAt: null });
    expect(
      allUpdatedToday(
        [connectionFixture({ accounts: [fresh, disabledStale] })],
        FIXED_NOW,
        ZONE,
      ),
    ).toBe(true);
    expect(
      allUpdatedToday(
        [connectionFixture({ status: "expiring", accounts: [fresh] })],
        FIXED_NOW,
        ZONE,
      ),
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(allUpdatedToday([], FIXED_NOW, ZONE)).toBe(false);
    expect(
      allUpdatedToday([connectionFixture({ accounts: [disabledStale] })], FIXED_NOW, ZONE),
    ).toBe(false);
  });

  it("uses the owner's local day, not UTC", () => {
    // 2026-11-09 23:30 in Rome is 22:30 UTC; an update at 00:30 Rome the same night is "today".
    const lateEvening = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 9, 22, 30, 0);
    const justAfterMidnight = accountFixture({ lastSyncedAt: Date.UTC(2026, 10, 8, 23, 30, 0) });
    expect(
      allUpdatedToday([connectionFixture({ accounts: [justAfterMidnight] })], lateEvening, ZONE),
    ).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe("small helpers", () => {
  it("builds the initials shown when a bank has no logo", () => {
    expect(bankInitials("Northwind Bank")).toBe("NB");
    expect(bankInitials("Banca Esempio")).toBe("BE");
    expect(bankInitials("Revolut")).toBe("RE");
    expect(bankInitials("Crédit Agricole")).toBe("CA");
    expect(bankInitials("   ")).toBe("?");
  });

  it("follows only http and https redirects", () => {
    expect(isSafeRedirect("https://bank.example.test/authorize?x=1")).toBe(true);
    expect(isSafeRedirect("http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/banks/callback?state=a")).toBe(true);
    expect(isSafeRedirect("javascript:alert(1)")).toBe(false);
    expect(isSafeRedirect("data:text/html,x")).toBe(false);
    expect(isSafeRedirect("/relative")).toBe(false);
    expect(isSafeRedirect("")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("formats counts with the grouping of the locale", () => {
    expect(formatCount("en-GB", 1234)).toBe("1,234");
    expect(formatCount("it-IT", 12400)).toBe("12.400");
    expect(formatCount("en-GB", 0)).toBe("0");
  });
});
```
