```tsx
    renderPage();
    await region("Northwind Bank");
    expect(screen.queryByText("All good: every account was updated today.")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("shows the progress of a running sync and a failed last sync", async () => {
    serve(
      {},
      {
        connections: [
          connectionFixture({
            accounts: [
              accountFixture({ id: 1, name: "Running", syncInProgress: true }),
              accountFixture({
                id: 2,
                name: "Failing",
                lastSyncedAt: FIXED_NOW - 2 * DAY,
                lastSyncError: { code: "ASPSP_ERROR", at: FIXED_NOW - HOUR },
              }),
            ],
          }),
        ],
        removedAccounts: [],
      },
    );
    renderPage();
    expect(await screen.findByText("Syncing…")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText("Last sync failed")).toBeTruthy();
    await openMenu("Actions for Running");
    const item = await screen.findByRole("menuitem", { name: /^Sync now/ });
    expect(item.getAttribute("aria-disabled")).toBe("true");
  });

  it("falls back to initials when a logo cannot be loaded", async () => {
    serve(
      {},
      {
        connections: [connectionFixture({ hasLogo: true, bankName: "Banca Esempio" })],
        removedAccounts: [],
      },
    );
    renderPage();
    const section = await region("Banca Esempio");
    const image = section.querySelector("img");
    expect(image?.getAttribute("src")).toBe("/api/banks/logo?country=IT&name=Banca+Esempio");
    if (image) fireEvent.error(image);
    await waitFor(() => expect(section.querySelector("img")).toBeNull());
    expect(within(section).getByText("BE")).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it("masks amounts and IBAN digits in privacy mode", async () => {
    useUi.setState({ privacy: true });
    serve();
    renderPage();
    const northwind = await region("Northwind Bank");
    expect(within(northwind).queryByText(/1,234\.50/)).toBeNull();
    expect(within(northwind).queryByText("IT60 •••• •••• 3456")).toBeNull();
    expect(within(northwind).getAllByRole("img", { name: "Amount hidden" }).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(within(northwind).getAllByRole("img", { name: "IBAN hidden by privacy mode" }).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  it("renders in Italian", async () => {
    await i18n.changeLanguage("it");
    serve();
    renderPage();
    const banca = await region("Banca Esempio");
    expect(within(banca).getByText("Il consenso scade tra 9 giorni")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(within(banca).getByRole("button", { name: "Rinnova il consenso" })).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole("heading", { level: 2, name: "Conti scollegati" })).toBeTruthy();
  });
});
```

```tsx
import { QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { renderHook, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import { isValidElement, type ReactElement, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import i18n from "../i18n";
import {
  accountFixture,
  connectionFixture,
  DAY,
  FIXED_NOW,
} from "../test/accounts-fixtures";
import { stubApi, testQueryClient } from "../test/router";
import { useNavBadges } from "./nav-badges";
import { PALETTE_SOURCES, type PaletteSource } from "./palette-sources";
import { accountDetailPath, routeById } from "./routes";

function wrapper() {
  const client = testQueryClient();
  return ({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) => (
    <QueryClientProvider client={client}>{children}</QueryClientProvider>
  );
}

function serve(connections: ReturnType<typeof connectionFixture>[]) {
  return stubApi({
    "GET /api/connections": () => ({ status: 200, body: { connections, removedAccounts: [] } }),
  });
}

describe("accountDetailPath", () => {
  it("is hidden until the account page ships, then builds the path", () => {
    expect(accountDetailPath(12)).toBeNull();
    const def = routeById("account");
    def.shipped = true;
    try {
      expect(accountDetailPath(12)).toBe("/accounts/12");
    } finally {
      def.shipped = false;
    }
  });
});

describe("useNavBadges", () => {
  beforeEach(async () => {
    await i18n.changeLanguage("en");
  });
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  });

  it("counts the connections that need action as an accent badge on Accounts", async () => {
    serve([
      connectionFixture({ id: 1, status: "active" }),
      connectionFixture({ id: 2, status: "expiring", validUntil: FIXED_NOW + 9 * DAY }),
      connectionFixture({ id: 3, status: "revoked" }),
    ]);
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useNavBadges(), { wrapper: wrapper() });
    await waitFor(() => expect(result.current.accounts).toEqual({ count: 2, tone: "accent" }));
  });

  it("shows no badge when every connection is healthy", async () => {
    const fetchMock = serve([connectionFixture({ status: "active" })]);
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useNavBadges(), { wrapper: wrapper() });
    await waitFor(() => expect(fetchMock).toHaveBeenCalled());
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 20));
    expect(result.current).toEqual({});
  });
});

describe("accounts palette source", () => {
  const found = PALETTE_SOURCES.find((candidate) => candidate.id === "accounts");
  if (!found) throw new Error("The accounts palette source is not registered");
  const source: PaletteSource = found;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    await i18n.changeLanguage("en");
  });
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  });

  const data = [
    connectionFixture({
      id: 1,
      bankName: "Northwind Bank",
      accounts: [
        accountFixture({ id: 1, name: "Household", last4: "3456" }),
        accountFixture({ id: 2, name: "Libretto Esempio", last4: "7890", status: "disabled" }),
      ],
    }),
    connectionFixture({
      id: 2,
      bankName: "Banca Esempio",
      accounts: [accountFixture({ id: 3, name: "Conto Corrente", last4: "1111" })],
    }),
  ];

  it("is registered after the pages source with a limit of six", () => {
    expect(PALETTE_SOURCES.map((candidate) => candidate.id)).toEqual(["pages", "accounts"]);
    expect(source.limit).toBe(6);
    expect(source.minQueryLength).toBe(2);
  });

  it("finds accounts by name, by bank and by the last four IBAN digits", async () => {
    serve(data);
    const byName = renderHook(() => source.useItems("housë"), { wrapper: wrapper() });
    await waitFor(() => expect(byName.result.current.items.map((item) => item.title)).toEqual(["Household"]));
    const item = byName.result.current.items[0];
    expect(item).toMatchObject({
      id: "account:1",
      subtitle: "Northwind Bank",
      group: "Accounts",
      to: "/accounts",
    });
    // UX doc §3 "Mini" form: the 30-day net chip of the account, in its currency.
    expect(isValidElement(item?.trailing)).toBe(true);
    expect((item?.trailing as ReactElement<{ netMinor: number; currency: string }>).props).toEqual({
      netMinor: 47_000,
      currency: "EUR",
    });

    const byBank = renderHook(() => source.useItems("NORTHWIND"), { wrapper: wrapper() });
    await waitFor(() => expect(byBank.result.current.items).toHaveLength(2));

    const byDigits = renderHook(() => source.useItems("1111"), { wrapper: wrapper() });
    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(byDigits.result.current.items.map((entry) => entry.title)).toEqual(["Conto Corrente"]),
    );
  });

  it("does not fetch for a query shorter than two characters", async () => {
    const fetchMock = serve(data);
    const { result } = renderHook(() => source.useItems("n"), { wrapper: wrapper() });
    expect(result.current).toEqual({ items: [], loading: false });
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 20));
    expect(fetchMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 7: Add the translations**

Merge these objects into `apps/web/src/i18n/en.json` and `it.json` (`palette.groups` already exists from Task 4: add `accounts` inside it; every other top-level key is new, `routes.accounts.*` already exists). English plural keys carry `_one` and `_other`; Italian ones also carry `_many` (Task 2's convention: i18next 27 never falls back from `_many` to `_other`). Counts shown in text are formatted by the code (`n`, through `formatCount`) because `it-IT` does not group four-digit numbers and the same function must be used everywhere; `count` only selects the plural form.

```ts
/**
 * Same-origin URL of a bank logo. The server proxies the image (the CSP allows only `'self'`
 * images) and looks the logo up by ASPSP, so no external URL ever reaches the browser.
```

- [ ] **Step 9: Write the connection state helpers and the shared connections query**

`apps/web/src/lib/connection-state.ts`:

```ts
import {
  type AccountSummary,
  type ConnectionStatus,
  type ConnectionSummary,
  toLocalDate,
} from "@bursar/shared";

export type ConnectionAction = "renew" | "sync" | "disconnect";

export interface ConnectionActionPlan {
  /** The natural next step; the card shows it as a button. `null` when nothing applies. */
  primary: ConnectionAction | null;
  /** Everything the owner may do, primary first. */
  allowed: ConnectionAction[];
  /** Actions the owner expects but cannot take now, with the i18n key of the reason (UX doc §7 level 2). */
  blocked: Partial<Record<ConnectionAction, string>>;
}

const SYNC_BLOCKED_KEYS: Record<"expired" | "revoked" | "error", string> = {
  expired: "connection.blocked.syncExpired",
  revoked: "connection.blocked.syncRevoked",
  error: "connection.blocked.syncError",
};

/**
 * The state machine of a connection with a primary action (UX doc §10): healthy connections
 * sync, connections that are ending or ended renew; syncing an ended connection is blocked with
 * a reason, disconnecting is always possible.
 */
export function connectionActions(status: ConnectionStatus): ConnectionActionPlan {
  switch (status) {
    case "active":
      return { primary: "sync", allowed: ["sync", "renew", "disconnect"], blocked: {} };
    case "expiring":
      return { primary: "renew", allowed: ["renew", "sync", "disconnect"], blocked: {} };
    case "expired":
    case "revoked":
    case "error":
      return {
        primary: "renew",
        allowed: ["renew", "disconnect"],
        blocked: { sync: SYNC_BLOCKED_KEYS[status] },
      };
  }
}

export function connectionTone(status: ConnectionStatus): "positive" | "warning" | "danger" {
  if (status === "active") return "positive";
  if (status === "expiring") return "warning";
  return "danger";
}

/** True for the states that need the owner: the consent is ending, ended, revoked or failing. */
export function needsAction(status: ConnectionStatus): boolean {
  return status !== "active";
}

export function countNeedingAction(connections: readonly { status: ConnectionStatus }[]): number {
  return connections.filter((connection) => needsAction(connection.status)).length;
}

/** Sort key: broken connections first, then expiring ones, then healthy ones. */
export function attentionRank(status: ConnectionStatus): number {
  if (status === "active") return 2;
  if (status === "expiring") return 1;
  return 0;
}

export interface SyncBlock {
  /** i18n key of the reason. */
  key: string;
  /** Epoch ms when a rate limit ends, for the `{{when}}` of the message. */
  retryAt?: number;
}

/**
 * Why a manual sync of this account cannot start right now, or `null` when it can. The
 * connection's state wins over the account's, then the rate limit, then a sync already running.
 */
export function accountSyncBlock(
  account: Pick<AccountSummary, "status" | "rateLimitedUntil" | "syncInProgress">,
  connectionStatus: ConnectionStatus,
  now: number,
): SyncBlock | null {
  const connectionReason = connectionActions(connectionStatus).blocked.sync;
  if (connectionReason) return { key: connectionReason };
  if (account.status === "disabled") return { key: "accounts.blocked.disabled" };
  if (account.status === "unavailable") return { key: "accounts.blocked.unavailable" };
  if (account.rateLimitedUntil !== null && account.rateLimitedUntil > now) {
    return { key: "accounts.blocked.rateLimited", retryAt: account.rateLimitedUntil };
  }
  if (account.syncInProgress) return { key: "accounts.blocked.running" };
  return null;
}

/**
 * The positive state: at least one active account, every connection active, and every active
 * account updated on the owner's current local day.
 */
export function allUpdatedToday(
  connections: readonly ConnectionSummary[],
  now: number,
  timeZone: string,
): boolean {
  const today = toLocalDate(now, timeZone);
  const active = connections
    .flatMap((connection) => connection.accounts)
    .filter((account) => account.status === "active");
  if (active.length === 0) return false;
  if (!connections.every((connection) => connection.status === "active")) return false;
  return active.every(
    (account) =>
      account.lastSyncedAt !== null && toLocalDate(account.lastSyncedAt, timeZone) === today,
  );
}

/** Two letters for the logo placeholder: first letters of the first two words, or the first two letters. */
export function bankInitials(name: string): string {
  const words = name
    .normalize("NFKD")
    .replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}\s]/gu, "")
    .trim()
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter((word) => word.length > 0);
  const first = words[0] ?? "";
  const second = words[1] ?? "";
  if (first === "") return "?";
  if (second === "") return first.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
  return `${first.charAt(0)}${second.charAt(0)}`.toUpperCase();
}

/** The redirect after `renew` goes to the bank: only http(s) URLs are followed. */
export function isSafeRedirect(url: string): boolean {
  try {
    const protocol = new URL(url).protocol;
    return protocol === "https:" || protocol === "http:";
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/** A count in the grouping of the locale (`1,234` in en-GB, `12.400` in it-IT). */
export function formatCount(locale: string, value: number): string {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale).format(value);
}
```

`apps/web/src/lib/use-connections.ts`:

```ts
import { type QueryClient, useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { api } from "../api";
import { queryKeys } from "./query-keys";

/**
 * The connections and their accounts. One key shared by the Accounts page, the sidebar badge and
 * the command palette, so they always agree; live events invalidate it (Task 17).
 */
export function useConnectionsQuery(options: { enabled?: boolean } = {}) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.connections,
    queryFn: () => api.connections(),
    staleTime: 30_000,
    enabled: options.enabled ?? true,
  });
}

/**
 * Everything that shows an account's name, status, balance or transactions. Called after any
 * change to an account or a connection.
 */
export async function invalidateAccountData(client: QueryClient): Promise<void> {
  await Promise.all(
    [queryKeys.connections, queryKeys.summary, ["accounts"], ["transactions"], ["cashflow"]].map(
      (queryKey) => client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey }),
    ),
  );
}
```

```tsx
        />

      )}
```

`apps/web/src/pages/accounts/NicknameEditor.tsx`:

```tsx
import { Check, Pencil, X } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Link } from "react-router";
import { IconButton } from "../../components/ui";

export const NICKNAME_MAX_LENGTH = 80;

export interface NicknameEditorProps {
  /** The name shown now: the nickname, or the default name when there is none. */
  name: string;
  nickname: string | null;
  /** Shown in the empty field: what the name falls back to. */
  placeholder: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Where the name links to (the detail page), or `null`/omitted for plain text. */
  to?: string | null;
  /** Saves the nickname (`null` resets it). Reject to keep the editor open; the caller reports the failure. */
  onSave(nickname: string | null): Promise<void>;
}

/**
 * Inline rename: the pencil opens a field, Enter or the check saves, Escape or the cross cancels.
 * An empty field resets the name; an unchanged value closes without calling the API.
 */
export function NicknameEditor({
  name,
  nickname,
  placeholder,
  disabled = false,
  to = null,
  onSave,
}: NicknameEditorProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [value, setValue] = useState("");
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const returnFocus = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (editing) {
      inputRef.current?.focus();
      inputRef.current?.select();
    } else if (returnFocus.current) {
      returnFocus.current = false;
      triggerRef.current?.focus();
    }
  }, [editing]);

  function start(): void {
    setValue(nickname ?? "");
    setEditing(true);
  }

  function cancel(): void {
    returnFocus.current = true;
    setEditing(false);
  }

  async function commit(): Promise<void> {
    if (saving) return;
    const trimmed = value.trim();
    const next = trimmed === "" ? null : trimmed;
    if (next === nickname) {
      cancel();
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await onSave(next);
      returnFocus.current = true;
      setEditing(false);
    } catch {
      // The caller already reported the failure; stay open so the typed text is not lost.
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  if (!editing) {
    return (
      <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1">
        {to ? (
          <Link to={to} className="truncate font-medium text-fg hover:underline">
            {name}
          </Link>
        ) : (
          <span className="truncate font-medium text-fg">{name}</span>
        )}
        <IconButton
          ref={triggerRef}
          label={t("accounts.row.rename", { name })}
          icon={Pencil}
          disabled={disabled}
          onClick={start}
        />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1">
      <input
        ref={inputRef}
        type="text"
        value={value}
        maxLength={NICKNAME_MAX_LENGTH}
        placeholder={placeholder}
        aria-label={t("accounts.row.renameLabel")}
        enterKeyHint="done"
        disabled={saving}
        className="h-9 min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-lg border border-subtle bg-surface px-2 text-sm text-fg placeholder:text-muted"
        onChange={(event) => setValue(event.target.value)}
        onKeyDown={(event) => {
          if (event.key === "Enter" && !event.nativeEvent.isComposing) {
            event.preventDefault();
            void commit();
          } else if (event.key === "Escape") {
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopPropagation();
            cancel();
          }
        }}
      />
      <IconButton
        label={t("accounts.row.renameSave")}
        icon={Check}
        disabled={saving}
        onClick={() => void commit()}
      />
      <IconButton
        label={t("accounts.row.renameCancel")}
        icon={X}
        disabled={saving}
        onClick={cancel}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`apps/web/src/pages/accounts/ActionMenu.tsx`:

```tsx
import { Ellipsis, type LucideIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { type KeyboardEvent, useCallback, useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useDismiss } from "../../app/useDismiss";
import { IconButton } from "../../components/ui";

export interface MenuAction {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: LucideIcon;
  onSelect(): void;
  /** A blocked action stays visible (UX doc §7 level 2) and explains itself in `disabledReason`. */
  disabled?: boolean;
  disabledReason?: string;
  tone?: "default" | "danger";
  /** Draws a divider above the item: the destructive item goes last, under a divider. */
  separatorBefore?: boolean;
}

/**
 * The “…” menu of a card or a row. Closes on Escape (focus returns to the button), on an outside
 * click and on selection; arrow keys, Home and End move between items. Positioned `absolute`
 * inside a parent without `overflow-hidden`.
 */
export function ActionMenu({ label, actions }: { label: string; actions: readonly MenuAction[] }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const itemRefs = useRef<(HTMLButtonElement | null)[]>([]);
  const menuId = useId();
  const close = useCallback(() => setOpen(false), []);
  useDismiss(open, close, rootRef, triggerRef);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) itemRefs.current.find((item) => item !== null)?.focus();
  }, [open]);

  function items(): HTMLButtonElement[] {
    return itemRefs.current.filter((item): item is HTMLButtonElement => item !== null);
  }

  function onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>): void {
    const list = items();
    if (list.length === 0) return;
    const current = list.findIndex((item) => item === document.activeElement);
    let next: number | null = null;
    if (event.key === "ArrowDown") next = (current + 1) % list.length;
    else if (event.key === "ArrowUp") next = (current - 1 + list.length) % list.length;
    else if (event.key === "Home") next = 0;
    else if (event.key === "End") next = list.length - 1;
    else if (event.key === "Tab") close();
    if (next !== null) {
      event.preventDefault();
      list[next]?.focus();
    }
  }

  function select(action: MenuAction): void {
    if (action.disabled) return;
    close();
    triggerRef.current?.focus();
    action.onSelect();
  }

  return (
    <div ref={rootRef} className="relative">
      <IconButton
        ref={triggerRef}
        label={label}
        icon={Ellipsis}
        aria-haspopup="menu"
        aria-expanded={open}
        aria-controls={open ? menuId : undefined}
        onClick={() => setOpen((value) => !value)}
      />
      {open ? (
        <div
          id={menuId}
          role="menu"
          aria-label={label}
          tabIndex={-1}
          onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
          className="absolute right-0 top-full z-30 mt-1 w-64 max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] rounded-xl border border-subtle bg-surface p-1 shadow-xl"
        >
          {actions.map((action, index) => {
            const Icon = action.icon;
            return (
              <div key={action.id}>
                {action.separatorBefore ? <hr className="my-1 border-subtle" /> : null}
                <button
                  ref={(node) => {
                    itemRefs.current[index] = node;
                  }}
                  type="button"
                  role="menuitem"
                  aria-disabled={action.disabled || undefined}
                  title={action.disabled ? action.disabledReason : undefined}
                  className={`flex w-full items-start gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-left text-sm hover:bg-surface-2 focus-visible:bg-surface-2 max-sm:min-h-11 ${
                    action.disabled
                      ? "cursor-not-allowed text-muted"
                      : action.tone === "danger"
                        ? "text-danger"
                        : "text-fg"
                  }`}
                  onClick={() => select(action)}
                >
                  {Icon ? <Icon aria-hidden size={16} strokeWidth={1.75} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" /> : null}
                  <span className="min-w-0">
                    {action.label}
                    {action.disabled && action.disabledReason ? (
                      <span className="mt-0.5 block text-xs font-normal">{action.disabledReason}</span>
                    ) : null}
                  </span>
                </button>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```ts
import type { AccountSummary, ConnectionSummary } from "@bursar/shared";
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useCallback } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { ApiError, api } from "../../api";
import { feedback } from "../../components/feedback";
import { isSafeRedirect } from "../../lib/connection-state";
import { useFormatters } from "../../lib/format";
import { queryKeys } from "../../lib/query-keys";
import { invalidateAccountData } from "../../lib/use-connections";

/**
 * The only place that leaves the app for the bank. A seam so tests can spy on it: jsdom's
 * `window.location.assign` cannot be replaced.
 */
export const browser = {
  assign(url: string): void {
    window.location.assign(url);
  },
};

export type ActionKind = "sync" | "rename" | "toggle" | "renew" | "disconnect" | "purge";

/** API codes with a translated message under `accounts.errors.codes.<code>`. */
const KNOWN_CODES = new Set([
  "sync_in_progress",
  "rate_limited",
  "connection_inactive",
  "account_inactive",
  "nothing_to_sync",
  "not_allowed",
  "connection_removed",
  "already_removed",
  "account_not_removed",
  "banking_not_configured",
  "REDIRECT_URI_NOT_ALLOWED",
  "WRONG_ASPSP_PROVIDED",
  "unknown_bank",
  "bank_error",
  "not_found",
]);

/** The item the owner acted on no longer exists or changed state: the lists are refreshed. */
export function isGone(error: unknown): boolean {
  return error instanceof ApiError && (error.status === 404 || error.status === 409);
}

/**
 * Reports a failed action as a toast: a refusal the server explains by code is a `warning`
 * (translated, with the retry time when it has one), anything else a generic `error`.
 */
export function useReportError(): (error: unknown, action: ActionKind) => void {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { relative } = useFormatters();
  const client = useQueryClient();
  return useCallback(
    (error, action) => {
      const title = t(`accounts.errors.titles.${action}`);
      if (isGone(error)) void invalidateAccountData(client);
      if (error instanceof ApiError && error.code !== null && KNOWN_CODES.has(error.code)) {
        const when = error.retryAt === null ? t("accounts.errors.later") : relative(error.retryAt);
        feedback(
          title,
          t(`accounts.errors.codes.${error.code}`, { when }),
          error.code === "bank_error" ? "error" : "warning",
        );
        return;
      }
      feedback(title, t("accounts.errors.generic"), "error");
    },
    [client, relative, t],
  );
}

/** The mutations of the Accounts page: sync, rename, disable/enable and renew. */
export function useAccountActions() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const client = useQueryClient();
  const report = useReportError();

  const syncAccount = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (account: AccountSummary) => api.syncAccount(account.id),
    onSuccess: (_result, account) => {
      feedback(
        t("accounts.toast.syncStarted"),
        t("accounts.toast.syncStartedAccount", { name: account.name }),
        "info",
      );
      // Queued syncs count as running (`syncInProgress`), so the row shows “Syncing…” at once.
      void client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.connections });
    },
    onError: (error) => report(error, "sync"),
  });

  const syncConnection = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (connection: ConnectionSummary) => api.syncConnection(connection.id),
    onSuccess: (result, connection) => {
      feedback(
        t("accounts.toast.syncStarted"),
        t("accounts.toast.syncStartedConnection", {
          count: result.queued,
          bank: connection.bankName,
        }),
        "info",
      );
      void client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.connections });
    },
    onError: (error) => report(error, "sync"),
  });

  const rename = useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ account, nickname }: { account: AccountSummary; nickname: string | null }) =>
      api.updateAccount(account.id, { nickname }),
    onSuccess: (updated, { nickname }) => {
      feedback(
        t("accounts.toast.renamed"),
        nickname === null
          ? t("accounts.toast.renamedReset")
          : t("accounts.toast.renamedDetail", { name: updated.name }),
      );
      void invalidateAccountData(client);
    },
    onError: (error) => report(error, "rename"),
  });

  const setEnabled = useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ account, enabled }: { account: AccountSummary; enabled: boolean }) =>
      api.updateAccount(account.id, { status: enabled ? "active" : "disabled" }),
    onSuccess: (updated, { enabled }) => {
      if (enabled) {
        feedback(
          t("accounts.toast.enabled"),
          t("accounts.toast.enabledDetail", { name: updated.name }),
        );
      } else {
        feedback(
          t("accounts.toast.disabled"),
          t("accounts.toast.disabledDetail", { name: updated.name }),
          "warning",
        );
      }
      void invalidateAccountData(client);
    },
    onError: (error) => report(error, "toggle"),
  });

  const renew = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (connection: ConnectionSummary) => api.renewConnection(connection.id),
    onSuccess: ({ redirectUrl }) => {
      if (isSafeRedirect(redirectUrl)) browser.assign(redirectUrl);
      else feedback(t("accounts.errors.titles.renew"), t("accounts.errors.generic"), "error");
    },
    onError: (error) => report(error, "renew"),
  });

  return { syncAccount, syncConnection, rename, setEnabled, renew };
}

export type AccountActions = ReturnType<typeof useAccountActions>;
```

```tsx
import type { AccountSummary, ConnectionStatus } from "@bursar/shared";
import { ExternalLink, Power, PowerOff, RefreshCw } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router";
import { accountDetailPath } from "../../app/routes";
import { useSettingsQuery } from "../../app/useSettingsQuery";
import { CashFlowStrip } from "../../components/charts/CashFlowStrip";
import { NetChip } from "../../components/charts/NetChip";
import { DeadlineChip, MaskedIban, Money, StatusPill } from "../../components/ui";
import { accountSyncBlock } from "../../lib/connection-state";
import { useFormatters } from "../../lib/format";
import { freshnessUrgency } from "../../lib/thresholds";
import { ActionMenu, type MenuAction } from "./ActionMenu";
import type { AccountActions } from "./actions";
import { NicknameEditor } from "./NicknameEditor";

export interface AccountRowProps {
  account: AccountSummary;
  connectionStatus: ConnectionStatus;
  actions: AccountActions;
  /** Disabling asks first (level 1); the page owns the dialog. */
  onRequestDisable(account: AccountSummary): void;
}

/**
 * One account: name with inline rename, masked IBAN with copy, balance, 30-day net, freshness and
 * status chips, and the row menu. A grid: name, balance and menu share the first line below `xl`
 * (phone and tablet), the IBAN and the chips follow on their own lines; from `xl` everything is
 * one row of five columns.
 */
export function AccountRow({ account, connectionStatus, actions, onRequestDisable }: AccountRowProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { now, relative, absolute } = useFormatters();
  const nowMs = now();
  const detailsPath = accountDetailPath(account.id);
  const block = accountSyncBlock(account, connectionStatus, nowMs);
  const fresh = freshnessUrgency(account.lastSyncedAt, nowMs);
  const disabled = account.status === "disabled";
  const highlightNegativeNet = useSettingsQuery().data?.values.highlightNegativeNet ?? true;
  const hasRecentFlow = account.daily30d.some((day) => day.count > 0);
  const masked = account.maskedIdentifier ?? (account.last4 ? `•••• ${account.last4}` : null);
  const failedSince =
    account.lastSyncError !== null &&
    (account.lastSyncedAt === null || account.lastSyncError.at > account.lastSyncedAt)
      ? account.lastSyncError.at
      : null;

  const menu: MenuAction[] = [
    {
      id: "sync",
      label: t("accounts.row.syncNow"),
      icon: RefreshCw,
      disabled: block !== null,
      disabledReason: block
        ? t(block.key, { when: block.retryAt === undefined ? "" : relative(block.retryAt) })
        : undefined,
      onSelect: () => actions.syncAccount.mutate(account),
    },
    {
      id: "toggle",
      label: disabled ? t("accounts.row.enable") : t("accounts.row.disable"),
      icon: disabled ? Power : PowerOff,
      onSelect: () =>
        disabled
          ? actions.setEnabled.mutate({ account, enabled: true })
          : onRequestDisable(account),
    },
  ];
  if (detailsPath) {
    menu.push({
      id: "details",
      label: t("accounts.row.openDetails"),
      icon: ExternalLink,
      onSelect: () => void navigate(detailsPath),
    });
  }

  return (
    <li className="relative grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_auto_auto] items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-2 px-4 py-3 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.3fr)_minmax(0,1fr)_auto_auto_auto] xl:gap-x-4">
      <div className="min-w-0 xl:col-start-1 xl:row-start-1">
        <NicknameEditor
          name={account.name}
          nickname={account.nickname}
          placeholder={account.nickname ? (account.bankProduct ?? "") : account.name}
          to={detailsPath}
          onSave={async (nickname) => {
            await actions.rename.mutateAsync({ account, nickname });
          }}
        />
        {account.nickname && account.bankProduct ? (
          <p className="truncate text-xs text-muted">{account.bankProduct}</p>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <div className="text-right xl:col-start-4 xl:row-start-1 xl:w-36">
        {account.balance ? (
          <Money
            minor={account.balance.amountMinor}
            currency={account.balance.currency}
            tone="auto-balance"
            className="text-base font-semibold"
          />
        ) : (
          <span className="text-sm text-muted">{t("accounts.row.balanceNone")}</span>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="xl:col-start-5 xl:row-start-1">
        <ActionMenu label={t("accounts.row.actionsFor", { name: account.name })} actions={menu} />
      </div>

      <div className="col-span-3 min-w-0 xl:col-span-1 xl:col-start-2 xl:row-start-1">
        {masked ? (
          <MaskedIban masked={masked} iban={account.iban} copyable={account.iban !== null} />
        ) : (
          <span className="text-xs text-muted">—</span>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="col-span-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 xl:col-span-1 xl:col-start-3 xl:row-start-1 xl:justify-end">
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1" title={t("accounts.row.netTitle")}>
          <NetChip netMinor={account.net30d.netMinor} currency={account.currency} />
          <span className="text-xs text-muted">{t("accounts.row.last30d")}</span>
        </span>
        {hasRecentFlow ? (
          <div className="hidden w-24 sm:block">
            <CashFlowStrip
              variant="mini"
              buckets={account.daily30d}
              currency={account.currency}
              highlightNegativeNet={highlightNegativeNet}
              summaryLabel={t("accounts.row.miniStrip")}
            />
          </div>
        ) : null}
        {account.syncInProgress ? (
          <output className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-primary">
            {t("accounts.row.syncing")}
          </output>
        ) : disabled ? null : (
          <DeadlineChip
            urgency={fresh.urgency}
            label={
              account.lastSyncedAt === null
                ? t("accounts.freshness.never")
                : t("accounts.freshness.updated", { when: relative(account.lastSyncedAt) })
            }
            title={account.lastSyncedAt === null ? undefined : absolute(account.lastSyncedAt, true)}
          />
        )}
        {failedSince !== null ? (
          <span title={t("accounts.row.syncFailedTitle", { when: relative(failedSince) })}>
            <StatusPill tone="warning" label={t("accounts.row.syncFailed")} />
          </span>
        ) : null}
        {disabled ? (
          <span title={t("accounts.status.disabledTitle")}>
            <StatusPill tone="neutral" label={t("accounts.status.disabled")} />
          </span>
        ) : null}
        {account.status === "unavailable" ? (
          <span title={t("accounts.status.unavailableTitle")}>
            <StatusPill tone="warning" label={t("accounts.status.unavailable")} />
          </span>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      {account.syncInProgress ? (
        <span
          aria-hidden
          className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-0.5 animate-pulse bg-accent"
        />
      ) : null}
    </li>
  );
}
```

`apps/web/src/pages/accounts/ConnectionCard.tsx`:

```tsx
import type { AccountSummary, ConnectionSummary } from "@bursar/shared";
import { KeyRound, RefreshCw, Unplug } from "lucide-react";
import { useId } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import {
  Button,
  Cascade,
  Card,
  DeadlineChip,
  InlineEmpty,
  StatusPill,
} from "../../components/ui";
import { type ConnectionAction, connectionActions, connectionTone } from "../../lib/connection-state";
import { useFormatters } from "../../lib/format";
import { consentUrgency, type Urgency } from "../../lib/thresholds";
import { ActionMenu, type MenuAction } from "./ActionMenu";
import type { AccountActions } from "./actions";
import { AccountRow } from "./AccountRow";
import { BankLogo } from "./BankLogo";

export interface ConnectionCardProps {
  connection: ConnectionSummary;
  /** Position in the sorted list, for the entry cascade. */
  index: number;
  actions: AccountActions;
  onRequestDisconnect(connection: ConnectionSummary): void;
  onRequestDisable(account: AccountSummary): void;
}

function regionName(country: string, locale: string): string {
  try {
    return new Intl.DisplayNames([locale], { type: "region" }).of(country) ?? country;
  } catch {
    return country;
  }
}

const HINT_CLASSES = {
  expiring: "bg-warning-soft text-warning",
  expired: "bg-danger-soft text-danger",
  revoked: "bg-danger-soft text-danger",
  error: "bg-danger-soft text-danger",
} as const;

/**
 * One bank connection: logo (or initials), name, status pill, consent chip, the primary action of
 * its state machine and a “…” menu with the others (the destructive one last, in red), then its
 * accounts. Below `md` the chips and the primary button take their own lines.
 */
export function ConnectionCard({
  connection,
  index,
  actions,
  onRequestDisconnect,
  onRequestDisable,
}: ConnectionCardProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { now, locale, timeZone, absolute } = useFormatters();
  const headingId = useId();
  const nowMs = now();
  const status = connection.status;
  const plan = connectionActions(status);
  const syncable = connection.accounts.filter((account) => account.status === "active").length;
  const noneToSync = syncable === 0;
  const renewing = actions.renew.isPending && actions.renew.variables?.id === connection.id;
  const syncing =
    actions.syncConnection.isPending && actions.syncConnection.variables?.id === connection.id;

  function consentChip(): { urgency: Urgency; label: string } | null {
    if (status === "revoked" || status === "error") return null;
    const consent = consentUrgency(connection.validUntil, nowMs, timeZone);
    if (status === "expired" || consent.expired) {
      if (!consent.expired) return { urgency: "danger", label: t("connection.consent.ended") };
      return {
        urgency: "danger",
        label:
          consent.daysLeft < 0
            ? t("connection.consent.expiredAgo", { count: -consent.daysLeft })
            : t("connection.consent.expiredToday"),
      };
    }
    return {
      urgency: consent.urgency,
      label:
        consent.daysLeft <= 0
          ? t("connection.consent.expiresToday")
          : t("connection.consent.expiresIn", { count: consent.daysLeft }),
    };
  }
  const chip = consentChip();

  function describe(action: ConnectionAction): MenuAction {
    if (action === "renew") {
      return {
        id: "renew",
        label: t("connection.actions.renew"),
        icon: KeyRound,
        onSelect: () => actions.renew.mutate(connection),
      };
    }
    if (action === "sync") {
      const blockedKey = plan.blocked.sync;
      const reason = blockedKey
        ? t(blockedKey)
        : noneToSync
          ? t("connection.blocked.noActiveAccounts")
          : undefined;
      return {
        id: "sync",
        label: t("connection.actions.sync", { count: syncable }),
        icon: RefreshCw,
        disabled: reason !== undefined,
        disabledReason: reason,
        onSelect: () => actions.syncConnection.mutate(connection),
      };
    }
    return {
      id: "disconnect",
      label: t("connection.actions.disconnect"),
      icon: Unplug,
      tone: "danger",
      onSelect: () => onRequestDisconnect(connection),
    };
  }

  const menu: MenuAction[] = [];
  for (const action of plan.allowed) {
    if (action !== plan.primary && action !== "disconnect") menu.push(describe(action));
  }
  for (const action of Object.keys(plan.blocked) as ConnectionAction[]) menu.push(describe(action));
  menu.push({ ...describe("disconnect"), separatorBefore: menu.length > 0 });

  const syncReason = plan.blocked.sync
    ? t(plan.blocked.sync)
    : noneToSync
      ? t("connection.blocked.noActiveAccounts")
      : undefined;

  return (
    <Cascade index={index}>
      <section aria-labelledby={headingId}>
        <Card padding="none">
          <header className="grid grid-cols-[auto_minmax(0,1fr)_auto] items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-3 px-4 py-3 md:grid-cols-[auto_minmax(0,1fr)_auto_auto_auto] md:gap-x-4">
            <BankLogo name={connection.bankName} country={connection.country} hasLogo={connection.hasLogo} />
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <h2 id={headingId} className="truncate font-display text-base font-bold text-fg">
                {connection.bankName}
              </h2>
              <p className="truncate text-xs text-muted">
                {t("connection.meta", {
                  country: regionName(connection.country, locale),
                  date: absolute(connection.createdAt),
                })}
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="md:col-start-5 md:row-start-1">
              <ActionMenu label={t("connection.actions.menu", { bank: connection.bankName })} actions={menu} />
            </div>
            <div className="col-span-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 md:col-span-1 md:col-start-3 md:row-start-1">
              <StatusPill tone={connectionTone(status)} label={t(`connection.status.${status}`)} />
              {chip ? (
                <DeadlineChip
                  urgency={chip.urgency}
                  label={chip.label}
                  title={t("connection.consent.validUntil", { date: absolute(connection.validUntil, true) })}
                />
              ) : null}
            </div>
            {plan.primary === "renew" ? (
              <Button
                data-qa-skip
                className="col-span-3 w-full md:col-span-1 md:col-start-4 md:row-start-1 md:w-auto"
                icon={KeyRound}
                loading={renewing}
                onClick={() => actions.renew.mutate(connection)}
              >
                {t("connection.actions.renew")}
              </Button>
            ) : null}
            {plan.primary === "sync" ? (
              <Button
                variant="secondary"
                className="col-span-3 w-full md:col-span-1 md:col-start-4 md:row-start-1 md:w-auto"
                icon={RefreshCw}
                loading={syncing}
                disabled={noneToSync}
                title={syncReason}
                onClick={() => actions.syncConnection.mutate(connection)}
              >
                {t("connection.actions.sync", { count: syncable })}
              </Button>
            ) : null}
          </header>

          {status !== "active" ? (
            <p className={`mx-4 mb-3 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm ${HINT_CLASSES[status]}`}>
              {t(`connection.hint.${status}`)}
            </p>
          ) : null}

          {connection.accounts.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="border-t border-subtle">
              <InlineEmpty title={t("accounts.noAccounts.title")} description={t("accounts.noAccounts.body")} />
            </div>
          ) : (
            <ul className="divide-y divide-subtle border-t border-subtle">
              {connection.accounts.map((account) => (
                <AccountRow
                  key={account.id}
                  account={account}
                  connectionStatus={status}
                  actions={actions}
                  onRequestDisable={onRequestDisable}
                />
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </Card>
      </section>
    </Cascade>
  );
}
```

`apps/web/src/pages/accounts/DisconnectDialog.tsx`:

```tsx
import type { ConnectionSummary } from "@bursar/shared";
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { api } from "../../api";
import { feedback } from "../../components/feedback";
import { Button, Dialog } from "../../components/ui";
import { formatCount } from "../../lib/connection-state";
import { useFormatters } from "../../lib/format";
import { queryKeys } from "../../lib/query-keys";
import { invalidateAccountData } from "../../lib/use-connections";
import { isGone, useReportError } from "./actions";

/** The dialog reads only these two fields, so the Account detail page can pass a partial object. */
export type DisconnectTarget = Pick<ConnectionSummary, "id" | "bankName">;

/**
 * Level-3 confirmation (UX doc §7): a question as the title, what goes away with the real counts
 * from `removal-preview`, and a button that repeats the verb. The button stays disabled until
 * the counts have loaded; Cancel never is.
 */
export function DisconnectDialog({
  connection,
  onClose,
}: {
  connection: DisconnectTarget | null;
  onClose(): void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const client = useQueryClient();
  const { locale } = useFormatters();
  const report = useReportError();
  const connectionId = connection?.id ?? 0;

  const preview = useQuery({
    queryKey: [...queryKeys.connections, connectionId, "removal-preview"],
    queryFn: () => api.removalPreview(connectionId),
    enabled: connection !== null,
    gcTime: 0,
  });

  const disconnect = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (target: DisconnectTarget) => api.disconnect(target.id),
    onSuccess: (result, target) => {
      feedback(
        t("accounts.toast.disconnected"),
        t("accounts.toast.disconnectedDetail", {
          bank: target.bankName,
          count: result.removedAccounts,
        }),
      );
      void invalidateAccountData(client);
    },
    onError: (error) => report(error, "disconnect"),
  });

  async function confirm(): Promise<void> {
    if (!connection) return;
    try {
      await disconnect.mutateAsync(connection);
      onClose();
    } catch (error) {
      if (isGone(error)) onClose();
    }
  }

  const counts = preview.data;
  return (
    <Dialog
      open={connection !== null}
      onClose={onClose}
      title={t("accounts.disconnect.title", { bank: connection?.bankName ?? "" })}
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="secondary" disabled={disconnect.isPending} onClick={onClose}>
            {t("common.cancel")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="danger"
            loading={disconnect.isPending}
            disabled={!preview.isSuccess}
            onClick={() => void confirm()}
          >
            {t("accounts.disconnect.confirm")}
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <div className="space-y-3 text-sm text-fg">
        <p>{t("accounts.disconnect.lead")}</p>
        {counts ? (
          <ul className="list-disc space-y-1 pl-5">
            <li>{t("accounts.disconnect.accounts", { count: counts.accounts })}</li>
            <li>
              {counts.transactions > 0
                ? t("accounts.disconnect.transactions", {
                    count: counts.transactions,
                    n: formatCount(locale, counts.transactions),
                  })
                : t("accounts.disconnect.noTransactions")}
            </li>
          </ul>
        ) : preview.isError ? (
          <p role="alert" className="text-danger">
            {t("accounts.disconnect.failed")}{" "}
            <button
              type="button"
              className="font-semibold underline"
              onClick={() => void preview.refetch()}
            >
              {t("accounts.disconnect.retry")}
            </button>
          </p>
        ) : (
          <p className="text-muted">{t("accounts.disconnect.loading")}</p>
        )}
        <p className="text-muted">{t("accounts.disconnect.outro")}</p>
      </div>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { RemovedAccountSummary } from "@bursar/shared";
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { api } from "../../api";
import { feedback } from "../../components/feedback";
import { ConfirmDialog } from "../../components/ui";
import { formatCount } from "../../lib/connection-state";
import { useFormatters } from "../../lib/format";
import { invalidateAccountData } from "../../lib/use-connections";
import { isGone, useReportError } from "./actions";

/**
 * Purge is a separate level-3 action (spec §6.3): the count is the one on the list, the button
 * repeats the verb with it (“Yes, purge 1,234 transactions”). An account with no transactions
 * left is simply removed.
 */
export function PurgeDialog({
  account,
  onClose,
}: {
  account: RemovedAccountSummary | null;
  onClose(): void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const client = useQueryClient();
  const { locale } = useFormatters();
  const report = useReportError();

  const purge = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (target: RemovedAccountSummary) => api.purgeAccount(target.id),
    onSuccess: (result, target) => {
      if (result.transactions === 0) {
        feedback(
          t("accounts.toast.removedAccount"),
          t("accounts.toast.removedAccountDetail", { name: target.name }),
        );
      } else {
        feedback(
          t("accounts.toast.purged"),
          t("accounts.toast.purgedDetail", {
            count: result.transactions,
            n: formatCount(locale, result.transactions),
            name: target.name,
          }),
        );
      }
      void invalidateAccountData(client);
    },
    onError: (error) => report(error, "purge"),
  });

  async function confirm(): Promise<void> {
    if (!account) return;
    try {
      await purge.mutateAsync(account);
    } catch (error) {
      // A refusal the server explains (already purged, not removed) closes the dialog; the
      // lists were refreshed. Anything else keeps it open for another try.
      if (!isGone(error)) throw error;
    }
  }

  const count = account?.transactionCount ?? 0;
  const n = formatCount(locale, count);
  const name = account?.name ?? "";
  return (
    <ConfirmDialog
      open={account !== null}
      tone="danger"
      title={count > 0 ? t("accounts.purge.title", { name }) : t("accounts.purge.titleEmpty", { name })}
      body={count > 0 ? t("accounts.purge.body", { count, n }) : t("accounts.purge.bodyEmpty", { name })}
      confirmLabel={count > 0 ? t("accounts.purge.confirm", { count, n }) : t("accounts.purge.confirmEmpty")}
      busy={purge.isPending}
      onConfirm={confirm}
      onCancel={onClose}
    />
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { RemovedAccountSummary } from "@bursar/shared";
import { useId } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Button, Card, Cascade } from "../../components/ui";
import { formatCount } from "../../lib/connection-state";
import { useFormatters } from "../../lib/format";

/**
 * Accounts of disconnected banks. Their transactions stay in Bursar until purged (spec §6.3);
 * the purge is its own level-3 action, opened by the page.
 */
export function RemovedAccounts({
  accounts,
  index,
  onRequestPurge,
}: {
  accounts: RemovedAccountSummary[];
  index: number;
  onRequestPurge(account: RemovedAccountSummary): void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { locale, relative, absolute } = useFormatters();
  const headingId = useId();
  return (
    <Cascade index={index}>
      <section aria-labelledby={headingId}>
        <Card padding="none">
          <div className="px-4 py-3">
            <h2 id={headingId} className="font-display text-base font-bold text-fg">
              {t("accounts.removed.title")}
            </h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted">{t("accounts.removed.description")}</p>
          </div>
          <ul className="divide-y divide-subtle border-t border-subtle">
            {accounts.map((account) => (
              <li
                key={account.id}
                className="flex flex-col gap-2 px-4 py-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between sm:gap-4"
              >
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <p className="truncate font-medium text-fg">{account.name}</p>
                  <p className="truncate text-xs text-muted">
                    {account.bankName}
                    {account.maskedIdentifier ? (
                      <>
                        {" · "}
                        <span className="font-mono">{account.maskedIdentifier}</span>
                      </>
                    ) : null}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-2 sm:justify-end">
                  <span className="tabular text-sm text-fg">
                    {t("accounts.removed.transactions", {
                      count: account.transactionCount,
                      n: formatCount(locale, account.transactionCount),
                    })}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted" title={absolute(account.removedAt, true)}>
                    {t("accounts.removed.since", { when: relative(account.removedAt) })}
                  </span>
                  <Button variant="danger" size="sm" onClick={() => onRequestPurge(account)}>
                    {account.transactionCount > 0
                      ? t("accounts.removed.purge")
                      : t("accounts.removed.remove")}
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </Card>
      </section>
```

```tsx
import type { AccountSummary, ConnectionSummary, RemovedAccountSummary } from "@bursar/shared";
import { CircleCheck, Landmark, RefreshCw, TriangleAlert } from "lucide-react";
import { type ReactNode, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import {
  Button,
  Card,
  ConfirmDialog,
  EmptyState,
  InlineEmpty,
  PageHeader,
} from "../components/ui";
import { allUpdatedToday, attentionRank } from "../lib/connection-state";
import { useFormatters } from "../lib/format";
import { naturalCollator } from "../lib/search";
import { useConnectionsQuery } from "../lib/use-connections";
import { isGone, useAccountActions } from "./accounts/actions";
import { ConnectionCard } from "./accounts/ConnectionCard";
import { DisconnectDialog } from "./accounts/DisconnectDialog";
import { PurgeDialog } from "./accounts/PurgeDialog";
import { RemovedAccounts } from "./accounts/RemovedAccounts";

const SKELETON_WIDTHS = ["w-48", "w-64", "w-40"] as const;

function AccountsSkeleton() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  return (
    <div aria-busy="true" className="space-y-6">
      <span className="sr-only">{t("accounts.loading")}</span>
      {["first", "second"].map((card) => (
        <Card key={card} padding="none">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3">
            <div className="size-10 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-surface-2" />
            <div className="h-4 w-40 animate-pulse rounded bg-surface-2" />
          </div>
          <div className="divide-y divide-subtle border-t border-subtle">
            {SKELETON_WIDTHS.map((width) => (
              <div key={width} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 px-4 py-4">
                <div className={`h-4 ${width} animate-pulse rounded bg-surface-2`} />
                <div className="h-4 w-24 animate-pulse rounded bg-surface-2" />
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </Card>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Accounts (UX doc §4): connections grouped by bank, each with the actions of its state machine,
 * the accounts of the connection, and the disconnected accounts that still hold transactions.
 */
export function AccountsPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { locale, now, timeZone } = useFormatters();
  const query = useConnectionsQuery();
  const actions = useAccountActions();
  const [disconnecting, setDisconnecting] = useState<ConnectionSummary | null>(null);
  const [disabling, setDisabling] = useState<AccountSummary | null>(null);
  const [purging, setPurging] = useState<RemovedAccountSummary | null>(null);

  const data = query.data;
  const connections = useMemo(() => {
    const collator = naturalCollator(locale);
    return [...(data?.connections ?? [])].sort(
      (a, b) =>
        attentionRank(a.status) - attentionRank(b.status) ||
        collator.compare(a.bankName, b.bankName) ||
        a.createdAt - b.createdAt,
    );
  }, [data, locale]);
  const removed = data?.removedAccounts ?? [];
  const accountCount = connections.reduce((total, connection) => total + connection.accounts.length, 0);

  let content: ReactNode;
  if (!data) {
    content = query.isError ? (
      <Card>
        <EmptyState
          kind="state"
          icon={TriangleAlert}
          title={t("accounts.loadError.title")}
          description={t("accounts.loadError.body")}
          action={
            <Button variant="secondary" icon={RefreshCw} onClick={() => void query.refetch()}>
              {t("accounts.retry")}
            </Button>
          }
        />
      </Card>
    ) : (
      <AccountsSkeleton />
    );
  } else if (connections.length === 0 && removed.length === 0) {
    content = (
      <Card>
        <EmptyState
          kind="empty"
          icon={Landmark}
          title={t("accounts.empty.title")}
          description={t("accounts.empty.body")}
        />
      </Card>
    );
  } else {
    content = (
      <div className="space-y-6">
        {allUpdatedToday(connections, now(), timeZone) ? (
          <p className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-surface-2 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium text-positive">
            <CircleCheck aria-hidden size={18} strokeWidth={1.75} />
            {t("accounts.allUpdated")}
          </p>
        ) : null}
        {connections.length === 0 ? (
          <Card>
            <InlineEmpty
              icon={Landmark}
              title={t("accounts.noConnections.title")}
              description={t("accounts.noConnections.body")}
            />
          </Card>
        ) : null}
        {connections.map((connection, index) => (
          <ConnectionCard
            key={connection.id}
            connection={connection}
            index={index}
            actions={actions}
            onRequestDisconnect={setDisconnecting}
            onRequestDisable={setDisabling}
          />
        ))}
        {removed.length > 0 ? (
          <RemovedAccounts accounts={removed} index={connections.length} onRequestPurge={setPurging} />
        ) : null}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title={t("routes.accounts.title")}
        count={data ? accountCount : undefined}
        subtitle={t("accounts.subtitle")}
      />
      {content}

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={disabling !== null}
        tone="primary"
        title={t("accounts.disable.title", { name: disabling?.name ?? "" })}
        body={t("accounts.disable.body", { name: disabling?.name ?? "" })}
        confirmLabel={t("accounts.disable.confirm")}
        busy={actions.setEnabled.isPending}
        onConfirm={async () => {
          if (!disabling) return;
          try {
            await actions.setEnabled.mutateAsync({ account: disabling, enabled: false });
          } catch (error) {
            // A refusal the server explains (the account was disconnected meanwhile) closes the
            // dialog, the lists were refreshed; anything else keeps it open for another try.
            if (!isGone(error)) throw error;
          }
        }}
        onCancel={() => setDisabling(null)}
      />
      <DisconnectDialog connection={disconnecting} onClose={() => setDisconnecting(null)} />
      <PurgeDialog account={purging} onClose={() => setPurging(null)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

```ts
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { countNeedingAction } from "../lib/connection-state";
import { useConnectionsQuery } from "../lib/use-connections";
import type { RouteId } from "./routes";

export interface NavBadge {
  count: number;
  tone: "neutral" | "accent";
}

const NO_BADGES: Partial<Record<RouteId, NavBadge>> = Object.freeze({});

/**
 * Sidebar badges by route: neutral for a total, accent for a count that needs action. Accounts
 * gets an accent badge with the number of connections that are expiring, expired, revoked or in
 * error, read from the same `connections` query as the Accounts page.
 */
export function useNavBadges(): Partial<Record<RouteId, NavBadge>> {
  const { data } = useConnectionsQuery();
  return useMemo(() => {
    const count = countNeedingAction(data?.connections ?? []);
    return count > 0 ? { accounts: { count, tone: "accent" as const } } : NO_BADGES;
  }, [data]);
}
```

Add above `PALETTE_SOURCES`:

```ts
/**
 * Accounts by name, bank and the last four IBAN digits. They appear only once the query has two
 * characters (records are never listed for an empty query), and the connections are fetched only
 * then. The result opens the account's page, or the Accounts list while that page is not shipped.
 */
const accountsSource: PaletteSource = {
  id: "accounts",
  minQueryLength: 2,
  limit: 6,
  useItems(query) {
    const { t } = useTranslation();
    const enabled = normalizeForSearch(query).length >= 2;
    const connections = useConnectionsQuery({ enabled });
    const data = connections.data;
    const items = useMemo(() => {
      if (!enabled || !data) return [];
      const group = t("palette.groups.accounts");
      return data.connections.flatMap((connection) =>
        connection.accounts
          .filter((account) =>
            matchesQuery(
              [account.name, account.bankProduct ?? "", connection.bankName, account.last4 ?? ""],
              query,
            ),
          )
          .map(
            (account): PaletteItem => ({
              id: `account:${account.id}`,
              group,
              title: account.name,
              subtitle: connection.bankName,
              icon: Wallet,
              to: accountDetailPath(account.id) ?? buildPath("accounts"),
              trailing: createElement(NetChip, {
                netMinor: account.net30d.netMinor,
                currency: account.currency,
              }),
            }),
          ),
      );
    }, [data, enabled, query, t]);
    return { items, loading: enabled && connections.isPending };
  },
};
```

- Modify: `apps/web/src/api.ts`, `apps/web/src/app/routes.ts`, `apps/web/src/app/pages.ts`, `apps/web/qa/extra-paths.ts`, `apps/web/src/i18n/en.json`, `apps/web/src/i18n/it.json`
- Modify (not in the skeleton): `apps/web/src/app/routes.test.ts` (its list of shipped routes gains `account`)
- Test: `apps/web/src/components/charts/BalanceChart.test.tsx`, `apps/web/src/pages/AccountDetailPage.test.tsx`; plus `apps/web/src/pages/account/account-state.test.ts` (new: the pure alert, stripe and action rules)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: shared `AccountDetailResponse`, `BalanceHistoryResponse`, `CashFlowResponse`, `TransactionListResponse`, `SyncRunItem`; routes `GET /api/accounts/:id`, `GET /api/accounts/:id/balance-history?days=90`, `GET /api/cashflow?accountId=`, `GET /api/transactions?accountId=&pageSize=20`; Task 18 `connectionActions`, `api.syncAccount`, `api.renewConnection`, `NicknameEditor`, `useAccountActions().rename` (`pages/accounts/actions.ts`), `DisconnectDialog`; Task 17 `CashFlowStrip`, `api.cashflow`.
- Produces:
  - `api.ts`: `account(id: number): Promise<AccountDetailResponse>`, `balanceHistory(id: number, days: 30 | 90 | 365): Promise<BalanceHistoryResponse>`, `transactions(params: Record<string, string>): Promise<TransactionListResponse>` (added here; Task 21 reuses). `cashflow(params: { accountId?: number; from?: string; to?: string; currency?: string }): Promise<CashFlowResponse | null>` comes from Task 17 and is reused, not added.
  - `BalanceChart` props `{ points: { date: LocalDate; balanceMinor: number }[]; currency: string; summaryLabel: string; height?: number }` (Recharts area/line, negative segment in `danger`, privacy-aware tooltip, SR summary).
  - Route `account` shipped (`/accounts/:accountId`, parent `accounts`); `QA_EXTRA_PATHS` gains `/accounts/999999` (not found), `/accounts/1?tab=transactions`, `/accounts/1?tab=connection`.
  - i18n prefix `account.*`.

**Additions to the contract (all additive, no name above changes):**
- `pages/account/account-state.ts` holds the rules the three tabs and the hero share, as pure functions so a table test covers them: `type AccountTab = "overview" | "transactions" | "connection"`, `ACCOUNT_TABS`, `isAccountTab(value: string): value is AccountTab`; `stripeTone(detail): "positive" | "warning" | "danger" | "neutral"`; `statusPill(detail): { tone; key }`; `deriveAlerts(detail, now, timeZone): AccountAlert[]` (empty array = "All good"); `accountActionStates(detail, now): AccountActionState[]` (primary first; `blockedKey` is the i18n key of the reason an action cannot run, shown as the button `title`).
- `pages/account/labels.ts`: `errorLabel(t, code)` (translated sentence for a stored Enable Banking or Bursar error code, generic sentence for an unknown or null code, never the raw code), `skipReasonLabel(t, reason)`, `consentLabel(t, { expired, daysLeft })`.
- `pages/account/useAccountActions.ts`: `useAccountActions(detail)` returns `{ run(action: "sync" | "renew" | "enable"): void; pending: Record<"sync" | "renew" | "enable", boolean> }`, shared by the hero, the alerts and the Connection tab. All its feedback goes through `feedback()`.
- `BalanceChart.tsx` also exports `buildBalanceRows`, `balanceDomain`, `axisTicks` and the types `BalancePoint`, `BalanceChartProps` (pure helpers, tested directly). `BalanceChart` renders nothing when it gets fewer than two points; the page decides what to show instead.
- `QA_EXTRA_PATHS` gains six more state URLs besides the three of the contract (seeded accounts 3, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 10, see Step 11).
- i18n: every string of this task is under the `account.*` prefix (plural keys follow the Task 2 convention: Italian `_one`/`_many`/`_other`, English `_one`/`_other`).

**Assumptions about neighbouring tasks (all reported to the plan reviewer; reconcile when Task 17 and Task 18 are written):**
- Task 18 `NicknameEditor` takes `{ name, nickname, placeholder, disabled?, to?, onSave(nickname): Promise<void> }` and leaves saving and toasts to the caller. `AccountHero` passes `name={account.name}`, `nickname={account.nickname}`, the same `placeholder` expression as Task 18's `AccountRow`, and an `onSave` that awaits `rename.mutateAsync({ account, nickname })` from Task 18's `useAccountActions()` in `pages/accounts/actions.ts` (imported as `useAccountsPageActions` to avoid the name clash with this task's hook). That mutation calls `api.updateAccount(id, { nickname })`, shows the "Account renamed" toast through `feedback()`, reports a failure (the editor then stays open) and calls `invalidateAccountData(client)` from `lib/use-connections.ts`, which invalidates the `["accounts"]` prefix (covering `queryKeys.account(id)`) and `queryKeys.connections`. The editor's pencil button is named `accounts.row.rename` ("Rename …", matches `/rename/i`).
- Task 18 `DisconnectDialog` is used as `<DisconnectDialog connection={{ id, bankName } | null} onClose={() => …} />` (open when `connection` is not null) and does the removal preview, the confirmation, the request, the toast and the cache invalidation itself. The skeleton lists `connectionActions` (which includes `disconnect`) but not this dialog in Task 19's Consumes, so the Connection tab would otherwise have no way to disconnect.
- Task 18 `api.updateAccount(id, { status: "active" })` backs the "Enable account" action.
- Task 17 `components/charts/chart-colors.ts` exports `useChartColors()` (`{ positive, ink, danger, muted, primary, grid, surface }`, re-read on a theme change) and `tokenColor`; `BalanceChart` uses `useChartColors()` (`grid` is the `--border` token) instead of reading the tokens itself.
- Error codes are translated once, by Task 17's `syncErrorText` (`syncErrors.*`, in `app/useLiveEvents.ts`); `labels.ts` `errorLabel` delegates to it, and this task adds no `account.errors.*` keys.
- Task 17 `useSettingsQuery()` supplies `highlightNegativeNet` for the cash-flow strip (default `true` while loading).
- Task 16: `GET /api/accounts/:id/balance-history` for an account that has no balance answers 404 `not_found` (as `balanceHistory(): … | null` suggests) or 200 with fewer than two points; the page treats both as "no balance history yet". `GET /api/cashflow` answers 204 for "no data"; `api.cashflow` maps it to `null`. Task 16 documents the sign convention (`inMinor`/`outMinor` non-negative, `netMinor = inMinor - outMinor`); the page shows `totals.netMinor` next to the strip.

**Notes for neighbouring tasks:**
- Task 21 ships `/transactions` and adds the "See all in Transactions" link (`/transactions?accountId=<id>`) at the end of `TransactionsTab.tsx`, below the "Showing the latest …" line. This task's test "lists the latest transactions and has no link to the full list until it exists" asserts that no link to `/transactions` is rendered; Task 21 Step 19 renames it and flips that assertion (link href `/transactions?accountId=1&period=all`) in its own commit.
- The page is registered as route `account`; `buildPath("account", { accountId })` is the way to link to it. Task 22's stories can start from `/accounts/1`.

**Implementation notes (read before Step 1):**
- `BalanceChart` draws the series as two Recharts `Area`s: a non-negative one in `primary` and a non-positive one in `danger`. Where two neighbouring points have opposite signs `buildBalanceRows` inserts an interpolated row at the exact zero crossing, so the colour changes at zero. No gradient tricks, no float arithmetic on amounts: the value-axis labels divide the minor units with `BigInt` before `Intl.NumberFormat` (compact notation) formats them, the tooltip uses `<Money>`, and the change over the period is an integer subtraction. In privacy mode the value axis is hidden and the tooltip is masked by `<Money>`. Colours are read from the CSS tokens (`--primary`, `--danger`, …, RGB triplets) with `getComputedStyle` and re-read when `data-theme` changes; animation is off (`isAnimationActive={false}`) and the Recharts accessibility layer is off because the wrapper is a single `role="img"` described by `summaryLabel`. The component was run against Recharts 3.10.1 and jsdom while this plan was written: the 11 tests of Step 1 pass there.
- jsdom has no layout, so `BalanceChart.test.tsx` replaces `ResponsiveContainer` with a function that gives its chart a fixed 600 × 240 size. `AccountDetailPage.test.tsx` mocks `BalanceChart` and `CashFlowStrip` (their own tests cover them) and `DisconnectDialog`, and stubs `fetch` with a small router keyed by method and path that records every call. Dates: the test freezes only `Date` (`vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ["Date"] })`), 9 Nov 2026 10:00 in `Europe/Rome`, and wraps the page in `FormatProvider timeZone="Europe/Rome"`, so the 30-day window is `2026-10-11`..`2026-11-09` on every machine.
- While this plan was written the page test was run against stand-ins that implement the Interfaces of Tasks 3, 4, 17 and 18 (77 tests in the three files). Where the real components differ in markup, adapt the selector, not the behaviour under test. The test relies on: `Tabs` rendering `role="tab"` with `aria-selected` and the count inside the tab's text; `DataTable` naming its table with `caption`; `Toaster` rendering a toast's title and detail as separate text; `EmptyState`/`InlineEmpty` rendering title and description as text; `Money` formatting `4,200.00` for 420000 EUR in `en-GB`; `Breadcrumbs` having `aria-label` "Breadcrumb" (Task 4).
- Nothing on the page shows an id: not-found text, breadcrumbs, toasts and dialogs name the account, the bank or the page. Ids appear only in URLs, query keys and component props.
- Counts go through i18next plurals (`count`), dates through `useFormatters()`, amounts through `<Money>` or `money()`; tones through `amountTone`-backed components; no `dark:`, palette colour or hex literal (the Task 2 `rules.test.ts` scans every source).

```tsx
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import { cloneElement, type ReactElement } from "react";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { useUi } from "../../store/ui";
import { axisTicks, BalanceChart, balanceDomain, buildBalanceRows } from "./BalanceChart";

vi.mock("recharts", async (importOriginal) => {
  const original = await importOriginal<typeof import("recharts")>();
  return {
    ...original,
    ResponsiveContainer: ({
      children,
    }: {
      children: ReactElement<{ width?: number; height?: number }>;
    }) => cloneElement(children, { width: 600, height: 240 }),
  };
});

const POSITIVE = [
  { date: "2026-11-01", balanceMinor: 100_000 },
  { date: "2026-11-02", balanceMinor: 120_000 },
  { date: "2026-11-03", balanceMinor: 90_000 },
];
const DIPPING = [
  { date: "2026-11-01", balanceMinor: 20_000 },
  { date: "2026-11-02", balanceMinor: -10_000 },
  { date: "2026-11-03", balanceMinor: -30_000 },
  { date: "2026-11-04", balanceMinor: 5_000 },
];

describe("buildBalanceRows", () => {
  it("keeps one row per point when the balance never changes sign", () => {
    const rows = buildBalanceRows(POSITIVE);
    expect(rows.map((row) => row.x)).toEqual([0, 1, 2]);
    expect(rows.every((row) => row.negative === null)).toBe(true);
  });
  it("adds an interpolated row at each zero crossing", () => {
    const rows = buildBalanceRows(DIPPING);
    expect(rows).toHaveLength(6);
    expect(rows.map((row) => row.index)).toEqual([0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 3]);
    expect(rows[1]?.x).toBeCloseTo(2 / 3, 5);
    expect(rows[1]).toMatchObject({ positive: 0, negative: 0 });
    expect(rows[4]?.x).toBeCloseTo(2 + 6 / 7, 5);
    expect(rows[0]).toMatchObject({ positive: 20_000, negative: null });
    expect(rows[2]).toMatchObject({ positive: null, negative: -10_000 });
  });
  it("treats a zero balance as both sides without a crossing row", () => {
    const rows = buildBalanceRows([
      { date: "2026-11-01", balanceMinor: 5 },
      { date: "2026-11-02", balanceMinor: 0 },
      { date: "2026-11-03", balanceMinor: -5 },
    ]);
    expect(rows).toHaveLength(3);
    expect(rows[1]).toMatchObject({ positive: 0, negative: 0 });
  });
});

describe("balanceDomain and axisTicks", () => {
  it("keeps a series that stays positive above zero", () => {
    const [low, high] = balanceDomain([100, 100]);
    expect(low).toBe(0);
    expect(high).toBe(200);
  });
  it("includes zero when the series dips below it", () => {
    const [low, high] = balanceDomain([-500, -100]);
    expect(low).toBeLessThan(-500);
    expect(high).toBe(0);
  });
  it("spreads at most five ticks over the indices", () => {
    expect(axisTicks(90)).toEqual([0, 22, 45, 67, 89]);
    expect(axisTicks(2)).toEqual([0, 1]);
  });
});

describe("BalanceChart", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--primary", "30 42 74");
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--danger", "185 28 28");
  });
  afterEach(() => {
    document.documentElement.style.removeProperty("--primary");
    document.documentElement.style.removeProperty("--danger");
    useUi.setState({ privacy: false });
  });

  it("describes the chart for screen readers", () => {
    render(
      <BalanceChart
        points={POSITIVE}
        currency="EUR"
        summaryLabel="Balance from 1,000.00 to 900.00"
      />,
    );
    expect(screen.getByRole("img", { name: "Balance from 1,000.00 to 900.00" })).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it("draws a series that stays positive in the primary colour only", () => {
    const { container } = render(
      <BalanceChart points={POSITIVE} currency="EUR" summaryLabel="s" />,
    );
    const strokes = [...container.querySelectorAll("path.recharts-area-curve")].map((path) =>
      path.getAttribute("stroke"),
    );
    expect(strokes).toEqual(["rgb(30 42 74)"]);
  });

  it("draws the negative stretch in the danger colour", () => {
    const { container } = render(<BalanceChart points={DIPPING} currency="EUR" summaryLabel="s" />);
    const strokes = [...container.querySelectorAll("path.recharts-area-curve")].map((path) =>
      path.getAttribute("stroke"),
    );
    expect(strokes).toContain("rgb(30 42 74)");
    expect(strokes).toContain("rgb(185 28 28)");
    expect(container.querySelector(".recharts-reference-line")).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it("hides the value axis in privacy mode", () => {
    const { container, rerender } = render(
      <BalanceChart points={POSITIVE} currency="EUR" summaryLabel="s" />,
    );
    expect(container.querySelector(".recharts-yAxis")).not.toBeNull();
    useUi.setState({ privacy: true });
    rerender(<BalanceChart points={POSITIVE} currency="EUR" summaryLabel="s" />);
    expect(container.querySelector(".recharts-yAxis")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("renders nothing with fewer than two points", () => {
    const { container } = render(
      <BalanceChart points={POSITIVE.slice(0, 1)} currency="EUR" summaryLabel="s" />,
    );
    expect(container.firstChild).toBeNull();
  });
});
```
