```ts
import type { AccountDetailResponse, AccountSummary } from "@bursar/shared";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  accountActionStates,
  deriveAlerts,
  isAccountTab,
  statusPill,
  stripeTone,
} from "./account-state";

const NOW = Date.parse("2026-11-09T09:00:00Z");
const HOUR = 3_600_000;
const DAY = 24 * HOUR;
const ZONE = "Europe/Rome";

function detail(
  account: Partial<AccountSummary> = {},
  connection: Partial<AccountDetailResponse["connection"]> = {},
): AccountDetailResponse {
  return {
    account: {
      id: 1,
      connectionId: 3,
      name: "Conto Smart",
      nickname: null,
      bankProduct: null,
      maskedIdentifier: "IT95 •••• •••• 0001",
      iban: null,
      last4: "0001",
      currency: "EUR",
      cashAccountType: "CACC",
      status: "active",
      balance: null,
      net30d: { inMinor: 0, outMinor: 0, netMinor: 0 },
      daily30d: [],
      lastSyncedAt: NOW - HOUR,
      lastSyncError: null,
      rateLimitedUntil: null,
      syncInProgress: false,
      ...account,
    },
    connection: {
      id: 3,
      bankName: "Banca Esempio",
      country: "IT",
      hasLogo: false,
      status: "active",
      validUntil: NOW + 88 * DAY,
      createdAt: NOW - 100 * DAY,
      renewedAt: null,
      lastError: null,
      ...connection,
    },
    syncRuns: [],
    transactionCount: 0,
  };
}

const ids = (d: AccountDetailResponse): string[] =>
  deriveAlerts(d, NOW, ZONE).map((alert) => alert.id);

describe("isAccountTab", () => {
  it("accepts the three tabs and nothing else", () => {
    expect(["overview", "transactions", "connection"].every(isAccountTab)).toBe(true);
    expect(["", "Overview", "settings", "transactions "].some(isAccountTab)).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("deriveAlerts", () => {
  it("returns nothing for a healthy account", () => {
    expect(ids(detail())).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("maps the connection states to danger alerts with a renew action", () => {
    for (const [status, id] of [
      ["expired", "expired"],
      ["revoked", "revoked"],
      ["error", "connectionError"],
    ] as const) {
      const [alert] = deriveAlerts(detail({}, { status }), NOW, ZONE);
      expect(alert).toMatchObject({ id, tone: "danger", action: { kind: "run", action: "renew" } });
    }
  });

  it("counts calendar days for an expiring consent and turns danger within three days", () => {
    const at = (days: number) =>
      deriveAlerts(detail({}, { status: "expiring", validUntil: NOW + days * DAY }), NOW, ZONE)[0];
    expect(at(9)).toMatchObject({ id: "expiring", tone: "warning", values: { count: 9 } });
    expect(at(3)).toMatchObject({ id: "expiring", tone: "danger", values: { count: 3 } });
    expect(at(1)).toMatchObject({ id: "expiring", tone: "danger", values: { count: 1 } });
    expect(
      deriveAlerts(detail({}, { status: "expiring", validUntil: NOW + 2 * HOUR }), NOW, ZONE)[0],
    ).toMatchObject({ id: "expiringToday", tone: "danger" });
  });

  it("gives a removed account that single alert and nothing else", () => {
    const removed = detail(
      { status: "removed", lastSyncError: { code: "X", at: NOW } },
      { status: "revoked" },
    );
    expect(ids(removed)).toEqual(["removed"]);
    expect(deriveAlerts(removed, NOW, ZONE)[0]?.action).toEqual({ kind: "accounts" });
  });

  it("flags unavailable and disabled accounts", () => {
    expect(ids(detail({ status: "unavailable" }))).toEqual(["unavailable"]);
    expect(deriveAlerts(detail({ status: "disabled" }), NOW, ZONE)[0]).toMatchObject({
      id: "disabled",
      action: { kind: "run", action: "enable" },
    });
  });

  it("prefers the rate limit to a failed update and ignores a limit in the past", () => {
    const failed = { code: "ASPSP_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED", at: NOW - HOUR };
    expect(ids(detail({ rateLimitedUntil: NOW + HOUR, lastSyncError: failed }))).toEqual([
      "rateLimited",
    ]);
    expect(ids(detail({ rateLimitedUntil: NOW - HOUR, lastSyncError: failed }))).toEqual([
      "syncFailed",
    ]);
  });

  it("does not repeat a consent problem as a failed update", () => {
    const failed = { code: "EXPIRED_SESSION", at: NOW - HOUR };
    expect(ids(detail({ lastSyncError: failed }, { status: "expired" }))).toEqual(["expired"]);
    expect(ids(detail({ lastSyncError: failed }, { status: "expiring" }))).toEqual([
      "expiring",
      "syncFailed",
    ]);
  });

  it("tells a never-synced account from one whose first sync is running", () => {
    expect(ids(detail({ lastSyncedAt: null }))).toEqual(["neverSynced"]);
    expect(ids(detail({ lastSyncedAt: null, syncInProgress: true }))).toEqual(["firstSync"]);
    expect(
      deriveAlerts(detail({ lastSyncedAt: null, syncInProgress: true }), NOW, ZONE)[0]?.action,
    ).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe("stripeTone and statusPill", () => {
  it("follows the connection, then downgrades a healthy one for account problems", () => {
    expect(stripeTone(detail())).toBe("positive");
    expect(stripeTone(detail({}, { status: "expiring" }))).toBe("warning");
    expect(stripeTone(detail({}, { status: "revoked" }))).toBe("danger");
    expect(stripeTone(detail({ status: "unavailable" }))).toBe("warning");
    expect(stripeTone(detail({ lastSyncError: { code: null, at: NOW } }))).toBe("warning");
    expect(stripeTone(detail({ status: "disabled" }, { status: "expired" }))).toBe("neutral");
    expect(stripeTone(detail({ status: "removed" }))).toBe("neutral");
  });

  it("shows one pill: the account state when it is not active, else the connection state", () => {
    expect(statusPill(detail())).toEqual({ tone: "positive", key: "active" });
    expect(statusPill(detail({}, { status: "expiring" }))).toEqual({
      tone: "warning",
      key: "expiring",
    });
    expect(statusPill(detail({ status: "disabled" }, { status: "expired" }))).toEqual({
      tone: "neutral",
      key: "disabled",
    });
    expect(statusPill(detail({ status: "unavailable" }))).toEqual({
      tone: "warning",
      key: "unavailable",
    });
  });
});

describe("accountActionStates", () => {
  const actions = (d: AccountDetailResponse) =>
    accountActionStates(d, NOW).map(
      (s) => `${s.action}${s.primary ? "*" : ""}${s.blockedKey ? "!" : ""}`,
    );

  it("makes sync primary on an active connection and keeps renew and disconnect", () => {
    expect(actions(detail())).toEqual(["sync*", "renew", "disconnect"]);
  });

  it("makes renew primary when the consent is expiring", () => {
    expect(accountActionStates(detail({}, { status: "expiring" }), NOW)[0]).toMatchObject({
      action: "renew",
      primary: true,
      blockedKey: null,
    });
  });

  it("blocks sync with the reason from the state machine when the consent ended", () => {
    const states = accountActionStates(detail({}, { status: "expired" }), NOW);
    expect(states.map((s) => s.action)).toEqual(["renew", "sync", "disconnect"]);
    expect(states.find((s) => s.action === "sync")?.blockedKey).toBeTruthy();
    expect(states[0]).toMatchObject({ action: "renew", primary: true, blockedKey: null });
  });

  it("blocks sync while syncing, while rate limited and on an unavailable account", () => {
    const reason = (d: AccountDetailResponse) =>
      accountActionStates(d, NOW).find((s) => s.action === "sync")?.blockedKey;
    expect(reason(detail({ syncInProgress: true }))).toBe("account.actions.blocked.syncing");
    expect(reason(detail({ rateLimitedUntil: NOW + HOUR }))).toBe(
      "account.actions.blocked.rateLimited",
    );
    expect(reason(detail({ rateLimitedUntil: NOW - HOUR }))).toBeNull();
    expect(reason(detail({ status: "unavailable" }))).toBe("account.actions.blocked.unavailable");
  });

  it("puts enable first for a disabled account and blocks its sync", () => {
    const states = accountActionStates(detail({ status: "disabled" }), NOW);
    expect(states[0]).toMatchObject({ action: "enable", primary: true, blockedKey: null });
    expect(states.find((s) => s.action === "sync")).toMatchObject({
      primary: false,
      blockedKey: "account.actions.blocked.disabled",
    });
  });

  it("has no actions for a removed account", () => {
    expect(actions(detail({ status: "removed" }))).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

```tsx
}));

function makeDetail(
  patch: {
    account?: Partial<AccountSummary>;
    connection?: Partial<AccountDetailResponse["connection"]>;
    syncRuns?: SyncRunItem[];
  } = {},
): AccountDetailResponse {
  return {
    account: { ...ACCOUNT, ...patch.account },
    connection: { ...CONNECTION, ...patch.connection },
    syncRuns: patch.syncRuns ?? RUNS,
    transactionCount: 57,
  };
}

interface Call {
  method: string;
  path: string;
  search: URLSearchParams;
  body: unknown;
}

interface Server {
  detail: AccountDetailResponse | null;
  settingsHighlight: boolean;
  balanceStatus: number;
  cashflow: CashFlowResponse | null;
  syncResponse: { status: number; body: unknown };
  calls: Call[];
}

let server: Server;

function respond(status: number, body?: unknown): Response {
  return new Response(body === undefined ? null : JSON.stringify(body), {
    status,
    headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
  });
}

/** A fetch stub that answers the account endpoints from `server` and records every call. */
function stubFetch() {
  const fetchMock = vi.fn(async (input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit) => {
    const url = new URL(String(input), "http://localhost");
    const call: Call = {
      method: init?.method ?? "GET",
      path: url.pathname,
      search: url.searchParams,
      body: typeof init?.body === "string" ? JSON.parse(init.body) : undefined,
    };
    server.calls.push(call);
    const key = `${call.method} ${call.path}`;
    if (key === "GET /api/accounts/1") {
      return server.detail
        ? respond(200, server.detail)
        : respond(404, { error: "Not found", code: "not_found" });
    }
    if (key === "GET /api/accounts/1/balance-history") {
      return server.balanceStatus === 200
        ? respond(200, {
            currency: "EUR",
            points: [
              { date: "2026-08-12", balanceMinor: 300_000 },
              { date: "2026-10-01", balanceMinor: 250_000 },
              { date: "2026-11-09", balanceMinor: 420_000 },
            ],
          })
        : respond(server.balanceStatus, { error: "Not found", code: "not_found" });
    }
    if (key === "GET /api/cashflow") {
      return server.cashflow ? respond(200, server.cashflow) : respond(204);
    }
    if (key === "GET /api/transactions") return respond(200, TRANSACTIONS);
    if (key === "GET /api/settings") {
      return respond(200, {
        values: { highlightNegativeNet: server.settingsHighlight },
        system: { timezone: "Europe/Rome" },
      });
    }
    if (key === "POST /api/accounts/1/sync") {
      return respond(server.syncResponse.status, server.syncResponse.body);
    }
    if (key === "POST /api/connections/3/renew") {
      return respond(200, { redirectUrl: "https://bank.example.test/authorise?state=abc" });
    }
    if (key === "PATCH /api/accounts/1") {
      const patch = call.body as { nickname?: string | null; status?: "active" | "disabled" };
      if (server.detail && patch.nickname !== undefined) {
        server.detail = makeDetail({
          account: {
            ...server.detail.account,
            nickname: patch.nickname,
            name: patch.nickname ?? "Conto Smart",
          },
          connection: server.detail.connection,
        });
      }
      if (server.detail && patch.status !== undefined) {
        server.detail = makeDetail({
          account: { ...server.detail.account, status: patch.status },
          connection: server.detail.connection,
        });
      }
      return respond(200, server.detail?.account);
    }
    return respond(404, { error: "Not found" });
  });
  vi.stubGlobal("fetch", fetchMock);
  return fetchMock;
}

function renderPage(path = "/accounts/1") {
  return renderRoutes(
    [
      {
        path: "/accounts/:accountId",
        element: (
          <FormatProvider timeZone="Europe/Rome">
            <Toaster />
            <AccountDetailPage />
          </FormatProvider>
        ),
      },
      { path: "/accounts", element: <p>Accounts list</p> },
    ],
    { initialEntries: [path] },
  );
}

function callsTo(method: string, path: string): Call[] {
  return server.calls.filter((call) => call.method === method && call.path === path);
}

beforeEach(async () => {
  await i18n.changeLanguage("en");
  vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ["Date"], now: NOW });
  server = {
    detail: makeDetail(),
    settingsHighlight: true,
    balanceStatus: 200,
    cashflow: CASHFLOW,
    syncResponse: { status: 202, body: { queued: 1 } },
    calls: [],
  };
  stubFetch();
});

afterEach(() => {
  vi.useRealTimers();
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
});

describe("AccountDetailPage hero", () => {
  it("shows name, bank, masked IBAN, one status pill, balance and a stripe in the state colour", async () => {
    renderPage();
    expect((await screen.findByRole("heading", { level: 1 })).textContent).toContain("Conto Smart");
    expect(screen.getByText("Banca Esempio")).not.toBeNull();
    expect(screen.getByText("IT95 •••• •••• 0001")).not.toBeNull();
    expect(screen.getByText("Active")).not.toBeNull();
    expect(screen.getByText(/4,200\.00/)).not.toBeNull();
    expect(screen.getByText("Updated 2 hours ago")).not.toBeNull();
    expect(screen.getByTestId("status-stripe").getAttribute("data-tone")).toBe("positive");
    expect(screen.getByRole("navigation", { name: "Breadcrumb" }).textContent).toContain(
      "Conto Smart",
    );
  });

  it.each([
    ["an expired connection", { connection: { status: "expired" as const } }, "danger"],
    ["an expiring connection", { connection: { status: "expiring" as const } }, "warning"],
    ["a disabled account", { account: { status: "disabled" as const } }, "neutral"],
    ["an unavailable account", { account: { status: "unavailable" as const } }, "warning"],
    [
      "a failed last update",
      { account: { lastSyncError: { code: "ASPSP_ERROR", at: NOW - HOUR } } },
      "warning",
    ],
  ])("colours the stripe for %s", async (_name, patch, tone) => {
    server.detail = makeDetail(patch);
    renderPage();
    expect((await screen.findByTestId("status-stripe")).getAttribute("data-tone")).toBe(tone);
  });

  it("renames the account in place and shows the new name", async () => {
    renderPage();
    await screen.findByRole("heading", { level: 1 });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: /rename/i }));
    const input = screen.getByRole("textbox");
    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: "Daily account" } });
    fireEvent.keyDown(input, { key: "Enter" });
    await waitFor(() => expect(callsTo("PATCH", "/api/accounts/1")).toHaveLength(1));
    expect(callsTo("PATCH", "/api/accounts/1")[0]?.body).toEqual({ nickname: "Daily account" });
    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(screen.getByRole("heading", { level: 1 }).textContent).toContain("Daily account"),
    );
    expect(screen.getByRole("navigation", { name: "Breadcrumb" }).textContent).toContain(
      "Daily account",
    );
  });

  it("starts a sync from the primary action and tells the owner", async () => {
    renderPage();
    await screen.findByRole("heading", { level: 1 });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Sync now" }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(callsTo("POST", "/api/accounts/1/sync")).toHaveLength(1));
    expect(await screen.findByText("Sync started")).not.toBeNull();
    expect(
      screen.getByText("Updating Conto Smart: new transactions appear in a minute."),
    ).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it("explains a refused sync with a warning that names the account", async () => {
    server.syncResponse = {
      status: 409,
      body: { error: "Sync already running", code: "sync_in_progress" },
    };
    renderPage();
    await screen.findByRole("heading", { level: 1 });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Sync now" }));
    expect(await screen.findByText("Already updating")).not.toBeNull();
    expect(screen.getByText("Conto Smart is being updated right now.")).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it("makes renewing the primary action when the consent ended, and leaves for the bank", async () => {
    server.detail = makeDetail({ connection: { status: "expired" } });
    const assign = vi.fn();
    vi.stubGlobal("location", { ...window.location, assign });
    renderPage();
    await screen.findByRole("heading", { level: 1 });
    expect(screen.queryByRole("button", { name: "Sync now" })).toBeNull();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getAllByRole("button", { name: "Renew consent" })[0] as HTMLElement);
    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(assign).toHaveBeenCalledWith("https://bank.example.test/authorise?state=abc"),
    );
    expect(callsTo("POST", "/api/connections/3/renew")).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it("offers to enable a disabled account", async () => {
    server.detail = makeDetail({ account: { status: "disabled" } });
    renderPage();
    await screen.findByRole("heading", { level: 1 });
    expect(screen.getByText("Disabled")).not.toBeNull();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getAllByRole("button", { name: "Enable account" })[0] as HTMLElement);
    await waitFor(() => expect(callsTo("PATCH", "/api/accounts/1")).toHaveLength(1));
    expect(callsTo("PATCH", "/api/accounts/1")[0]?.body).toEqual({ status: "active" });
    expect(await screen.findByText("Account enabled")).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it("shows a progress indicator instead of the freshness chip while syncing", async () => {
    server.detail = makeDetail({ account: { syncInProgress: true } });
    renderPage();
    expect(await screen.findByText("Syncing…")).not.toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByText("Updated 2 hours ago")).toBeNull();
    const sync = screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Sync now" }) as HTMLButtonElement;
    expect(sync.disabled).toBe(true);
    expect(sync.title).toBe("This account is being updated right now.");
  });
});

describe("AccountDetailPage tabs", () => {
  it("opens on the overview and keeps the tab in the URL", async () => {
    const { router } = renderPage();
    await screen.findByRole("heading", { level: 1 });
    expect(screen.getByRole("tab", { name: "Overview", selected: true })).not.toBeNull();
    expect(router.state.location.search).toBe("");

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("tab", { name: /Transactions/ }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(router.state.location.search).toBe("?tab=transactions"));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("tab", { name: "Connection" }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(router.state.location.search).toBe("?tab=connection"));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("tab", { name: "Overview" }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(router.state.location.search).toBe(""));
  });

  it("opens the tab named in the URL and shows the transaction count on its tab", async () => {
    renderPage("/accounts/1?tab=connection");
    expect(await screen.findByRole("tab", { name: "Connection", selected: true })).not.toBeNull();
    expect(screen.getByRole("tab", { name: /Transactions/ }).textContent).toContain("57");
    expect(screen.getByRole("tabpanel", { name: "Connection" })).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it("falls back to the overview for an unknown tab", async () => {
    renderPage("/accounts/1?tab=bogus");
    expect(await screen.findByRole("tab", { name: "Overview", selected: true })).not.toBeNull();
  });
});

describe("AccountDetailPage overview", () => {
  it("says all is good when nothing needs attention", async () => {
    renderPage();
    await screen.findByRole("heading", { level: 1 });
    expect(screen.queryByRole("list", { name: "Needs attention" })).toBeNull();
    expect(
      await screen.findByText(/^All good: updated 2 hours ago and the consent is valid until/),
    ).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it.each([
    [
      "an expiring consent",
      { connection: { status: "expiring" as const, validUntil: NOW + 9 * DAY } },
      /expires in 9 days/,
      "Renew consent",
    ],
    [
      "a consent that expires tomorrow",
      { connection: { status: "expiring" as const, validUntil: NOW + DAY } },
      /expires tomorrow/,
      "Renew consent",
    ],
    [
      "a consent that expires today",
      { connection: { status: "expiring" as const, validUntil: NOW + 2 * HOUR } },
      /expires today/,
      "Renew consent",
    ],
    [
      "an expired consent",
      { connection: { status: "expired" as const, validUntil: NOW - 3 * DAY } },
      /Access to Banca Esempio has expired/,
      "Renew consent",
    ],
    [
      "a withdrawn consent",
      { connection: { status: "revoked" as const } },
      /Access to Banca Esempio was withdrawn/,
      "Renew consent",
    ],
    [
      "a connection error",
      { connection: { status: "error" as const } },
      /Bursar cannot reach Banca Esempio/,
      "Renew consent",
    ],
    [
      "an unavailable account",
      { account: { status: "unavailable" as const } },
      /no longer shares this account/,
      "See connection",
    ],
    [
      "a disabled account",
      { account: { status: "disabled" as const } },
      /This account is disabled/,
      "Enable account",
    ],
    [
      "a rate limit",
      { account: { rateLimitedUntil: NOW + HOUR } },
      /paused updates\. You can sync again/,
      "See connection",
    ],
    [
      "a failed update",
      { account: { lastSyncError: { code: "ASPSP_TIMEOUT", at: NOW - HOUR } } },
      /The last update failed\. The bank did not answer in time\. Bursar will try again later\./,
      "Sync now",
    ],
    [
      "an unknown error code",
      { account: { lastSyncError: { code: "SOMETHING_NEW", at: NOW - HOUR } } },
      /The bank did not complete the request\./,
      "Sync now",
    ],
    [
      "an account never fetched",
      { account: { lastSyncedAt: null, balance: null } },
      /has not fetched this account yet/,
      "Sync now",
    ],
  ])("raises an alert for %s with its call to action", async (_name, patch, text, cta) => {
    server.detail = makeDetail(patch);
    renderPage();
    const list = await screen.findByRole("list", { name: "Needs attention" });
    expect(within(list).getByText(text)).not.toBeNull();
    expect(within(list).getByRole("button", { name: new RegExp(`^${cta}`) })).not.toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByText(/^All good/)).toBeNull();
  });

  it("shows only the first-update notice while the first sync runs", async () => {
    server.detail = makeDetail({
      account: { lastSyncedAt: null, balance: null, syncInProgress: true },
    });
    renderPage();
    const list = await screen.findByRole("list", { name: "Needs attention" });
    expect(within(list).getByText(/The first update is running/)).not.toBeNull();
    expect(within(list).queryByRole("button")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("gives a removed account one notice that links to Accounts", async () => {
    server.detail = makeDetail({ account: { status: "removed" } });
    renderPage();
    const list = await screen.findByRole("list", { name: "Needs attention" });
    expect(within(list).getAllByRole("listitem")).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(within(list).getByText(/was disconnected from Banca Esempio/)).not.toBeNull();
    fireEvent.click(within(list).getByRole("link", { name: /Open Accounts/ }));
    expect(await screen.findByText("Accounts list")).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it("switches to the connection tab from the call to action of an alert", async () => {
    server.detail = makeDetail({ account: { status: "unavailable" } });
    const { router } = renderPage();
    const list = await screen.findByRole("list", { name: "Needs attention" });
    fireEvent.click(within(list).getByRole("button", { name: /See connection/ }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(router.state.location.search).toBe("?tab=connection"));
  });

  it("does not repeat an ended consent as a failed update", async () => {
    server.detail = makeDetail({
      connection: { status: "expired" },
      account: { lastSyncError: { code: "EXPIRED_SESSION", at: NOW - HOUR } },
    });
    renderPage();
    const list = await screen.findByRole("list", { name: "Needs attention" });
    expect(within(list).getAllByRole("listitem")).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it("runs the action behind the call to action of an alert", async () => {
    server.detail = makeDetail({
      account: { lastSyncError: { code: "ASPSP_ERROR", at: NOW - HOUR } },
    });
    renderPage();
    const list = await screen.findByRole("list", { name: "Needs attention" });
    fireEvent.click(within(list).getByRole("button", { name: /^Sync now/ }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(callsTo("POST", "/api/accounts/1/sync")).toHaveLength(1));
  });

  it("charts the last 90 days of balance and 30 days of cash flow of this account only", async () => {
    server.settingsHighlight = false;
    renderPage();
    const chart = await screen.findByTestId("balance-chart");
    expect(chart.getAttribute("data-points")).toBe("3");
    expect(chart.getAttribute("data-currency")).toBe("EUR");
    expect(chart.textContent).toMatch(
      /^Balance from .* to .*: .*3,000\.00 at the start, .*4,200\.00 at the end, lowest .*2,500\.00, highest .*4,200\.00\.$/,
    );
    expect(callsTo("GET", "/api/accounts/1/balance-history")[0]?.search.get("days")).toBe("90");

    const strip = await screen.findByTestId("cashflow-strip");
    expect(strip.getAttribute("data-variant")).toBe("full");
    expect(strip.getAttribute("data-show-balance")).toBe("false");
    expect(strip.getAttribute("data-buckets")).toBe("2");
    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(screen.getByTestId("cashflow-strip").getAttribute("data-highlight")).toBe("false"),
    );
    const flow = callsTo("GET", "/api/cashflow")[0];
    expect(flow?.search.get("accountId")).toBe("1");
    expect(flow?.search.get("currency")).toBe("EUR");
    expect(flow?.search.get("from")).toBe("2026-10-11");
    expect(flow?.search.get("to")).toBe("2026-11-09");
  });

  it("explains an empty balance history and an empty cash flow instead of drawing nothing", async () => {
    server.balanceStatus = 404;
    server.cashflow = null;
    renderPage();
    expect(await screen.findByText("No balance history yet")).not.toBeNull();
    expect(await screen.findByText("No transactions in this period")).not.toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByTestId("balance-chart")).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByTestId("cashflow-strip")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("shows an error with a retry when the balance history fails", async () => {
    server.balanceStatus = 500;
    renderPage();
    expect(await screen.findByText("The chart could not be loaded")).not.toBeNull();
    expect(screen.getAllByRole("button", { name: "Try again" })).toHaveLength(1);
  });
});

describe("AccountDetailPage transactions", () => {
  it("lists the latest transactions and has no link to the full list until it exists", async () => {
    renderPage("/accounts/1?tab=transactions");
    const table = await screen.findByRole("table", { name: "Latest transactions of this account" });
    expect(within(table).getByText("Mercato Verde")).not.toBeNull();
    expect(within(table).getByText("Employer Srl")).not.toBeNull();
    expect(within(table).getByText("Pending")).not.toBeNull();
    expect(within(table).getByText("Yesterday")).not.toBeNull();
    expect(within(table).getByText("Today")).not.toBeNull();
    expect(within(table).getByText(/42\.50/)).not.toBeNull();
    expect(screen.getByText("Showing the latest 3 of 57 transactions")).not.toBeNull();
    const request = callsTo("GET", "/api/transactions")[0];
    expect(request?.search.get("accountId")).toBe("1");
    expect(request?.search.get("pageSize")).toBe("20");
    expect(document.querySelector('a[href^="/transactions"]')).toBeNull();
  });

  it("shows the absolute date of a transaction in its title", async () => {
    renderPage("/accounts/1?tab=transactions");
    const table = await screen.findByRole("table");
    const time = within(table).getByText("Yesterday");
    expect(time.getAttribute("datetime")).toBe("2026-11-08");
    expect(time.getAttribute("title")).toMatch(/8 November 2026|08 November 2026/);
```

Create `apps/web/src/components/charts/BalanceChart.tsx`:

```tsx
import { currencyMinorDigits, type LocalDate } from "@bursar/shared";
import { useId, useMemo } from "react";
import {
  Area,
  ComposedChart,
  ReferenceLine,
  ResponsiveContainer,
  Tooltip,
  type TooltipContentProps,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
} from "recharts";
import { useFormatters } from "../../lib/format";
import { useUi } from "../../store/ui";
import { Money } from "../ui";
import { useChartColors } from "./chart-colors";

export interface BalancePoint {
  date: LocalDate;
  balanceMinor: number;
}

export interface BalanceChartProps {
  points: BalancePoint[];
  currency: string;
  /** One sentence for screen readers: range, first and last value, lowest and highest value. */
  summaryLabel: string;
  height?: number;
}

/** One plotted row. `x` is the point index; a zero crossing sits between two indices. */
export interface BalanceRow {
  x: number;
  /** Index of the real point closest to `x`, used by the tooltip. */
  index: number;
  positive: number | null;
  negative: number | null;
}

/**
 * Splits a balance series into a non-negative series and a non-positive series so the negative
 * stretches can be drawn in `danger`. Where two neighbouring points have opposite signs an
 * interpolated row at the exact zero crossing closes both series, so the colour changes at zero.
 */
export function buildBalanceRows(points: readonly BalancePoint[]): BalanceRow[] {
  const rows: BalanceRow[] = [];
  points.forEach((point, index) => {
    const value = point.balanceMinor;
    rows.push({
      x: index,
      index,
      positive: value >= 0 ? value : null,
      negative: value <= 0 ? value : null,
    });
    const next = points[index + 1];
    if (next && (value < 0 ? next.balanceMinor > 0 : value > 0 && next.balanceMinor < 0)) {
      const share = value / (value - next.balanceMinor);
      rows.push({
        x: index + share,
        index: share < 0.5 ? index : index + 1,
        positive: 0,
        negative: 0,
      });
    }
  });
  return rows;
}

/** The value axis range: padded by 10 %, kept at zero or above for a series that never dips below. */
export function balanceDomain(values: readonly number[]): [number, number] {
  const min = Math.min(...values);
  const max = Math.max(...values);
  const pad = Math.max(Math.round((max - min) / 10), 100);
  if (min < 0) return [min - pad, Math.max(max + pad, 0)];
  return [Math.max(min - pad, 0), max + pad];
}

/** Evenly spaced tick positions over point indices (five at most). */
export function axisTicks(count: number): number[] {
  const last = count - 1;
  const steps = Math.min(4, last);
  return Array.from(
    new Set(Array.from({ length: steps + 1 }, (_, k) => Math.round((k * last) / steps))),
  );
}

/** Whole-unit compact money for the value axis: integer division of the minor units, no floats. */
function useAxisFormatter(currency: string): (minor: number) => string {
  const { locale } = useFormatters();
  return useMemo(() => {
    const divisor = 10n ** BigInt(currencyMinorDigits(currency));
    const format = new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {
      style: "currency",
      currency,
      notation: "compact",
      maximumFractionDigits: 1,
    });
    return (minor: number) => format.format(BigInt(Math.round(minor)) / divisor);
  }, [locale, currency]);
}

/**
 * Balance over time as an area chart (Recharts). Stretches below zero are drawn in `danger`, the
 * rest in `primary`; the whole chart is one image for assistive technology, described by
 * `summaryLabel`. Needs at least two points and renders nothing otherwise.
 */
export function BalanceChart({ points, currency, summaryLabel, height = 240 }: BalanceChartProps) {
  const gradientId = useId();
  // Task 17's theme-aware chart colours (re-read when `data-theme` changes).
  const colors = useChartColors();
  const { localDate } = useFormatters();
  const privacy = useUi((state) => state.privacy);
  const formatAxis = useAxisFormatter(currency);
  const rows = useMemo(() => buildBalanceRows(points), [points]);
  if (points.length < 2) return null;

  const [low, high] = balanceDomain(points.map((point) => point.balanceMinor));
  const dipsBelowZero = low < 0;
  const hasPositive = rows.some((row) => row.positive !== null);
  const hasNegative = rows.some((row) => row.negative !== null);
  const positiveFill = `${gradientId}-positive`;
  const negativeFill = `${gradientId}-negative`;

  const renderTooltip = ({ active, payload }: TooltipContentProps) => {
    const row = payload?.[0]?.payload as BalanceRow | undefined;
    const point = active && row ? points[row.index] : undefined;
    if (!point) return null;
    return (
      <div className="rounded-lg border border-subtle bg-surface px-3 py-2 text-xs shadow-sm">
        <div className="text-muted">{localDate(point.date, "medium")}</div>
        <div className="text-sm font-semibold">
          <Money minor={point.balanceMinor} currency={currency} tone="auto-balance" />
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div role="img" aria-label={summaryLabel} className="w-full text-muted">
      <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={height}>
        <ComposedChart
          data={rows}
          margin={{ top: 8, right: 8, bottom: 0, left: 0 }}
          accessibilityLayer={false}
        >
          <defs>
            <linearGradient id={positiveFill} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
              <stop offset="0%" stopColor={colors.primary} stopOpacity={0.45} />
              <stop offset="100%" stopColor={colors.primary} stopOpacity={0.02} />
            </linearGradient>
            <linearGradient id={negativeFill} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
              <stop offset="0%" stopColor={colors.danger} stopOpacity={0.02} />
              <stop offset="100%" stopColor={colors.danger} stopOpacity={0.45} />
            </linearGradient>
          </defs>
          <XAxis
            type="number"
            dataKey="x"
            domain={[0, points.length - 1]}
            ticks={axisTicks(points.length)}
            tickFormatter={(value: number) =>
              localDate(points[Math.round(value)]?.date ?? "", "short")
            }
            tickLine={false}
            axisLine={false}
            tick={{ fill: colors.muted, fontSize: 12 }}
            tickMargin={8}
          />
          <YAxis
            hide={privacy}
            domain={[low, high]}
            tickFormatter={formatAxis}
            tickLine={false}
            axisLine={false}
            width={56}
            tick={{ fill: colors.muted, fontSize: 12 }}
          />
          {dipsBelowZero ? <ReferenceLine y={0} stroke={colors.grid} /> : null}
          <Tooltip content={renderTooltip} cursor={{ stroke: colors.grid }} />
          {hasPositive ? (
            <Area
              dataKey="positive"
              type="linear"
              baseValue={dipsBelowZero ? 0 : "dataMin"}
              stroke={colors.primary}
              strokeWidth={2}
              fill={`url(#${positiveFill})`}
              dot={false}
              activeDot={false}
              connectNulls={false}
              isAnimationActive={false}
            />
          ) : null}
          {hasNegative ? (
            <Area
              dataKey="negative"
              type="linear"
              baseValue={0}
              stroke={colors.danger}
              strokeWidth={2}
              fill={`url(#${negativeFill})`}
              dot={false}
              activeDot={false}
              connectNulls={false}
              isAnimationActive={false}
            />
          ) : null}
        </ComposedChart>
      </ResponsiveContainer>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```ts
import type { SkipReason } from "@bursar/shared";
import type { TFunction } from "i18next";
import { syncErrorText } from "../../app/useLiveEvents";

/**
 * A sentence for a stored error code. It delegates to Task 17's `syncErrorText` (`syncErrors.*`),
 * the one translation of Enable Banking and Bursar codes in the panel, so a toast and this page
 * never word the same code differently; an unknown or missing code gets its generic sentence and
 * the raw code is never shown.
 */
export function errorLabel(t: TFunction, code: string | null): string {
  return syncErrorText(t, code);
}

/** Why a sync run was skipped, in words. */
export function skipReasonLabel(t: TFunction, reason: SkipReason): string {
  return t(`account.skip.${reason}`);
}

/** "Consent expires in 9 days", "Consent expired 3 days ago", or the same-day forms. */
export function consentLabel(t: TFunction, state: { expired: boolean; daysLeft: number }): string {
  const days = Math.abs(state.daysLeft);
  if (state.expired) {
    return days === 0
      ? t("account.consent.expiredToday")
      : t("account.consent.expired", { count: days });
  }
  return days === 0
    ? t("account.consent.expiresToday")
    : t("account.consent.expires", { count: days });
}
```

Create `apps/web/src/pages/account/account-state.ts`:

```ts
import type { AccountDetailResponse } from "@bursar/shared";
import {
  type ConnectionAction,
  connectionActions,
  connectionTone,
} from "../../lib/connection-state";
import { consentUrgency } from "../../lib/thresholds";

export type AccountTab = "overview" | "transactions" | "connection";

export const ACCOUNT_TABS: readonly AccountTab[] = ["overview", "transactions", "connection"];

export function isAccountTab(value: string): value is AccountTab {
  return (ACCOUNT_TABS as readonly string[]).includes(value);
}

/** What the page can do for the account right now. */
export type AccountRunAction = "sync" | "renew" | "enable";

export type StripeTone = "positive" | "warning" | "danger" | "neutral";

/**
 * Colour of the 6 px stripe on top of the hero. A removed or disabled account is neutral; otherwise
 * the connection state decides, and an unavailable account or a failed last update downgrades a
 * healthy connection to a warning.
 */
export function stripeTone(detail: AccountDetailResponse): StripeTone {
  const { account, connection } = detail;
  if (account.status === "removed" || account.status === "disabled") return "neutral";
  const tone = connectionTone(connection.status);
  if (tone !== "positive") return tone;
  return account.status === "unavailable" || account.lastSyncError !== null
    ? "warning"
    : "positive";
}

/** The single status pill of the hero: the account state when it is not active, else the connection state. */
export function statusPill(detail: AccountDetailResponse): {
  tone: "positive" | "warning" | "danger" | "neutral";
  key: string;
} {
  const { account, connection } = detail;
  if (account.status === "removed") return { tone: "neutral", key: "removed" };
  if (account.status === "disabled") return { tone: "neutral", key: "disabled" };
  if (account.status === "unavailable") return { tone: "warning", key: "unavailable" };
  return { tone: connectionTone(connection.status), key: connection.status };
}

export type AlertId =
  | "removed"
  | "expired"
  | "revoked"
  | "connectionError"
  | "expiringToday"
  | "expiring"
  | "unavailable"
  | "disabled"
  | "syncFailed"
  | "rateLimited"
  | "neverSynced"
  | "firstSync";

export type AlertTone = "danger" | "warning" | "info";

export type AlertAction =
  | { kind: "tab"; tab: AccountTab }
  | { kind: "run"; action: AccountRunAction }
  | { kind: "accounts" };

export interface AccountAlert {
  id: AlertId;
  tone: AlertTone;
  /** What the call to action does; null for an alert without one. */
  action: AlertAction | null;
  values: { bank: string; count?: number; at?: number; code?: string | null };
}

/**
 * The contextual alerts of the Overview tab, most urgent first. An empty list means "All good".
 * A removed account has one alert only; reasons that the connection state already explains are not
 * repeated for the account (a failed update on an expired consent, for example).
 */
export function deriveAlerts(
  detail: AccountDetailResponse,
  now: number,
  timeZone: string,
): AccountAlert[] {
  const { account, connection } = detail;
  const bank = connection.bankName;
  if (account.status === "removed") {
    return [{ id: "removed", tone: "info", action: { kind: "accounts" }, values: { bank } }];
  }

  const renew: AlertAction = { kind: "run", action: "renew" };
  const alerts: AccountAlert[] = [];
  switch (connection.status) {
    case "expired":
      alerts.push({ id: "expired", tone: "danger", action: renew, values: { bank } });
      break;
    case "revoked":
      alerts.push({ id: "revoked", tone: "danger", action: renew, values: { bank } });
      break;
    case "error":
      alerts.push({ id: "connectionError", tone: "danger", action: renew, values: { bank } });
      break;
    case "expiring": {
      const { urgency, daysLeft } = consentUrgency(connection.validUntil, now, timeZone);
      alerts.push(
        daysLeft <= 0
          ? { id: "expiringToday", tone: "danger", action: renew, values: { bank } }
          : {
              id: "expiring",
              tone: urgency === "danger" ? "danger" : "warning",
              action: renew,
              values: { bank, count: daysLeft },
            },
      );
      break;
    }
    case "active":
      break;
  }

  if (account.status === "unavailable") {
    alerts.push({
      id: "unavailable",
      tone: "warning",
      action: { kind: "tab", tab: "connection" },
      values: { bank },
    });
  }
  if (account.status === "disabled") {
    alerts.push({
      id: "disabled",
      tone: "info",
      action: { kind: "run", action: "enable" },
      values: { bank },
    });
  }

  const reachable = connection.status === "active" || connection.status === "expiring";
  if (account.status === "active" && reachable) {
    const rateLimited = account.rateLimitedUntil !== null && account.rateLimitedUntil > now;
    if (rateLimited) {
      alerts.push({
        id: "rateLimited",
        tone: "info",
        action: { kind: "tab", tab: "connection" },
        values: { bank, at: account.rateLimitedUntil ?? undefined },
      });
    } else if (account.lastSyncError !== null) {
      alerts.push({
        id: "syncFailed",
        tone: "warning",
        action: { kind: "run", action: "sync" },
        values: { bank, code: account.lastSyncError.code },
      });
    } else if (account.lastSyncedAt === null) {
      alerts.push(
        account.syncInProgress
          ? { id: "firstSync", tone: "info", action: null, values: { bank } }
          : {
              id: "neverSynced",
              tone: "info",
              action: { kind: "run", action: "sync" },
              values: { bank },
            },
      );
    }
  }
  return alerts;
}

export type AccountActionKind = ConnectionAction | "enable";

export interface AccountActionState {
  action: AccountActionKind;
  primary: boolean;
  /** i18n key of the reason the action is unavailable right now; null when it can run. */
  blockedKey: string | null;
}

/**
 * Actions for the account, primary first: the connection state machine (`connectionActions`) plus
 * "enable" for a disabled account, with the reason when one is blocked. A removed account has none.
 */
export function accountActionStates(
  detail: AccountDetailResponse,
  now: number,
): AccountActionState[] {
  const { account, connection } = detail;
  if (account.status === "removed") return [];
  const base = connectionActions(connection.status);
  const primary: AccountActionKind | null = account.status === "disabled" ? "enable" : base.primary;

  const syncBlocked = (): string | null => {
    if (base.blocked.sync !== undefined) return base.blocked.sync;
    if (account.status === "disabled") return "account.actions.blocked.disabled";
    if (account.status === "unavailable") return "account.actions.blocked.unavailable";
    if (account.syncInProgress) return "account.actions.blocked.syncing";
    if (account.rateLimitedUntil !== null && account.rateLimitedUntil > now) {
      return "account.actions.blocked.rateLimited";
    }
    return null;
  };

  const kinds: AccountActionKind[] = account.status === "disabled" ? ["enable"] : [];
  for (const action of ["sync", "renew", "disconnect"] as const) {
    if (
      action === base.primary ||
      base.allowed.includes(action) ||
      base.blocked[action] !== undefined
    ) {
      kinds.push(action);
    }
  }
  const states = kinds.map((action) => ({
    action,
    primary: action === primary,
    blockedKey:
      action === "sync"
        ? syncBlocked()
        : action === "enable"
          ? null
          : (base.blocked[action] ?? null),
  }));
  return states.sort((a, b) => Number(b.primary) - Number(a.primary));
}
```

Create `apps/web/src/pages/account/useAccountActions.ts`:

```ts
import type { AccountDetailResponse } from "@bursar/shared";
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { ApiError, api } from "../../api";
import { feedback } from "../../components/feedback";
import { useFormatters } from "../../lib/format";
import { queryKeys } from "../../lib/query-keys";
import type { AccountRunAction } from "./account-state";

export interface AccountActions {
  run(action: AccountRunAction): void;
  pending: Record<AccountRunAction, boolean>;
}

/**
 * The three things the detail page can do to an account: sync it now, renew its consent (leaves the
 * app for the bank) and enable it again. Feedback goes through `feedback()`; sync refusals from the
 * API become warnings with a sentence that names the account and the bank, never an id.
 */
export function useAccountActions(detail: AccountDetailResponse): AccountActions {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { relative } = useFormatters();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const accountId = detail.account.id;
  const accountName = detail.account.name;
  const bank = detail.connection.bankName;

  const refresh = async () => {
    await Promise.all([
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.account(accountId) }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.connections }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.summary }),
    ]);
  };

  const sync = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => api.syncAccount(accountId),
    onSuccess: async () => {
      feedback(
        t("account.toast.syncStarted"),
        t("account.toast.syncStartedDetail", { account: accountName }),
        "info",
      );
      await refresh();
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      const code = error instanceof ApiError ? error.code : null;
      if (code === "sync_in_progress") {
        feedback(
          t("account.toast.alreadySyncing"),
          t("account.toast.alreadySyncingDetail", { account: accountName }),
          "warning",
        );
      } else if (code === "rate_limited") {
        const retryAt = error instanceof ApiError ? error.retryAt : null;
        feedback(
          t("account.toast.paused"),
          retryAt === null
            ? t("account.toast.pausedNoTime", { bank })
            : t("account.toast.pausedDetail", { bank, when: relative(retryAt) }),
          "warning",
        );
      } else if (code === "connection_inactive") {
        feedback(
          t("account.toast.needsRenewal"),
          t("account.toast.needsRenewalDetail", { bank, account: accountName }),
          "warning",
        );
      } else if (code === "account_inactive" || code === "nothing_to_sync") {
        feedback(
          t("account.toast.notSynced"),
          t("account.toast.notSyncedDetail", { account: accountName }),
          "warning",
        );
      } else {
        feedback(t("account.toast.failed"), t("account.toast.failedDetail"), "error");
      }
    },
  });

  const renew = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => api.renewConnection(detail.connection.id),
    onSuccess: ({ redirectUrl }) => {
      window.location.assign(redirectUrl);
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      if (error instanceof ApiError && error.code === "banking_not_configured") {
        feedback(t("account.toast.bankingOff"), t("account.toast.bankingOffDetail"), "warning");
      } else {
        feedback(t("account.toast.failed"), t("account.toast.failedDetail"), "error");
      }
    },
  });

  const enable = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => api.updateAccount(accountId, { status: "active" }),
    onSuccess: async () => {
      feedback(
        t("account.toast.enabled"),
        t("account.toast.enabledDetail", { account: accountName }),
      );
      await refresh();
    },
    onError: () => {
      feedback(t("account.toast.failed"), t("account.toast.failedDetail"), "error");
    },
  });

  return {
    run(action) {
      if (action === "sync") sync.mutate();
      else if (action === "renew") renew.mutate();
      else enable.mutate();
    },
    pending: { sync: sync.isPending, renew: renew.isPending, enable: enable.isPending },
  };
}
```

```tsx
import type { SyncRunItem } from "@bursar/shared";
import { History } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { InlineEmpty, RelativeTime, StatusPill } from "../../components/ui";
import { type Column, DataTable } from "../../components/ui/DataTable";
import { errorLabel, skipReasonLabel } from "./labels";

const STATUS_TONE = {
  running: "info",
  succeeded: "positive",
  failed: "danger",
  skipped: "neutral",
} as const;

/** The sync history of one account: when, why it ran, how it ended and what changed. */
export function SyncHistory({ runs }: { runs: SyncRunItem[] }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  const changes = (run: SyncRunItem): string => {
    const parts = [
      run.inserted > 0 ? t("account.sync.inserted", { count: run.inserted }) : null,
      run.updated > 0 ? t("account.sync.updated", { count: run.updated }) : null,
      run.removed > 0 ? t("account.sync.removed", { count: run.removed }) : null,
    ].filter((part): part is string => part !== null);
    return parts.length > 0 ? parts.join(" · ") : t("account.sync.noChanges");
  };

  const note = (run: SyncRunItem): string | null => {
    if (run.status === "failed") return errorLabel(t, run.errorCode);
    if (run.status === "skipped" && run.skipReason !== null)
      return skipReasonLabel(t, run.skipReason);
    return null;
  };

  const columns: Column<SyncRunItem>[] = [
    {
      id: "startedAt",
      header: t("account.sync.started"),
      cell: (run) => <RelativeTime at={run.startedAt} />,
      className: "whitespace-nowrap",
    },
    {
      id: "trigger",
      header: t("account.sync.triggerHeader"),
      cell: (run) => t(`account.sync.trigger.${run.trigger}`),
      hideBelow: "sm",
    },
    {
      id: "status",
      header: t("account.sync.statusHeader"),
      cell: (run) => (
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col items-start gap-1">
          <StatusPill
            tone={STATUS_TONE[run.status]}
            label={t(`account.sync.status.${run.status}`)}
          />
          {note(run) ? <span className="text-xs text-muted">{note(run)}</span> : null}
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      id: "changes",
      header: t("account.sync.changesHeader"),
      cell: (run) => (
        <span className="text-muted">{run.status === "succeeded" ? changes(run) : "—"}</span>
      ),
      align: "end",
      hideBelow: "md",
    },
  ];

  return (
    <DataTable
      columns={columns}
      rows={runs}
      getRowKey={(run) => run.id}
      caption={t("account.sync.caption")}
      empty={
        <InlineEmpty
          icon={History}
          title={t("account.sync.emptyTitle")}
          description={t("account.sync.emptyDescription")}
        />
      }
    />
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { LocalDate, TransactionItem } from "@bursar/shared";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { ArrowLeftRight, TriangleAlert } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { api } from "../../api";
import { Button, EmptyState, InlineEmpty, Money, StatusPill } from "../../components/ui";
import { type Column, DataTable } from "../../components/ui/DataTable";
import { useFormatters } from "../../lib/format";
import { queryKeys } from "../../lib/query-keys";

const PAGE_SIZE = 20;

/** A booking date: "Yesterday", "3 days ago" within 45 days, the date beyond; the long date in `title`. */
function TransactionDate({ date }: { date: LocalDate }) {
  const { localDate, relativeDay } = useFormatters();
  return (
    <time dateTime={date} title={localDate(date, "long")}>
      {relativeDay(date)}
    </time>
  );
}

/**
 * The latest 20 transactions of the account. The link to the full list is added by the task that
 * ships the Transactions page.
 */
export function TransactionsTab({ accountId }: { accountId: number }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const params = { accountId: String(accountId), pageSize: String(PAGE_SIZE) };
  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.transactions(params),
    queryFn: () => api.transactions(params),
  });

  if (query.isError) {
    return (
      <EmptyState
        kind="state"
        icon={TriangleAlert}
        title={t("account.transactions.errorTitle")}
        description={t("account.transactions.errorDescription")}
        action={
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => query.refetch()}>
            {t("account.retry")}
          </Button>
        }
      />
    );
  }

  const columns: Column<TransactionItem>[] = [
    {
      id: "date",
      header: t("account.transactions.date"),
      cell: (row) => <TransactionDate date={row.date} />,
      className: "whitespace-nowrap",
    },
    {
      id: "counterparty",
      header: t("account.transactions.counterparty"),
      cell: (row) => (
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1">
          <span className="truncate font-medium text-fg">{row.counterparty ?? "—"}</span>
          {row.description ? (
            <span className="truncate text-xs text-muted md:hidden">{row.description}</span>
          ) : null}
          {row.status === "pending" ? (
            <span>
              <StatusPill tone="neutral" label={t("account.transactions.pending")} />
            </span>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      id: "description",
      header: t("account.transactions.description"),
      cell: (row) => <span className="line-clamp-2 text-muted">{row.description ?? "—"}</span>,
      hideBelow: "md",
    },
    {
      id: "amount",
      header: t("account.transactions.amount"),
      cell: (row) => (
        <Money minor={row.amountMinor} currency={row.currency} tone="auto-flow" sign="always" />
      ),
      align: "end",
      className: "whitespace-nowrap",
    },
  ];

  const total = query.data?.total ?? 0;
  const shown = query.data?.items.length ?? 0;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <DataTable
        columns={columns}
        rows={query.data?.items}
        loading={query.isPending}
        skeletonRows={6}
        getRowKey={(row) => row.id}
        caption={t("account.transactions.caption")}
        empty={
          <InlineEmpty
            icon={ArrowLeftRight}
            title={t("account.transactions.emptyTitle")}
            description={t("account.transactions.emptyDescription")}
          />
        }
      />
      {total > shown ? (
        <p className="text-xs text-muted">
          {t("account.transactions.showingLatest", { shown, count: total })}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import {
  type AccountDetailResponse,
  addDays,
  SETTINGS_DEFAULTS,
  toLocalDate,
} from "@bursar/shared";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import {
  ChartNoAxesCombined,
  CircleAlert,
  CircleCheck,
  Info,
  type LucideIcon,
  TriangleAlert,
} from "lucide-react";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Link } from "react-router";
import { ApiError, api } from "../../api";
import { buildPath } from "../../app/routes";
import { useSettingsQuery } from "../../app/useSettingsQuery";
import { BalanceChart } from "../../components/charts/BalanceChart";
import { CashFlowStrip } from "../../components/charts/CashFlowStrip";
import { NetChip } from "../../components/charts/NetChip";
import { Button, Card, InlineEmpty } from "../../components/ui";
import { useFormatters } from "../../lib/format";
import { queryKeys } from "../../lib/query-keys";
import { useUi } from "../../store/ui";
import { type AccountAlert, type AccountTab, type AlertTone, deriveAlerts } from "./account-state";
import { errorLabel } from "./labels";
import { useAccountActions } from "./useAccountActions";

const BALANCE_DAYS = 90;
const CASHFLOW_DAYS = 30;

const ALERT_STYLE: Record<AlertTone, { box: string; Icon: LucideIcon }> = {
  danger: { box: "bg-danger-soft text-danger", Icon: CircleAlert },
  warning: { box: "bg-warning-soft text-warning", Icon: TriangleAlert },
  info: { box: "bg-info-soft text-info", Icon: Info },
};

const CTA_CLASS =
  "mt-1.5 inline-flex min-h-8 items-center rounded-md text-sm font-semibold underline underline-offset-2 disabled:opacity-60";

interface OverviewTabProps {
  detail: AccountDetailResponse;
  onSelectTab(tab: AccountTab): void;
}

/** Overview: contextual alerts or "All good", the 90-day balance and the 30-day cash flow. */
export function OverviewTab({ detail, onSelectTab }: OverviewTabProps) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <Alerts detail={detail} onSelectTab={onSelectTab} />
      <BalanceCard accountId={detail.account.id} currency={detail.account.currency} />
      <CashFlowCard accountId={detail.account.id} currency={detail.account.currency} />
    </div>
  );
}

function Alerts({ detail, onSelectTab }: OverviewTabProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { now, timeZone, relative, localDate } = useFormatters();
  const actions = useAccountActions(detail);
  const alerts = deriveAlerts(detail, now(), timeZone);

  if (alerts.length === 0) {
    const { lastSyncedAt } = detail.account;
    return (
      <div className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-subtle bg-surface-2 p-4">
        <CircleCheck aria-hidden size={18} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-positive" />
        <p className="text-sm text-fg">
          {t("account.alerts.allGood", {
            when: lastSyncedAt === null ? "" : relative(lastSyncedAt),
            date: localDate(toLocalDate(detail.connection.validUntil, timeZone), "medium"),
          })}
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const text = (alert: AccountAlert): string =>
    t(`account.alerts.${alert.id}.text`, {
      bank: alert.values.bank,
      count: alert.values.count,
      when: alert.values.at === undefined ? "" : relative(alert.values.at),
      reason: errorLabel(t, alert.values.code ?? null),
    });

  const callToAction = (alert: AccountAlert): ReactNode => {
    const action = alert.action;
    if (action === null) return null;
    const label = `${t(`account.alerts.${alert.id}.cta`)} →`;
    if (action.kind === "accounts") {
      return (
        <Link to={buildPath("accounts")} className={CTA_CLASS}>
          {label}
        </Link>
      );
    }
    if (action.kind === "tab") {
      return (
        <button type="button" className={CTA_CLASS} onClick={() => onSelectTab(action.tab)}>
          {label}
        </button>
      );
    }
    return (
      <button
        type="button"
        className={CTA_CLASS}
        data-qa-skip={action.action === "renew" ? "" : undefined}
        disabled={actions.pending[action.action]}
        onClick={() => actions.run(action.action)}
      >
        {label}
      </button>
    );
  };

  return (
    <ul aria-label={t("account.alerts.label")} className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
      {alerts.map((alert) => {
        const { box, Icon } = ALERT_STYLE[alert.tone];
        return (
          <li key={alert.id} className={`flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl p-4 ${box}`}>
            <Icon aria-hidden size={18} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <p className="text-sm font-medium">{text(alert)}</p>
              {callToAction(alert)}
            </div>
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ul>
  );
}

function SectionHeader({ title, aside }: { title: string; aside?: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
      <h2 className="font-display text-base font-semibold text-fg">{title}</h2>
      {aside}
    </div>
  );
}

function ChartError({ onRetry }: { onRetry(): void }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <InlineEmpty
        icon={TriangleAlert}
        title={t("account.overview.chartErrorTitle")}
        description={t("account.overview.chartErrorDescription")}
      />
      <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={onRetry}>
        {t("account.retry")}
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}

function BalanceCard({ accountId, currency }: { accountId: number; currency: string }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { money, localDate } = useFormatters();
  const privacy = useUi((state) => state.privacy);
  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.balanceHistory(accountId, BALANCE_DAYS),
    queryFn: () => api.balanceHistory(accountId, BALANCE_DAYS),
  });
  // A 404 means "no balance yet" (the API has nothing to compute the history from).
  const failed = query.isError && !(query.error instanceof ApiError && query.error.status === 404);
  const points = query.data?.points ?? [];
  const first = points[0];
  const last = points[points.length - 1];

  let summary = "";
  if (first && last) {
    const lowest = points.reduce((low, p) => (p.balanceMinor < low.balanceMinor ? p : low), first);
    const highest = points.reduce(
      (high, p) => (p.balanceMinor > high.balanceMinor ? p : high),
      first,
    );
    const masked = { masked: privacy };
    summary = t("account.overview.balanceSummary", {
      from: localDate(first.date, "medium"),
      to: localDate(last.date, "medium"),
      start: money(first.balanceMinor, currency, masked),
      end: money(last.balanceMinor, currency, masked),
      low: money(lowest.balanceMinor, currency, masked),
      high: money(highest.balanceMinor, currency, masked),
    });
  }

  return (
    <Card padding="lg">
      <SectionHeader
        title={t("account.overview.balanceTitle", { count: BALANCE_DAYS })}
        aside={
          first && last ? (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted">
              <NetChip netMinor={last.balanceMinor - first.balanceMinor} currency={currency} />
              {t("account.overview.balanceChange", { count: BALANCE_DAYS })}
            </span>
          ) : null
        }
      />
      {query.isPending ? (
        <div aria-busy="true" className="h-60 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-surface-2" />
      ) : failed ? (
        <ChartError onRetry={() => query.refetch()} />
      ) : points.length >= 2 ? (
        <BalanceChart points={points} currency={currency} summaryLabel={summary} />
      ) : (
        <InlineEmpty
          icon={ChartNoAxesCombined}
          title={t("account.overview.noBalanceTitle")}
          description={t("account.overview.noBalanceDescription")}
        />
      )}
    </Card>
  );
}

function CashFlowCard({ accountId, currency }: { accountId: number; currency: string }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { money, localDate, now, timeZone } = useFormatters();
  const privacy = useUi((state) => state.privacy);
  const settings = useSettingsQuery();
  const to = toLocalDate(now(), timeZone);
  const from = addDays(to, 1 - CASHFLOW_DAYS);
  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.cashflow({ accountId: String(accountId), currency, from, to }),
    queryFn: () => api.cashflow({ accountId, currency, from, to }),
  });
  const flow = query.data ?? null;
  const movements = flow !== null && flow.totals.count > 0 ? flow : null;

  return (
    <Card padding="lg">
      <SectionHeader
        title={t("account.overview.cashflowTitle", { count: CASHFLOW_DAYS })}
        aside={
          movements ? <NetChip netMinor={movements.totals.netMinor} currency={currency} /> : null
        }
      />
      {query.isPending ? (
        <div aria-busy="true" className="h-40 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-surface-2" />
      ) : query.isError ? (
        <ChartError onRetry={() => query.refetch()} />
      ) : movements ? (
        <CashFlowStrip
          buckets={movements.buckets}
          currency={currency}
          variant="full"
          showBalance={false}
          highlightNegativeNet={
            settings.data?.values.highlightNegativeNet ?? SETTINGS_DEFAULTS.highlightNegativeNet
          }
          summaryLabel={t("account.overview.cashflowSummary", {
            from: localDate(movements.from, "medium"),
            to: localDate(movements.to, "medium"),
            net: money(movements.totals.netMinor, currency, { sign: "always", masked: privacy }),
            count: movements.totals.count,
          })}
        />
      ) : (
        <InlineEmpty
          icon={ChartNoAxesCombined}
          title={t("account.overview.cashflowEmptyTitle")}
          description={t("account.overview.cashflowEmptyDescription")}
        />
      )}
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { AccountDetailResponse } from "@bursar/shared";
import { Check, RefreshCw, RotateCw, Unplug } from "lucide-react";
import { type ReactNode, useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Button, Card, DeadlineChip, StatusPill } from "../../components/ui";
import { connectionTone } from "../../lib/connection-state";
import { useFormatters } from "../../lib/format";
import { consentUrgency } from "../../lib/thresholds";
import { DisconnectDialog } from "../accounts/DisconnectDialog";
import { type AccountActionKind, accountActionStates } from "./account-state";
import { consentLabel, errorLabel } from "./labels";
import { SyncHistory } from "./SyncHistory";
import { useAccountActions } from "./useAccountActions";

const ACTION_ICON = {
  sync: RefreshCw,
  renew: RotateCw,
  enable: Check,
  disconnect: Unplug,
} as const;

function Fact({ label, children }: { label: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5 py-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-baseline sm:gap-4">
      <dt className="w-44 shrink-0 text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted">
        {label}
      </dt>
      <dd className="min-w-0 text-sm text-fg">{children}</dd>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Region name in the interface language ("Italy"), falling back to the country code. */
function countryName(code: string, locale: string): string {
  try {
    return new Intl.DisplayNames([locale], { type: "region" }).of(code) ?? code;
  } catch {
    return code;
  }
}

/** Connection: consent, dates, last error, the actions of the state machine and the sync history. */
export function ConnectionTab({ detail }: { detail: AccountDetailResponse }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { absolute, relative, locale, now, timeZone } = useFormatters();
  const actions = useAccountActions(detail);
  const [disconnecting, setDisconnecting] = useState(false);
  const { account, connection } = detail;

  const consent = consentUrgency(connection.validUntil, now(), timeZone);
  const states = accountActionStates(detail, now());
  const pausedUntil =
    account.rateLimitedUntil !== null && account.rateLimitedUntil > now()
      ? account.rateLimitedUntil
      : null;

  const press = (action: AccountActionKind) => {
    if (action === "disconnect") setDisconnecting(true);
    else actions.run(action);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <Card padding="lg">
        <h2 className="mb-2 font-display text-base font-semibold text-fg">
          {t("account.connection.title")}
        </h2>
        <dl className="divide-y divide-subtle">
          <Fact label={t("account.connection.bank")}>
            {connection.bankName}
            <span className="text-muted"> · {countryName(connection.country, locale)}</span>
          </Fact>
          <Fact label={t("account.connection.status")}>
            <StatusPill
              tone={connectionTone(connection.status)}
              label={t(`account.status.${connection.status}`)}
            />
          </Fact>
          <Fact label={t("account.connection.validUntil")}>
            <span className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <span>{absolute(connection.validUntil)}</span>
              <DeadlineChip
                urgency={consent.urgency}
                label={consentLabel(t, consent)}
                title={absolute(connection.validUntil, true)}
              />
            </span>
          </Fact>
          <Fact label={t("account.connection.connectedOn")}>{absolute(connection.createdAt)}</Fact>
          <Fact label={t("account.connection.renewedOn")}>
            {connection.renewedAt === null ? (
              <span className="text-muted">{t("account.connection.notRenewed")}</span>
            ) : (
              absolute(connection.renewedAt)
            )}
          </Fact>
          <Fact label={t("account.connection.lastUpdate")}>
            {account.lastSyncedAt === null ? (
              <span className="text-muted">{t("account.connection.never")}</span>
            ) : (
              <time title={absolute(account.lastSyncedAt, true)}>
                {relative(account.lastSyncedAt)}
              </time>
            )}
          </Fact>
          {pausedUntil !== null ? (
            <Fact label={t("account.connection.pausedUntil")}>{relative(pausedUntil)}</Fact>
          ) : null}
          <Fact label={t("account.connection.lastError")}>
            {connection.lastError === null && account.lastSyncError === null ? (
              <span className="text-muted">{t("account.connection.noError")}</span>
            ) : (
              <span className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                {connection.lastError !== null ? (
                  <span>
                    {t("account.connection.connectionError", {
                      reason: errorLabel(t, connection.lastError.code),
                      when: relative(connection.lastError.at),
                    })}
                  </span>
                ) : null}
                {account.lastSyncError !== null ? (
                  <span>
                    {t("account.connection.updateError", {
                      reason: errorLabel(t, account.lastSyncError.code),
                      when: relative(account.lastSyncError.at),
                    })}
                  </span>
                ) : null}
              </span>
            )}
          </Fact>
        </dl>
      </Card>

      <Card padding="lg">
        <h2 className="mb-3 font-display text-base font-semibold text-fg">
          {t("account.connection.actionsTitle")}
        </h2>
        {states.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted">{t("account.connection.removedNote")}</p>
        ) : (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {states.map((state) => (
              <Button
                key={state.action}
                variant={
                  state.primary ? "primary" : state.action === "disconnect" ? "danger" : "secondary"
                }
                icon={ACTION_ICON[state.action]}
                loading={state.action !== "disconnect" && actions.pending[state.action]}
                disabled={state.blockedKey !== null}
                title={state.blockedKey !== null ? t(state.blockedKey) : undefined}
                data-qa-skip={state.action === "renew" ? "" : undefined}
                onClick={() => press(state.action)}
              >
                {t(`account.actions.${state.action}`)}
              </Button>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>

      <Card padding="lg">
        <h2 className="mb-3 font-display text-base font-semibold text-fg">
          {t("account.sync.title")}
        </h2>
        <SyncHistory runs={detail.syncRuns} />
      </Card>

      <DisconnectDialog
        connection={disconnecting ? { id: connection.id, bankName: connection.bankName } : null}
        onClose={() => setDisconnecting(false)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```
