- [ ] **Step 9: Implement the hero and the page**

Create `apps/web/src/pages/account/AccountHero.tsx`:

```tsx
import type { AccountDetailResponse } from "@bursar/shared";
import { Check, RefreshCw, RotateCw } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Button, DeadlineChip, MaskedIban, Money, StatusPill } from "../../components/ui";
import { useFormatters } from "../../lib/format";
import { freshnessUrgency } from "../../lib/thresholds";
import { useAccountActions as useAccountsPageActions } from "../accounts/actions";
import { NicknameEditor } from "../accounts/NicknameEditor";
import { accountActionStates, type StripeTone, statusPill, stripeTone } from "./account-state";
import { useAccountActions } from "./useAccountActions";

const STRIPE_CLASS: Record<StripeTone, string> = {
  positive: "bg-positive",
  warning: "bg-warning",
  danger: "bg-danger",
  neutral: "bg-muted",
};

const ACTION_ICON = { sync: RefreshCw, renew: RotateCw, enable: Check } as const;

/**
 * The identity card of the account: a 6 px stripe in the state colour, the name (renamed in place),
 * bank, masked IBAN with copy, one status pill, freshness, the balance and the primary action.
 */
export function AccountHero({ detail }: { detail: AccountDetailResponse }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { relative, absolute, now } = useFormatters();
  const actions = useAccountActions(detail);
  // Task 18's rename mutation: saves, shows the "Account renamed" toast, reports a failure and
  // invalidates connections, summary and the `["accounts"]` prefix (this page's detail query).
  const { rename } = useAccountsPageActions();
  const { account, connection } = detail;

  const tone = stripeTone(detail);
  const pill = statusPill(detail);
  const freshness = freshnessUrgency(account.lastSyncedAt, now());
  const primary = accountActionStates(detail, now()).find((state) => state.primary);
  const primaryAction = primary && primary.action !== "disconnect" ? primary.action : null;
  const bankLine = [connection.bankName, account.nickname !== null ? account.bankProduct : null]
    .filter((part): part is string => part !== null && part !== "")
    .join(" · ");

  return (
    <section
      aria-label={t("account.hero.label")}
      className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-subtle bg-surface shadow-sm"
    >
      <div
        aria-hidden="true"
        data-testid="status-stripe"
        data-tone={tone}
        className={`h-1.5 ${STRIPE_CLASS[tone]}`}
      />
      <div className="grid gap-5 p-5 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_auto] md:p-6">
        <div className="min-w-0 space-y-3">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <h1 className="font-display text-2xl font-semibold text-fg">
              <NicknameEditor
                name={account.name}
                nickname={account.nickname}
                placeholder={account.nickname ? (account.bankProduct ?? "") : account.name}
                onSave={async (nickname) => {
                  await rename.mutateAsync({ account, nickname });
                }}
              />
            </h1>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted">{bankLine}</p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <StatusPill tone={pill.tone} label={t(`account.status.${pill.key}`)} />
            {account.syncInProgress ? (
              <span role="status" className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted">
                <RefreshCw
                  aria-hidden
                  size={14}
                  className="animate-spin motion-reduce:animate-none"
                />
                {t("account.hero.syncing")}
              </span>
            ) : (
              <DeadlineChip
                urgency={freshness.urgency}
                label={
                  account.lastSyncedAt === null
                    ? t("account.hero.neverUpdated")
                    : t("account.hero.updated", { when: relative(account.lastSyncedAt) })
                }
                title={
                  account.lastSyncedAt === null ? undefined : absolute(account.lastSyncedAt, true)
                }
              />
            )}
            <span className="text-xs font-medium text-muted">{account.currency}</span>
          </div>
          {account.maskedIdentifier !== null ? (
            <MaskedIban masked={account.maskedIdentifier} iban={account.iban} copyable />
          ) : null}
        </div>

        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-3 md:items-end md:text-right">
          {account.balance !== null ? (
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted">
                {t("account.hero.balance")}
              </p>
              <Money
                minor={account.balance.amountMinor}
                currency={account.balance.currency}
                tone="auto-balance"
                className="font-display text-3xl font-semibold"
              />
              <p className="text-xs text-muted">
                {t("account.hero.balanceAsOf", { when: relative(account.balance.asOf) })}
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted">{t("account.hero.noBalance")}</p>
          )}
          {primary && primaryAction ? (
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              icon={ACTION_ICON[primaryAction]}
              loading={actions.pending[primaryAction]}
              disabled={primary.blockedKey !== null}
              title={primary.blockedKey !== null ? t(primary.blockedKey) : undefined}
              data-qa-skip={primaryAction === "renew" ? "" : undefined}
              onClick={() => actions.run(primaryAction)}
            >
              {t(`account.actions.${primaryAction}`)}
            </Button>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

Create `apps/web/src/pages/AccountDetailPage.tsx`:

```tsx
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { SearchX, TriangleAlert } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useNavigate, useParams } from "react-router";
import { ApiError, api } from "../api";
import { BackButton } from "../app/BackButton";
import { Breadcrumbs } from "../app/Breadcrumbs";
import { buildPath } from "../app/routes";
import { Button, Cascade, EmptyState, Tabs } from "../components/ui";
import { queryKeys } from "../lib/query-keys";
import { useUrlState } from "../lib/url-state";
import { AccountHero } from "./account/AccountHero";
import { type AccountTab, isAccountTab } from "./account/account-state";
import { ConnectionTab } from "./account/ConnectionTab";
import { OverviewTab } from "./account/OverviewTab";
import { TransactionsTab } from "./account/TransactionsTab";

/** A positive integer path segment, or null (so `abc`, `0`, `-1` and `1.5` never reach the API). */
function parseAccountId(raw: string | undefined): number | null {
  return raw !== undefined && /^[1-9]\d{0,9}$/.test(raw) ? Number(raw) : null;
}

function Trail({ current }: { current: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1">
      <BackButton routeId="account" />
      <Breadcrumbs routeId="account" current={current} />
    </div>
  );
}

function AccountNotFound() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <Trail current={t("account.notFound.crumb")} />
      <EmptyState
        kind="notFound"
        icon={SearchX}
        title={t("account.notFound.title")}
        description={t("account.notFound.description")}
        action={
          <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => navigate(buildPath("accounts"))}>
            {t("account.notFound.back")}
          </Button>
        }
      />
    </div>
  );
}

function DetailSkeleton() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  return (
    <div aria-busy="true" className="space-y-5">
      <p className="sr-only">{t("common.loading")}</p>
      <div className="h-5 w-56 animate-pulse rounded bg-surface-2" />
      <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-subtle bg-surface">
        <div className="h-1.5 bg-surface-2" />
        <div className="grid gap-4 p-6 md:grid-cols-[1fr_auto]">
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div className="h-7 w-64 animate-pulse rounded bg-surface-2" />
            <div className="h-4 w-40 animate-pulse rounded bg-surface-2" />
            <div className="h-6 w-72 animate-pulse rounded bg-surface-2" />
          </div>
          <div className="h-12 w-44 animate-pulse rounded bg-surface-2" />
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="h-64 animate-pulse rounded-2xl bg-surface-2" />
    </div>
  );
}

/** `/accounts/:accountId`: hero, then the Overview, Transactions and Connection tabs (`?tab=`). */
export function AccountDetailPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const accountId = parseAccountId(useParams().accountId);
  const [url, setUrl] = useUrlState({ tab: "overview" }, { validate: { tab: isAccountTab } });
  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.account(accountId ?? 0),
    queryFn: () => api.account(accountId ?? 0),
    enabled: accountId !== null,
  });

  if (accountId === null || (query.error instanceof ApiError && query.error.status === 404)) {
    return <AccountNotFound />;
  }
  if (query.isError && !query.data) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-6">
        <Trail current={t("account.loadError.crumb")} />
        <EmptyState
          kind="state"
          icon={TriangleAlert}
          title={t("account.loadError.title")}
          description={t("account.loadError.description")}
          action={
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => query.refetch()}>
              {t("account.retry")}
            </Button>
          }
        />
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (!query.data) return <DetailSkeleton />;

  const detail = query.data;
  const tab = url.tab as AccountTab;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <Trail current={detail.account.name} />
      <Cascade index={0}>
        <AccountHero detail={detail} />
      </Cascade>
      <Cascade index={1}>
        <Tabs
          ariaLabel={t("account.tabs.label")}
          value={tab}
          onChange={(id) => setUrl({ tab: id })}
          items={[
            { id: "overview", label: t("account.tabs.overview") },
            {
              id: "transactions",
              label: t("account.tabs.transactions"),
              count: detail.transactionCount,
            },
            { id: "connection", label: t("account.tabs.connection") },
          ]}
        />
      </Cascade>
      <Cascade index={0} key={tab}>
        <div role="tabpanel" aria-label={t(`account.tabs.${tab}`)}>
          {tab === "overview" ? (
            <OverviewTab detail={detail} onSelectTab={(next) => setUrl({ tab: next })} />
          ) : tab === "transactions" ? (
            <TransactionsTab accountId={detail.account.id} />
          ) : (
            <ConnectionTab detail={detail} />
          )}
        </div>
      </Cascade>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Task 20: Connect wizard and callback page

**Files:**

- Create (additive, the contract does not list them): `apps/web/src/pages/connect/consent.ts` (default duration, options and end date), `apps/web/src/pages/connect/countries.ts` (curated country list, localised names), `apps/web/src/pages/connect/LinkButton.tsx` (a router `Link` styled as a button), `apps/web/src/pages/connect/ConnectBankButton.tsx` (the "Connect a bank" button used by Accounts and Home)
- Modify: `apps/web/src/api.ts`, `apps/web/src/app/routes.ts`, `apps/web/src/app/pages.ts`, `apps/web/src/pages/AccountsPage.tsx`, `apps/web/src/pages/HomePage.tsx`, `apps/web/qa/extra-paths.ts`, `apps/web/src/i18n/en.json`, `apps/web/src/i18n/it.json`
- Modify (tests of earlier tasks that this task's changes touch, additive): `apps/web/src/app/routes.test.ts` (the pinned list of shipped routes), `apps/web/src/pages/AccountsPage.test.tsx`, `apps/web/src/pages/HomePage.test.tsx` (one assertion each for the new button)
- Test: `apps/web/src/pages/ConnectPage.test.tsx`, `apps/web/src/pages/ConnectCallbackPage.test.tsx`, and the additive `apps/web/src/pages/connect/helpers.test.ts`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: shared `AspspListResponse`, `AspspSummary`, `BankStatusResponse`, `StartConnectionRequest`, `StartConnectionResponse`, `CompleteConnectionRequest`, `CompleteConnectionResponse`; routes `GET /api/banks/status`, `GET /api/banks/aspsps`, `GET /api/banks/logo`, `POST /api/connections`, `POST /api/connections/complete`; settings (`country`, `consentDays`).
- Produces:
  - `api.ts`: `bankStatus(): Promise<BankStatusResponse>`, `aspsps(country: string): Promise<AspspListResponse>`, `startConnection(body: StartConnectionRequest): Promise<StartConnectionResponse>`, `completeConnection(body: CompleteConnectionRequest): Promise<CompleteConnectionResponse>`.
  - Routes `connect` (`/connect`) and `connectCallback` (`/connect/callback`) shipped (parent `accounts`, not in the sidebar); "Connect a bank" buttons added to the Accounts header and the Home/Accounts true-empty states.
  - `QA_EXTRA_PATHS` gains `/connect?step=bank&country=IT`, `/connect?step=consent&country=IT&bank=<first fake bank>`, `/connect/callback?state=invalid-state-value-000`, `/connect/callback?error=access_denied&state=invalid-state-value-000`.
  - i18n prefix `connect.*`.

**Implementation notes (read before Step 1):**
- **Earlier tasks that must be merged:** Task 4 (router, `Breadcrumbs`, `BackButton`, `queryKeys`, `ApiError`, the `renderRoutes`/`stubApi`/`testQueryClient` helpers in `apps/web/src/test/router.tsx`), Task 3 (primitives, `feedback`, `useUrlState`, `useFormatters`, `matchesQuery`), Task 17 (`useSettingsQuery`, `api.settings`), Task 18 (`bankLogoUrl` in `api.ts`, the Accounts page) and Task 10/11 on the server (the fake bank and the connect routes, used by the QA round trip). The code below uses exactly the signatures in their **Interfaces** blocks. If an installed version differs, keep the names and signatures of this task's Interfaces and record the difference in the commit body.
- **Wizard state** lives in the URL: `step` (`country` | `bank` | `consent`, default `country`), `country` (two capital letters) and `bank` (the ASPSP name). Writes use `replace` through `useUrlState`. The step that is *shown* is derived: a missing country always falls back to the country step, a missing or unknown bank to the bank step, so a pasted or stale URL never shows a broken step. The consent duration is local state of the consent step (it is not worth a URL parameter and it must reset when the bank changes; the step is keyed by bank).
- **Country** options come from `bankStatus.countries` when that list is not empty, otherwise from the curated list in `countries.ts`; the preselection is `settings.values.country` when it is in the list. Names come from `Intl.DisplayNames`, never from a hand-written table.
- **Consent duration:** default `min(bank maximumConsentDays, settings.consentDays)` (UX doc §4 says "default the maximum"; the M1 contract says the settings value capped by the bank, which is what the owner configured). The end date shown is computed like the server does (`now + days − 10 minutes`, in the settings time zone) so the date in the UI is the date the bank will show. The 10-minute constant is duplicated from Task 11's `CONSENT_SAFETY_MARGIN_MS` on purpose and has a comment pointing at it.
- **Redirect:** `window.location.assign(redirectUrl)` only for `http:` and `https:` URLs; anything else is treated as a failed start. A `pageshow` listener resets the mutation when the browser restores the page from its back-forward cache, so the button is not stuck in its loading state after "Back" from the bank.
- **Callback page:** it reads `window.location.search` once (a lazy `useState` initialiser, so React StrictMode's double render sees the same value), strips the four parameters with `history.replaceState` in the first effect and posts `completeConnection` exactly once (a `useRef` guard survives StrictMode's mount, unmount, mount). If the POST answers 401 (the session expired between the bank and the panel), the original query string is put back **before** the error reaches the query client, so the global 401 handler builds `/login?…&next=/connect/callback?state=…` and the page resumes after login; the state is only consumed by the server on a successful exchange, so it stays valid for its 30 minutes. The page never shows `error_description` (it is arbitrary bank text); failures show a translated sentence chosen by the `errorCode`.
- **Hidden until shipped:** this task flips `connect` and `connectCallback` to `shipped: true` in `routes.ts` and adds their loaders in `pages.ts` in the same commit, so the router never has a shipped route without a page.
- **Icon names** (`KeyRound`, `TriangleAlert`, `ShieldCheck`, `ChevronRight`, `CircleCheck`, `CircleAlert`, `Ban`, `Clock`, `Info`, `Plus`, `Check`, `Landmark`) are checked by `pnpm typecheck` against the installed `lucide-react`; if one is missing, replace it with the closest existing icon and say so in the commit body.
- **Test selectors:** the product code carries four `data-testid` attributes that the temporary QA round-trip script (Step 13) uses: `connect-country-continue`, `bank-option`, `connect-start`, and `data-outcome` on the callback card. They are also asserted in the unit tests so they cannot rot silently.

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { consentEndDate, consentOptions, defaultConsentDays } from "./consent";
import { CURATED_COUNTRIES, countryName, countryOptions } from "./countries";

describe("consent helpers", () => {
  it("defaults to the smaller of the bank maximum and the configured duration", () => {
    expect(defaultConsentDays(90, 180)).toBe(90);
    expect(defaultConsentDays(180, 60)).toBe(60);
    expect(defaultConsentDays(400, 500)).toBe(365);
    expect(defaultConsentDays(0, 90)).toBe(1);
  });

  it("offers presets up to the bank maximum plus the default and the maximum", () => {
    expect(consentOptions(90, 90)).toEqual([30, 60, 90]);
    expect(consentOptions(180, 45)).toEqual([30, 45, 60, 90, 180]);
    expect(consentOptions(20, 20)).toEqual([20]);
    expect(consentOptions(400, 365)).toEqual([30, 60, 90, 180, 365]);
  });

  it("computes the end date in the given time zone, ten minutes before the whole days", () => {
    const morning = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 9, 10, 0);
    expect(consentEndDate(morning, 90, "Europe/Rome")).toBe("2027-02-07");
    const lateEvening = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 9, 23, 55);
    expect(consentEndDate(lateEvening, 1, "UTC")).toBe("2026-11-10");
    expect(consentEndDate(lateEvening, 1, "Europe/Rome")).toBe("2026-11-11");
  });
});

describe("country helpers", () => {
  it("names a country in the given locale and falls back to the code", () => {
    expect(countryName("IT", "en-GB")).toBe("Italy");
    expect(countryName("IT", "it-IT")).toBe("Italia");
    expect(countryName("toolong", "en-GB")).toBe("toolong");
  });

  it("builds sorted, de-duplicated options by localised name", () => {
    const options = countryOptions(["IT", "DE", "FI", "it"], "en-GB");
    expect(options).toEqual([
      { value: "FI", label: "Finland" },
      { value: "DE", label: "Germany" },
      { value: "IT", label: "Italy" },
    ]);
  });

  it("keeps a curated list of two-letter codes without duplicates", () => {
    expect(CURATED_COUNTRIES.every((code) => /^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(code))).toBe(true);
    expect(new Set(CURATED_COUNTRIES).size).toBe(CURATED_COUNTRIES.length);
    expect(CURATED_COUNTRIES).toContain("IT");
  });
});
```

```tsx
import {
  type AspspListResponse,
  type BankStatusResponse,
  SETTINGS_DEFAULTS,
  type SettingsResponse,
} from "@bursar/shared";
import { fireEvent, screen, waitFor, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { feedback } from "../components/feedback";
import i18n from "../i18n";
import { renderRoutes, stubApi } from "../test/router";
import { ConnectBankButton } from "./connect/ConnectBankButton";
import { ConnectPage } from "./ConnectPage";

vi.mock("../components/feedback", async (importOriginal) => {
  const actual = await importOriginal<typeof import("../components/feedback")>();
  return { ...actual, feedback: vi.fn() };
});

type Handler = (body: unknown) => { status: number; body?: unknown };

const STATUS_OK: BankStatusResponse = {
  configured: true,
  environment: "SANDBOX",
  active: true,
  redirectUrlAllowed: true,
  countries: ["IT", "DE", "FI"],
  error: null,
};

const BANKS: AspspListResponse = {
  aspsps: [
    { name: "Banca Esempio", country: "IT", maximumConsentDays: 180, beta: false, hasLogo: false },
    { name: "Banca Perù", country: "IT", maximumConsentDays: 365, beta: false, hasLogo: false },
    { name: "Northwind Bank", country: "IT", maximumConsentDays: 90, beta: true, hasLogo: false },
  ],
};

function settingsResponse(overrides: Partial<SettingsResponse["values"]> = {}): SettingsResponse {
  return {
    values: { ...SETTINGS_DEFAULTS, country: "IT", ...overrides },
    system: {
      timezone: "Europe/Rome",
      publicUrl: "https://bursar.example.test",
      enableBankingConfigured: true,
      smtpConfigured: false,
      backupTarget: "local",
    },
  };
}

function handlers(
  extra: Record<string, Handler> = {},
  options: {
    status?: BankStatusResponse;
    settings?: SettingsResponse;
    banks?: AspspListResponse;
  } = {},
): Record<string, Handler> {
  return {
    "GET /api/banks/status": () => ({ status: 200, body: options.status ?? STATUS_OK }),
    "GET /api/settings": () => ({ status: 200, body: options.settings ?? settingsResponse() }),
    "GET /api/banks/aspsps?country=IT": () => ({ status: 200, body: options.banks ?? BANKS }),
    ...extra,
  };
}

function renderConnect(url: string) {
  return renderRoutes(
    [
      { path: "/connect", element: <ConnectPage /> },
      { path: "/accounts", element: <p>Accounts page</p> },
    ],
    { initialEntries: [url] },
  );
}

function urlParams(router: { state: { location: { search: string } } }) {
  return Object.fromEntries(new URLSearchParams(router.state.location.search));
}

const CONSENT_URL = "/connect?step=consent&country=IT&bank=Banca%20Esempio";

describe("ConnectPage", () => {
  beforeEach(async () => {
    await i18n.changeLanguage("en");

  it("preselects the settings country and moves to the bank step", async () => {

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Choose a bank" }));

  it("offers the countries reported by the bank status, sorted by name", async () => {
```

```tsx
import type { CompleteConnectionResponse } from "@bursar/shared";
import { QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { render, screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import { StrictMode } from "react";
import { createMemoryRouter } from "react-router";
import { RouterProvider } from "react-router/dom";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import i18n from "../i18n";
import { stubApi, testQueryClient } from "../test/router";
import { ConnectCallbackPage } from "./ConnectCallbackPage";

const STATE = "s-3f9a1c7e5b2d4a60-abcdef";
const COMPLETE = "POST /api/connections/complete";

function response(overrides: Partial<CompleteConnectionResponse>): CompleteConnectionResponse {
  return {
    outcome: "connected",
    connectionId: 7,
    bankName: "Northwind Bank",
    accounts: [],
    errorCode: null,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

const ONE_ACCOUNT = [
  {
    id: 1,
    name: "Northwind Current",
    maskedIdentifier: "IT60 •••• •••• 1234",
    currency: "EUR",
    status: "active" as const,
  },
];

function renderCallback(search: string, options: { strict?: boolean } = {}) {
  window.history.replaceState(null, "", `/connect/callback${search}`);
  const router = createMemoryRouter(
    [
      { path: "/connect/callback", element: <ConnectCallbackPage /> },
      { path: "/connect", element: <p>Connect page</p> },
      { path: "/accounts", element: <p>Accounts page</p> },
    ],
    { initialEntries: ["/connect/callback"] },
  );
  const tree = (
    <QueryClientProvider client={testQueryClient()}>
      <RouterProvider router={router} />
    </QueryClientProvider>
  );
  return render(options.strict ? <StrictMode>{tree}</StrictMode> : tree);
}

function completeCalls(fetchMock: ReturnType<typeof stubApi>) {
  return fetchMock.mock.calls.filter(([input]) => input === "/api/connections/complete");
}

describe("ConnectCallbackPage", () => {
  beforeEach(async () => {
    await i18n.changeLanguage("en");
  });
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllGlobals();
    window.history.replaceState(null, "", "/");
  });

  it("completes a new connection, lists the accounts and strips the parameters", async () => {
    const fetchMock = stubApi({
      [COMPLETE]: () => ({ status: 200, body: response({ accounts: ONE_ACCOUNT }) }),
    });
    renderCallback(`?state=${STATE}&code=fake-1`);
    await screen.findByRole("heading", { name: "Bank connected" });
    expect(screen.getByText("1 account found")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText("Northwind Current")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText("IT60 •••• •••• 1234")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText("EUR")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(
      screen.getByText("Initial sync started: transactions appear in a few minutes."),
    ).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole("link", { name: "Open accounts" }).getAttribute("href")).toBe(
      "/accounts",
    );
    expect(document.querySelector('[data-outcome="connected"]')).not.toBeNull();
    expect(window.location.search).toBe("");
    const calls = completeCalls(fetchMock);
    expect(calls).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(JSON.parse(String(calls[0]?.[1]?.body))).toEqual({ state: STATE, code: "fake-1" });
  });

  it("shows a renewed consent", async () => {
    stubApi({
      [COMPLETE]: () => ({
        status: 200,
        body: response({ outcome: "renewed", accounts: ONE_ACCOUNT }),
      }),
    });
    renderCallback(`?state=${STATE}&code=fake-2`);
    await screen.findByRole("heading", { name: "Consent renewed" });
  });

  it("gives restricted-mode guidance when the bank shared no accounts", async () => {
    stubApi({ [COMPLETE]: () => ({ status: 200, body: response({ outcome: "no_accounts" }) }) });
    renderCallback(`?state=${STATE}&code=fake-empty-1`);
    await screen.findByRole("heading", { name: "No accounts were shared" });
    expect(screen.getByText(/Open the Enable Banking Control Panel/)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole("link", { name: "Try again" }).getAttribute("href")).toBe("/connect");
  });

  it("reports a cancelled authorisation and sends the error to the server", async () => {
    const fetchMock = stubApi({
      [COMPLETE]: () => ({ status: 200, body: response({ outcome: "denied" }) }),
    });
    renderCallback(
      `?error=access_denied&error_description=Cancelled%20by%20user&state=${STATE}`,
    );
    await screen.findByRole("heading", { name: "You cancelled at the bank" });
    expect(screen.getByRole("link", { name: "Try again" }).getAttribute("href")).toBe("/connect");
    expect(JSON.parse(String(completeCalls(fetchMock)[0]?.[1]?.body))).toEqual({
      state: STATE,
      error: "access_denied",
      errorDescription: "Cancelled by user",
    });
  });

  it("translates a known failure code", async () => {
    stubApi({
      [COMPLETE]: () => ({
        status: 200,
        body: response({ outcome: "failed", errorCode: "EXPIRED_AUTHORIZATION_CODE" }),
      }),
    });
    renderCallback(`?state=${STATE}&code=fake-3`);
    await screen.findByRole("heading", { name: "The bank could not be connected" });
    expect(screen.getByText(/authorisation code from the bank expired/)).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it("shows a generic sentence for an unknown failure code and never the raw code", async () => {
    stubApi({
      [COMPLETE]: () => ({
        status: 200,
        body: response({ outcome: "failed", errorCode: "server_error" }),
      }),
    });
    renderCallback(`?state=${STATE}&error=server_error`);
    await screen.findByText(/The bank reported an error/);
    expect(screen.queryByText(/server_error/)).toBeNull();
  });

  it("explains an expired or already used link on 410", async () => {
    stubApi({
      [COMPLETE]: () => ({
        status: 410,
        body: { error: "Invalid state", code: "state_invalid" },
      }),
    });
    renderCallback(`?state=${STATE}&code=fake-4`);
    await screen.findByRole("heading", { name: "This link has expired or was already used" });
    expect(screen.getByRole("link", { name: "Start again" }).getAttribute("href")).toBe("/connect");
    expect(document.querySelector('[data-outcome="state_invalid"]')).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it("explains that banking is not configured on 503", async () => {
    stubApi({
      [COMPLETE]: () => ({
        status: 503,
        body: { error: "Banking is not configured", code: "banking_not_configured" },
      }),
    });
    renderCallback(`?state=${STATE}&code=fake-5`);
    await screen.findByRole("heading", { name: "Bank connections are not set up" });
  });

  it("shows a generic error for any other failure", async () => {
    stubApi({ [COMPLETE]: () => ({ status: 500, body: { error: "Internal error" } }) });
    renderCallback(`?state=${STATE}&code=fake-6`);
    await screen.findByRole("heading", { name: "The connection could not be completed" });
    expect(screen.getByRole("link", { name: "Start again" })).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it("does not call the server when there is nothing to complete", async () => {
    const fetchMock = stubApi({});
    renderCallback("");
    await screen.findByRole("heading", { name: "There is no bank response to complete" });
    expect(screen.getByRole("link", { name: "Connect a bank" }).getAttribute("href")).toBe(
      "/connect",
    );
    expect(fetchMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("treats a state that is too short as missing", async () => {
    const fetchMock = stubApi({});
    renderCallback("?state=short&code=fake-7");
    await screen.findByRole("heading", { name: "There is no bank response to complete" });
    expect(fetchMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("submits exactly once under StrictMode", async () => {
    const fetchMock = stubApi({
      [COMPLETE]: () => ({ status: 200, body: response({ accounts: ONE_ACCOUNT }) }),
    });
    renderCallback(`?state=${STATE}&code=fake-8`, { strict: true });
    await screen.findByRole("heading", { name: "Bank connected" });
    expect(completeCalls(fetchMock)).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(window.location.search).toBe("");
  });

  it("puts the parameters back when the session expired, so login can resume", async () => {
    stubApi({ [COMPLETE]: () => ({ status: 401, body: { error: "Unauthorized" } }) });
    renderCallback(`?state=${STATE}&code=fake-9`);
    await waitFor(() => expect(window.location.search).toBe(`?state=${STATE}&code=fake-9`));
  });
});
```

```ts
import { type LocalDate, toLocalDate } from "@bursar/shared";

const DAY_MS = 86_400_000;

/**
 * The server ends a consent this long before the whole-day mark (`CONSENT_SAFETY_MARGIN_MS` in
 * `apps/server/src/finance/connect.ts`, Task 11), so a bank never rejects `valid_until`. The panel
 * subtracts it too, so the date it shows is the date the bank will show.
 */
export const CONSENT_MARGIN_MS = 10 * 60_000;

/** The API accepts 1–365 days (`startConnectionRequestSchema`). */
export const MAX_CONSENT_DAYS = 365;

const PRESET_DAYS = [30, 60, 90, 180, 365] as const;

/** Default duration: the configured duration, capped by what the bank allows. */
export function defaultConsentDays(bankMaxDays: number, settingsDays: number): number {
  return Math.max(1, Math.min(bankMaxDays, settingsDays, MAX_CONSENT_DAYS));
}

/** Sorted, de-duplicated durations: the presets the bank allows, the default and the maximum. */
export function consentOptions(bankMaxDays: number, defaultDays: number): number[] {
  const ceiling = Math.max(1, Math.min(bankMaxDays, MAX_CONSENT_DAYS));
  const days = new Set<number>([defaultDays, ceiling]);
  for (const preset of PRESET_DAYS) {
    if (preset <= ceiling) days.add(preset);
  }
  return [...days].filter((value) => value >= 1 && value <= ceiling).sort((a, b) => a - b);
}

/** Calendar date, in the owner's time zone, on which a consent of `days` days ends. */
export function consentEndDate(now: number, days: number, timeZone: string): LocalDate {
  return toLocalDate(now + days * DAY_MS - CONSENT_MARGIN_MS, timeZone);
}
```

```ts
import { naturalCollator } from "../../lib/search";

/** Countries Enable Banking covers, used when the bank status does not report its own list. */
export const CURATED_COUNTRIES: readonly string[] = [
  "AT",
  "BE",
  "BG",
  "HR",
  "CY",
  "CZ",
  "DK",
  "EE",
  "FI",
  "FR",
  "DE",
  "GR",
  "HU",
  "IS",
  "IE",
  "IT",
  "LV",
  "LI",
  "LT",
  "LU",
  "MT",
  "NL",
  "NO",
  "PL",
  "PT",
  "RO",
  "SK",
  "SI",
  "ES",
  "SE",
  "GB",
];

/** Localised country name; falls back to the code itself for anything `Intl` cannot name. */
export function countryName(code: string, locale: string): string {
  try {
    return new Intl.DisplayNames([locale], { type: "region", fallback: "code" }).of(code) ?? code;
  } catch {
    return code;
  }
}

/** Select options for the given codes, upper-cased, de-duplicated and sorted by localised name. */
export function countryOptions(
  codes: readonly string[],
  locale: string,
): { value: string; label: string }[] {
  const collator = naturalCollator(locale);
  return [...new Set(codes.map((code) => code.toUpperCase()))]
    .map((code) => ({ value: code, label: countryName(code, locale) }))
    .sort((a, b) => collator.compare(a.label, b.label));
}
```

```tsx
const BASE =
  "inline-flex min-h-10 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 text-sm font-semibold transition-colors max-sm:min-h-11";

const VARIANTS = {
  primary: "bg-primary text-surface hover:opacity-90",
  secondary: "border border-subtle bg-surface text-fg hover:bg-surface-2",
} as const;

export interface LinkButtonProps {
  to: string;
  variant?: keyof typeof VARIANTS;
  icon?: LucideIcon;
  className?: string;
  children: ReactNode;
}

/** A router link that looks like a button: navigation stays a link for the keyboard and for AT. */
export function LinkButton({
  to,
  variant = "primary",
  icon: Icon,
  className,
  children,
}: LinkButtonProps) {
  return (
    <Link to={to} className={cn(BASE, VARIANTS[variant], className)}>
      {Icon ? <Icon aria-hidden size={16} strokeWidth={1.75} /> : null}
      {children}
    </Link>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Check } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { cn } from "../../components/ui/cn";

export type WizardStepId = "country" | "bank" | "consent";

/** The redirect to the bank is the action of the last step, not a step of its own. */
export const WIZARD_STEPS: readonly WizardStepId[] = ["country", "bank", "consent"];

export function isWizardStep(value: string): value is WizardStepId {
  return (WIZARD_STEPS as readonly string[]).includes(value);
}

export interface WizardStepsProps {
  current: WizardStepId;
  /** Steps the owner may jump to (completed ones). */
  reachable: readonly WizardStepId[];
  onSelect(step: WizardStepId): void;
}

/**
 * Step indicator that fits 390 px: numbered circles joined by lines; below `sm` only the current
 * label is drawn (the others stay readable for screen readers).
 */
export function WizardSteps({ current, reachable, onSelect }: WizardStepsProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const currentIndex = WIZARD_STEPS.indexOf(current);
  return (
    <nav aria-label={t("connect.steps.label")} className="mb-6">
      <ol className="flex items-center gap-2">
        {WIZARD_STEPS.map((step, index) => {
          const label = t(`connect.steps.${step}`);
          const active = step === current;
          const done = index < currentIndex;
          const selectable = !active && reachable.includes(step);
          const content = (
            <>
              <span
                aria-hidden
                className={cn(
                  "inline-flex size-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[13px] font-semibold",
                  active
                    ? "bg-primary text-surface"
                    : done
                      ? "bg-primary-50 text-primary"
                      : "bg-surface-2 text-muted",
                )}
              >
                {done ? <Check size={14} strokeWidth={2.25} /> : index + 1}
              </span>
              <span
                className={cn(
                  "text-sm",
                  active ? "font-semibold text-fg" : "text-muted",
                  !active && "max-sm:sr-only",
                )}
              >
                {label}
              </span>
            </>
          );
          return (
            <li
              key={step}
              aria-current={active ? "step" : undefined}
              className="flex items-center gap-2"
            >
              {index > 0 ? <span aria-hidden className="h-px w-5 bg-subtle sm:w-8" /> : null}
              {selectable ? (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onSelect(step)}
                  className="flex min-h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg sm:min-h-0"
                >
                  {content}
                </button>
              ) : (
                <span className="flex items-center gap-2">{content}</span>
              )}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ol>
    </nav>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Button, Select } from "../../components/ui";
import { useFormatters } from "../../lib/format";
import { countryOptions } from "./countries";

export interface CountryStepProps {
  countries: readonly string[];
  value: string;
  onChange(code: string): void;
  onContinue(): void;
}

export function CountryStep({ countries, value, onChange, onContinue }: CountryStepProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { locale } = useFormatters();
  const options = useMemo(
    () => [{ value: "", label: t("connect.country.choose") }, ...countryOptions(countries, locale)],
    [countries, locale, t],
  );
  return (
    <form
      className="space-y-5"
      onSubmit={(event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        if (value !== "") onContinue();
      }}
    >
      <section>
        <h2 className="font-display text-xl font-bold text-fg">{t("connect.country.title")}</h2>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted">{t("connect.country.description")}</p>
      </section>
      <Select
        id="connect-country"
        label={t("connect.country.label")}
        options={options}
        value={value}
        onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}
      />
      <div className="flex justify-end">
        <Button type="submit" disabled={value === ""} data-testid="connect-country-continue">
          {t("connect.country.continue")}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { AspspListResponse, AspspSummary } from "@bursar/shared";
import type { UseQueryResult } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { ChevronRight } from "lucide-react";
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { bankLogoUrl } from "../../api";
import { Badge, Button, EmptyState, SearchInput } from "../../components/ui";
import { matchesQuery } from "../../lib/search";

/** Up to two initials of the bank name, for banks without a logo. */
export function bankInitials(name: string): string {
  return name
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter((word) => word.length > 0)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((word) => Array.from(word)[0]?.toUpperCase() ?? "")
    .join("");
}

const MARK_SIZES = { sm: "size-8", md: "size-10" } as const;

/** The bank's logo through the server proxy, or its initials when there is none or it fails. */
export function BankMark({
  bank,
  size = "md",
}: {
  bank: Pick<AspspSummary, "name" | "country" | "hasLogo">;
  size?: keyof typeof MARK_SIZES;
}) {
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);
  if (bank.hasLogo && !failed) {
    return (
      <img
        src={bankLogoUrl(bank.country, bank.name)}
        alt=""
        loading="lazy"
        onError={() => setFailed(true)}
        className={`${MARK_SIZES[size]} shrink-0 rounded-lg bg-surface-2 object-contain`}
      />
    );
  }
  return (
    <span
      aria-hidden
      className={`${MARK_SIZES[size]} inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary-50 text-sm font-semibold text-primary`}
    >
      {bankInitials(bank.name)}
    </span>
  );
}

const SKELETON_ROWS = [
  { id: "a", width: "w-full" },
  { id: "b", width: "w-11/12" },
  { id: "c", width: "w-full" },
  { id: "d", width: "w-10/12" },
  { id: "e", width: "w-full" },
] as const;

export interface BankStepProps {
  /** Localised name of the chosen country. */
  countryLabel: string;
  query: UseQueryResult<AspspListResponse>;
  onPick(bank: AspspSummary): void;
  onChangeCountry(): void;
}

export function BankStep({ countryLabel, query, onPick, onChangeCountry }: BankStepProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const banks = query.data?.aspsps;
  const visible = useMemo(() => {
    if (!banks) return [];
    return search.trim() === "" ? banks : banks.filter((bank) => matchesQuery(bank.name, search));
  }, [banks, search]);

  return (
    <section className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-2">
        <div>
          <h2 className="font-display text-xl font-bold text-fg">{t("connect.bank.title")}</h2>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted">
            {t("connect.bank.inCountry", { country: countryLabel })}
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={onChangeCountry}>
          {t("connect.bank.changeCountry")}
        </Button>
      </div>

      {query.isPending ? (
        <div aria-busy="true" className="space-y-2">
          <span className="sr-only">{t("connect.loading")}</span>
          {SKELETON_ROWS.map((row) => (
            <div key={row.id} className={`h-14 animate-pulse rounded-2xl bg-surface-2 ${row.width}`} />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : query.isError ? (
        <EmptyState
          kind="state"
          title={t("connect.bank.listError.title")}
          description={t("connect.bank.listError.description")}
          action={
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => void query.refetch()}>
              {t("connect.bank.listError.retry")}
            </Button>
          }
        />
      ) : (banks?.length ?? 0) === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          kind="empty"
          title={t("connect.bank.empty.title")}
          description={t("connect.bank.empty.description")}
          action={
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onChangeCountry}>
              {t("connect.bank.changeCountry")}
            </Button>
          }
        />
      ) : (
        <>
          <SearchInput
            value={search}
            onChange={setSearch}
            label={t("connect.bank.searchLabel")}
            placeholder={t("connect.bank.searchPlaceholder")}
          />
          <p aria-live="polite" className="text-[13px] text-muted">
            {t("connect.bank.results", { count: visible.length })}
          </p>
          {visible.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState
              kind="filter"
              title={t("connect.bank.noMatch.title", { query: search.trim() })}
              description={t("connect.bank.noMatch.description")}
              action={
                <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setSearch("")}>
                  {t("connect.bank.clearSearch")}
                </Button>
              }
            />
          ) : (
            <ul className="divide-y divide-subtle overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-subtle bg-surface">
              {visible.map((bank) => (
                <li key={`${bank.country}:${bank.name}`}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    data-testid="bank-option"
                    onClick={() => onPick(bank)}
                    className="flex min-h-14 w-full items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-surface-2 max-sm:min-h-16"
                  >
                    <BankMark bank={bank} />
                    <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-fg">{bank.name}</span>
                        {bank.beta ? (
                          <span title={t("connect.bank.betaHint")}>
                            <Badge tone="neutral">{t("connect.bank.beta")}</Badge>
                          </span>
                        ) : null}
                      </span>
                      <span className="block text-[13px] text-muted">
                        {t("connect.bank.maxDays", { count: bank.maximumConsentDays })}
                      </span>
                    </span>
                    <ChevronRight aria-hidden size={16} className="shrink-0 text-muted" />
                  </button>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { AspspSummary } from "@bursar/shared";
import { ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Badge, Button, Card, Select } from "../../components/ui";
import { useFormatters } from "../../lib/format";
import { BankMark } from "./BankStep";
import { consentEndDate, consentOptions, defaultConsentDays } from "./consent";
import { countryName } from "./countries";

export interface ConsentStepProps {
  bank: AspspSummary;
  /** `settings.values.consentDays`. */
  settingsDays: number;
  submitting: boolean;
  onStart(days: number): void;
  onBack(): void;
}

export function ConsentStep({ bank, settingsDays, submitting, onStart, onBack }: ConsentStepProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const formatters = useFormatters();
  const [now] = useState(() => formatters.now());
  const initialDays = defaultConsentDays(bank.maximumConsentDays, settingsDays);
  const [days, setDays] = useState(initialDays);

  const endDateLabel = (count: number) =>
    formatters.localDate(consentEndDate(now, count, formatters.timeZone), "long");
  const options = consentOptions(bank.maximumConsentDays, initialDays).map((count) => ({
    value: String(count),
    label: t("connect.consent.option", { count, date: endDateLabel(count) }),
  }));
  const capped = settingsDays > bank.maximumConsentDays;

  return (
    <form
      className="space-y-5"
      onSubmit={(event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        onStart(days);
      }}
    >
      <section>
        <h2 className="font-display text-xl font-bold text-fg">{t("connect.consent.title")}</h2>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted">{t("connect.consent.description")}</p>
      </section>

      <Card padding="md" className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <BankMark bank={bank} />
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <p className="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-fg">{bank.name}</p>
          <p className="text-[13px] text-muted">{countryName(bank.country, formatters.locale)}</p>
        </div>
        {bank.beta ? <Badge tone="neutral">{t("connect.bank.beta")}</Badge> : null}
      </Card>

      <Select
        id="connect-duration"
        label={t("connect.consent.durationLabel")}
        options={options}
        value={String(days)}
        onChange={(event) => setDays(Number(event.target.value))}
        hint={
          capped
            ? t("connect.consent.cappedHint", { bank: bank.name, count: bank.maximumConsentDays })
            : undefined
        }
      />
      <p data-testid="consent-end" className="text-sm text-fg">
        {t("connect.consent.endsOn", { date: endDateLabel(days) })}
      </p>

      <div className="flex gap-3 rounded-2xl bg-primary-50 p-4 text-sm text-fg">
        <ShieldCheck aria-hidden size={20} strokeWidth={1.75} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-primary" />
        <div className="min-w-0 space-y-1">
          <p className="font-semibold">{t("connect.consent.readOnly.title")}</p>
          <p>{t("connect.consent.readOnly.body")}</p>
          <p>{t("connect.consent.readOnly.redirect", { bank: bank.name })}</p>
          <p>{t("connect.consent.readOnly.revoke")}</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <Button variant="ghost" onClick={onBack}>
          {t("connect.back")}
        </Button>
        <Button type="submit" loading={submitting} data-testid="connect-start">
          {t("connect.consent.start", { bank: bank.name })}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import type { TFunction } from "i18next";
import { KeyRound, TriangleAlert } from "lucide-react";
import { type ReactNode, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { ApiError, api } from "../api";
import { BackButton } from "../app/BackButton";
import { Breadcrumbs } from "../app/Breadcrumbs";
import { useSettingsQuery } from "../app/useSettingsQuery";
import { type FeedbackTone, feedback } from "../components/feedback";
import { Button, EmptyState, PageHeader } from "../components/ui";
import { useFormatters } from "../lib/format";
import { queryKeys } from "../lib/query-keys";

import { BankStep } from "./connect/BankStep";
import { ConsentStep } from "./connect/ConsentStep";
import { CountryStep } from "./connect/CountryStep";
import { CURATED_COUNTRIES, countryName } from "./connect/countries";
import { isWizardStep, type WizardStepId, WizardSteps } from "./connect/WizardSteps";

/** Only web addresses are followed; the redirect comes from our server but costs nothing to check. */
function isNavigable(redirectUrl: string): boolean {
  try {
    const { protocol } = new URL(redirectUrl);
    return protocol === "https:" || protocol === "http:";
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

interface StartNotice {
  title: string;
  detail: string;
  tone: FeedbackTone;
}

/** Toast for a failed `POST /api/connections`: the title names the outcome, the detail the fix. */
function startNotice(error: unknown, t: TFunction): StartNotice {
  if (error instanceof ApiError) {
    if (error.code === "banking_not_configured" || error.status === 503) {
      return {
        title: t("connect.errors.notConfigured.title"),
        detail: t("connect.errors.notConfigured.detail"),
        tone: "warning",
      };
    }
    switch (error.code) {
      case "unknown_bank":
        return {
          title: t("connect.errors.unknownBank.title"),
          detail: t("connect.errors.unknownBank.detail"),
          tone: "warning",
        };
      case "REDIRECT_URI_NOT_ALLOWED":
        return {
          title: t("connect.errors.redirectNotAllowed.title"),
          detail: t("connect.errors.redirectNotAllowed.detail"),
          tone: "error",
        };
      case "WRONG_ASPSP_PROVIDED":
        return {
          title: t("connect.errors.wrongBank.title"),
          detail: t("connect.errors.wrongBank.detail"),
          tone: "warning",
        };
      case "bank_error":
        return {
          title: t("connect.errors.bank.title"),
          detail: t("connect.errors.bank.detail"),
          tone: "error",
        };
    }
  }
  return {
    title: t("connect.errors.generic.title"),
    detail: t("connect.errors.generic.detail"),
    tone: "error",
  };
}

function isNotConfigured(error: unknown): boolean {
  return (
    error instanceof ApiError && (error.code === "banking_not_configured" || error.status === 503)
  );
}

function Notice({ title, children }: { title: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div
      role="status"
      className="mb-4 flex gap-3 rounded-2xl bg-warning-soft p-4 text-sm text-warning"
    >
      <TriangleAlert aria-hidden size={18} strokeWidth={1.75} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
      <div className="min-w-0">
        <p className="font-semibold">{title}</p>
        <div className="mt-1 break-words">{children}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function WizardSkeleton() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  return (
    <div aria-busy="true" className="space-y-3">
      <span className="sr-only">{t("connect.loading")}</span>
      <div className="h-7 w-1/2 animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-surface-2" />
      <div className="h-11 w-full animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-surface-2" />
      <div className="h-11 w-1/3 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-surface-2" />
    </div>
  );
}

export function ConnectPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { locale } = useFormatters();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [url, setUrl] = useUrlState(
    { step: "country", country: "", bank: "" },
    {
      validate: {
        step: isWizardStep,
        country: (value) => /^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(value),
        bank: (value) => value.length <= 200,
      },
    },
  );

  const status = useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.bankStatus,
    queryFn: () => api.bankStatus(),
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });
  const settings = useSettingsQuery();
  const configured = status.data?.configured === true;
  const hasCountry = url.country !== "";
  const requestedStep: WizardStepId = isWizardStep(url.step) ? url.step : "country";
  const aspsps = useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.aspsps(url.country),
    queryFn: () => api.aspsps(url.country),
    enabled: configured && hasCountry && requestedStep !== "country",
    staleTime: 5 * 60_000,
  });
  const bank: AspspSummary | null = aspsps.data?.aspsps.find((item) => item.name === url.bank) ?? null;

  // The step that is shown never depends on data the URL cannot vouch for.
  let step: WizardStepId = requestedStep;
  if (!hasCountry) step = "country";
  else if (requestedStep === "consent" && url.bank === "") step = "bank";
  else if (requestedStep === "consent" && aspsps.isSuccess && bank === null) step = "bank";
  const reachable: WizardStepId[] = ["country"];
  if (hasCountry) reachable.push("bank");
  if (bank) reachable.push("consent");

  const countries =
    status.data && status.data.countries.length > 0 ? status.data.countries : CURATED_COUNTRIES;
  const preselected = settings.data?.values.country ?? "";
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const countryValue =
    picked ?? (hasCountry ? url.country : countries.includes(preselected) ? preselected : "");

  const start = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (body: StartConnectionRequest) => {
      const response = await api.startConnection(body);
      if (!isNavigable(response.redirectUrl)) throw new Error("Unexpected redirect address");
      return response;
    },
    onSuccess: ({ redirectUrl }) => {
      window.location.assign(redirectUrl);
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      const notice = startNotice(error, t);
      feedback(notice.title, notice.detail, notice.tone);
      if (error instanceof ApiError && error.code === "unknown_bank") {
        setUrl({ step: "bank", bank: "" });
        void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.aspsps(url.country) });
      }
      if (isNotConfigured(error)) {
        void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.bankStatus });
      }
    },
  });
  const submitting = start.isPending || start.isSuccess;

  // Back from the bank through the back-forward cache: the page comes back as it was left.
  const { reset: resetStart } = start;
  useEffect(() => {
    const onShow = (event: PageTransitionEvent) => {
      if (event.persisted) resetStart();
    };
    window.addEventListener("pageshow", onShow);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("pageshow", onShow);
  }, [resetStart]);

  const callbackUrl = (() => {
    const publicUrl = settings.data?.system.publicUrl;
    if (!publicUrl) return null;
    try {
      return new URL("/api/banks/callback", publicUrl).toString();
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  })();

  let body: ReactNode;
  if (status.isPending || (settings.isPending && step === "country")) {
    body = <WizardSkeleton />;
  } else if (status.isError) {
    body = (
      <EmptyState
        kind="state"
        title={t("connect.statusError.title")}
        description={t("connect.statusError.description")}
        action={
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => void status.refetch()}>
            {t("connect.retry")}
          </Button>
        }
      />
    );
  } else if (!configured || isNotConfigured(aspsps.error)) {
    body = (
      <EmptyState
        kind="state"
        icon={KeyRound}
        title={t("connect.notConfigured.title")}
        description={t("connect.notConfigured.description")}
      />
    );
  } else {
    let content: ReactNode;
    if (step === "country") {
      content = (
        <CountryStep
          countries={countries}
          value={countryValue}
          onChange={setPicked}
          onContinue={() => setUrl({ step: "bank", country: countryValue, bank: "" })}
        />
      );
    } else if (step === "bank") {
      content = (
        <BankStep
          countryLabel={countryName(url.country, locale)}
          query={aspsps}
          onPick={(chosen) => setUrl({ step: "consent", bank: chosen.name })}
          onChangeCountry={() => setUrl({ step: "country" })}
        />
      );
    } else if (bank) {
      content = (
        <ConsentStep
          key={`${bank.country}:${bank.name}`}
          bank={bank}
          settingsDays={settings.data?.values.consentDays ?? 180}
          submitting={submitting}
          onStart={(days) =>
            start.mutate({ aspspName: bank.name, aspspCountry: bank.country, consentDays: days })
          }
          onBack={() => setUrl({ step: "bank" })}
        />
      );
    } else {
      content = <WizardSkeleton />;
    }
    body = (
      <>
        {status.data?.active === false ? (
          <Notice title={t("connect.inactive.title")}>{t("connect.inactive.description")}</Notice>
        ) : null}
        {status.data?.redirectUrlAllowed === false ? (
          <Notice title={t("connect.redirectNotAllowed.title")}>
            {callbackUrl ? (
              <>
                <p>{t("connect.redirectNotAllowed.description")}</p>
                <code className="mt-2 block break-all rounded-lg bg-surface px-2 py-1 font-mono text-[13px] text-fg">
                  {callbackUrl}
                </code>
              </>
            ) : (
              <p>{t("connect.redirectNotAllowed.descriptionNoUrl")}</p>
            )}
          </Notice>
        ) : null}
        <WizardSteps
          current={step}
          reachable={reachable}
          onSelect={(target) => setUrl({ step: target })}
        />
        {content}
      </>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="max-w-2xl">
      <PageHeader
        title={t("connect.title")}
        subtitle={t("connect.subtitle")}
        breadcrumb={<Breadcrumbs routeId="connect" />}
        back={<BackButton routeId="connect" />}
      />
      {body}
    </div>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: Implement the callback page**

`apps/web/src/pages/ConnectCallbackPage.tsx`:

```tsx
import {
  type CompleteConnectionRequest,
  type CompleteConnectionResponse,
  completeConnectionRequestSchema,
} from "@bursar/shared";
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import {
  Ban,
  CircleAlert,
  CircleCheck,
  Clock,
  Info,
  KeyRound,
  type LucideIcon,
} from "lucide-react";
import { type ReactNode, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { ApiError, api } from "../api";
import { BackButton } from "../app/BackButton";
import { Breadcrumbs } from "../app/Breadcrumbs";
import { Badge, Card, MaskedIban, PageHeader } from "../components/ui";
import { cn } from "../components/ui/cn";
import { queryKeys } from "../lib/query-keys";
import { ConnectBankButton } from "./connect/ConnectBankButton";
import { LinkButton } from "./connect/LinkButton";

/**
 * Parameters of the bank's redirect (`state`, `code`, `error`, `error_description`) as a request
 * body, or `null` when the URL does not carry a usable response. Bank-supplied text is truncated to
 * what the API accepts; `state` is never truncated, a state of the wrong length is simply unusable.
 */
export function parseCallbackSearch(search: string): CompleteConnectionRequest | null {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(search);
  const candidate: Record<string, string> = {};
  const state = params.get("state");
  if (state) candidate.state = state;
  const code = params.get("code");
  if (code) candidate.code = code.slice(0, 512);
  const error = params.get("error");
  if (error) candidate.error = error.slice(0, 200);
  const description = params.get("error_description");
  if (description) candidate.errorDescription = description.slice(0, 512);
  if (!candidate.state || (!candidate.code && !candidate.error)) return null;
  const parsed = completeConnectionRequestSchema.safeParse(candidate);
  return parsed.success ? parsed.data : null;
}

/** Removes the one-time parameters from the address bar without adding a history entry. */
function stripParameters(): void {
  window.history.replaceState(window.history.state, "", window.location.pathname);
}

function restoreParameters(search: string): void {
  window.history.replaceState(window.history.state, "", `${window.location.pathname}${search}`);
}

type Tone = "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "info";

const TONE_CLASSES: Record<Tone, string> = {
  success: "bg-primary-50 text-positive",
  warning: "bg-warning-soft text-warning",
  danger: "bg-danger-soft text-danger",
  info: "bg-info-soft text-info",
};

interface OutcomeCardProps {
  outcome: string;
  tone: Tone;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  busy?: boolean;
  /** Move focus to the heading when the card appears (every result, not the pending card). */
  focus?: boolean;
  actions?: ReactNode;
  children?: ReactNode;
}

function OutcomeCard({
  outcome,
  tone,
  icon: Icon,
  title,
  description,
  busy = false,
  focus = true,
  actions,
  children,
}: OutcomeCardProps) {
  const heading = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (focus) heading.current?.focus();
  }, [focus]);
  return (
    <Card
      padding="lg"
      role="status"
      aria-live="polite"
      aria-busy={busy || undefined}
      data-outcome={outcome}
    >
      <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
        <span
          className={cn(
            "inline-flex size-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl",
            TONE_CLASSES[tone],
          )}
        >
          <Icon aria-hidden size={22} strokeWidth={1.75} />
        </span>
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <h2 ref={heading} tabIndex={-1} className="font-display text-xl font-bold text-fg">
            {title}
          </h2>
          {description ? <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted">{description}</p> : null}
          {children}
          {actions ? <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap gap-2">{actions}</div> : null}
        </div>
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}

function AccountsFound({ response }: { response: CompleteConnectionResponse }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  if (response.accounts.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <div className="mt-4">
      <p className="text-[13px] font-medium text-muted">
        {t("connect.callback.accountsFound", { count: response.accounts.length })}
      </p>
      <ul className="mt-2 divide-y divide-subtle rounded-xl border border-subtle">
        {response.accounts.map((account) => (
          <li key={account.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 px-3 py-2.5">
            <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-sm font-semibold text-fg">
              {account.name}
            </span>
            {account.maskedIdentifier ? (
              <MaskedIban masked={account.maskedIdentifier} />
            ) : null}
            <Badge tone="neutral">{account.currency}</Badge>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      <p className="mt-3 flex items-start gap-2 text-sm text-fg">
        <Info aria-hidden size={16} strokeWidth={1.75} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-info" />
        {t("connect.callback.syncStarted")}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

export function ConnectCallbackPage() {
  const { t, i18n } = useTranslation();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  // Read once: the first render sees the parameters, the first effect strips them.
  const [initial] = useState(() => ({
    search: window.location.search,
    body: parseCallbackSearch(window.location.search),
  }));

  const mutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (body: CompleteConnectionRequest) => {
      try {
        return await api.completeConnection(body);
      } catch (error) {
        // Session expired on the way back: restore the address so login can resume with `next`.
        if (error instanceof ApiError && error.status === 401) restoreParameters(initial.search);
        throw error;
      }
    },
    onSuccess: (response) => {
      if (response.outcome === "connected" || response.outcome === "renewed") {
        void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.connections });
        void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.summary });
        void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["accounts"] });
      }
    },
  });

  const started = useRef(false);
  const { mutate } = mutation;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (started.current) return;
    started.current = true;
    stripParameters();
    if (initial.body) mutate(initial.body);
  }, [initial.body, mutate]);

  const tryAgain = (
    <LinkButton to="/connect">{t("connect.callback.tryAgain")}</LinkButton>
  );
  const startAgain = (
    <LinkButton to="/connect">{t("connect.callback.startAgain")}</LinkButton>
  );

  let card: ReactNode;
  if (!initial.body) {
    card = (
      <OutcomeCard
        outcome="missing"
        tone="info"
        icon={Info}
        title={t("connect.callback.missing.title")}
        description={t("connect.callback.missing.description")}
        actions={
          <>
            <ConnectBankButton />
            <LinkButton to="/accounts" variant="secondary">
              {t("connect.callback.openAccounts")}
            </LinkButton>
          </>
        }
      />
    );
  } else if (mutation.isError) {
    const error = mutation.error;
    if (error instanceof ApiError && error.status === 401) {
      card = (
        <OutcomeCard
          outcome="pending"
          tone="info"
          icon={Clock}
          busy
          focus={false}
          title={t("connect.callback.pending.title")}
        />
      );
    } else if (error instanceof ApiError && (error.status === 410 || error.code === "state_invalid")) {
      card = (
        <OutcomeCard
          outcome="state_invalid"
          tone="warning"
          icon={Clock}
          title={t("connect.callback.stateInvalid.title")}
          description={t("connect.callback.stateInvalid.description")}
          actions={startAgain}
        />
      );
    } else if (
      error instanceof ApiError &&
      (error.code === "banking_not_configured" || error.status === 503)
    ) {
      card = (
        <OutcomeCard
          outcome="unavailable"
          tone="warning"
          icon={KeyRound}
          title={t("connect.callback.unavailable.title")}
          description={t("connect.callback.unavailable.description")}
          actions={startAgain}
        />
      );
    } else {
      card = (
        <OutcomeCard
          outcome="error"
          tone="danger"
          icon={CircleAlert}
          title={t("connect.callback.error.title")}
          description={t("connect.callback.error.description")}
          actions={startAgain}
        />
      );
    }
  } else if (mutation.data) {
    const response = mutation.data;
    if (response.outcome === "connected" || response.outcome === "renewed") {
      card = (
        <OutcomeCard
          outcome={response.outcome}
          tone="success"
          icon={CircleCheck}
          title={t(`connect.callback.${response.outcome}.title`)}
          description={t(`connect.callback.${response.outcome}.description`, {
            bank: response.bankName,
          })}
          actions={<LinkButton to="/accounts">{t("connect.callback.openAccounts")}</LinkButton>}
        >
          <AccountsFound response={response} />
        </OutcomeCard>
      );
    } else if (response.outcome === "no_accounts") {
      card = (
        <OutcomeCard
          outcome="no_accounts"
          tone="warning"
          icon={CircleAlert}
          title={t("connect.callback.noAccounts.title")}
          description={t("connect.callback.noAccounts.description", { bank: response.bankName })}
          actions={tryAgain}
        >
          <ol className="mt-4 list-decimal space-y-2 pl-5 text-sm text-fg">
            <li>{t("connect.callback.noAccounts.step1")}</li>
            <li>{t("connect.callback.noAccounts.step2")}</li>
            <li>{t("connect.callback.noAccounts.step3")}</li>
          </ol>
        </OutcomeCard>
      );
    } else if (response.outcome === "denied") {
      card = (
        <OutcomeCard
          outcome="denied"
          tone="info"
          icon={Ban}
          title={t("connect.callback.denied.title")}
          description={t("connect.callback.denied.description")}
          actions={tryAgain}
        />
      );
    } else {
      const code = response.errorCode;
      const key = code && /^[A-Z_]{3,64}$/.test(code) ? `connect.callback.failed.codes.${code}` : null;
      card = (
        <OutcomeCard
          outcome="failed"
          tone="danger"
          icon={CircleAlert}
          title={t("connect.callback.failed.title")}
          description={
            key && i18n.exists(key) ? t(key) : t("connect.callback.failed.generic")
          }
          actions={tryAgain}
        />
      );
    }
  } else {
    card = (
      <OutcomeCard
        outcome="pending"
        tone="info"
        icon={Clock}
        busy
        focus={false}
        title={t("connect.callback.pending.title")}
        description={t("connect.callback.pending.description")}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="max-w-2xl">
      <PageHeader
        title={t("routes.connectCallback.title")}
        breadcrumb={<Breadcrumbs routeId="connectCallback" />}
        back={<BackButton routeId="connectCallback" />}
      />
      {card}
    </div>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 13: Round trip through the fake bank, state by state, with screenshots**

The unit tests cannot show the callback outcomes as the owner sees them, and the QA extra paths reach only the "expired link" state, so this step drives the whole flow once per outcome with a temporary script. It is not committed. The fake bank returns `code=fake-<n>`; the script rewrites the bank's redirect to simulate an empty account list (`fake-empty-1`), a cancelled authorisation and a bank error.

Create `apps/web/qa/tmp-connect-flow.ts`:

```ts
import { mkdirSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import {
  attachProbe,
  buildWeb,
  CAPTURES,
  launchBrowser,
  newCaptureContext,
  OUT_DIR,
  settle,
  startQaServer,
} from "./lib";

interface Flow {
  name: string;
  outcome: string;
  rewrite(url: URL): URL;
}

const FLOWS: Flow[] = [
  { name: "connected", outcome: "connected", rewrite: (url) => url },
  {
    name: "no-accounts",
    outcome: "no_accounts",
    rewrite: (url) => {
      url.searchParams.set("code", "fake-empty-1");
      return url;
    },
  },
  {
    name: "denied",
    outcome: "denied",
    rewrite: (url) => {
      url.searchParams.delete("code");
      url.searchParams.set("error", "access_denied");
      url.searchParams.set("error_description", "Cancelled by user");
      return url;
    },
  },
  {
    name: "failed",
    outcome: "failed",
    rewrite: (url) => {
      url.searchParams.delete("code");
      url.searchParams.set("error", "server_error");
      return url;
    },
  },
];

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  buildWeb();
  const server = await startQaServer({ owner: true });
  const failures: string[] = [];
  const browser = await launchBrowser();
  try {
    if (server.sessionToken === null) throw new Error("The QA server returned no session token");
    const session = { baseUrl: server.baseUrl, token: server.sessionToken };
    for (const capture of CAPTURES) {
      for (const flow of FLOWS) {
        const context = await newCaptureContext(browser, capture, session);
        try {
          const page = await context.newPage();
          const probe = attachProbe(page);
          const dir = path.join(OUT_DIR, "connect-flow", capture.name);
          mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
          const shot = async (name: string) => {
            await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(dir, `${name}.png`), fullPage: true });
          };
          await page.route("**/api/banks/callback*", (route) =>
            route.continue({ url: flow.rewrite(new URL(route.request().url())).toString() }),
          );
          await page.goto(`${server.baseUrl}/connect`, { waitUntil: "load" });
          await page.selectOption("#connect-country", "IT");
          if (flow.name === "connected") await shot("1-country");
          await page.getByTestId("connect-country-continue").click();
          await page.getByTestId("bank-option").first().waitFor();
          await settle(page, probe, failures);
          if (flow.name === "connected") await shot("2-bank");
          await page.getByTestId("bank-option").first().click();
          await page.getByTestId("connect-start").waitFor();
          if (flow.name === "connected") await shot("3-consent");
          await page.getByTestId("connect-start").click();
          await page.waitForSelector(`[data-outcome="${flow.outcome}"]`, { timeout: 30_000 });
          await settle(page, probe, failures);
          await shot(`4-${flow.name}`);
          failures.push(...probe.failures.map((item) => `${capture.name}/${flow.name}: ${item}`));
        } finally {
          await context.close();
        }
      }
    }
  } finally {
    await browser.close();
    await server.stop();
  }
  console.log(`CONNECT FLOW: ${failures.length} failures`);
  for (const failure of failures) console.log(failure);
  process.exitCode = failures.length > 0 ? 1 : 0;
}

await main();
```
