- Test: `apps/web/src/pages/transactions/period.test.ts`, `apps/web/src/pages/TransactionsPage.test.tsx`, `apps/web/src/pages/transactions/TransactionDrawer.test.tsx`; the palette transactions source is tested in `apps/web/src/app/CommandPalette.test.tsx`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: shared `TransactionListResponse`, `TransactionItem`, `TransactionDetail`, `CashFlowResponse`, `SearchResponse`, `transactionQuerySchema`; routes `GET /api/transactions`, `GET /api/transactions/:id`, `GET /api/search`, `GET /api/connections` (account filter options); Task 19 `api.transactions`; Task 17 `CashFlowStrip` (aggregate variant); Task 3 list primitives and `useUrlState`.
- Produces:
  - `api.ts`: `transaction(id: number): Promise<TransactionDetail>`, `search(q: string): Promise<SearchResponse>`.
  - `period.ts`: `type PeriodPreset = "30d" | "90d" | "12m" | "all" | "custom"`; `resolvePeriod(input: { period: PeriodPreset; from?: string; to?: string }, today: LocalDate): { from: LocalDate | null; to: LocalDate | null }`; `periodFromRange(from: LocalDate | null, to: LocalDate | null, today: LocalDate): PeriodPreset`.
  - URL state keys (defaults omitted): `q` (""), `tab` ("all"), `accountId` (""), `period` ("30d"), `from`, `to` (only with `period=custom`; a link with only `from`/`to` implies custom), `currency` (""), `sort` ("date"), `order` ("desc"), `page` ("1", reset on any other change), `tx` (open drawer id, not reset).
  - Route `transactions` shipped; palette source `transactions` (counterparty search through `api.search`, ≥ 2 chars, 6 results, subtitle = account name and date, `to` = `/transactions?tx=<id>`); Account detail "See all in Transactions" link added.
  - `QA_EXTRA_PATHS` gains `/transactions?tab=pending`, `/transactions?tab=out&period=90d`, `/transactions?q=zzzz-no-match`, `/transactions?tx=1`, `/transactions?accountId=1&period=all`.
  - i18n prefix `transactions.*`.

**Read before starting:**

- `<prefix>` is the Global Constraints shell prefix. Tasks 1–20 are merged: the code uses Task 1 date helpers (`addDays`, `diffDays`, `toLocalDate`, `formatLocalDate`, `formatRelativeDay`, `localDateSchema`, `RELATIVE_LIMIT_DAYS`), Task 2 `useUi` and `amountTone`, the Task 3 primitives through the barrel `../components/ui` (`Button`, `Card`, `CopyButton`, `DataTable`, `Column`, `SortState`, `Drawer`, `EmptyState`, `InlineEmpty`, `FilterChips`, `FilterChipsProps`, `MaskedIban`, `Money`, `PageHeader`, `Pagination`, `RelativeTime`, `SearchInput`, `Select`, `StatusPill`, `Tabs`, `TextInput`), `feedback`, `useFormatters`, `FormatProvider`, the Task 4 `useUrlState` (on `useSearchParams`), `queryKeys`, `buildPath`, `PaletteSource`/`PaletteItem`, the test helper `src/test/router.tsx` (`renderRoutes`), Task 16 shared types and `transactionTabSchema`, Task 17 `useSettingsQuery()` and `CashFlowStrip`, Task 18 `api.connections()`, Task 19 `api.transactions(params: Record<string, string>)` and `pages/account/TransactionsTab.tsx`.
- **Two URL-state hooks.** Task 4's `useUrlState` resets every `resetOnChange` key when *any* other key in the patch changes. If `tx` lived in the same hook as `page`, opening the drawer would send the owner back to page 1. The list state therefore lives in one hook (`resetOnChange: ["page"]`) and `tx` in a second hook over the same query string; both keep parameters they do not own, and no event writes both at once.
- **Period semantics** (pinned by `period.test.ts`): `30d` is the 30 local days ending today (`today − 29 … today`), `90d` is `today − 89 … today`, `12m` starts the day after the same date one year earlier (29 February clamps to 28 February), `all` has no bounds. `custom` uses `from`/`to` (swapped when reversed, one side may be open); a custom period without a valid date reads as the default `30d`. A URL with `from`/`to` but no `period` is read through `periodFromRange` (custom unless it is exactly a preset's range). All arithmetic is on `LocalDate` strings, so daylight saving time cannot shift a boundary; "today" is `toLocalDate(now, timeZone)` in the owner's time zone. Home (Task 17) links to `/transactions?tab=in` and expects this 30-day window to equal the summary's `cashflow30d` window.
- **Sort mapping.** The server default is date descending, which the table shows as "no sort" (`SortState` null). Header clicks follow `nextSort` (asc → desc → none); "none" writes `sort=date&order=desc`, the defaults, so they disappear from the URL. On the date column the cycle is asc → desc (= none) → asc.
- **Probe queries.** Two small extra requests keep the page honest without new API fields: the results line "12 results of 840" uses the total of the same period without search, account and tab (`pageSize=10` with the period bounds; requested only while one of those narrows the list); when the default view is empty, an all-time probe (`pageSize=10`, no bounds) tells a true-empty account set apart from an empty period, which gets its own "No transactions in this period" state with "Show all periods". The main list request never sends `pageSize` (server default 20), which is how the tests tell the requests apart.
- **Aggregate figures.** In and Out are shown without a sign (`sign="never"`; Task 16 returns both as non-negative magnitudes); Out's tone is `amountTone(-Math.abs(outMinor), "flow")` (ink, or muted at zero), Net uses `amountTone(net, "net", { highlightNegativeNet })` with the setting from `useSettingsQuery()` (default true while it loads).
- **Mobile.** Below `sm` the table hides every column except Counterparty, whose cell stacks "counterparty · pending pill · amount" over "date · account" (the extra spans are `sm:hidden`). The account and period filters sit in a panel toggled by a "Filters" button (`max-sm:hidden` while closed). The drawer is full width below 640 px (Task 3).
- `currency` only selects the aggregate's currency (rows keep their own); the page shows a switch and the no-conversion note when `aggregate.currencies.length > 1`.

```ts
import { formatLocalDate, toLocalDate } from "@bursar/shared";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { periodFromRange, readPeriod, relativeDayLabel, resolvePeriod } from "./period";

const TODAY = "2026-11-09";

describe("resolvePeriod", () => {
  it("resolves the presets to local date ranges ending today", () => {
    expect(resolvePeriod({ period: "30d" }, TODAY)).toEqual({ from: "2026-10-11", to: TODAY });
    expect(resolvePeriod({ period: "90d" }, TODAY)).toEqual({ from: "2026-08-12", to: TODAY });
    expect(resolvePeriod({ period: "12m" }, TODAY)).toEqual({ from: "2025-11-10", to: TODAY });
    expect(resolvePeriod({ period: "all" }, TODAY)).toEqual({ from: null, to: null });
  });

  it("clamps 29 February when going back twelve months", () => {
    expect(resolvePeriod({ period: "12m" }, "2028-02-29")).toEqual({
      from: "2027-03-01",
      to: "2028-02-29",
    });
    expect(resolvePeriod({ period: "12m" }, "2025-03-01")).toEqual({
      from: "2024-03-02",
      to: "2025-03-01",
    });
  });

  it("counts calendar days across daylight saving changes", () => {
    // Europe/Rome moves to summer time on 29 March 2026 and back on 25 October 2026.
    expect(resolvePeriod({ period: "30d" }, "2026-03-29")).toEqual({
      from: "2026-02-28",
      to: "2026-03-29",
    });
    expect(resolvePeriod({ period: "30d" }, "2026-10-25")).toEqual({
      from: "2026-09-26",
      to: "2026-10-25",
    });
    // 23:30 UTC on 28 March is already 29 March in Rome: "today" follows the owner's zone.
    const today = toLocalDate(Date.UTC(2026, 2, 28, 23, 30), "Europe/Rome");
    expect(today).toBe("2026-03-29");
    expect(resolvePeriod({ period: "90d" }, today)).toEqual({ from: "2025-12-30", to: today });
  });

  it("keeps custom ranges, swaps reversed ones and allows an open side", () => {
    expect(
      resolvePeriod({ period: "custom", from: "2026-11-01", to: "2026-11-03" }, TODAY),
    ).toEqual({ from: "2026-11-01", to: "2026-11-03" });
    expect(
      resolvePeriod({ period: "custom", from: "2026-11-03", to: "2026-11-01" }, TODAY),
    ).toEqual({ from: "2026-11-01", to: "2026-11-03" });
    expect(resolvePeriod({ period: "custom", from: "2026-11-01" }, TODAY)).toEqual({
      from: "2026-11-01",
      to: null,
    });
    expect(resolvePeriod({ period: "custom", to: "2026-11-01" }, TODAY)).toEqual({
      from: null,
      to: "2026-11-01",
    });
  });

  it("falls back to the last 30 days when a custom range has no valid date", () => {
    expect(resolvePeriod({ period: "custom" }, TODAY)).toEqual({ from: "2026-10-11", to: TODAY });
    expect(
      resolvePeriod({ period: "custom", from: "2026-02-30", to: "yesterday" }, TODAY),
    ).toEqual({ from: "2026-10-11", to: TODAY });
  });
});

describe("periodFromRange", () => {
  it("recognises the presets, the open range and anything else as custom", () => {
    expect(periodFromRange(null, null, TODAY)).toBe("all");
    expect(periodFromRange("2026-10-11", TODAY, TODAY)).toBe("30d");
    expect(periodFromRange("2026-08-12", TODAY, TODAY)).toBe("90d");
    expect(periodFromRange("2025-11-10", TODAY, TODAY)).toBe("12m");
    expect(periodFromRange("2026-10-11", "2026-11-08", TODAY)).toBe("custom");
    expect(periodFromRange("2026-11-01", null, TODAY)).toBe("custom");
    expect(periodFromRange(null, TODAY, TODAY)).toBe("custom");
  });
});

describe("readPeriod", () => {
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement `period.ts`**

`apps/web/src/pages/transactions/period.ts`:

```ts
import { addDays, formatRelativeDay, type LocalDate, localDateSchema } from "@bursar/shared";

export type PeriodPreset = "30d" | "90d" | "12m" | "all" | "custom";

/** Select order of the period filter. */
export const PERIOD_PRESETS: readonly PeriodPreset[] = ["30d", "90d", "12m", "all", "custom"];

/** The Transactions default: Home's 30-day figures link here without date parameters. */
export const DEFAULT_PERIOD = "30d" satisfies PeriodPreset;

export interface PeriodRange {
  from: LocalDate | null;
  to: LocalDate | null;
}

export interface PeriodState extends PeriodRange {
  preset: PeriodPreset;
}

export function isPeriodPreset(value: string): value is PeriodPreset {
  return (PERIOD_PRESETS as readonly string[]).includes(value);
}

/** A real calendar date in `YYYY-MM-DD` form (Task 1 `localDateSchema`). */
export function isLocalDate(value: string | null | undefined): value is LocalDate {
  return typeof value === "string" && localDateSchema.safeParse(value).success;
}

function daysInMonth(year: number, month: number): number {
  // Day 0 of the next month is the last day of `month` (1-based).
  return new Date(Date.UTC(year, month, 0)).getUTCDate();
}

/** The same calendar day one year earlier, clamped to the month's length (29 Feb → 28 Feb). */
function oneYearEarlier(date: LocalDate): LocalDate {
  const year = Number(date.slice(0, 4)) - 1;
  const month = Number(date.slice(5, 7));
  const day = Math.min(Number(date.slice(8, 10)), daysInMonth(year, month));
  return `${String(year).padStart(4, "0")}-${date.slice(5, 7)}-${String(day).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

function presetRange(preset: "30d" | "90d" | "12m", today: LocalDate): PeriodRange {
  if (preset === "30d") return { from: addDays(today, -29), to: today };
  if (preset === "90d") return { from: addDays(today, -89), to: today };
  return { from: addDays(oneYearEarlier(today), 1), to: today };
}

/**
 * The local date bounds of a period. Presets end today (inclusive); `all` has no bounds; `custom`
 * keeps its valid dates (swapped when reversed, one side may be open) and falls back to the
 * default 30 days when neither date is valid. Pure calendar arithmetic: DST cannot move a bound.
 */
export function resolvePeriod(
  input: { period: PeriodPreset; from?: string; to?: string },
  today: LocalDate,
): PeriodRange {
  if (input.period === "all") return { from: null, to: null };
  if (input.period === "custom") {
    const from = isLocalDate(input.from) ? input.from : null;
    const to = isLocalDate(input.to) ? input.to : null;
    if (from === null && to === null) return presetRange(DEFAULT_PERIOD, today);
    if (from !== null && to !== null && from > to) return { from: to, to: from };
    return { from, to };
  }
  return presetRange(input.period, today);
}

/** The preset whose range is exactly `from`–`to` (`all` for no bounds), otherwise `custom`. */
export function periodFromRange(
  from: LocalDate | null,
  to: LocalDate | null,
  today: LocalDate,
): PeriodPreset {
  if (from === null && to === null) return "all";
  if (from !== null && to === today) {
    for (const preset of ["30d", "90d", "12m"] as const) {
      if (presetRange(preset, today).from === from) return preset;
    }
  }
  return "custom";
}

/**
 * Reads the period from raw URL values: an unknown preset is the default; a URL with `from`/`to`
 * but no `period` (Home's "See 14 transactions on 12 Nov" link) is read with `periodFromRange`;
 * a custom period without a valid date is the default; dates next to a preset are ignored.
 */
export function readPeriod(
  input: { period: string; from: string; to: string },
  today: LocalDate,
): PeriodState {
  const from = isLocalDate(input.from) ? input.from : null;
  const to = isLocalDate(input.to) ? input.to : null;
  let preset: PeriodPreset = isPeriodPreset(input.period) ? input.period : DEFAULT_PERIOD;
  if (preset === DEFAULT_PERIOD && (from !== null || to !== null)) {
    preset = periodFromRange(from, to, today);
  }
  if (preset === "custom" && from === null && to === null) preset = DEFAULT_PERIOD;
  const range = resolvePeriod(
    { period: preset, from: from ?? undefined, to: to ?? undefined },
    today,
  );
  return { preset, ...range };
}

/**
 * A transaction day for the list against the page's `today`: Task 1's `formatRelativeDay`, the one
 * relative-day label of the panel (the Account detail tab shows the same text through
 * `useFormatters().relativeDay`).
 */
export function relativeDayLabel(date: LocalDate, today: LocalDate, locale: string): string {
  return formatRelativeDay(date, today, locale);
}
```

`apps/web/src/pages/transactions/TransactionDrawer.tsx`:

```tsx
import type { TransactionDetail } from "@bursar/shared";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { CircleAlert, FileQuestionMark, RotateCw } from "lucide-react";
import { type ReactNode, useId } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Link } from "react-router";
import { ApiError, api } from "../../api";
import { buildPath } from "../../app/routes";
import { feedback } from "../../components/feedback";
import {
  Button,
  CopyButton,
  Drawer,
  InlineEmpty,
  MaskedIban,
  Money,
  RelativeTime,
  StatusPill,
} from "../../components/ui";
import { useFormatters } from "../../lib/format";
import { queryKeys } from "../../lib/query-keys";

/** A link styled as the primary button (navigation, not an action). */
export const PRIMARY_LINK_CLASS =
  "inline-flex h-10 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-primary px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-bg transition-opacity hover:opacity-90 max-sm:min-h-11";

export interface TransactionDrawerProps {
  /** The open transaction (`tx` in the URL), or null when the drawer is closed. */
  id: number | null;
  onClose(): void;
}

function bankCodeText(code: NonNullable<TransactionDetail["bankCode"]>): string | null {
  const codes = [code.code, code.subCode]
    .filter((part): part is string => typeof part === "string" && part.length > 0)
    .join(" · ");
  if (code.description && codes) return `${code.description} (${codes})`;
  return code.description ?? (codes.length > 0 ? codes : null);
}

interface DetailRow {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  value: ReactNode;
}

function DetailBody({ detail }: { detail: TransactionDetail }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { localDate } = useFormatters();
  const detailsId = useId();
  const remittanceId = useId();
  const pending = detail.status === "pending";
  const name = detail.counterparty ?? detail.description ?? t("transactions.noCounterparty");

  const rows: DetailRow[] = [];
  if (detail.bookingDate) {
    rows.push({
      id: "booking",
      label: t("transactions.drawer.bookingDate"),
      value: localDate(detail.bookingDate, "long"),
    });
  }
  if (detail.valueDate) {
    rows.push({
      id: "value",
      label: t("transactions.drawer.valueDate"),
      value: localDate(detail.valueDate, "long"),
    });
  }
  if (detail.transactionDate) {
    rows.push({
      id: "transaction",
      label: t("transactions.drawer.transactionDate"),
      value: localDate(detail.transactionDate, "long"),
    });
  }
  if (detail.counterpartyAccount) {
    rows.push({
      id: "counterpartyAccount",
      label: t("transactions.drawer.counterpartyAccount"),
      value: <MaskedIban masked={detail.counterpartyAccount} />,
    });
  }
  rows.push({
    id: "account",
    label: t("transactions.drawer.account"),
    value: t("transactions.drawer.accountAndBank", {
      account: detail.accountName,
      bank: detail.bankName,
    }),
  });
  const bankCode = detail.bankCode ? bankCodeText(detail.bankCode) : null;
  if (bankCode) {
    rows.push({ id: "bankCode", label: t("transactions.drawer.bankCode"), value: bankCode });
  }
  if (detail.merchantCategoryCode) {
    rows.push({
      id: "mcc",
      label: t("transactions.drawer.merchantCategoryCode"),
      value: <span className="font-mono text-[13px]">{detail.merchantCategoryCode}</span>,
    });
  }
  if (detail.balanceAfter) {
    rows.push({
      id: "balanceAfter",
      label: t("transactions.drawer.balanceAfter"),
      value: (
        <Money
          minor={detail.balanceAfter.amountMinor}
          currency={detail.balanceAfter.currency}
          tone="auto-balance"
        />
      ),
    });
  }
  const reference = detail.providerReference;
  if (reference) {
    rows.push({
      id: "reference",
      label: t("transactions.drawer.reference"),
      value: (
        <span className="inline-flex max-w-full items-center gap-1">
          <span className="min-w-0 font-mono text-[13px] break-all">{reference}</span>
          <CopyButton
            value={reference}
            label={t("transactions.drawer.copyReference")}
            onCopied={() =>
              feedback(t("copy.done"), t("transactions.drawer.referenceCopied"), "info")
            }
          />
        </span>
      ),
    });
  }
  rows.push({
    id: "firstSeen",
    label: t("transactions.drawer.firstSeen"),
    value: <RelativeTime at={detail.firstSeenAt} />,
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <p className="font-display text-3xl font-bold">
          <Money
            minor={detail.amountMinor}
            currency={detail.currency}
            sign="always"
            tone="auto-flow"
          />
        </p>
        <div className="mt-2">
          <StatusPill
            tone={pending ? "info" : "neutral"}
            label={pending ? t("transactions.pending") : t("transactions.booked")}
          />
        </div>
        <p className="mt-3 text-base font-semibold break-words text-fg">{name}</p>
        {detail.counterparty && detail.description ? (
          <p className="text-sm break-words text-muted">{detail.description}</p>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      {pending ? (
        <p className="rounded-xl bg-info-soft px-3 py-2 text-[13px] text-info">
          {t("transactions.drawer.pendingNote")}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      <section aria-labelledby={detailsId}>
        <h3
          id={detailsId}
          className="mb-2 text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide text-muted uppercase"
        >
          {t("transactions.drawer.details")}
        </h3>
        <dl className="divide-y divide-subtle rounded-xl border border-subtle">
          {rows.map((row) => (
            <div
              key={row.id}
              className="grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,9rem)_minmax(0,1fr)] gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 text-sm"
            >
              <dt className="text-muted">{row.label}</dt>
              <dd className="min-w-0 break-words text-fg">{row.value}</dd>
            </div>
          ))}
        </dl>
      </section>
      {detail.remittanceLines.length > 0 ? (
        <section aria-labelledby={remittanceId}>
          <h3
            id={remittanceId}
            className="mb-2 text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide text-muted uppercase"
          >
            {t("transactions.drawer.remittance")}
          </h3>
          <ul className="space-y-1 rounded-xl bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2.5 font-mono text-[13px] text-fg">
            {detail.remittanceLines.map((line, index) => (
              // biome-ignore lint/suspicious/noArrayIndexKey: remittance lines can repeat and have no identity
              <li key={`${index}-${line}`} className="break-words">
                {line}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </section>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

function DetailSkeleton({ label }: { label: string }) {
  return (
    <div aria-busy="true" className="space-y-4">
      <span className="sr-only">{label}</span>
      <div className="h-9 w-40 animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-surface-2" />
      <div className="h-5 w-24 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-surface-2" />
      <div className="h-4 w-3/4 animate-pulse rounded bg-surface-2" />
      <div className="h-48 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-surface-2" />
    </div>
  );
}

function DrawerError({
  error,
  retrying,
  onRetry,
}: {
  error: unknown;
  retrying: boolean;
  onRetry(): void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  if (error instanceof ApiError && error.status === 404) {
    return (
      <InlineEmpty
        icon={FileQuestionMark}
        title={t("transactions.drawer.notFound")}
        description={t("transactions.drawer.notFoundDescription")}
      />
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <InlineEmpty icon={CircleAlert} title={t("transactions.drawer.error")} />
      <Button variant="secondary" icon={RotateCw} loading={retrying} onClick={onRetry}>
        {t("transactions.drawer.retry")}
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * The 520 px detail drawer of a transaction (full width below 640 px). It is the only place that
 * shows the bank reference (UX doc §4, business codes). Closing it removes `tx` from the URL.
 */
export function TransactionDrawer({ id, onClose }: TransactionDrawerProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const detail = useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.transaction(id ?? 0),
    queryFn: () => api.transaction(id ?? 0),
    enabled: id !== null,
  });
  const data = id === null ? undefined : detail.data;

  let body: ReactNode;
  if (data) body = <DetailBody detail={data} />;
  else if (detail.isError) {
    body = (
      <DrawerError
        error={detail.error}
        retrying={detail.isFetching}
        onRetry={() => void detail.refetch()}
      />
    );
  } else body = <DetailSkeleton label={t("transactions.drawer.loading")} />;

  return (
    <Drawer
      open={id !== null}
      onClose={onClose}
      title={t("transactions.drawer.title")}
      footer={
        data ? (
          <Link
            to={buildPath("account", { accountId: data.accountId })}
            className={PRIMARY_LINK_CLASS}
          >
            {t("transactions.drawer.openAccount")}
          </Link>
        ) : undefined
      }
    >
      {body}
    </Drawer>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import {

const TZ = "Europe/Rome";
const today = toLocalDate(Date.now(), TZ);
const yesterday = addDays(today, -1);
const twoDaysAgo = addDays(today, -2);
const from30 = addDays(today, -29);

function item(overrides: Partial<TransactionItem> & Pick<TransactionItem, "id">): TransactionItem {
  return {
    accountId: 1,
    accountName: "Conto corrente",
    status: "booked",
    date: yesterday,
    bookingDate: yesterday,
    valueDate: yesterday,
    amountMinor: -4210,

}

const CAFE = item({ id: 101 });
const SALARY = item({
  id: 102,
  status: "pending",

  amountMinor: 234050,

  description: "Salary",
});
const TRANSIT = item({

  amountMinor: -1250,
  counterparty: "City Transit",
  description: "Monthly pass",
});

function bucket(date: LocalDate, inMinor: number, outMinor: number): CashFlowBucket {
  return { date, end: date, inMinor, outMinor, netMinor: inMinor - outMinor, count: 1, balanceMinor: null };
}

function aggregate(overrides: Partial<CashFlowResponse> = {}): CashFlowResponse {

    from: from30,

    bucket: "day",

}

function listResponse(overrides: Partial<TransactionListResponse> = {}): TransactionListResponse {

}

const EMPTY_LIST = listResponse({

});

function account(id: number, name: string): AccountSummary {

    status: "active",
    balance: null,
    net30d: { inMinor: 0, outMinor: 0, netMinor: 0 },
    daily30d: [],
    lastSyncedAt: null,
    lastSyncError: null,
    rateLimitedUntil: null,
    syncInProgress: false,
  };
}

const CONNECTIONS: ConnectionsResponse = {
  connections: [
    {
      id: 1,
      bankName: "Banca Esempio",
      country: "IT",
      hasLogo: false,
      status: "active",
      validUntil: Date.UTC(2027, 4, 1),
      createdAt: Date.UTC(2026, 9, 1),
      renewedAt: null,
      lastError: null,
      accounts: [account(1, "Conto corrente"), account(2, "Savings")],
    },
  ],
  removedAccounts: [
    {
      id: 7,
      name: "Old card",
      maskedIdentifier: "•••• 9876",
      bankName: "Northwind Bank",
      transactionCount: 42,
      removedAt: Date.UTC(2026, 8, 1),
    },
  ],
};

const DETAIL: TransactionDetail = {
  ...CAFE,
  transactionDate: null,
  providerReference: "REF-2026-000101",
  counterpartyAccount: null,
  remittanceLines: [],
  bankCode: null,
  merchantCategoryCode: null,
  balanceAfter: null,
  firstSeenAt: Date.UTC(2026, 10, 6, 9, 30),
  lastSeenAt: Date.UTC(2026, 10, 8, 9, 30),
  bankName: "Banca Esempio",
};

interface Call {
  method: string;
  path: string;
  params: Record<string, string>;
}
type Reply = { status: number; body?: unknown };

let calls: Call[] = [];

function stubFetch(handler: (call: Call) => Reply | undefined): void {
  calls = [];
  vi.stubGlobal(
    "fetch",
    vi.fn(async (input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit) => {
      const url = new URL(String(input), "http://localhost");
      const call: Call = {
        method: init?.method ?? "GET",
        path: url.pathname,
        params: Object.fromEntries(url.searchParams),
      };
      calls.push(call);
      const reply = handler(call) ?? { status: 404, body: { error: "Not found" } };
      return new Response(reply.body === undefined ? null : JSON.stringify(reply.body), {
        status: reply.status,
        headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
      });
    }),
  );
}

function apiHandler(
  list: (params: Record<string, string>) => TransactionListResponse = () => listResponse(),
) {
  return (call: Call): Reply | undefined => {
    if (call.path === "/api/transactions") return { status: 200, body: list(call.params) };
    if (call.path === "/api/transactions/101") return { status: 200, body: DETAIL };
    if (call.path === "/api/connections") return { status: 200, body: CONNECTIONS };
    return undefined;
  };
}

/** Parameters of the latest list request (probe requests carry `pageSize`, the list never does). */
function lastList(): Record<string, string> | undefined {
  return calls
    .filter((call) => call.path === "/api/transactions" && call.params.pageSize === undefined)
    .at(-1)?.params;
}

function renderPage(path = "/transactions") {
  return renderRoutes(
    [
      {
        path: "/transactions",
        element: (
          <FormatProvider timeZone={TZ}>
            <TransactionsPage />
          </FormatProvider>
        ),
      },
      { path: "/accounts", element: <p>Accounts page</p> },
      { path: "/accounts/:accountId", element: <p>Account page</p> },
    ],
    { initialEntries: [path] },
  );
}

type Rendered = ReturnType<typeof renderPage>;

function urlParams(router: Rendered["router"]): URLSearchParams {
  return new URLSearchParams(router.state.location.search);
}

async function findTable(): Promise<HTMLElement> {
  const table = await screen.findByRole("table", { name: "Transactions" });
  await within(table).findAllByText("Caffè Centrale");
  return table;
}

describe("TransactionsPage", () => {
  beforeEach(async () => {
```

`apps/web/src/pages/transactions/CashFlowAggregate.tsx`:

```tsx
import type { CashFlowBucket, CashFlowResponse, LocalDate, TransactionTab } from "@bursar/shared";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { CashFlowStrip } from "../../components/charts/CashFlowStrip";
import { Card, Money } from "../../components/ui";
import { useFormatters } from "../../lib/format";
import { amountTone } from "../../lib/tones";
import { useUi } from "../../store/ui";

export interface CashFlowAggregateProps {
  /** `undefined` while the first response is on its way. */
  aggregate: CashFlowResponse | undefined;
  tab: TransactionTab;
  onTabChange(tab: TransactionTab): void;
  /** A click on a bar: the page turns it into a custom period. */
  onSelectBucket(bucket: CashFlowBucket): void;
  selectedDate: LocalDate | null;
  onCurrencyChange(currency: string): void;
  highlightNegativeNet: boolean;
}

interface FigureProps {
  label: string;
  hint: string;
  /** Set for the In and Out toggles; Net is a plain button that clears the direction. */
  pressed?: boolean;
  onClick(): void;
  children: ReactNode;
}

function Figure({ label, hint, pressed, onClick, children }: FigureProps) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      title={hint}
      aria-pressed={pressed}
      onClick={onClick}
      className={`flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-start transition-colors max-sm:min-h-11 sm:w-auto sm:min-w-36 sm:flex-col sm:items-start sm:justify-start sm:gap-0.5 ${
        pressed ? "border-primary bg-primary-50" : "border-subtle hover:bg-surface-2"
      }`}
    >
      <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted">{label}</span>
      <span className="font-display text-lg font-bold sm:text-xl">{children}</span>
    </button>
  );
}

/**
 * The aggregated form of the cash-flow strip (UX doc §3): "In · Out · Net" figures that act as
 * direction filters, the period's diverging bars (a click selects that bucket's dates) and, with
 * mixed currencies, a currency switch with the no-conversion note.
 */
export function CashFlowAggregate({
  aggregate,
  tab,
  onTabChange,
  onSelectBucket,
  selectedDate,
  onCurrencyChange,
  highlightNegativeNet,
}: CashFlowAggregateProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { money, localDate } = useFormatters();
  const privacy = useUi((state) => state.privacy);

  if (!aggregate) {
    return (
      <Card aria-busy="true" className="space-y-4">
        <div className="grid gap-2 sm:flex">
          {[0, 1, 2].map((slot) => (
            <div key={slot} className="h-14 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-surface-2 sm:w-36" />
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="h-28 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-surface-2" />
      </Card>
    );
  }

  const { totals, currency, currencies } = aggregate;
  const mixed = currencies.length > 1;
  const range = t("transactions.aggregate.range", {
    from: localDate(aggregate.from),
    to: localDate(aggregate.to),
  });
  const summary = t("transactions.aggregate.summary", {
    from: localDate(aggregate.from),
    to: localDate(aggregate.to),
    in: money(totals.inMinor, currency, { sign: "never", masked: privacy }),
    out: money(totals.outMinor, currency, { sign: "never", masked: privacy }),
    net: money(totals.netMinor, currency, { sign: "always", masked: privacy }),
  });

  return (
    <Card padding="none">
      <section aria-label={t("transactions.aggregate.label")} className="space-y-3 p-4 sm:p-5">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="grid w-full gap-2 sm:flex sm:w-auto sm:flex-wrap">
            <Figure
              label={t("transactions.aggregate.in")}
              hint={t(
                tab === "in" ? "transactions.aggregate.showAll" : "transactions.aggregate.filterIn",
              )}
              pressed={tab === "in"}
              onClick={() => onTabChange(tab === "in" ? "all" : "in")}
            >
              <Money
                minor={totals.inMinor}
                currency={currency}
                sign="never"
                tone={amountTone(totals.inMinor, "flow")}
              />
            </Figure>
            <Figure
              label={t("transactions.aggregate.out")}
              hint={t(
                tab === "out"
                  ? "transactions.aggregate.showAll"
                  : "transactions.aggregate.filterOut",
              )}
              pressed={tab === "out"}
              onClick={() => onTabChange(tab === "out" ? "all" : "out")}
            >
              <Money
                minor={totals.outMinor}
                currency={currency}
                sign="never"
                tone={amountTone(-Math.abs(totals.outMinor), "flow")}
              />
            </Figure>
            <Figure
              label={t("transactions.aggregate.net")}
              hint={t("transactions.aggregate.showAll")}
              onClick={() => onTabChange("all")}
            >
              <Money
                minor={totals.netMinor}
                currency={currency}
                sign="always"
                tone={amountTone(totals.netMinor, "net", { highlightNegativeNet })}
              />
            </Figure>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 sm:flex-col sm:items-end">
            <p className="tabular text-[13px] text-muted">{range}</p>
            {mixed ? (
              <fieldset className="inline-flex rounded-lg border border-subtle p-0.5">
                <legend className="sr-only">{t("transactions.aggregate.currency")}</legend>
                {currencies.map((code) => (
                  <button
                    key={code}
                    type="button"
                    aria-pressed={code === currency}
                    onClick={() => onCurrencyChange(code)}
                    className={`rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold max-sm:min-h-11 ${
                      code === currency ? "bg-primary-50 text-primary" : "text-muted hover:text-fg"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {code}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </fieldset>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        </div>
        {mixed ? <p className="text-[13px] text-muted">{t("transactions.aggregate.mixedNote")}</p> : null}
        <CashFlowStrip
          buckets={aggregate.buckets}
          currency={currency}
          variant="aggregate"
          highlightNegativeNet={highlightNegativeNet}
          selectedDate={selectedDate}
          onSelectBucket={onSelectBucket}
          height={112}
          summaryLabel={summary}
        />
      </section>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { addDays, type LocalDate } from "@bursar/shared";
import { SlidersHorizontal } from "lucide-react";
import { useId, useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import {
  Button,
  FilterChips,
  type FilterChipsProps,
  SearchInput,
  Select,
  TextInput,
} from "../../components/ui";
import { useFormatters } from "../../lib/format";
import { DEFAULT_PERIOD, PERIOD_PRESETS, type PeriodState } from "./period";

export interface AccountOption {
  /** Account id as written in the URL. */
  id: string;
  /** Display name for the chip. */
  name: string;
  /** Option text: name and bank, disconnected accounts labelled. */
  label: string;
}

type FilterKey = "q" | "accountId" | "period" | "from" | "to";

export interface TransactionFiltersProps {
  q: string;
  accountId: string;
  period: PeriodState;
  today: LocalDate;
  accounts: AccountOption[];
  /** Name for the account chip (never an id), null without an account filter. */
  accountName: string | null;
  /** "12 results of 840", shown while search, account or tab narrow the list. */
  results: { shown: number; total: number } | null;
  onChange(patch: Partial<Record<FilterKey, string>>): void;
  onClearAll(): void;
}

/**
 * Search, account and period filters with their chips and the results line. Below `sm` the
 * account and period controls live in a panel opened by the "Filters" button.
 */
export function TransactionFilters({
  q,
  accountId,
  period,
  today,
  accounts,
  accountName,
  results,
  onChange,
  onClearAll,
}: TransactionFiltersProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { locale, localDate } = useFormatters();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const panelId = useId();

  function periodLabel(): string {
    const { preset, from, to } = period;
    if (preset !== "custom") return t(`transactions.periods.${preset}`);
    if (from !== null && to !== null) {
      return from === to ? localDate(from) : `${localDate(from)} – ${localDate(to)}`;
    }
    if (from !== null) return t("transactions.chips.rangeFrom", { date: localDate(from) });
    if (to !== null) return t("transactions.chips.rangeTo", { date: localDate(to) });
    return t("transactions.periods.custom");
  }

  const query = q.trim();
  const chips: FilterChipsProps["chips"] = [];
  if (query !== "") {
    chips.push({
      id: "q",
      label: t("transactions.chips.search", { q: query }),
      onRemove: () => onChange({ q: "" }),
    });
  }
  if (accountId !== "") {
    chips.push({
      id: "account",
      label: t("transactions.chips.account", {
        name: accountName ?? t("transactions.filters.unknownAccount"),
      }),
      onRemove: () => onChange({ accountId: "" }),
    });
  }
  if (period.preset !== DEFAULT_PERIOD) {
    chips.push({
      id: "period",
      label: t("transactions.chips.period", { label: periodLabel() }),
      onRemove: () => onChange({ period: DEFAULT_PERIOD, from: "", to: "" }),
    });
  }
  const panelFilters = (accountId !== "" ? 1 : 0) + (period.preset !== DEFAULT_PERIOD ? 1 : 0);

  const accountOptions = [
    { value: "", label: t("transactions.filters.allAccounts") },
    ...accounts.map((option) => ({ value: option.id, label: option.label })),
  ];
  if (accountId !== "" && !accounts.some((option) => option.id === accountId)) {
    accountOptions.push({
      value: accountId,
      label: accountName ?? t("transactions.filters.unknownAccount"),
    });
  }
  const periodOptions = PERIOD_PRESETS.map((preset) => ({
    value: preset,
    label: t(`transactions.periods.${preset}`),
  }));

  function changePeriod(value: string): void {
    if (value === "custom") {
      // Start the custom range from what is on screen, so switching loses nothing.
      onChange({
        period: "custom",
        from: period.from ?? addDays(today, -29),
        to: period.to ?? today,
      });
    } else {
      onChange({ period: value, from: "", to: "" });
    }
  }

  const number = new Intl.NumberFormat(locale);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <SearchInput
            value={q}
            onChange={(value) => onChange({ q: value })}
            label={t("transactions.filters.searchLabel")}
            placeholder={t("transactions.filters.searchPlaceholder")}
          />
        </div>
        <Button
          variant="secondary"
          icon={SlidersHorizontal}
          className="sm:hidden"
          aria-expanded={open}
          aria-controls={panelId}
          onClick={() => setOpen((value) => !value)}
        >
          {panelFilters > 0
            ? t("transactions.filters.toggleCount", { active: panelFilters })
            : t("transactions.filters.toggle")}
        </Button>
      </div>
      <div
        id={panelId}
        className={`grid gap-x-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 ${open ? "" : "max-sm:hidden"}`}
      >
        <Select
          label={t("transactions.filters.account")}
          value={accountId}
          options={accountOptions}
          onChange={(event) => onChange({ accountId: event.target.value })}
        />
        <Select
          label={t("transactions.filters.period")}
          value={period.preset}
          options={periodOptions}
          onChange={(event) => changePeriod(event.target.value)}
        />
        {period.preset === "custom" ? (
          <>
            <TextInput
              type="date"
              label={t("transactions.filters.from")}
              value={period.from ?? ""}
              max={period.to ?? undefined}
              onChange={(event) =>
                onChange({ period: "custom", from: event.target.value, to: period.to ?? "" })
              }
            />
            <TextInput
              type="date"
              label={t("transactions.filters.to")}
              value={period.to ?? ""}
              min={period.from ?? undefined}
              onChange={(event) =>
                onChange({ period: "custom", from: period.from ?? "", to: event.target.value })
              }
            />
          </>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      <FilterChips chips={chips} onClearAll={onClearAll} />
      {results ? (
        <p aria-live="polite" className="tabular text-[13px] text-muted">
          {t("transactions.results", {
            count: results.shown,
            shown: number.format(results.shown),
            total: number.format(results.total),
          })}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { formatLocalDate, type LocalDate, type TransactionItem } from "@bursar/shared";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { type Column, DataTable, Money, type SortState, StatusPill } from "../../components/ui";
import { useFormatters } from "../../lib/format";
import { relativeDayLabel } from "./period";

export interface TransactionTableProps {
  /** `undefined` while the first response is on its way. */
  rows: TransactionItem[] | undefined;
  loading: boolean;
  sort: SortState;
  onSortChange(sort: SortState): void;
  onOpen(row: TransactionItem): void;
  selectedId: number | null;
  today: LocalDate;
  /** The empty state chosen by the page (filter-empty, true-empty, positive…). */
  empty: ReactNode;
}

function DayLabel({ date, today }: { date: LocalDate; today: LocalDate }) {
  const { locale } = useFormatters();
  return (
    <time
      dateTime={date}
      title={formatLocalDate(date, locale, { style: "long", weekday: true })}
      className="whitespace-nowrap"
    >
      {relativeDayLabel(date, today, locale)}
    </time>
  );
}

function SignedAmount({ row, className }: { row: TransactionItem; className: string }) {
  return (
    <Money
      minor={row.amountMinor}
      currency={row.currency}
      sign="always"
      tone="auto-flow"
      className={className}
    />
  );
}

/** Counterparty cell; below `sm` it is the whole row: name, pill and amount over date · account. */
function CounterpartyCell({ row, today }: { row: TransactionItem; today: LocalDate }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const name = row.counterparty ?? row.description;
  return (
    <div className="max-w-[calc(100vw_-_5rem)] min-w-0 py-1.5 sm:max-w-[16rem] xl:max-w-[22rem]">
      <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2">
        <span
          title={name ?? undefined}
          className={`min-w-0 flex-1 truncate font-medium ${name ? "text-fg" : "text-muted"}`}
        >
          {name ?? t("transactions.noCounterparty")}
        </span>
        {row.status === "pending" ? (
          <StatusPill tone="info" label={t("transactions.pending")} className="shrink-0" />
        ) : null}
        <SignedAmount row={row} className="shrink-0 font-semibold whitespace-nowrap sm:hidden" />
      </div>
      <p className="mt-0.5 flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 text-xs text-muted sm:hidden">
        <DayLabel date={row.date} today={today} />
        <span aria-hidden>·</span>
        <span className="min-w-0 truncate">{row.accountName}</span>
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * The transactions table: relative day (absolute date in `title`), counterparty with the pending
 * pill, description, account and the signed amount in its flow tone. Sorting is server-side.
 */
export function TransactionTable({
  rows,
  loading,
  sort,
  onSortChange,
  onOpen,
  selectedId,
  today,
  empty,
}: TransactionTableProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const columns: Column<TransactionItem>[] = [
    {
      id: "date",
      header: t("transactions.table.date"),
      sortable: true,
      hideBelow: "sm",
      className: "w-32",
      cell: (row) => <DayLabel date={row.date} today={today} />,
    },
    {
      id: "counterparty",
      header: t("transactions.table.counterparty"),
      sortable: true,
      cell: (row) => <CounterpartyCell row={row} today={today} />,
    },
    {
      id: "description",
      header: t("transactions.table.description"),
      hideBelow: "lg",
      cell: (row) => (
        <span title={row.description ?? undefined} className="block max-w-[18rem] truncate text-muted">
          {row.description ?? ""}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      id: "account",
      header: t("transactions.table.account"),
      hideBelow: "md",
      cell: (row) => (
        <span title={row.accountName} className="block max-w-[12rem] truncate text-muted">
          {row.accountName}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      id: "amount",
      header: t("transactions.table.amount"),
      sortable: true,
      align: "end",
      hideBelow: "sm",
      cell: (row) => <SignedAmount row={row} className="font-semibold whitespace-nowrap" />,
    },
  ];
  return (
    <DataTable
      caption={t("transactions.table.caption")}
      columns={columns}
      rows={rows}
      getRowKey={(row) => row.id}
      loading={loading}
      skeletonRows={10}
      sort={sort}
      onSortChange={onSortChange}
      onRowClick={onOpen}
      selectedKey={selectedId}
      empty={empty}
    />
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { type TransactionTab, toLocalDate, transactionTabSchema } from "@bursar/shared";
import { keepPreviousData, useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { RotateCw } from "lucide-react";
import { type ReactNode, useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Link } from "react-router";
import { api } from "../api";
import { buildPath } from "../app/routes";
import { useSettingsQuery } from "../app/useSettingsQuery";
import {
  Button,
  Card,
  EmptyState,
  PageHeader,
  Pagination,
  type SortState,
  Tabs,
} from "../components/ui";
import { useFormatters } from "../lib/format";
import { queryKeys } from "../lib/query-keys";
import { useUrlState } from "../lib/url-state";
import { CashFlowAggregate } from "./transactions/CashFlowAggregate";
import { type AccountOption, TransactionFilters } from "./transactions/TransactionFilters";
import { PRIMARY_LINK_CLASS, TransactionDrawer } from "./transactions/TransactionDrawer";
import { TransactionTable } from "./transactions/TransactionTable";
import {
  DEFAULT_PERIOD,
  isLocalDate,
  isPeriodPreset,
  type PeriodState,
  readPeriod,
} from "./transactions/period";

const PAGE_SIZE = 20;
const TABS: readonly TransactionTab[] = ["all", "in", "out", "pending"];
const SORT_COLUMNS: readonly string[] = ["date", "amount", "counterparty"];
const POSITIVE_ID = /^[1-9]\d{0,9}$/;
/** Probe requests only need `total`; the list itself always uses the server default (20). */
const PROBE_PAGE_SIZE = "10";
const ALL_TIME_PARAMS: Record<string, string> = { pageSize: PROBE_PAGE_SIZE };

/** The list state in the URL; a value equal to its default is absent from the URL. */
export const LIST_DEFAULTS = {
  q: "",
  tab: "all",
  accountId: "",
  period: "30d",
  from: "",
  to: "",
  currency: "",
  sort: "date",
  order: "desc",
  page: "1",
};

export type TransactionUrlState = typeof LIST_DEFAULTS;

const LIST_RULES: Partial<Record<keyof TransactionUrlState, (value: string) => boolean>> = {
  q: (value) => value.length <= 100,
  tab: (value) => transactionTabSchema.safeParse(value).success,
  accountId: (value) => POSITIVE_ID.test(value),
  period: isPeriodPreset,
  from: isLocalDate,
  to: isLocalDate,
  currency: (value) => /^[A-Z]{3}$/.test(value),
  sort: (value) => SORT_COLUMNS.includes(value),
  order: (value) => value === "asc" || value === "desc",
  page: (value) => /^[1-9]\d{0,5}$/.test(value),
};

/** The open drawer lives in its own hook so that opening it never resets `page`. */
const DRAWER_DEFAULTS = { tx: "" };
const DRAWER_RULES = { tx: (value: string) => POSITIVE_ID.test(value) };

function rangeParams(period: PeriodState): Record<string, string> {
  const params: Record<string, string> = {};
  if (period.from !== null) params.from = period.from;
  if (period.to !== null) params.to = period.to;
  return params;
}

/** API query for the list: only the values that differ from the server defaults. */
export function listParams(
  state: TransactionUrlState,
  period: PeriodState,
): Record<string, string> {
  const params: Record<string, string> = {};
  const q = state.q.trim();
  if (q !== "") params.q = q;
  if (state.tab !== "all") params.tab = state.tab;
  if (state.accountId !== "") params.accountId = state.accountId;
  Object.assign(params, rangeParams(period));
  if (state.currency !== "") params.currency = state.currency;
  if (state.sort !== "date") params.sort = state.sort;
  if (state.order !== "desc") params.order = state.order;
  if (state.page !== "1") params.page = state.page;
  return params;
}

/** Date descending is the server default and reads as "no sort" (asc → desc → none). */
function toSortState(state: TransactionUrlState): SortState {
  if (state.sort === "date" && state.order === "desc") return null;
  return { columnId: state.sort, direction: state.order === "asc" ? "asc" : "desc" };
}

/**
 * Transactions (UX doc §4, list grammar): header with the count, the cash-flow aggregate whose
 * figures and bars filter the list, faceted tabs, search, account and period filters with chips,
 * the table with server-side sorting and pagination, and the detail drawer. Every piece of state
 * is in the URL.
 */
export function TransactionsPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { now, timeZone } = useFormatters();
  const today = toLocalDate(now(), timeZone);
  const [state, setState] = useUrlState(LIST_DEFAULTS, {
    validate: LIST_RULES,
    resetOnChange: ["page"],
  });
  const [drawer, setDrawer] = useUrlState(DRAWER_DEFAULTS, { validate: DRAWER_RULES });
  const period = readPeriod(state, today);
  const tab = state.tab as TransactionTab;
  const params = listParams(state, period);

  const list = useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.transactions(params),
    queryFn: () => api.transactions(params),
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
  });
  const settings = useSettingsQuery();
  const connections = useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.connections,
    queryFn: () => api.connections(),
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });

  const data = list.data;
  const fresh = data !== undefined && !list.isPlaceholderData ? data : undefined;
  const searchOrAccount = state.q.trim() !== "" || state.accountId !== "";
  const narrowed = searchOrAccount || tab !== "all";
  const isEmpty = fresh !== undefined && fresh.total === 0;

  const baseParams = { ...rangeParams(period), pageSize: PROBE_PAGE_SIZE };
  const base = useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.transactions(baseParams),
    queryFn: () => api.transactions(baseParams),
    enabled: narrowed,
  });
  const needsAllTime = isEmpty && !narrowed && period.preset !== "all";
  const allTime = useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.transactions(ALL_TIME_PARAMS),
    queryFn: () => api.transactions(ALL_TIME_PARAMS),
    enabled: needsAllTime,
  });

  const pageNumber = Number(state.page);
  useEffect(() => {
    // A page beyond the last one (rows removed since the link was made): go to the last page.
    if (fresh === undefined || fresh.items.length > 0 || fresh.total === 0) return;
    const last = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(fresh.total / PAGE_SIZE));
    if (pageNumber > last) setState({ page: String(last) });
  }, [fresh, pageNumber, setState]);

  const accounts = useMemo((): AccountOption[] => {
    const response = connections.data;
    if (!response) return [];
    return [
      ...response.connections.flatMap((connection) =>
        connection.accounts.map((account) => ({
          id: String(account.id),
          name: account.name,
          label: t("transactions.filters.accountOption", {
            name: account.name,
            bank: connection.bankName,
          }),
        })),
      ),
      ...response.removedAccounts.map((account) => ({
        id: String(account.id),
        name: account.name,
        label: t("transactions.filters.removedAccountOption", {
          name: account.name,
          bank: account.bankName,
        }),
      })),
    ];
  }, [connections.data, t]);

  let accountName: string | null = null;
  if (state.accountId !== "") {
    const selected = accounts.find((option) => option.id === state.accountId);
    if (selected) accountName = selected.name;
    else if (connections.isPending) accountName = t("common.loading");
    else accountName = t("transactions.filters.unknownAccount");
  }

  const results =
    narrowed && fresh !== undefined && base.data !== undefined
      ? { shown: fresh.total, total: base.data.total }
      : null;

  function clearFilters(): void {
    setState({ q: "", accountId: "", period: DEFAULT_PERIOD, from: "", to: "", tab: "all" });
  }

  function emptyState(): ReactNode {
    if (tab === "pending" && !searchOrAccount) {
      return (
        <EmptyState
          kind="positive"
          title={t("transactions.empty.pendingTitle")}
          description={t("transactions.empty.pendingDescription")}
        />
      );
    }
    if (narrowed) {
      return (
        <EmptyState
          kind="filter"
          title={t("transactions.empty.filterTitle")}
          description={t("transactions.empty.filterDescription")}
          action={
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={clearFilters}>
              {t("table.clearFilters")}
            </Button>
          }
        />
      );
    }
    if (period.preset === "all" || allTime.data?.total === 0) {
      return (
        <EmptyState
          kind="empty"
          title={t("transactions.empty.trueTitle")}
          description={t("transactions.empty.trueDescription")}
          action={
            <Link to={buildPath("accounts")} className={PRIMARY_LINK_CLASS}>
              {t("transactions.empty.openAccounts")}
            </Link>
          }
        />
      );
    }
    return (
      <EmptyState
        kind="filter"
        title={t("transactions.empty.periodTitle")}
        description={t("transactions.empty.periodDescription")}
        action={
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            onClick={() => setState({ period: "all", from: "", to: "" })}
          >
            {t("transactions.empty.showAllPeriods")}
          </Button>
        }
      />
    );
  }

  const tableLoading = fresh === undefined || (needsAllTime && allTime.isPending);
  const selectedDate =
    period.preset === "custom" && period.from !== null && period.from === period.to
      ? period.from
      : null;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <PageHeader
        title={t("routes.transactions.title")}
        count={data?.total}
        subtitle={t("routes.transactions.description")}
      />
      {list.isError && data === undefined ? (
        <Card padding="lg" role="alert" className="flex flex-col items-start gap-3">
          <p className="font-display text-base font-bold text-fg">
            {t("transactions.error.title")}
          </p>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted">{t("transactions.error.description")}</p>
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            icon={RotateCw}
            loading={list.isFetching}
            onClick={() => void list.refetch()}
          >
            {t("transactions.error.retry")}
          </Button>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <>
          <CashFlowAggregate
            aggregate={data?.aggregate}
            tab={tab}
            onTabChange={(next) => setState({ tab: next })}
            onSelectBucket={(bucket) =>
              setState({ period: "custom", from: bucket.date, to: bucket.end })
            }
            selectedDate={selectedDate}
            onCurrencyChange={(currency) => setState({ currency })}
            highlightNegativeNet={settings.data?.values.highlightNegativeNet ?? true}
          />
          <Tabs
            ariaLabel={t("transactions.tabs.label")}
            value={tab}
            onChange={(id) => setState({ tab: id })}
            items={TABS.map((id) => ({
              id,
              label: t(`transactions.tabs.${id}`),
              count: data?.facets[id],
            }))}
          />
          <TransactionFilters
            q={state.q}
            accountId={state.accountId}
            period={period}
            today={today}
            accounts={accounts}
            accountName={accountName}
            results={results}
            onChange={setState}
            onClearAll={clearFilters}
          />
          <TransactionTable
            rows={data?.items}
            loading={tableLoading}
            sort={toSortState(state)}
            onSortChange={(next) =>
              setState(
                next === null
                  ? { sort: "date", order: "desc" }
                  : { sort: next.columnId, order: next.direction },
              )
            }
            onOpen={(row) => setDrawer({ tx: String(row.id) })}
            selectedId={drawer.tx === "" ? null : Number(drawer.tx)}
            today={today}
            empty={emptyState()}
          />
          {data !== undefined && data.total > 0 ? (
            <Pagination
              page={pageNumber}
              pageSize={PAGE_SIZE}
              total={data.total}
              onPageChange={(page) => setState({ page: String(page) })}
            />
          ) : null}
        </>
      )}
      <TransactionDrawer
        id={drawer.tx === "" ? null : Number(drawer.tx)}
        onClose={() => setDrawer({ tx: "" })}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

In `apps/web/src/app/palette-sources.ts` add these imports (merge with the existing ones; `LucideIcon`, `useMemo`, `useTranslation`, `buildPath` are already imported by Task 4):

```ts
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { ArrowLeftRight } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { api } from "../api";
import { useFormatters } from "../lib/format";
import { queryKeys } from "../lib/query-keys";
```

Add this code above the `PALETTE_SOURCES` declaration:

```ts
const SEARCH_DEBOUNCE_MS = 200;

function useDebouncedValue<T>(value: T, delayMs: number): T {
  const [debounced, setDebounced] = useState(value);
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setDebounced(value), delayMs);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [value, delayMs]);
  return debounced;
}

/**
 * Transactions by counterparty, through `GET /api/search` (accent-insensitive on the server).
 * The request waits for 200 ms of quiet typing; until the answer for the current query arrives the
 * source reports `loading`, so the palette does not flash its empty text. Amounts are not shown:
 * the palette ignores privacy mode, and a subtitle never carries financial data.
 */
export const transactionsSource: PaletteSource = {
  id: "transactions",
  minQueryLength: 2,
  limit: 6,
  useItems(query) {
    const { t } = useTranslation();
    const { localDate } = useFormatters();
    const debounced = useDebouncedValue(query, SEARCH_DEBOUNCE_MS);
    const active = query.length >= 2;
    const current = active && debounced === query;
    const result = useQuery({
      queryKey: queryKeys.search(debounced),
      queryFn: () => api.search(debounced),
      enabled: current,
      staleTime: 30_000,
    });
    const transactions = current ? result.data?.transactions : undefined;
    const items = useMemo(() => {
      if (!transactions) return [];
      const group = t("palette.groups.transactions");
      return transactions.map(
        (transaction): PaletteItem => ({
          id: `transaction:${transaction.id}`,
          group,
          title: transaction.counterparty,
          subtitle: t("palette.transactionSubtitle", {
            account: transaction.accountName,
            date: localDate(transaction.date),
          }),
          icon: ArrowLeftRight,
          to: buildPath("transactions", {}, { tx: String(transaction.id) }),
        }),
      );
    }, [transactions, t, localDate]);
    return { items, loading: active && (!current || result.isFetching) };
  },
};
```

**Implementation notes (read before Step 1):**
- **Why the extra files.** The contract names `useSectionForm` but no shared card, no save helper and no registry for the sticky bar. `SectionCard` holds the header (title, "Edit section", Cancel/Save) so the five sections stay short; `save-settings.ts` holds the one PATCH-and-toast path; the registry in `UnsavedBar.tsx` lets the bar know which sections are dirty without lifting the five forms into the page.
- **Field errors come from the client.** The server's 400 for `PATCH /api/settings` is `{ error: "Invalid settings", code: "invalid_settings" }` without field names (Task 8). So every section validates its fields with the same Zod schema the server uses (`settingsValuesSchema.shape[key]` from `@bursar/shared`) before it sends, and shows a translated message next to the field. A 400 that still arrives (version skew) becomes a warning toast and the section stays in edit mode.
- **`useSectionForm` contract details.** `values` is the draft while editing and `initial` otherwise, so after a successful save the card shows the saved values at once (the save helper writes the PATCH response into the `settings` query). `submit()` never rejects: a `SectionFormError` thrown by `save` fills `errors` (its keys are field names); any other failure leaves the section editing, and `save` is responsible for reporting it (the helper shows the toast). `set()` is ignored when not editing. `dirty` is true only when the draft differs from `initial`.
- **Escape.** Escape inside a section form cancels the edit (UX: nothing is lost silently, and Task 5's monkey run presses Escape after every click, so it never leaves a dirty form behind and never meets the `beforeunload` prompt).
- **Task 20 dependency.** `api.bankStatus()` and `queryKeys.bankStatus` come from Task 20 (it produces `bankStatus()`; this task's Consumes line lists the route only).
- **Notification parameter names.** Tasks 9, 13 and 14 raise notifications with `bankName`, `accountName` and `days`, and Task 6's QA seed stores the same names; `toPopoverNotification` reads exactly those keys (no alias fallback).
- **Libraries.** No new dependency. Icons imported by name from `lucide-react`: `Pencil`, `TriangleAlert`, `Mail`, `DatabaseBackup`, `Info`, `CircleAlert`, `Bell`, `BellOff` (typecheck is the check; if a name does not exist in the installed version, pick the closest icon and say so in the commit body).
- **Toasts** only through `feedback()`; the save helper and the backup toast use the global `i18n.t`, not the hook's `t`, because after a language switch the toast must already speak the new language.
- `<prefix>` is the Global Constraints shell prefix. The QA server started by the stories is a loopback test fixture started and stopped inside the command, not a dev server: no owner gate.

```tsx
  const view = renderHook(() => useSectionForm(INITIAL, saveSpy));
  return { ...view, saveSpy };
}

describe("useSectionForm", () => {
  it("starts read-only and clean", () => {
    const { result } = setup();
    expect(result.current.values).toEqual(INITIAL);
    expect(result.current.editing).toBe(false);
    expect(result.current.dirty).toBe(false);
    expect(result.current.saving).toBe(false);
    expect(result.current.errors).toEqual({});
  });

  it("ignores set() while the section is not being edited", () => {
    const { result } = setup();
    act(() => result.current.set("name", "Other"));
    expect(result.current.values).toEqual(INITIAL);
    expect(result.current.editing).toBe(false);
    expect(result.current.dirty).toBe(false);
  });

  it("is editing but clean after startEdit, dirty after a change and clean again when restored", () => {
    const { result } = setup();
    act(() => result.current.startEdit());
    expect(result.current.editing).toBe(true);
    expect(result.current.dirty).toBe(false);
    act(() => result.current.set("days", 90));
    expect(result.current.values).toEqual({ name: "Main", days: 90 });
    expect(result.current.dirty).toBe(true);
    act(() => result.current.set("days", 30));
    expect(result.current.dirty).toBe(false);
    expect(result.current.editing).toBe(true);
  });

  it("discards the draft and the errors on cancel", async () => {
    const { result } = setup(async () => {
      throw new SectionFormError({ days: "Too long" });
    });
    act(() => result.current.startEdit());
    act(() => result.current.set("days", 999));
    await act(async () => {
      await result.current.submit();
    });
    expect(result.current.errors).toEqual({ days: "Too long" });
    act(() => result.current.cancel());
    expect(result.current.editing).toBe(false);
    expect(result.current.dirty).toBe(false);
    expect(result.current.values).toEqual(INITIAL);
    expect(result.current.errors).toEqual({});
  });

  it("saves the draft and returns to read mode", async () => {
    const { result, saveSpy } = setup();
    act(() => result.current.startEdit());
    act(() => result.current.set("name", "Renamed"));
    await act(async () => {
      await result.current.submit();
    });
    expect(saveSpy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(saveSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ name: "Renamed", days: 30 });
    expect(result.current.editing).toBe(false);
    expect(result.current.saving).toBe(false);
    expect(result.current.errors).toEqual({});
    // The parent passes the saved values back as `initial`; here it is unchanged.
    expect(result.current.values).toEqual(INITIAL);
  });

  it("keeps the draft and shows the field errors when save throws a SectionFormError", async () => {
    const { result } = setup(async () => {
      throw new SectionFormError({ days: "Enter a number between 1 and 365." });
    });
    act(() => result.current.startEdit());
    act(() => result.current.set("days", 0));
    await act(async () => {
      await result.current.submit();
    });
    expect(result.current.editing).toBe(true);
    expect(result.current.dirty).toBe(true);
    expect(result.current.errors).toEqual({ days: "Enter a number between 1 and 365." });
    act(() => result.current.set("days", 10));
    expect(result.current.errors).toEqual({});
  });

  it("keeps editing without field errors when save fails for another reason", async () => {
    const { result } = setup(async () => {
      throw new Error("network down");
    });
    act(() => result.current.startEdit());
    act(() => result.current.set("name", "Renamed"));
    await act(async () => {
      await result.current.submit();
    });
    expect(result.current.editing).toBe(true);
    expect(result.current.dirty).toBe(true);
    expect(result.current.saving).toBe(false);
    expect(result.current.errors).toEqual({});
  });

  it("reports saving while the save is pending and ignores a second submit", async () => {
    let release: () => void = () => undefined;
    const { result, saveSpy } = setup(
      () =>
        new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
          release = resolve;
        }),
    );
    act(() => result.current.startEdit());
    act(() => result.current.set("name", "Renamed"));
    let first: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();
    act(() => {
      first = result.current.submit();
    });
    expect(result.current.saving).toBe(true);
    act(() => {
      void result.current.submit();
    });
    expect(saveSpy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    await act(async () => {
      release();
      await first;
    });
    expect(result.current.saving).toBe(false);
    expect(result.current.editing).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

```tsx
function backups(overrides: Partial<BackupStatusResponse> = {}): BackupStatusResponse {

        errorMessage: null,
      },
    ],
    ...overrides,
  };
}

interface Rendered {
  fetchMock: ReturnType<typeof stubApi>;
  patches: unknown[];
  posts: string[];
}

function renderSettings(
  overrides: Record<string, Handler> = {},
  options: { hash?: string } = {},
): Rendered {
  const patches: unknown[] = [];
  const posts: string[] = [];
  const fetchMock = stubApi({
    "GET /api/settings": () => ({ status: 200, body: SETTINGS }),
    "GET /api/banks/status": () => ({ status: 200, body: BANK_STATUS }),
    "GET /api/backups": () => ({ status: 200, body: backups() }),
    "PATCH /api/settings": (body) => {
      patches.push(body);
      return {
        status: 200,
        body: { ...SETTINGS, values: { ...SETTINGS.values, ...(body as object) } },
      };
    },
    "POST /api/backups/run": () => {
      posts.push("backups/run");
      return { status: 202, body: { queued: true } };
    },
    "POST /api/notifications/test-email": () => {
      posts.push("test-email");
      return { status: 202, body: { sent: true } };
    },
    ...overrides,
  });
  renderRoutes(
    [
      {
        path: "/settings",
        element: (
          <>
            <SettingsPage />
            <Toaster />
          </>
        ),
      },
    ],
    { initialEntries: [`/settings${options.hash ?? ""}`] },
  );
  return { fetchMock, patches, posts };
}

  it("keeps the backups card reachable at the #backups anchor", async () => {
    renderSettings({}, { hash: "#backups" });
    const card = await screen.findByRole("region", { name: "Backups" });
    expect(card.id).toBe("backups");

});
```
