```tsx
import type { NotificationEvent, NotificationItem } from "@bursar/shared";
import { fireEvent, render, screen, waitFor, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import { useLocation } from "react-router";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import i18n from "../i18n";
import { renderRoutes, stubApi } from "../test/router";
import {
  NotificationsPopover,
  type PopoverNotification,
  toPopoverNotification,
  useNotificationsFeed,
} from "./NotificationsPopover";

const NOW = Date.now();
const HOUR_MS = 3_600_000;

function item(overrides: Partial<NotificationItem> & Pick<NotificationItem, "id" | "event">) {
  return {
    params: {},
    link: null,
    createdAt: NOW - HOUR_MS,
    readAt: null,
    ...overrides,
  } satisfies NotificationItem;
}

describe("toPopoverNotification", () => {
  beforeEach(async () => {
    await i18n.changeLanguage("en");
  });

  it("maps every event to a title, a body, a tone and the link", () => {
    const t = i18n.t;
    const expiring = toPopoverNotification(
      item({
        id: 1,
        event: "consent_expiring",
        params: { bankName: "Northwind Bank", days: 9 },
        link: "/accounts",
      }),
      t,
    );
    expect(expiring).toMatchObject({
      id: 1,
      title: "Consent expiring",
      tone: "warning",
      to: "/accounts",
      read: false,
      at: NOW - HOUR_MS,
    });
    expect(expiring.body).toBe(
      "Consent for Northwind Bank has 9 days left. Renew it to keep your data up to date.",
    );

    const oneDay = toPopoverNotification(
      item({ id: 2, event: "consent_expiring", params: { bankName: "Northwind Bank", days: 1 } }),
      t,
    );
    expect(oneDay.body).toContain("has 1 day left");

    const expired = toPopoverNotification(
      item({ id: 3, event: "consent_expired", params: { bankName: "Banca Esempio" } }),
      t,
    );
    expect(expired).toMatchObject({ title: "Consent expired", tone: "danger" });
    expect(expired.body).toBe("Consent for Banca Esempio has expired. Renew it to resume syncing.");

    const problem = toPopoverNotification(
      item({ id: 4, event: "connection_error", params: { bankName: "Banca Esempio" } }),
      t,
    );
    expect(problem).toMatchObject({ title: "Bank connection problem", tone: "danger" });

    const failing = toPopoverNotification(
      item({
        id: 5,
        event: "sync_failing",
        params: { accountName: "Everyday Account", bankName: "Northwind Bank" },
        link: "/accounts/3",
        readAt: NOW,
      }),
      t,
    );
    expect(failing).toMatchObject({
      title: "Sync is failing",
      tone: "warning",
      to: "/accounts/3",
      read: true,
    });
    expect(failing.body).toBe("Everyday Account has not synced for over two days.");

    const backup = toPopoverNotification(
      item({ id: 6, event: "backup_failing", link: "/settings#backups" }),
      t,
    );
    expect(backup).toMatchObject({
      title: "Backups are failing",
      tone: "warning",
      to: "/settings#backups",
    });
  });

  it("speaks Italian with the server's parameter names and never leaves a placeholder", async () => {
    await i18n.changeLanguage("it");
    const seeded = toPopoverNotification(
      item({ id: 1, event: "consent_expiring", params: { bankName: "Northwind Bank", days: 9 } }),
      i18n.t,
    );
    expect(seeded.title).toBe("Consenso in scadenza");
    expect(seeded.body).toContain("Northwind Bank");
    expect(seeded.body).toContain("9 giorni");
    const account = toPopoverNotification(
      item({ id: 2, event: "sync_failing", params: { accountName: "Conto Smart" } }),
      i18n.t,
    );
    expect(account.body).toContain("Conto Smart");
    for (const text of [seeded.title, seeded.body, account.title, account.body]) {
      expect(text).not.toContain("{{");
      expect(text).not.toContain("undefined");
    }
  });

  it("drops links that are not panel paths and falls back for unknown events", () => {
    const external = toPopoverNotification(
      item({ id: 1, event: "backup_failing", link: "https://example.test/phish" }),
      i18n.t,
    );
    expect(external.to).toBeNull();
    const protocolRelative = toPopoverNotification(
      item({ id: 2, event: "backup_failing", link: "//example.test" }),
      i18n.t,
    );
    expect(protocolRelative.to).toBeNull();
    const unknown = toPopoverNotification(
      item({ id: 3, event: "future_event" as NotificationEvent }),
      i18n.t,
    );
    expect(unknown).toMatchObject({ title: "Bursar notification", tone: "info" });
    expect(unknown.body).not.toContain("notifications.events");
  });
});

describe("NotificationsPopover", () => {
  beforeEach(async () => {
    await i18n.changeLanguage("en");
  });

  const ITEMS: PopoverNotification[] = [
    {
      id: 1,
      title: "Consent expiring",
      body: "Consent for Northwind Bank has 9 days left.",
      at: NOW - HOUR_MS,
      read: false,
      tone: "warning",
      to: "/accounts",
    },
    {
      id: 2,
      title: "Sync is failing",
      body: "Everyday Account has not synced for over two days.",
      at: NOW - 5 * HOUR_MS,
      read: true,
      tone: "warning",
      to: "/accounts/3",
    },
  ];

  it("lists the items with the new-count chip, an unread dot and no see-all footer", () => {
    const onOpenItem = vi.fn();
    const onMarkAllRead = vi.fn();
    render(
      <NotificationsPopover
        items={ITEMS}
        unread={1}
        onOpenItem={onOpenItem}
        onMarkAllRead={onMarkAllRead}
      />,
    );
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Notifications: 1 unread" }));
    const dialog = screen.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Notifications" });
    expect(within(dialog).getByText("1 new")).not.toBeNull();
    expect(within(dialog).getAllByText("Unread")).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(within(dialog).queryByText(/see all/i)).toBeNull();
    fireEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: /Consent expiring/ }));
    expect(onOpenItem).toHaveBeenCalledWith(1);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Notifications: 1 unread" }));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Mark all as read" }));
    expect(onMarkAllRead).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it("shows the empty state and disables Mark all as read at zero", () => {
    render(
      <NotificationsPopover
        items={[]}
        unread={0}
        onOpenItem={() => undefined}
        onMarkAllRead={() => undefined}
      />,
    );
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Notifications" }));
    expect(screen.getByText("No notifications")).not.toBeNull();
    const markAll = screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Mark all as read" }) as HTMLButtonElement;
    expect(markAll.disabled).toBe(true);
    expect(screen.queryByText(/see all/i)).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe("useNotificationsFeed", () => {
  let state: { items: NotificationItem[]; unread: number };
  const posts: string[] = [];

  function Page() {
    const feed = useNotificationsFeed();
    const location = useLocation();
    return (
      <>
        <NotificationsPopover {...feed} />
        <p data-testid="where">{`${location.pathname}${location.hash}`}</p>
      </>
    );
  }

  function mount() {
    stubApi({
      "GET /api/notifications?limit=6": () => ({ status: 200, body: state }),
      "POST /api/notifications/1/read": () => {
        posts.push("read:1");
        state = {
          items: state.items.map((entry) =>
            entry.id === 1 ? { ...entry, readAt: Date.now() } : entry,
          ),
          unread: 0,
        };
        return { status: 204 };
      },
      "POST /api/notifications/read-all": () => {
        posts.push("read-all");
        state = {
          items: state.items.map((entry) => ({ ...entry, readAt: entry.readAt ?? Date.now() })),
          unread: 0,
        };
        return { status: 200, body: { updated: 1 } };
      },
    });
    return renderRoutes([
      { path: "/", element: <Page /> },
      { path: "/accounts", element: <Page /> },
      { path: "/settings", element: <Page /> },
    ]);
  }

  beforeEach(async () => {
    await i18n.changeLanguage("en");
    posts.length = 0;
    state = {
      items: [
        item({
          id: 1,
          event: "backup_failing",
          link: "/settings#backups",
          createdAt: NOW - HOUR_MS,
        }),
        item({
          id: 2,
          event: "consent_expiring",
          params: { bankName: "Northwind Bank", days: 9 },
          link: "/accounts",
          createdAt: NOW - 5 * HOUR_MS,
          readAt: NOW - 4 * HOUR_MS,
        }),
      ],
      unread: 1,
    };
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  });

  it("loads the feed, marks an unread item read and follows its link", async () => {
    mount();
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "Notifications: 1 unread" }));
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: /Backups are failing/ }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByTestId("where").textContent).toBe("/settings#backups"));
    await waitFor(() => expect(posts).toEqual(["read:1"]));
    expect(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "Notifications" })).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it("does not mark an item that is already read, but still navigates", async () => {
    mount();
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "Notifications: 1 unread" }));
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: /Consent expiring/ }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByTestId("where").textContent).toBe("/accounts"));
    expect(posts).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("marks everything read and disables the button afterwards", async () => {
    mount();
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "Notifications: 1 unread" }));
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "Mark all as read" }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(posts).toEqual(["read-all"]));
    await waitFor(() => {
      const markAll = screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Mark all as read" }) as HTMLButtonElement;
      expect(markAll.disabled).toBe(true);
    });
  });
});
```

```ts
import { act, renderHook } from "@testing-library/react";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { clearToasts, useToasts } from "../components/feedback";
import i18n from "../i18n";
import { announceBackupFinished } from "./backup-toast";

describe("announceBackupFinished", () => {
  beforeEach(async () => {
    await i18n.changeLanguage("en");
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    clearToasts();
  });

  it("announces a finished backup as a success toast", () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useToasts());
    act(() => announceBackupFinished("succeeded"));
    expect(result.current).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(result.current[0]).toMatchObject({
      title: "Backup completed",
      tone: "success",
    });
  });

  it("announces a failed backup as an error toast", () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useToasts());
    act(() => announceBackupFinished("failed"));
    expect(result.current[0]).toMatchObject({ title: "Backup failed", tone: "error" });
  });

  it("speaks the current language", async () => {
    await i18n.changeLanguage("it");
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useToasts());
    act(() => announceBackupFinished("succeeded"));
    expect(result.current[0]?.title).toBe("Backup completato");
  });
});
```

`apps/web/src/app/UserMenu.test.tsx` (the user-menu language switch persists the `locale` setting):

```tsx
import type { SettingsResponse } from "@bursar/shared";
import { fireEvent, screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import i18n from "../i18n";
import { queryKeys } from "../lib/query-keys";
import { renderRoutes, stubApi } from "../test/router";
import { UserMenu } from "./UserMenu";

const SAVED = {
  values: { locale: "en" },
  system: { timezone: "Europe/Rome" },
} as unknown as SettingsResponse;

function renderMenu() {
  return renderRoutes([{ path: "/", element: <UserMenu /> }]);
}

beforeEach(async () => {
  await i18n.changeLanguage("it");
});
afterEach(async () => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  await i18n.changeLanguage("en");
});

describe("UserMenu language", () => {
  it("switches the language and saves it as the locale setting", async () => {
    const fetchMock = stubApi({ "PATCH /api/settings": () => ({ status: 200, body: SAVED }) });
    const { client } = renderMenu();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Apri il menu utente" }));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "English" }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(fetchMock).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
    const [url, init] = fetchMock.mock.calls[0] ?? [];
    expect(`${init?.method} ${String(url)}`).toBe("PATCH /api/settings");
    expect(JSON.parse(String(init?.body))).toEqual({ locale: "en" });
    expect(i18n.language).toBe("en");
    await waitFor(() => expect(client.getQueryData(queryKeys.settings)).toEqual(SAVED));
  });

  it("does not call the API when the current language is chosen again", () => {
    const fetchMock = stubApi({});
    renderMenu();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Apri il menu utente" }));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Italiano" }));
    expect(fetchMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
```

Run: `<prefix> && pnpm --filter @bursar/web test src/pages/settings src/pages/SettingsPage.test.tsx src/app/NotificationsPopover.test.tsx src/app/backup-toast.test.ts src/app/UserMenu.test.tsx`
Expected: FAIL with `Test Files  5 failed (5)`. `useSectionForm.test.tsx`, `SettingsPage.test.tsx` and `backup-toast.test.ts` fail to load (`Failed to resolve import "./useSectionForm"`, `"./SettingsPage"`, `"./backup-toast"`). In `UserMenu.test.tsx` the first test fails (`fetchMock` called 0 times: the Task 4 menu only switches the language locally) and the second passes. In `NotificationsPopover.test.tsx` the `toPopoverNotification` tests fail (`toPopoverNotification is not a function`) and the `useNotificationsFeed` tests fail on the empty feed, while the two prop-driven popover tests already pass (the component exists since Task 4). That is the expected red state, not a harness problem. If Vitest reports `No test files found`, the path filters are wrong; fix them before going on.

- [ ] **Step 5: Add the API functions**

In `apps/web/src/api.ts`, add the types that are not imported yet to the `import type { … } from "@bursar/shared"` list (Task 17 already imports `SettingsResponse`, Task 20 `BankStatusResponse`; keep the list alphabetical, `pnpm format` sorts it): `BackupStatusResponse`, `NotificationListResponse`, `SettingsPatch`, `SettingsResponse`, `TestEmailResponse`. Then add these entries to the `api` object, after the entries earlier tasks added:

```ts
  updateSettings: (patch: SettingsPatch) =>
    request<SettingsResponse>("PATCH", "/api/settings", patch),
  backups: () => request<BackupStatusResponse>("GET", "/api/backups"),
  runBackup: () => request<{ queued: true }>("POST", "/api/backups/run"),
  notifications: (limit?: number) =>
    request<NotificationListResponse>(
      "GET",
      limit === undefined ? "/api/notifications" : `/api/notifications?limit=${limit}`,
    ),
  markNotificationRead: (id: number) =>
    request<void>("POST", `/api/notifications/${id}/read`),
  markAllNotificationsRead: () =>
    request<{ updated: number }>("POST", "/api/notifications/read-all"),
  sendTestEmail: () => request<TestEmailResponse>("POST", "/api/notifications/test-email"),
```

`markNotificationRead` resolves with `undefined` because the server answers 204 and `request` returns `undefined` for 204 (Task 4).

Merge these objects into `apps/web/src/i18n/en.json` and `apps/web/src/i18n/it.json`. `settings` is new. `notifications` already holds `popover` (Task 4): add `events` next to it, do not create a second `notifications` object. `common.cancel` and `shell.retry` already exist (Tasks 3 and 4). Italian plural keys carry `_one`, `_many` and `_other` (Task 2's parity test enforces it); English ones `_one` and `_other`.

`apps/web/src/pages/settings/useSectionForm.ts`:

```ts
import { useState } from "react";

/**
 * Thrown by a section's `save` to place messages next to fields. The keys are field names of the
 * section's values. An empty map means "the server refused, nothing to point at".
 */
export class SectionFormError extends Error {
  readonly fields: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;

  constructor(fields: Record<string, string>) {
    super("The section has invalid values");
    this.name = "SectionFormError";
    this.fields = fields;
  }
}

export interface SectionForm<T extends object> {
  /** The draft while editing, the saved values otherwise. */
  values: T;
  /** Changes one field of the draft; ignored when the section is not being edited. */
  set<K extends keyof T>(key: K, value: T[K]): void;
  /** True when the draft differs from the saved values. */
  dirty: boolean;
  editing: boolean;
  startEdit(): void;
  /** Throws the draft and the errors away. */
  cancel(): void;
  /**
   * Saves the draft. Never rejects: a `SectionFormError` fills `errors`, any other failure leaves
   * the section in edit mode and `save` is responsible for reporting it (a toast).
   */
  submit(): Promise<void>;
  saving: boolean;
  errors: Partial<Record<keyof T, string>>;
}

function sameValues<T extends object>(a: T, b: T): boolean {
  const keys = new Set([...Object.keys(a), ...Object.keys(b)]) as Set<keyof T>;
  for (const key of keys) {
    if (!Object.is(a[key], b[key])) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

/**
 * Inline edit state of one settings section (UX doc §4): read-only until `startEdit()`, a draft
 * while editing, and one `save` call on `submit()`. `initial` is the saved state; the parent
 * passes the new values after a successful save, which is what returns the card to read mode with
 * the saved values showing.
 */
export function useSectionForm<T extends object>(
  initial: T,
  save: (values: T) => Promise<void>,
): SectionForm<T> {
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<T | null>(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Partial<Record<keyof T, string>>>({});

  const set = <K extends keyof T>(key: K, value: T[K]): void => {
    setDraft((current) => (current === null ? current : ({ ...current, [key]: value } as T)));
    setErrors((current) => {
      if (!(key in current)) return current;
      return Object.fromEntries(
        Object.entries(current).filter(([name]) => name !== String(key)),
      ) as Partial<Record<keyof T, string>>;
    });
  };

  const startEdit = (): void => {
    setDraft((current) => current ?? { ...initial });
    setErrors({});
  };

  const cancel = (): void => {
    setDraft(null);
    setErrors({});
  };

  const submit = async (): Promise<void> => {
    if (draft === null || saving) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await save(draft);
      setDraft(null);
      setErrors({});
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof SectionFormError) {
        setErrors({ ...error.fields } as Partial<Record<keyof T, string>>);
      }
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return {
    values: draft ?? initial,
    set,
    dirty: draft !== null && !sameValues(draft, initial),
    editing: draft !== null,
    startEdit,
    cancel,
    submit,
    saving,
    errors,
  };
}
```

`apps/web/src/pages/settings/save-settings.ts`:

```ts
import { type SettingsPatch, type SettingsResponse, settingsValuesSchema } from "@bursar/shared";
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { ApiError, api } from "../../api";
import { feedback } from "../../components/feedback";
import i18n from "../../i18n";
import { isSessionExpired } from "../../lib/query-client";
import { queryKeys } from "../../lib/query-keys";
import { SectionFormError } from "./useSectionForm";

export type SectionId = "general" | "banking" | "notifications" | "display" | "backups";

interface FieldSchema {
  safeParse(value: unknown): { success: boolean };
}

const FIELD_SCHEMAS: Readonly<Record<string, FieldSchema>> = settingsValuesSchema.shape;

/**
 * Checks each field of a patch with the same Zod schema the server applies and returns a
 * `SectionFormError` with a translated message per invalid field, or null. The server's 400 does
 * not name fields (Task 8), so this is where "errors next to the fields" come from.
 */
export function validateSettingsFields(patch: SettingsPatch): SectionFormError | null {
  const fields: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(patch)) {
    const schema = FIELD_SCHEMAS[key];
    if (!schema || schema.safeParse(value).success) continue;
    fields[key] = i18n.t(`settings.errors.${key}`, {
      defaultValue: i18n.t("settings.errors.generic"),
    });
  }
  return Object.keys(fields).length > 0 ? new SectionFormError(fields) : null;
}

/**
 * The one path every section saves through: validate, PATCH, put the response in the `settings`
 * query, run `afterSave`, then confirm with a toast that names the section. Failures are reported
 * here (toast) and rethrown for `useSectionForm`, which keeps the section in edit mode. A 401 is
 * left to the query client's session-expiry handler.
 */
export function useSaveSettings() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const mutation = useMutation({ mutationFn: (patch: SettingsPatch) => api.updateSettings(patch) });

  return async (
    section: SectionId,
    patch: SettingsPatch,
    afterSave?: () => void,
  ): Promise<void> => {
    const invalid = validateSettingsFields(patch);
    if (invalid) {
      feedback(
        i18n.t("settings.invalid.title"),
        i18n.t("settings.invalid.detail", { count: Object.keys(invalid.fields).length }),
        "warning",
      );
      throw invalid;
    }
    let response: SettingsResponse;
    try {
      response = await mutation.mutateAsync(patch);
    } catch (error) {
      if (isSessionExpired(error)) throw error;
      if (error instanceof ApiError && error.status === 400) {
        feedback(i18n.t("settings.invalid.title"), i18n.t("settings.invalid.refused"), "warning");
        throw new SectionFormError({});
      }
      feedback(i18n.t("settings.saveFailed.title"), i18n.t("settings.saveFailed.detail"), "error");
      throw error;
    }
    queryClient.setQueryData(queryKeys.settings, response);
    afterSave?.();
    // After `afterSave`: a language change must already apply to the confirmation.
    feedback(
      i18n.t("settings.saved.title"),
      i18n.t("settings.saved.detail", {
        section: i18n.t(`settings.sections.${section}.title`),
      }),
    );
  };
}
```

```tsx
import { TriangleAlert } from "lucide-react";
import {
  createContext,
  type ReactNode,
  type RefObject,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  useState,
} from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui";

interface SectionStatus {
  dirty: boolean;
  saving: boolean;
}

interface SectionActions {
  submit(): Promise<void>;
  cancel(): void;
}

interface RegistryApi {
  report(id: string, status: SectionStatus): void;
  setActions(id: string, actions: SectionActions): void;
  forget(id: string): void;
}

interface RegistryState {
  statuses: Record<string, SectionStatus>;
  actions: RefObject<Map<string, SectionActions>>;
}

const RegistryApiContext = createContext<RegistryApi | null>(null);
const RegistryStateContext = createContext<RegistryState | null>(null);

/**
 * Lets the sticky bar know which sections are dirty and drive them (save all, discard all)
 * without lifting the five forms into the page. Sections register through `useRegisterSection`.
 */
export function SectionRegistryProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [statuses, setStatuses] = useState<Record<string, SectionStatus>>({});
  const actions = useRef(new Map<string, SectionActions>());

  const registry = useMemo<RegistryApi>(
    () => ({
      report: (id, status) =>
        setStatuses((current) => {
          const known = current[id];
          if (known && known.dirty === status.dirty && known.saving === status.saving) {
            return current;
          }
          return { ...current, [id]: status };
        }),
      setActions: (id, value) => {
        actions.current.set(id, value);
      },
      forget: (id) => {
        actions.current.delete(id);
        setStatuses((current) =>
          Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(current).filter(([key]) => key !== id)),
        );
      },
    }),
    [],
  );
  const state = useMemo<RegistryState>(() => ({ statuses, actions }), [statuses]);

  return (
    <RegistryApiContext.Provider value={registry}>
      <RegistryStateContext.Provider value={state}>{children}</RegistryStateContext.Provider>
    </RegistryApiContext.Provider>
  );
}

interface RegisterableForm {
  dirty: boolean;
  saving: boolean;
  submit(): Promise<void>;
  cancel(): void;
}

/** Registers a section's form with the registry. A no-op outside a `SectionRegistryProvider`. */
export function useRegisterSection(id: string, form: RegisterableForm): void {
  const registry = useContext(RegistryApiContext);
  const latest = useRef(form);
  useEffect(() => {
    latest.current = form;
  });
  useEffect(() => {
    registry?.setActions(id, {
      submit: () => latest.current.submit(),
      cancel: () => latest.current.cancel(),
    });
    return () => registry?.forget(id);
  }, [registry, id]);
  const { dirty, saving } = form;
  useEffect(() => {
    registry?.report(id, { dirty, saving });
  }, [registry, id, dirty, saving]);
}

/**
 * Sticky "Unsaved changes" bar (UX doc §4): visible while any section is dirty, with Save changes
 * and Discard changes for all of them, and a `beforeunload` warning for the same period.
 */
export function UnsavedBar() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const state = useContext(RegistryStateContext);
  const statuses = state?.statuses ?? {};
  const dirtyIds = Object.entries(statuses)
    .filter(([, status]) => status.dirty)
    .map(([id]) => id);
  const saving = Object.values(statuses).some((status) => status.saving);
  const anyDirty = dirtyIds.length > 0;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!anyDirty) return;
    const warn = (event: BeforeUnloadEvent) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      event.returnValue = "";
    };
    window.addEventListener("beforeunload", warn);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("beforeunload", warn);
  }, [anyDirty]);

  if (!state || !anyDirty) return null;

  const saveAll = async () => {
    for (const id of dirtyIds) await state.actions.current?.get(id)?.submit();
  };
  const discardAll = () => {
    for (const id of dirtyIds) state.actions.current?.get(id)?.cancel();
  };

  return (
    <section aria-label={t("settings.unsaved.region")} className="sticky bottom-4 z-20 mt-6">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-subtle bg-surface px-4 py-3 shadow-xl">
        <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold text-fg">
          <TriangleAlert aria-hidden size={18} strokeWidth={1.75} className="text-warning" />
          {t("settings.unsaved.title")}
          <span className="font-normal text-muted">
            {t("settings.unsaved.sections", { count: dirtyIds.length })}
          </span>
        </p>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Button variant="ghost" disabled={saving} onClick={discardAll}>
            {t("settings.unsaved.discard")}
          </Button>
          <Button loading={saving} onClick={() => void saveAll()}>
            {t("settings.unsaved.save")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Pencil } from "lucide-react";
import type { FormEvent, KeyboardEvent, ReactNode } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Button, Card, Cascade } from "../../components/ui";

/** The part of `useSectionForm`'s result the card needs. */
export interface SectionControls {
  editing: boolean;
  saving: boolean;
  startEdit(): void;
  cancel(): void;
  submit(): Promise<void>;
}

export interface SectionCardProps {
  /** Anchor id of the card; `backups` is the deep-link target of the notifications. */
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  form: SectionControls;
  /** Position on the page, for the entry cascade. */
  index: number;
  children: ReactNode;
}

/**
 * A settings section: a titled card whose header switches between "Edit section" and
 * Cancel/Save (UX doc §4). The card is a form, so Enter saves and Escape cancels the edit.
 */
export function SectionCard({ id, title, description, form, index, children }: SectionCardProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const titleId = `${id}-title`;

  const onSubmit = (event: FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    void form.submit();
  };
  const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (event.key === "Escape" && form.editing && !form.saving) {
      event.stopPropagation();
      form.cancel();
    }
  };

  return (
    <Cascade index={index}>
      <Card id={id} role="region" aria-labelledby={titleId} padding="none" className="scroll-mt-24">
        <form noValidate onSubmit={onSubmit} onKeyDown={onKeyDown}>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3 border-b border-subtle px-5 py-4">
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <h2 id={titleId} className="font-display text-base font-bold text-fg">
                {title}
              </h2>
              <p className="mt-0.5 text-[13px] text-muted">{description}</p>
            </div>
            {form.editing ? (
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <Button
                  variant="secondary"
                  size="sm"
                  disabled={form.saving}
                  onClick={() => form.cancel()}
                >
                  {t("common.cancel")}
                </Button>
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  type="submit"
                  loading={form.saving}
                  aria-label={t("settings.saveSectionNamed", { section: title })}
                >
                  {t("settings.saveSection")}
                </Button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <Button
                variant="secondary"
                size="sm"
                icon={Pencil}
                aria-label={t("settings.editSectionNamed", { section: title })}
                onClick={() => form.startEdit()}
              >
                {t("settings.editSection")}
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="px-5 py-4">{children}</div>
        </form>
      </Card>
    </Cascade>
  );
}

/** A label/value pair of the read-only view; place inside a `<dl>`. */
export function ReadRow({ label, children }: { label: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="min-w-0">
      <dt className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted">{label}</dt>
      <dd className="mt-0.5 text-sm text-fg">{children}</dd>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import {
  formatAbsolute,
  formatMoney,
  formatRelative,
  type SettingsResponse,
} from "@bursar/shared";
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Select } from "../../components/ui";
import { type Language, setLanguage } from "../../i18n";
import { localeFor } from "../../lib/format";
import { useSaveSettings } from "./save-settings";
import { ReadRow, SectionCard } from "./SectionCard";
import { useRegisterSection } from "./UnsavedBar";
import { useSectionForm } from "./useSectionForm";

/** Countries Enable Banking serves in Europe. The connect wizard narrows this by what the application allows. */
const COUNTRY_CODES = [
  "AT",
  "BE",
  "BG",
  "CH",
  "CY",
  "CZ",
  "DE",
  "DK",
  "EE",
  "ES",
  "FI",
  "FR",
  "GB",
  "GR",
  "HR",
  "HU",
  "IE",
  "IS",
  "IT",
  "LI",
  "LT",
  "LU",
  "LV",
  "MT",
  "NL",
  "NO",
  "PL",
  "PT",
  "RO",
  "SE",
  "SI",
  "SK",
] as const;

const PREVIEW_AMOUNT_MINOR = 123_456;
const PREVIEW_AGE_MS = 2 * 3_600_000;

function isLanguage(value: string): value is Language {
  return value === "it" || value === "en";
}

function regionName(code: string, language: string): string {
  try {
    return new Intl.DisplayNames([language], { type: "region" }).of(code) ?? code;
  } catch {
    return code;
  }
}

/** Live preview of a date, a relative time and an amount in the chosen language. */
function Preview({ language, timeZone }: { language: Language; timeZone: string }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const locale = localeFor(language);
  const reference = useMemo(() => Date.now(), []);
  const rows = [
    ["date", formatAbsolute(reference, locale, timeZone)],
    ["relative", formatRelative(reference - PREVIEW_AGE_MS, reference, locale, timeZone)],
    ["amount", formatMoney(PREVIEW_AMOUNT_MINOR, "EUR", locale)],
  ] as const;
  return (
    <div className="mt-5 rounded-xl bg-surface-2 p-4" aria-live="polite">
      <h3 className="text-[13px] font-semibold text-fg">{t("settings.general.preview.title")}</h3>
      <dl className="mt-3 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
        {rows.map(([id, value]) => (
          <ReadRow key={id} label={t(`settings.general.preview.${id}`)}>
            {value}
          </ReadRow>
        ))}
      </dl>
      <p className="mt-3 text-[13px] text-muted">{t("settings.general.preview.hint")}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

export function GeneralSection({ settings, index }: { settings: SettingsResponse; index: number }) {
  const { t, i18n } = useTranslation();
  const save = useSaveSettings();
  const initial = { locale: settings.values.locale, country: settings.values.country };
  const form = useSectionForm(initial, (values) =>
    save("general", { locale: values.locale, country: values.country }, () =>
      setLanguage(values.locale),
    ),
  );
  useRegisterSection("general", form);

  const { values, errors, editing, saving } = form;
  const timeZone = settings.system.timezone;
  const codes: readonly string[] =
    values.country !== null && !(COUNTRY_CODES as readonly string[]).includes(values.country)
      ? [...COUNTRY_CODES, values.country]
      : COUNTRY_CODES;
  const collator = new Intl.Collator(i18n.language);
  const countryOptions = [
    { value: "", label: t("settings.notSet") },
    ...codes
      .map((code) => ({ value: code, label: regionName(code, i18n.language) }))
      .sort((a, b) => collator.compare(a.label, b.label)),
  ];

  return (
    <SectionCard
      id="settings-general"
      title={t("settings.sections.general.title")}
      description={t("settings.sections.general.description")}
      form={form}
      index={index}
    >
      {editing ? (
        <div className="grid gap-x-6 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <Select
            label={t("settings.general.language")}
            value={values.locale}
            disabled={saving}
            error={errors.locale}
            options={[
              { value: "it", label: t("settings.general.languages.it") },
              { value: "en", label: t("settings.general.languages.en") },
            ]}
            onChange={(event) => {
              if (isLanguage(event.target.value)) form.set("locale", event.target.value);
            }}
          />
          <Select
            label={t("settings.general.country")}
            value={values.country ?? ""}
            disabled={saving}
            error={errors.country}
            options={countryOptions}
            onChange={(event) =>
              form.set("country", event.target.value === "" ? null : event.target.value)
            }
          />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <dl className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <ReadRow label={t("settings.general.language")}>
            {t(`settings.general.languages.${values.locale}`)}
          </ReadRow>
          <ReadRow label={t("settings.general.country")}>
            {values.country === null
              ? t("settings.notSet")
              : regionName(values.country, i18n.language)}
          </ReadRow>
        </dl>
      )}
      <dl className="mt-4">
        <ReadRow label={t("settings.general.timezone")}>
          <span>{timeZone}</span>
          <span className="mt-0.5 block text-[13px] text-muted">
            {t("settings.general.timezoneNote")}
          </span>
        </ReadRow>
      </dl>
      <Preview language={values.locale} timeZone={timeZone} />
    </SectionCard>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { BankStatusResponse, SettingsResponse } from "@bursar/shared";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { api } from "../../api";
import { Button, Select, StatusPill, TextInput } from "../../components/ui";
import { queryKeys } from "../../lib/query-keys";
import { useSaveSettings } from "./save-settings";
import { ReadRow, SectionCard } from "./SectionCard";
import { useRegisterSection } from "./UnsavedBar";
import { useSectionForm } from "./useSectionForm";

const CAP_OPTIONS = [1, 2, 3, 4] as const;

function toNumber(raw: string): number {
  const value = Number(raw);
  return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0;
}

function StatusDetails({ status }: { status: BankStatusResponse }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  if (!status.configured) {
    return (
      <div className="mt-2 flex flex-col items-start gap-2">
        <StatusPill tone="neutral" label={t("settings.banking.status.notConfigured")} />
        <p className="text-[13px] text-muted">{t("settings.banking.status.notConfiguredHint")}</p>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className="mt-2">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {status.environment !== null ? (
          <StatusPill
            tone={status.environment === "PRODUCTION" ? "positive" : "info"}
            label={t(`settings.banking.status.environment.${status.environment}`)}
          />
        ) : null}
        {status.active === null ? null : (
          <StatusPill
            tone={status.active ? "positive" : "danger"}
            label={t(status.active ? "settings.banking.status.active" : "settings.banking.status.inactive")}
          />
        )}
        {status.redirectUrlAllowed === null ? null : (
          <StatusPill
            tone={status.redirectUrlAllowed ? "positive" : "warning"}
            label={t(
              status.redirectUrlAllowed
                ? "settings.banking.status.redirectAllowed"
                : "settings.banking.status.redirectBlocked",
            )}
          />
        )}
      </div>
      {status.redirectUrlAllowed === false ? (
        <p className="mt-2 text-[13px] text-muted">
          {t("settings.banking.status.redirectBlockedHint")}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {status.error !== null ? (
        <p className="mt-2 text-[13px] text-muted">{t("settings.banking.status.unreachable")}</p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

function BankStatus() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.bankStatus,
    queryFn: () => api.bankStatus(),
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });
  return (
    <div className="mt-5 border-t border-subtle pt-4">
      <h3 className="text-[13px] font-semibold text-fg">{t("settings.banking.status.title")}</h3>
      {query.isPending ? (
        <p aria-busy="true" className="mt-2 text-[13px] text-muted">
          {t("settings.banking.status.loading")}
        </p>
      ) : query.isError ? (
        <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          <p className="text-[13px] text-muted">{t("settings.banking.status.failed")}</p>
          <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={() => void query.refetch()}>
            {t("shell.retry")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <StatusDetails status={query.data} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function BankingSection({ settings, index }: { settings: SettingsResponse; index: number }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const save = useSaveSettings();
  const initial = {
    consentDays: settings.values.consentDays,
    backgroundSyncCap: settings.values.backgroundSyncCap,

  };
  const form = useSectionForm(initial, (values) => save("banking", values));
  useRegisterSection("banking", form);

  const { values, errors, editing, saving } = form;

  return (
    <SectionCard

      {editing ? (

          />
          <Select
            label={t("settings.banking.syncCap")}
            hint={t("settings.banking.syncCapHint")}
            value={String(values.backgroundSyncCap)}
            disabled={saving}
            error={errors.backgroundSyncCap}
            options={CAP_OPTIONS.map((cap) => ({ value: String(cap), label: String(cap) }))}
            onChange={(event) => form.set("backgroundSyncCap", toNumber(event.target.value))}
          />
          <TextInput
            label={t("settings.banking.dailyTime")}

            value={values.dailySyncTime}
            disabled={saving}
            error={errors.dailySyncTime}
            onChange={(event) => form.set("dailySyncTime", event.target.value)}
          />
        </div>
      ) : (

          </ReadRow>
          <ReadRow label={t("settings.banking.short.syncCap")}>
            {t("settings.banking.syncCapValue", { count: values.backgroundSyncCap })}
          </ReadRow>
          <ReadRow label={t("settings.banking.short.dailyTime")}>{values.dailySyncTime}</ReadRow>
        </dl>
      )}
      <BankStatus />
    </SectionCard>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { SettingsResponse } from "@bursar/shared";
import { useMutation } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Mail } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { ApiError, api } from "../../api";
import { feedback } from "../../components/feedback";
import { Button, StatusPill, Switch, TextInput } from "../../components/ui";
import { useSaveSettings } from "./save-settings";
import { ReadRow, SectionCard } from "./SectionCard";
import { useRegisterSection } from "./UnsavedBar";
import { useSectionForm } from "./useSectionForm";

type TestOutcome = "sent" | "smtp_not_configured" | "recipient_missing" | "smtp_failed" | "unknown";

const REFUSAL_CODES = ["smtp_not_configured", "recipient_missing", "smtp_failed"] as const;

function outcomeOf(error: unknown): TestOutcome {
  if (error instanceof ApiError) {
    const known = REFUSAL_CODES.find((code) => code === error.code);
    if (known) return known;
  }
  return "unknown";
}

export function NotificationsSection({
  settings,
  index,
}: {
  settings: SettingsResponse;
  index: number;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const save = useSaveSettings();
  const [outcome, setOutcome] = useState<TestOutcome | null>(null);
  const initial = {
    notificationEmail: settings.values.notificationEmail,
    emailNotifications: settings.values.emailNotifications,
  };
  const form = useSectionForm(initial, (values) =>
    save("notifications", {
      notificationEmail: values.notificationEmail?.trim() || null,
      emailNotifications: values.emailNotifications,
    }),
  );
  useRegisterSection("notifications", form);

  const test = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => api.sendTestEmail(),
    onSuccess: () => {
      setOutcome("sent");
      feedback(
        t("settings.notifications.test.sentTitle"),
        t("settings.notifications.test.sentDetail", {
          email: settings.values.notificationEmail ?? "",
        }),
      );
    },
    onError: (error) => setOutcome(outcomeOf(error)),
  });

  const { values, errors, editing, saving } = form;
  const smtp = settings.system.smtpConfigured;

  return (
    <SectionCard
      id="settings-notifications"
      title={t("settings.sections.notifications.title")}
      description={t("settings.sections.notifications.description")}
      form={form}
      index={index}
    >
      {editing ? (
        <div>
          <TextInput
            label={t("settings.notifications.email")}
            hint={t("settings.notifications.emailHint")}
            type="email"
            autoComplete="email"
            placeholder={t("settings.notifications.emailPlaceholder")}
            value={values.notificationEmail ?? ""}
            disabled={saving}
            error={errors.notificationEmail}
            onChange={(event) =>
              form.set("notificationEmail", event.target.value === "" ? null : event.target.value)
            }
          />
          <Switch
            label={t("settings.notifications.enabled")}
            description={t("settings.notifications.enabledHint")}
            checked={values.emailNotifications}
            disabled={saving}
            onChange={(checked) => form.set("emailNotifications", checked)}
          />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <dl className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <ReadRow label={t("settings.notifications.email")}>
            {values.notificationEmail ?? t("settings.notSet")}
          </ReadRow>
          <ReadRow label={t("settings.notifications.enabledShort")}>
            {values.emailNotifications ? t("settings.on") : t("settings.off")}
          </ReadRow>
        </dl>
      )}

      <div className="mt-5 border-t border-subtle pt-4">
        <h3 className="text-[13px] font-semibold text-fg">{t("settings.notifications.smtp.label")}</h3>
        <div className="mt-2 flex flex-col items-start gap-2">
          <StatusPill
            tone={smtp ? "positive" : "warning"}
            label={t(
              smtp ? "settings.notifications.smtp.configured" : "settings.notifications.smtp.notConfigured",
            )}
          />
          {smtp ? null : (
            <p className="text-[13px] text-muted">{t("settings.notifications.smtp.hint")}</p>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            icon={Mail}
            loading={test.isPending}
            disabled={editing}
            title={editing ? t("settings.notifications.test.blocked") : undefined}
            onClick={() => {
              setOutcome(null);
              test.mutate();
            }}
          >
            {t("settings.notifications.test.button")}
          </Button>
        </div>
        {outcome === null ? null : outcome === "sent" ? (
          <output className="mt-2 block text-[13px] text-positive">
            {t("settings.notifications.test.outcomes.sent")}
          </output>
        ) : (
          <p
            role="alert"
            className="mt-2 rounded-lg bg-warning-soft px-3 py-2 text-[13px] text-warning"
          >
            {t(`settings.notifications.test.outcomes.${outcome}`)}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    </SectionCard>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { BackupRunItem, SettingsResponse } from "@bursar/shared";
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { DatabaseBackup, TriangleAlert } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { ApiError, api } from "../../api";
import { feedback } from "../../components/feedback";
import {
  Button,
  type Column,
  DataTable,
  InlineEmpty,
  RelativeTime,
  StatusPill,
  TextInput,
} from "../../components/ui";
import { useFormatters } from "../../lib/format";
import { isSessionExpired } from "../../lib/query-client";
import { queryKeys } from "../../lib/query-keys";
import { useSaveSettings } from "./save-settings";
import { ReadRow, SectionCard } from "./SectionCard";
import { useRegisterSection } from "./UnsavedBar";
import { useSectionForm } from "./useSectionForm";

const RUNS_SHOWN = 8;
const RUNNING_POLL_MS = 3_000;
const BYTE_UNITS = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB"] as const;
const RUN_TONE = { running: "info", succeeded: "positive", failed: "danger" } as const;

/** "1.8 MB": binary steps, one decimal above bytes, in the panel's number format. */
export function formatBytes(bytes: number, locale: string): string {
  let value = bytes;
  let unit = 0;
  while (value >= 1024 && unit < BYTE_UNITS.length - 1) {
    value /= 1024;
    unit += 1;
  }
  const formatted = new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {
    maximumFractionDigits: unit === 0 ? 0 : 1,
  }).format(value);
  return `${formatted} ${BYTE_UNITS[unit] ?? "B"}`;
}

export function BackupsSection({ settings, index }: { settings: SettingsResponse; index: number }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { locale } = useFormatters();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const save = useSaveSettings();
  const status = useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.backups,
    queryFn: () => api.backups(),
    refetchInterval: (query) =>
      query.state.data?.runs.some((run) => run.status === "running") ? RUNNING_POLL_MS : false,
  });
  const initial = { backupTime: settings.values.backupTime };
  const form = useSectionForm(initial, (values) =>
    save("backups", { backupTime: values.backupTime }),
  );
  useRegisterSection("backups", form);

  const run = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => api.runBackup(),
    onSuccess: () => {
      feedback(t("settings.backups.startedTitle"), t("settings.backups.startedDetail"), "info");
      void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.backups });
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      if (isSessionExpired(error)) return;
      if (error instanceof ApiError && error.status === 409) {
        feedback(t("settings.backups.busyTitle"), t("settings.backups.busyDetail"), "warning");
        void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.backups });
        return;
      }
      feedback(t("settings.backups.runFailedTitle"), t("settings.backups.runFailedDetail"), "error");
    },
  });

  const data = status.data;
  const running = data?.runs.some((item) => item.status === "running") ?? false;
  const failures = data?.consecutiveFailures ?? 0;

  const columns: Column<BackupRunItem>[] = [
    {
      id: "started",
      header: t("settings.backups.columns.started"),
      cell: (item) => <RelativeTime at={item.startedAt} />,
    },
    {
      id: "trigger",
      header: t("settings.backups.columns.trigger"),
      hideBelow: "sm",
      cell: (item) => t(`settings.backups.triggers.${item.trigger}`),
    },
    {
      id: "status",
      header: t("settings.backups.columns.status"),
      cell: (item) => (
        <StatusPill
          tone={RUN_TONE[item.status]}
          label={t(`settings.backups.statuses.${item.status}`)}
        />
      ),
    },
    {
      id: "size",
      header: t("settings.backups.columns.size"),
      align: "end",
      hideBelow: "md",
      cell: (item) => (item.sizeBytes === null ? "—" : formatBytes(item.sizeBytes, locale)),
    },
    {
      id: "details",
      header: t("settings.backups.columns.details"),
      hideBelow: "lg",
      className: "max-w-[16rem] truncate",
      cell: (item) =>
        item.errorMessage ? <span title={item.errorMessage}>{item.errorMessage}</span> : "—",
    },
  ];

  return (
    <SectionCard
      id="backups"
      title={t("settings.sections.backups.title")}
      description={t("settings.sections.backups.description")}
      form={form}
      index={index}
    >
      {data?.target === "local" ? (
        <div
          role="note"
          className="mb-4 flex gap-3 rounded-xl bg-warning-soft p-4 text-warning"
        >
          <TriangleAlert aria-hidden size={18} strokeWidth={1.75} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
          <div>
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{t("settings.backups.localOnly.title")}</p>
            <p className="mt-0.5 text-[13px]">{t("settings.backups.localOnly.body")}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <dl className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
        <ReadRow label={t("settings.backups.target")}>
          {data ? (
            <StatusPill
              tone={data.target === "s3" ? "positive" : "warning"}
              label={t(data.target === "s3" ? "settings.backups.targetS3" : "settings.backups.targetLocal")}
            />
          ) : (
            "—"
          )}
        </ReadRow>
        <ReadRow label={t("settings.backups.lastSuccess")}>
          {!data ? (
            "—"
          ) : data.lastSuccessAt === null ? (
            t("settings.backups.never")
          ) : (
            <RelativeTime at={data.lastSuccessAt} />
          )}
        </ReadRow>
        <ReadRow label={t("settings.backups.failures")}>
          {!data ? (
            "—"
          ) : failures === 0 ? (
            <StatusPill tone="positive" label={t("settings.backups.failuresNone")} />
          ) : (
            <StatusPill
              tone={failures >= 2 ? "danger" : "warning"}
              label={t("settings.backups.failuresValue", { count: failures })}
            />
          )}
        </ReadRow>
      </dl>

      {form.editing ? (
        <div className="mt-4 max-w-xs">
          <TextInput
            label={t("settings.backups.nightlyTime")}
            hint={t("settings.backups.nightlyTimeHint", { timezone: settings.system.timezone })}
            type="time"
            value={form.values.backupTime}
            disabled={form.saving}
            error={form.errors.backupTime}
            onChange={(event) => form.set("backupTime", event.target.value)}
          />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <dl className="mt-4">
          <ReadRow label={t("settings.backups.nightlyTime")}>{form.values.backupTime}</ReadRow>
        </dl>
      )}

      <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        <Button
          variant="secondary"
          icon={DatabaseBackup}
          loading={run.isPending}
          disabled={running}
          title={running ? t("settings.backups.runBlocked") : undefined}
          onClick={() => run.mutate()}
        >
          {t("settings.backups.runNow")}
        </Button>
        {running ? (
          <output className="text-[13px] text-muted">{t("settings.backups.running")}</output>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <h3 className="mt-6 text-[13px] font-semibold text-fg">{t("settings.backups.recent")}</h3>
      {status.isError ? (
        <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 rounded-xl bg-danger-soft p-3 text-danger">
          <p className="text-[13px]">{t("settings.backups.loadFailed")}</p>
          <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={() => void status.refetch()}>
            {t("shell.retry")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="mt-2">
          <DataTable
            columns={columns}
            rows={data?.runs.slice(0, RUNS_SHOWN)}
            getRowKey={(item) => item.id}
            loading={status.isPending}
            skeletonRows={3}
            caption={t("settings.backups.caption")}
            empty={
              <InlineEmpty
                icon={DatabaseBackup}
                title={t("settings.backups.empty.title")}
                description={t("settings.backups.empty.body", { time: settings.values.backupTime })}
              />
            }
          />
        </div>
      )}
    </SectionCard>
  );
}
```

```tsx
const SKELETON_CARDS = ["first", "second", "third"] as const;

/** Scrolls to the element named by the URL hash once the cards exist (`/settings#backups`). */
function useScrollToHash(hash: string, ready: boolean): void {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ready || hash.length < 2) return;
    let id = hash.slice(1);
    try {
      id = decodeURIComponent(id);
    } catch {
      // A malformed escape: use the raw text.
    }
    document.getElementById(id)?.scrollIntoView?.({ block: "start" });
  }, [hash, ready]);
}

export function SettingsPage() {

  const settings = useSettingsQuery();
  const { hash } = useLocation();
  useScrollToHash(hash, settings.isSuccess);

  return (

      {settings.isPending ? (
        <div aria-busy="true" className="flex max-w-3xl flex-col gap-5">

            <div
              key={id}
              className="h-40 animate-pulse rounded-2xl border border-subtle bg-surface-2"
            />

        </div>
```

and replace the block that starts with `const NO_ITEMS: PopoverNotification[] = [];` and ends with the closing brace of the Task 4 `useNotificationsFeed` (the JSDoc above `useNotificationsFeed` included) with:

```tsx
const FEED_LIMIT = 6;
const FEED_STALE_MS = 30_000;

/** Tone per event: warnings need attention soon, danger means data is no longer flowing. */
const EVENT_TONES: Record<NotificationEvent, PopoverNotification["tone"]> = {
  consent_expiring: "warning",
  consent_expired: "danger",
  connection_error: "danger",
  sync_failing: "warning",
  backup_failing: "warning",
};

/** Panel paths only: an absolute or protocol-relative link in the data is never followed. */
function safeLink(link: string | null): string | null {
  return link !== null && link.startsWith("/") && !link.startsWith("//") ? link : null;
}

/**
 * Turns a stored notification into popover text: `notifications.events.<event>.title|body`
 * interpolated with the event's params (`days` also drives the plural), the tone of the event and
 * the panel link. An event the panel does not know yet gets a generic text and the info tone.
 */
export function toPopoverNotification(item: NotificationItem, t: TFunction): PopoverNotification {
  const params = item.params;
  const options: Record<string, string | number> = { ...params };
  if (typeof params.days === "number") options.count = params.days;
  const base = `notifications.events.${item.event}`;
  return {
    id: item.id,
    title: t(`${base}.title`, {
      ...options,
      defaultValue: t("notifications.events.generic.title"),
    }),
    body: t(`${base}.body`, {
      ...options,
      defaultValue: t("notifications.events.generic.body"),
    }),
    at: item.createdAt,
    read: item.readAt !== null,
    tone: EVENT_TONES[item.event] ?? "info",
    to: safeLink(item.link),
  };
}

/**
 * Data for the popover: the latest six notifications (`staleTime` 30 s; live events invalidate
 * the query). Opening an unread item marks it read and follows its link; "Mark all as read"
 * clears the badge. Both settle with a refetch, so the unread count always comes from the server.
 */
export function useNotificationsFeed(): NotificationsPopoverProps {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.notifications,
    queryFn: () => api.notifications(FEED_LIMIT),
    staleTime: FEED_STALE_MS,
  });
  const refresh = () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.notifications });
  const markRead = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (id: number) => api.markNotificationRead(id),
    onSettled: refresh,
  });
  const markAll = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => api.markAllNotificationsRead(),
    onSettled: refresh,
  });

  const data = query.data;
  const items = useMemo(
    () => (data?.items ?? []).map((entry) => toPopoverNotification(entry, t)),
    [data, t],
  );

  return {
    items,
    unread: data?.unread ?? 0,
    loading: query.isPending,
    onOpenItem: (id) => {
      const opened = items.find((entry) => entry.id === id);
      if (!opened) return;
      if (!opened.read) markRead.mutate(id);
      if (opened.to) void navigate(opened.to);
    },
    onMarkAllRead: () => markAll.mutate(),
  };
}
```

Create `apps/web/qa/stories.ts`. It reuses Task 5's `qa/lib.ts` (browser, QA server, capture contexts, probe), starts a fresh QA server with the fake bank for every story, drives the panel with real clicks, uses the API only to prepare state and to check the outcome, and fails a story on any console error, page error, CSP violation, 5xx or error boundary (the probe's checks).

```ts
import { mkdirSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { setTimeout as delay } from "node:timers/promises";
import { parseArgs } from "node:util";
import type {
  AccountDetailResponse,
  AccountSummary,
  ConnectionsResponse,
  NotificationListResponse,
  SettingsResponse,
} from "@bursar/shared";
import type { Browser, BrowserContext, Locator, Page } from "playwright-core";
import {
  attachProbe,
  buildWeb,
  CAPTURES,
  errorMessage,
  launchBrowser,
  newCaptureContext,
  OUT_DIR,
  startQaServer,
} from "./lib";

/**
 * End-to-end stories (skill Phase 6): each one is a chain of real clicks against a fresh QA
 * server whose bank is the offline fake (Task 10), with visible results to assert on.
 *
 *   pnpm --filter @bursar/web qa:stories [--skip-build] [--only 1,3]
 *
 * Output: one line per story, `Stories: <p> passed, <f> failed`, then `Review shots: …`.
 * Screenshots: apps/web/qa/out/stories/.
 */

const STORIES_DIR = path.join(OUT_DIR, "stories");
const STEP_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000;
const SYNC_TIMEOUT_MS = 90_000;
const BACKUP_TIMEOUT_MS = 90_000;

/** The fake bank connected in stories 1 and 2: names come from `FakeEnableBanking` (Task 10). */
const FAKE_BANK = {
  name: "Banca Esempio",
  country: "IT",
  accounts: ["Conto Esempio", "Deposito Esempio"],
} as const;

/** A currency symbol next to digits: how an amount looks in the visible text. */
const AMOUNT = /(?:US\$|[€£$])\s?\d[\d.,]*|\d[\d.,]*\s?[€£$]/;
/** An English-format amount (`€1,234.56`) and an Italian-format number (`1.234,56`). */
const AMOUNT_EN = /[€$]\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})*\.\d{2}/;
const NUMBER_IT = /\d\.\d{3},\d{2}/;
const MASK = "•••••";

/**
 * The labels the stories click or wait for. Stories 1 to 3 and 5 run with the panel in English
 * (`useEnglish`); story 4 starts in Italian and uses this task's own Italian strings. The English
 * patterns come from Tasks 4 and 17 to 21; if one of those pages words a control differently,
 * change the pattern here and nowhere else.
 */
const UI = {
  connectBank: /connect a bank/i,
  continueTo: (bank: string) => new RegExp(`continue to ${bank}`, "i"),
  openAccounts: /open accounts/i,
  syncCompleted: /sync completed/i,
  renew: /renew/i,
  menu: /more|actions|menu/i,
  disconnectItem: /^disconnect/i,
  confirmDisconnect: /^yes, disconnect/i,
  disconnectedAccounts: /disconnected accounts/i,
  purge: /purge/i,
  confirmPurge: /^yes, purge/i,
  privacyOn: /privacy mode on/i,
  privacyOff: /privacy mode off/i,
} as const;

interface StoryContext {
  page: Page;
  context: BrowserContext;
  baseUrl: string;
  /** GET a JSON API path with the story's session. */
  get<T>(apiPath: string): Promise<T>;
  /** PATCH or POST JSON with the Origin header the server requires. */
  send<T>(method: "PATCH" | "POST", apiPath: string, data: unknown): Promise<T>;
  /** Full-page screenshot into apps/web/qa/out/stories/. */
  shot(name: string): Promise<void>;
}

interface Story {
  id: number;
  slug: string;
  title: string;
  run(ctx: StoryContext): Promise<void>;
}

function check(condition: boolean, message: string): asserts condition {
  if (!condition) throw new Error(message);
}

/** Runs one named step; a failure keeps the step name so the report says where the story broke. */
async function step<T>(name: string, action: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  try {
    return await action();
  } catch (error) {
    throw new Error(`${name}: ${errorMessage(error)}`);
  }
}

async function pollUntil(
  label: string,
  condition: () => Promise<boolean>,
  timeoutMs = STEP_TIMEOUT_MS,
): Promise<void> {
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
    if (await condition()) return;
    await delay(500);
  }
  throw new Error(`timed out after ${timeoutMs} ms waiting for ${label}`);
}

/** Waits until the text of `main` satisfies `predicate`; returns that text. */
async function waitForMain(
  page: Page,
  label: string,
  predicate: (text: string) => boolean,
  timeoutMs = STEP_TIMEOUT_MS,
): Promise<string> {
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
  let text = "";
  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
    text = await page.locator("main").first().innerText();
    if (predicate(text)) return text;
    await delay(250);
  }
  throw new Error(`timed out waiting for ${label}; main said: ${text.replace(/\s+/g, " ").slice(0, 200)}`);
}

function createStoryContext(
  page: Page,
  context: BrowserContext,
  baseUrl: string,
  slug: string,
): StoryContext {
  const call = async <T>(method: "GET" | "PATCH" | "POST", apiPath: string, data?: unknown) => {
    const response = await context.request.fetch(`${baseUrl}${apiPath}`, {
      method,
      data,
      headers: { origin: baseUrl },
    });
    if (!response.ok()) throw new Error(`${method} ${apiPath} answered ${response.status()}`);
    return (await response.json()) as T;
  };
  return {
    page,
    context,
    baseUrl,
    get: <T>(apiPath: string) => call<T>("GET", apiPath),
    send: <T>(method: "PATCH" | "POST", apiPath: string, data: unknown) =>
      call<T>(method, apiPath, data),
    async shot(name) {
      mkdirSync(STORIES_DIR, { recursive: true });
      await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(STORIES_DIR, `${slug}-${name}.png`), fullPage: true });
    },
  };
}

/** English UI for the story: the saved locale and the browser's stored choice both say "en". */
async function useEnglish(ctx: StoryContext): Promise<void> {
  await ctx.context.addInitScript(() => {
    try {
      globalThis.localStorage.setItem("bursar.language", "en");
    } catch {
      // Storage is unavailable: the saved locale applies once settings load.
    }
  });
  await ctx.send<SettingsResponse>("PATCH", "/api/settings", { locale: "en" });
}

const sidebarLink = (page: Page, name: RegExp): Locator =>
  page.getByRole("navigation").getByRole("link", { name }).first();

const linkOrButton = (page: Page, name: RegExp): Locator =>
  page.getByRole("link", { name }).or(page.getByRole("button", { name })).first();

/** Resolves true when a toast matching `text` shows up; never rejects, so it can run unattended. */
function watchToast(page: Page, text: RegExp): Promise<boolean> {
  return page
    .getByText(text)
    .first()
    .waitFor({ state: "visible", timeout: SYNC_TIMEOUT_MS })
    .then(
      () => true,
      () => false,
    );
}

/**
 * The smallest element that holds `text` and a button named `button`: a connection card (or its
 * header). Pick `text` and `button` so the match cannot be a single account row.
 */
function cardWith(page: Page, text: string, button: RegExp): Locator {
  return page
    .locator("div, section, article, li")
    .filter({ hasText: text })
    .filter({ has: page.getByRole("button", { name: button }) })
    .last();
}

/**
 * Accounts → Connect a bank → the wizard's consent step → the fake bank → the callback page.
 * The wizard keeps step, country and bank in the URL (Task 20), so the country and bank steps are
 * a URL jump; the consent button and everything after it are real clicks. Resolves with a watcher
 * for the "Sync completed" toast, started as soon as the callback has finished.
 */
async function connectBank(ctx: StoryContext): Promise<{ syncToast: Promise<boolean> }> {
  const { page } = ctx;
  await step("open Connect a bank from the Accounts page", async () => {
    await page.goto(`${ctx.baseUrl}/accounts`, { waitUntil: "load" });
    await linkOrButton(page, UI.connectBank).click();
    await page.waitForURL(/\/connect(\?|$)/);
  });
  await step("reach the consent step and continue to the bank", async () => {
    const bank = encodeURIComponent(FAKE_BANK.name);
    await page.goto(
      `${ctx.baseUrl}/connect?step=consent&country=${FAKE_BANK.country}&bank=${bank}`,
      { waitUntil: "load" },
    );
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: UI.continueTo(FAKE_BANK.name) }).click();
  });
  await step("come back from the fake bank to the callback page", async () => {
    await page.waitForURL(/\/connect\/callback/);
    await linkOrButton(page, UI.openAccounts).waitFor();
  });
  return { syncToast: watchToast(page, UI.syncCompleted) };
}

async function connectedAccounts(ctx: StoryContext): Promise<AccountSummary[]> {
  const { connections } = await ctx.get<ConnectionsResponse>("/api/connections");
  const names: readonly string[] = FAKE_BANK.accounts;
  return connections.flatMap((connection) =>
    connection.accounts.filter((account) => names.includes(account.name)),
  );
}

/** Waits until both accounts of the fake bank exist and hold transactions; returns them. */
async function waitForInitialSync(ctx: StoryContext): Promise<AccountSummary[]> {
  await pollUntil(
    "both accounts of the new connection to hold transactions",
    async () => {
      const accounts = await connectedAccounts(ctx);
      if (accounts.length !== FAKE_BANK.accounts.length) return false;
      const details = await Promise.all(
        accounts.map((account) => ctx.get<AccountDetailResponse>(`/api/accounts/${account.id}`)),
      );
      return details.every((detail) => detail.transactionCount > 0);
    },
    SYNC_TIMEOUT_MS,
  );
  return connectedAccounts(ctx);
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

const connectSyncTransactions: Story = {
  id: 1,
  slug: "connect-sync-transactions",
  title: "Connect a bank, see its accounts, sync, read the transactions",
  async run(ctx) {
    const { page } = ctx;
    await useEnglish(ctx);
    const { syncToast } = await connectBank(ctx);
    await step("the callback lists the accounts the bank returned", async () => {
      for (const name of FAKE_BANK.accounts) await page.getByText(name).first().waitFor();
    });
    await step("Open accounts leads to the Accounts page, which lists them", async () => {
      await linkOrButton(page, UI.openAccounts).click();
      await page.waitForURL(/\/accounts$/);
      for (const name of FAKE_BANK.accounts) await page.getByText(name).first().waitFor();
    });
    await step("the sync finishes with a toast and the accounts hold transactions", async () => {
      check(await syncToast, "no 'Sync completed' toast appeared");
      await waitForInitialSync(ctx);
    });
    await step("Transactions lists rows of the new accounts", async () => {
      await sidebarLink(page, /^Transactions/).click();
      await page.waitForURL(/\/transactions/);
      const rows = page
        .locator("tbody tr")
        .filter({ hasText: new RegExp(FAKE_BANK.accounts.join("|")) });
      await rows.first().waitFor();
      check((await rows.count()) > 0, "no transaction row shows one of the new accounts");
    });
    await ctx.shot("transactions");
  },
};

const renewConsent: Story = {
  id: 2,
  slug: "renew-consent",
  title: "Renew an expiring connection: the accounts keep their names and history",
  async run(ctx) {
    const { page } = ctx;
    await useEnglish(ctx);
    // A 10-day consent makes the new connection "expiring" at once, so Renew is its primary action.
    await ctx.send("PATCH", "/api/settings", { consentDays: 10 });
    await connectBank(ctx);
    const before = await step("wait for the first sync, name one account", async () => {
      const accounts = await waitForInitialSync(ctx);
      const first = accounts[0];
      check(first !== undefined, "the connection has no accounts");
      await ctx.send("PATCH", `/api/accounts/${first.id}`, { nickname: "Household" });
      const detail = await ctx.get<AccountDetailResponse>(`/api/accounts/${first.id}`);
      check(
        detail.connection.status === "expiring",
        `expected an expiring connection, found ${detail.connection.status}`,
      );
      return Promise.all(
        accounts.map(async (account) => ({
          id: account.id,
          transactions: (await ctx.get<AccountDetailResponse>(`/api/accounts/${account.id}`))
            .transactionCount,
        })),
      );
    });
    await step("renew from the Accounts page and land on the callback", async () => {
      await ctx.send("PATCH", "/api/settings", { consentDays: 180 });
      await page.goto(`${ctx.baseUrl}/accounts`, { waitUntil: "load" });
      await page.getByText("Household").first().waitFor();
      await cardWith(page, "Household", UI.renew).getByRole("button", { name: UI.renew }).first().click();
      await page.waitForURL(/\/connect\/callback/);
      await linkOrButton(page, UI.openAccounts).waitFor();
    });
    await step("the same accounts keep their names and history", async () => {
      const { connections } = await ctx.get<ConnectionsResponse>("/api/connections");
      const first = before[0];
      check(first !== undefined, "no account was recorded before the renewal");
      const owner = connections.find((connection) =>
        connection.accounts.some((account) => account.id === first.id),
      );
      check(owner !== undefined, "the connection disappeared after the renewal");
      check(owner.accounts.length === before.length, `the connection now has ${owner.accounts.length} accounts`);
      for (const old of before) {
        const account = owner.accounts.find((candidate) => candidate.id === old.id);
        check(account !== undefined, "an account was replaced instead of kept");
        const detail = await ctx.get<AccountDetailResponse>(`/api/accounts/${old.id}`);
        check(
          detail.transactionCount >= old.transactions,
          `history shrank from ${old.transactions} to ${detail.transactionCount} transactions`,
        );
      }
      check(
        owner.accounts.some((account) => account.id === first.id && account.name === "Household"),
        "the nickname was lost",
      );
      check(owner.status === "active", `expected an active connection, found ${owner.status}`);
      check(owner.renewedAt !== null, "the connection does not record the renewal");
    });
    await step("Accounts still shows the renamed account", async () => {
      await linkOrButton(page, UI.openAccounts).click();
      await page.waitForURL(/\/accounts$/);
      await page.getByText("Household").first().waitFor();
    });
    await ctx.shot("renewed");
  },
};

const disconnectAndPurge: Story = {
  id: 3,
  slug: "disconnect-purge",
  title: "Disconnect a bank, then purge its transactions",
  async run(ctx) {
    const { page } = ctx;
    await useEnglish(ctx);
    // Seeded connection in error state (Task 6): "Polaris Finance" with the account "Compte Courant".
    const bank = "Polaris Finance";
    const account = "Compte Courant";
    await step("open Accounts and find the connection", async () => {
      await page.goto(`${ctx.baseUrl}/accounts`, { waitUntil: "load" });
      await page.getByText(account).first().waitFor();
    });
    await step("disconnect it from the connection menu and confirm", async () => {
      const card = cardWith(page, bank, UI.menu);
      await card.getByRole("button", { name: UI.menu }).first().click();
      await page
        .locator('[role="menuitem"], button')
        .filter({ hasText: UI.disconnectItem })
        .first()
        .click();
      const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog");
      await dialog.getByText(new RegExp(`disconnect ${bank}\\?`, "i")).waitFor();
      await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: UI.confirmDisconnect }).click();
      await dialog.waitFor({ state: "detached" });
    });
    await step("it moved to Disconnected accounts", async () => {
      await page.getByText(UI.disconnectedAccounts).first().waitFor();
      await pollUntil("the API to list the account as removed", async () => {
        const { connections, removedAccounts } = await ctx.get<ConnectionsResponse>("/api/connections");
        return (
          !connections.some((connection) => connection.bankName === bank) &&
          removedAccounts.some((removed) => removed.name === account)
        );
      });
    });
    await ctx.shot("disconnected");
    await step("purge its transactions and confirm", async () => {
      const row = page
        .locator("li, tr, div")
        .filter({ hasText: account })
        .filter({ has: page.getByRole("button", { name: UI.purge }) })
        .last();
      await row.getByRole("button", { name: UI.purge }).click();
      const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog");
      await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: UI.confirmPurge }).click();
      await dialog.waitFor({ state: "detached" });
    });
    await step("it disappears from the page and from the API", async () => {
      await pollUntil("the page to stop showing the account", async () => {
        return (await page.getByText(account).count()) === 0;
      });
      const { removedAccounts } = await ctx.get<ConnectionsResponse>("/api/connections");
      check(
        !removedAccounts.some((removed) => removed.name === account),
        "the purged account is still listed",
      );
      check(removedAccounts.length >= 1, "the other disconnected account was purged too");
    });
    await ctx.shot("purged");
  },
};

  title: "Switch the language in Settings: the UI and the money preview follow",
  async run(ctx) {
    const { page } = ctx;

      await page.getByRole("region", { name: "Modifiche non salvate" }).waitFor();

      await page.getByText("Settings saved").first().waitFor();
      check(

      check(
        /€1,234\.56/.test(await general.innerText()),

    });
    await ctx.shot("english");
    await step("the user menu switch is stored too: Italian survives a reload", async () => {
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Open the user menu" }).click();
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Italiano" }).click();
      await sidebarLink(page, /^Movimenti/).waitFor();
      await page.reload({ waitUntil: "load" });
      await sidebarLink(page, /^Movimenti/).waitFor();
      check(
        (await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.lang)) === "it",
        "<html lang> is not Italian after the reload",
      );
      const settings = await ctx.get<SettingsResponse>("/api/settings");
      check(settings.values.locale === "it", `the saved locale is ${settings.values.locale}`);
    });
```
